verses.sanskrit: शिवः सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्च त्रिगुणात्मा निरञ्जनः | सर्वव्यापी महादेवो योगिनां हृदि संस्थितः ||
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ sattvaṃ rajastamaśca triguṇātmā nirañjanaḥ | sarvavyāpī mahādevo yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ ||
verses.translation: Shiva is sattva, rajas, and tamas — the soul of the three gunas, yet unstained. The great God is all-pervading, dwelling in the hearts of yogins.
verses.hindi: शिव सत्त्व, रज और तम — तीनों गुणों के आत्मा हैं, फिर भी निरञ्जन हैं। महादेव सर्वव्यापी हैं — योगियों के हृदय में स्थित हैं।
verses.commentary: The Mahesvara Khanda's foundational paradox: Shiva is "triguṇātmā" — the self of the three gunas, the substratum from which all qualities emerge — and simultaneously "nirañjana" — unstained, unmodified. How can the absolute contain all qualities without being affected by them? As the mirror is not coloured by the images it reflects. Shiva is the ground of manifestation, not its product. "Yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ" — dwelling in the hearts of yogins: Shiva is found not only in sacred geography but in the inner space that sustained practice opens. The entire Skanda Purana balances these two: the outer pilgrimage (tirtha) and the inner recognition (yoga).

verses.sanskrit: एकबाणेन तत्सर्वं दग्धं ब्रह्माण्डमण्डलम् | त्रिपुरं च महेशेन योगाग्नौ भस्मसात्कृतम् ||
verses.transliteration: ekabaṇena tatsarvaṃ dagdhaṃ brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalam | tripuraṃ ca maheśena yogāgnau bhasmasātkṛtam ||
verses.translation: With a single arrow, the entire cosmic circle was burned. The three cities were reduced to ash by Maheshvara in the fire of yoga.
verses.hindi: एक ही बाण से समस्त ब्रह्माण्ड-मण्डल जल गया। त्रिपुर को महेश्वर ने योगाग्नि में भस्म कर दिया।
verses.commentary: The Tripura-daha teaching: Shiva waits until the three cities align into one straight line before releasing the single arrow. The waiting is the teaching — liberation is not produced by force or continuous effort but released at the precise moment when all three levels (gross, subtle, causal) align simultaneously. The single arrow is the pure act of awareness — the recognition of the witness-self that dissolves all three levels at once. "Yogāgnau" — in the fire of yoga, not an external conflagration. The destruction is interior.

verses.sanskrit: महाकालो महादेवः कालः कालस्य कालकः | कालचक्रप्रवर्तको मोक्षदः परमेश्वरः ||
verses.transliteration: mahākālo mahādevaḥ kālaḥ kālasya kālakaḥ | kālacakrapravartako mokṣadaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||
verses.translation: Mahakala is the great God — Time itself, the time of time, the kala of kala. The one who sets the wheel of time in motion — the giver of liberation, the supreme Lord.
verses.hindi: महाकाल महादेव हैं — स्वयं काल, काल के भी काल। कालचक्र को गति देने वाले — मोक्षदाता, परमेश्वर।
verses.commentary: The theology of Mahakala — Shiva as the lord of time — developed to its fullest here. "Kālasya kālakaḥ" — the kala of kala: the time of time itself. Time governs all beings; Shiva governs time. He is not subject to time because he is time's innermost nature. The phrase "kālacakrapravartakaḥ" — the one who sets the wheel of time in motion — is important: Shiva does not destroy time (that would be nihilism) but is its ground and mover. From within time, as its very energy. "Mokṣadaḥ" — giver of liberation: liberation from what? From the false identification with the time-bound self — the one who was born and will die. Mahakala's worship is the recognition that the awareness witnessing time is itself timeless.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानि सर्वाणि तथा गङ्गादि सर्वतो दिशि | तीर्थभूता शिवभक्ताः शिवे भक्तिमन्त्रताः ||
verses.transliteration: tīrthāni sarvāṇi tathā gaṅgādi sarvato diśi | tīrthabhūtā śivabhaktāḥ śive bhaktimantaratāḥ ||
verses.translation: All sacred places, and the Ganga in all directions — Shiva devotees themselves are the sacred places, those who are devoted to Shiva with deep faith.
verses.hindi: सभी तीर्थ, और सभी दिशाओं में गंगा — शिव भक्त स्वयं तीर्थ हैं, जो शिव में गहरी भक्ति रखते हैं।
verses.commentary: The Skanda Purana teaches that the true tirtha is not a place but a person — specifically, the Shiva devotee. All external sacred places and the Ganga in all directions are secondary to the devotee who embodies devotion. This is the radical teaching: the sacred geography is internalised in the devotee. The devotee becomes the tirtha.

verses.sanskrit: शिवः सर्वभूतानां हृदये संनिविष्टः | यो जानाति स पश्यति यो न जानाति न पश्यति ||
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛdaye saṃniviṣṭaḥ | yo jānāti sa paśyati yo na jānāti na paśyati ||
verses.translation: Shiva dwells in the heart of all beings. He who knows, sees; he who does not know, does not see.
verses.hindi: शिव सभी प्राणियों के हृदय में निवास करते हैं। जो जानता है, वह देखता है; जो नहीं जानता, वह नहीं देखता।
verses.commentary: The Skanda Purana declares that Shiva dwells in the heart of all beings — not in distant heavens but in the innermost center of every living being. The verse then states the paradox of recognition: knowledge is seeing, ignorance is blindness. Shiva is equally present in all hearts, but only those who know can see. The seeing is not visual but recognitional — the recognition of the presence that is always there.

verses.sanskrit: शिवः साक्षात् परं ब्रह्म निर्गुणो निश्चलः शुद्धः | योगिनां हृदये नित्यं शिवो भवति साक्षात् ||
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ sākṣāt paraṃ brahma nirguṇo niścalaḥ śuddhaḥ | yogināṃ hṛdaye nityaṃ śivo bhavati sākṣāt ||
verses.translation: Shiva is indeed the supreme Brahman — without qualities, unmoving, pure. In the hearts of yogins, Shiva is indeed present.
verses.hindi: शिव साक्षात् परम ब्रह्म हैं — निर्गुण, निश्चल, शुद्ध। योगियों के हृदय में शिव साक्षात् विराजमान हैं।
verses.commentary: The Skanda Purana identifies Shiva with the supreme Brahman — nirguna (without qualities), nishcala (unmoving), shuddha (pure). This is the non-dual teaching: Shiva is not a deity among deities but the absolute reality itself. The verse then states that this absolute reality is present in the hearts of yogins — not as a distant abstraction but as immediate presence. The yogin's heart is the location where the absolute becomes accessible.

verses.sanskrit: काश्यां मरणान्मुक्तिः सर्वेषां प्राणिनामपि | तारकं ब्रह्म तत्रैव जपते शङ्करः स्वयम् ||
verses.transliteration: kāśyāṃ maraṇānmuktiḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmapi | tārakaṃ brahma tatraiva japate śaṅkaraḥ svayam ||
verses.translation: In Kashi, liberation comes through death — for all beings. There, Shankara himself whispers the Taraka Brahman.
verses.hindi: काशी में मृत्यु से मुक्ति मिलती है — सभी प्राणियों को। वहाँ शंकर स्वयं तारक ब्रह्म जपते हैं।
verses.commentary: The most theologically radical verse of the Kashi Khanda. "Sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmapi" — for all beings, without exception. Not virtuous beings. Not initiated beings. All — including animals, insects, and those who have lived in complete ignorance. The mechanism: Shiva personally whispers the Taraka mantra (Ram-nama, the liberating name) into the ear of every dying person in Kashi. Liberation here is not earned but given — by grace, by place, at the final moment. This is the Shaiva expression of unconditional mercy. The tradition also notes the paradox: Kashi is the place where even the worst sinner is liberated, making it simultaneously the most democratic and the most spiritually potent location on earth.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गा च यमुना चैव गोदावरी सरस्वती | नर्मदा सिन्धु कावेरी जले अस्मिन् सन्निधिं कुरु ||
verses.transliteration: gaṅgā ca yamunā caiva godāvarī sarasvatī | narmadā sindhu kāverī jale asmin sannidhiṃ kuru ||
verses.translation: Ganga, Yamuna, Godavari, Sarasvati, Narmada, Sindhu, Kaveri — be present in this water.
verses.hindi: गङ्गा, यमुना, गोदावरी, सरस्वती, नर्मदा, सिन्धु, कावेरी — इस जल में सन्निधि करो।
verses.commentary: The saptanadi mantra — invoking all seven sacred rivers into one vessel of water. The Kashi Khanda's most widely used practical verse. Its theological content: all sacred waters are one water. The seven rivers span the entire subcontinent — north (Ganga, Yamuna), invisible (Sarasvati, the disappeared river of wisdom), central (Narmada), south (Kaveri), northwest (Sindhu), Deccan (Godavari). Invoking all seven into one vessel is the enactment of non-duality: the many sanctities are one sanctity. The invisible Sarasvati is particularly significant — the river of wisdom that flows underground, unseen, present everywhere even when not visible.

Time governs all beings; Shiva governs time. He is not subject to time because he is time's innermost nature. The phrase "kālacakrapravartakaḥ" — the one who sets the wheel of time in motion — is important: Shiva does not destroy time (that would be nihilism) but is its ground and mover. verses.commentary: The Skanda Purana teaches that the true tirtha is not a place but a person — specifically, the Shiva devotee. All external sacred places and the Ganga in all directions are secondary to the devotee who embodies devotion. This is the radical teaching: the sacred geography is internalised in the devotee. The devotee becomes the tirtha.

verses.commentary: The Skanda Purana declares that Shiva dwells in the heart of all beings — not in distant heavens but in the innermost center of every living being. The verse then states the paradox of recognition: knowledge is seeing, ignorance is blindness. Shiva is equally present in all hearts, but only those who know can see. The seeing is not visual but recognitional — the recognition of the presence that is always there.

verses.sanskrit: एकबाणेन तत्सर्वं दग्धं ब्रह्माण्डमण्डलम् | त्रिपुरं च महेशेन योगाग्नौ भस्मसात्कृतम् ||
verses.transliteration: ekabaṇena tatsarvaṃ dagdhaṃ brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalam | tripuraṃ ca maheśena yogāgnau bhasmasātkṛtam ||
verses.translation: With a single arrow, the entire cosmic circle was burned. The three cities were reduced to ash by Maheshvara in the fire of yoga.
verses.hindi: एक ही बाण से समस्त ब्रह्माण्ड-मण्डल जल गया। त्रिपुर को महेश्वर ने योगाग्नि में भस्म कर दिया।
verses.commentary: The Tripura-daha teaching: Shiva waits until the three cities align into one straight line before releasing the single arrow. The waiting is the teaching — liberation is not produced by force or continuous effort but released at the precise moment when all three levels (gross, subtle, causal) align simultaneously. The single arrow is the pure act of awareness — the recognition of the witness-self that dissolves all three levels at once. "Yogāgnau" — in the fire of yoga, not an external conflagration. The destruction is interior.

verses.sanskrit: सोमनाथं ज्योतिर्लिङ्गं सर्वपापहरं परम् | दर्शनात्स्पर्शनात् नित्यं मुक्तिदं शिवसन्निधौ ||
verses.transliteration: somanāthaṃ jyotirliṅgaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ param | darśanātsparśanāt nityaṃ muktidam śivasannidhau ||
verses.translation: Somnath — the supreme jyotirlinga — remover of all sin. By its vision, by its touch — always, in Shiva's nearness — it grants liberation.
verses.hindi: सोमनाथ — सर्वोच्च ज्योतिर्लिङ्ग — सभी पापों को हरने वाला। दर्शन से, स्पर्श से — नित्य, शिव की सन्निधि में — मुक्तिदायक।
verses.commentary: The Somnath mahatmya: the jyotirlinga as a column of light (jyoti = light; linga = sign/mark) that is simultaneously the symbol of Shiva and Shiva himself. "Darśanāt sparśanāt" — by seeing, by touching: the physical senses become instruments of liberation at the jyotirlinga. This is the Skanda Purana's most direct statement of sacred materiality — the divine is not only in formless contemplation but in the material contact with consecrated form. The jyotirlinga is a "sign of light": the physical stone is not the light, but it reliably points to and participates in the light. Somnath has been destroyed multiple times and rebuilt each time — the Prabhasa Khanda's implicit teaching: the light cannot be destroyed, only the stone.

verses.translation: Breaking it (the egg) the four-faced being, Pitamaha, was born. He created thus the universe consisting of Devas, Asuras and human beings, animals, creatures and birds, the sweat-born, egg-born and the embryo-born ones. This egg is proclaimed as the first one in the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तस् तदा राजा प्रार्थये ऽहं तवाज्ञया । यदि तुष्टो ऽसि मे देव कार्यं तत् कथयाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: evam uktas tadā rājā prārthaye 'haṃ tavājñayā / yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva kāryaṃ tat kathayāmy aham
verses.translation: Then all the Devas and Asuras approached the girl saying, "I shall seize her, I shall seize her." Even as all were watching her, the girl vanished. Then they saw her stationed a Yojana away. All of them then rushed to the place where she was seen. Then they saw her stationed three or four Yojanas away. Then the lady of elephantine gait vanished and stationed herself hundreds and thousands of Yojanas away. On account of her lightness she was seen hundred thousands of Yojanas away. They saw her sometimes ahead and sometimes behind in different directions and intermediate quarters. The beautiful lady appeared in one direction and many directions. Thus they were forced to wander about by her for a period of a thousand divine years. But that girl born of Mahadeva's limbs was not attained by them. Thereupon the Lord laughed boisterously along with Uma.
verses.hindi: वेगसे चली और पर्यक-पर्वतकी चोटीपर होती हुई उस स्थानपर पहुँची, जहाँ पूर्वकालमें राजा पृथुने अश्वमेध यज्ञ किया था। वहीं एक बाँसके मूलभागसे महानदी नर्मदा निकली। उस समय

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते नदी महाभागा नर्मदा नाम विश्रुता । अवतारयतां शम्भो कुमारीं दिव्यरूपिणीम्
verses.transliteration: āste nadī mahābhāgā narmadā nāma viśrutā / avatārayatāṃ śambho kumārīṃ divyarūpiṇīm
verses.translation: The Ganas joyously danced in accordance with the beating of the time. Suddenly the girl was seen very near Sankara. On seeing her the wonder-struck Devas returned with faces turned away. Then the Pinaka-bearing Lord himself gave her a name: "Since you humoured them by means of your pranks and gambols, O beautiful girl, you will become the excellent river Narmada ( Narma, humour+da, giver)." The Lord resumed his form and joked. This river of cool water and auspicious features was called Narmada by him. When the destruction of the seven Kalpas, as was said by Sambhu before, took place, O great king, she did not die. She became well-known as Narmada. Then he gave that well-behaved, splendid girl to the great Ocean. The Lord, the Lord of Devas, the Lord of all living beings and goblins gave her to the Ocean. Thereafter the divine river Narmada laughing boisterously through the foams de- scended from the great mountain Rksa and entered the Ocean, the Lord of rivers. Thus she was born of Isvara in the Brahma Kalpa and was seen by me in Matsya Kalpa. Listen as described by me.
verses.hindi: सब देवता, गन्धर्व, यक्ष, मरुत्, अश्विनीकुमार, पिशाच, राक्षस, नाग और तपोधन ऋषि-सब लोग अर्घ्य और पाद्यसे पूजन करके नर्मदाजीकी शरणमें प्राप्त हुए और बोले- आज हमलोगोंका

verses.sanskrit: तेजः शब्दम् च भारं च तस्याः पातं रयं तथा । असमर्था नगा वोढुं त्वामृते गिरिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: tejaḥ śabdam ca bhāraṃ ca tasyāḥ pātaṃ rayaṃ tathā / asamarthā nagā voḍhuṃ tvāmṛte girisattama
verses.translation: The Ganas joyously danced in accordance with the beating of the time. Suddenly the girl was seen very near Sankara. On seeing her the wonder-struck Devas returned with faces turned away. Then the Pinaka-bearing Lord himself gave her a name: "Since you humoured them by means of your pranks and gambols, O beautiful girl, you will become the excellent river Narmada ( Narma, humour+da, giver)." The Lord resumed his form and joked. This river of cool water and auspicious features was called Narmada by him. When the destruction of the seven Kalpas, as was said by Sambhu before, took place, O great king, she did not die. She became well-known as Narmada. Then he gave that well-behaved, splendid girl to the great Ocean. The Lord, the Lord of Devas, the Lord of all living beings and goblins gave her to the Ocean. Thereafter the divine river Narmada laughing boisterously through the foams de- scended from the great mountain Rksa and entered the Ocean, the Lord of rivers. Thus she was born of Isvara in the Brahma Kalpa and was seen by me in Matsya Kalpa. Listen as described by me.

verses.transliteration: yena pūtatvam āyānti narmade naṣṭakilviṣāḥ / narmadā tu vadatyevaṃ na spṛśāmi surān gaṇān
verses.translation: The Ganas joyously danced in accordance with the beating of the time. Suddenly the girl was seen very near Sankara. On seeing her the wonder-struck Devas returned with faces turned away. Then the Pinaka-bearing Lord himself gave her a name: "Since you humoured them by means of your pranks and gambols, O beautiful girl, you will become the excellent river Narmada ( Narma, humour+da, giver)." The Lord resumed his form and joked. This river of cool water and auspicious features was called Narmada by him. When the destruction of the seven Kalpas, as was said by Sambhu before, took place, O great king, she did not die. She became well-known as Narmada. Then he gave that well-behaved, splendid girl to the great Ocean. The Lord, the Lord of Devas, the Lord of all living beings and goblins gave her to the Ocean. Thereafter the divine river Narmada laughing boisterously through the foams de- scended from the great mountain Rksa and entered the Ocean, the Lord of rivers. Thus she was born of Isvara in the Brahma Kalpa and was seen by me in Matsya Kalpa. Listen as described by me.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदां प्रातर् उत्थाय ये स्मरन्ति विचक्षणाः । पूर्वजन्मकृतं पापमैहिकश् च विनश्यति
verses.transliteration: narmadāṃ prātar utthāya ye smaranti vicakṣaṇāḥ / pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ pāpamaihikaś ca vinaśyati
verses.translation: The Ganas joyously danced in accordance with the beating of the time. Suddenly the girl was seen very near Sankara. On seeing her the wonder-struck Devas returned with faces turned away. Then the Pinaka-bearing Lord himself gave her a name: "Since you humoured them by means of your pranks and gambols, O beautiful girl, you will become the excellent river Narmada ( Narma, humour+da, giver)." The Lord resumed his form and joked. This river of cool water and auspicious features was called Narmada by him. When the destruction of the seven Kalpas, as was said by Sambhu before, took place, O great king, she did not die. She became well-known as Narmada. Then he gave that well-behaved, splendid girl to the great Ocean. The Lord, the Lord of Devas, the Lord of all living beings and goblins gave her to the Ocean. Thereafter the divine river Narmada laughing boisterously through the foams de- scended from the great mountain Rksa and entered the Ocean, the Lord of rivers. Thus she was born of Isvara in the Brahma Kalpa and was seen by me in Matsya Kalpa. Listen as described by me.

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्य वर्तते चात्र ब्रह्मविष्णुं विडौजसाम् । कोटिभिस् त्रिदशानान्तुका ऽन्या धर्तुं प्रशक्यते

verses.translation: The Ganas joyously danced in accordance with the beating of the time. Suddenly the girl was seen very near Sankara. On seeing her the wonder-struck Devas returned with faces turned away. Then the Pinaka-bearing Lord himself gave her a name: "Since you humoured them by means of your pranks and gambols, O beautiful girl, you will become the excellent river Narmada ( Narma, humour+da, giver)." The Lord resumed his form and joked. This river of cool water and auspicious features was called Narmada by him. When the destruction of the seven Kalpas, as was said by Sambhu before, took place, O great king, she did not die. She became well-known as Narmada. Then he gave that well-behaved, splendid girl to the great Ocean. The Lord, the Lord of Devas, the Lord of all living beings and goblins gave her to the Ocean. Thereafter the divine river Narmada laughing boisterously through the foams de- scended from the great mountain Rksa and entered the Ocean, the Lord of rivers. Thus she was born of Isvara in the Brahma Kalpa and was seen by me in Matsya Kalpa. Listen as described by me.

verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe narmadāyāś caturthāvatāre pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 6 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: mune mekalakanyāyā avatāraḥ śruto mayā / idānīṃ śrotum icchāmi tīrthāni ca yathākramam
verses.translation: Again, O excellent king, when the end of the third Yuga approached, Lord Nilalohita assumed the forms of the twelve Suns and burnt the entire ocean-girt earth along with the mountains and forests. Mahesvara then was in the form of Kala, the destroyer. Thereafter he became an enormously big. cloud and flooded the entire earth with water. His body as- sumed a dark physical form and the earth was marked with lightning and Moon as though hit with a weapon and flooded with water. The entire universe was turned into a vast expanse of water. By means of his Maya, he withdrew the universe into himself and slept in the translucent water. In the ocean envel- oped in darkness, when the element of Vayu (Wind) assumed the activity of Mahesvara, I wandered about for a period of a thousand divine years. O great king, I meditated upon the Lord in the form of Oiiikara, the Lord by whom everything was rendered impenetrable. I was meditating in the pure water when the mobile and immobile beings got merged in that ter- rible ocean. I suddenly espied a Mayura (peacock) embellished with golden feathers with wonderful eyelike marks of various colours. The peacock was blue-throated and had excellent eyes.
verses.hindi: जहाँ त्रिशूलधारी देवाधिदेव महादेवने त्रिपुरको मार गिराया था। यहाँ देवदेव महादेवके नाम- कीर्तनसे तथा नर्मदाजीके जलद्वारा उनका स्नान और पूजन करनेसे ब्रह्महत्या नष्ट हो जाती है।

verses.transliteration: atrāntare 'pi tīrthānāṃ saṃkhyā kena tu śakyate / tathāpi te pravakṣyāmi yathā vṛṣṭaṃ viśāmpate
verses.translation: Then the Mayura (peacock) of great prowess moved about within the ocean-like expanse of water which it agitated much through its great shrill cry. Tlje three-crowned peacock was Siva, the protector of the three worlds. He agitated the waters in the form of a peacock. He saw the river of great flow of current, whirling within the great ocean. On seeing her whirling rapidly with waves after waves, Mahadeva in the form of Mayura asked her: "Who are you, O splendid lady with a permanent physical form? In the course of the great annihi- lation you have not become destroyed, even when the multi- tudes of Devas and Asuras have perished in the great ocean- like expanse of rivers and lakes. Who are you, O lotus-eyed one, who continue to move about? How is it that you did not get destroyed?"
verses.hindi: शिवके stead जब दान किया जाता है, तब  काननॉसहित
verses.wordMeaning: Then the Mayura (peacock) of great prowess moved about within the ocean-like expanse of water which it agitated much through its great shrill cry. Tlje three-crowned peacock was Siva, the protector of the three worlds. He agitated the waters in the form of a peacock.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Mayura (peacock) of great prowess moved about within the ocean-like expanse of water which it agitated much through its great shrill cry. Tlje three-crowned peacock was Siva, the protector of the three worlds. He agitated the waters in the form of a peacock.…

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदा सौम्यभागे तु अनन्तपुरमव्ययम् । अनन्तसिद्धिलिङ्गं च सर्वपापहरं परम्
verses.transliteration: narmadā saumyabhāge tu anantapuramavyayam / anantasiddhiliṅgaṃ ca sarvapāpaharaṃ param
verses.translation: Then the Lord of Devas separated the rivers and oceans and said to Narmada: M You go to the southern quarter. Just as in the northern country Jahnavl is the meritorious sacred river, destroyer of great sins, you shall be the splendid river in the South. Just as Ganga originating from my head is highly meritorious, so also indeed better than Ganga, you shall be meritorious undoubtedly. With a part of mine I shall be by your side. You shall be a panacea for those who are defiled by great sins.'*
verses.hindi: उंस दानका' पुण्य असंख्य हो जाता है। राजन्! वे मनुष्य धन्य हैं जो त्रिपुरीमें स्वान करके
verses.wordMeaning: Then the Lord of Devas separated the rivers and oceans and said to Narmada: M You go to the southern quarter. Just as in the northern country Jahnavl is the meritorious sacred river, destroyer of great sins, you shall be the splendid river in the South.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Lord of Devas separated the rivers and oceans and said to Narmada: M You go to the southern quarter. Just as in the northern country Jahnavl is the meritorious sacred river, destroyer of great sins, you shall be the splendid river in the South.…

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं वैश्रवणं नाम कौबेरं धनदं तथा । मणिभद्रं तथा यज्ञं तत् तीर्थस्य प्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: tīrthaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ nāma kauberaṃ dhanadaṃ tathā / maṇibhadraṃ tathā yajñaṃ tat tīrthasya prabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: While the Lord was performing the penance, drops fell down from the tip of the trident. Hence she became known by the name Sona.
verses.hindi: निवास करता है, वह साक्षात् कैलाशमें निवास पाता है। जो इच्छा या अनिच्छासे भी त्रिपुरीमें प्राण-त्याग करता है, वह विमानद्वारा महादेवजीके परम धाममें जाकर वहाँके दिव्य विभवका
verses.wordMeaning: While the Lord was performing the penance, drops fell down from the tip of the trident. Hence she became known by the name Sona.
verses.commentary: Sense: While the Lord was performing the penance, drops fell down from the tip of the trident. Hence she became known by the name Sona.

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षदं कामदं पुण्यं सर्वलोकव्यवस्थितम् । ऋषीणामाश्रमं पुण्यं सर्वदेवम् अयं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: mokṣadaṃ kāmadaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvalokavyavasthitam / ṛṣīṇāmāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadevam ayaṃ śubham
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: उपभोग करता है। वहाँ देवेश्वर त्रिपुरारि शिव तैंतीस कोटि प्रसिद्ध देवताओंके साथ निवास करते है । इसलिये त्रिपुरी क्षेत्रको शिवक्षेत्र कहा गया है। उसकी लम्बाई-चौड़ाई दो कोसकी है।
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: सावर्णिः कौशिकश् चैव मुनिश् चैवाघमर्षणः । शाकल्यश्च कुशाकर्णिः शरभङ्गो ऽग्निर्भगः
verses.transliteration: sāvarṇiḥ kauśikaś caiva muniś caivāghamarṣaṇaḥ / śākalyaśca kuśākarṇiḥ śarabhaṅgo 'gnirbhagaḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: इस बीचमें जिनकी मृत्यु होती है, वे शुभ गतिको प्राप्त होते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च बहवो मुनयः शंसितव्रताः । अस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यात् तपस् तप्त्वा दिवङ्गताः
verses.transliteration: ete cānye ca bahavo munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ / asya tīrthasya māhātmyāt tapas taptvā divaṅgatāḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: यहीं सब सिद्धियोंको देनेवाले गोकर्ण, महादेव, वटेश्वर, सिद्धलिंग, सुरेश्वर, ईश्वर, कामेश्वर, अश्विनीकुमारेश्वर, अनंगेश्वर, वामदेव, कपोतेश्वर,
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: वाल्मीकिर् ऋषिवर्यो वै नैषादीं योनिमाश्रितः । प्रभावात् तस्य तीर्थस्य ब्रह्मतेजो वपुर्धरः
verses.transliteration: vālmīkir ṛṣivaryo vai naiṣādīṃ yonimāśritaḥ / prabhāvāt tasya tīrthasya brahmatejo vapurdharaḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: 'पापनाशन, इन्द्रेश्वर, ब्रह्येश्वर, शिव, नारायण, भव, विश्वेदेव, सिद्धनाथ, अमरेश्वर, चान्द्रलिंग, सिद्धेश्वर, विद्याधरेश्वर, यज्ञेश्वर, तुलनारहित
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुः कुवलयाश्वो दिलीपो नहुषस् तथा । वेणुर् ययाती राजा च अजपालस्म हैहयः
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākuḥ kuvalayāśvo dilīpo nahuṣas tathā / veṇur yayātī rājā ca ajapālasma haihayaḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: सावित्रलिंग तथा रोहिणीतीर्थ हैं। विष्णु, मरीचि,
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च राजानो ह्य् अनन्तपुरवासिनः । अत्रान्तरे महेशानं मेकलातीरमाश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: ete cānye ca rājāno hy anantapuravāsinaḥ / atrāntare maheśānaṃ mekalātīramāśritam
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: सिद्ध त्रिपुरीमें निवास करते हैं। इस पुरीकी स्तुति सहस्रो वर्षोमें भी नहीं की जा सकती।
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: तम् अभ्यर्च्य विधानेन सर्वे ते त्रिदिवङ्गताः । अखिलैर् अन्यतीर्थैश् च चिरकालफलप्रदैः
verses.transliteration: tam abhyarcya vidhānena sarve te tridivaṅgatāḥ / akhilair anyatīrthaiś ca cirakālaphalapradaiḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: जिसमें कपिल मुनिका अवतार हुआ था, वह कालसंज्ञक स्वयंभू मन्वन्तर प्राप्त होनेपर अयोध्यापुरीमें महायशस्वी मनु नामक एक चक्रवर्ती राजा हुए थे। उनका जन्म सूर्यवंशमें हुआ था।
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रास्ते स्वर्गदः श्रीमान् स्वयं देवो महेश्वरः । तीर्थं सप्तऋषिर् नाम सप्तसारस्वतं नृप
verses.transliteration: atrāste svargadaḥ śrīmān svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ / tīrthaṃ saptaṛṣir nāma saptasārasvataṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने भगवान् शंकर और विष्णुकी आराधना करके अयोध्यापुरी प्राप्त की थी। जैसे कुबेरकी अलकापुरी विख्यात है तथा जिस प्रकार इन्द्रकी अमरावतीपुरी बड़ी मनोहर है, अयोध्या भी
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: अमर्त्यसम्भवं लिङ्गं तथैवारण्यकेश्वरम् । अघौघनाशनं तीर्थं तथान्यत् कल्मषापहम्
verses.transliteration: amartyasambhavaṃ liṅgaṃ tathaivāraṇyakeśvaram / aghaughanāśanaṃ tīrthaṃ tathānyat kalmaṣāpaham
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: वैसी ही शोभासम्पन्न थी। वहाँ रहकर महाराज
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चब्रह्मम् अयं तीर्थं सहस्रशिरसं हरम् । वाराहं वामनं तीर्थं यमतीर्थं महोत्कटम्
verses.transliteration: pañcabrahmam ayaṃ tīrthaṃ sahasraśirasaṃ haram / vārāhaṃ vāmanaṃ tīrthaṃ yamatīrthaṃ mahotkaṭam
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: महादेवजीका दर्शन करते हैं। जो मानव त्रिपुरीमें  विमानोंकी
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: सौरभङ्गं सहस्रं तु अश्वमेधं महामखम् । हिरण्यगर्भं सावित्र्यां चातुर्वेदं च पावनम्
verses.transliteration: saurabhaṅgaṃ sahasraṃ tu aśvamedhaṃ mahāmakham / hiraṇyagarbhaṃ sāvitryāṃ cāturvedaṃ ca pāvanam
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: उनमें संगीत और वाद्यकी भी ध्वनि हो रही थी। वह सब देख-सुनकर राजाको बड़ा विस्मय हुआ। चे सोचने लगे “ये विमान किसके हैं, जो मेरे ही भवनके ऊपर खड़े हैं। यह कितना साहसपूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् सर्व विजानीहि लोकानां पावनं परम् । तथा ऽनन्तपुरं यावत् पर्यङ्कात् पश्चिमे शुभम्
verses.transliteration: etat sarva vijānīhi lokānāṃ pāvanaṃ param / tathā 'nantapuraṃ yāvat paryaṅkāt paścime śubham
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: कार्य है?” इस प्रकार सोच-विचारमें पड़े हुए राजाकी वह रात्रि व्यतीत हो गयी। सूर्योदय होनेपर नैत्यिक धर्म-कर्मका अनुष्ठान पूरा करके राजर्षि मनुने वसिष्ठ मुनिसे कहा--' महामुने !
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रान्तरे मृता ये च दानधर्मविवर्जिताः । ते ऽपि स्वर्गे महीयन्ते यावद् इन्द्राश् चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: atrāntare mṛtā ye ca dānadharmavivarjitāḥ / te 'pi svarge mahīyante yāvad indrāś caturdaśa
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: यह मेरे महलके ऊपर किसके विमान हैं तथा ये किस कर्मके फलसे या किस-किस दान और नियमके पालनसे प्राप्त होते हैं? क्षत्रियवंशमें उत्पन्न होकर जो पृथ्वीका शासन करता है, वह
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: ततो द्वीपेश्वरं नाम व्यासतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । तत्र स्नात्वा तु लभते हयमेधफलं नरः
verses.transliteration: tato dvīpeśvaraṃ nāma vyāsatīrthamanuttamam / tatra snātvā tu labhate hayamedhaphalaṃ naraḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: यज्ञोंका अनुष्ठान करके माता और पिताके कुलको स्वर्गलोकमें पहुँचाता है। वास्तवमें उसी राजाका जन्म लेना सार्थक है, जिसके शासनमें इस भूमण्डलपर किसी प्रकारका पापकर्म नहीं हो पाता। दूसरे
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: कामिकं तत्परं तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति । प्रदक्षिणां च यः कुर्याद् व्यासतीर्थस्य भारत
verses.transliteration: kāmikaṃ tatparaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / pradakṣiṇāṃ ca yaḥ kuryād vyāsatīrthasya bhārata
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: लोग तो केवल माता-पिताको क्लेश देनेके लिये ही उनके पुत्ररूपसे जन्मग्रहण करते हैं।' राजा मनुके ऐसा कहनेपर वसिष्ठजी बोले महाभाग! पुराण और वेदोंसे बाहर जो कर्म किया
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणीकृता तेन सप्तद्वीपा वसुन्धरा । नरो वा यदि वा नारी शिवलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasundharā / naro vā yadi vā nārī śivaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: जाता है, उसकी साधुपुरुष प्रशंसा नहीं करते; क्योंकि उसके द्वारा धर्मकी हानि होती है। नर्मदाके तटपर त्रिपुरी नामसे विख्यात एक तीर्थ है। वहाँ जिन लोगोंने यज्ञ, दान और होम आदि सत्कर्म
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: द्वीपेश्वरे ततस् स्नात्वा वृषभं यः प्रयच्छति । काञ्चनेन विमानेन रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: dvīpeśvare tatas snātvā vṛṣabhaṃ yaḥ prayacchati / kāñcanena vimānena rudraloke mahīyate
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: किये हैं, उन्हींके विमान महलोंके ऊपर खड़े थे। महाराज! एकमात्र नर्मदादेवी ही ऐसी हैं, जिन्होंने समस्त पापियों और दुराचारियोंको स्वर्गलोकमें पहुँचाया है। संसार-समुद्रमें डूबे हुए पापसे दूषित
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: कार्तिकस्य चतुर्दश्यां कृष्णपक्षे जितेन्द्रियः । स्नापयेद् यः शिवं तत्र ह्य् उपवासपरायणः
verses.transliteration: kārtikasya caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe jitendriyaḥ / snāpayed yaḥ śivaṃ tatra hy upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: 'चित्तवाले जीवोंको भी स्वर्गलोकमें पहुँचानेके लिये 'यह नर्मदा नदी दिव्य विमानस्वरूप है। महाभाग! ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और महादेवजीको छोड़कर दूसरा कोई एक मुखवाला पुरुष नर्मदा नदीके पुण्योंका
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो रुद्रलोके महीयते । व्यासतीर्थं तु वै गत्वा सर्वे ब्रह्मादयः सुराः
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmukto rudraloke mahīyate / vyāsatīrthaṃ tu vai gatvā sarve brahmādayaḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: वर्णन नहीं कर सकता। नर्मदातटपर किये हुए तप, दान और सत्कर्मोके पुण्यकी कोई भी गणना “सकता  जम्बूद्वीपमें जो-जो तीर्थ और 4 "कोई भी नर्मदा नदीकी समता
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुवन्ति भावितात्मानं ऋषयश् च तपोधनाः । ये चान्ये सिद्धगन्धर्वकिन्नरोरगराक्षसाः
verses.transliteration: stuvanti bhāvitātmānaṃ ṛṣayaś ca tapodhanāḥ / ye cānye siddhagandharvakinnaroragarākṣasāḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: पुण्यक्षेत्रमें किया हुआ पाप
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य मोदन्ते गतकल्मषाः । स्तुवन्ति विविधैः स्तोत्रैर् माङ्गल्यस्तुति संस्कृतैः
verses.transliteration: narmadātaṭamāśritya modante gatakalmaṣāḥ / stuvanti vividhaiḥ stotrair māṅgalyastuti saṃskṛtaiḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: वज्रलेप हो जाता है। यही बात धर्मके लिये भी है। वहाँ किया हुआ धर्म भी अक्षय होता है। यह जीवन चंचल है-- क्षणभंगुर है । इसलिये मनुष्य कभी पाप न करे।
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: यस्यास्ति शक्तिरसशक्तिर् इह प्रवीरः प्रोर्ध्वी करोतु यदि वा ऽवनतिं करोतु । यः पूजितः सुरवरः शशिशेखरेण ना ऽराधितः सपदि भूतपति सुरैर् वा
verses.transliteration: yasyāsti śaktirasaśaktir iha pravīraḥ prordhvī karotu yadi vā 'vanatiṃ karotu / yaḥ pūjitaḥ suravaraḥ śaśiśekhareṇa nā 'rādhitaḥ sapadi bhūtapati surair vā
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: राजा मनुने नर्मदाके सुयशका वर्णन सुनकर अपने मन्त्रियों, सदस्यों तथा सेवकोंको आज्ञा दी--तुम सब लोग राजकीय सामग्री लेकर शीघ्र ही नर्मदाकी यात्रा करो, विलम्ब
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: किं वा न वृष्टं हि पितामहेन न वा सुरैर् वा मधुसूदनेन । क्षीरोदमन्थोद्भवकालकूटं कण्ठे वृतं केन हरं विहाय
verses.transliteration: kiṃ vā na vṛṣṭaṃ hi pitāmahena na vā surair vā madhusūdanena / kṣīrodamanthodbhavakālakūṭaṃ kaṇṭhe vṛtaṃ kena haraṃ vihāya
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: नहीं होना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: एकेन दग्धं त्रिपुरं शरेण कामो ललाटाक्षिनिरीक्षणेन । भिन्नो ऽन्धकः शूलवरेण येन कस् तेन सार्द्धं कुरुते विरोधम्
verses.transliteration: ekena dagdhaṃ tripuraṃ śareṇa kāmo lalāṭākṣinirīkṣaṇena / bhinno 'ndhakaḥ śūlavareṇa yena kas tena sārddhaṃ kurute virodham
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर राजा वेदवेत्ता ब्राह्मणोंके साथ देव दानववन्दित त्रिपुरी पुरीको गये। वहाँ रानियों तथा समस्त परिवारके साथ नर्मदाजीके जलका दर्शन करके वे जन्मभरके पापोंसे मुक्त हो गये।
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: जलौघकल्लोलतरङ्गभङ्गा गङ्गा धृता येन जटाग्रभागे पादाम्बुजाङ्गुष्ठनिपीडनेन पपात लङ्काधिपतिर् विसंज्ञः
verses.transliteration: jalaughakallolataraṅgabhaṅgā gaṅgā dhṛtā yena jaṭāgrabhāge pādāmbujāṅguṣṭhanipīḍanena papāta laṅkādhipatir visaṃjñaḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: उस तीर्थमें विधिपूर्वक स्नान करके देवताओं और पितरोंका तर्पण करनेके पश्चात् राजाने चन्दन और पुष्प आदिसे महादेवजीकी पूजा की और नर्मदाके तटपर दस योजनका विशाल यज्ञमण्डप
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: सुरासुराणामिह यत् समक्षं विध्वंसितो दक्षमखः क्षणेन प्रणम्य दक्षः क्षयकारकस्य लेभे वरं तारकमारकस्य
verses.transliteration: surāsurāṇāmiha yat samakṣaṃ vidhvaṃsito dakṣamakhaḥ kṣaṇena praṇamya dakṣaḥ kṣayakārakasya lebhe varaṃ tārakamārakasya
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: निर्माण कराया। उत्तम ब्रतका पालन करनेवाले, यज्ञकर्ममें कुशल, चारों विद्याओंके ज्ञाता तथा वेदज्ञ महर्षि एवं ब्राह्मण उस यज्ञके लिये निमन्त्रित किये गये। जैसे पुष्करतीर्थ ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्य पूज्यं हि वरोत्तमाङ्गं सम्पूज्यते लिङ्गवरं हरस्य अनेन पर्याप्तम् अतीव मूढः प्राप्तुं पदं यच्छति यत् करोति
verses.transliteration: sarvasya pūjyaṃ hi varottamāṅgaṃ sampūjyate liṅgavaraṃ harasya anena paryāptam atīva mūḍhaḥ prāptuṃ padaṃ yacchati yat karoti
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: शिव--तीनों देवताओंका स्वरूप है, उसी प्रकार यह त्रिपुरीतीर्थ भी है। वहाँ राजाने परमोत्तम अश्वमेध यज्ञ प्रारम्भ किया। उस यज्ञमें सम्पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मात्र वृद्धो हरिर् अत्र लिङ्गं सुरा ऽसुराश् चैव समर्चयन्ति तथापि नूनं सुविचारयान्ति को वा ऽधिको वा ऽस्ति समो हरेण
verses.transliteration: brahmātra vṛddho harir atra liṅgaṃ surā 'surāś caiva samarcayanti tathāpi nūnaṃ suvicārayānti ko vā 'dhiko vā 'sti samo hareṇa
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: विष्टर आदि देकर सबको सन्तुष्ट किया । वेदोक्त विधिके अनुसार यज्ञका कार्य पूर्ण हुआ । ब्राह्मणोंको वैभवके अनुसार दक्षिणा देकर प्रसन्न किया  गया । देवता, पितर और मनुष्य सभी तृप्त होकर :
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: तेनैव चक्राङ्कसरोरुहाङ्कौ लिङ्गाङ्कितं यस्य जगद् भगाङ्कम् हस्ते प्रबद्धे नवकङ्कणे वै पश्यन्ति मूढाः खलु दर्पणेन
verses.transliteration: tenaiva cakrāṅkasaroruhāṅkau liṅgāṅkitaṃ yasya jagad bhagāṅkam haste prabaddhe navakaṅkaṇe vai paśyanti mūḍhāḥ khalu darpaṇena
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: परम गतिको प्राप्त हो गये। ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और ' शिव राजाको वरदान देकर अपने-अपने लोकमें  गये। इस तीर्थमें किया हुआ तप और दान सब  कुछ अक्षय होता है।  i
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यं पवित्रं स्तवनं व्यासेनोक्तं महात्मना । कृतं देवाधिनाथस्य सर्वकल्मषनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ stavanaṃ vyāsenoktaṃ mahātmanā / kṛtaṃ devādhināthasya sarvakalmaṣanāśanam
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार महातेजस्वी महाराज मनुका यड ' जब पूरा हो गया तब उन्होंने हाथ जोड़कर नर्मदासे  'कहा- देवि! केवल सहस्रं चान्द्रायण और सैकडौं
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिपूज्य यथा न्यायम् अर्घपाद्यैर् अनुक्रमात् । उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं प्रसादः क्रियतां मयि
verses.transliteration: pratipūjya yathā nyāyam arghapādyair anukramāt / uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: सोमयागका जो फल है, वह तुम्हारे जलका पान करनेमात्रसे होनेवाले पुण्यकी समता नहीं कर सकता । तुमने सम्पूर्ण जगतूको तथा समस्त चराचर जीवोंको व्याप्त कर रखा है। जैसे आग रूईके
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: देयं तस्य फलं देव यः पुमान् छ्रद्धया ऽर्चति । इति स्तुत्वा महेशानं ऋषयः शंसितव्रताः
verses.transliteration: deyaṃ tasya phalaṃ deva yaḥ pumān chraddhayā 'rcati / iti stutvā maheśānaṃ ṛṣayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: ढेरको जला देती है, उसी प्रकार तुम्हारा जल स्नान, अवगाहन, पान, स्मरण और कीर्तन करनेसे मनुष्यके अनेक जन्मोंकी पापराशिको भस्म कर देता है। देवि! तुम पितरोंके हितकी कामनासे
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले प्रयातास् ते यथातथम् । अन्ये च ऋषयो देवा द्वैपायनम् अथाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle prayātās te yathātatham / anye ca ṛṣayo devā dvaipāyanam athābruvan
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: स्वर्गकी सीढ़ी बनकर आयी हो। चारों प्रकारके जीवोंको स्वर्गलोकमें पहुँचाओ। नर्मदे! लोकमें जो कोई भी नदियाँ और नाना प्रकारके तीर्थ हैं, उन सबकी जननी तुम्हीं हो । तुम पितरोंका उद्धार
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमस् ते महाभाग वायसैर् आकुलीकृतः । यथा न वायसाः के ऽपि प्रविशन्ति तपोवनम्
verses.transliteration: āśramas te mahābhāga vāyasair ākulīkṛtaḥ / yathā na vāyasāḥ ke 'pi praviśanti tapovanam
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: करनेवाली पराशक्ति हो । जैसे सूर्य और चन्द्रमाका प्रभाव सब जीवोंपर समानरूपसे पड्ता है, जैसे बादल अन्नके पौथों और घासोंपर समानरूपसे जलकी वर्षा करते हैं, उसी प्रकार तुम सम्पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: म्रियन्ते ते सदा सर्वे मूर्धा तेषां विशीर्यते । व्यासेन शप्तास् ते सर्वे वायसा महतो भयात्
verses.transliteration: mriyante te sadā sarve mūrdhā teṣāṃ viśīryate / vyāsena śaptās te sarve vāyasā mahato bhayāt
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: विश्वपर समानरूपसे स्नेह रखनेवाली गौरवमयी माता हो। शुभे! ब्रह्मा और बृहस्पतिजी weet वर्षोतक लगे रहनेपर भी तुम्हारे गुणोंका पूर्णतया वर्णन करनेमें समर्थ नहीं हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस् तीर्थे महाराज प्रविशन्ति न कर्हिचित् । ऋषयो वचनं श्रुत्वा व्यासस्य तु महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃs tīrthe mahārāja praviśanti na karhicit / ṛṣayo vacanaṃ śrutvā vyāsasya tu mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: अमिततेजस्वी मनुके द्वारा किये हुए इस स्तवनको सुनकर परम सौभाग्यशालिनी नर्मदादेवी
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदा दक्षिणे कूले सर्वमेव कृतं क्षणात् । तिष्ठन्ति मुनयः सर्वे देवस्याराधने रताः
verses.transliteration: narmadā dakṣiṇe kūle sarvameva kṛtaṃ kṣaṇāt / tiṣṭhanti munayaḥ sarve devasyārādhane ratāḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: तुम कोई मनोवांछित वर माँगो। तब महादेवी नर्मदाको नमस्कार करके राजाने कहा--'देवि! तुम सम्पूर्ण जगतूको पवित्र करो और अयोध्या प्रदेशमें अनेक नदियाँ प्रकट हो जायँ। देवलोकमें
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: आराध्य विधिना देवम् अस्तुवन् परमेश्वरम् । यस्यास्ति शक्तिर् इत्यादि व्यासस्तुतिपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: ārādhya vidhinā devam astuvan parameśvaram / yasyāsti śaktir ityādi vyāsastutiparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: गंगा आदि अनेकों सरिताएँ बहती हैं, ऐसा सुना जाता है। वे सब इस भूलोकमें भी जिस प्रकार उतर आवें, वैसा उपाय करो।'
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रं तद् एतत् त्रिदशेश्वरस्य व्यासेन भक्त्या कृतमीश्वरस्य । प्रातः पठेद् यः स्मरति प्रयत्नात् काले स जातो ऽनुचरो हरस्य
verses.transliteration: stotraṃ tad etat tridaśeśvarasya vyāsena bhaktyā kṛtamīśvarasya / prātaḥ paṭhed yaḥ smarati prayatnāt kāle sa jāto 'nucaro harasya
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: नर्मदा बोलीं--नृपश्रेष्ठ ! त्रेताके प्रथम भागमें तुम्हारे कुलमें भगीरथ नामसे विख्यात एक राजा होंगे। वे इस लोकमें गंगाजीको लावेंगे। त्रेताके द्वितीय भागमें इस भारतवर्षके भीतर कालिन्दी,
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: व्यासाष्टकम् इदं पुण्यं यः पठेच्छिवसन्निधौ । व्यासस् तस्य भवेत् प्रीतो नर्मदा च प्रसीदति
verses.transliteration: vyāsāṣṭakam idaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchivasannidhau / vyāsas tasya bhavet prīto narmadā ca prasīdati
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: सरस्वती, सरयू तथा महाभागा गण्डकी आदि नदियाँ भी प्रकट हो जायँगी। तुम्हारे वंशमें उत्पन्न भगीरथके ही नामपर सरिताओंमें श्रेष्ठ गंगाजी भागीरथी' कहलायेंगी। भागीरथीके ही समान
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुतो महादेवो व्यासेन तु महात्मना । शिवो व्यासस्य सन्तुष्ट इदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ stuto mahādevo vyāsena tu mahātmanā / śivo vyāsasya santuṣṭa idaṃ vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: उनका दूसरा नाम “जाह्नवी' भी होगा। उक्त सभी नदियाँ कन्या-द्वीपमें प्रसिद्धिको प्राप्त होंगी।
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: किं करोमि स्थितो विप्र वरं ब्रूहि यथेप्सितम् । वरं ददामि ते प्रीतो येन त्वं सुखमेधसे
verses.transliteration: kiṃ karomi sthito vipra varaṃ brūhi yathepsitam / varaṃ dadāmi te prīto yena tvaṃ sukhamedhase
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: भृगुतीर्थं और भास्करतीर्थको माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच: नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले तिष्ठ त्वं चोत्तरे शिव । आश्रमास् ते भविष्यन्ति सर्वे पुण्यतमाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tiṣṭha tvaṃ cottare śiva / āśramās te bhaviṣyanti sarve puṇyatamāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं-राजन्। त्रिपुरी क्षेत्रमें
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा ततो व्यासं तत्रैवान्तर धीयत । व्यासो ऽपि चात्र वत्स्यामि दक्षिणं नर्मदे व्रज
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā tato vyāsaṃ tatraivāntara dhīyata / vyāso 'pi cātra vatsyāmi dakṣiṇaṃ narmade vraja
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: ही मर्कटीतीर्थ है और मर्कटीतीर्थके पूर्वभागमें परम उत्तम भूगुतीर्थ स्थित है। कार्तिकी पूर्णिमाको इस तीर्थमें स्नान करके मनुष्य सब पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है। वहीं नरकेश्वर नामसे प्रसिद्ध भगवान्
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: ततश् च दण्डकाष्ठेन चालयामास नर्मदाम् । नर्मदा चाब्रवीद् वाक्यं पूर्वमार्गेण सा गता
verses.transliteration: tataś ca daṇḍakāṣṭhena cālayāmāsa narmadām / narmadā cābravīd vākyaṃ pūrvamārgeṇa sā gatā
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: शिव हैं, जो स्वर्ग और मोक्ष देनेवाले हैं। उनके आगे बाँसका वृक्ष दिखायी देता है। उसके पूर्वभागमें त्रिलोचन नामक महादेवजी विराजमान हैं। उनके ललारमें स्थित तृतीय नेत्रका दर्शन करके मुनिश्रेष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: ततो व्यासस् तु संक्रुद्धो युगान्ताग्निर् इवाभवत् । व्यासस् तु कुपितो राजन् सन्तीर्णो द्विजसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tato vyāsas tu saṃkruddho yugāntāgnir ivābhavat / vyāsas tu kupito rājan santīrṇo dvijasattamaḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: भूगुने पृथ्वीपर दण्डवत् प्रणाम किया और इस प्रकार उनकी स्तुति की।
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: हुंकारिता च सा देवी नागता तत्र नर्मदा । नाहं कोपवत विप्र प्रलयं यामि कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: huṃkāritā ca sā devī nāgatā tatra narmadā / nāhaṃ kopavata vipra pralayaṃ yāmi karhicit
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: हैं, कल्याण एवं ऐश्वर्य प्रदान करनेवाले हैं, सबका पाप हर लेनेके कारण जिन्हें हर कहते हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तकल्पक्षये वृत्ते न मृता ऽस्मीति नर्मदा । ततो द्विजस् तु संजातो दक्षिणेन ततो गता
verses.transliteration: saptakalpakṣaye vṛtte na mṛtā 'smīti narmadā / tato dvijas tu saṃjāto dakṣiṇena tato gatā
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: विश्वके स्वामी हैं, जिनमें दोषमात्रका सर्वथा अभाव है तथा जो नित्य विज्ञानानन्दस्वरूप हैं, उन भगवान् शिवको मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ) प्रभो! मैं दूसरोंका तिरस्कार करनेके पापसे पराजित हा
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: न वारिता च सा ऽनेन व्यासभीता महानदी । उत्तरे मुनयः सर्वे कूले तिष्ठन्त्य् अनेकशः
verses.transliteration: na vāritā ca sā 'nena vyāsabhītā mahānadī / uttare munayaḥ sarve kūle tiṣṭhanty anekaśaḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: मेरी उस पापसे रक्षा कीजिये। परमेश्वर क्षणभंगुर शरीरके प्रति मेरै मनमें
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते हृष्टमनसो मुनयः शंसितव्रताः । व्यासेन चार्जितं श्राद्धं तथा ऽन्यैर् मुनिपुङ्गवैः
verses.transliteration: tataste hṛṣṭamanaso munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ / vyāsena cārjitaṃ śrāddhaṃ tathā 'nyair munipuṅgavaiḥ
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: सदा सबका कल्याण करनेवाले हैं, फिर मुझे मूढ़ देखकर भी (ज्ञानदानमें) विलम्ब क्यों करते हैं? हर! आप मेरी बढ़ी हुई तृष्णाको हर लें और मुझे स्थिर रहनेवाली लक्ष्मी प्रदान करें। महेश्वर !
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: पितरो द्वादशाब्दानि तार्पितास् ते नराधिप
verses.transliteration: pitaro dvādaśābdāni tārpitās te narādhipa
verses.translation: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.hindi: आपके तीर्थामें जानेमात्रसे जो पुण्य होता है, वह सदा ही मोहका उच्छेद, पापोंका विनाश और संसार-सागरसे उद्धार करता है, परंतु मुझ भाग्यहीनने उस पुण्यका संचय भी नहीं किया है।
verses.wordMeaning: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.
verses.commentary: Sense: She came to this world quickly piercing through the great ocean. She is worthy of being adored by Suras and Siddhas. Hence she is Maharnava.

verses.sanskrit: इति रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्ये षष्ठो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ७ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अन्यत्तीर्थं महापुण्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् । अश्वमेधसमुद्भूता नदी यत्र वराङ्गना
verses.transliteration: iti revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātye ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 7 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: anyattīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam / aśvamedhasamudbhūtā nadī yatra varāṅganā
verses.translation: Again there was the advent of a vast expanse of ocean- like water with horrible features in which mobile and immobile beings perished. The whole world was submerged in water. Darkness enveloped everything and there was no light at all. Brahma alone assumed the form of a Khadyota (Firefly, Glow- worm). For the period of a thousand divine years, he moved about in the great ocean enveloped in darkness. He then saw in the terrible expanse of ocean, the Lord asleep in the form of a tortoise. The excellent Lord, the incomprehensible, ex- tended to a thousand Yojanas. He resembled the twelve Adityas (Suns) in splendour. He had a thousand feet and eyes. On seeing him, Brahma was surprised and roused him slowly by means of auspicious hymns taken from the Vedic and Vedanga texts: "O Vacaspati (Lord of Speech), do wake up. O Supreme Being, obeisance to you. O Paramesvara (Supreme Lord), the entire universe is stationed in your belly. Hence, O Mahasattva (huge being of immense inner strength and good qualities), release what was withdrawn within by you. The night of Brahma has passed off. The day has dawned. O Lord of all worlds, have a view, whereby the universe can take birth."
verses.hindi: महर्षि भृगुके द्वारा कहे हुए इस “करुणाहृदय” नामक स्तोत्रका जो प्रतिदिन प्रातःकाल उठकर पाठ करता है, वह परम गतिको प्राप्त होता है। इस स्तोत्रसे सन्तुष्ट होकर भगवान् शिवने भृगुसे

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा च सङ्गमे यत्र हयमेधफलं लभेत् । व्याधिभिर् मुच्यते यत्र नारी वा यदि वानरः
verses.transliteration: snātvā ca saṅgame yatra hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet / vyādhibhir mucyate yatra nārī vā yadi vānaraḥ
verses.translation: After dividing the entire ocean-like expanse of wa- ter, Paramesvara espied the earth consisting of trees, medici- nal herbs and puddles, extensively abounding in stones and flood of water and full of rivers and lakes. He saw Himavan the great mountain, Sveta the excellent mountain, the great mountain Srngavan as well as other Kulaparvatas. (He espied) the Dvipas

verses.translation: This describes Narmada in the form of a beautiful lady who survived Pralaya in g&rma Kalpa.
verses.hindi: भृगुने कहा-देवेश्वर! यदि आप सन्तुष्ट हैं और मुझे वर देना चाहते हैं, तो पृथ्वीपर मेरे ही नामसे इस तीर्थकी प्रसिद्धि हो। महेश्वर ! मेरी दूसरी प्रार्थना यह है कि आप अपनेको उस भूगुक्षेत्रमें

verses.sanskrit: अनुग्रहार्थं लोकानां शैवक्षेत्रं विदुर्बुधाः । पञ्चाशीतिः कुरुक्षेत्रे पश्चाशीतिर् इवात्र तु
verses.transliteration: anugrahārthaṃ lokānāṃ śaivakṣetraṃ vidurbudhāḥ / pañcāśītiḥ kurukṣetre paścāśītir ivātra tu
verses.translation: He saw Narmada of unmanifest limbs and noble features. She was beautified by various ornaments of magical origin. The young woman had just risen above the water with half raised arms eulogizing the Lord of the chiefs of Devas. Her eyes were large like the petals of a lotus. On seeing that splendid lady, I was overwhelmed with surprise in the heart. I took my holy dip in her splendid water. I began to eulogize joyously by means of Mantras taken from the Vedic Scriptures. In front of her I saw the mobile and immobile beings created along with Devas, Asuras, Gandharvas, Pannagas and great Uragas. I saw that the highly esteemable lady did not undergo destruc- tion before because she was born of the body of Mahadeva. With his favour she did not get dissolved. She was seen by me again and again. O excellent king, it has been recounted to you. Those excellent Brahmanas who study this manifestation pertaining to Kurma and the learned men who listen to it, are liberated from all sins.

On seeing that splendid lady, I was overwhelmed with surprise in the heart. I took my holy dip in her splendid water. I began to eulogize joyously by means of Mantras taken from the Vedic Scriptures. O excellent king, it has been recounted to you. Those excellent Brahmanas who study this manifestation pertaining to Kurma and the learned men who listen to it, are liberated from all sins.

verses.sanskrit: अनेकभाविकं घोरमघं नश्यति तत्क्षणात् । ततस् तस्मिन् महाभाग कपिलातीर्थमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: anekabhāvikaṃ ghoramaghaṃ naśyati tatkṣaṇāt / tatas tasmin mahābhāga kapilātīrthamuttamam
verses.translation: He saw Narmada of unmanifest limbs and noble features. She was beautified by various ornaments of magical origin. The young woman had just risen above the water with half raised arms eulogizing the Lord of the chiefs of Devas. Her eyes were large like the petals of a lotus. On seeing that splendid lady, I was overwhelmed with surprise in the heart. I took my holy dip in her splendid water. I began to eulogize joyously by means of Mantras taken from the Vedic Scriptures. In front of her I saw the mobile and immobile beings created along with Devas, Asuras, Gandharvas, Pannagas and great Uragas. I saw that the highly esteemable lady did not undergo destruc- tion before because she was born of the body of Mahadeva. With his favour she did not get dissolved. She was seen by me again and again. O excellent king, it has been recounted to you. Those excellent Brahmanas who study this manifestation pertaining to Kurma and the learned men who listen to it, are liberated from all sins.
verses.hindi: नामक प्रसिद्ध शिवलिंग है। उसीके समीप सब पापोंका नाश करनेवाला सिद्धेश्वर तीर्थ है। वहाँ स्नान करनेसे स्वर्गलोककी प्राप्ति होती है और जो वहाँ मृत्युको प्राप्त होते हैं, उनका फिर

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे व्यासतीर्थमहिमवर्णनो नाम सप्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ८ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अथान्यत् परमं तीर्थं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् । त्रिपुरी नाम विख्यातं रेवाया उत्तरेतटे
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe vyāsatīrthamahimavarṇano nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 8 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: athānyat paramaṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam / tripurī nāma vikhyātaṃ revāyā uttaretaṭe
verses.translation: Tea girls from all the quarters came to the ocean. They were clad In gorgeous garments and bedecked with anklets
verses.hindi: 'पितरोंका श्राद्ध अवश्य करना चाहिए। वह उनकी प्रसन्नताको बढ़ानेवाला होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Tea girls from all the quarters came to the ocean. They were clad In gorgeous garments and bedecked with anklets

verses.sanskrit: सपादलक्षतीर्थानि यत्र तिष्ठन्ति भारत । शतमष्टोत्तरं तत्र लिङ्गानां तु स्वयम्भुवाम्
verses.transliteration: sapādalakṣatīrthāni yatra tiṣṭhanti bhārata / śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tatra liṅgānāṃ tu svayambhuvām
verses.translation: There was a very splendid river in the middle of the city. It had meritorious waters and rocky banks studded with gems. It was a great river. On its bank I saw a great Linga too. It had the lustre of lightning and the Sun. All round, it was set with blue sapphires. In some places it resembled fire. In some other places it was smoke-coloured, yellow in some places, red in other places and white elsewhere. The Linga of diverse colours was very wonderful to behold. It was surrounded by Brahma, Visnu, Indra and Sadhyas. It was surrounded by Nandlsvara and other Ga$adhyak$as, Indra and Adityas. I stared at that great Linga of Isana alone.
verses.hindi: राजाने पूछा--मुनिश्रेष्ठ ! इस तीर्थमें गंगा और यमुना कैसे आयीं, यह प्रसंग विस्तारपूर्वक बतलाइये।
verses.wordMeaning: There was a very splendid river in the middle of the city. It had meritorious waters and rocky banks studded with gems. It was a great river. On its bank I saw a great Linga too. It had the lustre of lightning and the Sun. All round, it was set with blue sapphires.…

verses.sanskrit: त्रिपुरः पातितो राजन् देवदेवेन शूलिना । स्तोतव्यं किं परं तत्र सुरासुरनिषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: tripuraḥ pātito rājan devadevena śūlinā / stotavyaṃ kiṃ paraṃ tatra surāsuraniṣevitam
verses.translation: Neither the king of birds was there nor those women nor the Devas. The Lihga alone which was being worshipped (by me?) remained there. I was surprised. On account of the grief, I was fainting as it were. I thought everything was an illusion created by Rudra. Then those girls emerged (from the water) brightening the entire universe with the divine gar- ments and ornaments they were wearing, like lightning streaks brightening a cluster of clouds. After adoring the Lihga with divine, golden lotuses those ladies of splendid countenances and excellent ornaments soon entered the water.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी बोले-राजन्! त्रिपुरीमें मतंग नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक धर्मपरायण राजर्षि रहते थे। वे भगवान् शिवके भक्त, महान् योगी और वेदवेत्ताऑमें श्रेष्ठ थे। एक दिन तपस्वी मतंग मुनिके समीप

verses.sanskrit: लोकानुग्रहकं देवं स्वयं विद्धि महेश्वरम् । गोकर्णं नाम विख्यातं भोगदं मोक्षदायकम्
verses.transliteration: lokānugrahakaṃ devaṃ svayaṃ viddhi maheśvaram / gokarṇaṃ nāma vikhyātaṃ bhogadaṃ mokṣadāyakam
verses.translation: O Brahmana, how is it that I have been forgotten by you? You had seen me in the previous Kalpa. Let there be no forgetfulness on your part. I am the same Kalpavahini well- known as Narmada; I was born of Rudra's body. The girls seen by you adoring Mahesvara, the girls who have brought you along with the king of birds, O excellent sage, are the quarters. Mahayogin Mahesvara has been brought here by these, Nandisvara and others from Sivapura, O Brahmana. The same deity, Mahadeva, has established himself here in the form of a Lihga. The preceptor of the Suras and Asuras is being worshipped by Brahma, Visnu and Indra. It is called Lihga by the great sages conversant with the Puranas, because the entire universe consisting of mobile and immobile beings, becomes merged therein. Formerly, all the groups of Devas were taken together and dissolved by the Lord through Maya. They are not seen now. On being created by the Self-born Lord, they will be seen 'again. I am engaged in adoring th« Lihga. My name is Narmada. I have been the maid in attendance of Rudra for a period of a thousand Yugas.
verses.hindi: उसी मार्गसे जाते हुए सप्तर्षिगण आये। उन्होंने उन ऋषियोंको नमस्कार करके अर्घ्य और पाद्य आदिके द्वारा उन सबकी पूजा की। जब
