verses.sanskrit: कीर्तनाद् देवदेवस्य स्नपनेना ऽर्चनेन च । तोयेन नर्मदायास् तु ब्रह्महत्या प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: kīrtanād devadevasya snapanenā 'rcanena ca / toyena narmadāyās tu brahmahatyā praṇaśyati
verses.translation: The women, the Lord of Devas, Mahesvara in the form of a Baka — all vanished. On hearing her words I got down into the great river and took bath, with the recitation of Mantras duly worshipping the Lihga. But when I rose up from the river I could not see the Lihga or the river, O king. At that time itself all the worlds were born and also the earth with all forests. The same firmament became spangled with the stars, moon and sun. As before, what was rendered unseen was seen again. I mentally bowed down to the Lord and worshipped Mahesvara.

verses.translation: The women, the Lord of Devas, Mahesvara in the form of a Baka — all vanished. verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe tripurīvarṇano nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 9 narmadovāca: tretāyāṃ prathame pāde tava vaṃśe nṛpottama / bhagīratha iti khyātaḥ sa gaṅgā mānayiṣyati
verses.translation: I shall recount to you another subsequent Yuganta (ending of a Yuga). Listen.

verses.sanskrit: सगराः षष्टिसाहस्रा अलाबुजसमुद्भवाः । कपिलस्य तु मार्गेण हये पातालगामिनि
verses.transliteration: sagarāḥ ṣaṣṭisāhasrā alābujasamudbhavāḥ / kapilasya tu mārgeṇa haye pātālagāmini
verses.translation: That lady is omniformed. Mahesvara is also omniformed. I saw the immutable Lord who closely embraced her and lay asleep. At the foot of the Lord I saw that dark-complexioned girl characterised by lotuses, with well-shaped buttocks, mas- saging the feet of the Lord. That Syama (Dark-complexioned one) was clad in pure, spotless garments. She had a python for the sacred thread. Her eyes resembled the petals of a lotus. She was bedecked in ail sorts of ornaments. This knowledge- able Narmada of excellent complexion serves and attends upon the sleeping Lord of the chiefs of Devas for the entire period of a thousand Yugas.
verses.hindi: और क्रियासे जो कुछ भी पुण्यकर्म बना हो, उससे ये सभी दुःखार्त प्राणी शुभ गतिको प्राप्त हों। तदनन्तर शुद्धचित्तवाले महर्षि आपस्तम्बकी सत्यवाणीके प्रभावसे वे सभी मल्लाह मछलियोंके

verses.sanskrit: पितुराज्ञा ऽवसाने तु विदार्य धरणीं ततः । हयं तु वासुदेवेन सागरास् ते विदुर्बुधाः
verses.transliteration: piturājñā 'vasāne tu vidārya dharaṇīṃ tataḥ / hayaṃ tu vāsudevena sāgarās te vidurbudhāḥ
verses.translation: It behoves you, O Lord of the chiefs of Devas, to give them (back) to me quickly. The entire universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings is insentient, blind and* deaf. O Lord of Suras, the fourteen worlds do not shine. Deprived of the Vedas, O Lord of Suras, I have become deficient in vigour and vitality. Hence I bow down (ardefttly). Whatever there is, whether mobile or immobile, is entirely born of the Vedas. O preceptor of the universe, the entire range of scrip- tural texts shines well only as long as the eternal treasure of the Vedas has not been removed. By keeping up and holding steadfast to the Vedas one can quell all sins as in the case of the darkness that is destroyed by the rising sun.
verses.hindi: साथ स्वर्गलोकमें चले गये । मछलियोंसहित उन मत्स्यजीवी निषादोंको स्वर्गमें गया हुआ देख

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टाः सागरास् ते तु रसातलतलं गताः । तान् अहं पूरयिष्यामि आत्मतोयेन सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭāḥ sāgarās te tu rasātalatalaṃ gatāḥ / tān ahaṃ pūrayiṣyāmi ātmatoyena suvrata
verses.translation: On being told thus by Brahma Paramesthin, the Lord of Devas spoke to Narmada, the most excellent one among rivers, in sweet and smooth words: "O blessed one, tell Brahma what he is asking for? By whom have all the Vedas of Brahma, the preceptor of the universe, been taken away?" On being told thus by Rudra, the fawn-eyed one said: "O Mahesvara, while you were asleep, Brahma was reciting the Vedas. verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन पूजयामास भास्करम् । त्रिरात्र्याराधितो भानुः प्रातः प्रोवाच तं नृप

verses.sanskrit: चित्रकुष्ठं विनश्येत त्वत् प्रसादेन मे प्रभो । एवम् अस्त्विति तं प्राह गन्धर्वाधिपतिं तदा

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः शिवलोके महीयते

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे ऽर्कतीर्थमाहात्म्ये नवमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय १० मार्कण्डेय उवाच: दक्षिणे तस्य तीर्थस्य कल्पगातीरमाश्रितम् । सोमेनाराधितं तीर्थं भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe 'rkatīrthamāhātmye navamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 10 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: dakṣiṇe tasya tīrthasya kalpagātīramāśritam / somenārādhitaṃ tīrthaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmana, in which Kalpa was this highly e$eemable Narmada divided by all the noble-souled sages en- dowed with the power of penance? Narrate this in detail, O most excellent one among eloquent persons.
verses.hindi: आश्रमपर आये। पिताको मारा गया देख क्रोधसे उनका पराक्रम दूना हो गया। वे सहसा उठकर माहिष्मतीपुरीकी ओर चल दिये। वहाँ कार्तवीर्य
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmana, in which Kalpa was this highly e$eemable Narmada divided by all the noble-souled sages en- dowed with the power of penance? Narrate this in detail, O most excellent one among eloquent persons.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmana, in which Kalpa was this highly e$eemable Narmada divided by all the noble-souled sages en- dowed with the power of penance? Narrate this in detail, O most excellent one among eloquent persons.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति मृतास् ते न पुनर्भवाः । दक्षिणे तस्य देवस्य स्थितः शक्रेश्वरः शिवः
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti mṛtās te na punarbhavāḥ / dakṣiṇe tasya devasya sthitaḥ śakreśvaraḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: When (the other parts of) the world were assailed by drought, when the mobile and immobile beings became dried up, when all the reckonings of the beginning of the Yuga had been changed, when there was loss of consciousness fol- lowed by a hue and cry, when the classification of the four Varnas became extinct, when the. order of Balis (oblations) and Homos became defunct, when the utterance of the phrases Svahd and Vasat ceased, when* the purity of personal cleanli- ness and good conduct was no longer maintained, then this excellent river alone was resorted to by crores of sages. No other river was as beautiful as this in all the three worlds, O king. This region with the meritorious water shone like the city of Amaravatl of Indra. The divine river Narmada shone like Ganga in Svarga.
verses.hindi: अर्जुनको देखकर परशुरामने क्रोधपूर्वक कहा- “अरे ओ नराधम! खड़ा रह। मेरे पिताकी हत्या करके अब तू कहाँ जा सकता है ?' ऐसा कहकर उन्होंने अपनी कुल्हाड़ी हाथमें ली और कार्तवीर्यकी

verses.transliteration: yogī snātvā vidhānena yogānte tridivaṃ gataḥ / tatra snātvā naro rājaṃs tiryag yonau na gacchati
verses.translation: After a number of births human state is obtained. With great difficulty devotion to Sahkara is generated. This attainment is rendered possible through Tlrthas, Danas, fasts, Yajnas, adorations of Devas and Brahmanas and through great faith, O king. Hence faith has to be maintained by men fond of pious rites. Isvara is also attainable by Sraddha (faith). Hence faith is considered specially significant. Otherwise, if it is devoid of Sraddha, everything is fruitless, O descendant of Bharata. Hence one should resort to devotion to Rudra Paramesthin. Only the life of those is fruitful who have unswerving devotion. Bhakti (devotion) is of three kinds, namely SattvikI, Rajas! and Tamas! and the benefit derived by all the people is also of three kinds. Men are reborn again and again as a result of their Karmas. After hundreds of births, wise worshippers of the deities obtain devotion to the three deities when sinful Karmas are destroyed.

verses.translation: Through (the kindness of) Isana, salvation is ob- tained thereafter without any doubt. Those people who are of concentrated minds and who ardently worship the immutable Siva attain spiritual progress quickly.

verses.commentary: Sense: Hence one should as a habit take the holy bath and smear oneself with holy ash. By approaching the banks of Narmada, one shall quickly attain Siddhi.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्याद् दिवि दीव्यन्तिदेवताः । तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति ये मृता न पुनर्भवाः
verses.transliteration: tasya tīrthasya māhātmyād divi dīvyantidevatāḥ / tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ
verses.translation: A man who calmly and respectfully adores the Linga thrice a day, shall become freed from all ailments and attain the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: पूजनसे ब्रह्महत्या आदि पाप सात रातमें नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: A man who calmly and respectfully adores the Linga thrice a day, shall become freed from all ailments and attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who calmly and respectfully adores the Linga thrice a day, shall become freed from all ailments and attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यत् परमं तीर्थं वाराहं नाम विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: athānyat paramaṃ tīrthaṃ vārāhaṃ nāma viśrutam
verses.translation: Sankara has declared that, more particularly so, in the case of those who are unsteady in the performance of austerities despite the fact that they have resorted to the holy rites of ascetics. Undoubtedly they go to Naraka.
verses.hindi: सभी आपसमें यह गाथा गाते रहते हैं कि “क्या हमारे कुलमें भी कोई ऐसा परम धार्मिक पुत्र उत्पन्न होगा जो हमें नर्मदाके जलसे पूजित तिलयुक्त हविष्यका पिण्ड देगा, जिससे कि लाखों वर्षोतक
verses.wordMeaning: Sankara has declared that, more particularly so, in the case of those who are unsteady in the performance of austerities despite the fact that they have resorted to the holy rites of ascetics. Undoubtedly they go to Naraka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sankara has declared that, more particularly so, in the case of those who are unsteady in the performance of austerities despite the fact that they have resorted to the holy rites of ascetics. Undoubtedly they go to Naraka.

verses.sanskrit: महाशूकररूपेण धात्री यत्र समुद्धृता । एकादश्यां नरः स्नात्वा कृत्वा चैव यथोदितम्
verses.transliteration: mahāśūkararūpeṇa dhātrī yatra samuddhṛtā / ekādaśyāṃ naraḥ snātvā kṛtvā caiva yathoditam
verses.translation: After knowing this, all Brahmanas should act in accordance with the injunctions (of religion). They must fre- quently recite in a low voice the great Brahman (the Vedic passages). He who recites the passages connected with Lord Virupak$a (Siva) of the highest form and also the Rudra Mantras sees Isana directly within six months if he avoids undue attach- ment (to the world). He who has perfect self-control and recites the Samhitas ten times on the banks of Narmada shall be liberated from all sins.
verses.hindi: तृप्त रहकर हम परम गतिको प्राप्त होंगे?!
verses.wordMeaning: After knowing this, all Brahmanas should act in accordance with the injunctions (of religion). They must fre- quently recite in a low voice the great Brahman (the Vedic passages).…
verses.commentary: Sense: After knowing this, all Brahmanas should act in accordance with the injunctions (of religion). They must fre- quently recite in a low voice the great Brahman (the Vedic passages).…

verses.sanskrit: उपवासपरो भूत्वा द्वादश्यां तु युधिष्ठिर । वैष्णवस् तु शुचिर् भूत्वा वाराहं च समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: upavāsaparo bhūtvā dvādaśyāṃ tu yudhiṣṭhira / vaiṣṇavas tu śucir bhūtvā vārāhaṃ ca samarcayet
verses.translation: The Pinaka-wielding holy Lord protects the man who is disgusted with birth, is afraid of death and is over- whelmed by lust etc., but who does not slip from Yama (re- strain ts),.Niyama (observances) etc.
verses.hindi: नर्मदा और कुन्जाके संगममें स्नान करनेके लिये सोमवती अमावास्या प्रसिद्ध पर्व है । एरण्डी और चण्डवेगाका जहाँ नर्मदा नदीसे संगम हुआ है, वहाँ स्नान करनेके लिये सोमवती अमावास्या,
verses.wordMeaning: The Pinaka-wielding holy Lord protects the man who is disgusted with birth, is afraid of death and is over- whelmed by lust etc., but who does not slip from Yama (re- strain ts),.Niyama (observances) etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pinaka-wielding holy Lord protects the man who is disgusted with birth, is afraid of death and is over- whelmed by lust etc., but who does not slip from Yama (re- strain ts),.Niyama (observances) etc.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पोपहारधूपैश् च गन्धदीपविलेपनैः । वर्षलक्षं तु साग्रं वै लोके क्रीडति वैष्णवे
verses.transliteration: puṣpopahāradhūpaiś ca gandhadīpavilepanaiḥ / varṣalakṣaṃ tu sāgraṃ vai loke krīḍati vaiṣṇave
verses.translation: O deluded one, why do you go to distant quarters like a mad person (or) like one devoid of any feelings, after abandoning Reva worthy of being attended upon by even the celestial river, and where Lord Hara and Lord Hari are sta- tioned on her banks?
verses.hindi: दक्षिणायन और उत्तरायणके प्रारम्भिक दिन-ये पर्व उत्तम माने गये हैं। अमावास्याको स्नान करनेसे बीस गुना पुण्य होता है, व्यतिपात योगमें सौगुना, संक्रान्तिकाल तथा वैधृतियोगमें पचासगुना और
verses.wordMeaning: O deluded one, why do you go to distant quarters like a mad person (or) like one devoid of any feelings, after abandoning Reva worthy of being attended upon by even the celestial river, and where Lord Hara and Lord Hari are sta- tioned on her banks?
verses.commentary: Sense: O deluded one, why do you go to distant quarters like a mad person (or) like one devoid of any feelings, after abandoning Reva worthy of being attended upon by even the celestial river, and where Lord Hara and Lord Hari are sta- tioned on her banks?

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारी जितक्रोधो विष्णुधर्मपरायणः । भक्त्या भोजयते यस् तु विप्रान् वैष्णवकांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: brahmacārī jitakrodho viṣṇudharmaparāyaṇaḥ / bhaktyā bhojayate yas tu viprān vaiṣṇavakāṃs tathā
verses.translation: A Brahmana equipped with the (knowledge of) Veda is rid of all sins by performing once the Japa of Rudradhyaya. He goes to Visnuloka.
verses.hindi: सोमवती अमावास्या एवं चन्द्रग्रहणके समय कुरुक्षेत्रसे सौगुना पुण्य होता है। यह साक्षात् महादेवजीका कथन है। वहाँ बिल्वाम्रक नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक सिद्धलिंग है, जो ब्रह्महत्याका नाश करनेवाला
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana equipped with the (knowledge of) Veda is rid of all sins by performing once the Japa of Rudradhyaya. He goes to Visnuloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana equipped with the (knowledge of) Veda is rid of all sins by performing once the Japa of Rudradhyaya. He goes to Visnuloka.

verses.sanskrit: लेखयित्वा विष्णुधर्मान् वस्त्रालङ्कारभूषितान् । निवेदयेद् ब्राह्मणाय श्रोत्रियाय विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: lekhayitvā viṣṇudharmān vastrālaṅkārabhūṣitān / nivedayed brāhmaṇāya śrotriyāya viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Due to the power of those sages who had mastered the Vedas and attained Siddhi earlier, Lord Indra, the slayer of Bala and Vftra, showered rain.
verses.hindi: है। उसके दर्शन और स्पर्शसे मनुष्य शिवलोकमें प्रतिष्ठित होता है। जो सोमवती अमावास्याके दिन वहाँ प्राण-त्याग करता है, वह महादेवजीके कल्याणमय धाममें निवास करता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the power of those sages who had mastered the Vedas and attained Siddhi earlier, Lord Indra, the slayer of Bala and Vftra, showered rain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the power of those sages who had mastered the Vedas and attained Siddhi earlier, Lord Indra, the slayer of Bala and Vftra, showered rain.

verses.sanskrit: पुराणं नर्मदाख्यानं श्रावयेच् च समाहितः । वरदाश् च त्रयो देवा ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: purāṇaṃ narmadākhyānaṃ śrāvayec ca samāhitaḥ / varadāś ca trayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: राजन्! अयोध्याके चक्रवती नरेश श्रीमान् रन्तिदेव
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्ति तस्य सत्यं वै ना ऽत्र कार्य्या विचारणा । यावद् अक्षरसंख्यानं यावत् पत्रसमुच्चयः
verses.transliteration: bhavanti tasya satyaṃ vai nā 'tra kāryyā vicāraṇā / yāvad akṣarasaṃkhyānaṃ yāvat patrasamuccayaḥ
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रके तुल्य महापराक्रमी राजा थे। वे समस्त धर्मात्माओंमें श्रेष्ठ माने जाते थे। उनके राज्यमें मनुष्योंको शोक, मात्सर्य, रोग और दारिक्र्यका दुःख नहीं होता था। सब प्रजा दीर्घायु तथा धन-
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तावद् युगसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते । विद्यादानात् परं दानं नान्य लोकेषु गीयते
verses.transliteration: tāvad yugasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate / vidyādānāt paraṃ dānaṃ nānya lokeṣu gīyate
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: धान्यसे सम्पन्न थी, गौएँ स्वयं ही इच्छाके अनुसार दूध देती थीं और पृथ्वी सदा हरी-भरी खेतीसे सुशोभित रहती थी। इस प्रकार पृथ्वीका पालन करते हुए राजा रन्तिदेवने अपने पुरोहित मुनिवर
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अदीपा च यथा रात्रिर् अनादित्यं यथा नभः । विद्याहीनं तथा सर्वमन्धे तमसि मज्जति
verses.transliteration: adīpā ca yathā rātrir anādityaṃ yathā nabhaḥ / vidyāhīnaṃ tathā sarvamandhe tamasi majjati
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: वसिष्ठजीसे पूछा-“महामुने! किस तीर्थमें निर्विध्नतापूर्वक यज्ञकी सिद्धि होती है?! मुनिवर वसिष्ठने कहा--राजन् ! पुराणमें सब तीर्थोंसे बढ़कर उत्तम तीर्थ उसीको बताया गया
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं विद्यादानस्य यत् फलम् । सर्वदानफलं तस्य विद्यादानप्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vidyādānasya yat phalam / sarvadānaphalaṃ tasya vidyādānaprabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: है, जहाँ नर्मदा नदी बहती हैं । तब राजाने सेवक, मन्त्री और पुरोहितको आज्ञा देते हुए कहा--यज्ञका सामान शीघ्र ही तैयार किया जाय। तत्पश्चात् दूतोंको भिन्न-भिन्न देशोंमें
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यत् परमं तीर्थं चान्द्रायणम् इति स्मृतम् । शशाङ्के रोहिणीयुक्ते पौर्णमास्यां महोत्सवे
verses.transliteration: athānyat paramaṃ tīrthaṃ cāndrāyaṇam iti smṛtam / śaśāṅke rohiṇīyukte paurṇamāsyāṃ mahotsave
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: शीघ्र जानेकी आज्ञा देते हुए कहा--' समस्त राष्ट्रमें यह घोषणा करा दी जाय कि “सब राजा मेरे यज्ञमें पधारेँ।' रन्तिदेवकी आज्ञासे सभी सामन्त नरेश उस यज्ञमें सम्मिलित होनेके लिये आये।
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: शशाङ्कभूषणं देवं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम् । अर्चयित्वा विधानेन स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: śaśāṅkabhūṣaṇaṃ devaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam / arcayitvā vidhānena svargaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: महाराज रन्तिदेव भी अपनी रानी और यज्ञसामग्रियोकि साथ दिव्य रथपर आरूढ़ हो नर्मदाके तटपर गये। वहाँ यज्ञमण्डप, यज्ञकुण्ड और यज्ञके यूप सभी सुवर्णमय बनाये गये थे। नाना प्रकारके भक्ष्य-
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: पौर्णमास्यां तु कुरुते राहुसूर्यसमागमे । तिलोदकं पिण्डदानं पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: paurṇamāsyāṃ tu kurute rāhusūryasamāgame / tilodakaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: महाराजने अपनी धर्मपत्नीके साथ यज्ञकी दीक्षा ली। तदनन्तर नर्मदाके सुन्दर तटपर उनका यज्ञ प्रारम्भ हुआ। उसमें धूमरहित अग्निदेव प्रत्यक्ष प्रकट होकर प्रज्वलित हो रहे थे। ब्रह्मा और इन्द्र
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: पितरस् तस्य तृप्यन्ति पापोपहतचेतसः । सर्वं पाखण्डयुक्तं च आवृतं कलिना तथा
verses.transliteration: pitaras tasya tṛpyanti pāpopahatacetasaḥ / sarvaṃ pākhaṇḍayuktaṃ ca āvṛtaṃ kalinā tathā
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: आदि देवता, लोकपाल, मरुद्गण, विश्वेदेव, साध्य,
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: पुराणवेदधर्माश् च दानं यज्ञस् तपस् तथा । आच्छादितम् इदं पुण्यं हेतुकैः पापकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: purāṇavedadharmāś ca dānaṃ yajñas tapas tathā / ācchāditam idaṃ puṇyaṃ hetukaiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: उमासहित शिव तथा देवेश्वर विष्णु- लिये राजाने पृथक्-पृथक् यज्ञभाग दिये।  या
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: नग्नैर् मलिनदीनैश् च कलौ लोके दिगम्बरैः । तस्माद् धर्मपरैर् नित्यम् उपास्या नर्मदा नदी
verses.transliteration: nagnair malinadīnaiś ca kalau loke digambaraiḥ / tasmād dharmaparair nityam upāsyā narmadā nadī
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: कुब्जा और नर्मदाके संगमकी महिमा, हरिकेश ब्राह्मणका परिवारसहित ब्रह्मराक्षसयोनिसे उद्धार
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: सौम्ये तु द्वादशादित्यं तीर्थं पुण्यविवर्धनम् । तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन्न् अर्चयित्वा तु भास्करम्
verses.transliteration: saumye tu dvādaśādityaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyavivardhanam / tatra snātvā naro rājann arcayitvā tu bhāskaram
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं-शालग्रामक्षेत्रमें हरिकेश नामसे विख्यात एक श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मण रहते थे। वे शिल और उञ्छवृत्तिसे जीवन-निर्वाह करते थे। बड़े ही धर्मात्मा और सत्यपरायण थे। उनकी
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: संक्रान्तौ विषुवे चैव सूर्यलोके महीयते । एकस्मिन् भोजिते विप्रे लक्षं भवति भोजितम्
verses.transliteration: saṃkrāntau viṣuve caiva sūryaloke mahīyate / ekasmin bhojite vipre lakṣaṃ bhavati bhojitam
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: धर्मपत्नी ब्राह्मणी भी उत्तम व्रतका पालन करनेवाली,
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तिलान्नं च हिरण्यं च यथा शक्त्या ददाति यः । शुक्लपक्षस्य माघस्य शुभा षष्ठी च सप्तमी
verses.transliteration: tilānnaṃ ca hiraṇyaṃ ca yathā śaktyā dadāti yaḥ / śuklapakṣasya māghasya śubhā ṣaṣṭhī ca saptamī
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: पतिसेवामें संलग्न रहनेवाली थी। वह स्त्री समयपर रजस्वला हुई और ब्राह्मणने ऋतुकालमें उसके साथ सहवास किया। ब्राह्मणीके गर्भसे सौ पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। वे सभी कपिलापुरमें रहते थे।
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां दानप्रभावेण ह्य् उपवासपरायणः । दशवर्षसहस्राणि सूर्यलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ dānaprabhāveṇa hy upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / daśavarṣasahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणदेवता शिलोज्छवृत्तिके प्रयोगसे एक प्रस्थ अन्न प्रतिदिन उपार्जन करते थे। इससे उनके बच्चे भूखसे दुर्बल होकर बड़े करुण स्वरमें रोते रहते थे। बालकोंको भूखा देख माता शोक और
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थम् आप्सरसं नाम याम्यां दिशि समाश्रितम् । चम्पका सीमपा नामा केशिनी भामिनी तथा
verses.transliteration: tīrtham āpsarasaṃ nāma yāmyāṃ diśi samāśritam / campakā sīmapā nāmā keśinī bhāminī tathā
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: पीड़ासे व्याकुल रहती थी। एक दिन वह अत्यन्त दुःखसे कातर हो पतिसे बोली, ' आर्यपुत्र! बूढ़े
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: कौमुदी सुप्रभा चैव उत्पला च महोदया । निषादयोनिं संप्राप्ताः पूर्वजन्मनि भारत
verses.transliteration: kaumudī suprabhā caiva utpalā ca mahodayā / niṣādayoniṃ saṃprāptāḥ pūrvajanmani bhārata
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: बालक-इन सबका प्रयत्नपूर्वक भरण-पोषण करना चाहिए, यही सनातन धर्म है। यों तो सभी पोष्यवर्गका भरण-पोषण आवश्यक है, परंतु पुत्रोंके पालन- पोषणपर तो विशेष ध्यान देना चाहिए।'
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: एता आप्सरसं देवं गौरी चैव सुरेश्वरी । माघे मासि तृतीयायां निराहाराश् च निर्जलाः
verses.transliteration: etā āpsarasaṃ devaṃ gaurī caiva sureśvarī / māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ nirāhārāś ca nirjalāḥ
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: युधिष्ठिर! ब्राह्मणीका यह वचन सुनकर हरिकेशजी शोकसे विह्वृल हो उठे और इस प्रकार बोले-'देवि! मैं गाँव-गाँवमें भीख माँगकर सबके लिये पृथक्-पृथक् बाँटकर उत्तम अन्न देता ही
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: उदकैः स्नापयित्वा तु बिल्वपत्रैर् अपूजयन् । दशवर्षसहस्राणि सावधानास् तु नार्मदैः
verses.transliteration: udakaiḥ snāpayitvā tu bilvapatrair apūjayan / daśavarṣasahasrāṇi sāvadhānās tu nārmadaiḥ
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: Gl दूसरी कोई वृत्ति करता नहीं, फिर अधिक अन मैं कहाँसे लाऊँ?। ब्राह्मणी बोली--यदि बालक और वृद्ध भूखसे पीड़ित हों, तो बालहत्याके समान पाप लगता है।
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामसमृद्धास्ता अप्सरोभिः सुपूजिताः । सर्वालङ्कारशोभाढ्या नानावसनभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmasamṛddhāstā apsarobhiḥ supūjitāḥ / sarvālaṅkāraśobhāḍhyā nānāvasanabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: अतः दान ग्रहण करके भी अपने बालकोंका पालन-पोषण करना चाहिए। कहते हैं, कुरुक्षेत्रमें
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यात् संसिद्धिं परमां गताः । अथान्यत् कथयिष्यामि पुण्यतीर्थम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasya tīrthasya māhātmyāt saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ / athānyat kathayiṣyāmi puṇyatīrtham anuttamam
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: अयोध्यानरेश महाराज अम्बरीषका कोई महान् यज्ञ हो रहा है। वहाँ दान लेनेके लिये बहुत-से
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र स्नातस्य विधिवत् कन्यादानफलं भवेत् । शङ्करं नाम लिङ्गं तु उत्तरस्यां दिशि स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: yatra snātasya vidhivat kanyādānaphalaṃ bhavet / śaṅkaraṃ nāma liṅgaṃ tu uttarasyāṃ diśi smṛtam
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: सुवर्ण और धन पाकर वे सब लोग लोटे हैं। जहाँ सब शालग्रामनिवासी ब्राह्मण गये थे, वहाँ आप
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चयित्वा तु तं देवं दर्शे चैव नराधिप । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: arcayitvā tu taṃ devaṃ darśe caiva narādhipa / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: तब पुत्रोंके भरण-पोषणकी इच्छासे हरिकेशजी भी ब्राह्मणी और बालकोंको साथ ले राजा अम्बरीषके महायज्ञमें गये और जहाँ ऋत्विग् लोग बैठे थे, वहाँ उन्होंने यज्ञमण्डपमें प्रवेश
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि सङ्गमं लोकविश्रुतम् । दत्तात्रेया नदी यत्र सङ्गता सह रेवया
verses.transliteration: athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi saṅgamaṃ lokaviśrutam / dattātreyā nadī yatra saṅgatā saha revayā
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: किया। महाराज अम्बरीषने उन श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणको देखकर मस्तक झुकाया और अर्घ्य-पाद्यके द्वारा उन सबका पूजन किया। तत्पश्चात् उन्होंने
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: सौम्यभागे वरारोहासुरासुरनमस्कृता । तत्र स्नात्वा च दत्त्वा च अर्चयित्वा तु केशवम्
verses.transliteration: saumyabhāge varārohāsurāsuranamaskṛtā / tatra snātvā ca dattvā ca arcayitvā tu keśavam
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: यहाँ किसलिये आये हैं? आपने आतिथ्यके समय यहाँ पदार्पण किया है। अतः जो उचित एवं आवश्यक वस्तु हो उसे माँगिये।'
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: पापिष्ठा ये दुराचारा धर्मकर्मबहिष्कृताः । प्रभावात् तस्य तीर्थस्य ते ऽपि यान्ति हरेः पुरम्
verses.transliteration: pāpiṣṭhā ye durācārā dharmakarmabahiṣkṛtāḥ / prabhāvāt tasya tīrthasya te 'pi yānti hareḥ puram
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणने कहा-राजन्! आप मेरे एक-एक पुत्रको सौ-सौ वर्षोंकी जीविकाके लिये पर्याप्त धन दीजिये। साथ ही यज्ञ और होमके लिये उत्तम धेनु तथा सुवर्णके भारसे विभूषित दस
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: मेधातिथिः करः स्कन्दः सावर्णिः कौशिको मनुः । काश्यपो गालवश् चैव मैत्रेयस् तपसां निधिः
verses.transliteration: medhātithiḥ karaḥ skandaḥ sāvarṇiḥ kauśiko manuḥ / kāśyapo gālavaś caiva maitreyas tapasāṃ nidhiḥ
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: हजार गौएँ प्रदान कीजिये। इसके अतिरिक्त एक करोड़ स्वर्णमुद्राएँ तथा उत्तम-उत्तम वस्त्र और आभूषण अर्पण कीजिये।
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये ऽपि बहवो ऋषयः संशितव्रताः । तीर्थस्या ऽस्य प्रभावेण शंसिद्धिं परमां गताः
verses.transliteration: ete cānye 'pi bahavo ṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ / tīrthasyā 'sya prabhāveṇa śaṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणकी यह बात सुनकर महाराज अम्बरीषने बड़ी श्रद्धाके साथ वह सब कुछ उन्हें समर्पित किया और अपनी सवारियोंसे उन्हें शालग्राम स्थानतक पहुँचा दिया। इस प्रकार उस महान्
verses.wordMeaning: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by resorting to this great river that our grand- fathers and great-grandfathers and other forefathers — all of them, went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे तीर्थमहिमवर्णनो नामैकादशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय १२ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अथ शृणुष्व राजेन्द्र दक्षिणां दिशमाश्रितम् । शैवं गाञ्जालभेदं च संगमं सुरपूजितम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe tīrthamahimavarṇano nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 12 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: atha śṛṇuṣva rājendra dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritam / śaivaṃ gāñjālabhedaṃ ca saṃgamaṃ surapūjitam
verses.translation: On hearing this, O king, the sages became highly delighted. With palms joined together in veneration the Brahmanas began to eulogize Narmada.
verses.hindi: यज्ञको परिपूर्ण करके वे राजर्षि दीर्षकालतक
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this, O king, the sages became highly delighted. With palms joined together in veneration the Brahmanas began to eulogize Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this, O king, the sages became highly delighted. With palms joined together in veneration the Brahmanas began to eulogize Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति ये मृता न पुनर्भवाः । यः कुर्यात् पितृदेवानां तर्पणं पिण्डपातनम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ / yaḥ kuryāt pitṛdevānāṃ tarpaṇaṃ piṇḍapātanam
verses.translation: Men wander through the various Narakas because they are fettered with many kinds of inauspicious sins. But their sufferings torment them only till they do not touch- your waters emerging from the waves set in motion by violent gusts of winds. O lotus-faced one, you are the goal unto those who are tortured by the fear of many series of miseries, who are envel- oped by many sins and overwhelmed by many Dvandvas (mu- tually opposing pairs e.g. pleasure — pain).
verses.hindi: “उञ्छः कणश आदानं कणिशाद्यर्जनं शिलम्' इस कोष-वाक्यके अनुसार बाजार या खलिहानका अन्न उठ जानेपर
verses.wordMeaning: Men wander through the various Narakas because they are fettered with many kinds of inauspicious sins. But their sufferings torment them only till they do not touch- your waters emerging from the waves set in motion by violent gusts of winds. O lotus-faced one,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Men wander through the various Narakas because they are fettered with many kinds of inauspicious sins. But their sufferings torment them only till they do not touch- your waters emerging from the waves set in motion by violent gusts of winds. O lotus-faced one,…

verses.sanskrit: पितरस् तस्य तृप्यन्ति यावच् चन्द्रार्कतारकम् । महोत्सवे च कौमुद्यां कार्त्तिक्यां चैव पर्वणि
verses.transliteration: pitaras tasya tṛpyanti yāvac candrārkatārakam / mahotsave ca kaumudyāṃ kārttikyāṃ caiva parvaṇi
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: 'बीनना 'शिल' कहा गया है।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: गाञ्जालेश्वरलिङ्गं च अर्चयेत् सिद्धिदायकम् । हरिकेशश्चक्रवर्ती कन्यापुरपतिः पुरा
verses.transliteration: gāñjāleśvaraliṅgaṃ ca arcayet siddhidāyakam / harikeśaścakravartī kanyāpurapatiḥ purā
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: वहाँ बिखरे हुए एक-एक दातेको चुनना "उञ्छ' कहलाता है और खेत कट जानेपर वहाँ गिरी हुई धान या गेहूँकी मंजरी
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थस्या ऽस्य प्रभावेण मुक्तो भूद् वत्सगोवधात् । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ममास्ति संशयस् तात सुमहांल्लोमहर्षणः
verses.transliteration: tīrthasyā 'sya prabhāveṇa mukto bhūd vatsagovadhāt / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: mamāsti saṃśayas tāta sumahāṃllomaharṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: प्रकारके भोग भोगकर कालान्तरमें मृत्युको प्राप्त हुए। मरनेके पश्चात् उन्हें निर्जल मरुप्रदेशमें ब्रह्मणक्षस होना पड़ा। राजाका प्रतिग्रह दोषयुक्त होता है। उसे लेनेसे फिर मानव-जन्म दुर्लभ हो जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: कथं राजनि गोहत्या कथं मुक्तश् च गोवधात् । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: शृणु राजन् कथां दिव्याम् इतिहासं पुरातनम्
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ rājani gohatyā kathaṃ muktaś ca govadhāt / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu rājan kathāṃ divyām itihāsaṃ purātanam
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: जो द्रव्यके लोभसे मोहित और विषयलोलुप होकर राजाका दान ग्रहण करता है, उसका रौरव- नरकमें गिरना अवश्यम्भावी है।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: सोमवंशे नृपश्चासीत् सत्यधर्मव्रते स्थितः । देवानीक इति ख्यातो हरिकेशस् तदात्मजः
verses.transliteration: somavaṃśe nṛpaścāsīt satyadharmavrate sthitaḥ / devānīka iti khyāto harikeśas tadātmajaḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: वह ब्रह्मराक्षस अपनी स्त्री और पुत्रोंके साथ कुरुक्षेत्रको गया और बारह वर्षोतक भूखा रहकर इस चिन्तामें पड़ा कि “क्या करूँ, मेरा यह शरीर किसी प्रकार छूट नहीं पाता। अब मैं अपने
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलक्षणसम्पूर्णश् चक्रवर्ती महाबलः । अनेकाश् च मखास् तेन राजन् निष्टा महात्मना
verses.transliteration: sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇaś cakravartī mahābalaḥ / anekāś ca makhās tena rājan niṣṭā mahātmanā
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: पापकी शुद्धिके लिये अग्निमें प्रवेश करूँगा।' तब उत्तम ब्रतका पालन करनेवाली उसकी पुत्रवती पत्नीने अपने ब्रह्मराक्षस पतिसे कहा--'प्रभो! ब्राह्मणका यह सब धर्म अग्निसे ही सिद्ध होता
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: ख्यातं कन्यापुरं तस्य धनदस्यालका यथा । चिरायुषः प्रजाः सर्वा धनधान्यसमन्विताः
verses.transliteration: khyātaṃ kanyāpuraṃ tasya dhanadasyālakā yathā / cirāyuṣaḥ prajāḥ sarvā dhanadhānyasamanvitāḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: है। अतः लकड़ी इकट्टी करके आप उसमें आग जला दीजिये और मैं सौभाग्यवती रहकर पहले स्वयं ही अग्निमें प्रवेश करूँगी। अपनेसे पहले पतिको भयंकर आगमें गिरते नहीं देख सकूँगी ।'
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: तुङ्गभद्रेति विख्याता श्रीशैले त्रिपुरान्तिके । उक्ता पातालगङ्गेति मल्लिकार्जुनदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: tuṅgabhadreti vikhyātā śrīśaile tripurāntike / uktā pātālagaṅgeti mallikārjunadarśanāt
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: उसके ऐसा निश्चय करनेपर आकाशवाणीने उससे कहा-'शुभे ! तुम्हें मृत्युका भय नहीं है, कुब्जा और नर्मदाके संगममें स्नान करनेसे ब्रह्मराक्षसयोनि छूट जाती है। उसमें स्नान करके
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वभागे ततस् तस्य श्रीधामं नाम खेटकम् । नाना मुनिसमाकीर्णं देवकोटिसमावृतम्
verses.transliteration: pūrvabhāge tatas tasya śrīdhāmaṃ nāma kheṭakam / nānā munisamākīrṇaṃ devakoṭisamāvṛtam
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: बिल्वाम्रकेश्वरकी पूजासे मनुष्य स्वर्गलोकमें जाता है, ब्रह्मराक्षसयोनिसे मुक्त होता है और ब्रह्मलोकको प्राप्त होता है।' ऐसा कहकर आकाशवाणी मौन हो गयी। तब हरिकेशने अपनी स्त्री और पुत्रोंके
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: ललितोद्वाहिता तत्र शिवेन परमात्मना । पुरा त्वस्यायुषा नाम प्रजापतिरकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: lalitodvāhitā tatra śivena paramātmanā / purā tvasyāyuṣā nāma prajāpatirakalpayat
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: साथ वहाँ जाकर महादेवजीको प्रणाम किया और कुब्जा एवं नर्मदाके संगममें विधिपूर्वक स्नान करके महादेवजीका पूजन किया। तत्पश्चात् वे सब-के-सब काम और क्रोधसे रहित हो भगवान्
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रभा नाम तस्यास् तु विख्यातम् अभवत् तथा । देव्याः पूर्वावतारो ऽयं कथितस् ते विशाम्पते
verses.transliteration: suprabhā nāma tasyās tu vikhyātam abhavat tathā / devyāḥ pūrvāvatāro 'yaṃ kathitas te viśāmpate
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: विष्णु और शिवका स्मरण करते हुए अपने घरकी भाँति प्रज्वलित अग्निमें बिना क्लेशके ही प्रवेश कर गये। फिर तो उन्हें तत्क्षण दिव्य देहकी प्राप्ति हुई और वे ब्रह्मतेजोमय शरीर
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीये हिमवत्पुत्री पार्वती च उमा तथा । तृतीये दक्षदुहिता नाम्ना गौरीति विश्रुता
verses.transliteration: dvitīye himavatputrī pārvatī ca umā tathā / tṛtīye dakṣaduhitā nāmnā gaurīti viśrutā
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: धारण करके दिव्य विमानपर बैठकर ब्रह्मलोकको
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यतीर्थे च क्षेत्रे ऽस्मिन् हरिकेशः प्रतापवान् । सुप्रभा निकटे नाम सुप्रभो राजसत्तम
verses.transliteration: puṇyatīrthe ca kṣetre 'smin harikeśaḥ pratāpavān / suprabhā nikaṭe nāma suprabho rājasattama
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: उस पवित्र संगममें एक सौ आठ शिवलिंग हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: शशास मेदिनीं राजा सर्वधर्मपरायणः । लक्षम् एकं तु दोग्ध्रीणां राहुसूर्यसमागमे
verses.transliteration: śaśāsa medinīṃ rājā sarvadharmaparāyaṇaḥ / lakṣam ekaṃ tu dogdhrīṇāṃ rāhusūryasamāgame
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: माहेश्वरतीर्थकी महिमा, राजा सालंकायनका यज्ञ
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: निष्काणां तु सहस्रं वै प्रतिगङ्गामकल्पयत् । सर्वाभरणशोभाढ्याम् एकां गां चोपवेशयत्
verses.transliteration: niṣkāṇāṃ tu sahasraṃ vai pratigaṅgāmakalpayat / sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyām ekāṃ gāṃ copaveśayat
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--राजन्! माहेश्वरपुरमें बहुत-से तीर्थ हैं, वहाँसे रौद्रवारुणतीर्थतक जो एक कोसकी भूमि है, उसके भीतरका स्थान शिवक्षेत्र कहा गया है। जो वहाँ मृत्युको प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणांश् च समाहूय वेदविद्याबहुश्रुतान् । पञ्चभिर्दिवसैः पूर्वं राहुसूर्यसमागमे
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāṃś ca samāhūya vedavidyābahuśrutān / pañcabhirdivasaiḥ pūrvaṃ rāhusūryasamāgame
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: होता है, वह शिवलोकमें आनन्दका भागी होता है। वहाँ पितरोंको तिल और जलकी अंजलि देनेसे माता और पिता दोनों कुलोंके पितर महाप्रलय- 'कालतक तृप्त रहते हैं। प्राचीन कालमें ब्रह्माजीके
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयागे तत्र योगे वा इत्युक्तं वेदपारगैः । दैवोपकृतयोगेन पूर्वकर्म्मकृतेन च
verses.transliteration: prayāge tatra yoge vā ityuktaṃ vedapāragaiḥ / daivopakṛtayogena pūrvakarmmakṛtena ca
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: द्वारा वहाँ असंख्य उत्तम यज्ञ किये गये हैं। इन्द्रने भी वहीं यज्ञानुष्ठान करके देवराज-पदको प्राप्त किया है। कार्तवीर्य अर्जुनने भी वहीं पूर्वकालमें सौ यज्ञ किये थे। राजन्! पहलेकी बात है।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयी हूयते चेष्टी राज्ञा ऽनलसमागमे । अग्नावाहवनीये ऽत्र रौद्रैर्मन्त्रैः सुतेजसैः
verses.transliteration: āgneyī hūyate ceṣṭī rājñā 'nalasamāgame / agnāvāhavanīye 'tra raudrairmantraiḥ sutejasaiḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: अयोध्यापुरीमें सूर्यवंशी राजा वैवस्वत मनु, जो साक्षात् भगवान् सूर्यके ही पुत्र थे, चक्रवर्ती नरेशके
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: पातालाद् उत्थितो वह्णिर् युगान्ताग्निसमप्रभः । दग्धं गोमण्डलं कृत्स्नम् अयुतं ब्रह्मचारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: pātālād utthito vahṇir yugāntāgnisamaprabhaḥ / dagdhaṃ gomaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnam ayutaṃ brahmacāriṇām
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: पदपर प्रतिष्ठित थे। वे सदा यज्ञ और दानमें  सोचा “जन्मसे लेकर
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मीभूतं च तत्सर्वं मण्डपं पुरम् एव हि । हरिकेशो विषण्णात्मा प्रवेष्टुं वै हुताशनम्
verses.transliteration: bhasmībhūtaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ maṇḍapaṃ puram eva hi / harikeśo viṣaṇṇātmā praveṣṭuṃ vai hutāśanam
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: तत्पर रहते थे। उनके शासनकालमें उत्तम पुरी अयोध्याके भीतर मृत्यु, रोग और वृद्धावस्थाका कष्ट किसीको भी नहीं होता था । तदनन्तर उन्हींके वंशमें परम धर्मात्मा राजर्षि सालंकायन हुए,
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: आसनाद् उत्थितो राजा सान्तः पुरपरिच्छदः । अमात्यैः संवृतस् तावत् समयज्ञैर् बलोत्तरैः
verses.transliteration: āsanād utthito rājā sāntaḥ puraparicchadaḥ / amātyaiḥ saṃvṛtas tāvat samayajñair balottaraiḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: जिनके राज्यकालमें समूची पृथ्वी सस्य-श्यामला एवं धन-धान्यसे सम्पन्न थी। गौएँ स्वयं ही इच्छानुसार दूध देती थीं। एक समय अयोध्याके राज्यमें बारह वर्षांतक वर्षा नहीं हुई। सम्पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: हाहाकारो महानासीत् त्रिषु लोकेषु भारत । उवाच वचनं राजा ब्राह्मणान् वेदपारगान्
verses.transliteration: hāhākāro mahānāsīt triṣu lokeṣu bhārata / uvāca vacanaṃ rājā brāhmaṇān vedapāragān
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: तृण, लता, बेलें तथा चार प्रकारके जीवसमुदाय' भी नष्टप्राय हो गये। उस समय देवता, असुर तथा मनुष्योंमें बड़ा भारी हाहाकार मचा। युधिष्ठिर! अपने देशपर आयी हुई इस आपत्तिको
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणस्यैव हत्याया गवां चैव विशेषतः । अपि वर्षसहस्रेण निष्कृतिर् न विधीयते
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇasyaiva hatyāyā gavāṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ / api varṣasahasreṇa niṣkṛtir na vidhīyate
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: राजर्षि सालंकायनको बड़ी
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: धेनूनां चैव वत्सानां ब्राह्मणानां यथागतिः । सा गतिर् मे भवेन् नित्यं सत्यम् एतद् ब्रवीम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: dhenūnāṃ caiva vatsānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yathāgatiḥ / sā gatir me bhaven nityaṃ satyam etad bravīmy aham
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: नहीं हुआ, मैं सदा संसार-सागरसे पार उतारनेवाले भगवान् श्रीहरिका पूजन करता हूँ । ब्राह्मण और ऋषि-मुनियोंको भी मैंने इच्छानुसार तृप्त किया है, तो भी मेरे राष्ट्रमै यह विपत्ति क्यों आयी ।'
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण उवाच: गच्छ त्वं महाभाग कल्पग्रामं पुरोत्तमम् । अगस्तिर् भगवान् यत्र कश्यपो भृगुर् एव च
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇa uvāca: gaccha tvaṃ mahābhāga kalpagrāmaṃ purottamam / agastir bhagavān yatra kaśyapo bhṛgur eva ca
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार विचार करते हुए राजाने बृहस्पतिके समान बुद्धिमान् ब्रह्मवादी वसिष्ठ मुनिको भक्तिभावसे साष्टांग प्रणाम करके पूछा--ब्रह्मन्! यह बारह वर्षोंकी अनावृष्टि क्यों हुई है?
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: भारद्वाजो ऽत्रिगर्गौ च गौतमो मनुर् एव च । याज्ञवल्क्यो वशिष्ठश् च ऋषयः शंसितव्रताः
verses.transliteration: bhāradvājo 'trigargau ca gautamo manur eva ca / yājñavalkyo vaśiṣṭhaś ca ṛṣayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: 'बसिष्ठजी बोले-महाबाहो! जनसमुदायमें महर्षियोंके वचन सुनकर उसीके अनुसार कोई उपाय करना चाहिए। तब राजाने जनसभामें आसनपर बैठे हुए
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा महाराज प्रायश्चित्तं प्रगृह्यताम् । महर्षीणां मतेनैव वेदशास्त्रार्थदर्शिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvā mahārāja prāyaścittaṃ pragṛhyatām / maharṣīṇāṃ matenaiva vedaśāstrārthadarśinām
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: महर्षियोंके पास जाकर अनावृष्टिका कारण पूछा। उनके पूछनेपर महर्षिलोग इस प्रकार बोले-राजन्! भूत और भविष्य-कालके तत्त्वको जाननेवाले गुरु एवं महात्मा मार्कण्डेय मुनिके
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तो ययौ राजा पादचारी द्विजैः सह । विवेश नगरीं पुण्यां ब्रह्मलोकसमां नृपः
verses.transliteration: evam ukto yayau rājā pādacārī dvijaiḥ saha / viveśa nagarīṃ puṇyāṃ brahmalokasamāṃ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: आश्रमपर जाकर ब्राह्मणोंके साथ इस प्रश्‍नपर विचार करो। वे मुनि जो-जो धर्म बतावें, वह- वह तुम्हें पालन करना चाहिए।' तदनन्तर राजा सालंकायन ब्राह्मणोंके साथ
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: महर्षींस् तत्र तान् दृष्ट्वा सो ऽभिवाद्य प्रणम्य च । निश्चयं चिरकालं तु तेषामेवाग्रत स्थितः
verses.transliteration: maharṣīṃs tatra tān dṛṣṭvā so 'bhivādya praṇamya ca / niścayaṃ cirakālaṃ tu teṣāmevāgrata sthitaḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: दिव्य रथपर आरूढ़ हो नर्मदाके तटपर गये और वहाँ मुनियोंके साथ बैठे हुए मुझ मार्कण्डेयको प्रणाम करके बैठ गये। तब मैंने उनसे कुशल-
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः: स्वागतं ते नृपश्रेष्ठ फलं कर्मसहस्रशः । किमागमनकार्यं च सत्यमेतद् वदस्व नः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ: svāgataṃ te nṛpaśreṣṭha phalaṃ karmasahasraśaḥ / kimāgamanakāryaṃ ca satyametad vadasva naḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: राजा attr! आज आपके चरणारविन्दोंका दर्शन करनेसे मैं सकुशल हूँ। परंतु मेरे राष्ट्रका भविष्य क्या होगा, यह चिन्ता मुझे सदा पीड़ित किये रहती है।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ऋषीणाम् ऊर्द्ध्वरेतसाम् । कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा वृत्तान्तं स्वं न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ṛṣīṇām ūrddhvaretasām / kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā vṛttāntaṃ svaṃ nyavedayat
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: मैंने कहा--प्रजाके कुमार्गगामी होनेसे, देवताओं और ब्राह्मणोंको कष्ट पहुँचानेसे तथा वर्णाश्रमधर्मका लोप करनेसे जो महान् अधर्म होता है, वह धर्मको हानि पहुँचाता है। अत: इस संकटसे
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: दैवाद् विपद्यते कार्यं संसिद्धमपि भो द्विजाः । दशा ऽयुतं गवां दग्धं द्विजानाम् अयुतं तथा
verses.transliteration: daivād vipadyate kāryaṃ saṃsiddhamapi bho dvijāḥ / daśā 'yutaṃ gavāṃ dagdhaṃ dvijānām ayutaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: मुक्ति पानेके लिये तुम नर्मदाके तटपर आकर रुद्रयज्ञ करो और'महादेवजीकी विधिपूर्वक आराधना 'करो। इससे वर्तमान उपद्रवकी शान्ति होगी; बादल इच्छाके अनुसार वर्षा करेंगे और पुनः सृष्टिका
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: अनुग्रहं बहु मन्ये प्रायश्चित्तमथोदितम् । ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः: दशलक्षाणि गायत्र्यास् तीर्थे तीर्थे जपं कुरुं
verses.transliteration: anugrahaṃ bahu manye prāyaścittamathoditam / brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ: daśalakṣāṇi gāyatryās tīrthe tīrthe japaṃ kuruṃ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: सारा कार्य पूर्ववत् चलने लगेगा। तुम भी पापदोषसे
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: अयुतं तु गवां दत्त्वा सहिरण्यं नृपोत्तम । कोटिहोमं तु कुर्वीत सहस्रशतदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: ayutaṃ tu gavāṃ dattvā sahiraṇyaṃ nṛpottama / koṭihomaṃ tu kurvīta sahasraśatadakṣiṇam
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: मुनिका यह वचन सुनकर राजाने मुनियोंसहित मुझे नमस्कार किया और कहा--महामुने ! आपने कृपापूर्वक जो कुछ बताया है उसे मैं अपने ऊपर आपका बहुत बड़ा अनुग्रह मानता हूँ।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयागं च महातीर्थं गच्छेद् वाराणसीं शुभाम् । केदारं च तथेशानं गङ्गासागरसङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: prayāgaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ gacched vārāṇasīṃ śubhām / kedāraṃ ca tatheśānaṃ gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgamam
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: यह कहकर राजाने अयोध्यापुरीको सन्देश भेजकर अपनी रानियों और राजकुमारोंको यज्ञसामग्रीके साथ वहीं बुलवाया। उनके बुलानेपर महाराजकी एक हजार आठ रानियाँ, राजकुमार तथा घरका
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: पितृतीर्थं गयां चैव नैमिषं पुष्करं तथा । मायापुरीं हरिक्षेत्रं गङ्गाद्वारं महाफलम्
verses.transliteration: pitṛtīrthaṃ gayāṃ caiva naimiṣaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā / māyāpurīṃ harikṣetraṃ gaṅgādvāraṃ mahāphalam
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: काम-काज करनेवाले अन्य सब लोग भी यज्ञसामग्रीसहित वहाँ उपस्थित हुए। तब राजा सालंकायन मुझे प्रणाम करके इस प्रकार बोले-'मुने! आज्ञा दीजिये कहाँ यज्ञ आरम्भ
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थेष्वेतेषु चान्येषु यावद् द्वादशवत्सरान्
verses.transliteration: tīrtheṣveteṣu cānyeṣu yāvad dvādaśavatsarān
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: मैंने कहा- वैदूर्यपर्वतके पश्चिम भागमें यज्ञयूप और यज्ञमण्डप निर्माण कराओ तथा यज्ञकी अन्य सब सामग्रियोंका भी वहीं संग्रह कराओ।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: अनेन क्रमयोगेन शुद्धिस् ते नात्र संशय । मुक्तिस् ते भविता राजन् ब्राह्मणानां प्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: anena kramayogena śuddhis te nātra saṃśaya / muktis te bhavitā rājan brāhmaṇānāṃ prabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: तब राजाने यज्ञके लिये वसिष्ठ, वामदेव आदि बहुत-से ऋषियोंका वरण किया । यज्ञमण्डपमें सोनेके बड़े-बड़े GF लगाये गये, जिनसे वहाँ बड़ी शोभा
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: दत्तं ते श्रुतिवाक्येन प्रायश्चित्तं द्विजोत्तमैः । पादपूजा द्विजेन्द्राणां कर्तव्या च विधानतः
verses.transliteration: dattaṃ te śrutivākyena prāyaścittaṃ dvijottamaiḥ / pādapūjā dvijendrāṇāṃ kartavyā ca vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: सुवर्णमय थे। नाना प्रकारके भक्ष्य-भोज्य पदार्थ तथा भाँति-भाँतिके रस तैयार किये गये थे। वेदपाठी ब्राह्णोंद्वारा देवताओंका आवाहन और पूजन किया गया । होमकुण्डमें अग्निका आधान हुआ। धूमरहित
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
