verses.sanskrit: कुरुक्षेत्रं जगामाथ कर्तुं सोमसवं नृपः । विचिन्त्यैवं स्वाघन्यासं सरस्वत्यां समाश्रयत्
verses.transliteration: kurukṣetraṃ jagāmātha kartuṃ somasavaṃ nṛpaḥ / vicintyaivaṃ svāghanyāsaṃ sarasvatyāṃ samāśrayat
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: अग्नि प्रज्वलित हो उठी। वेदमन्त्रोके उच्चारणसे आकाश गूँज उठा। आहुतियाँ दी जाने लगीं। इस प्रकार विधिपूर्वक यज्ञ पूर्ण होनेपर जब सब लोग अवभृथ-स्नानके लिये नर्मदामें गये तब उसका
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: जपति स्म शिवस्तोत्रं हरं विष्णुं सरस्वतीम् । कुरुक्षेत्रं गमिष्यामि कुरुक्षेत्रे वसाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: japati sma śivastotraṃ haraṃ viṣṇuṃ sarasvatīm / kurukṣetraṃ gamiṣyāmi kurukṣetre vasāmyaham
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: जल सूखा दिखायी दिया। यह देख राजाको बड़ा आश्चर्य हुआ। उन्होंने मुनिवर दुर्वासाजीसे पूछा- “यह क्या हुआ? वर्षा भी कहीं नहीं हुई और नर्मदाका जो पुराना जल था वह भी सूख गया।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुक्षेत्रस्य नाम्ना ऽपि नरः पापात् प्रमुच्यते । अखिलशब्दम् अहौषधप्रक्षालितसकलाभूतकलङ्का । मुनिभिरुपासिततीर्था सरस्वतीह हरतु मे दुरितम्
verses.transliteration: kurukṣetrasya nāmnā 'pi naraḥ pāpāt pramucyate / akhilaśabdam ahauṣadhaprakṣālitasakalābhūtakalaṅkā / munibhirupāsitatīrthā sarasvatīha haratu me duritam
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: इसका क्या कारण है?
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञस् तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा प्राह पापहरा नदी । विषादं त्यज राजेन्द्र शृणु मे वचनं परम्
verses.transliteration: rājñas tad vacanaṃ śrutvā prāha pāpaharā nadī / viṣādaṃ tyaja rājendra śṛṇu me vacanaṃ param
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: राजाका प्रश्‍न सुनकर दुर्वासा बोले-राजन्। जल तो सभी लोकोंको अभीष्ट है। तप, होम और वेदमन्त्र ब्राह्मणोंके अधीन हैं और यज्ञरक्षा
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: उपदेशं प्रदास्यामि स्थातुं तव नृपोत्तम । अनेकभाविकं घोरं स्मरणाद् एव नश्यति
verses.transliteration: upadeśaṃ pradāsyāmi sthātuṃ tava nṛpottama / anekabhāvikaṃ ghoraṃ smaraṇād eva naśyati
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: एवं दक्षिणा यजमानके अधीन। सो सब कुछ विधिवत् सम्पन्न हुआ है। नर्मदा जलरहित हो गयी और मेघ अभीतक पानी नहीं बरसाते। इससे हताश होनेकी आवश्यकता नहीं है। जो चली
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्या सहस्रं तु गोहत्यालक्षम् एव च । न च मोचयितुं शक्ता गङ्गा चैव सरिद्वरा
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyā sahasraṃ tu gohatyālakṣam eva ca / na ca mocayituṃ śaktā gaṅgā caiva saridvarā
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: गयी है, उस नर्मदा नदीके आनेकी बाट देखो।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: चराचरे ऽस्य लोके ऽस्मिन् कर्त्री तिष्ठति कल्पगा । दीपादित्यादिभिर् वीक्ष्य यथान्धत्व प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: carācare 'sya loke 'smin kartrī tiṣṭhati kalpagā / dīpādityādibhir vīkṣya yathāndhatva praṇaśyati
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: तब राजाने नर्मदाकी स्तुति प्रारम्भ की-- सुरेश्वरि! तुम्हें नमस्कार है । शंकरात्मजे ! तुम्हें नमस्कार है। इडा, पिंगला, उमा, गंगा, सरस्वती, वेदमाता
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: तथा नाशयते पापं कल्पगा सरितां वरा । दानैर् दग्धा पुरा चाहं क्षत्रियाणाम् अनेकधा
verses.transliteration: tathā nāśayate pāpaṃ kalpagā saritāṃ varā / dānair dagdhā purā cāhaṃ kṣatriyāṇām anekadhā
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: लोकमाता लक्ष्मी हो। पृथ्वीपर जितने भी तीर्थ बताये गये हैं, वे सब तुमसे व्याप्त हैं । समस्त चराचर जगत् तुम्हारे जलसे व्याप्त है । जगत्में ऐसा कोई स्थान नहीं दिखायी देता जो तुम्हारे जलसे
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रस्ता ऽहं तेन पापेन नृपदक्षिणया ततः । शुक्लतः कृष्णतां चाहं प्राप्ता भो पृथिवीपते
verses.transliteration: grastā 'haṃ tena pāpena nṛpadakṣiṇayā tataḥ / śuklataḥ kṛṣṇatāṃ cāhaṃ prāptā bho pṛthivīpate
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: आवृत न हो। तुम्हारे जलमें स्नान करनेमात्रसे तृप्त होकर सब जीव परम गतिको प्राप्त होते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशा ऽब्दे चतुर्विंशे स्नानं कर्तुं समागमम् । ग्रस्ते वै राहुणा सूर्ये कोटितीर्थे नराधिपः
verses.transliteration: dvādaśā 'bde caturviṃśe snānaṃ kartuṃ samāgamam / graste vai rāhuṇā sūrye koṭitīrthe narādhipaḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: अमिततेजस्वी राजाके मुखसे यह स्तवन सुनकर नर्मदादेवीने उन्हं प्रत्यक्ष दर्शन दिया और कहा राजन्! तुम्हारे मनमें जो अभिलाषा हो, उसके
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षं मे शरीरं त्वं पश्य तेजः समुज्ज्वलम् । स्नात्वा तु शिवमभ्यर्च्य बहु स्वर्णं मखोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: pratyakṣaṃ me śarīraṃ tvaṃ paśya tejaḥ samujjvalam / snātvā tu śivamabhyarcya bahu svarṇaṃ makhottamam
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: राजाने कहा- देवि! तुम सात पूर्वके और सात दूसरे प्रवाहोंको अक्षय करो।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: कुरु तत्र नृपश्रेष्ठ तेन ते निष्कृतिर् भवेत् । ये मृता ब्राह्मणा गावस् तेषाम् अस्थिप्रवाहनम्
verses.transliteration: kuru tatra nṛpaśreṣṭha tena te niṣkṛtir bhavet / ye mṛtā brāhmaṇā gāvas teṣām asthipravāhanam
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: नर्मदा बोली-राजन्! लो, यह वरदान मैंने तुम्हें यथार्थरूपसे दे दिया।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदोदकसम्पर्काद् दिवि देवत्वमाप्यते । तिलोदकप्रदानेन तेषां मुक्तिः परा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: narmadodakasamparkād divi devatvamāpyate / tilodakapradānena teṣāṃ muktiḥ parā bhavet
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर सरिताओंमें श्रेष्ठ नर्मदा जलराशिसे परिपूर्ण हो विस्तृत प्रवाहोंसे बहने लगी। राजा सालंकायनका यह अद्भुत कर्म देखकर सत्यधर्म- परायण सभी महर्षि उनकी प्रशंसा करने लगे।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वैतत् कथितं वाक्यं सरस्वत्या नृपश्च ताम् । नमस्कृत्य समुत्थाय कन्यापुरमगात् ततः
verses.transliteration: śrutvaitat kathitaṃ vākyaṃ sarasvatyā nṛpaśca tām / namaskṛtya samutthāya kanyāpuramagāt tataḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर उन सबने नर्मदामें स्नान, अवगाहन,
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: सान्तः पुरपरीवारो मुदा परमया नृपः । तेनाज्ञप्तास् ततो भृत्याः सर्वसम्भारसभृताः
verses.transliteration: sāntaḥ puraparīvāro mudā paramayā nṛpaḥ / tenājñaptās tato bhṛtyāḥ sarvasambhārasabhṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: दक्षिणा पाये हुए ब्राह्मणोंने वह यज्ञ समाप्त किया। जो जिस वस्तुकी कामना करता, उसे वही वस्तु दी जाती थी। तदनन्तर शिवालयमें जाकर समस्त मनोवांछित फलोंको देनेवाले देवपूजित माहेश्वरलिंगमें
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञोपस्करम् आदाय मेकला यत्र गच्छत । अस्थि भस्म यथान्यायं नीतं कर्मकरैस् ततः
verses.transliteration: yajñopaskaram ādāya mekalā yatra gacchata / asthi bhasma yathānyāyaṃ nītaṃ karmakarais tataḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: स्थित भोग-मोक्ष-प्रदाता उमा-महेश्वरका राजाने विधिपूर्वक पूजन किया। पूजामें प्रत्येक उपचार ‘So महेश्वराय देवाय शम्भवाय नमो नमः '-- इस मन्त्रसे चढ़ाया गया। पूजा समाप्त होनेपर
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: प्रावाहयत् कल्पगायां मन्त्रयुक्तेन वारिणा । अस्थ्यादि पूजयित्वा च यथा विधम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: prāvāhayat kalpagāyāṃ mantrayuktena vāriṇā / asthyādi pūjayitvā ca yathā vidham anuttamam
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: राजा वहीं हाथ जोड़कर खड़े हो गये। तत्पश्चात् नर्मदादेवी भगवान् शंकरके चरणके नीचेसे प्रकट हुईं। उनका वह प्रवाह सम्पूर्ण देवताओंद्वारा पूजित हुआ। तदनन्तर सन्तुष्ट हुए महादेव आदि सब
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: देवांश् च ब्राह्मणांस् तत्र तर्पयित्वा कृताञ्जलिः । प्रवाहो निर्गतस् तत्र नर्मदायां समाविशत्
verses.transliteration: devāṃś ca brāhmaṇāṃs tatra tarpayitvā kṛtāñjaliḥ / pravāho nirgatas tatra narmadāyāṃ samāviśat
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: उनके ऐसा कहनेपर राजा सालंकायनने कहा--
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: स गाञ्जालेति विख्यातो नर्मदा सङ्गमो नृप । गाञ्जालसिद्धलिङ्गं च सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: sa gāñjāleti vikhyāto narmadā saṅgamo nṛpa / gāñjālasiddhaliṅgaṃ ca sūryakoṭisamaprabham
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: न करें। हमारे राष्ट्रमें अनावृष्टि आदि दोषोंसे पीड़ित प्रजाका कष्ट दूर हो और वह सदा फले- फूले। इसके सिवा इस स्थानपर आहवनीय अग्नि
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्ययानसमारूढा दग्धाः कालाग्निना तु ये । आशीर्वादपरास् सर्वे हरिकेशं प्रतुष्टुवुः
verses.transliteration: divyayānasamārūḍhā dagdhāḥ kālāgninā tu ye / āśīrvādaparās sarve harikeśaṃ pratuṣṭuvuḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: है, वह सब पूरा होगा।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत् प्रसादान् महाभाग दिवि देवत्वम् आगताः । देवदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैर् वेणुवीणारवैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: tvat prasādān mahābhāga divi devatvam āgatāḥ / devadundubhinirghoṣair veṇuvīṇāravais tathā
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर सब देवता वहाँसे अन्तर्धान हो गये। राजाका राज्य पुनः वृद्धिको प्राप्त हुआ और इन्द्र इच्छानुसार वर्षा करने लगे। वह यज्ञ पूरा करके राजा सालंकायन अपने मन्त्रियों तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्ययानसमारूढा गतास् ते वैष्णवं पदम् । हरिकेशो नृपश्रेष्ठः परया च मुदायुतः
verses.transliteration: divyayānasamārūḍhā gatās te vaiṣṇavaṃ padam / harikeśo nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ parayā ca mudāyutaḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: अन्तःपुरकी रानियोंके साथ देवनिर्मित अयोध्यापुरीमें लौट आये। युधिष्ठिर! इस प्रकार मैंने तुम्हें उमामहेश्वरतीर्थका माहात्म्य सुनाया है।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तकल्पवहां देवीं नर्मदा लोकपावनीम् । नमस्कृत्य सरिच्छ्रेष्ठां स्तुतिं चक्रे समाहितः
verses.transliteration: saptakalpavahāṃ devīṃ narmadā lokapāvanīm / namaskṛtya saricchreṣṭhāṃ stutiṃ cakre samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: श्वेतकिंशुक आदि तीर्थोकी महिमा 4 मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--युधिष्ठिर! अमरेश्वरके  सिद्धि प्रदान करनेवाला श्वेतकिंशुक नामक लिंग
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते ऽस्तु सरिच्छ्रेष्ठे सप्तकल्पनिवासिनि । यत्र तत्र नरः स्नात्वा मुक्तो भवति कल्मषात्
verses.transliteration: namaste 'stu saricchreṣṭhe saptakalpanivāsini / yatra tatra naraḥ snātvā mukto bhavati kalmaṣāt
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: पूर्वभागमें स्थित श्वेतकिंशुक नामक पापनाशन  है तथा स्वर्गरूपी फल प्रदान करनेवाले तीर्थका माहात्म्य सुनो, जिसमें स्नान करनेवाले महादेव भी वहीं विराजमान हैं। उसके मनुष्य स्वर्गलोकको प्राप्त होते हैं। वहाँ उत्तम नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक दूसरा पापना
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: न तस्य पुनरावृत्तिर्घोरे संसारसागरे । जन्मान्तरसहस्रेण न त्वां स्तम्भयते बली
verses.transliteration: na tasya punarāvṛttirghore saṃsārasāgare / janmāntarasahasreṇa na tvāṃ stambhayate balī
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: जहाँ लोकमें वर देनेवाले त्र्यम्बक महादेव विद्यमान हैं। उस तीर्थके माहात्म्यसे गण्डेशको स्वर्गलोककी प्राप्ति हुई थी। वहाँ गण्डकेश्वर और शुक्लेश्वर लिंग प्रसिद्ध हैं । नर्मदा और दन्तिवनिकाका संगम
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: जह्नुना हि पुरा पीता करतोयेन जाह्नवी । त्वया च पूरितं सर्वं विश्वं चैव चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: jahnunā hi purā pītā karatoyena jāhnavī / tvayā ca pūritaṃ sarvaṃ viśvaṃ caiva carācaram
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: सर्वत्र विख्यात है। वहीं सब सिद्धियोंको देनेवाला लिंगेश्वर लिंग है। बालकेश्वर और पूर्णकेश्वर लिंग भी वहीं हैं। नर्मदाके उत्तर तटपर उत्तम नर्मदापुर है। कपिशिला नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक तीर्थ
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत् प्रसादात् महादेवि मुक्तिश्चापि भवार्णवात् । प्रत्यक्षा कल्पगैतच्च स्तोत्रं श्रुत्वा नृपोदितम्
verses.transliteration: tvat prasādāt mahādevi muktiścāpi bhavārṇavāt / pratyakṣā kalpagaitacca stotraṃ śrutvā nṛpoditam
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: है, जो सब अनर्थोंका निवारण करनेवाला है। वहीं सिद्धेश्वर तथा नाडकेश्वर लिंग हैं। नृपश्रेष्ठ! तदनन्तर वैदूर्य पर्वतसे पश्चिम दिशाकी ओर जाय। वहाँ शशभी और नर्मदाका संगम है,
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदोवाच: वरं वृणु महाभाग यत् ते मनसि वर्तते । तस्यास् तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा हरिकेशो ऽब्रवीद् इदम्
verses.transliteration: narmadovāca: varaṃ vṛṇu mahābhāga yat te manasi vartate / tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā harikeśo 'bravīd idam
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: जो सब पापोंका नाश करनेवाला है। वहीं भोग और मोक्ष प्रदान करनेवाला शशभेश्वर लिंग है, जो तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात है। वह गर्दभीकी योनिसे छुटकारा दिलानेवाला है । यहीं मण्डलेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: यदि मे वरदादेवि पूतं मां परिकल्पय । स्नानावगाहनात् पानात् स्मरणात् कीर्तनाद् अपि
verses.transliteration: yadi me varadādevi pūtaṃ māṃ parikalpaya / snānāvagāhanāt pānāt smaraṇāt kīrtanād api
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: नामक तीर्थ और लिंग है, जहाँ माण्डलिक नरेश अजापाल और मनु सिद्धिको प्राप्त हुए हैं। वहाँ यज्ञ करके मनुष्य फिर इस संसारमें जन्म नहीं लेता। वहाँ तिल और जल देने तथा पिण्डदान
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं सद्य एव प्रणश्यतु । रेवोवाच: एवम् अस्तु नृपश्रेष्ठ मत्प्रसादाद् भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sadya eva praṇaśyatu / revovāca: evam astu nṛpaśreṣṭha matprasādād bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: करनेसे जबतक चन्द्रमा और सूर्यकी सत्ता है, तबतक पितरोंको तृप्ति बनी रहती है। वहाँ जो दान दिया जाता है, उसके पुण्यकी कोई संख्या नहीं है। वहाँसे कान्तारकतीर्थमें जाय, जो सब
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ततो देवी तत्रैवान्तर धीयत । हरिकेशश्चक्रवर्ती साष्टाङ्गं प्रणिपत्य च
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tato devī tatraivāntara dhīyata / harikeśaścakravartī sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatya ca
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: तीथोंमें श्रेष्ठ और शुभ है। वहाँ स्नान करनेवाले स्वर्गमें जाते हैं और मरनेवाले मोक्ष पाते हैं। त्रेतायुगमें रघुवंशी राजकुमार श्रीराम और लक्ष्मण मिथिलेशकुमारी सीताके साथ यहाँ आकर नर्मदाके
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: कामिकं यानमारुह्य सर्वालङ्कारभूषितः । विवेश नगरं पुण्यं यथाशक्रो ऽमरावतीम्
verses.transliteration: kāmikaṃ yānamāruhya sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ / viveśa nagaraṃ puṇyaṃ yathāśakro 'marāvatīm
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: पार हुए थे। वे दोनों राजकुमार भगवान् विष्णुके अवतार थे और पिताकी आज्ञाका पालन करते हुए इस मार्गसे वनमें गये थे। उन्होंने इस श्रेष्ठ तीर्थमें स्नान करके भक्तिपूर्वक महादेवजीका पूजन
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: कालान्तरे ततः प्राप्ते राज्यं कृत्वा सुरालये । सान्तः पुरपरीवारो भोगान् भुङ्क्ते स्म पुष्कलान्
verses.transliteration: kālāntare tataḥ prāpte rājyaṃ kṛtvā surālaye / sāntaḥ puraparīvāro bhogān bhuṅkte sma puṣkalān
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: किया था। जहाँ उनका स्नान हुआ, वह स्थान “राजतीर्थ' के नामसे प्रसिद्ध है। वहाँ लक्ष्मणेशवर तथा सीतेश्वर लिंग हैं, जो देवताओं और दानवोंद्वारा वन्दित हैं। उस तीर्थमें शूलपाणि महेश्वरका पूजन
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं राजन् महाभाग विशाम्पते । द्वापरं वंशम् ऐक्ष्वाकं ब्राह्मं वैवस्वतं तथा
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaṃ rājan mahābhāga viśāmpate / dvāparaṃ vaṃśam aikṣvākaṃ brāhmaṃ vaivasvataṃ tathā
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: करके मनुष्य गणपतिपदको प्राप्त होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: कापिलं पुष्करं चेति सप्तकल्पान् विदुर्बुधाः । कापिलं प्रथमं विद्धि प्राजापत्यं द्वितीयकम्
verses.transliteration: kāpilaṃ puṣkaraṃ ceti saptakalpān vidurbudhāḥ / kāpilaṃ prathamaṃ viddhi prājāpatyaṃ dvitīyakam
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: नृपश्रेष्ठ! बहाँसे पुण्यतीर्थ शिवालयको जाय। वहीं परम मनोहर माहिष्मती पुरी है, जिसका दर्शन करके कोई भी नीचे नहीं गिरता। वहाँ अपनी ज्चालाओंसे प्रज्वलित कालाग्निरुद्रका निवास
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मं रौचं च सावित्रं बार्हस्पत्यं प्रभासकम् । महेन्द्रम् अग्निकल्पं वैजयन्तं मारुतं तथा
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṃ raucaṃ ca sāvitraṃ bārhaspatyaṃ prabhāsakam / mahendram agnikalpaṃ vaijayantaṃ mārutaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: है। तदनन्तर कोटितीर्थ है, जहाँ कोटीश्वर लिंग विराजमान है। उसकी पूजासे कोटि यज्ञोंका फल प्राप्त होता है। वहाँ दिये हुए दानका पुण्य कोटि- गुना बढ़ जाता है। उसके बाद दशाश्वमेधतीर्थ है,
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: वैष्णवं ब्रह्मरूपं च ज्योतिषं च चतुर्दशम् । एते कल्पास् तु संख्याता न मृता येषु नर्मदा
verses.transliteration: vaiṣṇavaṃ brahmarūpaṃ ca jyotiṣaṃ ca caturdaśam / ete kalpās tu saṃkhyātā na mṛtā yeṣu narmadā
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: जो भोग और मोक्ष देनेवाला है। वहाँ तिल और जलसे तर्पण करनेपर पितरोंकी उत्तम गति होती है। वहाँ स्नान करनेमात्रसे मनुष्य तेजस्वी हो जाता है। तत्पश्चात् वन्ध्या और नर्मदाका संगम
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् ते कथितं राजन्नितिहासं पुरातनम् । धन्यं यशस्यम् आयुष्यं महतां कीर्तिवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: etat te kathitaṃ rājannitihāsaṃ purātanam / dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ mahatāṃ kīrtivarddhanam
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: है, जो देवताओं और असुरोंसे भी नमस्कृत है। राजेन्द्र! उस संगममें मुनकेश्वर लिंग है, जिसका दर्शन केवल योगियोंको होता है । साधारण मनुष्य उसे नहीं देख पाते नर्मदाके दक्षिण तटपर चण्डीश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: श्रवणात् कीर्तनाद् वापि मुच्यते सर्वकिल्विषात्
verses.transliteration: śravaṇāt kīrtanād vāpi mucyate sarvakilviṣāt
verses.translation: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.hindi: उडुगणेश्वर और वकेश्वर लिंग हैं, जहाँ बगले स्वर्गको प्राप्त हुए हैं। गंगावह नामवाला एक तीर्थ है, जहाँ सब सिद्धियोंको देनेवाला एके शिवलिंग है। उस निर्मल शिवलिंगका नाम अंगारेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eminent Brahmanas who read this eulogy and the quiescent men who listen to this attain Rudra by means of a vehicle drawn by a bull. They shall be adorned with divine garments too.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये गाञ्जालतीर्थवर्णनो नाम द्वादशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय १३ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अथान्यत् परमं तीर्थं सर्वपापविनाशनम् । दिशि याम्यां समाख्यातं नाम्ना वै बालुकेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye gāñjālatīrthavarṇano nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 13 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: athānyat paramaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam / diśi yāmyāṃ samākhyātaṃ nāmnā vai bālukeśvaram
verses.translation: On being eulogized thus by the leading sages, the divine, meritorious river thought thus: 'I shall grant excellent boon unto all.'
verses.hindi: जानना चाहिए। इसके बाद सोमतीर्थ और शुक्लतीर्थ हैं। फिर निरसतीर्थ और धुवतीर्थ हैं। युधिष्ठिर! इन सबके सिवा वहाँ और भी अनेक सहस्र तीर्थ हैं। पिपीलिकातीर्थ भोग और मोक्ष देनेवाला है।
verses.wordMeaning: On being eulogized thus by the leading sages, the divine, meritorious river thought thus: 'I shall grant excellent boon unto all.'
verses.commentary: Sense: On being eulogized thus by the leading sages, the divine, meritorious river thought thus: 'I shall grant excellent boon unto all.'

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यं प्रकीर्तितं तत्र लिङ्गम् परमसिद्धिदम् । तत्र स्नात्वा यथान्यायं हेमभारफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: puṇyaṃ prakīrtitaṃ tatra liṅgam paramasiddhidam / tatra snātvā yathānyāyaṃ hemabhāraphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: The sages do not observe strict vegetarianism. Probably fish was a staple ' food of North Indian Brihmanas then.
verses.hindi: वहाँ पूर्वसे पश्चिम एक कोसतककी भूमिमें पंद्रह हजार तीर्थ हैं, जो ऋषियों और देवताओंके द्वारा सेवित हैं। वहाँ जो दान और होम आदि किया जाता है, उसके पुण्यकी कोई संख्या नहीं है। जो
verses.wordMeaning: The sages do not observe strict vegetarianism. Probably fish was a staple ' food of North Indian Brihmanas then.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages do not observe strict vegetarianism. Probably fish was a staple ' food of North Indian Brihmanas then.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कुकर्ण इति ख्यातो यक्षः परमसिद्धिदः । उत्तरायणम् आसाद्य कन्या रेवासमागमे
verses.transliteration: śaṅkukarṇa iti khyāto yakṣaḥ paramasiddhidaḥ / uttarāyaṇam āsādya kanyā revāsamāgame
verses.translation: With those excellent Brahmanas performing Japa and penance for ever, the excellent river shone like the firma- ment with stars and planets.
verses.hindi: वहाँ मृत्युको प्राप्त होता है, वह सब पापोंसे मुक्त हो उमा-महेश्वरलोकमें आनन्द भोगता है । अतः मनुष्यको उचित है कि वह शान्तचित्त होकर महादेवजीका पूजन करे और सदा सबके प्रति
verses.wordMeaning: With those excellent Brahmanas performing Japa and penance for ever, the excellent river shone like the firma- ment with stars and planets.
verses.commentary: Sense: With those excellent Brahmanas performing Japa and penance for ever, the excellent river shone like the firma- ment with stars and planets.

verses.sanskrit: संजगाम नृपश्रेष्ठ शिवसंसक्तमानसः । मणिमाणिक्यरत्नानि ब्राह्मणार्थमकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: saṃjagāma nṛpaśreṣṭha śivasaṃsaktamānasaḥ / maṇimāṇikyaratnāni brāhmaṇārthamakalpayat
verses.translation: "O ye groups of sages, do come. I am never born of a womb. Do merge unto me along with your sons and wives. Thereby you will achieve Siddhi. I shall grant you the several wishes each one has. I shall take you unto Visnu, Brahma, Isana or any other excellent Sura. Indeed I am the bestower of boons and am pleased. Be engrossed in Pranayama ('re- straint of breath') and enter with concentration along with your sons and wives. Leave off your hermitages. You must not waste time. Pralaya is imminent. It is the annihilation of all
verses.hindi: मैत्री एवं करुणाका भाव बनाये रखे। राजन्! पुण्यवान् पुरुषोंमें ही मैत्री और मुदिता होती है। सब प्राणियोंमें पुण्यवानोंको ही सुख होता है, यह विचारकर पुण्यके लिये यत्न करे। जो पुण्यक्षेत्र
verses.wordMeaning: "O ye groups of sages, do come. I am never born of a womb. Do merge unto me along with your sons and wives. Thereby you will achieve Siddhi. I shall grant you the several wishes each one has. I shall take you unto Visnu, Brahma, Isana or any other excellent Sura.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "O ye groups of sages, do come. I am never born of a womb. Do merge unto me along with your sons and wives. Thereby you will achieve Siddhi. I shall grant you the several wishes each one has. I shall take you unto Visnu, Brahma, Isana or any other excellent Sura.…

verses.sanskrit: तावन् नृपस् तु तं स्थानात् स्थाणुं चैव महेश्वरम् । चालयामास यक्षस् तु ततः क्रुद्धो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tāvan nṛpas tu taṃ sthānāt sthāṇuṃ caiva maheśvaram / cālayāmāsa yakṣas tu tataḥ kruddho maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: On hearing her words their minds were overwhelmed with wonder. All of them venerated me and repeatedly craved for my pardon:
verses.hindi: नहीं हैं, ऐसे स्थानपर किया हुआ पुण्य सम होता
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing her words their minds were overwhelmed with wonder. All of them venerated me and repeatedly craved for my pardon:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing her words their minds were overwhelmed with wonder. All of them venerated me and repeatedly craved for my pardon:

verses.sanskrit: ददाह हस्तौ यक्षस्य विस्मयाविष्टचेतसः । आकाशवचसा प्रोक्तं विषादं त्यज पुत्रक
verses.transliteration: dadāha hastau yakṣasya vismayāviṣṭacetasaḥ / ākāśavacasā proktaṃ viṣādaṃ tyaja putraka
verses.translation: O son of Pandu, in the fourteen earlier Kalpas, when I too was not bom, this (divine river) was happily present. In those fourteen earlier Kalpas too Narmada never ceased to exist. I shall recount theta as that Divinity narrated to me.
verses.hindi: हे (जितना किया जाता है, उतना ही रहता है) । परंतु जहाँ नर्मदाका संगम हो, वहाँका थोड़ा-सा भी पुण्य असंख्य होता है। अन्य स्थानोंपर किया हुआ पाप पुण्यक्षेत्रमें नष्ट हो जाता है, किंतु यदि
verses.wordMeaning: O son of Pandu, in the fourteen earlier Kalpas, when I too was not bom, this (divine river) was happily present. In those fourteen earlier Kalpas too Narmada never ceased to exist. I shall recount theta as that Divinity narrated to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of Pandu, in the fourteen earlier Kalpas, when I too was not bom, this (divine river) was happily present. In those fourteen earlier Kalpas too Narmada never ceased to exist. I shall recount theta as that Divinity narrated to me.

verses.sanskrit: सुरसङ्घास्त्रयस्त्रिंशत् नैनं चालयितुं क्षमाः । सुरासुरगुरून् देवं स्थाणुभूतं स्वयम्भुवम्
verses.transliteration: surasaṅghāstrayastriṃśat nainaṃ cālayituṃ kṣamāḥ / surāsuragurūn devaṃ sthāṇubhūtaṃ svayambhuvam
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: पुण्यक्षेत्रमे पाप किया जाय तो वह वज्रलेप हो जायगा। महाबली कार्तिकेयजीने जहाँ नर्मदा पार की थी, वहाँ कार्तिकेश्वर नामक सिद्धिदायक
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: किं पुनर्दानवा यक्षमानुषाश्चाल्पचेतसः । क्षमयित्वा तु देवेशं शङ्कुकर्णो महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ punardānavā yakṣamānuṣāścālpacetasaḥ / kṣamayitvā tu deveśaṃ śaṅkukarṇo maheśvaram
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: लिंग प्रतिष्ठित है, यह जानना चाहिए। इसके सिवा वहाँ चन्द्रेश्वर, शिखीश्वर तथा सब पापोंका नाश करनेवाला शक्तीश्वर लिंग है। इन सब लिंगोंका भक्तिभावसे पूजन करके मनुष्य ब्रह्महत्या
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यकोटिसमप्रख्यं ज्वलन्तं दीप्ततेजसम् । अज्ञानात् कृतम् एतत् तु क्षन्तव्यं मयि पुत्रके
verses.transliteration: sūryakoṭisamaprakhyaṃ jvalantaṃ dīptatejasam / ajñānāt kṛtam etat tu kṣantavyaṃ mayi putrake
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: आदि पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है। इतना ही नहीं, अन्तमें वह शिवलोकको प्राप्त होता है और उसके पितरोंको स्वर्गलोकमें स्थान मिलता है।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच वचनं देवं वरं देहि महेश्वर । प्रसाद्य चाब्रवीद् यक्षस् तव भृत्यं वशं गतम्
verses.transliteration: uvāca vacanaṃ devaṃ varaṃ dehi maheśvara / prasādya cābravīd yakṣas tava bhṛtyaṃ vaśaṃ gatam
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: मान्धाताका चरित्र
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: गणत्वं गणमध्ये तु देहि हे सुरसत्तम । यक्षतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं लिङ्गं वै बालुकेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: gaṇatvaṃ gaṇamadhye tu dehi he surasattama / yakṣatīrtham iti khyātaṃ liṅgaṃ vai bālukeśvaram
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--राजन्! तदनन्तर सर्वदेववन्दित गौरीखण्डकी यात्रा करे। वहाँ स्नान करके मनुष्य सब तीर्थोका फल पाता है तथा उसमें तिल और जलसे तर्पण करनेपर पितरोंको
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: कर्तुम् अर्हसि देवेश तीर्थे ऽस्मिन् सचराचरैः । अयने चोत्तरे ह्य् अत्र स्नानदानमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kartum arhasi deveśa tīrthe 'smin sacarācaraiḥ / ayane cottare hy atra snānadānamanuttamam
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: अक्षय तृप्ति प्राप्त होती है। गौरीखण्डेश्वर नामक मणिमय लिंग जलके मध्यभागमें स्थित है। मनुष्य उसका दर्शन नहीं कर पाते। वह देवताओंद्वारा पूजित होता है। वहीं कुमारेश्वर नामक शिवलिंग
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: इमं वरम् अहं मन्ये यदि तुष्टो ऽसि शङ्कर । शङ्कर उवाच: सर्वकाभफलावाप्तिर् मत्प्रसादाद् भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: imaṃ varam ahaṃ manye yadi tuṣṭo 'si śaṅkara / śaṅkara uvāca: sarvakābhaphalāvāptir matprasādād bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: प्रतिष्ठित है। साथ ही भोग और मोक्ष प्रदान करनेवाला मयूरेश्वर लिंग भी है, जिसके माहात्म्यसे मयूरगण स्वर्गलोकको प्राप्त हुए हैं। उनके पूजनसे तिर्यग्योनिकी प्राप्ति नहीं होती।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा महेशानस् तत्रैवान्तर धीयत । शङ्कुकर्णो महातेजास् तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā maheśānas tatraivāntara dhīyata / śaṅkukarṇo mahātejās tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् करमर्दा संगममें स्नान करनेके लिये जाय। युधिष्ठिर! उस तीर्थमें जिसने स्नान कर लिया, वह फिर इस संसारमें जन्म नहीं लेता। करमर्दामें स्नान करके करमर्देश्वर लिंगका
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्ययानं समारुह्य ययौ माहेश्वरं पुरम् । अथान्यत् परमं तीर्थं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: divyayānaṃ samāruhya yayau māheśvaraṃ puram / athānyat paramaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: पूजन करना चाहिए। वहाँ पितरोंका तर्पण करनेसे मनुष्य स्वर्गलोकको प्राप्त होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: दिशि याम्यां समाख्यातं नाम्ना पूर्णमनोरथम् । पुण्यकीर्तनलिङ्गं तु ब्रह्महत्याप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: diśi yāmyāṃ samākhyātaṃ nāmnā pūrṇamanoratham / puṇyakīrtanaliṅgaṃ tu brahmahatyāpraṇāśanam
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: युधिष्ठिर बोले--मुने ! राजाओंमें शरेष्ठ मान्धाता तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात हैं। मैं उन बुद्धिमान् राजाका चरित्र सुनना चाहता हूँ।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा महाराज गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् । हरिवर्मा पुरा चासीद् विराट्नगराधिपः
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā mahārāja gosahasraphalaṃ labhet / harivarmā purā cāsīd virāṭnagarādhipaḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजीने कहा--महाभाग ! इक्ष्वाकुवंशमें एक युवनाश्व नामक राजा हो गये हैं। वे राजर्षि
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वधर्मगुणोपेतो यज्ञयाजी महायशाः । इष्टस् तत्र महायज्ञो येन वै कल्पगातटे
verses.transliteration: sarvadharmaguṇopeto yajñayājī mahāyaśāḥ / iṣṭas tatra mahāyajño yena vai kalpagātaṭe
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: अपना राज्य मन्त्रियोंक अधीन करके वनमें प्रवेश किया और शास्त्रोक्त विधिसे अपने मनका संयम
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: गोलक्षं तत्र दत्तं च हेमभारपरिष्कृतम् । देवाश् च तार्पितास् तत्र ब्रह्माविष्णुर् बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: golakṣaṃ tatra dattaṃ ca hemabhārapariṣkṛtam / devāś ca tārpitās tatra brahmāviṣṇur bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: करके फल-मूलका भक्षण करते हुए बड़ी भारी तपस्या की। एक दिनकी बात है। वे राजा प्याससे विकल हो गये। उनका गला सूखने 'लगा। तब वे पानीके लिये आश्रमके भीतर गये।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाः पूजिता भक्त्या नानारत्नविभूषिताः । प्रशशंसुश्च नृपतिं सुराः पूर्णमनोरथाः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ pūjitā bhaktyā nānāratnavibhūṣitāḥ / praśaśaṃsuśca nṛpatiṃ surāḥ pūrṇamanorathāḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: रात्रिका समय था। सब लोग सो गये थे। अतः उनके माँगनेपर भी किसीने उनकी बात नहीं सुनी। किसी शक्तिशाली ऋषिने उन्हीं राजा युवनाश्वको पुत्रकी प्राप्तिके लिये मन्त्रोंसे अभिमन्त्रित
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यत् कथयिष्यामि तीर्थात् तीर्थमनुत्तमम् । रेवामत्स्यासमायोगे सुरासुरनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: athānyat kathayiṣyāmi tīrthāt tīrthamanuttamam / revāmatsyāsamāyoge surāsuranamaskṛtam
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: करके एक जलपूर्ण कलश स्थापित कर रखा था। प्यासे हुए राजा बड़े वेगसे दौडे और उसी जलको पीकर सो रहे। प्याससे व्याकुल राजा उस शीतल जलको पीकर बहुत सुखी हुए।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: नाभागस्य च संवादम् आपस्तम्बस्य चानघ । मन्वन्तरे चाक्षुषे वै संप्राप्ते द्वापरे युगे
verses.transliteration: nābhāgasya ca saṃvādam āpastambasya cānagha / manvantare cākṣuṣe vai saṃprāpte dvāpare yuge
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर मुनियोंको यह बात मालूम हुई। उन्होंने कुपित होकर पूछा--'किसने कलशका जल पी लिया है।' युवनाश्वने कहा--“ महात्माओ! यह काम तो मैंने ही किया है।' तब महर्षि
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: नाम्ना मत्स्येश्वरं लिङ्गं जलमध्ये व्यवस्थितम् । पूज्यते नागकन्याभिर् न तं पश्यन्ति मानुषाः
verses.transliteration: nāmnā matsyeśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ jalamadhye vyavasthitam / pūjyate nāgakanyābhir na taṃ paśyanti mānuṣāḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: भार्गवने कहा-'राजन्! यह जल तुम्हारे पुत्र होनेके उद्देश्यसे तपस्यासे संचित एवं अभिमन्त्रित करके रखा गया था। इससे महाबलवान् एवं तपोबलसे युक्त सर्वधर्मपरायण पुत्रका जन्म हो,
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: महातेजो मणिमयं चन्द्रबिम्बसमप्रभम् । स्मरणाद् यस्य देवस्य ब्रह्महत्या प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: mahātejo maṇimayaṃ candrabimbasamaprabham / smaraṇād yasya devasya brahmahatyā praṇaśyati
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: इस संकल्पसे मन्त्रयुक्त विधिके द्वारा इस जलका संस्कार किया गया था। यह तुम्हारे लिये पीने योग्य नहीं था। आज तुम्हारे द्वारा जो कार्य हुआ है, वह अवश्य ही प्रारन्धसे प्रेरित है। महाराज!
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: साधुभिः सह संवासात् के गुणाः परिकीर्तिताः । काः कथाः कानि पुण्यानि सङ्गमे साप्तकल्पगे
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: sādhubhiḥ saha saṃvāsāt ke guṇāḥ parikīrtitāḥ / kāḥ kathāḥ kāni puṇyāni saṅgame sāptakalpage
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: इस जलको पीनेसे तुम गर्भवान् होओगे।' तदनन्तर सौ वर्षाँके पश्चात् राजा युवनाश्वकी
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीमम् इतिहासं पुरातनम् । नाभागस्य च संवादम् आपस्तम्ब तपोनिधेः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: atraivodāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam / nābhāgasya ca saṃvādam āpastamba taponidheḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: बायीं कुक्षि फाड्कर सूर्यके समान तेजस्वी पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ। तो भी राजाकी मृत्यु नहीं हुई। उस समय महातेजस्वी इन्द्र उस बालकको देखनेके लिये आये । देवता पूछने लगे-- देवराज !
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: महर्षिश्चात्मवान् पूर्वम् आपस्तम्बो द्विजोत्तमः । उपवासकृतारम्भो बभूव भगवांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: maharṣiścātmavān pūrvam āpastambo dvijottamaḥ / upavāsakṛtārambho babhūva bhagavāṃs tathā
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: यह किसका दूध पीयेगा?' इन्द्र बोले-- “एष मां धाता--यह मुझे ही पान करेगा।' ऐसा कहकर उन्होंने बालकके मुँहमें अपनी तर्जनी अँगुली डाल दी। बालक बड़े हर्षके साथ उस अँगुलीका
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यम् क्रोधं च कामञ्च लोभं मोहं विसृज्य च । रेवामत्स्यासमायोगे विवेश सलिलाशये
verses.transliteration: nityam krodhaṃ ca kāmañca lobhaṃ mohaṃ visṛjya ca / revāmatsyāsamāyoge viveśa salilāśaye
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: अमृतरस पीने लगा। तत्पश्चात् इन्द्रने उसका “मान्धाता यह सार्थक नाम रख fear इस प्रकार बालक मान्धाता सोलह वर्षातक इन्द्रकी तर्जनी पी-पीकर बढ़ता रहा। उसे आयुर्वेद
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: स मत्स्यैः सलिलावर्ते सरितश्चानुगैस् तदा । तत्रान्योत्पतितैर् जालैः समानीतो महायशाः
verses.transliteration: sa matsyaiḥ salilāvarte saritaścānugais tadā / tatrānyotpatitair jālaiḥ samānīto mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: आदि दिव्य शास्त्रोंका ज्ञान केवल उनके चिन्तनसे हो गया। आजगव नामक धनुष, सींगके बाण और अभेद्य कवच--ये तत्काल उनके पास स्वतः उपस्थित हो गये । इनद्रने समस्त देवताओंके
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् उत्तारयाम् आसुः सलिलाद् ब्रह्मनन्दनम् । तं दृष्ट्वा तपसा दीप्तं कैवर्ता भयविह्वलाः
verses.transliteration: tasmād uttārayām āsuḥ salilād brahmanandanam / taṃ dṛṣṭvā tapasā dīptaṃ kaivartā bhayavihvalāḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: साथ मान्धाताका राज्याभिषेक किया। महाराज मान्धाताने धर्मसे सम्पूर्ण लोकोंको उसी प्रकार व्याप्त कर लिया, जैसे भगवान् विष्णुने अपने तीन wid त्रिलोकीको नाप लिया था। उन
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: शिरोभिः प्रणिपत्योच्चैर् इदं वचनमब्रुवन् । अज्ञानात् क्रियमाणानामस्माकं क्षन्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: śirobhiḥ praṇipatyoccair idaṃ vacanamabruvan / ajñānāt kriyamāṇānāmasmākaṃ kṣantum arhasi
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: महात्माका शासनचक्र अप्रतिहत गतिसे चलता था। सैकड़ों राजा स्वयं उनकी सेवामें उपस्थित हुए। इस प्रकार उनका समूची पृथ्वीपर एकच्छत्र अधिकार था। उन्होंने प्रचुर दक्षिणावाले अनेक
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: किं वा किं च प्रियं ते ऽद्य तदाज्ञापय सुव्रत । स मुनिस्तन् महद् दृष्ट्वा मत्स्यानां कदनं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ vā kiṃ ca priyaṃ te 'dya tadājñāpaya suvrata / sa munistan mahad dṛṣṭvā matsyānāṃ kadanaṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: यङ्चोद्वारा भगवानका यजन किया उन प्रसन्नचित्त,
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: कृपया परयाविष्टो दाशान् प्रोवाच दुःखितः । दुःखितानीह भूतानि यो न भूतैः पृथग् विधैः
verses.transliteration: kṛpayā parayāviṣṭo dāśān provāca duḥkhitaḥ / duḥkhitānīha bhūtāni yo na bhūtaiḥ pṛthag vidhaiḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: अतिशय धर्मका अनुष्ठान करके इन्द्रके आधे सिंहासनको प्राप्त किया था। उन्होंने धर्मपूर्वक पृथ्वीका पालन किया। उन महात्माका राज्य दस करोड़ वर्षोतक चलता रहा। एक समय
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: केवलात्म सुखेच्छातो ऽवेन् नृशंसतरो ऽस्ति कः । अहो ऽस्वस्थेष्वकारुण्यं स्वआर्थे चैव बलिर्वृथा
verses.transliteration: kevalātma sukhecchāto 'ven nṛśaṃsataro 'sti kaḥ / aho 'svastheṣvakāruṇyaṃ svaārthe caiva balirvṛthā
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: बारह वर्षोतक वृष्टि नहीं हुई। उस समय मान्धाताने वज्रपाणि इन्द्रके देखते-देखते अपने
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानिनाम् अपि चेद् यस् तु केवलात्महिते रतः । ज्ञानिनो हि यथा स्वार्थम् आश्रित्य ध्यानम् आश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: jñāninām api ced yas tu kevalātmahite rataḥ / jñānino hi yathā svārtham āśritya dhyānam āśritāḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: राज्यकी खेतीको बढ़ानेके लिये बलपूर्वक वर्षा करवा ली। वहीं महाराज मान्धाताका यह देवस्थान है। उन्हींके पुण्यतम देशमें अमरकण्टक पर्वत देखा जाता है। उन्होंने अमरकण्टकपर ३कारेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: दुःखार्तानीह भूतानि प्रयान्ति शरणं ततः । यो ऽभिवाञ्छति भोक्तुं वै सुखान्येकान् ततो जनः
verses.transliteration: duḥkhārtānīha bhūtāni prayānti śaraṇaṃ tataḥ / yo 'bhivāñchati bhoktuṃ vai sukhānyekān tato janaḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: शिवके आगे सौ यज्ञोंका अनुष्ठान करके इस प्रकार स्तवन किया--' जगतूकी उत्पत्ति करनेवाले परमेश्वर! आप ही कालगतिके प्रवर्तक हैं, आप ही संसारस्वरूप और संसारका संहार करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: पापात् परतरं तं हि प्रवदन्ति मुमुक्षवः । को नु मे स्याद् उपायो हि येनाहं दुःखितात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: pāpāt parataraṃ taṃ hi pravadanti mumukṣavaḥ / ko nu me syād upāyo hi yenāhaṃ duḥkhitātmanām
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। ३ महादेवजीको नमस्कार है । भगवान् शम्भु और भवको नमस्कार है। तीन नेत्र और तीन मूर्ति धारण करनेवाले तीनों लोकोंके स्वामी आपको नमस्कार है।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःप्रविश्य भूतानां भवेयं सर्वदुःखभुक् । यन्ममास्ति शुभं किंचित् तद् दीनान् उपगच्छतु
verses.transliteration: antaḥpraviśya bhūtānāṃ bhaveyaṃ sarvaduḥkhabhuk / yanmamāsti śubhaṃ kiṃcit tad dīnān upagacchatu
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: कालरहित, जरारहित और मृत्युरहित आपको बारंबार नमस्कार है। जो लोग प्रतिदिन आदिदेव भगवान् ३कारेश्वरका ध्यान करते हैं, उनकी इस संसारसमुद्रमें पुनरावृत्ति नहीं होती।'
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: यत् कृतं दुष्कृतं तैश्च तदशेषमुपैतु माम् । दृष्ट्वा तान् कृपणान् व्यङ्गान् अनङ्गान् रोगिणस् तथा
verses.transliteration: yat kṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ taiśca tadaśeṣamupaitu mām / dṛṣṭvā tān kṛpaṇān vyaṅgān anaṅgān rogiṇas tathā
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: 'कालरूपधारी ३कारस्वरूप उमानाथ महादेवजीने यह स्तुति सुनकर राजा मान्थातासे 'कहा-सुत्रत! तुम कोई वर माँगो।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: दया न जायते यस्य स रक्ष इति मे मतिः । प्राणसंशयमापन्नान् प्राणिनो भयविह्वलान्
verses.transliteration: dayā na jāyate yasya sa rakṣa iti me matiḥ / prāṇasaṃśayamāpannān prāṇino bhayavihvalān
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: मान्धाताने कहा- देवेश्वर! वैदूर्यं नामसे प्रसिद्ध यह शैलराज मान्धाता नाम धारण करे और आपके प्रसादसे देवस्थान बन जाय। यहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: यो न रक्षति शस्तो ऽपि स तत्पापं समश्नुते । आहूतानां नयार्तानां सुखं यद् उपजायते
verses.transliteration: yo na rakṣati śasto 'pi sa tatpāpaṃ samaśnute / āhūtānāṃ nayārtānāṃ sukhaṃ yad upajāyate
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: करें, वे शिवधामके निवासी हों।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य स्वर्गापवर्गौ च कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् । तस्माच्चैतान् अहं दीनां छक्तुं मीनान् सुदुःखितान्
verses.transliteration: tasya svargāpavargau ca kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm / tasmāccaitān ahaṃ dīnāṃ chaktuṃ mīnān suduḥkhitān
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: मान्धाताका यह वचन सुनकर महादेवजी बोले-नृपश्रेष्ठ! मेरे प्रसादसे यह सब कुछ होगा। इस प्रकार वरदान पाकर महाराज मान्धाता अपनी पुरीको लौट गये। युधिष्ठिर! यह सब
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: यादृङ्मात्रं न पश्यामि किं पुनस् त्रिदशालयम् । निशम्यैतन् मुनेर् वाक्यं दाशास्ते जातसंभ्रमाः
verses.transliteration: yādṛṅmātraṃ na paśyāmi kiṃ punas tridaśālayam / niśamyaitan muner vākyaṃ dāśāste jātasaṃbhramāḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: मान्धाताका उत्तम चरित्र तुम्हें बताया गया। इस तीर्थके माहात्म्यसे मान्धाता आदि नरेश सम्पूर्ण मनोवांछित कामनाएँ प्राप्त करके भगवान् विष्णुके धाममें विहार करते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: यथार्थं तु तथा सर्वं नाभागाय न्यवेदयन् । नाभागो ऽपि ततः श्रुत्वा तं द्रष्टुं ब्रह्मनन्दनम्
verses.transliteration: yathārthaṃ tu tathā sarvaṃ nābhāgāya nyavedayan / nābhāgo 'pi tataḥ śrutvā taṃ draṣṭuṃ brahmanandanam
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: बाणासुरके तीन पुरोंका भगवान् शंकरके द्वारा संहार, जालेश्वरनामक बाणलिंगकी उत्पत्ति और बाणासुरको शिवलोक-प्राप्ति
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: त्वरितः प्रययौ तत्र सामात्यः सपुरोहितः । स सम्यक् पूजयित्वा तु देवकल्पं नृपस् ततः
verses.transliteration: tvaritaḥ prayayau tatra sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ / sa samyak pūjayitvā tu devakalpaṃ nṛpas tataḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--सत्ययुगमें बलि नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक श्रेष्ठ हैत्य हुए। उनके महापराक्रमी पुत्रका नाम बाणासुर था । वह अपनी सहस्त्र भुजाओंके कारण
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोवाच भगवन् विद्वन् किं करोमि तवाज्ञया । आपस्तम्ब उवाच: श्रमेण महताविष्टाः कैवर्ता दुःखजीविनः
verses.transliteration: provāca bhagavan vidvan kiṃ karomi tavājñayā / āpastamba uvāca: śrameṇa mahatāviṣṭāḥ kaivartā duḥkhajīvinaḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: महादेवजीकी आराधना की । इससे सन्तुष्ट होकर महादेवजीने कहा--'वत्स! तू कोई श्रेष्ठ वर माँग ले ।'
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: मम मूल्यं प्रयच्छेति यद् योग्यं मन्यसे नृप । नाभाग उवाच: सहस्राणि शतं मूल्यं निषादेभ्यो ददाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: mama mūlyaṃ prayaccheti yad yogyaṃ manyase nṛpa / nābhāga uvāca: sahasrāṇi śataṃ mūlyaṃ niṣādebhyo dadāmy aham
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण देवताओंके लिये अजेय हो। आपको छोड़कर दूसरे किसी देवताके लिये यहाँ प्रवेश पाना अत्यन्त कठिन हो। मेरा यह नगर मेरे स्थिर होनेपर स्थिर रहे और मेरे चलनेपर वह साथ-साथ चले--
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रयार्थं हि भगवन् नीतं ते ब्रह्मनन्दन । आपस्तम्ब उवाच: नाहं शतसहस्रेण नियम्यः पार्थिव त्वया
verses.transliteration: niṣkrayārthaṃ hi bhagavan nītaṃ te brahmanandana / āpastamba uvāca: nāhaṃ śatasahasreṇa niyamyaḥ pārthiva tvayā
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: सर्वथा मेरे मनके अनुकूल बना रहे।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: सदृशं दीयतां मूल्यम् अमात्यैः सह चिन्तय । नाभाग उवाच: कोटिं प्रदीयतां मूल्यं निषादेभ्यो द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyam amātyaiḥ saha cintaya / nābhāga uvāca: koṭiṃ pradīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ niṣādebhyo dvijottama
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: महादेवजीने कहा--एवमस्तु'। तदनन्तर भगवान् विष्णुने भी बाणासुरसे कहा-'यदि महादेवजीने तुम्हें एक पुर तुम्हारे मनके अनुरूप दिया है तो मैं भी तुम्हें वैसा ही दूसरा पुर देता
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: यद्य् एतद् अपि योग्यं नो ततो भूयः प्रदीयताम् । आपस्तम्ब उवाच: राजन्नार्हा वयं कोटिमधिकं चापि पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: yady etad api yogyaṃ no tato bhūyaḥ pradīyatām / āpastamba uvāca: rājannārhā vayaṃ koṭimadhikaṃ cāpi pārthiva
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: हूँ।' तत्पश्चात् दोनों देवता श्रीविष्णु और शिवने एकत्र होकर कहा-बाणासुर! अब तुम शीघ्र ही ब्रह्माजीके पास जाओ।' तब बलिका पुत्र ब्रह्माजीके पास गया। ब्रह्माजीने उसे हृदयसे लगाया और
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: सदृशं दीयतां मूल्यं ब्राह्मणैः सह संवद । राजोवाच: अर्द्धं राज्यं समस्तं वा निषादेभ्यः प्रदीयते
verses.transliteration: sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha saṃvada / rājovāca: arddhaṃ rājyaṃ samastaṃ vā niṣādebhyaḥ pradīyate
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: 'कहा--“वत्स! भगवान् शिव और विष्णु दोनोंने तुम्हें एक-एक पुर प्रदान किया है। अतः मैं भी
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: एतन् मूल्यम् अहं मन्ये किं वालं मन्यसे द्विज । आपस्तम्ब उवाच: अर्द्धं राज्यं समस्तं वा नाहम् अर्हामि वै नृप
verses.transliteration: etan mūlyam ahaṃ manye kiṃ vālaṃ manyase dvija / āpastamba uvāca: arddhaṃ rājyaṃ samastaṃ vā nāham arhāmi vai nṛpa
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: पुरोंको प्राप्त करके बाणासुर त्रिपुरके नामसे विख्यात हुआ। युधिष्ठिर! इस प्रकार वरदान पाकर सहस्र भुजाओंके विस्तारसे शक्तिशाली बना हुआ बाणासुर समस्त देवताओंके लिये अवध्य हो गया। उसने
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: सदृशं दीयतां मह्यं ऋषिभिः सह चिन्तय । महर्षेस् तद्वचः श्रुत्वा नाभागस् तु विवादयन्
verses.transliteration: sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ ṛṣibhiḥ saha cintaya / maharṣes tadvacaḥ śrutvā nābhāgas tu vivādayan
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: यक्ष, विद्याधर, देव, दानव, गन्धर्व और राक्षसोंके समस्त निवासस्थानोंको नष्ट कर दिया। वहाँकी वेदिकाएँ तोड़-फोड़ डाली । इन्द्रकी अमरावतीपुरीको उजाड दिया। उसके अत्याचारसे उद्विग्न होकर
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तयामास धर्मात्मा सामात्यः सपुरोहितः । ततः कश्चिद् ऋषिस् तत्र लोमशस्तु महातपाः
verses.transliteration: cintayāmāsa dharmātmā sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ / tataḥ kaścid ṛṣis tatra lomaśastu mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: सब देवता महादेवजीके पास गये और इस प्रकार बोले- भगवन्! आपने, श्रीविष्णुने तथा
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: नाभागम् अब्रवीत् माभैः तोषयिष्यामि तं मुनिम् । राजोवाच: ब्रूहि मूल्यं महाभाग मे ज्ञातिकुलबान्धवान्
verses.transliteration: nābhāgam abravīt mābhaiḥ toṣayiṣyāmi taṃ munim / rājovāca: brūhi mūlyaṃ mahābhāga me jñātikulabāndhavān
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: शरीब्रह्माजीने भी बाणासुरको वरदान देकर अजेय बना दिया है। उसके साथ युद्ध करनेकी शक्ति किसीमें भी नहीं है। जो भी उसके सामने खड़ा होगा, उसे वह भस्म कर सकता है।'
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: निर्दग्धवान् ऋषिः क्रुद्धस् त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । किं पुनर् मानवं दीनम् अत्यल्पं विषयात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: nirdagdhavān ṛṣiḥ kruddhas trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / kiṃ punar mānavaṃ dīnam atyalpaṃ viṣayātmakam
