verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: महादेवजी बोले--देवताओ! तुम सब लोग तीस करोड़की संख्यामें हो और बड़े बलवान् हो। सब लोग संगठित होकर जाओ और यलपूर्वक त्रिपुरका विनाश करो।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: लोमश उवाच: त्वं समर्थो महाराज जगत्पूज्या द्विजोत्तमाः । गावश्च दिव्यास्तस्माद् वै मूल्यम् अस्मै प्रदीयताम्
verses.transliteration: lomaśa uvāca: tvaṃ samartho mahārāja jagatpūjyā dvijottamāḥ / gāvaśca divyāstasmād vai mūlyam asmai pradīyatām
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: यह सुनकर सब देवता तीखे अस्त्र-शस्त्र लेकर बाणासुरके--त्रिपुरके समीप गये। किंतु उस हैत्यने समस्त देवताओंको क्षणभरमें परास्त कर दिया। उन सबके अस्त्र-शस्त्र भी छीन
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: ततः श्रुत्वा तु वचनं स सामात्यपुरोहितः । हर्षेण महताविष्टः प्रोवाचेदं वचो मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śrutvā tu vacanaṃ sa sāmātyapurohitaḥ / harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭaḥ provācedaṃ vaco munim
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: लिये। देवताओंके पाँव उखड़ गये। वे हतोत्साह होकर पुनः महादेवजीके समीप आये। महादेवजीने पूछा-- तुम सब लोगोंने वहाँ जाकर क्या किया?!
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भगवन् कृतमेव न संशयः । एतद् योग्यतं मूल्यं भवतो मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhagavan kṛtameva na saṃśayaḥ / etad yogyataṃ mūlyaṃ bhavato munisattama
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: पराक्रम वर्णन करनेमें असमर्थ हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: आपस्तम्ब उवाच: उत्तिष्ठाम्य् एव संप्रीत्या सम्यक् क्रीतो ऽस्मि पार्थिव । गोभ्यो मूल्यं न पश्यामि पवित्रं पापनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: āpastamba uvāca: uttiṣṭhāmy eva saṃprītyā samyak krīto 'smi pārthiva / gobhyo mūlyaṃ na paśyāmi pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: कहा- अच्छा तो इस महादुष्ट त्रिपुरका संहार मैं स्वयं करूँगा। यह कहकर वे कैलाससे चले और जहाँ त्रिपुरासुर था वहाँ जा पहुँचे। उनके साथ देवी पार्वती भी थीं। चण्डेश्वर, नन्दी, महाकाल,
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: गावः प्रदक्षिणी कार्य्या वन्दनीया हि नित्यशः । मङ्गलायतन दिव्यास् सृष्टास् त्वेताः स्वयम्भुवा
verses.transliteration: gāvaḥ pradakṣiṇī kāryyā vandanīyā hi nityaśaḥ / maṅgalāyatana divyās sṛṣṭās tvetāḥ svayambhuvā
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: महेश्वर, वृष, भृंगिरिटि, विघ्नेश (गणेश), स्कन्द, महावीर पुष्पदन्त, घण्टाकर्ण, महोदर, गोमुख, हस्तिकर्ण, स्थूलजंघ और वृकोदर ये पंद्रह पार्षद भी भगवान् शिवके साथ गये। वे सब-के-सब
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: अप्यागाराणि विप्राणां देवतायतनानि च । यद्गोमयेन शुद्ध्यन्ति किं ब्रूमो ह्यधिकं ततः
verses.transliteration: apyāgārāṇi viprāṇāṃ devatāyatanāni ca / yadgomayena śuddhyanti kiṃ brūmo hyadhikaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: महादेवजीके तुल्य पराक्रमी थे। जहाँ महान् क्षेत्रस्वरूप श्रीशैल नामका सिद्ध पर्वत है, वहीं ठहरकर. महादेवजीने देवीसे कहा- “प्रिये! यहीं त्रिपुरासुरको मारना उचित होगा ।' ऐसा कहकर भगवान् शंकरने
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिस् तथैव च । गवां पञ्च पवित्राणि पुनन्ति सकलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpis tathaiva ca / gavāṃ pañca pavitrāṇi punanti sakalaṃ jagat
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: उस पर्वतको अपना प्रधान निवास स्थान बनाया
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: गावो मे चाग्रतो नित्यं गावः पृष्ठत एव च । गावो मे हृदये चैव गवां मध्ये वसाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: gāvo me cāgrato nityaṃ gāvaḥ pṛṣṭhata eva ca / gāvo me hṛdaye caiva gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: नामक धनुष हाथमें लिया। फिर एक पैरसे पातालको
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: एव यः पठते नित्यं त्रिसन्ध्यं नियतः शुचिः । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः स्वर्गलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: eva yaḥ paṭhate nityaṃ trisandhyaṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ / mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ svargalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: और दूसरेसे ब्रह्माण्डको दबाया तथा त्रिपुरासुरकी ओर लक्ष्य बाँधकर अघोर नामक बाणका प्रहार 'किया। उस अम्त्रसे दग्ध होकर त्रिपुरके तीन खण्ड हो गये। उसे जर्जर करके शिवजीने नर्मदाके
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: अग्रे ग्रासपरो भावः कर्तव्यो भक्तितो ऽन्वहम् । अकृत्वा स्वयमाहारं कुर्वन्नाप्नोति दुर्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: agre grāsaparo bhāvaḥ kartavyo bhaktito 'nvaham / akṛtvā svayamāhāraṃ kurvannāpnoti durgatim
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: जलमें गिरा दिया। वहाँ गिरनेपर वह सात पातालोंका भेदन करके रसातलको चला गया। इससे वहाँ जालेशवर नामक तीर्थ प्रकट हुआ, जो तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात है । जालेश्वरदेवका पूजन करनेसे
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: तेनाग्नयो हुतास् सम्यक् पितरश् चापि तार्पिताः । देवाश्च पूजितास् तेन यो ददाति गवाह्निकम्
verses.transliteration: tenāgnayo hutās samyak pitaraś cāpi tārpitāḥ / devāśca pūjitās tena yo dadāti gavāhnikam
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य ब्रह्महत्यासे छुटकारा पा जाता है और कोटि सहस्र कल्पोंतक भगवान् शिवके धाममें सुखपूर्वक निवास करता है। जो वहाँ स्नान करते हैं, वे तो स्वर्गमें जाते हैं और जो मृत्युको प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रः सौरभेयी जगत्पूज्या नित्य विष्णुपदे स्थिता । सर्वदेवमयी ग्रासं मया दत्तं प्रतीक्षताम्
verses.transliteration: mantraḥ saurabheyī jagatpūjyā nitya viṣṇupade sthitā / sarvadevamayī grāsaṃ mayā dattaṃ pratīkṣatām
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: होते हैं, उनका पुनर्जन्म नहीं होता। युधिष्ठिर! वहाँ तिल और जलसे तर्पण करने तथा पिण्डदान देनेसे जबतक भगवान् शंकर और नर्मदाजी स्थित हैं, तबतक पितर तृप्त रहते हैं। कालाग्निरुद्रके
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षणाद् ब्रह्मपुत्राणां गवां कण्डूयनात् तथा । क्षीणार्तरक्षणाच् चैव ततः स्वर्गे महीयते
verses.transliteration: rakṣaṇād brahmaputrāṇāṃ gavāṃ kaṇḍūyanāt tathā / kṣīṇārtarakṣaṇāc caiva tataḥ svarge mahīyate
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: समान प्रज्वलित त्रिपुरनाशक अधोरास्त्रको नर्मदाके सिवा दूसरा कौन धारण कर सकता है? इस प्रकार अधोरास्त्रसे छूट हुआ बाणजाल ही ' जालेश्वर'
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: आदिर्हि गावो यज्ञस्य मध्यं चान्त्यं प्रकीर्तिताः । क्षरन्ति तास् तु सकलं क्षीराज्यममृतं तथा
verses.transliteration: ādirhi gāvo yajñasya madhyaṃ cāntyaṃ prakīrtitāḥ / kṣaranti tās tu sakalaṃ kṣīrājyamamṛtaṃ tathā
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: अपने तीनों पुरोंके दग्ध होनेपर बाणासुर भयभीत हो भगवान् शिवकी इस प्रकार स्तुति करने लगा-अनादिदेव! ईश! आपको नमस्कार है। विघ्नेश्वर! आपको नमस्कार है। महेश्वर!
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् गावः प्रदातव्याः पूजनीया हि नित्यशः । स्वर्गस्य सङ्गमायैतास् सोपानं हि विनिर्मिताः
verses.transliteration: tasmād gāvaḥ pradātavyāḥ pūjanīyā hi nityaśaḥ / svargasya saṅgamāyaitās sopānaṃ hi vinirmitāḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: आपको नमस्कार है। सर्वज्ञ! अज्ञानहारी हर! ज्ञानदाता शिव! आपको नमस्कार है। अनन्तगुणमय Tis विभूषित आप परमेश्वरको नमस्कार है। परात्पर! परातीत! उत्पत्ति और पालन करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा निषादास्ते गवां माहात्म्यम् उत्तमम् । प्रणिपत्य महाभागम् आपस्तम्बम् अथाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā niṣādāste gavāṃ māhātmyam uttamam / praṇipatya mahābhāgam āpastambam athābruvan
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: शिव! आपको नमस्कार है। सब प्रयोजनोंकी सिद्धिके साधनभूत विश्वनाथ! आपको नमस्कार है। धनंजय! निराधार! स्वभावसे ही उपद्रवरहित आपको नमस्कार है। सदा प्रसन्न रहनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: निषादा ऊचुः: सम्भाषा दर्शनस्पर्शवर्णनं कीर्तनं तथा । पावनानि समस्तानि साधूनाम् इति नः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: niṣādā ūcuḥ: sambhāṣā darśanasparśavarṇanaṃ kīrtanaṃ tathā / pāvanāni samastāni sādhūnām iti naḥ śrutam
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: परमेश्वर! आप सम्पूर्ण योगोंके स्वामी हैं। आपको नमस्कार है। भूतनाथ ! जगन्नाथ ! सर्वाधार! आपको नमस्कार है। सृष्टि, संहार, मोक्ष और सात पातालोंके आश्रय! आपको नमस्कार है।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: सम्भाषा दर्शनं चैवम् इहास्माभिः कृतं द्विज । कुरुष्वानुग्रहं तस्मात् त्वां वयं शरणं गताः
verses.transliteration: sambhāṣā darśanaṃ caivam ihāsmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ dvija / kuruṣvānugrahaṃ tasmāt tvāṃ vayaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: त्रिनेत्र और त्रिशूल धारण करनेवाले त्रिलोकस्वरूप आपको नमस्कार है। चन्द्रशेखर! देवता और असुर दोनों आपके चरणोंमें नतमस्तक होते हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। महाप्रभो! मैंने अपनी
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: आपस्तम्ब उवाच: एतां गां प्रतिगृह्णन्तु ततस् ते मुक्तकिल्बिषाः । निषादाश्च गताः स्वर्गं सह मत्स्यैर् जलोद्भवैः
verses.transliteration: āpastamba uvāca: etāṃ gāṃ pratigṛhṇantu tatas te muktakilbiṣāḥ / niṣādāśca gatāḥ svargaṃ saha matsyair jalodbhavaiḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: जिह्वाकी चपलताके कारण आपके विषयमें कुछ कहनेकी धृष्टता की है, आप उसे क्षमा करें। आपके गुणोंका वर्णन करनेमें कौन समर्थ है।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणिनां प्रीतिमुत्पाद्य निन्दितेना ऽपि कर्मणा । नरकं यदि पश्यामि वत्स्यामि स्वर्गम् एव वा
verses.transliteration: prāṇināṃ prītimutpādya ninditenā 'pi karmaṇā / narakaṃ yadi paśyāmi vatsyāmi svargam eva vā
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--बाणासुरद्वारा की हुई इस स्तुतिको सुनकर भगवान् शिव उसपर प्रसन्न हो गये और इस प्रकार बोले--' हैत्यराज! सेवापराधजनित तुम्हारा यह दोष क्षमा किया
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: यन्मया सुकृतं किंचिन् मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः । कृत तेनापि दुःखार्ताः सर्वे यान्तु शुभां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: yanmayā sukṛtaṃ kiṃcin manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ / kṛta tenāpi duḥkhārtāḥ sarve yāntu śubhāṃ gatim
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: गया। तुम कोई वर माँगो ।'
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तस्य प्रसादेन महर्षेर् भावितात्मनः । निषादास् तेन वाक्येन सह मत्स्या दिवं गताः
verses.transliteration: tatas tasya prasādena maharṣer bhāvitātmanaḥ / niṣādās tena vākyena saha matsyā divaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: बाणासुर बोला- देव! मैं अपने परिवारसहित इसी शरीरसे आपके उस परम धामको जाउँ, जहाँ पुनर्जन्मका भय नहीं है।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: तान् दृष्ट्वा अथ गतान् स्वर्गं समत्स्यान् मत्स्यजीविनः । सामात्यभृत्यो नृपतिर् विस्मयाद् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā atha gatān svargaṃ samatsyān matsyajīvinaḥ / sāmātyabhṛtyo nṛpatir vismayād idam abravīt
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: बाणासुरका यह वचन सुनकर महादेवजीने 'कहा-हैत्यराज! तुम मेरी भक्तिके प्रसादसे मेरे समीप निवास करोगे। तत्पश्चात् वह दिव्य विमानपर आरूढ़ हो महादेवजीके प्रसादसे उन्हींके
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: सेव्याः श्रेयो ऽर्थिभिः सन्तः तीर्थं पुण्यं जलोत्तमम् । क्षणोपासनमप्यत्र न तेषां निष्कलं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sevyāḥ śreyo 'rthibhiḥ santaḥ tīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ jalottamam / kṣaṇopāsanamapyatra na teṣāṃ niṣkalaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: 'अमरकण्टक और यज्ञपर्वतके श्रेष्ठ तीर्थ एवं लिंग, राजा इन्द्रद्युम्नका  यज्ञ और उन्हें देवोंका वरदान
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: सद्भिस्सह समासीत सद्भिः कुर्वीत सत्कथाम् । आपस्तम्बो मुनिस् तत्र लोमशश्च महातपा
verses.transliteration: sadbhissaha samāsīta sadbhiḥ kurvīta satkathām / āpastambo munis tatra lomaśaśca mahātapā
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: .. माक॑एडेयजी कहते हैं--युधिष्ठिर! अमर- 'कण्टक पर्वतपर सब ओर अत्यन्त गुप्त पुण्यका
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: पदैस् तु विविधैर् इष्टैर् बोधयामास तु नृपम् । ततः संधारयामास धर्मबुद्धिं सुदुर्लभाम्
verses.transliteration: padais tu vividhair iṣṭair bodhayāmāsa tu nṛpam / tataḥ saṃdhārayāmāsa dharmabuddhiṃ sudurlabhām
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: माने गये हैं। अमरकण्टकसे
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: तथेति कृत्वा चोक्त्वा च नृपं तं प्रशशंसतुः । अहो धन्यो ऽसि राजेन्द्र यत् ते धर्मपरामतिः
verses.transliteration: tatheti kṛtvā coktvā ca nṛpaṃ taṃ praśaśaṃsatuḥ / aho dhanyo 'si rājendra yat te dharmaparāmatiḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: उत्तरभागमें यज्ञ पर्वत है, जो विन्ध्याचलका कनिष्ठ पुत्र और पर्यक पर्वतका भाई है । पूर्वकालमें ब्रह्माजीने
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मः सुदुर्लभः पुंसां विशेषेण महीक्षिताम् । यदि राज्यमदाविष्टः स्वधर्मं न परित्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: dharmaḥ sudurlabhaḥ puṃsāṃ viśeṣeṇa mahīkṣitām / yadi rājyamadāviṣṭaḥ svadharmaṃ na parityajet
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: निवास है॥उस गिरिश्रेष्ठसे लेकर नर्मदा नदीतक  वहीं सौत्रामणि नामक यज्ञ किया था और इन्द्रने भी
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: ततो जगति कस् तस्मात् पुनर् अभ्यधिको भवेत् । ध्रुवं धर्मश्च राज्यं वै मोहश्चैव सदा ध्रुवः
verses.transliteration: tato jagati kas tasmāt punar abhyadhiko bhavet / dhruvaṃ dharmaśca rājyaṃ vai mohaścaiva sadā dhruvaḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: उसी पर्वतपर अश्वमेध-यज्ञका अनुष्ठान किया था।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: महाध्रुवश्च नरको राज्यं निन्दन्ति ते बुधाः । राज्यं हि मन्यते मूढो नरो विषयलोलुपः
verses.transliteration: mahādhruvaśca narako rājyaṃ nindanti te budhāḥ / rājyaṃ hi manyate mūḍho naro viṣayalolupaḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: महर्षि दधीचि तथा अन्य देवताओने वहीं बड़े-बड़े यज्ञोंका अनुष्ठान किया है। उसी यज्ञ पर्वतसे चतु नामकी एक महानदी निकली है, जो नर्मदामें जाकर मिली है । वह संगम विश्वविख्यात तीर्थ है । उसके
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: मनीषिणस् तु पश्यन्ति सदैव नरकोपमम् । तस्माच्छोकश्च मोहश्च न कर्तव्यो मदस् त्वया
verses.transliteration: manīṣiṇas tu paśyanti sadaiva narakopamam / tasmācchokaśca mohaśca na kartavyo madas tvayā
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: तटपर पीले रंगके कुश पृथ्वीपर फैले हैं। उनसे श्राद्ध करनेपर वे पितरोंको मोक्ष देनेवाले होते हैं। जहाँ चतु और नर्मदाका संगम है और जहाँ यज्ञ पर्वत है, इन दोनोंके बीचकी भूमिमें जो श्राद्धका
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: यदीच्छसि महाराज शाश्वतीं गतिमात्मनः । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: इत्युक्त्वा महात्मानौ जग्मतुः स्वं स्वमाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: yadīcchasi mahārāja śāśvatīṃ gatimātmanaḥ / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ityuktvā mahātmānau jagmatuḥ svaṃ svamāśramam
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: अनुष्ठान करता है, उसके पितर पूर्ण तृप्त होते हैं। जो वहाँ स्नान और सिद्धेश्वर एवं चतुष्केश्वर लिंगकी परिक्रमा करता है, उस मनुष्यकी लोकमें पुनः गणना नहीं होती--वह मुक्त हो जाता है। युधिष्ठिर! वहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: नाभागो ऽपि वरं लब्ध्वा प्रहृष्टस्त्वविशत् पुरम् । एतत् ते कथितं राजन् ये गणाः सत्समागमे
verses.transliteration: nābhāgo 'pi varaṃ labdhvā prahṛṣṭastvaviśat puram / etat te kathitaṃ rājan ye gaṇāḥ satsamāgame
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: महादेवजी संगममें स्थित हैं। मनुष्य उनका दर्शन नहीं कर पाते  देवता, असुर और नागकन्याओंद्वारा उनका पूजन किया जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: माहात्म्यं वै गवां तद्वत् किं भूयः श्रोतुम् इच्छसि । रेवामत्स्यासमायोगे गवां माहात्म्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: māhātmyaṃ vai gavāṃ tadvat kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi / revāmatsyāsamāyoge gavāṃ māhātmyamuttamam
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: सुपर्ण नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक जितेन्द्रिय ब्रह्मर्षि थे। उनकी पतिब्रता धर्मपत्नीका नाम पुरुहूता था। वे दोनों दम्पति नैमिषारण्यमें निवास करते थे। एक दिन पर्वकालमें ऋतुस्नाता होनेपर
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा महाराज मत्स्येश्वरमथा ऽर्चय । आपस्तम्बो महाभागो निषादा मत्स्यजीविनः
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā mahārāja matsyeśvaramathā 'rcaya / āpastambo mahābhāgo niṣādā matsyajīvinaḥ
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: पुरुहूताने अपने पतिको प्रसन्न करके कहा-- “महामुने! आज मेरै साथ सहवास कीजिये, जिससे मुझे सम्पूर्ण वंशको पवित्र करनेवाला पुत्र प्राप्त हो। पुत्रके द्वारा मनुष्य पुण्यलोकोंपर
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यैः सह गताः स्वर्गं तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः । दिव्यकान्तिधराः सर्वे लोके क्रीडन्ति वैष्णवे
verses.transliteration: matsyaiḥ saha gatāḥ svargaṃ tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ / divyakāntidharāḥ sarve loke krīḍanti vaiṣṇave
verses.translation: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.hindi: विजय पाता है। पुत्रसे देवता और पितर तृप्त होते हैं। अतः आप पुत्र उत्पन्न करें।'
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that BrShmaoas living on the banks were washed away in the flood of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे मत्स्येश्वरतीर्थवर्णनोनाम त्रयोदशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय १४ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अथान्यत् कथयिष्यामि तीर्थं पापविमोक्षणम् । मत्स्यायाः शुभताप्याश्च सङ्गमे सुरसेवितम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe matsyeśvaratīrthavarṇanonāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 14 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: athānyat kathayiṣyāmi tīrthaṃ pāpavimokṣaṇam / matsyāyāḥ śubhatāpyāśca saṅgame surasevitam
verses.translation: Then all those illustrious sages with austerities as their asset went to the -highest world. What miracle did happen thereafter?
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणने कहा--प्रिये! आज अमावास्या है। इसमें मैथुनका निषेध किया गया है। अतः आज यह नहीं करना चाहिए। पितरोंके लिये तो आजके दिन मैथुन विशेषरूपसे वर्जित है। जो
verses.wordMeaning: Then all those illustrious sages with austerities as their asset went to the -highest world. What miracle did happen thereafter?
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all those illustrious sages with austerities as their asset went to the -highest world. What miracle did happen thereafter?

verses.sanskrit: देवो मत्स्येश्वरो नाम नागकन्याभिरर्चितः । तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति ये मृता न पुनर्भवाः
verses.transliteration: devo matsyeśvaro nāma nāgakanyābhirarcitaḥ / tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ
verses.translation: Learned men know it as Linga 2 because it is that in which everything in the world beginning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass gets merged and unified.
verses.hindi: अमावास्याके दिन ऋतुकालमें भी पत्नीसंगम करता है, पितर उसका मांस भोजन करते हैं। उनके इस कथनसे पत्नीको सन्तोष हो गया और दोनों शिवाराधनमें तत्पर हो गये।
verses.wordMeaning: Learned men know it as Linga 2 because it is that in which everything in the world beginning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass gets merged and unified.
verses.commentary: Sense: Learned men know it as Linga 2 because it is that in which everything in the world beginning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass gets merged and unified.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चवक्त्रास्त्रिनेत्राश्च मत्स्यतीर्थप्रभावतः । कलहंस इति ख्यातो देवर्षिर् ध्यानतत्परः
verses.transliteration: pañcavaktrāstrinetrāśca matsyatīrthaprabhāvataḥ / kalahaṃsa iti khyāto devarṣir dhyānatatparaḥ
verses.translation: A popular etgmology of 1 Bhaga* and 'Vtypv.'
verses.hindi: नील time पश्चिम और नर्मदाके उत्तर व्यतीपातेशवर नामक शिवलिंग है, जो परम सिद्धि देनेवाला है। उसे साक्षात् जगदीश्वर सोमनाथका ही स्वरूप समझो। वहाँ सावित्री और सप्तर्षियोने
verses.wordMeaning: A popular etgmology of 1 Bhaga* and 'Vtypv.'
verses.commentary: Sense: A popular etgmology of 1 Bhaga* and 'Vtypv.'

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश्रमं परं रम्यं ब्रह्मर्षि विनिषेवितम् । शाकमूलफलाहारो जपध्यानपरायणः
verses.transliteration: tasyāśramaṃ paraṃ ramyaṃ brahmarṣi viniṣevitam / śākamūlaphalāhāro japadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: A popular etymology of the word *Lifiga\ This is accepted in Vtraiaiva Texts.
verses.hindi: तपस्या की थी। नर्मदाके तटपर सावित्रीकुण्ड एक विख्यात तीर्थ है। वहाँ स्नान करनेमात्रसे मनुष्यको कन्यादानका फल प्राप्त होता है। वहाँ तिलसहित जल देने और अन्नदान करनेसे पितर
verses.wordMeaning: A popular etymology of the word *Lifiga\ This is accepted in Vtraiaiva Texts.
verses.commentary: Sense: A popular etymology of the word *Lifiga\ This is accepted in Vtraiaiva Texts.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽतिष्ठद् अयुतं सार्द्धम् एकपादेन भारत । शिवध्यानपरो भूत्वा सर्वभूतहिते रतः
verses.transliteration: so 'tiṣṭhad ayutaṃ sārddham ekapādena bhārata / śivadhyānaparo bhūtvā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ
verses.translation: She was too dazzling to be seen, like a lightning streak. She was swiftly moving as clusters of lightning streaks. She was excited and enraged like the flames (streaks) of light- ning. Her eyes resembled the fiery lightning.
verses.hindi: सावित्रीलोकमें रहकर तृप्तिलाभ करते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: She was too dazzling to be seen, like a lightning streak. She was swiftly moving as clusters of lightning streaks. She was excited and enraged like the flames (streaks) of light- ning. Her eyes resembled the fiery lightning.
verses.commentary: Sense: She was too dazzling to be seen, like a lightning streak. She was swiftly moving as clusters of lightning streaks. She was excited and enraged like the flames (streaks) of light- ning. Her eyes resembled the fiery lightning.

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तु ध्यानयोगेन तस्य देवः शतक्रतुः । चकम्पे तपसा चासौ देवराजो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tatas tu dhyānayogena tasya devaḥ śatakratuḥ / cakampe tapasā cāsau devarājo bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: These are the "Seeds" of Mantras (MantraHjas) of a destructive nature. Using these Mantra-Kjas, Sankara transformed the motherly Um& into a devouring ogress in order to destroy the universe.
verses.hindi: पातालेश्वर नामसे प्रसिद्ध देवताओंके स्वामी जगदीश्वर सोमनाथका पूजन करके सब लोग शिवधामको प्राप्त होते हैं। सावित्रीकुण्डमें स्नान करके उसीके जलसे भगवान् सोमनाथका पूजन
verses.wordMeaning: These are the "Seeds" of Mantras (MantraHjas) of a destructive nature. Using these Mantra-Kjas, Sankara transformed the motherly Um& into a devouring ogress in order to destroy the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the "Seeds" of Mantras (MantraHjas) of a destructive nature. Using these Mantra-Kjas, Sankara transformed the motherly Um& into a devouring ogress in order to destroy the universe.

verses.sanskrit: हरिष्यति न सन्देहो पुरीं चैवामरावतीम् । ब्राह्मणश्च सुरेशानः कुब्जो वामनरूपधृक्
verses.transliteration: hariṣyati na sandeho purīṃ caivāmarāvatīm / brāhmaṇaśca sureśānaḥ kubjo vāmanarūpadhṛk
verses.translation: Hundreds of the Brahmanas, K?atriyas, Vaisyas and others and the great sages beginning with Bhrgu who had reached the Mahar Loka began to perish. Devas and Asuras became terrified. So also Yaksas, Uragas and Raksasas. Some of them entered Patala and got them concealed in the caves and lakes.
verses.hindi: करे, इससे उस मनुष्यका पुनः इस संसारमें जन्म
verses.wordMeaning: Hundreds of the Brahmanas, K?atriyas, Vaisyas and others and the great sages beginning with Bhrgu who had reached the Mahar Loka began to perish. Devas and Asuras became terrified. So also Yaksas, Uragas and Raksasas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hundreds of the Brahmanas, K?atriyas, Vaisyas and others and the great sages beginning with Bhrgu who had reached the Mahar Loka began to perish. Devas and Asuras became terrified. So also Yaksas, Uragas and Raksasas.…

verses.sanskrit: जगाम वृद्धरूपेण कलहंसाश्रमम् प्रति । उवाच वचनं शक्रो ब्राह्मणं तपसि स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: jagāma vṛddharūpeṇa kalahaṃsāśramam prati / uvāca vacanaṃ śakro brāhmaṇaṃ tapasi sthitam
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--युधिष्ठिर ! सूर्यवंशमें इन्द्रद्युम्न नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक राजा हो गये हैं, जो अयोध्याके अधिपति थे। उन्होंने पर्वत, वन और काननोंसहित सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वीका पालन किया
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं तपसे शीघ्रं कामम् एतद् ब्रवीहि मे । आराधयसि कं देवं सत्यम् एतत् तपोधन
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṃ tapase śīghraṃ kāmam etad bravīhi me / ārādhayasi kaṃ devaṃ satyam etat tapodhana
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: था। उनके राज्यकालमें चारों वर्णोके लोग स्वधर्म- पालनमें तत्पर थे। प्रत्येक धेनु इच्छानुसार दूध देनेवाली कामधेनु थी और पृथ्वी हरी-भरी खेतीसे सुशोभित होती थी। एक दिन राजर्षि
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: संहृत्य तपसा योगं प्रहसन्नब्रवीद् वचः । जानामि त्वां महाभाग शक्रस् त्वं त्रिदशेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: saṃhṛtya tapasā yogaṃ prahasannabravīd vacaḥ / jānāmi tvāṃ mahābhāga śakras tvaṃ tridaśeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: इन्द्रद्युम्नने महर्षि वसिष्ठसे पूछा- “महामुने! मैं अश्वमेध-यज्ञ करना चाहता हूँ, सो किस तीर्थमें उसका अनुष्ठान करूँ?!
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: न कामये ऽहम् इन्द्रत्वं राज्यं कुरु यथेप्सितम् । आराधयाम्यहं देवं नान्यं देवं कथञ्चन
verses.transliteration: na kāmaye 'ham indratvaṃ rājyaṃ kuru yathepsitam / ārādhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ nānyaṃ devaṃ kathañcana
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: 'बसिष्ठजी बोले-राजन्! वेदवेत्ता ब्रह्मर्षिगण! आपको जैसी सम्मति दें, उस प्रकार ब्राह्मण ऋत्विजोंके द्वारा आपको यज्ञका अनुष्ठान करना चाहिए। उस समय राजसभामें मरीचि, कश्यप,
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस् तस्य महर्षेर् अब्रवीद् वृषः । वरं वृणु महाभाग यथा द्रक्ष्यसि शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā vacas tasya maharṣer abravīd vṛṣaḥ / varaṃ vṛṇu mahābhāga yathā drakṣyasi śaṅkaram
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: अंगिरा, गौतम, दुर्वासा, च्यवन, धूम्र, महामुनि कण्व तथा और भी बहुत-से उत्तम व्रतका पालन करनेवाले मुनीश्वर बैठे थे। महाराज इन्द्रद्युम्ननें उन सबसे पूछा--“किस तीर्थमें किया हुआ यज्ञ
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: कलहंस उवाच: विना ऽहं त्र्यम्बकं याचे नान्याद् देवादहो वरम् । विजयी भव शक्र त्वं नान्यं वृणे वरं त्वहम्
verses.transliteration: kalahaṃsa uvāca: vinā 'haṃ tryambakaṃ yāce nānyād devādaho varam / vijayī bhava śakra tvaṃ nānyaṃ vṛṇe varaṃ tvaham
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: मनोवांछित फल देनेवाला होता है?!
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो ययौ शक्रः सर्वकामसमन्वितः । ज्ञात्वा तस्य परां भक्तिं देवदेवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: evamukto yayau śakraḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ / jñātvā tasya parāṃ bhaktiṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: ऋषि बोले- राजन्! इस कार्यके लिये ऋषियोंने अनेक भिन्न-भिन्न तीथाँको श्रेष्ठ ।
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: अदर्शयद् अथात्मानं नीलकण्ठं त्रिलोचनम् । दृष्ट्वा रूपं महेशस्य साष्टाङ्गं प्रणिपत्य च
verses.transliteration: adarśayad athātmānaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ trilocanam / dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ maheśasya sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatya ca
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: और धान्यकी अधिकतापर निर्भर है तथा शूद्र जन्म एवं आयुके अनुसार ही ज्येष्ठ माने जाते हैं । सात कल्पोंतक जीवित रहनेवाले तीनों वेदोंके ज्ञाता त्रिकालज्ञ महर्षि मार्कण्डेयजीके रहते हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: कलहंसो मुनिश्रेष्ठः स्तोतुं समुपचक्रमे । नमो ऽस्तु ते महादेव नीलकण्ठत्रिलोचन
verses.transliteration: kalahaṃso muniśreṣṭhaḥ stotuṃ samupacakrame / namo 'stu te mahādeva nīlakaṇṭhatrilocana
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: धर्मका निरूपण एवं निश्चय करनेकी शक्ति किसमें है? महाराज! आप नर्मदाके तटपर विद्यमान धर्मरिण्यमें जाइये  वहाँ मार्कण्डेयजी जहाँ बतावें, उसी स्थानपर अपना यज्ञ प्रारम्भ करें।
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: नमः शिवाय शान्ताय शूलहस्त नमो ऽस्तु ते । नमः शिवाय शम्भवाया ऽनाथाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: namaḥ śivāya śāntāya śūlahasta namo 'stu te / namaḥ śivāya śambhavāyā 'nāthāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: देवर्ष! आप जैसा कहते हैं, वैसा ही करूँगा-यों कहकर राजा इन्द्रद्युम्नने अपने
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यम्बकाय महादेवेत्यादि नामादिभिःस्तुत ॐ नमो देवाय शम्भवाय भूर्भुवः स्वः । सोमरुद्रध्वान्तसूर्याय नमो रुद्राग्नये नमः
verses.transliteration: tryambakāya mahādevetyādi nāmādibhiḥstuta oṃ namo devāya śambhavāya bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ | somarudradhvāntasūryāya namo rudrāgnaye namaḥ
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: आदेश दिया और स्वयं वहाँके ब्राह्मणों एवं मुनियोंके साथ दिव्य वाहनपर बैठकर बड़ी प्रसन्नताके साथ यात्रा की । उनके साथ अन्तःपुरकी रानियाँ भी थीं। सबके साथ राजा इन्द्रद्युम्न
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: नमः शम्भो पञ्चवक्त्र महाशिव नमो ऽस्तु ते । स्वयम्भूवन पाताल नीलकण्ठ नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: namaḥ śambho pañcavaktra mahāśiva namo 'stu te / svayambhūvana pātāla nīlakaṇṭha namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: धर्मारण्यमें पहुँचे, जहाँ मार्कण्डेयजी विद्यमान थे। वहाँ जाकर उन्होंने मार्कण्डेयजीको साष्टांग प्रणाम और उनका यथावत् पूजन किया । राजा इन्द्रद्युम्नको आया देख महामुनि मार्कण्डेयजीने पूछा--' नृपश्रेष्ठ !
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मशर्वसुरेशानहरिहराय नमो नमः । ज्ञानशक्तिक्रियाशक्तिचराचर नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: brahmaśarvasureśānahariharāya namo namaḥ / jñānaśaktikriyāśakticarācara namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: कुशल तो है न? बहुत दिनोंके बाद दिखायी दिये हो। इन ब्रह्मर्षियोंके साथ यहाँ किस प्रयोजनसे तुम्हारा आगमन हुआ है?!
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: हाटकाय नमस् तुभ्यम् उमानाथ नमो ऽस्तु ते । ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशाय सर्वज्ञाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: hāṭakāya namas tubhyam umānātha namo 'stu te / brahmaviṣṇumaheśāya sarvajñāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: इन्द्रद्युम्न बोले--द्विजश्रेष्ठ ! मैं यज्ञ करनेके लिये आया हूँ, सो किस तीर्थमें उसका अनुष्ठान करूँ?
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातस् तथा घोरस् तत् पुरुषाय नमो नमः । त्वया व्याप्तम् इदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: sadyojātas tathā ghoras tat puruṣāya namo namaḥ / tvayā vyāptam idaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजीने कहा--राजन्! समुद्रपर्यन्त पृथ्वीपर जितने तीर्थ हैं, वे सब नर्मदा नदीमें स्नान करनेके लिये आते हैं। उत्तरमें जितने शिवलिंग हैं और दक्षिणमें जो-जो तीर्थ हैं, वे
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: आदिमध्यान्तरूपाय कलिकाल नमो ऽस्तु ते । उमाकान्तार्धदेहाय श्रीकण्ठोरगभूषण
verses.transliteration: ādimadhyāntarūpāya kalikāla namo 'stu te / umākāntārdhadehāya śrīkaṇṭhoragabhūṣaṇa
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: सब कोटितीर्थमें लीन होते हैं, इसीलिये उसका नाम कोरितीर्थ हुआ है। भगवान् शंकरने पूर्वकालमें पार्वतीदेवी, कार्तिकेयजी, ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तथा इन्द्र आदि देवताओंके सम्मुख इस तीर्थके माहात्म्यका
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तगणरूपाय नागयज्ञोपवीतिने । शब्दः स्पर्शश् च गन्धश्च रसो रूपं च पञ्चमम्
verses.transliteration: anantagaṇarūpāya nāgayajñopavītine / śabdaḥ sparśaś ca gandhaśca raso rūpaṃ ca pañcamam
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार वर्णन किया है--' ३कारेश्वरके समीप नर्मदामें कोटितीर्थं बताया गया है । वहाँ जो दान, “तथा दुष्कर तप आदि. पुण्यकर्म किया
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिर् मनस्त्व् अहङ्कारो ह्य् अष्टमूर्ते नमो ऽस्तु ते । सूर्यो ऽर्यमा भगस् त्वष्टा पूषार्कः सविता रविः
verses.transliteration: buddhir manastv ahaṅkāro hy aṣṭamūrte namo 'stu te / sūryo 'ryamā bhagas tvaṣṭā pūṣārkaḥ savitā raviḥ
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: है। ग्रहणकालमें  हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: गभस्तिमांश् च त्वं कालो मृत्युर् धाता प्रकाशकः । पृथिव्यापस् तथा तेजो वायुराकाशम् एव च
verses.transliteration: gabhastimāṃś ca tvaṃ kālo mṛtyur dhātā prakāśakaḥ / pṛthivyāpas tathā tejo vāyurākāśam eva ca
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: कुरुक्षेत्रकी प्रशंसा की जाती है । परंतु नर्मदा सदा सब कार्योके लिये पुण्यदायिनी कही गयी है। अतः तुम कोटितीर्थमें यज्ञ करो।
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: सोमो बृहस्पतिः शुक्रो बुधो ऽङ्गारक एव च । इन्द्रो विवस्वान् दीप्तांशुः शुचिः शौरिर्जनेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: somo bṛhaspatiḥ śukro budho 'ṅgāraka eva ca / indro vivasvān dīptāṃśuḥ śuciḥ śaurirjaneśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: यह सुनकर परम धर्मात्मा राजा इन्द्रद्युम्नने अमित तेजस्वी मार्कण्डेय मुनिके चरण पकड़े और कहा--मुने! आपने जो कुछ कहा है, उसके लिये मैं अपने ऊपर आपका बहुत बड़ा
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: कलास्ते विष्णुब्रह्माद्या वेदो वैश्रवणो यमः । कलाकाष्ठामुहूर्ताश् च पक्षमासर्तवस् तथा
verses.transliteration: kalāste viṣṇubrahmādyā vedo vaiśravaṇo yamaḥ / kalākāṣṭhāmuhūrtāś ca pakṣamāsartavas tathā
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: अनुग्रह मानता हूँ। इसी समय सुन्दर यज्ञयूप, विभिन्न देशोंके क्षत्रियवृन्द, गौ, अश्व, हाथी तथा अन्यान्य आवश्यक सामग्री साथ लेकर
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरस् त्वम् एवासि कालचक्रो विभावसुः । पुरुषः शाश्वतो योगो व्यक्ताव्यक्तः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsaras tvam evāsi kālacakro vibhāvasuḥ / puruṣaḥ śāśvato yogo vyaktāvyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: योजनका एक विशाल यज्ञ-मण्डप बनवाया। उसमें बहुत-से यूप लगाये और अपने प्रमाणके अनुसार नाना प्रकारके कुण्ड निर्माण कराये। यज्ञ प्रारम्भ हुआ और वेदमन्त्रोंकी उच्चारण-
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: लोकाध्यक्षः सुराध्यक्षो विश्वकर्मा तमोनुदः । वरुणः शीतभारश् च जीमूतो जीवनो ऽरिहा
verses.transliteration: lokādhyakṣaḥ surādhyakṣo viśvakarmā tamonudaḥ / varuṇaḥ śītabhāraś ca jīmūto jīvano 'rihā
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: ध्वनिसे भूमि और आकाशका मध्यभाग गूँज उठा। सूर्यके सदृश तेजस्वी अग्निदेव अपने धूमरहित स्वरूपसे प्रज्वलित हो रहे थे। महाराज इन्द्रद्युम्नने उस यज्ञमें ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तथा शिवका
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: भूतो यज्ञो भूतपतिर् लोकपालैर् निषेवितः । मनः सुपर्णो भूतादिः सदाशिव नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: bhūto yajño bhūtapatir lokapālair niṣevitaḥ / manaḥ suparṇo bhūtādiḥ sadāśiva namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: भी आवाहन किया। इनके साथ सम्पूर्ण देवता भी पधारे। राजाके यज्ञमें घी और दूधकी नदियाँ बहती थीं, जहाँ दही और खीरकी कीच जमी हुई थी। अनेक प्रकारके भक्ष्य-भोज्य पदार्थ सदा
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: जिह्वाचापल्यभावेन खेदितो ऽसि मया प्रभो । ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादिभिर् देवैर् यस्यान्तो नैव लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: jihvācāpalyabhāvena khedito 'si mayā prabho / brahmaviṣṇvādibhir devair yasyānto naiva labhyate
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: सबके लिये प्रस्तुत रहते थे। देवता, मुनि तथा चार प्रकारके प्राणिसमुदाय भलीभाँति तृप्त हुए। अन्तमें ब्राह्मणोंको प्रचुर दक्षिणा दी गयी। हू प्रकार वह यज्ञ सम्पूर्ण हुआ।
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: भवसागरमग्नानां कः स्तोतुं शक्तिमान् भवेत् । अज्ञानाञ्ज्ञानतो वा ऽपि शूलपाणे क्षमस्व तत्
verses.transliteration: bhavasāgaramagnānāṃ kaḥ stotuṃ śaktimān bhavet / ajñānāñjñānato vā 'pi śūlapāṇe kṣamasva tat
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर ध्रुव तथा ब्रह्मपुत्र महर्षियोंको विदा करके ॐकारेश्वरके स्वरूपको जानकर राजाने उनका पूजन किया। मणि-माणिक्य आदि रलोंसे पहले ३कारलिंगको विभूषित किया। फिर
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: श्रुत्वा स्तोत्रम् इदं देवः कलहंसस्य भारत । वरं वृणु महाप्राज्ञप्रीतः स्तोत्रेण ते ऽनघ
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śrutvā stotram idaṃ devaḥ kalahaṃsasya bhārata / varaṃ vṛṇu mahāprājñaprītaḥ stotreṇa te 'nagha
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: गन्ध, नाना प्रकारके धूप, कपूर, अगर, चन्दन, ध्वज, छत्र, वितान, व्यजन और दिव्य चामरोंसे पूजा सम्पन्न करके इस प्रकार स्तुति की--'जिस विन्दुयुक्त ३४कारका योगीजन सदा ध्यान करते
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: कलहंस उवाच: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि मे देव वरं दातुम् इहेच्छसि । कलहंसेश्वरं नाम तीर्थलिङ्गं सुरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: kalahaṃsa uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva varaṃ dātum ihecchasi / kalahaṃseśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaliṅgaṃ sureśvara
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: अक्षया देवदेवा ऽत्र होमदानबलिक्रियाः । अत्राक्षयं कृतं सर्वं त्वत् प्रसादात् महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: akṣayā devadevā 'tra homadānabalikriyāḥ / atrākṣayaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ tvat prasādāt maheśvara
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: देनेवाले हैं, उनको बार-बार नमस्कार है । ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तथा इन्द्रको भी वर देनेवाले सर्वदेवमय शिव! आपको नमस्कार है । रुद्र! पुण्यसे सुशोभित 'होनेवाली जो आपकी कल्याणमयी अघोर (सौम्य)
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: शिवाज्ञा वर्तते ते ऽत्र नरः स्वर्गमवाप्नुयात् । उत्क्रान्तिं कुरुते यस् तु अवशः स्ववशो ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: śivājñā vartate te 'tra naraḥ svargamavāpnuyāt / utkrāntiṃ kurute yas tu avaśaḥ svavaśo 'pi vā
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: मूर्ति है, उसके द्वारा आप मुझपर कृपा कीजिये। आपके सब ओर हाथ और पैर हैं। सब ओर नेत्र, सिर और मुख हैं। लोकमें सब ओर आपके कान हैं तथा आप सबको व्याप्त करके स्थित
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: स्तवेनानेन य स्तौतियस्त्वा स्तोष्यति शङ्कर । ब्रह्महा वा सुरापो वा स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः
verses.transliteration: stavenānena ya stautiyastvā stoṣyati śaṅkara / brahmahā vā surāpo vā steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: हैं। आपको नमस्कार है।' इस प्रकार स्तुति करनेपर ३कारलिंगके मध्यभागमें एक दूसरा लिंग दिखायी दिया, जो प्रज्वलित कालाग्निके समान कान्तिमान् था। उसने इन्द्र्युम्नसे कहा--
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावेण सर्वे यान्तु शिवालयम् । इदं वरमहं मन्ये सर्वकामसमृद्धये
verses.transliteration: tīrthasyāsya prabhāveṇa sarve yāntu śivālayam / idaṃ varamahaṃ manye sarvakāmasamṛddhaye
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: राजन्! तुम्हारा कल्याण हो। तुम्हारे मनमें जो कामना हो, उसके लिये वर माँगो।'
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: यं यं कामयते कामं त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे । मत्प्रसादान् न सन्देह सर्वम् एतद् भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ trailokye sacarācare / matprasādān na sandeha sarvam etad bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: इन्द्रद्युम्न बोले-देव! वहाँ यज्ञ पर्वतपर देवद्रोणीमें भगवती पार्वतीके साथ पूजित होकर आप सदा निवास करें। देवदेवेश्वर! इस तीर्थमें जो प्राणत्याग करे, वह शिवलोकमें जाय।
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ययौ देवः कैलासनिलयं नृप । कलहंसो ऽथ मुनिभिर् ब्रह्मिष्ठैः सजितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā yayau devaḥ kailāsanilayaṃ nṛpa / kalahaṃso 'tha munibhir brahmiṣṭhaiḥ sajitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: ३०कारेशवर बोले--नृपश्रेष्ठ ! तुम्हारी यह सब कामना पूर्ण हो।
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: वर्षायुतानि साग्राणि भुङ्क्ते भोगाञ्छिवालये । दिव्ययानसमारूढः स्तूयमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: varṣāyutāni sāgrāṇi bhuṅkte bhogāñchivālaye / divyayānasamārūḍhaḥ stūyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: इतना कहकर वे वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये। उन्हींके साथ अन्यान्य देवता भी अपने-अपने स्थानको चले गये। भगवान् शंकर कैलासधामको गये। राजा इन्द्रद्युम्नने वहाँ चार प्रकारके प्राणियोंको
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.sanskrit: वेणुवीणानिनादेन सर्वालङ्कारभूषितः । दश वर्षसहस्राणि तथैव शिवसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: veṇuvīṇāninādena sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ / daśa varṣasahasrāṇi tathaiva śivasannidhau
verses.translation: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.hindi: सुनाकर कहा--“तुम सब लोग मेरे यज्ञके प्रभावसे नीरोग हो जाओ और सभी तृप्त रहो।' तत्पश्चात् राजा इन्द्रद्युम्नने साष्टांग प्रणाम करके भगवान् विष्णुकी स्तुति की।
verses.wordMeaning: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavan, Hemakuta, Niadha, Gandham&dana, Malyavan, Nila, the great mountain £veta, the centre of Meru,

verses.transliteration: ardhakoṭis tu tīrthānāṃ mahādevena bhārata / śatamaṣṭottara tatra liṅgānāṃ parikīrtitam
verses.translation: There was a great evil portent. The stellar sphere had completely vanished. It caused everything to whirl con- tinuously like Aldtacakra (circular movement of a firebrand).
verses.hindi: (साक्षी) तथा सबके आदिकारण हैं, उन भगवान् नारायणदेवको मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ । हैत्योंका अन्त करनेवाले देवता श्रीहरिको मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ। हिरण्य, पृथ्वी तथा यज्ञको अपने गर्भमें धारण

verses.sanskrit: यत्र वै वसुरुद्रैश्च ब्रह्माद् यैश् च सुरासुरैः । सिद्धगन्धर्वयक्षैश् च विद्याधरमहोरगैः
verses.transliteration: yatra vai vasurudraiśca brahmād yaiś ca surāsuraiḥ / siddhagandharvayakṣaiś ca vidyādharamahoragaiḥ
verses.translation: The divine being pervaded through the seven worlds. The great extending arms (serpents?) encircled all the limbs. His eye resembled the rising Sun with the centre like a tender sprout. It was pink in colour like the cloud at dusk, red lily, ruby, saffron and a streak of lightning. During the period of the conclusion of the Yuga, 'he played with heated Liriga and blazing eye. Like Meru the Lord appeared as though he was discharging golden shafts. He walked there making the moun- tain shattered to pieces through the kicking with the tips of his feet. He was desirous of annihilating the entire heaven. He was laughing hideously. The sole Lord of the universe desirous of annihilating Svarga burst out his boisterous laughter, agi- tated and annihilated the entire heaven.

verses.sanskrit: कार्तवीर्यार्जुनं दृष्ट्वा क्रुद्धः प्रोवाच भार्गवः । तिष्ठ तिष्ठ क्व गन्तासि निहत्य पितरं मम
verses.transliteration: kārtavīryārjunaṃ dṛṣṭvā kruddhaḥ provāca bhārgavaḥ / tiṣṭha tiṣṭha kva gantāsi nihatya pitaraṃ mama
verses.translation: The divine being pervaded through the seven worlds. The great extending arms (serpents?) encircled all the limbs. His eye resembled the rising Sun with the centre like a tender sprout. It was pink in colour like the cloud at dusk, red lily, ruby, saffron and a streak of lightning. During the period of the conclusion of the Yuga, 'he played with heated Liriga and blazing eye. Like Meru the Lord appeared as though he was discharging golden shafts. He walked there making the moun- tain shattered to pieces through the kicking with the tips of his feet. He was desirous of annihilating the entire heaven. He was laughing hideously. The sole Lord of the universe desirous of annihilating Svarga burst out his boisterous laughter, agi- tated and annihilated the entire heaven.

verses.translation: The Trident-bearing Lord was surrounded by the terrible groups of goblins along with the Mothers.

verses.sanskrit: नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णं विन्ध्यपर्वतसेवितम् । चम्पकैर् बकुलैर् युक्तमशोकैः स्तबकैर् अपि
verses.transliteration: nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ vindhyaparvatasevitam / campakair bakulair yuktamaśokaiḥ stabakair api
verses.translation: **Who is this being that sports about stationed on the surface of the earth? His limbs are terrible and they blaze like the refulgence of a lightning streak. His body resembles the Kalanala fire and due to his boisterous laughter the whole universe is bewildered.
verses.hindi: युधिष्ठिर! एक दिव्य कथा श्रवण करो, जो सब पापोंका नाश करनेवाली है ।

verses.transliteration: punnāgaiḥ kiṅkirātaiś ca sugandhair nāgakeśaraiḥ / mallikotpalajātībhiḥ pāṭalaiḥ pārijātakaiḥ
verses.translation: He is Kala (Death), the eternal Atman desirous of annihilating the entire heaven and the whole universe. When the whole work is complete, he will be lying down. The Lord Isana will be lying down in the future Parivatsaras (years). It is not surprising.

verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
