verses.sanskrit: वासरे वासरे चैव निषादो धर्मतत्परः । सौम्यायने च चक्षुर् वै दत्त्वा सौम्यं तथात्मनः
verses.transliteration: vāsare vāsare caiva niṣādo dharmatatparaḥ / saumyāyane ca cakṣur vai dattvā saumyaṃ tathātmanaḥ
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: 'चली। इन सब धाराओंके आपसमें मिल जानेपर ब्रह्मर्षियों और देवताओंने देखा, एक नदी बह रही है। वह नदी कपिला नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुई। कपिला और नर्मदाका जहाँ संगम है, वहाँ रुद्रावर्ततीर्थ
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सम्पूजयामास त्र्यम्बकं विधिपूर्वकम् । एतत् ते कथितं राजन् कल्पगा नेत्रसङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sampūjayāmāsa tryambakaṃ vidhipūrvakam / etat te kathitaṃ rājan kalpagā netrasaṅgamam
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर दक्षिणाओंद्वारा सब ब्राह्मणोंका भलीभाँति सत्कार किया गया। उन्हें नाना प्रकारके चस्त्राभूषणोंसे विभूषित करके हाथी, घोड़े और रथपर बिठाया गया। देवताओंको भी ऐसा ही
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: भगवन् छ्रोतुम् इच्छामि महाकौतूहलं हि मे । संजातो मुनिशार्दूल स कथं नेत्रसङ्गमः
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: bhagavan chrotum icchāmi mahākautūhalaṃ hi me / saṃjāto muniśārdūla sa kathaṃ netrasaṅgamaḥ
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: सत्कार प्राप्त हुआ। सब देवता सन्तुष्ट होकर राजर्षि वसुदानसे बोले-महाभाग! इस यज्ञसे हम बहुत प्रसन्न हैं, तुम कोई वर माँगो।'
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: एकस्मिन् वासरे प्राप्ते व्यतीपाते च संक्रमे । स पुष्पभारमादाय प्रविवेश शिवालये
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ekasmin vāsare prāpte vyatīpāte ca saṃkrame / sa puṣpabhāramādāya praviveśa śivālaye
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: बसुदान बोले-देवताओ! नर्मदा और कपिलाके संगममें स्नान करके जो मनुष्य महादेवजीकी पूजा करते हैं, वे दिव्य विमानोंद्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयम् ईक्षणं तत्र देवस्य च न पश्यति । तदा तु चिन्तयामास विस्मयाविष्ट चेतनः
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyam īkṣaṇaṃ tatra devasya ca na paśyati / tadā tu cintayāmāsa vismayāviṣṭa cetanaḥ
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: स्वर्गलोकमें जायँ और जिनकी यहाँ मृत्यु हो, वे पुनः संसारमें जन्म न लेकर मुक्त हो जायँ।
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: केनापहृतम् एतस्य नेत्रं देवस्य पाप्मना । इत्य् उक्त्वा च स्वकं नेत्रं तीक्ष्णबाणेन भारत
verses.transliteration: kenāpahṛtam etasya netraṃ devasya pāpmanā / ity uktvā ca svakaṃ netraṃ tīkṣṇabāṇena bhārata
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर सब देवता अपने-अपने विमानपर आरूढ़ हो प्रसन्नतापूर्वक स्वर्गलोकको चले गये। राजर्षि वसुदान भी वेदवेत्ता ब्राह्मणोंके साथ परम आनन्दसे युक्त हो अयोध्यापुरीमें
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: ललाटे देवदेवस्य उत्कृत्य संन्यवेशयत् । न कम्पो न च कार्पण्यं ना ऽन्यथा तस्य मानसम्
verses.transliteration: lalāṭe devadevasya utkṛtya saṃnyaveśayat / na kampo na ca kārpaṇyaṃ nā 'nyathā tasya mānasam
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: लौट आये। उस तीर्थके प्रभावसे अन्तःपुर एवं परिवारसहित उन्होंने प्रचुर भोगोंका उपभोग किया और अन्तमें वे भगवान् शिवके परम धाममें गये। युधिष्ठिर! इस प्रकार नर्मदा
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तुष्टः सुरेशानो निषादं प्रति भारत । प्रहसन् न ब्रवीद् देवो वरं वृणु यथेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: tatas tuṣṭaḥ sureśāno niṣādaṃ prati bhārata / prahasan na bravīd devo varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: और कपिलाके संगमका वृत्तान्त बताया गया। इसके श्रवण और कीर्तनसे मनुष्यको संसार- बन्धनसे छुटकारा मिल जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: शिवप्रसादसम्पन्ना बुद्धिर् अन्या प्रचक्रमे । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं शम्भोः साष्टाङ्गं प्रणिपत्य सः
verses.transliteration: śivaprasādasampannā buddhir anyā pracakrame / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ śambhoḥ sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatya saḥ
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: अमरावतीमें भगवानका हैत्यसूदनरूपसे निवास तथा वहाँके अन्यान्य तीर्थो और शिवलिंगोंका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि देवेश वरं दातुं ममेच्छसि । निषादास्त इमे सर्वे मृगपक्षिगणैः सह
verses.transliteration: yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa varaṃ dātuṃ mamecchasi / niṣādāsta ime sarve mṛgapakṣigaṇaiḥ saha
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं-महाराज! नर्मदाके दक्षिण और कपिलाके पश्‍चिम तटपर भगवान् विष्णुकी मनोहर पुरी अमरावती है, जिसमें भगवान् लक्ष्मीपति कोटि कल्प और युगोंतक
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: सपुत्रदारपशवो ये चान्ये पापयोनयः । त्वत् प्रसादान् महेशान शिवलोकं प्रयान्तु ते
verses.transliteration: saputradārapaśavo ye cānye pāpayonayaḥ / tvat prasādān maheśāna śivalokaṃ prayāntu te
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: निवास करते हैं। प्राचीन कालमें देवताओं और असुरोंके युद्धमें देवकण्टक दानवोंद्वारा सब देवता परास्त हो गये। उस समय दानवोंके अत्याचारसे पीड़ित होकर पृथ्वीदेवी और ब्रह्मा आदि देवता
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वरम् अहं मन्ये भूतानां हितकाम्यया । एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस् तस्य निषादाधिपतेः शिवः
verses.transliteration: etad varam ahaṃ manye bhūtānāṃ hitakāmyayā / etacchrutvā vacas tasya niṣādādhipateḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: क्षीरसागरमें शयन करनेवाले भगवान् विष्णुकी शरणमें गये और उन्हें प्रणाम करके इस प्रकार उनकी स्तुति करने लगे--' हैत्योंका अन्त करनेवाले जनार्दन! देव! जगन्नाथ! आपकी जय हो।
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच सर्वकामाप्तिं मत्प्रसादात् त्वमाप्स्यसि । एवम् उक्त्वा शिवो राजंस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: uvāca sarvakāmāptiṃ matprasādāt tvamāpsyasi / evam uktvā śivo rājaṃs tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: 'ेदोंके मूलस्थान जगदीश्वर! हम आपकी शरणमें आये हैं, आप हमारी रक्षा करें।'  इस स्तोत्रको सुनकर भगवान् विष्णुने कहा-- ह्मन्! भूलोकमें जो-जो दुर्धर्ष दानव हैं, उन
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्ययानसमारूढो निषादो ऽनुचरैः सह । धृतस्वर्णातपत्रं तु वीज्यमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: divyayānasamārūḍho niṣādo 'nucaraiḥ saha / dhṛtasvarṇātapatraṃ tu vījyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: सबका मैं शीघ्र ही नाश करूँगा। ऐसा कहकर
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्याभरणशोभाढ्यः सर्वालङ्कारभूषितः । दिव्यवस्त्रपरीधानो दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनः
verses.transliteration: divyābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ / divyavastraparīdhāno divyagandhānulepanaḥ
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: भगवान् विष्णु देवताओंके साथ आये और सम्पूर्ण लोकोंके हितके लिये अपने सुदर्शनचक्रसे हैत्योंके मस्तक काटने लगे। तब समस्त दानव भगवान् विष्णुके भयसे थर्रा उठे और पृथ्वी
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: सुरासुरैः स्तूयमानो वेणुवीणापुरस् सरः । प्रायाच्छिवपुरं क्षिप्रं तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: surāsuraiḥ stūyamāno veṇuvīṇāpuras saraḥ / prāyācchivapuraṃ kṣipraṃ tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: छोड़कर रसातलमें भाग गये। तदनन्तर पुनः ब्राह्मण, देवता और तपस्वीजनोंके यज्ञ पूर्ववत्
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् ते कथितं राजन् छिवनेत्रह्रदाश्रितम् । अनेकशतसंख्याताः पापयोनिरता नराः
verses.transliteration: etat te kathitaṃ rājan chivanetrahradāśritam / anekaśatasaṃkhyātāḥ pāpayoniratā narāḥ
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: में भगवान् विष्णु हैत्यसूदनके नामसे प्रतिष्ठित हुए। जो मनुष्य वहाँ प्राणत्याग करता है, वह विमानके द्वारा विष्णुलोकमें सम्मानित होता है। कपिलाके पश्‍्चिममें नीलगंगाका आगमन हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदाशिवसंयोगे संसिद्धिं परमां गताः । अवश स्ववशो वा ऽपि यस् तु प्राणान् परित्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: narmadāśivasaṃyoge saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ / avaśa svavaśo vā 'pi yas tu prāṇān parityajet
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: है। उसमें स्नान करके मनुष्य कोटितीर्थके सेवनका फल पाता है। सुदर्शन, हैत्यसूदन, विष्ण्वावर्त, शिवावर्त और लक्ष्म्यावर्त -इन तीर्थम जो दान दिया जाता है, उसका पुण्य असंख्य
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: वसेद् वर्षसहस्राणि उमामाहेश्वरे पुरे । श्रवणात् कीर्तनाच् चापि मुच्यते भवबन्धनात्
verses.transliteration: vased varṣasahasrāṇi umāmāheśvare pure / śravaṇāt kīrtanāc cāpi mucyate bhavabandhanāt
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: होता है। वहाँ श्रीविष्णुको प्रसन्न करके मनुष्य अनन्त फलका' भागी होता है। श्रीविष्णुक्षेत्रका
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यास् ते पुरुषा राजन् ये म्रियन्ते शिवायने । न तेषां गर्भभूतिश् च जन्म चैव युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: dhanyās te puruṣā rājan ye mriyante śivāyane / na teṣāṃ garbhabhūtiś ca janma caiva yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: प्रमाण एक कोसका बताया गया है। उसके भीतर ब्रह्महत्याका प्रवेश नहीं होता। जो वहाँ एक मासतक उपवास तथा अग्निहोत्र करता है, जो स्त्री वहाँ पातिव्रत्यधर्मका पालन करती है तथा
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रदारपरिग्रस्ता मोहजालसमावृताः । कल्पगां तु न पश्यन्ति पापोपहतचेतसः
verses.transliteration: putradāraparigrastā mohajālasamāvṛtāḥ / kalpagāṃ tu na paśyanti pāpopahatacetasaḥ
verses.translation: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.hindi: जो मनुष्य स्वाध्याय, यज्ञ, चान्द्रायण, पराक तथा पितरोंका तिल और जलसे तर्पण करते हैं, उनके पितर तृप्त होकर भगवान् विष्णुके धाममें विहार करते हैं और उन मनुष्योंको भी अपने सत्कर्मोंका
verses.wordMeaning: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been eulogized by you through diverse kinds of Mantras. O Lotus-born One, I shall increase the peace and calm in you. Look at me burning down this world, annihilating forcibly by means of many faces.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये ह्रदाख्यानं नाम षोडशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय १७ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अथान्यत् परमं तीर्थं कथ्यमानं निबोध मे । सहस्रयज्ञं विख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye hradākhyānaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 17 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: athānyat paramaṃ tīrthaṃ kathyamānaṃ nibodha me / sahasrayajñaṃ vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
verses.translation: On being eulogized thus by Brahma and others and by the leading sages who had gone to the world of Brahma, the Lord began the annihilation of the universe. Brahma saw the face of Mahadeva, the imperishable southern face (mouth) highly awful and hideous. Its great curved fangs produced loud reports while gnashing. The face resembled the abysmal depths of the nether worlds.
verses.hindi: उत्तम फल प्राप्त होता है। जो एकरात्र, त्रिरात्र,
verses.wordMeaning: On being eulogized thus by Brahma and others and by the leading sages who had gone to the world of Brahma, the Lord began the annihilation of the universe. Brahma saw the face of Mahadeva, the imperishable southern face (mouth) highly awful and hideous.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On being eulogized thus by Brahma and others and by the leading sages who had gone to the world of Brahma, the Lord began the annihilation of the universe. Brahma saw the face of Mahadeva, the imperishable southern face (mouth) highly awful and hideous.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा च जप्त्वा च पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् । न तस्य पुनरावृत्तिर् घोरे संसारसागरे
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā ca japtvā ca pūjayitvā maheśvaram / na tasya punarāvṛttir ghore saṃsārasāgare
verses.translation: The eyes were tawny like fire and lightning streaks. It extended to thousands of Yojanas, nay hundreds of thousands of Yojanas. All the ten quarters appeared hideous with flesh, fat and suet abounding therein.
verses.hindi: वैष्णवत्रत करता है और जो दोनों पक्षोंकी एकादशीको भोजन नहीं करता है, वह इन ब्रतोंके द्वारा भगवान् विष्णुके लोकमें पूजित होता है। चाण्डाल, श्वपच अथवा पशु-पक्षीकी योनिमें
verses.wordMeaning: The eyes were tawny like fire and lightning streaks. It extended to thousands of Yojanas, nay hundreds of thousands of Yojanas. All the ten quarters appeared hideous with flesh, fat and suet abounding therein.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eyes were tawny like fire and lightning streaks. It extended to thousands of Yojanas, nay hundreds of thousands of Yojanas. All the ten quarters appeared hideous with flesh, fat and suet abounding therein.

verses.sanskrit: कथयामि तवाख्यानम् इतिहासं पुरातनम् । ताराबलिर्नाम नागः कम्बलाश्वतरौ तथा
verses.transliteration: kathayāmi tavākhyānam itihāsaṃ purātanam / tārābalirnāma nāgaḥ kambalāśvatarau tathā
verses.translation: Hundreds and thousands of the curved fangs grew large. Pitamaha saw Suras, Gandharvas, Asuras, Yaksas, Uragas and Rak§asas stuck up at the tips of the curved fangs. From his mouth a huge column of flames and hideous sparks issued forth, scattering smoke everywhere. They had different forms and they illuminated all the quarters with the brilliance of fire.
verses.hindi: पड़ा हुआ प्राणी भी यदि इस तीर्थमें अपने प्राणोंका त्याग करता है, तो वह भगवान् विष्णुके लोकमें जाता है। इस तीर्थमें मासोपवासव्रत करनेवाले पुरुषों तथा पतित्रता स्त्रियोंको देखकर
verses.wordMeaning: Hundreds and thousands of the curved fangs grew large. Pitamaha saw Suras, Gandharvas, Asuras, Yaksas, Uragas and Rak§asas stuck up at the tips of the curved fangs. From his mouth a huge column of flames and hideous sparks issued forth, scattering smoke everywhere.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hundreds and thousands of the curved fangs grew large. Pitamaha saw Suras, Gandharvas, Asuras, Yaksas, Uragas and Rak§asas stuck up at the tips of the curved fangs. From his mouth a huge column of flames and hideous sparks issued forth, scattering smoke everywhere.…

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतोरगास् तथा चान्ये भुजङ्गाश् च तथा ऽपरे । नागेश्वरं ते ऽर्चयन्ति नानापुष्पविलेपनैः
verses.transliteration: śvetoragās tathā cānye bhujaṅgāś ca tathā 'pare / nāgeśvaraṃ te 'rcayanti nānāpuṣpavilepanaiḥ
verses.translation: The face of Mahesvara of myriad miraculous forms with curved fangs and tremulous tongues seemed to be garlanded with thousands of solar flames. Though one and single he revealed himself in twelve ways. Twelve Adityas came out of the mouth of Rudra. Re- sorting to the southern quarter, they began scorching the earth.
verses.hindi: धर्मराज स्वयं ही वहाँ जा उनके लिये अर्घ्य समर्पण करते हैं और उन महात्माओंको वैष्णवलोकका दर्शन कराकर लौट आते हैं। ब्रह्माजीके मानसपुत्र सप्तर्षियोंने एक समय धर्मराजसे पूछा-' धर्म!
verses.wordMeaning: The face of Mahesvara of myriad miraculous forms with curved fangs and tremulous tongues seemed to be garlanded with thousands of solar flames. Though one and single he revealed himself in twelve ways. Twelve Adityas came out of the mouth of Rudra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The face of Mahesvara of myriad miraculous forms with curved fangs and tremulous tongues seemed to be garlanded with thousands of solar flames. Though one and single he revealed himself in twelve ways. Twelve Adityas came out of the mouth of Rudra.…

verses.sanskrit: नागपूगाः समासाद्य पूजयन्ति महेश्वरम् । गर्गो ऽघमर्षणश् चैव च्यवनः शौनको ऽङ्गिराः
verses.transliteration: nāgapūgāḥ samāsādya pūjayanti maheśvaram / gargo 'ghamarṣaṇaś caiva cyavanaḥ śaunako 'ṅgirāḥ
verses.translation: All earthly creatures resting on the different trees and grass blades that had already been dried up earlier due to drought, became utterly confused over the entire range of the surface of th earth. Being burnt suddenly by those Suns coming out of
verses.hindi: क्या कारण है कि आप यहाँ स्वयं पैदल विचर रहे हैं? इससे हमें बड़ा विस्मय हुआ है। महाभाग! इसका कारण बताइये?!
verses.wordMeaning: All earthly creatures resting on the different trees and grass blades that had already been dried up earlier due to drought, became utterly confused over the entire range of the surface of th earth. Being burnt suddenly by those Suns coming out of

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये ऽपि बहवो ब्रह्मविद्याङ्गपारगाः । नागानां चाश्रमं हर्तुं तत्र सर्वे ह्य् उपस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: ete cānye 'pi bahavo brahmavidyāṅgapāragāḥ / nāgānāṃ cāśramaṃ hartuṃ tatra sarve hy upasthitāḥ
verses.translation: The entire terrestrial sphere became suddenly kindled and it blazed forth. All the mobile and immobile beings be- came enveloped in a garland of flames. In all the seven continents and oceans, rivers and lakes the fire consumed the entire universe as though it were the sacred clarified butter being consigned to it in the course of a sacrificial rite.
verses.hindi: यह सुनकर धर्मराजने हँसते हुए कहा-- मुनिवरो! मेरे भयंकर दूत पतिव्रता स्त्रियों, मासोपवासी पुरुषों तथा इन सबके विमानोंकी उज्ज्वल दीप्तिकी ओर दृष्टिपात करनेमें असमर्थ
verses.wordMeaning: The entire terrestrial sphere became suddenly kindled and it blazed forth. All the mobile and immobile beings be- came enveloped in a garland of flames. In all the seven continents and oceans,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire terrestrial sphere became suddenly kindled and it blazed forth. All the mobile and immobile beings be- came enveloped in a garland of flames. In all the seven continents and oceans,…

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तैः कुपितैर् नागैर् दष्टाश् चैव द्विजोत्तमाः । विषाघ्रातान् मुनीन् दृष्ट्वा कुपितश् चाघमर्षणः
verses.transliteration: tatastaiḥ kupitair nāgair daṣṭāś caiva dvijottamāḥ / viṣāghrātān munīn dṛṣṭvā kupitaś cāghamarṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The Adityas born from Rudra, refulgent with extensive fiery brilliance and overwhelmed with great flames burnt the whole universe. The rays of the Adityas got mutually entangled. Thus the Lord burnt the three worlds consisting of mobile and immobile beings.
verses.hindi: हो रहे हैं। इसलिये वे लौट गये हैं। इसीलिये मैं
verses.wordMeaning: The Adityas born from Rudra, refulgent with extensive fiery brilliance and overwhelmed with great flames burnt the whole universe. The rays of the Adityas got mutually entangled. Thus the Lord burnt the three worlds consisting of mobile and immobile beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Adityas born from Rudra, refulgent with extensive fiery brilliance and overwhelmed with great flames burnt the whole universe. The rays of the Adityas got mutually entangled. Thus the Lord burnt the three worlds consisting of mobile and immobile beings.

verses.sanskrit: वाहनं वासुदेवस्य पक्षिराजं समाह्वयत् । तत्क्षणाद् आगतः पक्षी गरुडः क्रोधमूर्छितः
verses.transliteration: vāhanaṃ vāsudevasya pakṣirājaṃ samāhvayat / tatkṣaṇād āgataḥ pakṣī garuḍaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ
verses.translation: Mahesvara became the fire itself of the size of the seven continents and burnt completely the entire earth consisting of the seven continents and encircled by the seven oceans. Then it burnt the earth with Sumeru and Mandara as its limit. Thereafter it pierced through the seven Patalas and burnt Nagaloka.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं-राजन्! अमरावतीमें अमिततेजस्वी भगवान् विष्णुका निवास है। वहाँ किया हुआ श्रीहरिका पूजन कलियुगके दोषोंका नाश करनेवाला है। नर्मदाके उत्तर तटपर एक
verses.wordMeaning: Mahesvara became the fire itself of the size of the seven continents and burnt completely the entire earth consisting of the seven continents and encircled by the seven oceans. Then it burnt the earth with Sumeru and Mandara as its limit.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahesvara became the fire itself of the size of the seven continents and burnt completely the entire earth consisting of the seven continents and encircled by the seven oceans. Then it burnt the earth with Sumeru and Mandara as its limit.…

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा ब्राह्मणं चेदमब्रवीत् । भुजङ्गान् भक्षयिष्यामि ब्राह्मणा निर्विषास् ततः
verses.transliteration: kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā brāhmaṇaṃ cedamabravīt / bhujaṅgān bhakṣayiṣyāmi brāhmaṇā nirviṣās tataḥ
verses.translation: O Yudhisthira, the Agni continued to burn and blaze after completely burning down the seven Patalas beneath the earth along with the stars. When fanned with bellows a metal piece seems to blaze at night along witlvthe burning charcoal. In the same manner everything in the universe blazed forth on being kindled by Samvartagni.
verses.hindi: अन्य श्रेष्ठ देवता हैं, जो ब्रह्मेशवरके नामसे विख्यात हैं। वे सब पापोंका नाश करनेवाले हैं। उनके
verses.wordMeaning: O Yudhisthira, the Agni continued to burn and blaze after completely burning down the seven Patalas beneath the earth along with the stars. When fanned with bellows a metal piece seems to blaze at night along witlvthe burning charcoal.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Yudhisthira, the Agni continued to burn and blaze after completely burning down the seven Patalas beneath the earth along with the stars. When fanned with bellows a metal piece seems to blaze at night along witlvthe burning charcoal.…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मशापभयार्तेन गरुडेन विषोल्बणाः । भक्षिताः पन्नगाः सर्वे मोचिता मुनयो विषात्
verses.transliteration: brahmaśāpabhayārtena garuḍena viṣolbaṇāḥ / bhakṣitāḥ pannagāḥ sarve mocitā munayo viṣāt
verses.translation: Bereft of trees, grass-blades, springs, lakes, and rivers and with the clusters of the peaks of mountains scattered, the ground became comparable to the back of a tortoise. After making the entire universe chaotically unsettled through the series of flames and sparks and merged in Cit (the conscious, sentient Being) Mahesvara,. Rudra, remained in his otvn great form.
verses.hindi: पूजनसे पापराशि नष्ट होती है और पितर तृप्त होकर ब्रह्मलोकको प्राप्त होते हैं। लंकेश्वरसे दक्षिण सिद्धलिंग बताया गया है। उसके पूजन और स्पर्शसे गणपतिपदकी प्राप्ति होती है। विश्वेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: Bereft of trees, grass-blades, springs, lakes, and rivers and with the clusters of the peaks of mountains scattered, the ground became comparable to the back of a tortoise.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Bereft of trees, grass-blades, springs, lakes, and rivers and with the clusters of the peaks of mountains scattered, the ground became comparable to the back of a tortoise.…

verses.sanskrit: पक्षीन्द्रे च गते स्थाने भक्षयित्वा भुजङ्गमान् । अवशिष्टास् तु ये नागा विविशुस्ते रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: pakṣīndre ca gate sthāne bhakṣayitvā bhujaṅgamān / avaśiṣṭās tu ye nāgā viviśuste rasātalam

verses.sanskrit: आप्लवे च सुसंप्राप्ते प्रवाहो नार्मदः क्षणात् । अस्थीनि स्रावयामास ततो नागा दिवं ययुः
verses.transliteration: āplave ca susaṃprāpte pravāho nārmadaḥ kṣaṇāt / asthīni srāvayāmāsa tato nāgā divaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: With the favour of Rudra, Narmada not born of a womb, and I were excluded from this annihilation. Ten thousand Yugas were thus concluded by me as though subsisting in water (of Narmada). The Trident-bearing Lord was propitiated formerly by me. Hence I became immortal and free from old age. I had also recited the following scriptural passages: Aghamarsana, Ghora Mantra, Vamadeva Sukta, Tryambaka Sukta,;, Rsabha Sukta, Trisuparna, Durga Sukta, Sdvitra Sukta, Brhadaranyaka, Brhatsaman and Uttara Saman. So also, the great Raudn Gayatn, Sivopanisad, Pratiratha Sukta and Mrtyunjaya Sukta. 1
verses.hindi: नर्मदा नदीके उत्तर तटकी यात्रा करे। वहाँ परम सिद्धिदायक पापनाशन लिंग है। वहाँ स्नान, तर्पण और पूजन करनेसे ब्रह्महत्याका नाश होता है। उसके बाद सब पापोंका नाश करनेवाला ऋणमोचन
verses.wordMeaning: With the favour of Rudra, Narmada not born of a womb, and I were excluded from this annihilation. Ten thousand Yugas were thus concluded by me as though subsisting in water (of Narmada). The Trident-bearing Lord was propitiated formerly by me.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्पयोनिं परित्यज्य लोके क्रीडन्ति शाम्भवे । नागेश्वरस्य रेवायाः सम्पर्कात् पापमोक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: sarpayoniṃ parityajya loke krīḍanti śāmbhave / nāgeśvarasya revāyāḥ samparkāt pāpamokṣaṇam
verses.translation: The earth extending to the rivers and oceans was reduced to ashes. But the highly esteemable Narmada compa- rable to Amrta, was excluded (spared).
verses.hindi: लिंग है। उसके पूजनसे अनेक जन्मोंका ऋण नष्ट हो जाता है। ऋणमोचनके दर्शनपूर्वक तिल और जलकी अंजलि देनेसे पितर तबतक तृप्त रहते हैं, जबतक कि सूर्य, चन्द्रमा और ताराओंकी
verses.wordMeaning: The earth extending to the rivers and oceans was reduced to ashes. But the highly esteemable Narmada compa- rable to Amrta, was excluded (spared).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र नागह्रदश् चास्ते त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः । तत्र स्नातो दिवं याति यो नागेश्वरमर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: tatra nāgahradaś cāste triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ / tatra snāto divaṃ yāti yo nāgeśvaramarcayet
verses.translation: The following are the Kulaparvatas: Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Hemakuta, Malyavan, Vindhya and Pariyatra. These mountains were completely burnt down by the twelve Adityas. (Due to heat) the rocks in them were severely shattered. They are seen reduced to ashes. But Narmada did not perish then. Himavan, Hemakuta, Nisadha, Gandhamadana, the excellent mountain Malyavan, Nila, Sveta and Srngavan — these great mountains were resorted to by Devas and Gandharvas. All of them were completely burnt down by the Yugantagni (Fire at the end of the Yuga). The great rocks and boulders of all these were shattered.
verses.hindi: स्थिति बनी रहती है। नर्मदा और चरुके संगममें शास्त्रोक्त रीतिसे स्नान करके संगमके जल और बिल्वपत्रसे जो महादेवजीको स्नान कराता और उनकी पूजा करता है, उसकी उमा-महेश्वरधामसे

verses.sanskrit: अयं ते कथितो राजन्नितिहासः पुरातनः । श्रवणात् कीर्तनाद् वा ऽपि मुच्यते भवबन्धनात्
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ te kathito rājannitihāsaḥ purātanaḥ / śravaṇāt kīrtanād vā 'pi mucyate bhavabandhanāt
verses.translation: Thus the utter annihilation of everything except that of the highly meritorious Narmada was earlier seen by me at the close of the Yuga, O excellent king.
verses.hindi: कभी पुनरावृत्ति नहीं होती। चतुष्केशवर नामक एक सिद्धलिंग है, जो आँवलेके फलके बराबर है। देवता और हैत्य उसका पूजन करते हैं। मनुष्य उसे नहीं देख पाते। जो परम धार्मिक

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे नागेश्वराख्यानं नाम सप्तदशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय १८ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अथान्यत् कथयिष्यामि तीर्थं च जनकोत्तमम् । रेवाया उत्तरे कूले सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe nāgeśvarākhyānaṃ nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 18 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: athānyat kathayiṣyāmi tīrthaṃ ca janakottamam / revāyā uttare kūle sarvasiddhipradāyakam
verses.translation: When the world was completely burnt by the Suns originating from Isvara, with the seven oceans rendered dry along with (the burning of) the seven continents, huge clouds issued forth from his mouth. When the world was dried up by the Suns and burnt down by Kalagni, clouds issued forth from the mouth of Sankara. Terrible clouds having features compa- rable to the weapon of Indra (i.e. Rainbow), urged by the most excellent Isana made the universe completely dark. Some of the clouds had the lustre of a blue lotus; somewhere they had the lustre of collyrium; some resembled cow's milk, Kunda flower and the moon; others resembled the eyelets on the feathers of a peacock; and some had the lustre of smokeless fire. Some clouds had the forms resembling great mountains; some could be compared to shoals of great fishes; some had excellent forms of huge elephants; and some clouds resembled great peaks. Some were similar in form to the moving waves and billows; some were akin to the domes in a big city; some resembled great towers and ornamental gateways; others ap- peared to be adorned at the extremities by comets, firebrands and thunderbolts characterized by lightning streaks. A Gana of Rudra named Samvartaka got his limbs concealed. The Lord showered limitlessly and made the universe one vast expanse of water.
verses.hindi: पुत्र उस तीर्थमें श्राद्ध करता है, उसके पितर महाप्रलय कालतक तृप्त रहते हैं। चरु नामवाली नदी यज्ञ पर्वतसे निकली है। पूर्वकालमें अपने पुरोहित बृहस्पतिजीके साथ देवराज इन्द्रने यहाँ

verses.transliteration: kalmāṣapāda uvāca: puṣkare daśayajñāś ca mayā ceṣṭā vidhānataḥ / gaṅgāyāṃ naimiṣāraṇye prabhāse śaśibhūṣaṇe
verses.translation: When the world was completely burnt by the Suns originating from Isvara, with the seven oceans rendered dry along with (the burning of) the seven continents, huge clouds issued forth from his mouth. When the world was dried up by the Suns and burnt down by Kalagni, clouds issued forth from the mouth of Sankara. Terrible clouds having features compa- rable to the weapon of Indra (i.e. Rainbow), urged by the most excellent Isana made the universe completely dark. Some of the clouds had the lustre of a blue lotus; somewhere they had the lustre of collyrium; some resembled cow's milk, Kunda flower and the moon; others resembled the eyelets on the feathers of a peacock; and some had the lustre of smokeless fire. Some clouds had the forms resembling great mountains; some could be compared to shoals of great fishes; some had excellent forms of huge elephants; and some clouds resembled great peaks. Some were similar in form to the moving waves and billows; some were akin to the domes in a big city; some resembled great towers and ornamental gateways; others ap- peared to be adorned at the extremities by comets, firebrands and thunderbolts characterized by lightning streaks. A Gana of Rudra named Samvartaka got his limbs concealed. The Lord showered limitlessly and made the universe one vast expanse of water.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा विष्णुः शिवः शास्ता सत्यमेव यथोदितम् । धर्मराज्ञा समग्रं तु नारदाद्यामहर्षयः
verses.transliteration: brahmā viṣṇuḥ śivaḥ śāstā satyameva yathoditam / dharmarājñā samagraṃ tu nāradādyāmaharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: When the world was completely burnt by the Suns originating from Isvara, with the seven oceans rendered dry along with (the burning of) the seven continents, huge clouds issued forth from his mouth. When the world was dried up by the Suns and burnt down by Kalagni, clouds issued forth from the mouth of Sankara. Terrible clouds having features compa- rable to the weapon of Indra (i.e. Rainbow), urged by the most excellent Isana made the universe completely dark. Some of the clouds had the lustre of a blue lotus; somewhere they had the lustre of collyrium; some resembled cow's milk, Kunda flower and the moon; others resembled the eyelets on the feathers of a peacock; and some had the lustre of smokeless fire. Some clouds had the forms resembling great mountains; some could be compared to shoals of great fishes; some had excellent forms of huge elephants; and some clouds resembled great peaks. Some were similar in form to the moving waves and billows; some were akin to the domes in a big city; some resembled great towers and ornamental gateways; others ap- peared to be adorned at the extremities by comets, firebrands and thunderbolts characterized by lightning streaks. A Gana of Rudra named Samvartaka got his limbs concealed. The Lord showered limitlessly and made the universe one vast expanse of water.
verses.hindi: प्रादुर्भाव हुआ है। वह यशस्वी वाराह पर्वतके शरीरसे निकली है। उसमें स्नान करनेपर मनुष्य निश्चय ही इस संसारमें जन्म नहीं लेता। युधिष्ठिर! वहाँ तिलोदक देनेसे पितर लाखों वर्षोतक भगवान्

verses.hindi: निवास करते हैं, उस एक कोसले क्षेत्रको विष्णुक्षेत्र जानना चाहिए। आश्‍्विनमासके कृष्ण पक्षकी चतुर्दशी और अमावास्या तथा शुक्ल पक्षकी प्रतिपदा- ये क्रमशः उस तीर्थके पर्व हँ । चतुर्दशीको चारका

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे जनकयज्ञो नामाष्टादशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय १९ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: सप्तसारस्वतं तीर्थ शंस मे ऽत्र महामुने । उत्पत्तिं चास्य तीर्थस्य कथयस्व यथार्थतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe janakayajño nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 19 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: saptasārasvataṃ tīrtha śaṃsa me 'tra mahāmune / utpattiṃ cāsya tīrthasya kathayasva yathārthataḥ
verses.translation: I was about to die in that vast ocean-like expanse of water and was distressed. Muttering to myself and sighing, O excellent king, I swam across the water with my arms.
verses.hindi: योग होनेपर अर्थात् मास, पक्ष, तिथि और विष्णुकषेत्रका संयोग होनेपर वहाँ अमृतकी धारा बहती है। उस दिन वहाँ तर्पण करनेसे पितर अवश्य ही तृप्त होते हैं। सूर्यग्रहणके समय कुरुक्षेत्रमें

verses.commentary: Sense: I was about to die in that vast ocean-like expanse of water and was distressed. Muttering to myself and sighing, O excellent king, I swam across the water with my arms.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: सप्तसारस्वतो नाम गन्धर्वः शिवगायनः । वीणावेणुप्रेक्षणीय यन्त्रगीतविशारदः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: saptasārasvato nāma gandharvaḥ śivagāyanaḥ / vīṇāveṇuprekṣaṇīya yantragītaviśāradaḥ
verses.translation: Have I been forgotten by you? I am Mahesvari (Great Goddess) of diverse forms. I am Narmada, the bestower of piety on men, the bestower of heavenly pleasures, happiness and strength. On seeing you distressed Rudra has despatched me saying: "O noble lady, redeem that Brahmana. Let him not lose his life in the water." At the instance of the Lord, I have come near you in the form of a cow. I hurried lest Sambhu should be one of false speech.
verses.hindi: जो फल बताया गया है, वह तापी और पयोष्णीके संगममें भी प्राप्त होता है। नर्मदाके दक्षिण पातालसे एक तीर्थ प्रकट हुआ है, जो तीनों लोकोंमें कावेरीकुण्डके नामसे विख्यात हुआ है। उसमें

verses.sanskrit: मणिभद्रा सुभद्रा च हेमगर्भा तथा परा । आभिर्वराप्सरोभिश् च चिक्रीडे प्रतिवासरम्
verses.transliteration: maṇibhadrā subhadrā ca hemagarbhā tathā parā / ābhirvarāpsarobhiś ca cikrīḍe prativāsaram
verses.translation: I circumambulated Lord Isa who was quiescent and asleep. He had the colour of fresh gold. He was associated with Uma. He was meritorious and excellent but was enveloped by darkness.
verses.hindi: स्नानमात्र करनेसे मनुष्य गणाध्यक्ष पदको प्राप्त करता है। वहाँ कुण्डेश्वर नामक एक सिद्धलिंग है, जो देवताओं और सिद्धोंसे सुसेवित हैं। उस पवित्र लिंगका जो भूलसे भी पूजन कर लेता है,
verses.wordMeaning: I circumambulated Lord Isa who was quiescent and asleep. He had the colour of fresh gold. He was associated with Uma. He was meritorious and excellent but was enveloped by darkness.
verses.commentary: Sense: I circumambulated Lord Isa who was quiescent and asleep. He had the colour of fresh gold. He was associated with Uma. He was meritorious and excellent but was enveloped by darkness.

verses.sanskrit: मदिरा नष्टचैतन्यः कामार्तः काममोहितः । विहाय शाङ्करीं पूजां भक्ष्यभोज्यरतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: madirā naṣṭacaitanyaḥ kāmārtaḥ kāmamohitaḥ / vihāya śāṅkarīṃ pūjāṃ bhakṣyabhojyarato 'bhavat
verses.translation: Here Siva is identified with Vi?i>u — a syncretism.
verses.hindi: उसके पुण्यकी कोई संख्या नहीं है । स्वयं हुए जो स्वयम्भू लिंग हैं, वे देनेवाले हैं। कावेरीमें मनुष्य जहाँ करता है, वह अश्वमेधके फलको
verses.wordMeaning: Here Siva is identified with Vi?i>u — a syncretism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here Siva is identified with Vi?i>u — a syncretism.

verses.sanskrit: कियत्यपि गते काले ययौ द्रष्टुम् उमापतिम् । गीतनृत्यैश् च तुष्टाव कैलासे तं नगोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: kiyatyapi gate kāle yayau draṣṭum umāpatim / gītanṛtyaiś ca tuṣṭāva kailāse taṃ nagottame
verses.translation: An echo of the Puru$a-sukta (RV X, 90).
verses.hindi: प्रतिष्ठित होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: An echo of the Puru$a-sukta (RV X, 90).
verses.commentary: Sense: An echo of the Puru$a-sukta (RV X, 90).

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वं तं समालोक्य चिरकाले समागतम् । शशाप नन्दी कोपेन शिवभक्तिपराङ्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: gandharvaṃ taṃ samālokya cirakāle samāgatam / śaśāpa nandī kopena śivabhaktiparāṅmukham
verses.translation: Vi$nu's Boar-incarnation is attributed to Siva here.
verses.hindi: भद्ररुद्रेश्वरकी महिमा, दुर्वासाजीके द्वारा अमरकण्टकका गयातीर्थके तुल्य होना तथा राजा भरतका यज्ञ
verses.wordMeaning: Vi$nu's Boar-incarnation is attributed to Siva here.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vi$nu's Boar-incarnation is attributed to Siva here.

verses.sanskrit: चाण्डालयोनिं गच्छ त्वं पापस्यास्य प्रभावतः । क्षुत्क्षामस्त्वं निराहारो मर्त्यलोके चरिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: cāṇḍālayoniṃ gaccha tvaṃ pāpasyāsya prabhāvataḥ / kṣutkṣāmastvaṃ nirāhāro martyaloke cariṣyasi
verses.translation: Strong condemnation of treating Siva and Vi$qu as different — a syncretic trend of that (Pur&Qic) age.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं-राजन्! एक भद्र- रुद्रेश्वर नामक लिंग है, जो उत्तम सिद्धियोंको देनेवाला है। पूर्वकल्पमें भद्र और रुद्र नामवाले
verses.wordMeaning: Strong condemnation of treating Siva and Vi$qu as different — a syncretic trend of that (Pur&Qic) age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Strong condemnation of treating Siva and Vi$qu as different — a syncretic trend of that (Pur&Qic) age.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसाद्य नन्दिनं सो ऽथ गन्धर्वो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । शापस्यान्तं महाभाग दातुं मे त्वमिहार्हसि
verses.transliteration: prasādya nandinaṃ so 'tha gandharvo vākyam abravīt / śāpasyāntaṃ mahābhāga dātuṃ me tvamihārhasi
verses.translation: With her body hanging, suspended at the tip of the curved fang (of the divine Boar) she shone like the moonlight sticking to the peak of Kailasa. Of uneven form, she resembled the lightning sticking to the cusp or horn of the moon.
verses.hindi: इस शिवलिंगकी अर्चना करके विद्याधरलोक
verses.wordMeaning: With her body hanging, suspended at the tip of the curved fang (of the divine Boar) she shone like the moonlight sticking to the peak of Kailasa. Of uneven form, she resembled the lightning sticking to the cusp or horn of the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: With her body hanging, suspended at the tip of the curved fang (of the divine Boar) she shone like the moonlight sticking to the peak of Kailasa. Of uneven form, she resembled the lightning sticking to the cusp or horn of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: नन्द्युवाच: नर्मदायां व्यतीपाते स्नात्वा ऽभ्यर्च्य महेश्वरम् । अन्तं शापस्य संप्राप्य पुनस्त्वं चागमिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: nandyuvāca: narmadāyāṃ vyatīpāte snātvā 'bhyarcya maheśvaram / antaṃ śāpasya saṃprāpya punastvaṃ cāgamiṣyasi
verses.translation: (In that short span of time) All those things con- sisting of names and forms, the entire universe was witnessed by me. They were surrounded by oceans and continents. Everything was overspread by the stars and constellations. Everything appeared wonderful with the sky, clouds and the system of planets full of different kinds of living beings. Yet I could not see the Sarvasuresvarl (the goddess of all Suras) in the form of the cow, the divinity of great esteem.
verses.hindi: आदिकल्पके चाक्षुष मन्वन्तरमें सत्ययुग आनेपर निमि नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक चक्रवर्ती राजा हुए। वे ब्राह्मणके क्रोधसे पक्षी-योनिमें पड़ गये थे। उन्होंने सोमवती अमावास्यामें यहाँ स्नान करके
verses.wordMeaning: (In that short span of time) All those things con- sisting of names and forms, the entire universe was witnessed by me. They were surrounded by oceans and continents. Everything was overspread by the stars and constellations. Everything appeared wonderful with the sky,…

verses.sanskrit: एवं तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा चाण्डालीं योनिम् आश्रितः । जातिस्मरत्वं संप्राप्य सशैलवनकाननाम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tad vacanaṃ śrutvā cāṇḍālīṃ yonim āśritaḥ / jātismaratvaṃ saṃprāpya saśailavanakānanām

verses.hindi: इस तीर्थके माहात्म्यसे पक्षी-योनि त्यागकर स्वर्गलोक प्राप्त किया।
verses.wordMeaning: (In that short span of time) All those things con- sisting of names and forms, the entire universe was witnessed by me. They were surrounded by oceans and continents. Everything was overspread by the stars and constellations. Everything appeared wonderful with the sky,…

verses.sanskrit: राहुसोमसमायोगे कुरुक्षेत्रे महाफलम् । तत्रैव जन्म राजर्षेः कार्तवीर्यनृपस्य च
verses.transliteration: rāhusomasamāyoge kurukṣetre mahāphalam / tatraiva janma rājarṣeḥ kārtavīryanṛpasya ca
verses.translation: Yaksas, Kinnaras and Gandharvas, Pisacas, Uragas and Raksasas — all these undergo annihilation when the close of the Yuga is imminent.
verses.hindi: उत्तान लिटाकर उस दुर्गम मार्गपर घसीटते हुए ले जाया जाता है। कोई पसलीमें बँधे होते हैं, कोई भुजाओंमें, कोई पेट या कमरमें बाँधे जाते हैं; किन्हींके गलेमें ther डालकर घसीटा जाता
verses.wordMeaning: Yaksas, Kinnaras and Gandharvas, Pisacas, Uragas and Raksasas — all these undergo annihilation when the close of the Yuga is imminent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yaksas, Kinnaras and Gandharvas, Pisacas, Uragas and Raksasas — all these undergo annihilation when the close of the Yuga is imminent.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य महादेवं गन्धपुष्पाद्युपस्करैः । सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ यावदुमामाहेश्वरे पुरे
verses.transliteration: snātvābhyarcya mahādevaṃ gandhapuṣpādyupaskaraiḥ / sūryācandramasau yāvadumāmāheśvare pure
verses.translation: Mountains, oceans, rivers, different types of lakes, trees, creepers and grasses — all get dried up.
verses.hindi: है और वे अत्यन्त दुःखी होते हैं। किन्हींकी जीभमें कील धँसायी जाती है। किन्हींको अर्धचन््राकार हाथसे गलेमें पकड़कर (गरमेंचा देकर) इधर- उधर धक्का दिया जाता है। किन्हींके लिंग और
verses.wordMeaning: Mountains, oceans, rivers, different types of lakes, trees, creepers and grasses — all get dried up.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mountains, oceans, rivers, different types of lakes, trees, creepers and grasses — all get dried up.

verses.sanskrit: भुङ्क्ते स विविधान् भोगांस् तावद् वै शिवसन्निधौ । तत्र शाण्डिल्यकौण्डिन्यौ माण्डव्यो मुनिमत्तमः
verses.transliteration: bhuṅkte sa vividhān bhogāṃs tāvad vai śivasannidhau / tatra śāṇḍilyakauṇḍinyau māṇḍavyo munimattamaḥ
verses.translation: Thus when everything was under turmoil, when all re- gions'were bereft of all medicinal herbs and water, when the three worlds consisting of mobile and immobile beings resembled a dry log of wood, at midday, when the time for ablution arrived, I saw the three worlds becoming inaccessible and in a form of fire too dazzling to be viewed.
verses.hindi: अण्डकोषमें रस्सी बाँधकर उन्हें खींचा जाता है। कितने ही पापियोंके हाथ, पैर, कान, ओठ, नासिका, शिश्न, अण्डकोष, मस्तक तथा अन्यान्य अंग काट लिये जाते हैं। कोई अंकुशोंसे छेदे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus when everything was under turmoil, when all re- gions'were bereft of all medicinal herbs and water, when the three worlds consisting of mobile and immobile beings resembled a dry log of wood, at midday, when the time for ablution arrived,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus when everything was under turmoil, when all re- gions'were bereft of all medicinal herbs and water, when the three worlds consisting of mobile and immobile beings resembled a dry log of wood, at midday, when the time for ablution arrived,…

verses.sanskrit: कौशिकश् च महातेजाः कश्यपो भृगुर् एव च । एते चान्ये ऽपि बहवो जपध्यानपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: kauśikaś ca mahātejāḥ kaśyapo bhṛgur eva ca / ete cānye 'pi bahavo japadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Two Suns were seen in the east, O dear one. So also in the north and in the west. Similarly in the south too, two radiant Suns were seen.
verses.hindi: जाते हैं। किन्हींको साँप और बिच्छू काट खाते हैं तथा वे पापी जीव अनाथ, निराश्रय होकर इधर-उधर भागते और चिल्लाते रहते हैं। मुद्गरों और लोहेके डंडोंसे उनपर बार-बार मार पड़ती
verses.wordMeaning: Two Suns were seen in the east, O dear one. So also in the north and in the west. Similarly in the south too, two radiant Suns were seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two Suns were seen in the east, O dear one. So also in the north and in the west. Similarly in the south too, two radiant Suns were seen.

verses.sanskrit: मुनीनां षष्टिसाहस्रं तपस्युग्रे व्यवस्थितम् । तस्याश्रमपदं रम्यं शाण्डिल्याकल्पगायुजि
verses.transliteration: munīnāṃ ṣaṣṭisāhasraṃ tapasyugre vyavasthitam / tasyāśramapadaṃ ramyaṃ śāṇḍilyākalpagāyuji
verses.translation: Two Suns were stationed in Nagaloka and two in the middle of the sky. Thus twelve Adityas began to blaze in all the quarters.
verses.hindi: है। उन्हें भयंकर कोड़ोंसे भी पीटा जाता और भिन्दिपालोंद्वारा पीडित किया जाता है। उनके Fed रक्त निकलता रहता है। वे कभी पानीमें गिरा दिये जाते हैं और कभी धूपसे सन्तप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Two Suns were stationed in Nagaloka and two in the middle of the sky. Thus twelve Adityas began to blaze in all the quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two Suns were stationed in Nagaloka and two in the middle of the sky. Thus twelve Adityas began to blaze in all the quarters.

verses.sanskrit: शाण्डिल्यपुरम् इत्येव ब्रह्मर्षि विनिषेवितम् । द्वादशादित्यतीर्थं च नर्मदादक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: śāṇḍilyapuram ityeva brahmarṣi viniṣevitam / dvādaśādityatīrthaṃ ca narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: They burnt the entire earth including mountains, parks and forests. Nothing was seen unburnt except Reva and myself.
verses.hindi: होकर छायाके लिये प्रार्थना करते हैं। दानहीन मनुष्योंको इसी प्रकार दुर्दशा भोगते हुए यमलोकमें जाना पड़ता है। जिन्होंने अपने: पापोंका प्रायश्चित्त कर लिया है, वे यमलोकमें
verses.wordMeaning: They burnt the entire earth including mountains, parks and forests. Nothing was seen unburnt except Reva and myself.
verses.commentary: Sense: They burnt the entire earth including mountains, parks and forests. Nothing was seen unburnt except Reva and myself.

verses.sanskrit: देवदारु तथा तीर्थम् अन्यद् देववनं तथा । दशलक्षाणि तीर्थानि तत्र तिष्ठन्ति संगमे
verses.transliteration: devadāru tathā tīrtham anyad devavanaṃ tathā / daśalakṣāṇi tīrthāni tatra tiṣṭhanti saṃgame
verses.translation: When the earth was being burnt, the smell of ghee and sacrificial offerings issued forth. Thereupon my body became parched. Unbearable thirst too overwhelmed me.
verses.hindi: सुखपूर्वक जाते हैं। इस तरह उस निकृष्ट मार्गसे यमराजके नगरमें गये हुए पापी जीव/ आज्ञा मिलनेपर दूतोंद्वारा यमराजके सम्मुख पहुँचाये
verses.wordMeaning: When the earth was being burnt, the smell of ghee and sacrificial offerings issued forth. Thereupon my body became parched. Unbearable thirst too overwhelmed me.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the earth was being burnt, the smell of ghee and sacrificial offerings issued forth. Thereupon my body became parched. Unbearable thirst too overwhelmed me.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशार्कम् इदं नाम तीर्थं पापप्रणाशनम् । अन्यानि यानि लिङ्गानि कथितानि तवा ऽनघ
verses.transliteration: dvādaśārkam idaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / anyāni yāni liṅgāni kathitāni tavā 'nagha
verses.translation: I did not find water. Everything was dried up by the Suns. I looked into the Kamandalu (waterpot). That too was dry.
verses.hindi: जाते हैं। वहाँ चित्रगुप्त उन पापियोंको धर्मोपदेश करते हुए उनके पापोंका स्मरण कराते हैं और इस प्रकार कहते हैं--'अरे ओ पापाचारियो! ओ पराये धनको SST लेनेवाले लुटेरो ! तुमलोगोंने
verses.wordMeaning: I did not find water. Everything was dried up by the Suns. I looked into the Kamandalu (waterpot). That too was dry.
verses.commentary: Sense: I did not find water. Everything was dried up by the Suns. I looked into the Kamandalu (waterpot). That too was dry.

verses.sanskrit: मूषकश्च तथा तीर्थे मार्जारेणैव भक्षितः । निशायां मूषकः कश्चिदटमान इतस् ततः
verses.transliteration: mūṣakaśca tathā tīrthe mārjāreṇaiva bhakṣitaḥ / niśāyāṃ mūṣakaḥ kaścidaṭamāna itas tataḥ
verses.translation: Then I was distressed with grief, particularly overwhelmed by thirst. I jumped up into the sky from the earth looking around.
verses.hindi: अपने रूप और बलके घमण्डमें आकर परायी स्त्रियोंका सतीत्व नष्ट किया है। तुम्हें ज्ञात होना चाहिए कि जो जिस कर्मको करता है, उसीको उस कर्मका फल भोगना पड़ता है। फिर तुमने
verses.wordMeaning: Then I was distressed with grief, particularly overwhelmed by thirst. I jumped up into the sky from the earth looking around.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then I was distressed with grief, particularly overwhelmed by thirst. I jumped up into the sky from the earth looking around.

verses.sanskrit: मार्जरेण ततः सो ऽपि भक्षितश् च धृतः पुरा । ततो मेघागमे काले प्रवाहस् तत्र निर्गतः
verses.transliteration: mārjareṇa tataḥ so 'pi bhakṣitaś ca dhṛtaḥ purā / tato meghāgame kāle pravāhas tatra nirgataḥ
verses.translation: TRen I espied a house in the firmament beautifully furnished. O excellent king, desirous of seeing it, I passed
verses.hindi: अपना ही सत्यानाश करनेके लिये पाप क्यों किया? और अब अपने उन्हीं कर्मोके कारण जब क्लेश भोगना पड़ता है, तब दुखी क्यों होते हो? सबको अपने-अपने कर्म ही भोगने
verses.wordMeaning: TRen I espied a house in the firmament beautifully furnished. O excellent king, desirous of seeing it, I passed
verses.commentary: Sense: TRen I espied a house in the firmament beautifully furnished. O excellent king, desirous of seeing it, I passed

verses.sanskrit: अस्थिप्रवहणं तस्य निमग्नं तत्र सङ्गमे । तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावेण यक्षराजो ऽभवत् नृप
verses.transliteration: asthipravahaṇaṃ tasya nimagnaṃ tatra saṅgame / tīrthasyāsya prabhāveṇa yakṣarājo 'bhavat nṛpa
verses.translation: Its height was eighty-six thousand Yojanas. Half thereof was separately embellished with gold and jewels.
verses.hindi: पड़ते हैं, इसमें किसीका कोई दोष नहीं है।'
verses.wordMeaning: Its height was eighty-six thousand Yojanas. Half thereof was separately embellished with gold and jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its height was eighty-six thousand Yojanas. Half thereof was separately embellished with gold and jewels.

verses.sanskrit: बृहद्वृन्दः समाख्यातो यक्षायुतसमावृतः । हंसयुक्तविमानेन यक्षलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: bṛhadvṛndaḥ samākhyāto yakṣāyutasamāvṛtaḥ / haṃsayuktavimānena yakṣaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: O excellent king, in the centre thereof I saw a huge bed. A Being of divine tresses of hairs was lying on the bed.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर चित्रगुप्तजी यमराजसे कहते हैं- “स्वामिन्! ये भूलोकसे राजालोग आये हैं। इन्हें
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, in the centre thereof I saw a huge bed. A Being of divine tresses of hairs was lying on the bed.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, in the centre thereof I saw a huge bed. A Being of divine tresses of hairs was lying on the bed.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यत् कथयिष्यामि शाण्डिल्यानर्मदाश्रितम् । नाम्ना चाप्सरसं लिङ्गं मुक्ताश्चाप्सरसो यतः
verses.transliteration: athānyat kathayiṣyāmi śāṇḍilyānarmadāśritam / nāmnā cāpsarasaṃ liṅgaṃ muktāścāpsaraso yataḥ
verses.translation: He was lying down stretching a full Yojana long with curly hairs. His splendour was heightened by a wonderful crown of refulgent lustre.
verses.hindi: नरेश अपने भयंकर दुष्कर्मॉसे प्रेरित होकर यहाँ आये हैं।' यमराजसे ऐसा कहकर वे उन राजाओंको. सम्बोधित करके कहते हैं-दुराचारी नरपालो! तुम सब लोग प्रजाका सर्वनाश करनेवाले रहे हो।
verses.wordMeaning: He was lying down stretching a full Yojana long with curly hairs. His splendour was heightened by a wonderful crown of refulgent lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was lying down stretching a full Yojana long with curly hairs. His splendour was heightened by a wonderful crown of refulgent lustre.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानरूपमयं देवं सिद्धलिङ्गं प्रकीर्तितम् । युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कस्मादप्सरसः शप्ताः कथं याताश् च सङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: jñānarūpamayaṃ devaṃ siddhaliṅgaṃ prakīrtitam / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kasmādapsarasaḥ śaptāḥ kathaṃ yātāś ca saṅgamam
verses.translation: This eulogy emphasizes the identity of Siva and Vitfiu.
verses.hindi: तुमने थोड़े समयके लिये राज्य पाकर ऐसा पापकर्म क्यों किया? राज्यके लोभसे, मोहवश, अन्यायपूर्ण वृत्तियोको अपनाकर तुमने जिन पापोंका संग्रह किया है, उनके यथार्थ फलका उपभोग करो। अरे! जिनके
verses.wordMeaning: This eulogy emphasizes the identity of Siva and Vitfiu.
verses.commentary: Sense: This eulogy emphasizes the identity of Siva and Vitfiu.

verses.sanskrit: कथं च मोक्षणं शापाद् विदितं कुरु साम्प्रतम् । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: शृणु राजन् यथा न्यायं कथयामि तवा ऽनघ
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ śāpād viditaṃ kuru sāmpratam / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu rājan yathā nyāyaṃ kathayāmi tavā 'nagha
verses.translation: O Lord, the earth was sportingly covered with (one) foot (by you). O Lord, Bali was bound by you. Indra was re- instated in his position by you,
verses.hindi: लिये तुमने अशुभ कर्म किये हैं, वह राज्य और
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord, the earth was sportingly covered with (one) foot (by you). O Lord, Bali was bound by you. Indra was re- instated in his position by you,
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord, the earth was sportingly covered with (one) foot (by you). O Lord, Bali was bound by you. Indra was re- instated in his position by you,

verses.sanskrit: मधूत्सवं शिवस्याग्रे विहायेन्द्रोत्सवं गताः । उर्वशी च तथा रम्भा अहल्या च तिलोत्तमा
verses.transliteration: madhūtsavaṃ śivasyāgre vihāyendrotsavaṃ gatāḥ / urvaśī ca tathā rambhā ahalyā ca tilottamā
verses.translation: O Lord, you are the Yugas like Kali, Dvapara, Treta and Krta. You are the suppressor of p ralamba. You are the creator. You are the destroyer. You support the worlds. You are Kala, the destroyer of all. All the clans of Devas were created by you alone, O God. You are the path of all the worlds. You are salvation, the greatest goal. Brahma, the eternal one of the Rajas form is the Lord born from you. Rudra originating from (your) Krodha (Anger) is also so (born from you). You are established in Sattva. O Lord, the mobile and immobile beings have been created by you for the sake of sport."
verses.hindi: वे स्त्रियाँ अब कहाँ हैं? वह सब कुछ छोड़कर तुम अकेले यहाँ आये हो। जिनके लिये तुमने प्रजाको सताया और नष्ट किया है, वे तुम्हारे भाई-बन्धु अब तुम्हारी यह यातना नहीं देख पा रहे हैं। इस
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord, you are the Yugas like Kali, Dvapara, Treta and Krta. You are the suppressor of p ralamba. You are the creator. You are the destroyer. You support the worlds. You are Kala, the destroyer of all. All the clans of Devas were created by you alone, O God.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord, you are the Yugas like Kali, Dvapara, Treta and Krta. You are the suppressor of p ralamba. You are the creator. You are the destroyer. You support the worlds. You are Kala, the destroyer of all. All the clans of Devas were created by you alone, O God.…

verses.sanskrit: घृताची मेनका चैव चित्ररेखा च शालिनी । एताश् चाप्सरसो बह्व्यः सर्वा वै देव निर्मिताः
verses.transliteration: ghṛtācī menakā caiva citrarekhā ca śālinī / etāś cāpsaraso bahvyaḥ sarvā vai deva nirmitāḥ
verses.translation: O king, the Lord of all living beings was thus eulo- gized by me with great devotion. Even as I was eulogizing the Lord, I saw there pots filled with water.
verses.hindi: समय यमदूत जब तुम्हे ऊँचेसे नीचे गिराते हैं, तब उन कर्मोंका कैसा मजा मिल रहा है।'  युधिष्ठिर! इस प्रकार चित्रगुप्तके अनेक तरहके
verses.wordMeaning: O king, the Lord of all living beings was thus eulo- gized by me with great devotion. Even as I was eulogizing the Lord, I saw there pots filled with water.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, the Lord of all living beings was thus eulo- gized by me with great devotion. Even as I was eulogizing the Lord, I saw there pots filled with water.

verses.sanskrit: वसन्ते ता विशन्ति स्म शक्रलोकं सुरैः सह । मदिरानन्दपानेन मोहिताः कामपीडिताः
verses.transliteration: vasante tā viśanti sma śakralokaṃ suraiḥ saha / madirānandapānena mohitāḥ kāmapīḍitāḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon the thirst that had been forgotten by me became increased. I approached the side of that Ptirusa.
verses.hindi: कठोर वचनोंद्वारा उपालम्भ देनेपर वे राजालोग
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon the thirst that had been forgotten by me became increased. I approached the side of that Ptirusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon the thirst that had been forgotten by me became increased. I approached the side of that Ptirusa.

verses.sanskrit: समतीते वसन्ते तु उमामाहेश्वरं पुरम् । कैलासनिलयं देवं समाराधयितुं गताः
verses.transliteration: samatīte vasante tu umāmāheśvaraṃ puram / kailāsanilayaṃ devaṃ samārādhayituṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: I thought thus when I was desirous of drinking water: 'He never saw me. He was asleep. He never woke up. He who is deluded by sin and tries to wake up a sleeping person incurs the great sin of Brahmana's slaughter.'
verses.hindi: नरकोंकी आगमें तपाओ और इन्हें पापोंसे शुद्ध करो।' तब वे दूत शीघ्र उठकर उन राजाओंके पाँव पकड़ लेते हैं और वेगपूर्वक घुमाते हुए उन्हें खूब तपी हुई भूमिपर फेंक देते हैं और लोहेके
verses.wordMeaning: I thought thus when I was desirous of drinking water: 'He never saw me. He was asleep. He never woke up. He who is deluded by sin and tries to wake up a sleeping person incurs the great sin of Brahmana's slaughter.'
verses.commentary: Sense: I thought thus when I was desirous of drinking water: 'He never saw me. He was asleep. He never woke up. He who is deluded by sin and tries to wake up a sleeping person incurs the great sin of Brahmana's slaughter.'

verses.sanskrit: शापस्य भयभीतास् ता देवेदेवस्य सुव्रताः । साष्टाङ्गं प्रणिपत्याथ मन्त्रगीतेन तुष्टुवुः
verses.transliteration: śāpasya bhayabhītās tā devedevasya suvratāḥ / sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatyātha mantragītena tuṣṭuvuḥ
verses.translation: Even as this was being thought by me, a second being came there. He did not utter anything. He did not see anyone. He had worn an antelope skin on his left shoulder. He had matted hairs. He held a Kamandalu (waterpot) and a staff. A girdle encircled him. He was three-eyed. He had smeared ash all over (be body. He was of great lustre.
verses.hindi: वृक्षोंपर भी पटक देते हैं। उन प्रहारोंसे जर्जर होकर वे राजा अचेत और निश्चेष्ट हो जाते हैं। फिर वायुका स्पर्श होनेपर वे धीरे-धीरे सचेत होते हैं। तब SS पापसे शुद्ध करनेके लिये यमदूत
verses.wordMeaning: Even as this was being thought by me, a second being came there. He did not utter anything. He did not see anyone. He had worn an antelope skin on his left shoulder. He had matted hairs. He held a Kamandalu (waterpot) and a staff. A girdle encircled him. He was three-eyed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as this was being thought by me, a second being came there. He did not utter anything. He did not see anyone. He had worn an antelope skin on his left shoulder. He had matted hairs. He held a Kamandalu (waterpot) and a staff. A girdle encircled him. He was three-eyed.…

verses.sanskrit: ताश् चैवाप्सरसो गौरी ज्ञात्वा तत्र पराङ्मुखी । गौर्याः परमचित्तज्ञाः सर्वाभरणभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: tāś caivāpsaraso gaurī jñātvā tatra parāṅmukhī / gauryāḥ paramacittajñāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: Evfcn as I was desirous of eulogizing him and gazed
verses.hindi: नरकके समुद्रमें डाल देते हैं। नरकोंकी अट्टाईस श्रेणियाँ हैं, जो सातवें पातालके अन्तमें घोर अन्धकारके भीतर स्थित हैं। (१) अतिघोरा, (२)
verses.wordMeaning: Evfcn as I was desirous of eulogizing him and gazed
verses.commentary: Sense: Evfcn as I was desirous of eulogizing him and gazed

verses.sanskrit: अनङ्गकुसुमा चान्या रूपयौवनशालिनी । धनपाली तथा चान्या व्योमरेखा तथापरा
verses.transliteration: anaṅgakusumā cānyā rūpayauvanaśālinī / dhanapālī tathā cānyā vyomarekhā tathāparā
verses.translation: Be victorious, O goddess originating from the limbs of Rudra. Be victorious, O eternal Brahmi. Be victorious, O Kaumari, O Mahendrl, O Vaisnavi, O Varum, be victorious, O Kauberl, O Savitrl; be victorious, O Dhsitri of excellent coun- tenance. In this world consisting of mobile and immobile beings protect my body that has become scorched with thirst."
verses.wordMeaning: Be victorious, O goddess originating from the limbs of Rudra. Be victorious, O eternal Brahmi. Be victorious, O Kaumari, O Mahendrl, O Vaisnavi, O Varum, be victorious, O Kauberl, O Savitrl; be victorious, O Dhsitri of excellent coun- tenance.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, O goddess originating from the limbs of Rudra. Be victorious, O eternal Brahmi. Be victorious, O Kaumari, O Mahendrl, O Vaisnavi, O Varum, be victorious, O Kauberl, O Savitrl; be victorious, O Dhsitri of excellent coun- tenance.…

verses.sanskrit: चामरग्राहिणी चान्या गान्धर्वी च तथा ऽपरा । हेमदण्डा प्रतीहारा ऊचुरप्सरसः प्रति
verses.transliteration: cāmaragrāhiṇī cānyā gāndharvī ca tathā 'parā / hemadaṇḍā pratīhārā ūcurapsarasaḥ prati
verses.translation: O tiger among Brahmanas, I am delighted by your splendid speech. O excellent Brahmana, what is in your mind has been understood by me.
verses.wordMeaning: O tiger among Brahmanas, I am delighted by your splendid speech. O excellent Brahmana, what is in your mind has been understood by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O tiger among Brahmanas, I am delighted by your splendid speech. O excellent Brahmana, what is in your mind has been understood by me.

verses.sanskrit: उमामाहेश्वरं नाम भवत्यो न समागताः । अपराधो ऽयम् एवाद्य भवतीनां सुदुःसहः
verses.transliteration: umāmāheśvaraṃ nāma bhavatyo na samāgatāḥ / aparādho 'yam evādya bhavatīnāṃ suduḥsahaḥ
verses.translation: Listen, O Brahmana, I too have adopted this severe vow. Due to the levity common to all women, an austere vow has been adopted by me who am deficient in intellect.
verses.hindi: अष्टभौमा और (२८) दीर्घमाया-ये ही नरकोंकी अट्टाईस कोटियाँ हैं। इन सबके क्रमशः पाँच- पाँच नायक होते हैं। इनमें पहला रौरव है, क्योंकि उसमें पड़े हुए प्राणी रोते रहते हैं। दूसरा महारौरव
verses.wordMeaning: Listen, O Brahmana, I too have adopted this severe vow. Due to the levity common to all women, an austere vow has been adopted by me who am deficient in intellect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O Brahmana, I too have adopted this severe vow. Due to the levity common to all women, an austere vow has been adopted by me who am deficient in intellect.

verses.sanskrit: अनेनैवापराधेन अजा मर्त्ये भविष्यथ । दिव्यं वर्षशतं साग्रम् एवं भवत दुःखिताः
verses.transliteration: anenaivāparādhena ajā martye bhaviṣyatha / divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ sāgram evaṃ bhavata duḥkhitāḥ
verses.translation: If a righteous son well-known all over the world is to be born to me, I will first breast-feed a Brahmana and then alone my son. O great sage, such a son has been born to me. O eminent Brahmana, if you wish to be alive suck the breasts.
verses.hindi: है, जिसकी दुःसह पीड़ाओंसे महान् साहसी भी रो देते हैं। तीसरा तम, चौथा शीत और पाँचवाँ उष्ण है-इस प्रकार पहली कोटिके ये पाँच नायक माने गये हैं। दूसरी कोटिके १ अघोर, २ तीक्ष्ण,
verses.wordMeaning: If a righteous son well-known all over the world is to be born to me, I will first breast-feed a Brahmana and then alone my son. O great sage, such a son has been born to me. O eminent Brahmana, if you wish to be alive suck the breasts.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a righteous son well-known all over the world is to be born to me, I will first breast-feed a Brahmana and then alone my son. O great sage, such a son has been born to me. O eminent Brahmana, if you wish to be alive suck the breasts.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरस ऊचुः: शापान्तं नो वरारोहे दातुमर्हसि पार्वति । इति तासां वचः श्रुत्वा देवी वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: apsarasa ūcuḥ: śāpāntaṃ no varārohe dātumarhasi pārvati / iti tāsāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā devī vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: In the case of Brahmanas this (namely sucking the breasts) is something not to be done. 1 Again a boy has to be invested with a sacred thread. Otherwise the Vrata cannot be fulfilled. O lotus-eyed one, Brahmana-hood is difficult to ob- tain in all the three worlds. Listen now how one becomes a Brahmana and by means of which Samskaras (consecratory rites). First there is the rite of BIjavapana ('sowing of the seed*) in women through sacred rites. It is called BIjak$epa too since the seed is thrown (sown).
verses.hindi: हैं। तीसरी कोटिके नायक हैं-१ महामाय,
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of Brahmanas this (namely sucking the breasts) is something not to be done. 1 Again a boy has to be invested with a sacred thread. Otherwise the Vrata cannot be fulfilled. O lotus-eyed one, Brahmana-hood is difficult to ob- tain in all the three worlds.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of Brahmanas this (namely sucking the breasts) is something not to be done. 1 Again a boy has to be invested with a sacred thread. Otherwise the Vrata cannot be fulfilled. O lotus-eyed one, Brahmana-hood is difficult to ob- tain in all the three worlds.…

verses.sanskrit: शाण्डिल्याकल्पगायोगे नर्मदादक्षिणे तटे । तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति शाण्डिल्येश्वरपूजनात्
verses.transliteration: śāṇḍilyākalpagāyoge narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe / tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti śāṇḍilyeśvarapūjanāt
verses.translation: O lady of high esteem, at the end thereof the sec- ond one, Garbhadhana (impregnation), takes place. Pumsavana rite is the third. Slmanta is the fourth one. The fifth one is
verses.hindi: चौथी कोरिके नायक १ वाम, २ कराल, ३ किंकराल, ४ प्रकम्पन और ५ महाचक्र हैं । पाँचवी कोटिके नायक १ सुपद्म, २ कालसूत्र, रे प्रगर्जन, ४ सूचीमुख और ५ सुनेमि हैं। छठी कोटिके नायक १ खादक,
verses.wordMeaning: O lady of high esteem, at the end thereof the sec- ond one, Garbhadhana (impregnation), takes place. Pumsavana rite is the third. Slmanta is the fourth one. The fifth one is
verses.commentary: Sense: O lady of high esteem, at the end thereof the sec- ond one, Garbhadhana (impregnation), takes place. Pumsavana rite is the third. Slmanta is the fourth one. The fifth one is

verses.sanskrit: गौरीतीर्थं तु तत्रैव ज्ञातुं योग्यं हि कल्पगाम् । उत्तीर्णा तेन मार्गेण लग्ना स्कन्दस्य पृष्ठतः
verses.transliteration: gaurītīrthaṃ tu tatraiva jñātuṃ yogyaṃ hi kalpagām / uttīrṇā tena mārgeṇa lagnā skandasya pṛṣṭhataḥ
verses.translation: After realizing this, O highly esteemed lady, it does not behove you to compel me to drink breast-milk. O gentle lady, how can one like me drink breast-milk?
verses.hindi: ५ क्रकच हैं। सातवीं कोटिके नायक १ सुदारुण,
verses.wordMeaning: After realizing this, O highly esteemed lady, it does not behove you to compel me to drink breast-milk. O gentle lady, how can one like me drink breast-milk?
verses.commentary: Sense: After realizing this, O highly esteemed lady, it does not behove you to compel me to drink breast-milk. O gentle lady, how can one like me drink breast-milk?

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा शिवं नत्वा कैलासं चा गमिष्यथ । शापभ्रष्टास् तु तास् सर्वाः क्ष्मां गत्वा अतिदुःखिताः
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā śivaṃ natvā kailāsaṃ cā gamiṣyatha / śāpabhraṣṭās tu tās sarvāḥ kṣmāṃ gatvā atiduḥkhitāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of mine, the lady spoke these words: "If \ou do not drink the breast-milk, the boy will die. It is heard in the three worlds, in the Vedas and in the Smrtis that one is rid of all sins but cannot be rid of the sin of infanticide. The sin of killing will be incurred by you. Even a great devotee of the Lord has to suffer the consequences of infanticide in a hundred births. On death he incurs the state of a dog extending to three hundred years. At the close thereof he is born in the womb of a crow. There too he suffers the consequences of the sinful act during eight hundred births. He becomes a pig during ten births, at the close of which he is born as a worm. Then he has a gradual rise in the births of cow, elephant, horse and human being. Thus it is heard in Gratis, Sastras and the Vedas. O scorcher of enemies, O excellent Brahmana, the killing of a child brings about a sin more heinous than all other-sins. A Brahmana committing the slaughter of a boy, is certainly cooked in Naraka. He undergoes torture at
verses.hindi: ५ सुतीक्ष्ण हैं। आठवीं कोटिके १ शुण्ड, २ शकुनि,
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words of mine, the lady spoke these words: "If \ou do not drink the breast-milk, the boy will die. It is heard in the three worlds, in the Vedas and in the Smrtis that one is rid of all sins but cannot be rid of the sin of infanticide.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of mine, the lady spoke these words: "If \ou do not drink the breast-milk, the boy will die. It is heard in the three worlds, in the Vedas and in the Smrtis that one is rid of all sins but cannot be rid of the sin of infanticide.…

verses.sanskrit: शापावसाने सम्प्राप्ते कल्पगातीरमाश्रिताः । तत्र स्नात्वा तु शाण्डिल्यं पूजयित्वा विधानत
verses.transliteration: śāpāvasāne samprāpte kalpagātīramāśritāḥ / tatra snātvā tu śāṇḍilyaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānata
verses.translation: On hearing those words I became ready to drink the milk from the breasts. I was never satisfied in the course of drinking the excellent breast-milk. O descendant of Bharata, thirty-three thousand years thus elapsed. Deluded by the deceptive slumber for a long time I woke up in the lap.
