After the delusion of sleep had vanished, O son of Pandu, I looked around and could not see the sleeping being or the boy. O descendant of Bharata, I saw those four waterpots. Nor was that goddess to be seen. All of them had gone somewhere.
verses.hindi: पाँच नायक हैं । नवीं कोटिके नायक १ पंकलेप, २ पूतिमान्, ३ हृद, ४ त्रपु और ५ उच्छ्वास हैं। दसवीं कोटिके नायक १ निरुच्छ्वास, २ सुदीर्घ, ३ क्रूर, ४ शाल्मलि और ५ उष्ट्रित हैं। ग्यारहवीं
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing those words I became ready to drink the milk from the breasts. I was never satisfied in the course of drinking the excellent breast-milk. O descendant of Bharata, thirty-three thousand years thus elapsed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words I became ready to drink the milk from the breasts. I was never satisfied in the course of drinking the excellent breast-milk. O descendant of Bharata, thirty-three thousand years thus elapsed.…

verses.sanskrit: अजारूपधरास् सर्वास् तस्मिन्नप्सरसः क्षणात् । दिव्ययानसमारूढास् सर्वालंकारभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: ajārūpadharās sarvās tasminnapsarasaḥ kṣaṇāt / divyayānasamārūḍhās sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: While I was reflecting thus and standing there pondering over everything, the goddess spoke these words with slight laughter.
verses.hindi: कोटिके नायक १ महानाद, २ प्रबाह, ३ सुप्रवाहन, ४ वृषाश्रय तथा ५ वृषश्व हैं। बारहवीं कोटिके
verses.wordMeaning: While I was reflecting thus and standing there pondering over everything, the goddess spoke these words with slight laughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: While I was reflecting thus and standing there pondering over everything, the goddess spoke these words with slight laughter.

verses.sanskrit: गौरीतीर्थं तथैवापुर् यथापूर्वं तथैव तु । अजातीर्थम् इति ख्यातं देवश्चाजेश्वरस् तथा
verses.transliteration: gaurītīrthaṃ tathaivāpur yathāpūrvaṃ tathaiva tu / ajātīrtham iti khyātaṃ devaścājeśvaras tathā
verses.translation: That sleeping person was Krsna. The second being that came was Hara. The four pitchers were the oceans, O excellent Brahmana. The boy seen by you was Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds. I should be known as Prthivi con- sisting of the seven continents and mountains. Here, O Brahmana, you see the excellent river Narmada who left you On the ground where she is well-established. She of auspicious features flows for the good of all living beings. She is well-known as River Reva. Hence Narmada has not become defunct. After realizing this be calm and normal, O great sage.
verses.hindi: और ५ सूकरानन-ये पाँच नायक हैं। तेरहवीं कोटिके नायक १ अजानन, २ महिषानन, ३ मेषानन, ४ मूषकानन तथा ५ खरानन हैं । चौदहवीं कोटिके
verses.wordMeaning: That sleeping person was Krsna. The second being that came was Hara. The four pitchers were the oceans, O excellent Brahmana. The boy seen by you was Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds. I should be known as Prthivi con- sisting of the seven continents and mountains. Here,…
verses.commentary: Sense: That sleeping person was Krsna. The second being that came was Hara. The four pitchers were the oceans, O excellent Brahmana. The boy seen by you was Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds. I should be known as Prthivi con- sisting of the seven continents and mountains. Here,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापहरं चैव लिङ्गमाप्सरसं तथा । तत्र स्नात्वा व्यतीपाते नारी वा यदि वा नरः
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpaharaṃ caiva liṅgamāpsarasaṃ tathā / tatra snātvā vyatīpāte nārī vā yadi vā naraḥ
verses.translation: It is thus that the Lord stationed in Sattva used to lie always during Pralaya — the great Lord in the form of Sattva on whose support the universe is sustained.
verses.hindi: और ५ भयानक--ये पाँच नायक हैं। पंद्रहवीं कोटिके नायक १ सर्वभक्ष, २ स्वभक्ष, ३ सर्वकर्मा, ४ अश्व तथा ५ वायस हैं। सोलहवीं कोटिके
verses.wordMeaning: It is thus that the Lord stationed in Sattva used to lie always during Pralaya — the great Lord in the form of Sattva on whose support the universe is sustained.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is thus that the Lord stationed in Sattva used to lie always during Pralaya — the great Lord in the form of Sattva on whose support the universe is sustained.

verses.sanskrit: अवशः स्ववशो वा ऽपि प्राणत्यागं करोति यः । दशवर्षसहस्राणि राजा विद्याधरे पुरे
verses.transliteration: avaśaḥ svavaśo vā 'pi prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ / daśavarṣasahasrāṇi rājā vidyādhare pure
verses.translation: Thus the great and excellent miracle was seen and experienced by me. It is meritorious and destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: और ५ कच्छुर हैं। सत्रहवीं कोटिके १ गण्डक,
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great and excellent miracle was seen and experienced by me. It is meritorious and destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great and excellent miracle was seen and experienced by me. It is meritorious and destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: कनकेश्वरमन्यत् तु कनकामोक्षदं शुभम् । ज्वरेश्वरं तत्र लिङ्गं ज्वरो यत्र न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: kanakeśvaramanyat tu kanakāmokṣadaṃ śubham / jvareśvaraṃ tatra liṅgaṃ jvaro yatra na vidyate
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: कणधूम्र-ये पाँच नायक हैं । अठारहवीं कोटिके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: ज्वरिता ऋषयो यत्र बभूवुर् ज्वरवर्जिताः । पञ्चब्रह्मेश्वरं नाम लिङ्गं पापविमोचनम्
verses.transliteration: jvaritā ṛṣayo yatra babhūvur jvaravarjitāḥ / pañcabrahmeśvaraṃ nāma liṅgaṃ pāpavimocanam
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: ४ आतोद्य और ५ प्रतोद्य हैं। उन्नीसवीं कोटिके नायक १ रुधिरोद्य, २ भोजन, ३ कालात्मग, ४ अनुभक्ष और ५ सर्वभक्ष हैं। बीसवीं कोटिके १ सुदारुण, २ कर्कट, ३ विशाल, ४ विकट और
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: असुरो मलकेतुश् च शक्रस्यैव भयेन तु । पञ्चब्रह्मात्मकैर् मन्त्रैः स्थण्डिलस्थं तु शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: asuro malaketuś ca śakrasyaiva bhayena tu / pañcabrahmātmakair mantraiḥ sthaṇḍilasthaṃ tu śaṅkaram
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: ५ कटपूतन-ये पाँच नायक हैं। इककीसवीं कोटिके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: नानाविधैः पुष्पधूपैः सम्पूज्य स्वपुरं ययौ । अपराह्णे ऽथ संस्मार स पापो लिङ्गमैशकम्
verses.transliteration: nānāvidhaiḥ puṣpadhūpaiḥ sampūjya svapuraṃ yayau / aparāhṇe 'tha saṃsmāra sa pāpo liṅgamaiśakam
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: वैतरणी, ४ सुतप्त तथा ५ लोहशंकु हैं। बाईसवीं कोटिके नायक १ एकपाद, २ अश्रुपूरण, ३ घोर
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कृत्वा ऽथ निर्माल्यं यावद् उद्धर्तुम् इच्छति । तावत् तत् स्थाणुभूतं वै लिङ्गं दृष्ट्वा महासुरः
verses.transliteration: namaskṛtvā 'tha nirmālyaṃ yāvad uddhartum icchati / tāvat tat sthāṇubhūtaṃ vai liṅgaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāsuraḥ
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: तिलयन्त्र हैं। तेईसवीं कोटिके १ अतसीयन्त्र, २ इक्षुयन्त्र, ३ कूट, ४ पाप तथा ५ प्रमर्दन-ये पाँच नायक हैं। चौबीसवीं कोटिके नायक १ महाचुल्ली,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: विषसादमहाबाहुः किम् एतद् इति विस्मितः । आकाशवाचाचोक्तं वै विषादं त्यजपुत्रक
verses.transliteration: viṣasādamahābāhuḥ kim etad iti vismitaḥ / ākāśavācācoktaṃ vai viṣādaṃ tyajaputraka
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: पर्वत तथा ५ मय हैं। पचीसवीं कोटिके नायक
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चब्रह्मेश्वरं नाम लिङ्गम् एतत् महासुर । आकाशवचनं श्रुत्वा नमस्कृत्य दिवं ययौ
verses.transliteration: pañcabrahmeśvaraṃ nāma liṅgam etat mahāsura / ākāśavacanaṃ śrutvā namaskṛtya divaṃ yayau
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: ४ अन्धकूप और ५ पतन हें । छब्बीसवीं कोटिके १ पातन, २ मुसली, ३ वृषली, ४ अशिवा तथा ५ संकटला--ये पाँच नायक हें । सत्ताईसवीं कोटिके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चब्रह्मेश्वरं लिङ्गं लिङ्गं पुष्पेश्वरं तथा । तृतीयं तु तथा विद्धि लिङ्गं वै स्थण्डिलेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: pañcabrahmeśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ liṅgaṃ puṣpeśvaraṃ tathā / tṛtīyaṃ tu tathā viddhi liṅgaṃ vai sthaṇḍileśvaram
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: ४ सम्मोहन तथा ५ अस्थिभंग हैं। अट्टाईसवीं कोटिके नायक १ तप्ताचलमय, २ अगुण, ३ बहुदुःख, ४ महादुःख तथा ५ कश्मल हैं। इनके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: नित्ये नैमित्तिके कार्ये ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्ययोः । श्रद्धया सङ्गमे स्नात्वा लिङ्गत्रितयपूजनात्
verses.transliteration: nitye naimittike kārye grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ / śraddhayā saṅgame snātvā liṅgatritayapūjanāt
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: एकपाद, त्रिपाद और तीव्र आदि नरक हैं। इस प्रकार यहाँ नरकोंके अट्टाईस पंचक बताये गये हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन्ति पितरः स्वर्गं हविर्दानादिभिर् यथा । मन्वन्तरशतं यावन् मोदते ब्रह्मणः पुरे
verses.transliteration: gacchanti pitaraḥ svargaṃ havirdānādibhir yathā / manvantaraśataṃ yāvan modate brahmaṇaḥ pure
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: पापियोंकी नरक-यातनाका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदायाप्यभागे तु गोप्यलिङ्गं व्यवस्थितम् । ब्रह्महत्यादिकं पापं सप्तरात्रेण नश्यति
verses.transliteration: narmadāyāpyabhāge tu gopyaliṅgaṃ vyavasthitam / brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ saptarātreṇa naśyati
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं-युधिष्ठिर! मनुष्य अपने कर्मोके अनुसार क्रमशः एक-एक नरकका उपभोग करते हैं। अपनी कुत्सित कामनाओंके कारण जो कुकर्मोका संग्रह किया गया है, उसीके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: त्वष्टा पूषेति विख्यातौ बलिनौ ब्रह्मराक्षसौ । वज्रेण स्वेन शक्रेण हतौ तौ सिन्धुचारिणौ
verses.transliteration: tvaṣṭā pūṣeti vikhyātau balinau brahmarākṣasau / vajreṇa svena śakreṇa hatau tau sindhucāriṇau
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: फलस्वरूप तपायी हुई लोहेकी साँकलसे बाँधकर अँधेरेमें बड़े-बड़े वृक्षोंकी शाखाओंमें पापी मनुष्य लटका दिये जाते हैं। फिर यमदूत उन सबको बड़े जोर-जोरसे झुलाते हैं । वेगपूर्वक झुलाये हुए
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: बुद्ध्वा ब्रह्मादिभिर्देवैर् ब्रह्महा त्वेष वासवः । इन्द्राण्या चैव संत्यक्तः सर्वैः सुरगणैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: buddhvā brahmādibhirdevair brahmahā tveṣa vāsavaḥ / indrāṇyā caiva saṃtyaktaḥ sarvaiḥ suragaṇais tathā
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: वे सभी पापी अचेत हो जाते हैं। फिर आकाशमें लटकते हुए उनके पैरोंमें सौ भार लोहा बाँध देते हैं। उस महान् भारसे वे सब लोग अत्यन्त सन्तप्त होते हैं और अपने-अपने कर्मौंका स्मरण करते
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्या समायुक्तः सम्प्राप्तो वै हिमालयम् । चन्द्रहीना यथा रात्रिर् अनादित्यं यथा नभः
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyā samāyuktaḥ samprāpto vai himālayam / candrahīnā yathā rātrir anādityaṃ yathā nabhaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: हुए निश्चल भावसे मौन रह जाते हैं । तत्पश्चात् क्रमश: आगमें तपाकर खूब लाल किये हुए लोहेके कँटीले दण्डोंसे यमदूत उनके मस्तकपर मारते हैं। इसके बाद उन्हें विष्ठा और कीटोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: इयमाभाति वै तद्वच् छक्रहीना ऽमरावती । ततो देवगणैः सर्वैः प्रेषितो हव्यवाहनः
verses.transliteration: iyamābhāti vai tadvac chakrahīnā 'marāvatī / tato devagaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ preṣito havyavāhanaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: भरे हुए कुएँमें डाल देते हैं। घोर यमदूत सब ओरसे घेरकर पापियोंको आगमें पकाते हैं। उसके बाद उनके शरीरपर नमकीन पानी डाल देते हैं। कितने ही पापियोंको लोहेके कड़ाहेमें बैंगनकी
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: शक्रस्यान्वेषणार्थाय कृशानो गम्यतां त्वया । जले दृष्ट्वा निवर्त्या ऽथ देवतास् संन्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: śakrasyānveṣaṇārthāya kṛśāno gamyatāṃ tvayā / jale dṛṣṭvā nivartyā 'tha devatās saṃnyavedayat
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: तरह भूनते हैं, फिर गंदे कूएँमें डाल देते हैं। मेदा, रक्त और पीबसे भरी हुई बावलीमें भी पापियोंको फेंक दिया जाता है और वहाँ उन्हें कीड़े तथा कौए लोहेके समान तीखी चोंचोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: ततस् संप्रेषितो देवैः सर्वव्यापी प्रभञ्जनः । स तं प्रवेशयामास प्रोवाच त्रिदशेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tatas saṃpreṣito devaiḥ sarvavyāpī prabhañjanaḥ / sa taṃ praveśayāmāsa provāca tridaśeśvaram
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: नोच-नोचकर खाते हैं। कितने ही पापी मनुष्योंको तीखे त्रिशूलोंमें गुम्फित करके उन्हें धधकते हुए अंगारोपर मांसकी भाँति पकाया जाता है। इसी प्रकार यमदूत पापियोंको खूब तपे हुए तेलसे भरे
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: देवानां शासनाद् एव समागच्छं च त्वत्कृते । तमानीय पुरं दिव्यं ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरस्मराः
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ śāsanād eva samāgacchaṃ ca tvatkṛte / tamānīya puraṃ divyaṃ brahmaviṣṇupurasmarāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: कड़ाहोंमें अनेक बार पकाते हैं। जो असत्य और अप्रिय बोलनेवाले हैं, उनकी छातीपर चढ़कर और पाँवसे दबाकर तपाये हुए मजबूत सँड्सेसे उनकी जीभ उखाड़ ली जाती है। दम्भपूर्ण झूठे
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवगणाः सर्वे शक्रेण सहिता गताः । ईशानो भगवान् यत्र कैलासे पर्वतोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: tato devagaṇāḥ sarve śakreṇa sahitā gatāḥ / īśāno bhagavān yatra kailāse parvatottame
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: शास्त्रसे प्रेरित होकर जो ब्राह्मण यज्ञके नामपर अधिक धनका संग्रह करता है, उसकी जिह्वा भी तीखे भालेसे छेदी जाती है। जो मूढ़ मानव माता-पिता और गुरुको फटकारते हैं, उनके मुँहमें
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कृत्य महादेवं सुरासुरनमस्कृतम् । प्रविष्टांस् तु यथान्यायं पप्रच्छ भगवान् हरः
verses.transliteration: namaskṛtya mahādevaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam / praviṣṭāṃs tu yathānyāyaṃ papraccha bhagavān haraḥ
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: बार-बार बालू भरकर पानीसे सींचा जाता है। तदनन्तर खारा और गरम जल भरा जाता है। फिर खौलते हुए तेलको उडेल दिया जाता है। यमदूत उन पापियोंके पैर पकड़कर कीड़ोंसे भरी
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: किमागमनकार्यं वः कुतो वो भयमागतम् । देवा ऊचुः: एष त्वां प्रति संप्रष्टुं देवराजः शतक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: kimāgamanakāryaṃ vaḥ kuto vo bhayamāgatam / devā ūcuḥ: eṣa tvāṃ prati saṃpraṣṭuṃ devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: हुई विष्ठापर घसीटते हैं। फिर सींगसे दबाकर उन्हें लोहेके शाल्मलि वृक्षमें बाँध दिया जाता है। उसके बाद वे महाबली भयानक दूत उन्हें पीछेकी ओरसे मारते हैं। अत्यन्त प्रबल दाँतीदार आरेसे
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षणं ब्रह्महत्यायाः स्याद् यथा वै तथा कुरु । ईश्वर उवाच: वाराणस्यां क्रतुं चेष्ट्वा हयमेधं यथा विधि
verses.transliteration: mokṣaṇaṃ brahmahatyāyāḥ syād yathā vai tathā kuru / īśvara uvāca: vārāṇasyāṃ kratuṃ ceṣṭvā hayamedhaṃ yathā vidhi
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: मस्तककी ओरसे चीरते हैं। अपने भयानक कर्मोके परिणामसे वे पापी जीव भूख लगनेपर अपना ही
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थयात्राक्रमेणैव ब्रह्महत्या प्रणश्यति । नमस्कृत्य ततो देवं सुराः काशीपुरं ययुः
verses.transliteration: tīrthayātrākrameṇaiva brahmahatyā praṇaśyati / namaskṛtya tato devaṃ surāḥ kāśīpuraṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: पीते हैं। जिन मूढ़ पुरुषोंने कभी अन्न और जलका दान नहीं किया है और न किसीके दानका अनुमोदन ही किया है, वे मुद्गरोंसे जर्जर करके ईखकी तरह पेरे जाते हैं। घोर
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञोपस्करमादाय तत्र चेष्टो मखोत्तमः । पौष्करं नैमिषारण्यं कुरुक्षेत्रं तथा पुनः
verses.transliteration: yajñopaskaramādāya tatra ceṣṭo makhottamaḥ / pauṣkaraṃ naimiṣāraṇyaṃ kurukṣetraṃ tathā punaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: असिताल वनमें खण्ड-खण्ड करके काटे जाते हैं। उनके सब अंगोंमें सूई चुभोयी जाती है। तत्पश्चात् उन्हें शूलीपर चढ़ा दिया जाता है। शूलीपर चढ़ाकर उन्हें बार-बार हिलाया और
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: केदारं भैरवं तीर्थं गङ्गासागरसङ्गमम् । ओघतीर्थं प्रयागं च प्रभासं शशिभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: kedāraṃ bhairavaṃ tīrthaṃ gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgamam / oghatīrthaṃ prayāgaṃ ca prabhāsaṃ śaśibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: जाता है  फिर भी उनकी मृत्यु नहीं होती ।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: बभ्रमुः सर्वतीर्थानि पृथिव्यां यानि कानि च । कृष्णमस्य शरीरार्द्धमर्द्धं गौरं निरीक्ष्य च
verses.transliteration: babhramuḥ sarvatīrthāni pṛthivyāṃ yāni kāni ca / kṛṣṇamasya śarīrārddhamarddhaṃ gauraṃ nirīkṣya ca
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: उनके शरीरसे मांस नोच लिया जाता है। लोहेके मुद्गरोंसे मारकर उनकी हड्डियाँ चूर-चूर कर दी जाती हैं। बलोन्मत्त यमदूत उस दशामें भी उन्हें अनेक बार जल्दी-जल्दी घसीटते हैं और वे
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: विस्मयं परमं जग्मुः सर्वे देवगणास् तथा । वाराणसीं पुरीं गत्वा सुरा विज्ञापयन्ति तम्
verses.transliteration: vismayaṃ paramaṃ jagmuḥ sarve devagaṇās tathā / vārāṇasīṃ purīṃ gatvā surā vijñāpayanti tam
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: पापी जीव दीर्घकालतक नरकमें रहकर दारुण 'यातनाएँ भोगते हैं। उनका मुँह बालूसे भरा होता है, इसलिये वे स्वाँसतक नहीं ले पाते। इन सब यातनाओंके बाद अनेक प्रकारके यमदूत रौरव
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षे पुरी ख्याता वाराणस्यसमा तथा । पञ्चक्रोशान्तरे तस्या ब्रह्महत्या न सर्पति
verses.transliteration: antarikṣe purī khyātā vārāṇasyasamā tathā / pañcakrośāntare tasyā brahmahatyā na sarpati
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: आदि नरकोंमें उन्हें पीड़ा देते हैं। महारौरवकी पीड़ाओंसे महान् धीर पुरुष भी रो देते हैं। मुख, लिंग, गुदा पार्श्व, पैर, छाती और मस्तकमें तपाये हुए ches तीखे मुद्गरोंसे यमदूत मारते हैं। जो
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: पुराणे श्रूयते देव देवराज शतक्रतो । यावत् तिष्ठति गङ्गायां वाराणस्यां समागमे
verses.transliteration: purāṇe śrūyate deva devarāja śatakrato / yāvat tiṣṭhati gaṅgāyāṃ vārāṇasyāṃ samāgame
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: स्त्रियाँ पराये पतियोंका आलिंगन करती हैं और अपने पतिकी सेवामें नहीं रहतां, ऐसी स्त्रियोंसे यमदूत कहते हैं-' अरी! अब तू क्यों जल्दीसे भागी जा रही है? स्मरण है या नहीं, तूने अपने
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: न तावद् ब्रह्महत्या तु निर्गमे पुनराविशेत् । काश्युवाच: नाहं समर्था हरणे मुक्त्वा काचित् तु कल्पगाम्
verses.transliteration: na tāvad brahmahatyā tu nirgame punarāviśet / kāśyuvāca: nāhaṃ samarthā haraṇe muktvā kācit tu kalpagām
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: पतिको धोखा दिया था और एक पापान्ध परपुरुषको सुखपूर्वक गलेसे लगाया था?' ऐसा कहकर वे उन्हें लोहकुम्भ नामक नरकमें फेंक देते हैं और धीरे-धीरे पकाते हैं। कभी उन्हें प्रज्वलित अग्निमें
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्या यथा नश्येद् उपदेशं ददामि ते । शाण्डिल्या नर्मदायोगे याम्ये भागे तु नार्मदे
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyā yathā naśyed upadeśaṃ dadāmi te / śāṇḍilyā narmadāyoge yāmye bhāge tu nārmade
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: राते हैं, तप्तशिलाओंपर बिठाते हैं, अंधेरे कुएँमें डालते हैं और अजगर सर्पोद्वारा Sara हैं। जो धर्मका उपदेश देनेवाले महात्मा आचार्यकी निन्दा
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा महाराज त्रीणि लिङ्गानि चार्चयेत् । पञ्चब्रह्मेश्वरं देवं पुष्पेश्वरम् अथापरम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā mahārāja trīṇi liṅgāni cārcayet / pañcabrahmeśvaraṃ devaṃ puṣpeśvaram athāparam
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: करते हैं, शिवभक्त, ब्राह्मण तथा सनातन शिवधर्मपर दोषारोपण करते हैं, उनकी छाती, कण्ठ, जिह्वा, शरीरकी सन्धियों तथा दोनों ओठोंमें काँटी ठोंककर यमदूत उन्हें कील देते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयं तु तथा शक्रलिङ्गं चैव स्थण्डिलेश्वरम् । शिवेन कीर्तितं पूर्वं पार्वत्याः षण्मुखस्य च
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyaṃ tu tathā śakraliṅgaṃ caiva sthaṇḍileśvaram / śivena kīrtitaṃ pūrvaṃ pārvatyāḥ ṣaṇmukhasya ca
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार पापाचारी पुरुषोंको यमलोकमें बड़ी भयानक यातनाएँ दी जाती हैं। एक-एक नरकमें सैकड़ों और सहस्रो प्रकारकी ऐसी यातनाएँ जाननी चाहिए, जो समस्त पापकर्मियोंको
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: काशीपुर्या वचः श्रुत्वा देवदेवः शतक्रतुः । तं देशं समनुप्राप्य सर्वं स्नानादिकं व्यधात्
verses.transliteration: kāśīpuryā vacaḥ śrutvā devadevaḥ śatakratuḥ / taṃ deśaṃ samanuprāpya sarvaṃ snānādikaṃ vyadhāt
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: प्राप्त होती हैं। सम्पूर्ण नरकोंमें ऐसी-एऐसी अनन्त पीड़ाएँ भोगनी पड़ती हैं। अपने-अपने कर्मॉसे नरकोंमें गिराये हुए पापी जीव क्रमशः सभी नरकोंमें पकाये जाते हैं। महापातकी मनुष्य सब
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: तत् क्षणाद् दिव्यदेहश् च सूर्यसंक्रमणं ययौ । शरीरात् तस्य निर्गत्य ब्रह्महत्या ह वासवम्
verses.transliteration: tat kṣaṇād divyadehaś ca sūryasaṃkramaṇaṃ yayau / śarīrāt tasya nirgatya brahmahatyā ha vāsavam
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: नरकोंमें चन्द्रमा और नक्षत्रोंकी स्थितिकालतक अनेकानेक यमदूतोंद्वारा पीड़ा भोगते रहते हैं। यही दशा पातकियोंकी भी होती है। उपपातकियोंको इनसे आधी यातना प्राप्त होती है। तात युधिष्ठिर!
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: अस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्याद् एकहत्या तवैव का । ब्रह्महत्यासहस्रं हि तमः सूर्योदये यथा
verses.transliteration: asya tīrthasya māhātmyād ekahatyā tavaiva kā / brahmahatyāsahasraṃ hi tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: कब किसकी मृत्यु हो जायगी, यह ज्ञात नहीं होता और अकस्मात् यदि मृत्यु आ गयी तो कौन मनुष्य यहाँ वर्ष या दिन पा सकता है। फिर तो सब कुछ छोड़कर अकेले ही परलोककी
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थे ऽस्मिन् न विशेद्धत्या योजनानि चतुर्दश । एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे शक्रं प्रत्यक्षं प्राह कल्पगा
verses.transliteration: tīrthe 'smin na viśeddhatyā yojanāni caturdaśa / etasminn antare śakraṃ pratyakṣaṃ prāha kalpagā
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: यात्रा करनी पड़ेगी। इसलिये पूर्ण प्रयत्न करके सत्यधर्मपरायण होओ। यह सब नरकोंका लक्षण तुमसे बताया गया।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: शिवम् अस्तु महाराज स्वगृहं याहि साम्प्रतम् । इति तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा नमस्कृत्य तु नर्मदाम्
verses.transliteration: śivam astu mahārāja svagṛhaṃ yāhi sāmpratam / iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā namaskṛtya tu narmadām
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: दान, पुण्य, शिवध्यान और नर्मदासेबनसे नरकसे उद्धार होनेका तथा संसारसे वैराग्यका उपदेश
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यं यानं समारूढो मुदा परमया युतः । अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णं सिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितम्
verses.transliteration: divyaṃ yānaṃ samārūḍho mudā paramayā yutaḥ / apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ siddhagandharvasevitam
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: युधिष्ठिरने पूछा-मुने! किस धर्मके द्वारा इस परम दुस्तर संसार-सागरको पार किया जा
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: तत्रारूढः सुरपतिर् यथापूर्वं तथैव च । धृतदिव्यातपत्रस् तु वीज्यमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: tatrārūḍhaḥ surapatir yathāpūrvaṃ tathaiva ca / dhṛtadivyātapatras tu vījyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी बोले-भनुष्य अनेक प्रकारके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: स्तूयमानः सुरगणैः प्रविवेशामरावतीम् । शिवेन कथितं ह्य् एतत् पार्वत्याः षण्मुखस्य च
verses.transliteration: stūyamānaḥ suragaṇaiḥ praviveśāmarāvatīm / śivena kathitaṃ hy etat pārvatyāḥ ṣaṇmukhasya ca
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: राग और लोभके वशीभूत होकर संसारमें नाना -
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: मया तु कथितं राजंस् तव ब्रह्मर्षिपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: mayā tu kathitaṃ rājaṃs tava brahmarṣipūrvakam
verses.translation: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.hindi: प्रकारके क्लेश उठाता है। गर्भमें पड़ जानेसे मनुष्य कहे हुए शास्त्रको नहीं समझता और स्वर्ग तथा 727४1 मोक्षसाधक कर्मोंकी चर्चा नहीं सुनता। सम्पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among men, it has thus been nar- rated and it was this that you had asked for. O king of mighty arms, what else do you wish to, hear?

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे ब्रह्महत्याछेदनो नाम विंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय २१ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: भूयश्चेच्छाम्य् अहं श्रोतुं नर्मदातीर्थकीर्तनम् । तृप्तिं नैवाधिगच्छामि शृण्वन्नपि महामुने
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe brahmahatyāchedano nāma viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 21 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: bhūyaścecchāmy ahaṃ śrotuṃ narmadātīrthakīrtanam / tṛptiṃ naivādhigacchāmi śṛṇvannapi mahāmune
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmana, with your favour different narratives of miraculous import have been heard by me. I wish to hear further, O Brahmana, about good holy vows. Do tell me. Hpw did this meritorious river named Narmada, the most excellent one among all the rivers, become well-known? Tell me again, O sinless one.
verses.hindi: है। वास्तवमें भगवान् शिवका चिन्तन ही नरकसे छुड़ाकर अपना परम अद्भुत कल्याण करनेवाला
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmana, with your favour different narratives of miraculous import have been heard by me. I wish to hear further, O Brahmana, about good holy vows. Do tell me. Hpw did this meritorious river named Narmada, the most excellent one among all the rivers,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmana, with your favour different narratives of miraculous import have been heard by me. I wish to hear further, O Brahmana, about good holy vows. Do tell me. Hpw did this meritorious river named Narmada, the most excellent one among all the rivers,…

verses.sanskrit: इदानीं श्रोतुम् इच्छामि रेवाकुब्जासमागमम् । आख्यानसहितं ब्रह्मन् कथयस्व प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: idānīṃ śrotum icchāmi revākubjāsamāgamam / ākhyānasahitaṃ brahman kathayasva prasādataḥ
verses.translation: Narmada is the most excellent one among all rivers. It is destructive of all sins. It shall redeem all living beings, both mobile and immobile.
verses.hindi: है। जो जम्बूद्वीपमें आकर मनुष्य-योनिमें जन्म लेता है, तथापि नर्मदादेवीकी शरणमें नहीं जाता, वह भाग्यहीन है। इस संसारमें पापसे दूषित चित्तवाले मनुष्योंको उत्तम गति देनेवाली नर्मदासे
verses.wordMeaning: Narmada is the most excellent one among all rivers. It is destructive of all sins. It shall redeem all living beings, both mobile and immobile.
verses.commentary: Sense: Narmada is the most excellent one among all rivers. It is destructive of all sins. It shall redeem all living beings, both mobile and immobile.

verses.sanskrit: कुब्जिका कर्मणा केन त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता । एतन्नस्त्वं परं ब्रह्मन् संशयं छेत्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: kubjikā karmaṇā kena triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā / etannastvaṃ paraṃ brahman saṃśayaṃ chettumarhasi
verses.translation: I shall recount to you the greatness of Narmada which has been heard by me from my predecessors. O king, listen with concentration of mind. Ganga is auspicious in Kanakhala; Sarasvati in Kuruksetra; but Narmada is auspicious everywhere, whether it be a village or a forest.
verses.hindi: बढ़कर दूसरी कौन नदी है? जो पापहारिणी महादेवी का ध्यान करते हैं, उनकी माप और प्रयोजनोंको सिद्ध करनेवाले भगवान्  नष्ट हो जाती है । जो नर्मदाका मनसे स्मरण और  वह अज्ञानवश कष्ट मानने लगता  वाणीद्वारा कीर्तन करता है, वह परलोकमें जानेप
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount to you the greatness of Narmada which has been heard by me from my predecessors. O king, listen with concentration of mind. Ganga is auspicious in Kanakhala; Sarasvati in Kuruksetra; but Narmada is auspicious everywhere, whether it be a village or a forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount to you the greatness of Narmada which has been heard by me from my predecessors. O king, listen with concentration of mind. Ganga is auspicious in Kanakhala; Sarasvati in Kuruksetra; but Narmada is auspicious everywhere, whether it be a village or a forest.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: शृणु राजन् कथां दिव्यां सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् । कथितामीश्वरेणैव पार्वत्याः षण्मुखस्य मे
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu rājan kathāṃ divyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm / kathitāmīśvareṇaiva pārvatyāḥ ṣaṇmukhasya me
verses.translation: The water of Sarasvati sanctifies one in three days; the water of Yamuna in seven days; the water of Ganga sanctifies one immediately; but the water of Narmada does so through the very sight.
verses.hindi: यमदूतोंद्वारा पीड़ित नहीं होता । नरकमें स्थित होनेपर भी जो नर्मदा नदी एवं भगवान् शिव और विष्णुका स्मरण करता है, उसे यमराजके दूत तत्काल त्याग देते हैं। यदि वैदूर्य पर्वत एवं
verses.wordMeaning: The water of Sarasvati sanctifies one in three days; the water of Yamuna in seven days; the water of Ganga sanctifies one immediately; but the water of Narmada does so through the very sight.
verses.commentary: Sense: The water of Sarasvati sanctifies one in three days; the water of Yamuna in seven days; the water of Ganga sanctifies one immediately; but the water of Narmada does so through the very sight.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां ब्रह्ममुख्यानां गणानां चानुचारिणाम् । नानाऋक्षाणि सूर्यस्य जगदुद्योतकारिणः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ brahmamukhyānāṃ gaṇānāṃ cānucāriṇām / nānāṛkṣāṇi sūryasya jagadudyotakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: It is meritorious and beautiful at every step, in all the three worlds. In the region to the west of Kalirigadesa on the mountain Amarakantaka, O great king, Devas, Gandharvas, sages and ascetics have performed penance and attained great Siddhis.
verses.hindi: अमरकण्टकपर भोग और मोक्ष फल देनेवाले परमेश्वर ' 3३कारजी' विद्यमान हैं, तो पापी मनुष्य यहाँ क्यों शोक करते हैं? वहीं सम्पूर्ण लोकोंपर अनुग्रह करनेवाले सिद्धलिंग सिद्धेश्वर, यज्ञेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: It is meritorious and beautiful at every step, in all the three worlds. In the region to the west of Kalirigadesa on the mountain Amarakantaka, O great king, Devas, Gandharvas, sages and ascetics have performed penance and attained great Siddhis.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is meritorious and beautiful at every step, in all the three worlds. In the region to the west of Kalirigadesa on the mountain Amarakantaka, O great king, Devas, Gandharvas, sages and ascetics have performed penance and attained great Siddhis.

verses.sanskrit: शशिसूर्योपगमने तारा भान्ति नभस्तले । नान्या पयस्विनी शक्ता संसारार्णवतारणे
verses.transliteration: śaśisūryopagamane tārā bhānti nabhastale / nānyā payasvinī śaktā saṃsārārṇavatāraṇe
verses.translation: After taking his holy bath there, strictly controlling the sense-organs and scrupulously observing restraints and Observ- ing fast for a night, a man shall redeem a hundred members of his family.
verses.hindi: और शशिभूषण हैं । नर्मदाके दक्षिण भागमें महेश्वर एवं कपिलेश्वरलिंग हैं। उस स्थानको विद्वान् पुरुष शिवक्षेत्र कहते हैं। जो मनुष्य सदा पुष्प, धूप, आरती और तर्पण आदिके द्वारा भक्तिपूर्वक
verses.wordMeaning: After taking his holy bath there, strictly controlling the sense-organs and scrupulously observing restraints and Observ- ing fast for a night, a man shall redeem a hundred members of his family.
verses.commentary: Sense: After taking his holy bath there, strictly controlling the sense-organs and scrupulously observing restraints and Observ- ing fast for a night, a man shall redeem a hundred members of his family.

verses.sanskrit: पितृदेवमनुष्याणां मुक्त्वा चैव तु कल्पगाम् । तत्र स्नाता दिवं यान्ति ये मृता न पुनर्भवाः
verses.transliteration: pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ muktvā caiva tu kalpagām / tatra snātā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ
verses.translation: O dear one, since the mountain Amarakantaka is a great Siddhi-k$etra, it has been resorted to by all the Devas and served by sages.
verses.hindi: इन लिंगोंकी अर्चना करते हैं, वे नरकसे छूटकर शिवलोकको जाते हैं। अनघ! तुमने जो कुछ पूछा था, वह सब मैंने तुम्हें बताया  पापी पुरुषोंको यमराजने यह बताया है कि “जो लोग गोदान,
verses.wordMeaning: O dear one, since the mountain Amarakantaka is a great Siddhi-k$etra, it has been resorted to by all the Devas and served by sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear one, since the mountain Amarakantaka is a great Siddhi-k$etra, it has been resorted to by all the Devas and served by sages.

verses.sanskrit: चान्द्रायणसहस्रं च ब्रह्मकूर्चायुतं तथा । नर्मदातोयपानेन तुल्यं भवति वा न वा
verses.transliteration: cāndrāyaṇasahasraṃ ca brahmakūrcāyutaṃ tathā / narmadātoyapānena tulyaṃ bhavati vā na vā
verses.translation: Ever since then I too have resorted to the great holy spot. Indeed in this holy spot the Consort of Uma is stationed in the form of Pranava.
verses.hindi: सामग्रियोंका दान तथा महल और बगीचेका दान करते हैं, वे घोर नरकस्वरूप यमलोकमें नहीं जाते। भगवान् शिवके वचनानुसार वे सब पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाते हैं।'
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since then I too have resorted to the great holy spot. Indeed in this holy spot the Consort of Uma is stationed in the form of Pranava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since then I too have resorted to the great holy spot. Indeed in this holy spot the Consort of Uma is stationed in the form of Pranava.

verses.sanskrit: तिलोदकप्रदानेन पितॄणां प्रीतिरक्षया । गायन्ति पितरो गाथा तथैव च पितामहाः
verses.transliteration: tilodakapradānena pitṝṇāṃ prītirakṣayā / gāyanti pitaro gāthā tathaiva ca pitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: Srikantha (Siva) and his Ganas have been served by groups of all living beings. O king, I shall recount the details of this Tlrtha extending from this excellent mountain.
verses.hindi: सम्मानको अपमानने, प्रियजनोंके संयोगको वियोगने और जवानीको बुढापेने ग्रस लिया है। सारा सुख दुःखके उपद्रवसे युक्त है। जब बाल पक जाते हैं, शरीरमें झुर्रियाँ पड़ जाती हैं, तब
verses.wordMeaning: Srikantha (Siva) and his Ganas have been served by groups of all living beings. O king, I shall recount the details of this Tlrtha extending from this excellent mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Srikantha (Siva) and his Ganas have been served by groups of all living beings. O king, I shall recount the details of this Tlrtha extending from this excellent mountain.

verses.sanskrit: मातामहाद्याः सततं सर्व एव परस्परम् । अपि स्यात् स्वकुले ऽस्माकं पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: mātāmahādyāḥ satataṃ sarva eva parasparam / api syāt svakule 'smākaṃ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: It is half a Yojana in width. There are sixty crore sixty thousand Tirthas undoubtedly on both the banks of the river from the mountain upto the sea.
verses.hindi: वृद्धावस्थामें जर्जरशरीर होकर विद्वान् मनुष्य क्या कर सकता है? स्त्री और पुरुषोंका यौवन तथा रूप, जो एक-दूसरेको बहुत ही प्रिय लगता है, जराग्रस्त हो जानेपर दोनोंके लिये अप्रिय हो
verses.wordMeaning: It is half a Yojana in width. There are sixty crore sixty thousand Tirthas undoubtedly on both the banks of the river from the mountain upto the sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is half a Yojana in width. There are sixty crore sixty thousand Tirthas undoubtedly on both the banks of the river from the mountain upto the sea.

verses.sanskrit: हविस् तिलयुतं दद्याद् यो रेवासलिलार्चितम् । वर्षलक्षं तथा तेन तृप्ता यामः परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: havis tilayutaṃ dadyād yo revāsalilārcitam / varṣalakṣaṃ tathā tena tṛptā yāmaḥ parāṃ gatim
verses.translation: The Wind-god has mentioned that the Tirthas number sixty-seven crore sixty-seven thousand sixty-seven hundred.
verses.hindi: जाता है। जो अपने-आपको अपूर्व शिथिलतासे युक्त देखकर भी संसारसे विरत नहीं होता, उससे बढ़कर मूर्ख दूसरा कौन हो सकता है? जराग्रस्त मनुष्य अशक्त होनेके कारण पत्नी-पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: The Wind-god has mentioned that the Tirthas number sixty-seven crore sixty-seven thousand sixty-seven hundred.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Wind-god has mentioned that the Tirthas number sixty-seven crore sixty-seven thousand sixty-seven hundred.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञक्रिया कृता तेन समग्रा भूरिदक्षिणा । एतत् ते कथितं राजं शिवेनोक्त यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: yajñakriyā kṛtā tena samagrā bhūridakṣiṇā / etat te kathitaṃ rājaṃ śivenokta yathā purā
verses.translation: But, only in Krtayuga they become visible, O king. All pious-minded men see them always.
verses.hindi: आदि बान्धवों तथा दुराचारी सेवकोंद्रारा भी अपमानित होता है । वृद्ध मनुष्य धर्म, अर्थ, काम और मोक्ष किसी भी पुरुषार्थका साधन करनेमें समर्थ नहीं होता। इसलिये बुढापा आनेसे पहले
verses.wordMeaning: But, only in Krtayuga they become visible, O king. All pious-minded men see them always.
verses.commentary: Sense: But, only in Krtayuga they become visible, O king. All pious-minded men see them always.

verses.sanskrit: स्वारोचिषे ऽन्तरे प्राप्ते आदिकल्पे कृते युगे । मा गयां गच्छ कौन्तेय मा गङ्गां मा सरस्वतीम्
verses.transliteration: svārociṣe 'ntare prāpte ādikalpe kṛte yuge / mā gayāṃ gaccha kaunteya mā gaṅgāṃ mā sarasvatīm
verses.translation: As Kali becomes severe and terrible, men become short in stature and deficient in intrinsic strength.
verses.hindi: a सभा बहा देते है
verses.wordMeaning: As Kali becomes severe and terrible, men become short in stature and deficient in intrinsic strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: As Kali becomes severe and terrible, men become short in stature and deficient in intrinsic strength.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गच्छ नृपश्रेष्ठ यत्र कुब्जा सनर्मदा । वाराणसीं प्रयागं च गङ्गासागरसङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: tatra gaccha nṛpaśreṣṭha yatra kubjā sanarmadā / vārāṇasīṃ prayāgaṃ ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgamam
verses.translation: They say, O king, that Jalesvara and other Tirthas on this mountain accord satisfaction to the Pitrs on whom they as well bestow heavenly pleasures and salvation.
verses.hindi: ही धर्माचरण करे । युधिष्ठिर! शरीरमें वात, पित्त और कफ आदिकी विषमता होती रहती है तथा वात, पित्त, कफका समूह शरीरसे ही उत्पन्न बताया गया है । इसलिये अपना यह शरीर सदा
verses.wordMeaning: They say, O king, that Jalesvara and other Tirthas on this mountain accord satisfaction to the Pitrs on whom they as well bestow heavenly pleasures and salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: They say, O king, that Jalesvara and other Tirthas on this mountain accord satisfaction to the Pitrs on whom they as well bestow heavenly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: केदारं कनखलं च प्रभासं शशिभूषणम् । हरिश्चन्द्रपुरं चान्द्रं श्रीशैलं त्रिपुरान्तकम्
verses.transliteration: kedāraṃ kanakhalaṃ ca prabhāsaṃ śaśibhūṣaṇam / hariścandrapuraṃ cāndraṃ śrīśailaṃ tripurāntakam
verses.translation: The holy spot Daruvana 1 is very excellent. There the confluence of Caruka is auspicious. On the north (bank) of Narmada the holy.spot of Carukesvara is the most excellent.
verses.hindi: रोगोंका ही आश्रय है, ऐसा जानना चाहिए । जब वातका प्रकोप होता है और मनुष्य ज्वरसे पीडित होता है, तब अनेक प्रकारसे होनेवाले रोगोंके कारण उसे बहुत दुःख सहन करने पड़ते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The holy spot Daruvana 1 is very excellent. There the confluence of Caruka is auspicious. On the north (bank) of Narmada the holy.spot of Carukesvara is the most excellent.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy spot Daruvana 1 is very excellent. There the confluence of Caruka is auspicious. On the north (bank) of Narmada the holy.spot of Carukesvara is the most excellent.

verses.sanskrit: माहेन्द्र मलयं चैव गोकर्णं च महाबलम् । कालञ्जरं नीलकण्ठं त्र्यम्बकं धूतकिल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: māhendra malayaṃ caiva gokarṇaṃ ca mahābalam / kālañjaraṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ tryambakaṃ dhūtakilbiṣam
verses.translation: Near Mandhatrpura are Siddhesvara and Yamesvara. To the east of Omkara is the excellent Tlrtha of Kedara.
verses.hindi: इस शरीरमें मृत्युके साधन सौसे भी अधिक हैं । इनमेंसे एक मृत्यु तो कालरूप है और शेष मृत्युएँ आगन्तुक मानी गयी हैं। जो आगन्तुक होती हैं वे ओषधिसेवन तथा जप, होम और दान आदिसे
verses.wordMeaning: Near Mandhatrpura are Siddhesvara and Yamesvara. To the east of Omkara is the excellent Tlrtha of Kedara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near Mandhatrpura are Siddhesvara and Yamesvara. To the east of Omkara is the excellent Tlrtha of Kedara.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रकोटिं हिमस्थानं भैरवं च महापथम् । तीर्थान्य् एतानि चान्यानि कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम्
verses.transliteration: rudrakoṭiṃ himasthānaṃ bhairavaṃ ca mahāpatham / tīrthāny etāni cānyāni kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
verses.translation: Near it, O great king, is Svargadvara ('Gateway to Heaven') that dispels sins. It is the meritorious Tirtha named Brahmesvara. In front of it is Saptasarasvata.
verses.hindi: शान्त हो जाती हैं; परंतु कालरूप मृत्यु किसी उपायसे भी शान्त नहीं होती। विष और मद्य आदिसे मनुष्यकी अपमृत्यु होती है। अतः इन सब वस्तुओंका सेवन कदापि न करे। अनेक
verses.wordMeaning: Near it, O great king, is Svargadvara ('Gateway to Heaven') that dispels sins. It is the meritorious Tirtha named Brahmesvara. In front of it is Saptasarasvata.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near it, O great king, is Svargadvara ('Gateway to Heaven') that dispels sins. It is the meritorious Tirtha named Brahmesvara. In front of it is Saptasarasvata.

verses.sanskrit: नानातीर्थसहस्राणि पुराणे कीर्तितानि च । ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवोक्तं हि तत्प्रमाणं हि सिद्धये
verses.transliteration: nānātīrthasahasrāṇi purāṇe kīrtitāni ca / brahmaviṣṇuśivoktaṃ hi tatpramāṇaṃ hi siddhaye
verses.translation: O dear one, crores of Rudras are stationed on this mountain. They can be propitiated through ablutions, scents, garlands and unguents.
verses.hindi: प्रकारके रोग, कष्ट, सर्प आदि जीव, विष और मारण आदिके प्रयोग-ये सब देहधारियोंके लिये मृत्युके द्वार हैं। यदि मनुष्यका मृत्युकाल आ पहुँचा है, उस समय रोग, सर्प आदिसे पीडित
verses.wordMeaning: O dear one, crores of Rudras are stationed on this mountain. They can be propitiated through ablutions, scents, garlands and unguents.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear one, crores of Rudras are stationed on this mountain. They can be propitiated through ablutions, scents, garlands and unguents.

verses.sanskrit: सोमे प्रसिद्धा ऽमावास्या रेवाकुब्जासमागमे । एरण्ड्यां चण्डवेगायां रेवया सह संगमे
verses.transliteration: some prasiddhā 'māvāsyā revākubjāsamāgame / eraṇḍyāṃ caṇḍavegāyāṃ revayā saha saṃgame
verses.translation: O king, the Rudras shall undoubtedly become pleased here. Sins can be wiped off by means of Japa. One attains infiniteness (Moksa) through meditation.
verses.hindi: हो तो साक्षात् धन्वन्तरि भी उसे नहीं बचा सकते। कालपीड़ित मनुष्यकी रक्षा करनेमें ओषधि, तप, दान, मित्र और बान्धक-कोई भी समर्थ नहीं हैं। मृत्युके समान कोई दुःख नहीं है, मृत्युके
verses.wordMeaning: O king, the Rudras shall undoubtedly become pleased here. Sins can be wiped off by means of Japa. One attains infiniteness (Moksa) through meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, the Rudras shall undoubtedly become pleased here. Sins can be wiped off by means of Japa. One attains infiniteness (Moksa) through meditation.

verses.sanskrit: राजन् दर्शे यदा सोमः संविशेद् रविमण्डले । व्यतीपाते च संक्रान्तौ वैधृतौ विषुवे तथा
verses.transliteration: rājan darśe yadā somaḥ saṃviśed ravimaṇḍale / vyatīpāte ca saṃkrāntau vaidhṛtau viṣuve tathā
verses.translation: One obtains worldly pleasures through Dana: So said Sankara. In the region towards the west of the mountain, Lord Mahesvara himself, the eternal Lord, the primordial cause of the Cosmos, is stationed in the form of Pranava.
verses.hindi: समान कोई श्रु नहीं है तथा समस्त देहधारियोंके लिये मृत्युके समान दूसरा कोई काल नहीं है।
verses.wordMeaning: One obtains worldly pleasures through Dana: So said Sankara. In the region towards the west of the mountain, Lord Mahesvara himself, the eternal Lord, the primordial cause of the Cosmos, is stationed in the form of Pranava.
verses.commentary: Sense: One obtains worldly pleasures through Dana: So said Sankara. In the region towards the west of the mountain, Lord Mahesvara himself, the eternal Lord, the primordial cause of the Cosmos, is stationed in the form of Pranava.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षोत्तरायणे चैव षडशीतिमुखे तथा । दर्शे स्याद् विंशतिगुणं व्यतीपाते समां शतः
verses.transliteration: dakṣottarāyaṇe caiva ṣaḍaśītimukhe tathā / darśe syād viṃśatiguṇaṃ vyatīpāte samāṃ śataḥ
verses.translation: A devotee should control his sense-organs and re- main celibate. After taking his holy bath, he shall remain pure and perform the libation and other rites of the Pitrs as en- joined by scriptures.
verses.hindi: राज्य तथा ऐश्वर्य आदि नाना प्रकारके सम्पूर्ण सुखोंको मृत्यु सहसा छीन लेती है। राजन्! भाई- बन्धु आदिके रूपमें जो यह दुस्तर संसार है,
verses.wordMeaning: A devotee should control his sense-organs and re- main celibate. After taking his holy bath, he shall remain pure and perform the libation and other rites of the Pitrs as en- joined by scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: A devotee should control his sense-organs and re- main celibate. After taking his holy bath, he shall remain pure and perform the libation and other rites of the Pitrs as en- joined by scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: संक्रमे वैधृतौ राजं छतार्धं परिकीर्तितम् । अमासोमसमायोगे राहुसोमसमागमे
verses.transliteration: saṃkrame vaidhṛtau rājaṃ chatārdhaṃ parikīrtitam / amāsomasamāyoge rāhusomasamāgame
verses.translation: He should propitiate Pitr-gods with the water mixed with gingelly seeds. O son of Pandu, members of his family up to seven generations including himself rejoice in heaven.
verses.hindi: मातंग, मृगवन और वाराहतीर्थकी महिमा
verses.wordMeaning: He should propitiate Pitr-gods with the water mixed with gingelly seeds. O son of Pandu, members of his family up to seven generations including himself rejoice in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should propitiate Pitr-gods with the water mixed with gingelly seeds. O son of Pandu, members of his family up to seven generations including himself rejoice in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुक्षेत्राच् छतगुणं पुण्यम् आह शिवः स्वयम् । बिल्वाम्रकं सिद्धलिङ्गं ब्रह्महत्याव्यपोहनम्
verses.transliteration: kurukṣetrāc chataguṇaṃ puṇyam āha śivaḥ svayam / bilvāmrakaṃ siddhaliṅgaṃ brahmahatyāvyapohanam
verses.translation: He remains happy and enjpys different kinds of worldly pleasures. He rejoices for sixty thousand years (in heaven) duly adored by Suras.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं-माहिष्मतीपुरीके पश्चिम अशोकवनिका नामक एक पापहारी तीर्थ है, जो सब प्रकारके शोकोंका विनाश करनेवाला है। वहाँ स्नान करके अपने वैभवके अनुसार गौरीदेवीका
verses.wordMeaning: He remains happy and enjpys different kinds of worldly pleasures. He rejoices for sixty thousand years (in heaven) duly adored by Suras.
verses.commentary: Sense: He remains happy and enjpys different kinds of worldly pleasures. He rejoices for sixty thousand years (in heaven) duly adored by Suras.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनात् स्पर्शनात् तस्य शिवलोके महीयते । कुब्जेश्वरं तथैवान्यत् न तत् पश्यन्ति मानवाः
verses.transliteration: darśanāt sparśanāt tasya śivaloke mahīyate / kubjeśvaraṃ tathaivānyat na tat paśyanti mānavāḥ
verses.translation: He rejoices for a long period. After coming down from heaven, he is reborn in a family devoid of impurities, when he shall be rich, liberal in gifts, devoid of ailments and honoured by laymen. Again he remembers the holy spot and makes pilgrimage thereto.
verses.hindi: पूजन करे। वहीं मातंगमुनिका आश्रम है। जो स्त्री शुक्ल और कृष्ण पक्षकी तृतीयाको गन्ध, धूप, चन्दन, नाना प्रकारके उपहार तथा दीपावली जलाने आदिके द्वारा वहाँ भक्तिपूर्वक गौरीदेवीका
verses.wordMeaning: He rejoices for a long period. After coming down from heaven, he is reborn in a family devoid of impurities, when he shall be rich, liberal in gifts, devoid of ailments and honoured by laymen. Again he remembers the holy spot and makes pilgrimage thereto.
verses.commentary: Sense: He rejoices for a long period. After coming down from heaven, he is reborn in a family devoid of impurities, when he shall be rich, liberal in gifts, devoid of ailments and honoured by laymen. Again he remembers the holy spot and makes pilgrimage thereto.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदाकुब्जिकामध्ये नागकन्याभिर् अर्च्यते । स्वारोचिषे ऽन्तरे प्राप्ते आदिकल्पे कृते युगे
verses.transliteration: narmadākubjikāmadhye nāgakanyābhir arcyate / svārociṣe 'ntare prāpte ādikalpe kṛte yuge
verses.translation: During the second birth he will be very enthusiastic (in eagerly resorting to the eddy) in the performance of the Vrata with celibacy, observance of fasts and subduing of sense- organs.
verses.hindi: पूजन करती है, वह रूप और सौभाग्यसे सम्पन्न पति प्राप्त करती है। युधिष्ठिर! पूर्व कल्पकी बात है--मातंग नामसे प्रसिद्ध देवर्षिने नर्मदा नदीके तटपर रहकर बड़ी
verses.wordMeaning: During the second birth he will be very enthusiastic (in eagerly resorting to the eddy) in the performance of the Vrata with celibacy, observance of fasts and subduing of sense- organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the second birth he will be very enthusiastic (in eagerly resorting to the eddy) in the performance of the Vrata with celibacy, observance of fasts and subduing of sense- organs.

verses.sanskrit: कालाग्निरुद्रसंकाशं भित्त्वा पातालसङ्गमम् । सूर्यकोटिसमप्रख्यं प्रदीप्तज्वलनप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: kālāgnirudrasaṃkāśaṃ bhittvā pātālasaṅgamam / sūryakoṭisamaprakhyaṃ pradīptajvalanaprabham
verses.translation: O king, if the devotee falls down (offers his body) into the Tlrtha, he will enjoy pleasures in Patala. Three thou- sand maidens stand in waiting in his abode seeking errands from him. Richly endowed with divine enjoyment of pleasures, he amuses himself for as long as he wishes (to do). On the whole of the earth stretching upto the sea, O excellent one among men, there is nothing like mountain Amarakantaka.
verses.hindi: दुष्कर तपस्या की थी। महर्षियोंके सत्संग और नर्मदाके दर्शनसे उन्होंने पाप-बुद्धिका परित्याग करके धर्म-बुद्धिका आश्रय लिया था। “मैं विरक्त और भिक्षु हूँ” ऐसा विचारकर वे अशोकवनिकामें
verses.wordMeaning: O king, if the devotee falls down (offers his body) into the Tlrtha, he will enjoy pleasures in Patala. Three thou- sand maidens stand in waiting in his abode seeking errands from him. Richly endowed with divine enjoyment of pleasures,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, if the devotee falls down (offers his body) into the Tlrtha, he will enjoy pleasures in Patala. Three thou- sand maidens stand in waiting in his abode seeking errands from him. Richly endowed with divine enjoyment of pleasures,…

verses.sanskrit: उत्थितं कल्पगामध्ये देवा ऽवाहनकाम्यया । ॐकारस्य यवैकेन हीनं लिङ्गं नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: utthitaṃ kalpagāmadhye devā 'vāhanakāmyayā / oṃkārasya yavaikena hīnaṃ liṅgaṃ nṛpottama
verses.translation: To the west of the mountain, it should be known that there is a Tirtha; the eddy named Jalesvara well-known in all the three worlds.
verses.hindi: गये और जटा, वल्कल धारण करके कन्द, मूल, 'फलका आहार करते हुए एक सहस्र दिव्य वर्षोतक भगवान् शिवकी आराधनामें तत्पर रहे। सब मन्त्रोंमें उत्तम "ॐ नमः शिवाय' इस षडक्षर मन्त्रका वे
verses.wordMeaning: To the west of the mountain, it should be known that there is a Tirtha; the eddy named Jalesvara well-known in all the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the west of the mountain, it should be known that there is a Tirtha; the eddy named Jalesvara well-known in all the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि लोके ऽस्मिन् सचराचरे । हीनान् यस्माद् यवार्द्धेन सत्यम् एतच् छिवोदितम्
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni loke 'smin sacarācare / hīnān yasmād yavārddhena satyam etac chivoditam
verses.translation: By offering balls of rice there and performing Sandhya prayers, the Pitrs become' propitiated and satisfied for a period of twelve years.
verses.hindi: दिन-रात अपने हृदयमें चिन्तन करते थे। उनकी उस पराभक्तिको जानकर देवाधिदेव महादेवजीने उन्हें प्रत्यक्ष दर्शन दिया और कहा--' सुव्रत! इस ध्यानसे तुम्हारा कल्याण हो, तुम वर माँगो।'
verses.wordMeaning: By offering balls of rice there and performing Sandhya prayers, the Pitrs become' propitiated and satisfied for a period of twelve years.
verses.commentary: Sense: By offering balls of rice there and performing Sandhya prayers, the Pitrs become' propitiated and satisfied for a period of twelve years.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र यस् त्यजति प्राणानमासोमसमागमे । दिव्ययानसमारूढः स्तूयमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: tatra yas tyajati prāṇānamāsomasamāgame / divyayānasamārūḍhaḥ stūyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Dc ( ) states that Kapili is an affluent (tributary) of Narmadi. This Purina traces the name to Sage Kapila who is said to have performed penance on the banks of Narmadi.
verses.hindi: मातंग बोले- देवेश्वर! यह तीर्थ मातंगके नामसे विख्यात हो। इसमें चाण्डाल, श्वपच आदि पापयोनिके जीव तथा जप आदिसे रहित पुरुष भी पापमुक्त होते रहें। जो यहाँ स्नान करके
verses.wordMeaning: Dc ( ) states that Kapili is an affluent (tributary) of Narmadi. This Purina traces the name to Sage Kapila who is said to have performed penance on the banks of Narmadi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dc ( ) states that Kapili is an affluent (tributary) of Narmadi. This Purina traces the name to Sage Kapila who is said to have performed penance on the banks of Narmadi.

verses.sanskrit: धृतदिव्यातपत्रस् तु सर्वालङ्कारभूषितः । त्रिंशच्छतसहस्राणि वसेच् छिवपुरे शुभे
verses.transliteration: dhṛtadivyātapatras tu sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ / triṃśacchatasahasrāṇi vasec chivapure śubhe
verses.translation: A popular etymology. Another such etymological episode is given in w 71-77 below:
verses.hindi: नर्मदातटवर्ती मातंगेश्‍वरलिंगका पूजन करे, उसका
verses.wordMeaning: A popular etymology. Another such etymological episode is given in w 71-77 below:
verses.commentary: Sense: A popular etymology. Another such etymological episode is given in w 71-77 below:

verses.sanskrit: त्यजेद्धि तत्र यः प्राणान् न वशः स्ववशो ऽपि वा । दशवर्षसहस्राणि राजा विद्याधरे पुरे
verses.transliteration: tyajeddhi tatra yaḥ prāṇān na vaśaḥ svavaśo 'pi vā / daśavarṣasahasrāṇi rājā vidyādhare pure
verses.translation: Formerly, O king, the daughter of Daksa i.e. DaksayanI (Gauri) sported about in the waters of Narmada with great joy along with the Trident-bearing One.
verses.hindi: मातंग मुनिका यह वचन सुनकर महादेवजी बोले--मुने! मेरे प्रसादसे यह सब कुछ तुम्हारे इच्छानुसार होगा। ऐसा कहकर भगवान् शिव पर्वतश्रेष्ठ कैलासको चले गये और मातंग मुनि
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, O king, the daughter of Daksa i.e. DaksayanI (Gauri) sported about in the waters of Narmada with great joy along with the Trident-bearing One.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, O king, the daughter of Daksa i.e. DaksayanI (Gauri) sported about in the waters of Narmada with great joy along with the Trident-bearing One.

verses.sanskrit: रन्तिदेवश् चक्रवर्ती शक्रतुल्यो महीपतिः । अयोध्याधिपतिः श्रीमान् सर्वधर्मभृतां वरः
verses.transliteration: rantidevaś cakravartī śakratulyo mahīpatiḥ / ayodhyādhipatiḥ śrīmān sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: After rising up suddenly from the water she changed her clothes. The wet clothes of the goddess were sportingly squeezed and pressed by the attendants.
verses.hindi: वरदान पाकर दिव्य विमानपर आरूढ् हो उमा- महेश्वर-धामको चले गये। चैत्रके कृष्ण पक्षमें जो चतुर्दशी और अमावास्या तिथि आती है, उसमें वहाँ जो कुछ दान, होम आदि किया जाता
verses.wordMeaning: After rising up suddenly from the water she changed her clothes. The wet clothes of the goddess were sportingly squeezed and pressed by the attendants.
verses.commentary: Sense: After rising up suddenly from the water she changed her clothes. The wet clothes of the goddess were sportingly squeezed and pressed by the attendants.

verses.sanskrit: कण्वाश्रमपदे रम्ये सुरासुरनिषेविते । आख्यानसहितं राजं छृणु वेद यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: kaṇvāśramapade ramye surāsuraniṣevite / ākhyānasahitaṃ rājaṃ chṛṇu veda yathākramam
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: है, वह अक्षय फल देनेवाला होता है। उस तीर्थमें तिल और seer तर्पण करनेसे और गुड़-सत्तूका पिण्डदान देनेसे चौदह इन्द्रोंक स्थित कालतक पितर तृप्त रहते हैं। अशोकवनिका
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थसंख्याप्रमाणं च इतिहासं पुरातनम् । हरन्ति के च कार्त्तिक्यां कैलासे पर्वतोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: tīrthasaṃkhyāpramāṇaṃ ca itihāsaṃ purātanam / haranti ke ca kārttikyāṃ kailāse parvatottame
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: नामसे प्रसिद्ध स्थान मातंग-तीर्थ कहलाता है, वह नर्मदाके उत्तर तटपर विद्यमान है।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादयो गतास् तत्र विष्णुशक्रपुरोगमाः । उमया सहितो रुद्रो गणकोटिसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: brahmādayo gatās tatra viṣṇuśakrapurogamāḥ / umayā sahito rudro gaṇakoṭisamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: युधिष्ठिर! अब मैं नर्मदाके दक्षिण तटपर विद्यमान मृगवन नामक तीर्थका वर्णन करूँगा। महाराज! वहाँ एकादशीको स्नान करके शंख- चक्र-गदाधारी भगवान् विष्णुका अर्चन करे और
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दिस्कन्दमहाकालसुरासुरनिषेवितः । सरितः सागराः शैलास् तीर्थानां कोटयस् तथा
verses.transliteration: nandiskandamahākālasurāsuraniṣevitaḥ / saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailās tīrthānāṃ koṭayas tathā
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: निराहार रहकर रात बितावे। प्रात:काल होनेपर फिर गन्ध और पुष्पोंद्रारा मृगवनमें श्रीहरिकी पूजा करे। वहाँ एक ब्राह्मणको भोजन करानेपर लाख ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन करानेका पुण्य होता
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मध्ये समुत्थाय स्कन्दो वचनम् अब्रवीत् । कस्यैतानि विमानानि दीव्यन्ते दिवि शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ madhye samutthāya skando vacanam abravīt / kasyaitāni vimānāni dīvyante divi śaṅkara
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: है। तिल और जलकी अंजलि देनेसे पितरोंको वैष्णव पदकी प्राप्ति होती है। वहीं उत्तम वाराहतीर्थ है, जहाँ वाराहरूप धारण करके Were इस पृथ्वीका उद्धार किया था और
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: साप्तभौमा गृहा रम्या हेमप्राकारतोरणाः । गीतनृत्यनिनादेन कामिनीनां मनोहराः
verses.transliteration: sāptabhaumā gṛhā ramyā hemaprākāratoraṇāḥ / gītanṛtyaninādena kāminīnāṃ manoharāḥ
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: वहीं अमित तेजस्वी श्रीहरिने विश्वरूपको भी
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: शृणु स्कन्द महाभाग कथ्यमानं यथोदितम् । तीर्थदानप्रभावेण तीर्थज्येष्ठक्रमेण तु
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: śṛṇu skanda mahābhāga kathyamānaṃ yathoditam / tīrthadānaprabhāveṇa tīrthajyeṣṭhakrameṇa tu
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: व्रत करके वहाँ विधिपूर्वक स्नान करती है, वह विष्णुधामको जाती है।
