verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: ये मृता नर्मदातीरे पर्वते ऽमरकण्टके । माहेश्वरादितीर्थेषु भृगुकच्छावसानतः
verses.transliteration: ye mṛtā narmadātīre parvate 'marakaṇṭake / māheśvarāditīrtheṣu bhṛgukacchāvasānataḥ
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: संसारसे मुक्त होनेके लिये पाप और पाखण्डी जनोंके त्याग तथा शिव एवं नर्मदाके आश्रय लेनेका उपदेश
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: इमानि यानि तीर्थानि लिङ्गमूर्तिधराणि च । सरितश्चापि गङ्गाद्यास् तासु दानप्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: imāni yāni tīrthāni liṅgamūrtidharāṇi ca / saritaścāpi gaṅgādyās tāsu dānaprabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--राजन्! नर्मदातटपर
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् ते कथितं स्कन्द हर्म्यास् सन्ति समुद्धृताः । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: एवं पुरा महाराज कैलासे पर्वतोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: etat te kathitaṃ skanda harmyās santi samuddhṛtāḥ / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: evaṃ purā mahārāja kailāse parvatottame
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: है, जो तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात है। वहाँ स्नान करके मनुष्य जिस-जिस मनोरथको चाहता है, उस तीर्थके प्रभावसे वह सब कुछ प्राप्त कर लेता है। वहीं संगमपर अंगारेश्वरदेव स्थित हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा पप्रच्छ तीर्थानां शङ्करं विधिपूर्वकम् । देवखातानि सर्वाणि सरितः सागरास् तथा
verses.transliteration: brahmā papraccha tīrthānāṃ śaṅkaraṃ vidhipūrvakam / devakhātāni sarvāṇi saritaḥ sāgarās tathā
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: जहाँ स्नान-मात्र करनेवाला मनुष्य गणपति-पदपर प्रतिष्ठित होता है ।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: नद्यः सर्वाश् च भूपृष्ठे गङ्गाद्या गिरिसम्भवाः । उत्तमाः कतिचिद् देव कथयस्व प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: nadyaḥ sarvāś ca bhūpṛṣṭhe gaṅgādyā girisambhavāḥ / uttamāḥ katicid deva kathayasva prasādataḥ
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: पाप बड़े ही कडवे और अत्यन्त दुःख देनेवाले होते हैं। इसलिये पाप कभी नहीं करना चाहिए । जिस देश-कालमें और जैसी आयुके द्वारा मनुष्य शुभाशुभ कर्म करता है, वह उसी प्रकार उसे
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: हर उवाच: कथयामि परं तीर्थं पवित्रं पापनाशनम् । कौतुकेन त्वया पृष्टा नदीनामुत्तमा नदी
verses.transliteration: hara uvāca: kathayāmi paraṃ tīrthaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam / kautukena tvayā pṛṣṭā nadīnāmuttamā nadī
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: भोगना पड्ता है। अतः अपनी शक्तिके अनुसार याचकको निरन्तर दान देना चाहिए  विद्वान् पुरुष शास्त्र और युक्तियोंद्वारा सदा आत्माके कल्याणका विचार करे। केवल अनुमानके ही द्वारा उसपर
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वासां सरितां मध्य उत्तमा सप्तकल्पगा । सर्वेषां जननी चेह नदी त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी
verses.transliteration: sarvāsāṃ saritāṃ madhya uttamā saptakalpagā / sarveṣāṃ jananī ceha nadī trailokyasundarī
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: विचार नहीं करना चाहिए। कर्मोके हीन और उत्तम नाना प्रकारके फल बताये गये हैं; अतः मनुष्य कोई कर्म करनेके पहले उसकी परीक्षा कर ले। जिसका श्रेष्ठ और महान् फल हो, वही
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच: सुरसिन्धुं परित्यज्य नर्मदा वर्ण्यते कथम् । विरुद्धं सर्वलोकानां देवानां च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca: surasindhuṃ parityajya narmadā varṇyate katham / viruddhaṃ sarvalokānāṃ devānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: पुण्यकर्म है । बुद्धिमान् पुरुषको चाहिए कि वह पाखण्डी, शास्त्रविपरीत कर्म करनेवाले, बैडालब्रती
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणस् तु वचः श्रुत्वा अगस्त्यो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । मध्ये पदे नियुक्तश् च वक्तुम् एव न युज्यते
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇas tu vacaḥ śrutvā agastyo vākyam abravīt / madhye pade niyuktaś ca vaktum eva na yujyate
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: तथा अन्यान्य पाखण्डी जनोंको दूरसे ही त्याग
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: धर्माः सर्वे वेदमूला ब्राह्मणा वेदसम्भवाः । वेदहीना न सिध्यन्ति यज्ञदानविधिक्रियाः
verses.transliteration: dharmāḥ sarve vedamūlā brāhmaṇā vedasambhavāḥ / vedahīnā na sidhyanti yajñadānavidhikriyāḥ
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: कलियुगमें धर्मके विपरीत आचार उपस्थित करते हैं। अतः उनके चलाये हुए पाखण्डका परित्याग करके तीनों वेदोंद्वारा प्रतिपादित धर्मका आचरण करे। सब धर्मोमें ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और शिवजीके
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयम्भूर् भगवां छम्भुः शम्भुश् च भगवान् हरिः । वेदाश् च भगवां छम्भुः कल्पगा शम्भुसम्भवा
verses.transliteration: svayambhūr bhagavāṃ chambhuḥ śambhuś ca bhagavān hariḥ / vedāś ca bhagavāṃ chambhuḥ kalpagā śambhusambhavā
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: वचन ही प्रमाण हैं। जो उनके विपरीत बर्ताव करता है वह निश्चय ही नरकमें गिरता है। पितरोंका तर्पण करे, भिखारीको भीख दे, सब प्राणियोंपर दया करे तथा नर्मदाजीकी माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्ताव्यक्तरूपेण जगतः कारणेच्छया । संहारसृष्टिरूपेण प्रलयोत्पत्तिकारिणी
verses.transliteration: avyaktāvyaktarūpeṇa jagataḥ kāraṇecchayā / saṃhārasṛṣṭirūpeṇa pralayotpattikāriṇī
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: कथाका चिन्तन करे। यही सब कमाँको शुद्ध
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: भगीरथनेमिनीता हरिणा ऽत्रावतारिता । गङ्गा सा जह्नुना पीता मुनिना चुलुकेन च
verses.transliteration: bhagīrathaneminītā hariṇā 'trāvatāritā / gaṅgā sā jahnunā pītā muninā culukena ca
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: करनेवाला सम्पूर्ण ज्ञान है। जो आदि, मध्य और अन्तसे रहित, स्वभावसे सबके स्वामी, सर्वज्ञ और परिपूर्ण हैं, वे भगवान् शिव शैवशास्त्रोंद्वारा जाननेयोग्य हैं। उनके द्वारा प्रतिपादित जो ज्ञान
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: क्रुद्धः पीत्वा मुनिस्तां तु स्थितो ध्यानपरायणः । दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु सा तु तस्योदरे स्थिता
verses.transliteration: kruddhaḥ pītvā munistāṃ tu sthito dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ / divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu sā tu tasyodare sthitā
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: है, वह संशयरहित एवं सम्पूर्ण प्रयोजनोंकी सिद्धि करनेवाला है । जो सर्वज्ञ हैं, सम्पूर्ण हैं, स्वभावतः निर्मल तथा सम्पूर्ण दोषोंसे रहित हैं, वे कल्याणमय शिव कोई विपरीत बात कैसे कह सकते हैं?
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: विस्मयो देवतानां हि समापेदे कुतूहलम् । ब्रह्माद्या देवताः सर्वा गत्वा तस्याश्रमं प्रति
verses.transliteration: vismayo devatānāṃ hi samāpede kutūhalam / brahmādyā devatāḥ sarvā gatvā tasyāśramaṃ prati
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शिवकी आज्ञाके बिना संसारकी सृष्टि कैसे हो सकती है? यदि कहें कि प्रकृतिसे सृष्टि होती है, तो ठीक नहीं, क्योंकि वह जड है। यदि कहा जाय कि जीवात्मा ही सृष्टि करता है,
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: शापशङ्काकुलात्मानो मुनिं विज्ञापयन्ति ते । महानदीं मुने मुञ्च पवित्रां पापनाशिनीम्
verses.transliteration: śāpaśaṅkākulātmāno muniṃ vijñāpayanti te / mahānadīṃ mune muñca pavitrāṃ pāpanāśinīm
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: तो यह भी उचित नहीं है; क्योंकि वह सर्वज्ञ नहीं, अज्ञ है। परमाणु आदि जो प्राकृत तत्त्व हैं, वे सब अचेतन हैं; अतः वे किसी बुद्धिमान् सहायकके बिना न तो स्वयं रचना कर सकते हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: मर्त्ये वहतु सा नित्यं लोकसन्तापहारिणी । देवता ऋषिप्रोक्तेन मुक्ता तेन महानदी
verses.transliteration: martye vahatu sā nityaṃ lokasantāpahāriṇī / devatā ṛṣiproktena muktā tena mahānadī
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: न देख ही सकते हैं। जैसे कुम्भकारके बिना मिट्टी स्वयं घड़ेके रूपमें नहीं परिणत होती, उसी प्रकार जड प्रकृति बुद्धिमान् चेतनके बिना स्वयं कुछ नहीं कर सकती। जैसे यह घोर संसार-
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: मुक्ता तु जह्नुना तत्र तेन सा जाह्नवी स्मृता । सा तु किं वर्ण्यते ब्रह्मन् पीताया जह्नुना पुरा
verses.transliteration: muktā tu jahnunā tatra tena sā jāhnavī smṛtā / sā tu kiṃ varṇyate brahman pītāyā jahnunā purā
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: समुद्र अनादिकालसे चला आ रहा है, उसी प्रकार इस संसारसे छुड़ानेवाले भगवान् शिव भी अनादि हैं। जैसे ओषधि स्वभावसे ही रोगोंका निवारण करनेवाली है, उसी प्रकार भगवान् शिव भी
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: मया चुलुकमात्रेण शोषिताः सप्तसागराः । हरिश् च भगवान् शम्भुश् शम्भुश् च भगवान् इति
verses.transliteration: mayā culukamātreṇa śoṣitāḥ saptasāgarāḥ / hariś ca bhagavān śambhuś śambhuś ca bhagavān iti
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: स्वभावसे ही घोर संसार-बन्धनका नाश करनेवाले माने गये हैं। जैसे वैद्यके बिना रोगी क्लेश उठाते हैं, उसी प्रकार भगवान् शिवके बिना जगत् दुःख उठाता है। अतः अनादि,
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: विन्ध्यः सप्तशैलराजो नर्मदायाः प्रभावतः । तेनोद्धता देवमार्गा वर्तमानानि वारिताः
verses.transliteration: vindhyaḥ saptaśailarājo narmadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ / tenoddhatā devamārgā vartamānāni vāritāḥ
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: परिपूर्ण, परम शिव ही सबके त्राता सिवा दूसरा कोई पुरुष इस संसार: करनेवाला नहीं है। जो अपने शिवका चिन्तन करते हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञपर्वतपर्यङ्कावुभौ विन्ध्यस्तौ पुरा । मया निवारितौ बुद्ध्या देवमार्ग प्रवृत्तये
verses.transliteration: yajñaparvataparyaṅkāvubhau vindhyastau purā / mayā nivāritau buddhyā devamārga pravṛttaye
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: करते हैं, उन्हें अवश्य ज्ञान होता 'ऐसा जानकर शिवस्वरूपा
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विगर्हितो ब्रह्मा संवादेन परस्परम् । ततस् तुष्टाः सुराः सर्वे ह्य् अगस्त्यं प्रति भारत
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vigarhito brahmā saṃvādena parasparam / tatas tuṣṭāḥ surāḥ sarve hy agastyaṃ prati bhārata
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: लेकर उसके तटपर धन-धान्यसे सम्पन्न दिव्य
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात च । इति ते कथितो राजन्न् इतिहासः पुरातनः
verses.transliteration: devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca / iti te kathito rājann itihāsaḥ purātanaḥ
verses.translation: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणोंको आदरपूर्वक देने चाहिए । अनाथ, अत्यन्त वृद्ध, विकल एवं कुटुम्बी ब्राह्मणको विशेषरूपसे देना चाहिए। जो ब्राह्मणको काठ और मिट्टीसे बना हुआ गृह दान करता है अथवा उसके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the excellent river is called Kapila by persons conversant with the topics of the Puranas. This excellent river Kapila originating from the waters of Narmada dropping from the clothes should be considered highly meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे कुब्जामाहात्म्य एकविंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय २२ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कथं निवर्तितो यज्ञो रन्तिदेवस्य धीमतः । कण्वाश्रमपदे रम्ये रेवाकुब्जासमागमे

verses.transliteration: harikeśo 'bravīd vākyaṃ brāhmaṇīṃ prati bhārata / na mayā saṃcitaṃ dhānyaṃ na vittaṃ gṛhamedhinā
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: पावन हैं। मैं किस स्थानपर यज्ञ करूँ?
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामे ग्रामे भिक्षयित्वा सविभागं पृथक् पृथक् । ददामि परमं धान्यं नान्यां वृत्तिं तु कारये
verses.transliteration: grāme grāme bhikṣayitvā savibhāgaṃ pṛthak pṛthak / dadāmi paramaṃ dhānyaṃ nānyāṃ vṛttiṃ tu kāraye
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: अगस्त्यजीने कहा--राजन्! एकमात्र नर्मदादेवी ही पुण्यमयी और शुभ हैं। जम्बूद्वीप एक लाख योजनका बताया गया है, उसमें जितने भी चराचर प्राणी हैं, उनमेंसे जो तपस्यासे हीन हैं वे भी
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण्य् उवाच: बालहत्यासमं पापं बाले वृद्धे क्षुधार्दिते । तस्मात् प्रतिग्रहं कृत्वा भर्तव्या मम पुत्रकाः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇy uvāca: bālahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ bāle vṛddhe kṣudhārdite / tasmāt pratigrahaṃ kṛtvā bhartavyā mama putrakāḥ
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: नर्मदाका जलपान करनेसे भगवान् शिवके लोकमें जाते हैं। sean आदि शिवलिंग और वैदूर्य आदि पर्वत, द्वापर और कलियुगमें परम पावन होते हैं। नर्मदाके दक्षिण और उत्तर भागमें जो
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रेण लोकं जयति पुत्रेण सुखमेधते । पुत्रेण स्वर्गम् आप्नोति पितॄणां परमा गतिः
verses.transliteration: putreṇa lokaṃ jayati putreṇa sukhamedhate / putreṇa svargam āpnoti pitṝṇāṃ paramā gatiḥ
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: यह देव-दानववन्दित भूमि है इसे यज्ञभूमि कहते हैं। इसीमें अशोकवनिका है, जहाँ साक्षात् भगवान् महेश्वर निवास करते हैं। यहाँ किया हुआ यज्ञ बिना किसी विघ्न-बाधाके परिपूर्ण होता है ।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: अम्बरीषस्य नृपतेर् अयोध्याधिपतेः किल । वर्तमाने महायज्ञे कुरुक्षेत्रे द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: ambarīṣasya nṛpater ayodhyādhipateḥ kila / vartamāne mahāyajñe kurukṣetre dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: ऐसा भगवान् शंकरका कथन है ।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: गताश् च ब्राह्मणास् तत्र प्रतिग्रहजिघृक्षया । गाः कांचनं धनं प्राप्य शालग्रामनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: gatāś ca brāhmaṇās tatra pratigrahajighṛkṣayā / gāḥ kāṃcanaṃ dhanaṃ prāpya śālagrāmanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: राजा बोले--महामुने! आपका कल्याण हो, मैं आपके साथ वहीं चलूँगा।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: नानाभरणशोभाढ्या आगताः समलंकृताः । याहि यत्र द्विजाः सर्वे शालग्रामनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: nānābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā āgatāḥ samalaṃkṛtāḥ / yāhi yatra dvijāḥ sarve śālagrāmanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर मुनियोंसे घिरे हुए राजा रविश्चन्द्र नर्मदाके दक्षिण तटपर वर्तमान सुन्दर पुण्यतीर्थ: अशोकवनिकामें आये। वहाँ दस योजन विस्तृत. भि 'यज्ञमण्डप बनाया ee
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: सुतार्थं हरिकेशो ऽथ रक्षिते कुरुजाङ्गले । अम्बरीषस्य नृपतेर् वर्तमाने महामखे
verses.transliteration: sutārthaṃ harikeśo 'tha rakṣite kurujāṅgale / ambarīṣasya nṛpater vartamāne mahāmakhe
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: गये। उस मण्डपके सभी द्वार और: स्तम्भ मणि-  माणिक्य तथा रत्नोंकी राशिसे शोभा. HRA है थे
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वा ब्राह्मणीं पुत्रान् कुरुक्षेत्रं जगाम ह । प्रविष्टश्चाध्वरे तस्मिन् यत्र ते सन्ति ऋत्विजः
verses.transliteration: gṛhītvā brāhmaṇīṃ putrān kurukṣetraṃ jagāma ha / praviṣṭaścādhvare tasmin yatra te santi ṛtvijaḥ
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: सम्मिलित हुए। प्रचुर दक्षिणा पानेवाले ब्राह्मणोंने यज्ञ प्रारम्भ किया। सब देवता बड़े प्रसन्न और तृप्त हुए। इसी समय महान् क्रोधी दुर्वासाजी, यमराज, चित्रगुप्त, काल और मृत्यु भी आये।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मघोषस्वरेणैव स दृष्ट्वा दिवि देवताः । यमो ऽङ्गिरामुनिर् विष्णुर्वशिष्ठो दक्ष एव च
verses.transliteration: brahmaghoṣasvareṇaiva sa dṛṣṭvā divi devatāḥ / yamo 'ṅgirāmunir viṣṇurvaśiṣṭho dakṣa eva ca
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: उस यज्ञमें इनके लिये कोई भाग नहीं दिया गया था। यह देखकर ये सभी कुपित हो उठे। उन सबको रुष्ट देखकर राजा रविश्चन्द्रने कहा-- “यज्ञके समयमें कोई मनुष्य भी आ जाय तो
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: बृहद्विष्णुः प्रसन्नात्मा शातातपपराशरौ । आपस्तम्बोशनोव्यासाः कात्यायनबृहस्पती
verses.transliteration: bṛhadviṣṇuḥ prasannātmā śātātapaparāśarau / āpastambośanovyāsāḥ kātyāyanabṛhaspatī
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: वह चार भुजाधारी भगवान् विष्णुके समान पूजनीय होता है। आपलोगोंको भी मैं अभीष्ट वस्तु दूँगा। अतः प्रसन्न हों।' इस प्रकार राजाके द्वारा अर्घ्य, पाद्य आदि देकर प्रसन्न कराये जानेपर वे सब
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: हारीतः शङ्खलिखितौ याज्ञवल्क्यो ऽथ गौतमः । दुर्वासाः काश्यपो गर्गो भारद्वाजो ऽत्रिरेव च
verses.transliteration: hārītaḥ śaṅkhalikhitau yājñavalkyo 'tha gautamaḥ / durvāsāḥ kāśyapo gargo bhāradvājo 'trireva ca
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: मुनि सन्तुष्ट हुए। उस समय दुर्वासाजीने कहा- राजन्! पूर्वकालमें जटा और वल्कल धारण करनेवाले तपस्वीलोग नेपालमें देवताओंके देवता भगवान् पशुपतिकी
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: नारदः पर्वतश् चैव पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः । विभाण्डको भृगुश् चैव शाकटो बादरायणः
verses.transliteration: nāradaḥ parvataś caiva pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ / vibhāṇḍako bhṛguś caiva śākaṭo bādarāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: भक्तिभावसे पूजा करते थे, परंतु उनके साथ उन्होंने पार्वतीजीकी पूजा नहीं की। इसलिये पार्वतीजीने उन ब्राह्मणोंको शाप दिया--'तुमलोग एक सहस्र वर्षोतक कुत्तेकी योनिमें रहोगे।' तबसे
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: बालखिल्या ब्रह्मपुत्रा ब्रह्मतेजो वपुर्धराः । अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि ब्रह्मदण्डं समारुहन्
verses.transliteration: bālakhilyā brahmaputrā brahmatejo vapurdharāḥ / aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi brahmadaṇḍaṃ samāruhan
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: वे मुनीश्वर लोग कुत्तेकी योनिमें पड़े हुए हैं। राजन्! हमारा प्रिय करनेकी इच्छासे तुम उन सबको शापसे मुक्त कर दो। राजा बोले--मैं उन ब्राह्मणोंको उस शापसे
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: अम्बरीषो महाराज दृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवम् । ब्रह्मर्षींस् तान् नमस्कृत्य अर्घपाद्यैर् अपूजयत्
verses.transliteration: ambarīṣo mahārāja dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇapuṅgavam / brahmarṣīṃs tān namaskṛtya arghapādyair apūjayat
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: मुक्त करूँगा। ऐसा कहकर राजाने अपने दूतोंको वनमें भेजा। दूतोंने उन वनवासी मुनियोंको नमस्कार करके उनके पूर्वजन्मका स्मरण कराया। तब वे
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थमागतो विप्रसभार्यः सहपुत्रकैः । अनुग्रहम् इमं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: kimarthamāgato viprasabhāryaḥ sahaputrakaiḥ / anugraham imaṃ manye yanmāṃ vadasi suvrata
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: सब लोग अशोकवनिकामें आये। उन सबको देखकर चक्रवर्ती राजा रविश्चन्द्रने बडी प्रसन्नताके साथ कहा--' भगवान् अशोकेश्वर एवं नर्मदादेवीकी महिमासे, मेरे दानके प्रभावसे तथा महर्षियोंके
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: आतिथ्यकाले सम्प्राप्तो याचयस्व यथोचितम् । ब्राह्मण उवाच: वित्तं वर्षशतं यावदेकैकाय सुताय मे
verses.transliteration: ātithyakāle samprāpto yācayasva yathocitam / brāhmaṇa uvāca: vittaṃ varṣaśataṃ yāvadekaikāya sutāya me
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: प्रसादसे ये सब मुनि कुत्तेकी योनि त्याग कर शिवलोकमें चले जायँ और इनका सब पाप मुझमें आ जाय।' राजाके ऐसा कहते ही वे सब मुनि तत्क्षण
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं देहि जीवनायाश होमधेनुं तथोत्तमाम् । अयुतं तु गवां भूप हेमभारपरिष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ dehi jīvanāyāśa homadhenuṃ tathottamām / ayutaṃ tu gavāṃ bhūpa hemabhārapariṣkṛtam
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: शापसे मुक्त हो गये और राजासे इस प्रकार बोले--आप ही हमारे माता-पिता और मोक्षदाता गुरु हैं। ऐसा कहकर वे सब महर्षि उमामहेश्वर- धामको चले गये।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: कोटिमेकां हिरण्यस्य वस्त्रभूषणमुत्तमम् । इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा द्विजस्य पृथिवीपतिः
verses.transliteration: koṭimekāṃ hiraṇyasya vastrabhūṣaṇamuttamam / iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā dvijasya pṛthivīpatiḥ
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: तब सम्पूर्ण देवताओंने राजाको धन्यवाद दिया।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धया परया युक्तः सर्वं दत्त्वा यथोदितम् । शालग्रामपदं यानैः शीघ्रं प्रावेशयत् ततः
verses.transliteration: śraddhayā parayā yuktaḥ sarvaṃ dattvā yathoditam / śālagrāmapadaṃ yānaiḥ śīghraṃ prāveśayat tataḥ
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: फूलोंकी वर्षा हुई।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: क्रतुम् इष्ट्वा स राजर्षिर् मुमुदे देववच् चिरम् । नानाविधान् स भुक्त्वा ऽथ भोगान् पत्नीसुतैः सह
verses.transliteration: kratum iṣṭvā sa rājarṣir mumude devavac ciram / nānāvidhān sa bhuktvā 'tha bhogān patnīsutaiḥ saha
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: उस समय दुर्वासाजीने कहा--महाराज ! क्षत्रियोंमें मैंने तुम्हारे समान दूसरे किसीको न तो देखा है और न सुना ही है। मनुष्योंके लिये अपने प्राणोंको त्याग देना तो सुकर है, परंतु अपने संचित धर्मका
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: कालान्तरे ततः प्राप्ते ऋषिर् मृत्युवशं गतः । मरुदेशे निरुदके ब्रह्मरक्षस्त्वमागतः
verses.transliteration: kālāntare tataḥ prāpte ṛṣir mṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥ / marudeśe nirudake brahmarakṣastvamāgataḥ
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: त्याग करना बहुत ही कठिन है। तुम्हारा कल्याण हो, तुम कोई वर माँगो।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: राजप्रतिग्रहाद् दुष्टात् पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते । ब्राह्मण्यं यः परित्यज्य द्रव्यलोभेन मोहितः
verses.transliteration: rājapratigrahād duṣṭāt punarjanma na vidyate / brāhmaṇyaṃ yaḥ parityajya dravyalobhena mohitaḥ
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: तब राजा हँसते हुए बोले-मुने ! हमारे दानके प्रभावसे पापबुद्धिवाले मनुष्य भी उत्तम पदको प्राप्त हों, यही मेरा प्रिय वर है।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: विषयामिषलुब्धस् तु कुर्याद् राज प्रतिग्रहम् । नरके रौरवे घोरे तस्येह पतनं ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: viṣayāmiṣalubdhas tu kuryād rāja pratigraham / narake raurave ghore tasyeha patanaṃ dhruvam
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: “एवमस्तु'--ऐसा ही होगा-यह कहकर मुनिवर दुर्वासा वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये। अमित तेजस्वी राजाके उस अद्भुत कर्मको देखकर धर्मरजने - 'कहा--'राजन् ! मैं तुम्हें वर देता हूँ, जिसने अपना
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षादावाग्निना दग्धाः प्ररोहन्ति वनागमे । राजप्रतिग्रहाद् दग्धा न प्ररोहन्ति कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣādāvāgninā dagdhāḥ prarohanti vanāgame / rājapratigrahād dagdhā na prarohanti karhicit
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: उत्तम पुण्य दे दिया, उसने यमलोक और देवलोकको भी जीत लिया। राजेन्द्र! तुम अवश्य वर पानेके
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: शोचन्ति पूर्व जन्मानि अन्यजन्मकृतानि च । भार्यापुत्रकृतेनैव गतो ऽहं नरकार्णवम्
verses.transliteration: śocanti pūrva janmāni anyajanmakṛtāni ca / bhāryāputrakṛtenaiva gato 'haṃ narakārṇavam
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: रविश्चन्द्र बोले-सूर्यनन्दन! मेरे सौ यज्ञ, दान और तपस्याके प्रभावसे वे सभी पापी जीव:  शिवधामको प्राप्त हो जायुँ जो इस समय पापयोनिं: पड़े हुए हैं। मैं इसी वरको प्राप्त करना चाहता
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा कुरुक्षेत्रं पुत्रदारादिभिः सह । तत्र द्वादशवर्षाणि उषित्वा सुबुभुक्षितः
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā kurukṣetraṃ putradārādibhiḥ saha / tatra dvādaśavarṣāṇi uṣitvā sububhukṣitaḥ
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: हूँ, आप मुझपर कृपा करें।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: उच्छिष्टं कश्मलं भुङ्क्ते राक्षसीं योनिमाश्रितः । वाराणसीं प्रयागं तु पुष्करं नैमिषं तथा
verses.transliteration: ucchiṣṭaṃ kaśmalaṃ bhuṅkte rākṣasīṃ yonimāśritaḥ / vārāṇasīṃ prayāgaṃ tu puṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ tathā
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: यमराजने कहा-सत्यधर्मका पालन करनेवाले राजेन्द्र! तुम्हारी यह इच्छा पूर्ण हो। सुव्रत! इस सत्यके प्रभावसे तुम उत्तम लोकको जाओ।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गासागरसम् भेदं क्षेत्रं कनखलं तथा । केदारं च महापुण्यं प्रभासं शशिभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāsāgarasam bhedaṃ kṣetraṃ kanakhalaṃ tathā / kedāraṃ ca mahāpuṇyaṃ prabhāsaṃ śaśibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: अन्यान्य जीवोंका पापसे उद्धार किया है, उनः सबकी कोई गणना नहीं है।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: अटित्वा सर्वतीर्थानि पापयोनिरतो नृप । चिन्तयामास देहं मे न निवृत्तं कथंचन
verses.transliteration: aṭitvā sarvatīrthāni pāpayonirato nṛpa / cintayāmāsa dehaṃ me na nivṛttaṃ kathaṃcana
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर धर्मराज देव-दानववन्दित कामिक 'विमानपर आरूढ़ हो अपने लोकको चले गये '
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् पापविशद्ध्यर्थं प्रविशामि हुताशनम् । भार्या तस्य सपुत्रा वै भर्तारं सुव्रता ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt pāpaviśaddhyarthaṃ praviśāmi hutāśanam / bhāryā tasya saputrā vai bhartāraṃ suvratā 'bravīt
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: वागीश्वरतीर्थमें राजा ब्रह्मदत्तके यज्ञमें प्रेतोंका उद्धार तथा सहस्त्रावर्त आदि तीर्थोकी महिमा
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: किंचिद् विज्ञापयामि त्वां यदि मां मन्यसे विभो । क्षणमात्रेण दुःखेन साधयामि सुखं बहु
verses.transliteration: kiṃcid vijñāpayāmi tvāṃ yadi māṃ manyase vibho / kṣaṇamātreṇa duḥkhena sādhayāmi sukhaṃ bahu
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं-नर्मदाके उत्तर तटपर वागीश्वर नामका एक पुर है, वहाँ वागु नामवाली नदी नर्मदाके साथ मिली है। उस संगममें जो स्नान करते हैं वे स्वर्गको जाते हैं और जो मरते
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणस्य हि धर्मो ऽयं सर्वस् तद् वह्णिसाधनेन । तत्समाहृत्य दारूणि प्रदीप्य च हुताशनम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇasya hi dharmo 'yaṃ sarvas tad vahṇisādhanena / tatsamāhṛtya dārūṇi pradīpya ca hutāśanam
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: हैं वे मुक्त हो जाते हैं। वहाँ दानवोंका विनाश करनेवाली वागीशा चामुण्डा रहती हैं। मणिभद्र और वीरभद्र आदि सैकड़ों राजा उस तीर्थके प्रभावसे शापमुक्त हुए हैं। वहाँ तिलसहित पिण्डदान
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: अहं विशाम्यविधवा भर्तारं प्रथमं द्रुतम् । न पश्यामि पतन्तं वै ज्वलने दारुणे भृशम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ viśāmyavidhavā bhartāraṃ prathamaṃ drutam / na paśyāmi patantaṃ vai jvalane dāruṇe bhṛśam
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: करनेसे पितरोंको उत्तम गति प्राप्त होती है। सूर्यवंशमें अयोध्याके चक्रवर्ती राजा ब्रह्मदत्त प्रसिद्ध हैं। वे धन-धान्यसे सम्पन्न तथा भय और दरिद्रतासे रहित थे। उनके शासनकालमें समस्त प्रजा बड़े
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: उक्ता सा ऽकाशवाण्या च मा ते मृत्युभयं शुभे । श्रूयतां मम वाक्यं हि यथा धर्मो न हीयते
verses.transliteration: uktā sā 'kāśavāṇyā ca mā te mṛtyubhayaṃ śubhe / śrūyatāṃ mama vākyaṃ hi yathā dharmo na hīyate
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: आनन्दसे रहती थी। उन्होंने नर्मदा और वागुके संगममें एक श्रेष्ठ यज्ञ किया था, जिसमें ब्रह्मा, इन्द्र, विष्णु, गणेश तथा महादेवजी आदिने प्रत्यक्ष प्रकट होकर अपना भाग ग्रहण किया। राजा
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: कुब्जारेवासमायोगे ब्रह्मरक्षोविमोक्षणम् । तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं याति बिल्वाम्रकम् अर्चनात्
verses.transliteration: kubjārevāsamāyoge brahmarakṣovimokṣaṇam / tatra snātvā divaṃ yāti bilvāmrakam arcanāt
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मदत्तकी यज्ञभूमि दस योजनतक फैली हुई थी। उनका यह यज्ञ स्वारोचिष मन्वन्तरके आदि- कल्पवाले सत्ययुगमें हुआ था। उस समय ब्रह्मदत्तके यज्ञसे तथा वागीश्वर और नर्मदाके प्रसादसे प्रेतोंको
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: लभते ब्रह्मलोकं च रक्षोयोनेश् च मोक्षणम् । ब्रह्मराक्षस उवाच: का ऽसि त्वं च वरारोहे कस्य चासि यशस्विनि
verses.transliteration: labhate brahmalokaṃ ca rakṣoyoneś ca mokṣaṇam / brahmarākṣasa uvāca: kā 'si tvaṃ ca varārohe kasya cāsi yaśasvini
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: भी बड़ी तृप्ति हुई। वे प्रेत पहलेके वानप्रस्थ ऋषि थे। उन्होंने स्त्रियोंके आग्रहसे सूर्यग्रहणके अवसरपर कुरुक्षेत्रमें बहुत-सा दान लिया था। इसीसे वे प्रेतभावको प्राप्त हुए थे। प्रेत होनेपर
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: अनुग्रहार्थं भूतानां पूर्वजन्म कृतैः शुभैः । आकाशवाण्य् उवाच: धन्या ऽहं सर्वभूतानामव्यक्ताव्यक्तरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: anugrahārthaṃ bhūtānāṃ pūrvajanma kṛtaiḥ śubhaiḥ / ākāśavāṇy uvāca: dhanyā 'haṃ sarvabhūtānāmavyaktāvyaktarūpiṇī
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: भी उन्हें पूर्वजन्मका स्मरण बना रहा। अतः एकान्तमें बैठकर वे अपने विषयमें इस प्रकार शोक करने लगे--' अहो! जिनके लिये हमने प्रतिग्रह स्वीकार किया, वे हमारे पुत्र, पत्नी,
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुस्त्वा तु सा देवी तत्रैवान्तरधीयत । पुत्रदारान्वितो नत्वा हरिकेशः सुरेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: evamustvā tu sā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata / putradārānvito natvā harikeśaḥ sureśvaram
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: भृत्य और भाई-बन्धु तो ज्यों-के-त्यों बने हुए हैं; वे उस प्रतिग्रहकी आगमें दग्ध नहीं हुए हैं। हमें अकेले ही उस आगमें जलना पड़ा है। यमदूतोंसे पकड़े हुए प्राणियोंके साथ उनके माता-
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: सम्प्राप्त सुमुदायुक्तः कुब्जारेवासमागमम् । तत्र स्नात्वा यथान्यायम् अर्चयित्वा महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: samprāpta sumudāyuktaḥ kubjārevāsamāgamam / tatra snātvā yathānyāyam arcayitvā maheśvaram
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: नहीं जाते, एकमात्र धर्म ही उनका साथ देता है।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: हुताशनं प्रविविशुः स्मृत्वा देवं हारिं हरम् । स्वीयं गृहमिवाक्लेशाः कामक्रोधविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: hutāśanaṃ praviviśuḥ smṛtvā devaṃ hāriṃ haram / svīyaṃ gṛhamivākleśāḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार दीर्घकालतक शोक करके स्त्री- पुत्रसे रहित हुए वे प्रेतगण सारी पृथ्वीपर घूम- घामकर नारदजीके उपदेशसे उमापति शिवका ध्यान करते हुए उसी वागीशपुरमें चले आये।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: तत्क्षणाद् दिव्यदेहास् तु ब्रह्मतेजोवपुर्धराः । दिव्ययानं समारुह्य ब्रह्मलोकम् अवाप्नुयुः
verses.transliteration: tatkṣaṇād divyadehās tu brahmatejovapurdharāḥ / divyayānaṃ samāruhya brahmalokam avāpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: वहाँ स्नान करके उन्होंने भगवान् शिव, विष्णु और सूर्यदेवका पूजन किया। ब्रह्मदत्ते उस यज्ञमें आकर वे सभी पापमुक्त हो गये और ब्रह्माजीके लोकमें गये। तदनन्तर राजा ब्रह्मदत्तके
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रदारसमायुक्तो हरिकेशो नृपोत्तम । तस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्याद् दिवि दीव्यति देववत्
verses.transliteration: putradārasamāyukto harikeśo nṛpottama / tasya tīrthasya māhātmyād divi dīvyati devavat
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: ऊपर फूलोंकी वर्षा होने लगी। मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं-युधिष्ठिर! प्रतिग्रह एक भारी ग्रह है। जो लोभ और मोहसे मोहित हो उस ग्रहसे ग्रस्त हो गये हैं, वे घोर नरकमें
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: शतमष्टोत्तरं तत्र लिङ्गानां पुण्यसङ्गमे । मार्कण्डेश्वरम् इत्येकं मधुरेश्वरम् एव च
verses.transliteration: śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tatra liṅgānāṃ puṇyasaṅgame / mārkaṇḍeśvaram ityekaṃ madhureśvaram eva ca
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: डूबते हैं। यद्यपि वेदोक्त यज्ञ और तीर्थयात्रा आदि सत्कर्म भी सफल होते हैं, उनके द्वारा सद्गतिमें सहायता मिलती है, तथापि प्रतिग्रह (दान) लेनेवाले मनुष्य अपने आत्माको क्लेश
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: शूलपाणिं तथैवान्यम् अगस्त्येश्वरम् एव च । एतान्य् अन्यानि चैवेह सिद्धलिङ्गानि सन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: śūlapāṇiṃ tathaivānyam agastyeśvaram eva ca / etāny anyāni caiveha siddhaliṅgāni santi vai
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: देते हैं। दाता और याचककी क्या गति होती है, इसकी सूचना उनके हाथोंसे ही मिल जाती है। देनेवाला ऊपरको जाता है और लेनेवाला नीचेको। 'सहस्रावर्तक नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक तीर्थ  1वहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् सर्वं यथा न्यायं कथितं तव सुव्रत । कुब्जारेवासमायोगं सुरासुरनिषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: etat sarvaṃ yathā nyāyaṃ kathitaṃ tava suvrata / kubjārevāsamāyogaṃ surāsuraniṣevitam
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: विधिपूर्वक स्नान करनेवाले पुरुषको वृषोत्सर्गका फल प्राप्त होता है और वह अपनी सात पीढ़ीतकको पवित्र कर देता है । नर्मदाके उत्तर तटपर यह तीर्थ सहस्र धनुषतक फैला हुआ है । उसके अन्तमें
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातर्यः कीर्तयेद् भक्त्या नर्मदां सप्तकल्पगाम् । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः स शैवं लभते पुरम्
verses.transliteration: prātaryaḥ kīrtayed bhaktyā narmadāṃ saptakalpagām / sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa śaivaṃ labhate puram
verses.translation: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.hindi: काराका उत्तम वन है। वहाँ स्नान करनेसे अग्निष्टोम यज्ञका फल मिलता है और मनुष्य स्वर्गलोकको जाता है । नर्मदाके उत्तर भागमें सौगन्धिक नामक परम सुन्दर वन है, जिसमें प्रवेश करके मनुष्य
verses.wordMeaning: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, of what avail is the verbose talk? If one does not wish to see again the terrible ocean of worldly existence, one should always resort to Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे कुब्जामाहात्म्ये त्रयोविंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय २४ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: समुत्पत्तिं च कुब्जाया यस्यां विमलमानसाः । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्ता गन्धर्वो रगराक्षसाः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe kubjāmāhātmye trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 24 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: samutpattiṃ ca kubjāyā yasyāṃ vimalamānasāḥ / sarvapāpavinirmuktā gandharvo ragarākṣasāḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: सब पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है । तदनन्तर नदियोंमें उत्तम सरस्वती नदी हैं। उनके जलमें स्नान करना चाहिए । वहाँ देवताओं और पितरोंका तर्पण करके मनुष्य अश्वमेध यज्ञका फल पाता है। व
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वै श्रोतुम् इच्छामि विस्तरेण महामुने । कथ्यतां मुनिशार्दूल समाख्यानं पुरातनम्
verses.transliteration: etad vai śrotum icchāmi vistareṇa mahāmune / kathyatāṃ muniśārdūla samākhyānaṃ purātanam
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: ईशानाध्युषित नामक परम दुर्लभ तीर्थ है । नरश्रेष्ठ! ल्‍ योग, संक्रान्ति और ग्रहणके समय उस
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: शृणु राजन् कथां दिव्यां सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् । चित्राङ्गदः शक्रसुतो गन्धर्वः काममोहितः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu rājan kathāṃ divyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm / citrāṅgadaḥ śakrasuto gandharvaḥ kāmamohitaḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: तीर्थमें स्नान करके मनुष्य सहस्र कपिला गौओं, सुगन्धित पदार्थों और सुवर्णोके दानका तथा पंच- यज्ञोंके अनुष्ठानका फल पाकर स्वर्गलोकमें प्रतिष्ठित होता है। भारत! वहीँ त्रिशूल नामक तीर्थ है।
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: समालम्ब्य कुमारीणां दशलक्षाणि भारत । रेमे यथेच्छया सो ऽपि पश्चान् मुक्तश् च किल्विषात्
verses.transliteration: samālambya kumārīṇāṃ daśalakṣāṇi bhārata / reme yathecchayā so 'pi paścān muktaś ca kilviṣāt
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: वहाँ जाकर जो स्नान और देवता-पितरोंका पूजन करता है, वह देहत्यागके पश्चात् गणपति-पदको
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: आख्यानं कथयिष्यामि यथावृत्त पुरातनम् । सुवर्णो नाम गन्धर्वस् तस्य भार्या यशस्विनी
verses.transliteration: ākhyānaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yathāvṛtta purātanam / suvarṇo nāma gandharvas tasya bhāryā yaśasvinī
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त होता है । युधिष्ठिर! नर्मदाके उत्तर तटपर ब्रह्मोद नामसे विख्यात एक तीर्थ है जो इच्छानुसार भोग एवं फल देनेवाला है । यहाँपर श्राद्धका दान देनेसे पितर ब्रह्मलोकमें जाते हैं । नर्मदाके उत्तर
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: हेमगर्भेति विख्याता शक्रस्यैव यथा शची । सुता तस्याः सुकामेति विदितानङ्गमोहिनी
verses.transliteration: hemagarbheti vikhyātā śakrasyaiva yathā śacī / sutā tasyāḥ sukāmeti viditānaṅgamohinī
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: भागमें अत्यन्त उत्तम सोमतीर्थ है । वहाँ स्नान करके मनुष्य स्वर्गलोकमें सम्मानित होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना ऊढा वै धनदेन सा । गौर्याराधनयोगेन तस्याः पुत्रो ऽप्य् अजायत
verses.transliteration: rūpayauvanasampannā ūḍhā vai dhanadena sā / gauryārādhanayogena tasyāḥ putro 'py ajāyata
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: देवपथतीर्थ, शुक्लतीर्थ, दीप्तिकेश्वरकी महिमा, देवासुरोंके द्वारा महादेवजीकी स्तुति तथा वैष्णव तीर्थकी महिमा
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: केतुमाल इति ख्यातो राजा वैद्याधरे पुरे । शशिरेखा प्रिया तस्य भार्व्या वै रूपशालिनी
verses.transliteration: ketumāla iti khyāto rājā vaidyādhare pure / śaśirekhā priyā tasya bhārvyā vai rūpaśālinī
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--तदनन्तर देवपथ नामक सर्वदेवमय शुभ तीर्थ है। उसमें विधिपूर्वक स्नान करनेवाला पुरुष सब यज्ञोंका फल पाता है। वहीं देवपथ नामसे प्रसिद्ध शिवलिंग भी है, जिसका
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: द्वे कन्ये जनयामास रतिः प्रीतिर्मनोरमे । ददौ स कामदेवाय पाणिग्रहणपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: dve kanye janayāmāsa ratiḥ prītirmanorame / dadau sa kāmadevāya pāṇigrahaṇapūrvakam
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: श्रद्धापूर्वक दर्शन करनेसे पितरोंकी उत्तम गति होती है। वहीं सहस्रयज्ञ नामका उत्तम तीर्थ है, जहाँ मार्गशीर्ष मासमें एकादशी तिथिको भगवान् विष्णुकी पूजा करके मनुष्य सहस््र यज्ञोंक अनुष्ठानका
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: कन्यानां दशलक्षाणि भूषणैर् भूषितानि च । तास् तु यानसमारूढाः कामरूपा मनोरमाः
verses.transliteration: kanyānāṃ daśalakṣāṇi bhūṣaṇair bhūṣitāni ca / tās tu yānasamārūḍhāḥ kāmarūpā manoramāḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: "फल पाता है । उस तीर्थके प्रभावसे वह पापरहित हो जाता है। वह यमलोकको नहीं देखता और पशु-पक्षियोंकी योनिमें भी नहीं जाता । तदनन्तर शुक्लतीर्थमें जाय। उसमें स्नान करनेवाला मनुष्य
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रवस्त्राभरणा गौर्याराधन तत् परा । तावन्न भुज्यते ताभिस् ताम्बूलं भोजनादिकम्
verses.transliteration: vicitravastrābharaṇā gauryārādhana tat parā / tāvanna bhujyate tābhis tāmbūlaṃ bhojanādikam
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: दस गोदानका फल पाता है। शुक्लतीर्थ आठ हाथका है। वहाँ कालाग्निरुद्र तथा श्रीकण्ठदेव हैं। पूर्वकालमें इन्द्रने भी देवदेव उमापतिको नर्मदाके जलसे नहलाकर बिल्वपत्रोद्वारा उनका पूजन किया
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: यावन्न कार्यम् अस्माभिर् इति सङ्कल्पमादधुः । नित्यं तैर्यत्रिकं तास् तु चक्रुः सर्वा समाहिता
verses.transliteration: yāvanna kāryam asmābhir iti saṅkalpamādadhuḥ / nityaṃ tairyatrikaṃ tās tu cakruḥ sarvā samāhitā
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: था। शुक्लतीर्थके प्रभावसे ही देवता उद्दीप्त हो रहे हैं। वहीं कश्यपजीका देवताओं और सिद्धोंसे सेवित पुण्य आश्रम है। वहाँ दस हजार मुनि शुक्लेश्वरकी उपासना करते हैं। कुबेरने सूर्यग्रहणके
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: वसन्ते समनुप्राप्ते द्रष्टुं प्रेक्षणकं पुरा । पुष्पकेण विमानेन जग्मुस् ता इन्द्रमन्दिरम्
