verses.transliteration: vasante samanuprāpte draṣṭuṃ prekṣaṇakaṃ purā / puṣpakeṇa vimānena jagmus tā indramandiram
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: अवसरपर शुक्लतीर्थमें चन्दन, अगर, कपूर, फूल- माला, चैंदोवा, ध्वज तथा दीपमाला आदि उपचारोंसे 'महेश्वरका पूजन किया था। अतः उस तीर्थके क ्रभावसे ही वे यक्षोंके राजा ee आहाती
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडयित्वा यथा न्यायं मदिरामदविह्वलाः । अदृष्ट्वैव भवानीं ताश् चक्रे ताम्बूलभक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: krīḍayitvā yathā nyāyaṃ madirāmadavihvalāḥ / adṛṣṭvaiva bhavānīṃ tāś cakre tāmbūlabhakṣaṇam
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: हुए हैं। उसी तीर्थके प्रभावसे देवता नाना प्रकारके भोग प्राप्त किये हैं। वह तीर्थ
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: चित्राङ्गदस्य चापारं रूपं दृष्ट्वा वराङ्गनाः । मोहिता ना ऽभिजानन्ति मदिरोन्मत्तमानसाः
verses.transliteration: citrāṅgadasya cāpāraṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā varāṅganāḥ / mohitā nā 'bhijānanti madironmattamānasāḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: सर्वतीर्थमय और सर्वदेवमय है । वहाँ स्नान और महादेवजीका पूजन करके मनुष्य सब देवताओं और हैत्योंके गणोंसे पूजित होता है ।
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: तैश् चापि कामिताः सर्वा गन्धर्व्यो मुदिताननाः । नानाविधैस् तथा कार्यैश् चिक्रीडुर्मन्मथाद् दिवि
verses.transliteration: taiś cāpi kāmitāḥ sarvā gandharvyo muditānanāḥ / nānāvidhais tathā kāryaiś cikrīḍurmanmathād divi
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: राजन्! ययाति नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक चक्रवर्ती राजा हो गये हैं। उन्होंने बड़े-बड़े यज्ञोंद्रार भगवान् यज्ञपुरुषका पूजन किया है। जहाँ पुण्यसलिला मधुमती नदी नर्मदाके साथ मिली है, वहाँ उन्होंने
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: अतीते वत्सरे तास् तु गन्धर्वपुरमागताः । गौरीं द्रष्टुं समाजग्मुर् उमा माहेश्वरं पुरम्
verses.transliteration: atīte vatsare tās tu gandharvapuramāgatāḥ / gaurīṃ draṣṭuṃ samājagmur umā māheśvaraṃ puram
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मण-ऋत्विजोंके साथ यज्ञ प्रारम्भ किया था! वहीं मध्येश्वरलिंग है जहाँ साक्षात् भगवान् महेश्वर निवास करते हैं। वहाँ स्नान करनेवाले स्वर्गमें जाते हैं और जो वहाँ मरते हैं वे मुक्त हो
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कृत्य ततो देवीम् इदं वचनम् अब्रुवन् । रक्षस्वास्माकमीशानि च्युतानां नियमात् स्वकात्
verses.transliteration: namaskṛtya tato devīm idaṃ vacanam abruvan / rakṣasvāsmākamīśāni cyutānāṃ niyamāt svakāt
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: जाते हैं। उसी स्थानपर भगवान् विष्णुने मधु और कैटभ नामक हैत्योंका वध किया था। वहाँ श्रीविष्णुदेवके पूजनसे सहस्र गोदानका फल मिलता है। उस तीर्थमें तिलोंके साथ जलदान
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: ततश् चुकोप देवी तान् पापकर्मरतान् प्रति । व्रतादिकं हता ये ये परदाराविदूषकाः
verses.transliteration: tataś cukopa devī tān pāpakarmaratān prati / vratādikaṃ hatā ye ye paradārāvidūṣakāḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: और पिण्डदान करनेसे पितर चौदह इन्द्रोंकी स्थिति-कालतक तृप्त रहते हैं। ययातिका यज्ञ पूर्ण होनेके पश्चात् वहाँ पातालसे कालाग्निके समान कान्तिमान् एक शिवलिंग प्रकट हुआ।
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: अपत्रपा दुराचाराः सर्वलोकबहिष्कृताः । तद् अधर्मस्य पापस्यानिष्कृतिर् धरणीतले
verses.transliteration: apatrapā durācārāḥ sarvalokabahiṣkṛtāḥ / tad adharmasya pāpasyāniṣkṛtir dharaṇītale
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: भारत! उस लिंगकी प्रभासे सम्पूर्ण जगत् उज्वल हो गया। तब लिंगरूपधारी भगवान् वृषध्वजने राजा ययातिसे कहा--राजन्! तुम्हारा कल्याण  हो, तुम कोई वर माँगो।'
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: कुमारीं कामयेद् यस् तु कामलोभेन मोहितः । षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि विष्ठायां जायते कृमिः
verses.transliteration: kumārīṃ kāmayed yas tu kāmalobhena mohitaḥ / ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: ययाति बोले-देव! आप भगवती पार्वतीके  साथ यहाँ रहें और इस स्थानका कभी त्याग  न करें। यहाँ किये हुए यज्ञ, दान आदि सब
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे राजंस् ततश्चैत्राङ्गदः स्तुवन् । प्रणम्य शिरसा देवीम् इदं वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: etasminn antare rājaṃs tataścaitrāṅgadaḥ stuvan / praṇamya śirasā devīm idaṃ vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: कार्य सदा अक्षय हों। तपस्या और दानसे रहित पापी मनुष्य भी यहाँ स्नान करके शुक्लतीर्थके प्रभावसे आपके लोकमें चले जायँ।
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: शापस्य स भयाद् भूरि विललाप नराधिप । अकार्यं कृतम् अस्माभिर् गन्धर्वतनयान्वितैः
verses.transliteration: śāpasya sa bhayād bhūri vilalāpa narādhipa / akāryaṃ kṛtam asmābhir gandharvatanayānvitaiḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: महादेवजीने कहा--राजन्! तुमने जो कुछ कहा है, वह सब सत्य होगा ।
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तं किम् अस्याद्य पापस्य गद निष्कृतिम् । उवाच वचनं देवी गन्धर्वं काममोहितम्
verses.transliteration: prāyaścittaṃ kim asyādya pāpasya gada niṣkṛtim / uvāca vacanaṃ devī gandharvaṃ kāmamohitam
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् सब देवता अपने-अपने विमानपर आरूढ़ हो स्वर्गलोकको चले गये। राजर्षि ययाति भी दीर्घकालतक राज्यका पालन करके अन्तमें स्वर्गलोकको गये।
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मक्रियाविलुप्तस्य स्वर्गलोकच्युतस्य च । कुमारीदूषणे पापं महतां लोमहर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: dharmakriyāviluptasya svargalokacyutasya ca / kumārīdūṣaṇe pāpaṃ mahatāṃ lomaharṣaṇam
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--दीप्तिकेश्वर नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक सिद्धलिंग कहा गया है, जिससे श्रेष्ठ तीनों लोकोंमें दूसरा कोई भी प्रसिद्ध नहीं है। दीप्तिकेश्वर देवका दर्शन, स्पर्श और पूजन करनेसे
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: कुमारीदूषणे पापे निष्कृतिर् न विधीयते । मम गन्धर्वकन्याश् च मधुपानैर् विडम्बिताः
verses.transliteration: kumārīdūṣaṇe pāpe niṣkṛtir na vidhīyate / mama gandharvakanyāś ca madhupānair viḍambitāḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: अनेक जन्मोंका घोर पाप क्षणभरमें नष्ट हो जाता है। जो मानव एक दिन या दो घड़ी भी उनकी पूजा करता है वह इस भयानक संसार-समुद्रमें फिर जन्म नहीं लेता।
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: यूयं त्व् अनेन पापेन गन्धर्वाः काममोहिताः । कुब्जावामनहीनाङ्गा भविष्यथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: yūyaṃ tv anena pāpena gandharvāḥ kāmamohitāḥ / kubjāvāmanahīnāṅgā bhaviṣyatha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: महादेवजीकी स्तुति इस प्रकार की गयी-- भगवान् शिव सदा रहनेवाले, अचल, प्रभा, प्रकाशरूप,
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यवर्षसहस्रं तु मर्त्यलोके चरिष्यथ । कन्याविकृतदोषेण कुब्जामर्कटकाननाः
verses.transliteration: divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu martyaloke cariṣyatha / kanyāvikṛtadoṣeṇa kubjāmarkaṭakānanāḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: पापहारी, श्वेतवर्ण, सब प्राणियोंका संहार करनेवाले, सर्वसमर्थ, संसारके कारण, वैराग्य एवं मोक्षके कारण, संयमरूप, सनातन, अटल, श्मशानवासी, भगवान्, आकाशमें विचरनेवाले, इन्द्रियोंमें व्याप्त,
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: स्वकर्मकृतदोषेण पापं भुञ्जन्तु भूतले । एव शप्तास् तु ते देव्या सर्वे मर्त्य समागमन्
verses.transliteration: svakarmakṛtadoṣeṇa pāpaṃ bhuñjantu bhūtale / eva śaptās tu te devyā sarve martya samāgaman
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: वन्दना करनेयोग्य, महान् कर्म करनेवाले, तपस्वी, समस्त प्राणियोंको उत्पन्न करनेवाले, मतवाले वेषमें अपने स्वरूपको छिपाये रखनेवाले, सम्पूर्ण लोकोंकी प्रजाके पालक और स्वामी, विराट्स्वरूप,
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: शोचन्तः स्वानि कर्माणि पूर्वजन्मकृतानि च । बभ्रमुः सर्वतीर्थानि लोके चैव चराचरे
verses.transliteration: śocantaḥ svāni karmāṇi pūrvajanmakṛtāni ca / babhramuḥ sarvatīrthāni loke caiva carācare
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: विशाल शरीरवाले, समस्त लोकोंकी सृष्टि करनेवाले ब्रह्म, समस्त प्राणियोंके परमात्मा, विविध रूपोंवाले, छोटे रूपवाले, मनन करनेवाले, सम्पूर्ण विश्वके पालक, छिपे रूपवाले, सदाप्रसन्न, संसार-बन्धनका
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: विषण्णवदनास् सर्वे पापेना ऽनेन कार्षिताः । शापस्या ऽन्तं न विन्दन्ति सर्वतीर्थान् भ्रमन्त्यपि
verses.transliteration: viṣaṇṇavadanās sarve pāpenā 'nena kārṣitāḥ / śāpasyā 'ntaṃ na vindanti sarvatīrthān bhramantyapi
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: नाश करनेवाले, प्रवृत्तिमार्गमें स्थित, महान् अंगोंवाले, समष्टिरूप, सबके सुनिश्चित आधार, सब
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: एकविंशतिलक्षाणि गन्धर्वाणि तथा ऽनघ । न देवा न च तीर्थानि पापस्या ऽस्य विशुद्धये
verses.transliteration: ekaviṃśatilakṣāṇi gandharvāṇi tathā 'nagha / na devā na ca tīrthāni pāpasyā 'sya viśuddhaye
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: 'कामनाओंसे सम्पन्न, स्वतः प्रकट होनेवाले, आदि और अन्त अर्थात् सृष्टि और संहार करनेवाले, जीवोंके आश्रय, सहस्रं नेत्रोंवाले, भयंकर नेत्रोंवाले, चन्द्रस्वरूप अथवा उमासहित, नक्षत्रोंको सिद्ध
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: नान्यद् वा युज्यते कर्म मुक्त्वा चैव हुताशनम् । कर्मणां दोषदाहेन मुञ्चामः पापकर्मणः
verses.transliteration: nānyad vā yujyate karma muktvā caiva hutāśanam / karmaṇāṃ doṣadāhena muñcāmaḥ pāpakarmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले, चन्द्र, सूर्य, शनि, केतु, ग्रह, ग्रहपति, श्रेष्ठ, तपस्याके साक्षी, बलस्वरूप, खड़े रहनेवाले, यज्ञरूपी मृगपर बाण चलानेवाले, पापरहित, महान् तपस्वी, दीर्घकालतक तपस्या करनेवाले, सबकी
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: दत्तो ऽस्माकं महाशापो पापमार्गनिवर्तकः । एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे प्राप्तः सकुबेरः पुराधिपः
verses.transliteration: datto 'smākaṃ mahāśāpo pāpamārganivartakaḥ / etasminn antare prāptaḥ sakuberaḥ purādhipaḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: उत्पत्तिके आदिकारण, दीनोंपर दया करनेवाले, सूर्यरूपसे वर्ष पूरा करनेवाले, मन्त्र, प्रमाण, परम तपःस्वरूप, योगी, योगकी महान् शक्तिसे सम्पन्न, महान् वीर्यवाले, हर, महाचेता, सर्वज्ञ, कारणसहित,
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: सम्प्राप्तो नैमिषारण्ये यत्र चित्राङ्गदादयः । तान् दृष्ट्वा सो ऽब्रवीद् देवः क्षणमात्रं प्रतीक्षत
verses.transliteration: samprāpto naimiṣāraṇye yatra citrāṅgadādayaḥ / tān dṛṣṭvā so 'bravīd devaḥ kṣaṇamātraṃ pratīkṣata
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: संहारकारी, हरण करनेवाले, कमण्डलुधारी, धनुष धारण करनेवाले, सबके प्राणोंको अपने हाथपर रखनेवाले, प्रतापवान्, जीवात्मारूप, अपनेसे भिन्न अन्य किसी ईश्वरसे रहित, शूलधारी, खट्वांगधारी,
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: उमामाहेश्वरे यावद् वच्मि गत्वा यथोदितम् । एवम् उक्त्वा ययौ देवः कैलासं पर्वतोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: umāmāheśvare yāvad vacmi gatvā yathoditam / evam uktvā yayau devaḥ kailāsaṃ parvatottamam
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: प्रकट करनेवाले, आश्रयस्वरूप, मुकुट धारण करनेवाले, सुमुख, जलमें रहनेवाले, विस्तार करनेवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: साष्टाङ्गं च नमस्कृत्य उमया सहितं हरम् । जय देवि सुरेशानि संसारार्णवतारिणि
verses.transliteration: sāṣṭāṅgaṃ ca namaskṛtya umayā sahitaṃ haram / jaya devi sureśāni saṃsārārṇavatāriṇi
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: तीर्थरूप, अपनी ओर आकृष्ट करनेवाले; शृगालेश्वररूपसे प्रकट, सर्वप्रयोजनरूप, YS धारण करनेवाले गणेशरूप, निर्मल, जलके आधारभूत कमण्डलुकी भाँति सम्पूर्ण संसारके आश्रय, अजन्मा,
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया सृष्टम् इदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । व्यापिनी शक्तिरूपेण सर्वेषां प्राणिनाम् अपि
verses.transliteration: tvayā sṛṣṭam idaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / vyāpinī śaktirūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ prāṇinām api
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: सुगन्धित माला धारण करनेवाले, हरिंणरूपधारी, कपाल धारण करनेवाले, जिनके वीर्यकी गति ऊपरकी ओर है ऐसे, ऊपरके लोकोंके साक्षी, ऊँची उठी हुई भुजाओंवाले, नभ, अष्टमूर्तियोमेंसे
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवम् आदिभिर् वाक्यैर् देवीं तुष्टाव वासवः । स्तोत्रैः स्तुता महादेवी शक्रं वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: ityevam ādibhir vākyair devīṃ tuṣṭāva vāsavaḥ / stotraiḥ stutā mahādevī śakraṃ vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: आकाशरूप, तीन जरा धारण करनेवाले, सब जीवेकि आवासस्थान, रद्र, कार्तिकेयरूपसे देवताओँकि' सेनानायक, सर्वव्यापक, दिनमें चलने-फिरनेवाले, रातमें विचरनेवाले; जिनके श्रीअंगोंसे उत्तम सुगन्ध
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: आर्तिः का ते समुत्पन्ना यथार्थं कथयस्व मे । उवाच वचनं शक्रः पार्वतीं प्रति भारत
verses.transliteration: ārtiḥ kā te samutpannā yathārthaṃ kathayasva me / uvāca vacanaṃ śakraḥ pārvatīṃ prati bhārata
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: निकल रही है ऐसे, सम्पूर्ण दिंशाओंके स्वामी राजाओंको मारनेवाले त्रिपुरासुर अन्धकासुर आदि हैत्योंको मार पोषण करनेवाले;  रूपगुणस्वरूप,
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: वरदा यदि मे देवि वरं दातुं त्वम् इच्छसि । चित्राङ्गदादिपापस्य मोक्षणं क्रियतां शुभे
verses.transliteration: varadā yadi me devi varaṃ dātuṃ tvam icchasi / citrāṅgadādipāpasya mokṣaṇaṃ kriyatāṃ śubhe
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: शार्दूलरूपसे प्रकट व्याघ्रेश्वर, गजासुरका गीला 'चमडा धारण करनेवाले, पीड़ा हरनेवाले, समयसे -योगसाधनामें तत्पर, महानादस्वरूप, सबके
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच: शिवाज्ञा वर्तते लोके पापस्यास्य विशुद्धये । तस्मात् पापविशुद्ध्यर्थं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca: śivājñā vartate loke pāpasyāsya viśuddhaye / tasmāt pāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: दुर्धर्ष प्रेतोंमें विचरनेवाले, समस्त प्राणियोंमें रहनेवाले, महान् ईश्वर, अनेक रूपोंमें प्रकट, बहुत धनवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: देवदेवं महादेवं याचस्व परमेश्वरम् । एवं देव्या वचः श्रुत्वा शक्रः प्रोवाच शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: devadevaṃ mahādevaṃ yācasva parameśvaram / evaṃ devyā vacaḥ śrutvā śakraḥ provāca śaṅkaram
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: नृत्यको पसंद करनेवाले, ताण्डव-नृत्य करनेवाले, नाचनेवाले, मेघस्वरूप, भयंकर, बड़ी भारी तपस्या करनेवाले, सबमें वास करनेवाले, अविनाशी, पर्वतोंको धारण करनेवाले आकाशरूप, deel
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: निष्कृतिस् त्व् अस्य पापस्य क्रियतां वचनात् मम । शङ्कर उवाच: यज्ञपाकाश्रमं गत्वा मेकलातीरम् आश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: niṣkṛtis tv asya pāpasya kriyatāṃ vacanāt mama / śaṅkara uvāca: yajñapākāśramaṃ gatvā mekalātīram āśritam
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: रूपोंमें प्रकट, जाननेयोग्य, उद्योग एवं निश्चयरूप,
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञपर्वतमासाद्य विन्ध्यस्यैव सुतोत्तमम् । तत्र यज्ञेश्वरं देवं लिङ्गं परमसिद्धिदम्
verses.transliteration: yajñaparvatamāsādya vindhyasyaiva sutottamam / tatra yajñeśvaraṃ devaṃ liṅgaṃ paramasiddhidam
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: क्षमाशील, चतुर, दक्ष-यज्ञका विध्वंस करनेवाले, दक्षयञज्ञका अपहरण करनेवाले, उत्तम उत्सवरूप, मध्यस्थ, विरोधियोंके तेजका अपहरण करनेवाले, दक्ष-यज्ञमें देवताओंके यज्ञभागका हनन करनेवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: बिल्वाम्रकं तथा चान्यत् कल्पगा तीरम् आश्रितम् । पुण्यस्थाने तु तत्रास्य शापस्यान्तो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: bilvāmrakaṃ tathā cānyat kalpagā tīram āśritam / puṇyasthāne tu tatrāsya śāpasyānto bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्न, पूजित, सबके उत्पादक, गम्भीर गर्जना करनेवाले, गाम्भीर्ययुक्त, गम्भीर, हविष्य पहुँचानेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: एकविंशतिलक्षाणि तत्र मुक्तानि सङ्गमे । गन्धर्वाणां महाराज कुब्जभावम् उपेयुषाम्
verses.transliteration: ekaviṃśatilakṣāṇi tatra muktāni saṅgame / gandharvāṇāṃ mahārāja kubjabhāvam upeyuṣām
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: नक्षत्रोंकी भाँति चमकनेवाले, समर्थ, विभु, तीखे बाणवाले, सूर्य और चन्द्ररूप नेत्रोंवाले, महादेव, कर्म और कालके ज्ञाता, यज्ञ एवं व्रतकी दीक्षा देनेवाले, भक्तोंद्रारा प्रसन्न किये जानेवाले, यज्ञस्वरूप,
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: महानदी नृपश्रेष्ठ कुब्जा तेन प्रकीर्तिता । दिव्ययानसमारूढाः स्तूयमाना मरुद्गणैः
verses.transliteration: mahānadī nṛpaśreṣṭha kubjā tena prakīrtitā / divyayānasamārūḍhāḥ stūyamānā marudgaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: यज्ञमें आहुतिरूपसे प्राप्त हविष्यके भोक्ता, अग्निमुख,
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: मुदा परमया युक्ता गान्धर्वं लोकम् आप्नुयुः । बिल्वाम्रकं पूजयित्वा गन्धर्वा गतकिल्बिषाः
verses.transliteration: mudā paramayā yuktā gāndharvaṃ lokam āpnuyuḥ / bilvāmrakaṃ pūjayitvā gandharvā gatakilbiṣāḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: विजय, जय, ज्योतिर्मण्डलके आश्रय, सिद्धरूप, शत्रुओसे मेल रखनेकी नीतिरूप, अवसर देखकर शत्रुके साथ युद्ध करनेकी नीतिरूप, शिखाधारी, दण्डधारी, जय धारण करनेवाले, लपखवाले, मूर्तिमान्
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: यथा पूर्वं तथेदानी तीर्थस्या ऽस्य प्रभावतः । हर्षेण महता युक्तः शक्रो ऽपि त्रिदिवालयम्
verses.transliteration: yathā pūrvaṃ tathedānī tīrthasyā 'sya prabhāvataḥ / harṣeṇa mahatā yuktaḥ śakro 'pi tridivālayam
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: जलरूप, बलहीन, बाह्यस्वरूप, बाँसका डंडा धारण करनेवाले, पापियोंको चेतालकी भाँति भय देनेवाले, कालाग्नि, कालको भी दण्ड देनेवाले, तारास्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: जगाम त्रिदशैः सार्धं परिपूर्णमनोरथः । षडस्य चोत्तरे भागे षडस्य दक्षिणे तथा
verses.transliteration: jagāma tridaśaiḥ sārdhaṃ paripūrṇamanorathaḥ / ṣaḍasya cottare bhāge ṣaḍasya dakṣiṇe tathā
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: प्रजाजनोंके रक्षक, विष्णुस्वरूप, भुजाकी भाँति सबके सहायक, यज्ञमें विशिष्ट भाग ग्रहण करनेवाले, सब ओर मुखवाले, संसार-बन्धनसे मुक्त करनेवाले, देवसमुदायरूप, सुवर्णमय कवच धारण करनेवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ते कथितो राजन् रेवाकुब्जासमागमः । अनेके यस्य माहात्म्यात् संसिद्धिं परमां गताः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ te kathito rājan revākubjāsamāgamaḥ / aneke yasya māhātmyāt saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: प्राणियोंके आदिकारण, सबके आदिपुरुष, सबके जन्मदाता, सबके ज्ञानदाता, सर्पस्वरूप, महान् आवाससे युक्त, तुच्छ वस्तु (धतूरों)-की माला धारण करनेवाले, मस्तकपर उठती हुई गंगाकी
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: श्रवणात् कीर्तनाद् वा ऽपि मुच्यते भवबन्धनात्
verses.transliteration: śravaṇāt kīrtanād vā 'pi mucyate bhavabandhanāt
verses.translation: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: लहरोंको जाननेवाले, तीन वेद और तीनों लोक जिनके पद अर्थात् स्थान हैं, वे भगवान् शिव त्रिनेत्रधारी, अव्यक्त, सब बन्धनोंसे मुक्त करनेवाले, ज्ञानसे प्रसन्न होनेवाले, असुन्दर वस्त्र धारण
verses.wordMeaning: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The confluence of Kara 1 and Narmada in Mandhatrpura shall take the Pitrs to Visnupura if one goes to the place, takes bath and propitiates the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे कुब्जामाहात्म्ये चित्राङ्गदशापमोचनो नाम चतुर्विंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय २५ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अथान्यत् कथयिष्यामि तीर्थानां तीर्थमुत्तमम् । सर्वपापहरं दिव्यं स्वर्गसोपानसन्निभम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe kubjāmāhātmye citrāṅgadaśāpamocano nāma caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 25 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: athānyat kathayiṣyāmi tīrthānāṃ tīrthamuttamam / sarvapāpaharaṃ divyaṃ svargasopānasannibham
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले, समस्त साधनोंसे सेवित, अपने मस्तकसे गंगाजीका स्रोत बहानेवाले, विभागरहित, सदा एकरस, यज्ञविभागके ज्ञाता, सबमें सदा रहनेवाले, सर्वत्र विचरनेवाले, दुर्वासामुनिस्वरूप, भैरव,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: सपादकोटितीर्थानि पुरे माहेश्वरे नृप । रौद्रं वारुणम् आसाद्य क्रोशमात्रप्रमाणतः
verses.transliteration: sapādakoṭitīrthāni pure māheśvare nṛpa / raudraṃ vāruṇam āsādya krośamātrapramāṇataḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: 'यमराजस्वरूप, शीतल, चन्द्रस्वरूप, यज्ञस्वरूप, सबका धारण-पोषण करनेवाले, विद्वानोंमें सर्वश्रेष्ठ,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रान्तरे महाराज शिवक्षेत्रमुदाहृतम् । प्राणत्यागं च यः कुर्याच् छिवलोके च मोदते
verses.transliteration: atrāntare mahārāja śivakṣetramudāhṛtam / prāṇatyāgaṃ ca yaḥ kuryāc chivaloke ca modate
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: विजयस्वरूप, विशिष्ट विद्वान्, संग्रह, विग्रह, कर्म, नागेन्द्र-हारसे विभूषित, सबमें प्रमुख, विमुक्तदेह, WR रहनेवाले प्राणस्वरूप, कर्दमरूप,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तिर्यग्योनिगताः पापाः कीटपक्षिमृगादयः । ते ऽपि यान्ति शिवस्थानं यत्र देवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tiryagyonigatāḥ pāpāḥ kīṭapakṣimṛgādayaḥ / te 'pi yānti śivasthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: और रूप धारण करनेवाले, आकाशवृत्तिरूप, निपात, सर्परूप, खलरूप, रौद्ररूप, देवताओंमें सूर्यरूप, रत्नस्वरूप किरणोंसे युक्त, उत्तम तेजवाले, वायुके समान वेगवाले, महान् वेगवाले, मनके समान
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तिलोदकप्रदानेन मातृकाः पितृकास् तथा । पितरस् तस्य तृप्यन्ति यावद् आभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: tilodakapradānena mātṛkāḥ pitṛkās tathā / pitaras tasya tṛpyanti yāvad ābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: वेगवाले, रात्रिचारी, सर्वावास, लक्ष्मीके निवासस्थान, व्यापक, लोकेश जिनकी कलाएँ हैं वे, हर, मुनि, आत्मगति, लोक, सहस्रमुख, विभुस्वरूप, यक्षोंसे . युक्त, कुबेररूप, बाज पक्षीके समान वेगवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रेष्टा ब्रह्मणा पूर्वमसंख्येयां मखोत्तमाः । शक्रश्च देवराज्रत्वं तत्रेष्ट्वा समवाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: tatreṣṭā brahmaṇā pūrvamasaṃkhyeyāṃ makhottamāḥ / śakraśca devarājratvaṃ tatreṣṭvā samavāptavān
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: प्रकाशरूप, प्रजाओंके स्वामी, मतवाले, कामदेवके . तुल्य रूपवाले, अर्थ और अनर्थकी प्राप्तिमें कारण, : महान् सिद्धयोगस्वरूप, भक्तोंके क्लेशोंका अपहरण
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: कार्तवीर्येण तत्रैव कृतं यज्ञशतं पुरा । अयोध्यायां पुरा राजन् यज्ञदानपरायणः
verses.transliteration: kārtavīryeṇa tatraiva kṛtaṃ yajñaśataṃ purā / ayodhyāyāṃ purā rājan yajñadānaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले, सिद्ध, सर्वार्थसाधक, भिक्षु, भिक्षुरूप, छः प्रकारके ऐश्वयाँके स्वामी, कोमल चमडीवाले, विशाल सेनावाले कार्तिकेयरूप, विशाख--स्कन्द, जिनका भाग लाठीमें बाँधा जाता है वे, गौओंके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यस्य सुतश्चासीत् सूर्यवंशे महीपतिः । जित्वा ऽसुरांस् तथा दैत्यान् रक्षोगणसमन्वितान्
verses.transliteration: ādityasya sutaścāsīt sūryavaṃśe mahīpatiḥ / jitvā 'surāṃs tathā daityān rakṣogaṇasamanvitān
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: 'पालक, हाथमें वज्र धारण करनेवाले, रोकनेवाले, विशेष रूपसे स्थित, स्तब्ध करनेवाले, नक्षत्ररूप, शत्रुको भी सहारा देनेवाले, काल, वसन्तरूप, महुआके समान नेत्रोंवाले, बृहस्पतिरूप, अन्न ही
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: मनुर्नाम्ना चक्रवर्ती शक्रादीशाद् गुणोत्तमः । पुरोत्तमे न सर्पन्ति मृत्युरोगजरास् तथा
verses.transliteration: manurnāmnā cakravartī śakrādīśād guṇottamaḥ / purottame na sarpanti mṛtyurogajarās tathā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: जिनकी सेना है ऐसे, निष्ठावान् आश्रमसूचक, ब्रह्मचारी, लोकचारी, सर्वचारी, उत्तम रत्नोंके ज्ञाता, ईशान, ईश्‍वर, काल, निशाचारी, एकमात्र सबके धारण करनेवाले, अमित प्रमाणातीत, नदों
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: शतार्द्धसाप्तभौमैश् च गृहैर् हेममयैः शुभैः । वापीकूपतडागानां दीर्घिकानां शतैर् युता
verses.transliteration: śatārddhasāptabhaumaiś ca gṛhair hemamayaiḥ śubhaiḥ / vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ dīrghikānāṃ śatair yutā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: और नदियोंको उत्पन्न करनेवाले, अव्यय, नन्दीश्वर, Ord, नन्दन, नन्दवर्धन, नागहारी, विहारी, काल,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: सुशोभिता प्रेक्षणीयैर् नानारूपैर् विलासिभिः । वेणुवीणाध्वनियुता नानावाद्यैः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: suśobhitā prekṣaṇīyair nānārūpair vilāsibhiḥ / veṇuvīṇādhvaniyutā nānāvādyaiḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: लिंगाध्यक्ष, सुराध्यक्ष, कालाध्यक्ष, युगोंको धारण करनेवाले, उमापति, उमाकान्त, गंगाधर, वर, सर्वार्थ, सब प्राणियोंका अर्थ सिद्ध करनेवाले, नित्य, सब ब्रतोंके पालक तथा शुचि (पवित्र) हैं। नाथ!
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: अलकेव कुबेरस्य शक्रस्येवामरावती । पुरी विराजते तद्वद् अयोध्या देवनिर्मिता
verses.transliteration: alakeva kuberasya śakrasyevāmarāvatī / purī virājate tadvad ayodhyā devanirmitā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा आदि देवताओं और महर्षियोंको भी जिनका ज्ञान नहीं होता, उन्हीं आप परात्पर परमात्माकी स्तुति कैसे की जा सकती है?
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: लक्षाणि द्वे च सार्धाणि प्रजा जीवन्ति तत्र च । तत्रैव वंशे राजर्षीर् अभूत् परमधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: lakṣāṇi dve ca sārdhāṇi prajā jīvanti tatra ca / tatraiva vaṃśe rājarṣīr abhūt paramadhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं-इस स्तोत्रको सुनकर श्रीमान् द्वीपेश्वर शिव प्रसन्नतापूर्वक मुसकराते हुए बोले-“देवताओ! तुमलोग वर माँगो।'
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: नानामखसहस्रैर् यो ददाह पृथिवीम् इमाम् । न तद् देशो न तत् तीर्थं न तद् राष्टं न चाश्रमः
verses.transliteration: nānāmakhasahasrair yo dadāha pṛthivīm imām / na tad deśo na tat tīrthaṃ na tad rāṣṭaṃ na cāśramaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: और हमारी रक्षाके लिये उद्यत रहें। जो पापपरायण अधम मनुष्य भी यहाँके पाँच लिंगोंका अर्चन
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: नेष्टं यत्र महायज्ञैः सालङ्कायनभूभृता । सस्यमालाधृता पृथ्वी धनधान्यसमन्विता
verses.transliteration: neṣṭaṃ yatra mahāyajñaiḥ sālaṅkāyanabhūbhṛtā / sasyamālādhṛtā pṛthvī dhanadhānyasamanvitā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: करे उसे वह उत्तम गति प्राप्त हो, जो बड़े-बड़े यज्ञोंद्वारा भी दुर्लभ है।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं कामदुघा गावः पट्टवस्त्रमहीरुहाः । यज्ञैः सर्वैर् विवाहैश् च वेदैर् माङ्गल्यमङ्गलैः
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ kāmadughā gāvaḥ paṭṭavastramahīruhāḥ / yajñaiḥ sarvair vivāhaiś ca vedair māṅgalyamaṅgalaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: पूर्वकालमें उसी तीर्थमें इन्द्रने देव-दानववन्दित देवाधिदेव उमापतिका सहस्र नामोंद्वारा स्तवन किया था। इससे भगवान् शंकरका प्रसाद प्राप्त करके वे देवराजके पदपर प्रतिष्ठित हुए। इसी
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तु सततं धात्री कालेन महता ततः । अनावृष्टिरभूद् राष्ट्रे पुरा द्वादशवार्षिकी
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tu satataṃ dhātrī kālena mahatā tataḥ / anāvṛṣṭirabhūd rāṣṭre purā dvādaśavārṣikī
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: प्रकार कुबेरने लक्षेशवर देवका स्तवन किया था। युधिष्ठिर! उस तीर्थमें जो मोक्षदा नामवाली देवी हैं, उन्हींको पार्वती जानो। मोक्षेश्वर सिद्धलिंग है, वहाँ देवता और असुर भी मस्तक नवाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: मृता जानपदाः सर्वे द्विपदाश् च चतुष्पदाः । तृणगुल्मलतावल्यो भूतग्रामं चतुर्विधम्
verses.transliteration: mṛtā jānapadāḥ sarve dvipadāś ca catuṣpadāḥ / tṛṇagulmalatāvalyo bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर परम उत्तम वैष्णवतीर्थको जाय। वह तीर्थ कोकिला नामसे विख्यात है और सब पापोंका नाश करनेवाला है। देवाधिदेव भगवान् जनार्दन उसे वैष्णवक्षेत्र कहते हैं। जो मनुष्य वहाँ परम
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: हाहाकारोमहानासीद् देवासुरनृणां तथा । सालङ्कायनराजर्षिः चिन्तयामास भारत
verses.transliteration: hāhākāromahānāsīd devāsuranṛṇāṃ tathā / sālaṅkāyanarājarṣiḥ cintayāmāsa bhārata
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: पवित्र एकादशी व्रत करके दीपमालाको जगाता है, उसकी इस दुःखद मर्त्यलोकमें पुनः आवृत्ति नहीं होती। बहाँपर श्राद्ध आदि करनेसे पितरोंको अनन्त कालतक तृप्ति बनी रहती है। इसी तीर्थमें
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: जन्मप्रभृति मे पापं किंचिद् एव न विद्यते । पूजयामि हरिं देवं संसारार्णवतारणम्
verses.transliteration: janmaprabhṛti me pāpaṃ kiṃcid eva na vidyate / pūjayāmi hariṃ devaṃ saṃsārārṇavatāraṇam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: किये हुए पुण्यसे ध्रुव नक्षत्रोंके तेजसे परम उज्ज्वल होकर ध्रुवपदको प्राप्त हुए हैं। नर्मदा सर्वतीर्थमयी है, महादेवजी भी सर्वदेवमय हैं, बुद्धि सर्वधर्ममयी है तथा तपस्या क्षमा और सत्यमय है। पाँचों इच्धरियोंको
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणांश् च मुनींश् चैव तर्पयामास चेच्छया । बृहस्पतिसमं बुद्ध्या वशिष्ठं ब्रह्मवादिनम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāṃś ca munīṃś caiva tarpayāmāsa cecchayā / bṛhaspatisamaṃ buddhyā vaśiṣṭhaṃ brahmavādinam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: वशमें करना ब्रह्मचर्य है और यह ब्रह्मचर्य ही तपस्याका मूल है। क्षमा, सत्य, जप, स्वाध्याय और तप-इन्हींका नाम संयम है। राजन्! जो मनुष्य प्रातःकाल उठकर द्वीपेश्‍वर, कपिलेश्वर और
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: पप्रच्छ नृपतिर् भक्त्या साष्टाङ्गं प्रणिपत्य च । अनावृष्टिर् अभूद् विप्र कथं द्वादशवार्षिकी
verses.transliteration: papraccha nṛpatir bhaktyā sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatya ca / anāvṛṣṭir abhūd vipra kathaṃ dvādaśavārṣikī
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: नरकेश्वस-इन सबका नाम लेता है, वह सब तीर्थांका 'फल पाकर शिवलोकमें प्रतिष्ठित होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: ना ऽपराधो मया कश्चित् कृतो ब्राह्मणदेवयोः । संशयो मे महास्तत्र वेदानुग्रहतत्पर
verses.transliteration: nā 'parādho mayā kaścit kṛto brāhmaṇadevayoḥ / saṃśayo me mahāstatra vedānugrahatatpara
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: नर्मदाजीकी तथा भगवान् विष्णुकी स्तुति . मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं-पूर्वकालमें जब नर्मदा  जलके रूपमें प्राप्त हुई नर्मदाजी महादेवजीकी
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: वशिष्ठ उवाच: शृणु राजन् महाबाहो अनावृष्टेश् च कारणम् । पुरा सांवत्सरे यज्ञे वृद्धाश् च मुनयो ऽवदन्
verses.transliteration: vaśiṣṭha uvāca: śṛṇu rājan mahābāho anāvṛṣṭeś ca kāraṇam / purā sāṃvatsare yajñe vṛddhāś ca munayo 'vadan
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: इस लोकमें आ रही थीं, उस समय देवताओं  उत्तम कला हैं। आप'ही उमा, और ब्रह्मर्षियोंने उन्हें नमस्कार करके उनका  यमुना, सरस्वती, चामुण्डा, च स्तवन किया--“देवि! आपने चराचर प्राणियॉसहित  हैं। देवि! अ मर्त्यलोकको पवित्र एवं पुण्यमय कर दिया हैं।  हैं। आप ye
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां च वचनं श्रुत्वा कर्तव्यं जनसंसदि । तावद् एव मुनिश्चात्रिः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā kartavyaṃ janasaṃsadi / tāvad eva muniścātriḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: पर्वतसे प्रकट होनेके कारण आपको उसकी कन्या कहते हैं। सबने आपका स्तवन किया है । आपके तट यज्ञयूपसे सुशोभित हैं । आप समस्त तीर्थांकी मुकुटमणि हैं और स्वर्ग तथा मोक्ष प्रदान करनेवाली
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: भृगुरग्निर् मरीचिश् च कश्यपो ऽथ विभाण्डकः । जमदग्निश् च माण्डव्यो यमो विष्णुस् तथाङ्गिराः
verses.transliteration: bhṛguragnir marīciś ca kaśyapo 'tha vibhāṇḍakaḥ / jamadagniś ca māṇḍavyo yamo viṣṇus tathāṅgirāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: हैं। आप ही सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंको तारनेवाली और उनके पापोंका नाश करनेवाली हैं । लक्ष्मी, स्वाहा, स्वधा और यशस्विनी पुरुहूता भी आप ही हैं। सुब्रते! आपने जलरूपसे सम्पूर्ण जगतूको व्याप्त
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिस् तथा दक्षः शातातपपराशरौ । उशना गौतमश् चैव व्यासः कात्यायनस् तथा
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatis tathā dakṣaḥ śātātapaparāśarau / uśanā gautamaś caiva vyāsaḥ kātyāyanas tathā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: कर रखा है। आपके संगम और सिद्धलिंगको
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रो ऽथ शाण्डिल्यः कक्षः कात्यायनिस् तथा । हारीतः शङ्खलिखितौ याज्ञवल्क्यो ऽथ गालवः
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitro 'tha śāṇḍilyaḥ kakṣaḥ kātyāyanis tathā / hārītaḥ śaṅkhalikhitau yājñavalkyo 'tha gālavaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: युधिष्ठिरने पूछा-मुनिश्रेष्ठ! जिस मनुष्यके कर्मरूप बन्धन नहीं टूटे हैं, उसे किस प्रकार 'परमपदकी प्राप्ति हो सकती है?
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: आत्रेयः शौनको गर्गो जह्नुर् उद्दालकस् तथा । कौशिको भार्गवो ऽगस्त्यो दुर्वासाश्च्यवनस् तथा
verses.transliteration: ātreyaḥ śaunako gargo jahnur uddālakas tathā / kauśiko bhārgavo 'gastyo durvāsāścyavanas tathā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी बोले- राजन्! पूर्वकालमें भगवान् विष्णुने महात्मा ब्रह्माजीको परमपद-प्राप्तिका उपाय बताया था। वह उपाय है- भगवान् विष्णुका स्तवन, जो इस प्रकार है-
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये ऽपि बहवो ऋषयः सूर्यवर्चसः
verses.transliteration: ete cānye 'pi bahavo ṛṣayaḥ sūryavarcasaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: “मैं कमलके समान नेत्रोंवाले पापहारी हरि श्रीनायणदेवकी शरण लेता हूँ। जो सम्पूर्ण लोकोंके रक्षक, सहस्रों नेत्रोंसे विभूषित, अविनाशी एवं परम पदस्वरूप हैं तथा भूत, भविष्य और वर्तमानके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: धर्माणामुपदेष्टारो वेदशास्त्रानुयायिनः । अनावृष्टिं तु वै ज्ञात्वा प्रत्ययोध्यां प्रतस्थिरे
verses.transliteration: dharmāṇāmupadeṣṭāro vedaśāstrānuyāyinaḥ / anāvṛṣṭiṃ tu vai jñātvā pratyayodhyāṃ pratasthire
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: स्वामी हैं, उन भगवान् विष्णुकी मैं शरण लेता हूँ। जो सब भूतोंकी सृष्टि करनेवाले तथा अनन्त बल-पराक्रमसे सम्पन्न हैं, जिनकी नाभिसे कमल प्रकट हुआ है, जो इन्द्रियोंके स्वामी, सत्यस्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: आगतान् स मुनीन् दृष्ट्वा राजा परमधार्मिकः । उदतिष्ठन् महाभाग दिवि शक्र इव ऽपरः
verses.transliteration: āgatān sa munīn dṛṣṭvā rājā paramadhārmikaḥ / udatiṣṭhan mahābhāga divi śakra iva 'paraḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: तथा विकाररहित. हैं, उन श्रीविष्णुकी मैं शरण लेता हूँ। जो हिरण्यगर्भस्वरूप, पृथ्वीको अपने गर्भमें रखनेवाले, अमृत (अविनाशी), सब ओर
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तान् अभ्यर्च्य यथा न्यायम् अर्घपाद्यादिभिः स्वयम् । उपविष्टान् यथा न्यायम् आसने शुभदर्शने
verses.transliteration: tān abhyarcya yathā nyāyam arghapādyādibhiḥ svayam / upaviṣṭān yathā nyāyam āsane śubhadarśane
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: स्वामीसे रहित हैं, उन सूर्यके सदृश कान्तिमान्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: स कारणम् अनावृष्टेः तान् पप्रच्छ महात्मनः । अब्रुवन् मुनयो वाक्यं सालङ्कायनभूपतिम्
verses.transliteration: sa kāraṇam anāvṛṣṭeḥ tān papraccha mahātmanaḥ / abruvan munayo vākyaṃ sālaṅkāyanabhūpatim
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: श्रीहरिकी मैं शरण लेता हूँ। जिनके सहस्रों मस्तक हैं, जो झुतिमान् देव, वैकुण्ठधामके अधिपति, सूक्ष्म, अचल, 'वरेण्य और अभयदाता हैं, उन भगवान् गरुड़वाहनकी मैं शरण लेता हूँ। जिन्हें
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यभूततत्त्वज्ञं सप्तकल्पान्तवासिनम् । मार्कण्डेयं महात्मानं सर्वेषां गुरुम् अर्चय
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyabhūtatattvajñaṃ saptakalpāntavāsinam / mārkaṇḍeyaṃ mahātmānaṃ sarveṣāṃ gurum arcaya
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: नारायण और हरि कहा गया है, जो योगात्मा;
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश्रमपदं गत्वा ब्राह्मणैः सह चिन्तय । यं यं धर्मं स वदति तं तं कर्तुम् इहार्हसि
verses.transliteration: tasyāśramapadaṃ gatvā brāhmaṇaiḥ saha cintaya / yaṃ yaṃ dharmaṃ sa vadati taṃ taṃ kartum ihārhasi
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: “तथासब/लोकोंको शरण देनेवाले  ईश्वरकी मैं शरण लेता हूँ। जो
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो द्विजैः सर्वैः सालङ्कायनभूपतिः । उवाच वचनं सर्वान् मुनीन्द्रां छंसितव्रतान्
verses.transliteration: evamukto dvijaiḥ sarvaiḥ sālaṅkāyanabhūpatiḥ / uvāca vacanaṃ sarvān munīndrāṃ chaṃsitavratān
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण भूतोंके स्वामी हैं, जिनसे यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् व्याप्त हो रहा है तथा जो संहारकारी देवता हैं, वे भगवान् विष्णु मुझपर प्रसन्न हों। पूर्वकालमें जिनसे कमलयोनि प्रजापति ब्रह्माजीका प्रादुर्भाव
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: अनुग्रहम् इमं मन्ये प्रसादं मुनिसत्तमाः । आदिदेश ततो राजा भ्रातरौ द्वारपालकौ
verses.transliteration: anugraham imaṃ manye prasādaṃ munisattamāḥ / ādideśa tato rājā bhrātarau dvārapālakau
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: हुआ है, वे पितामह ब्रह्मासे भी परे विराजमान भगवान् विष्णु मुझपर प्रसन्न हों। प्राचीन कालमें
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: सुधन्ववीरधन्वानौ प्रतीहारौ महाबलौ । रथे हयानि युज्यन्तां ब्राह्मणारोहणं प्रति
verses.transliteration: sudhanvavīradhanvānau pratīhārau mahābalau / rathe hayāni yujyantāṃ brāhmaṇārohaṇaṃ prati
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: नष्ट हो चुका था, उस समय जो योगस्वरूप परमात्मा अकेले ही शेष थे, वे श्रीविष्णु मुझपर प्रसन्न हों। जो पृथुरूपसे इस पृथ्वीको जीत लेते हैं, अथवा वाराहरूप धारण करके पृथ्वीको अपने
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मशर्मा देवशर्मा मन्त्रिणौ तत्त्वदर्शिनौ । पप्रच्छ गमनार्थाय कर्तव्यं च यथा ऽदिशत्
verses.transliteration: brahmaśarmā devaśarmā mantriṇau tattvadarśinau / papraccha gamanārthāya kartavyaṃ ca yathā 'diśat
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: अधिकारमें करते हैं, जो सत्य, काल, धर्म, क्रिया, 'फल और गुणस्वरूप हैं, सत्पुरुषोंकी वाणीरूप वे भगवान् वासुदेव मुझपर प्रसन्न हों।' “योगावास! आपको नमस्कार है। सबके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रिणावूचतुः: समयज्ञो महाबाहो त्वम् एव विहितं कुरु । राजा तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा धर्मशास्त्रविशारदः
verses.transliteration: mantriṇāvūcatuḥ: samayajño mahābāho tvam eva vihitaṃ kuru / rājā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dharmaśāstraviśāradaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: आवासस्थान ! वरदायक ! यज्ञभोगी और पंचभोगी नारायण! आपको नमस्कार है । वासुदेव, संकर्षण,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच श्लक्ष्णाया वाचा हर्षगद्गदमानसः । गन्तव्यं ब्राह्मणैः सार्द्धं यत्र कल्पान्तगो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: uvāca ślakṣṇāyā vācā harṣagadgadamānasaḥ / gantavyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ yatra kalpāntago muniḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: जगत्पते! आपको नमस्कार है  ज्ञानसागर! आप अजेय हैं। छः प्रकारकी ऊर्मियोंसे जिसका विभाग किया जाता है, वह सम्पूर्ण विश्व एकमात्र आपका ही स्वरूप है। आप वृषाकपि (शिव और विष्णु);
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ययौ राजा ब्राह्मणैः सह भारत । दिव्ययानसमारूढः सम्प्राप्तः कल्पगातटम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā yayau rājā brāhmaṇaiḥ saha bhārata / divyayānasamārūḍhaḥ samprāptaḥ kalpagātaṭam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: मृगाधिप (नृसिंह) और काल हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। अव्यक्त प्रकृतिसे इस सम्पूर्ण ब्रह्माण्डकी उत्पत्ति हुई है और प्रभु श्रीविष्णु अव्यक्तसे परे हैं। जिनसे परे कोई वस्तु नहीं है, उन भगवान् श्रीहरिकी
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मारण्यं समासाद्य मार्कण्डं मुनिभिः सह । स समीपे समासीनं प्रणम्य प्रणतिक्षमम्
verses.transliteration: dharmāraṇyaṃ samāsādya mārkaṇḍaṃ munibhiḥ saha / sa samīpe samāsīnaṃ praṇamya praṇatikṣamam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: मैं शरण लेता हूँ। ब्रह्मा और शिव आदि जिन
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: आपृष्टः कुशलं तेन तदा वै ब्रह्मवादिना । उवाच वचनं राजा मार्कण्डं ज्ञानचक्षुषम्
verses.transliteration: āpṛṣṭaḥ kuśalaṃ tena tadā vai brahmavādinā / uvāca vacanaṃ rājā mārkaṇḍaṃ jñānacakṣuṣam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: शक्तिशाली श्रीहरिका नित्य चिन्तन करते हैं, जो व्यापक परमात्मा अपने एक अंशसे सम्पूर्ण जगत्को व्याप्त करके स्थित हैं, जिनका किसी भी इन्द्रियसे
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य मे कुशलं ब्रह्मंस् त्वत्पादाम्बुजदर्शनात् । किंतु मां बाधते नित्यं भविष्यं चैव तत्त्ववित्
verses.transliteration: adya me kuśalaṃ brahmaṃs tvatpādāmbujadarśanāt / kiṃtu māṃ bādhate nityaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ caiva tattvavit
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: ग्रहण नहीं होता, जो निर्गुण होकर भी सम्पूर्ण  जगत्के शासक हैं, उन श्रीहरिकी मैं शरण लेता
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अपमार्गेण प्रजानां देव ब्राह्मणहिंसया । वर्णाश्रमविलोपेन अधर्मो धर्मबाधकः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: apamārgeṇa prajānāṃ deva brāhmaṇahiṃsayā / varṇāśramavilopena adharmo dharmabādhakaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: हूँ। जो सूर्यनाड़ी पिंगला और चन्द्रनाडी इडाके मध्यभाग= सुषुम्णामें ज्योतिर्मय स्वरूपसे विराजमान
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: शम्भुर् न पूज्यते यत्र रुद्रभागो न दीयते । देशे तस्मिन् अनावृष्टिर् दुर्भिक्षं मरणं ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: śambhur na pūjyate yatra rudrabhāgo na dīyate / deśe tasmin anāvṛṣṭir durbhikṣaṃ maraṇaṃ dhruvam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: हैं, fae क्षेत्रज्ञ कहते हैं, वे महात्मा 4  मुझपर प्रसन्न हों। जो कोई सिद्ध और महर्षि
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: विनश्यन्ति प्रजा राष्ट्रे अल्पायुर् नृपतिर् भवेत् । अब्रह्मण्या ब्राह्मणाश् च शूद्रा वै ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: vinaśyanti prajā rāṣṭre alpāyur nṛpatir bhavet / abrahmaṇyā brāhmaṇāś ca śūdrā vai brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: ज्ञानयोगके द्वारा जिनके तत्त्वको जानकर संसार- बन्धनसे मुक्त हो जाते हैं, वे महात्मा मुझपर प्रसन्न हों। सब ओरसे कल्याणमय परमेश्वर! आपको नमस्कार है । आपके नेत्र, सिर और मुख
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: शिवजपं यज्ञसूत्रं शूद्रो धारयते यदा । अलिङ्गिनो लिङ्गिनश् च अव्रता व्रतधारिणः
verses.transliteration: śivajapaṃ yajñasūtraṃ śūdro dhārayate yadā / aliṅgino liṅginaś ca avratā vratadhāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: सब ओर हैं। निर्विकार! आदिकल्प! हृदयस्थित परमेश्वर! आपको नमस्कार है । इन्द्रियातीत! आपको नमस्कार है। परमात्मन्! आपको नमस्कार है। जो राग-द्वेषसे मुक्त और लोभ-मोह आदिसे रहित
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: स्वपापं कृतवन्तश् च तान् स्वराष्ट्रे प्रवासिनः । सव्याङ्गे ब्रह्मसूत्रं च वह्णिसूत्रं च कारयेत्
verses.transliteration: svapāpaṃ kṛtavantaś ca tān svarāṣṭre pravāsinaḥ / savyāṅge brahmasūtraṃ ca vahṇisūtraṃ ca kārayet
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: पुरुष आपको जानते हैं, वे संसारमें आसक्त नहीं होते। आप शरीरसे रहित और अव्यक्त होते हुए भी सम्पूर्ण शरीरोंमें तदाकार हुए-से रहते हैं। अव्यक्त प्रकृति, बुद्धि, अहंकार, पंचमहाभूत और
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: गर्दभारोहणं तस्य कारयेल् लोकगार्हितम् । एतत् ते कथितं राजन्न् अनावृष्टेश् च कारणम्
verses.transliteration: gardabhārohaṇaṃ tasya kārayel lokagārhitam / etat te kathitaṃ rājann anāvṛṣṭeś ca kāraṇam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियाँ-ये सब आपमें स्थित हैं, आप उनमें नहीं हैं। वे आपके आश्रयके बिना स्वयं नहीं टिक सकतीं। आप अव्यक्त पुरुष हैं, अति कूटस्थ हैं, गुणोंक स्वामी और ईश्वर हैं, हेतुरहित आवर्त,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: अनावृष्ट्या सस्यहानिस् तत्क्षयान् म्रियते प्रजा । प्रजाक्षयाद् वेदहानिस् तद्धानौ यज्ञसंक्षयः
verses.transliteration: anāvṛṣṭyā sasyahānis tatkṣayān mriyate prajā / prajākṣayād vedahānis taddhānau yajñasaṃkṣayaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
