verses.hindi: प्रभु तथा अपने-आपमें स्थित हैं। पुण्डरीकाक्ष! आपको नमस्कार है। वासुदेव! आपको नमस्कार है। जगन्नाथ! आप ईश्वर हैं; इससे परे और क्या कहा जा सकता है। आप भक्तोंको मुक्ति देनेवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्क्षयाद् धर्महानिश् च तद्धानौ वर्णसङ्करः । तत्सङ्करात् कर्मलोपः पतनं नरके ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: tatkṣayād dharmahāniś ca taddhānau varṇasaṅkaraḥ / tatsaṅkarāt karmalopaḥ patanaṃ narake dhruvam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: गुरु और देवताओंके स्वामी हैं। समस्त प्राणियोंका पालन करनेवाले वे ही आप श्रीहरि जन्म-जन्ममें मेरे स्वामी हों। मैं अहंकार तथा सत्त्व आदि तीनों गुणोंसे बँधा हूँ। मेरी नासिका अपने कारणभूत
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गासागरसम्भेदे चाण्डालाः सप्तसाम्प्रतम् । कणधूमं पिबन्त्याशु ऊर्ध्वपादा ह्यधः शिराः
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāsāgarasambhede cāṇḍālāḥ saptasāmpratam / kaṇadhūmaṃ pibantyāśu ūrdhvapādā hyadhaḥ śirāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: पृथ्वीतत्त्वमें मिल जाय, मेरी जिह्वा जलतत्त्वमें विलीन हो जाय, मेरे नेत्र तेजस्-तत्त्वमें समा जाये, स्पर्शेन्द्रिय वायुमें विलीन हो जाय, श्रोत्रेन्द्रिय आकाशमें लीन हो जाय, मन अपने कारणतत्त्व
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: चकम्पिरे सुराः सर्वे सिद्धगन्धर्वकिन्नराः । देवराजः सुरैः सार्धमासनाच् चलितो नृप
verses.transliteration: cakampire surāḥ sarve siddhagandharvakinnarāḥ / devarājaḥ suraiḥ sārdhamāsanāc calito nṛpa
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: अहंकारमें लीन हो जाय और मेरा अहंकार मेरी बुद्धिमें प्रवेश कर जाय तथा मेरी बुद्धि आपमें
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तपसस् तु प्रभावो ऽयम् अपि दृष्टो नराधिप । नैमिषे च महारण्ये सुरासुरनमस्कृते
verses.transliteration: tapasas tu prabhāvo 'yam api dṛṣṭo narādhipa / naimiṣe ca mahāraṇye surāsuranamaskṛte
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: और पंचभूतोंसे मेरा वियोग हो जाय। मेरे सत्त्व,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: शतमष्टोत्तरं सर्वे तापसाः शूद्रजन्मनः । ब्रह्मकर्म समासाद्य स्थिता धर्मपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: śatamaṣṭottaraṃ sarve tāpasāḥ śūdrajanmanaḥ / brahmakarma samāsādya sthitā dharmaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: प्रकृतिमे समा जायँ। मैं तो प्रभुओंके भी प्रभु, दोषरहित श्रीहरिकी शरण लेता हूँ। जिनके सहस्रो मस्तक हैं, जो महान् ऋषि तथा सम्पूर्ण भूतोंको उत्पन्न करनेवाले हैं, उन भगवान् विष्णुकी मैं
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मचारिणां पुंसां राजा पापेन लिप्यते । अयज्ञयाजकस्थाने अनावृष्टिर् भवेत् सदा
verses.transliteration: adharmacāriṇāṃ puṃsāṃ rājā pāpena lipyate / ayajñayājakasthāne anāvṛṣṭir bhavet sadā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: शरण लेता हूँ। जो ब्रह्मस्वरूप और सम्पूर्ण विश्वके उत्पत्तिस्थान हैं, वे श्रीविष्णु मुझपर प्रसन्न हों। महाप्रलयकालमें जब स्थावर-जंगम नष्ट हो जाते हैं और सम्पूर्ण भूत ब्रह्मपत्ती--मायामें विलीन
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: अपूजनात् तथा नित्यं देवेदेवस्य शूलिनः । न स्वर्गो नापवर्गश् च न भोगाश् चापि पुष्कलाः
verses.transliteration: apūjanāt tathā nityaṃ devedevasya śūlinaḥ / na svargo nāpavargaś ca na bhogāś cāpi puṣkalāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: हो जाते हैं और महत्तत्त्व प्रकृतिमें लीन हो जाता है तथा वह प्रकृति जिनके आश्रित रहती है और वैदिक मन्त्रोंद्दार जिनके लिये आहुति दी जाती है, वे श्रीविष्णु मुझपर प्रसन्न हों। अग्नि, चन्द्रमा,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णुसुरेन्द्राद् या अर्चयन्ति महेश्वरम् । किं पुनर् मानुषाः पापा राजानः पापजीविनः
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇusurendrād yā arcayanti maheśvaram / kiṃ punar mānuṣāḥ pāpā rājānaḥ pāpajīvinaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: सूर्य, देवता, ब्रह्म, रुद्र, इन्द्र तथा योगियोंके तेजोंको जो सदा बढ़ाते हैं, वे भगवान् विष्णु मुझपर प्रसन्न हों। प्रभो! आप अजन्मा हैं, जगतूके लिये वास्तविक मार्ग आप ही हैं। आपकी कोई मूर्ति
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: नार्चयन्ति महेशं ये ते नराः पापभागिनः । न च स्वर्गस्य मोक्षस्य फलं भोगम् अवाप्नुयुः
verses.transliteration: nārcayanti maheśaṃ ye te narāḥ pāpabhāginaḥ / na ca svargasya mokṣasya phalaṃ bhogam avāpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: नहीं है तो भी विश्वकी सब मूर्तियोंपर आपका अधिकार है। आप नित्य नूतन हैं। प्रकृति, महत्तत्त्व और चेतन पुरुष रूपसे आप ही सुशोभित होते हैं। जो आत्मारूपसे अगोप्य (अपरोक्ष अनुभवके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान् नृप त्वं श्रेयांसि ब्राह्मणैः सह चिन्तय । नर्मदातीरमासाद्य रुद्रयज्ञं समारभ
verses.transliteration: tasmān nṛpa tvaṃ śreyāṃsi brāhmaṇaiḥ saha cintaya / narmadātīramāsādya rudrayajñaṃ samārabha
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: योग्य) और सबसे श्रेष्ठ हैं, उन श्रीहरिकी मैं शरणमें आया हूँ। चन्द्रमा और सूर्यके सदृश जो अपने तेजको स्वयं ही इस धराधामपर उतारते हैं, जिनसे सम्पूर्ण दिशाएँ प्रकट हुई हैं, वे महात्मा
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां शिरांसि होमे ऽस्मिन् पातय त्वं यथाविधि । समर्चय सुरेशानं ततः शान्तिर् भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ śirāṃsi home 'smin pātaya tvaṃ yathāvidhi / samarcaya sureśānaṃ tataḥ śāntir bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: हैं, वे महात्मा श्रीविष्णु मुझपर प्रसन्न हों। सूर्यके समीपमें चन्द्रमाकी स्थिति है अर्थात् पिंगला नाड़ीके निकट जो इडा नाडी है--इन दोनोंके मध्यभाग अर्थात् सुषुम्णा नाड़ीमें जिनका चिन्तन किया
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: कामवर्षी च पर्जन्यः पुनः सृष्टिः प्रवर्तते । मुच्यतां पापदोषेण राज्यं स्वर्गमवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: kāmavarṣī ca parjanyaḥ punaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ pravartate / mucyatāṃ pāpadoṣeṇa rājyaṃ svargamavāpsyasi
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: जाता है, जो वहाँ अविचल, तेजोमय स्वरूपसे प्रकाशित होते हैं, वे महात्मा श्रीहरि मुझपर प्रसन्न हों। प्रभो! जो नानात्वमें भी आपके एकत्वका दर्शन करते हैं, वे परमगतिको प्राप्त होते हैं। जो
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तवैतत् कथितं राजन् यथादृष्टं मया ऽनघ । तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा परमधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: tavaitat kathitaṃ rājan yathādṛṣṭaṃ mayā 'nagha / tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā paramadhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: सब प्राणियोंमें सम, शत्रु, मित्र और उदासीन जनोंको प्रिय हैं, सबको समभावसे ग्रहण अपने
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कृत्य मुनिश्रेष्ठम् ऋषिभिः सह भारत । अनुग्रहम् इमं मन्ये त्वत्प्रसादाद् यथोदितम्
verses.transliteration: namaskṛtya muniśreṣṭham ṛṣibhiḥ saha bhārata / anugraham imaṃ manye tvatprasādād yathoditam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: जाननेयोग्य हैं, वे भगवान् विष्णु हों। यह समस्त चराचर. जगत् :
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: आदिदेश प्रतीहारान् यज्ञसम्भारसिद्धये । गत्वा ऽयोध्यां पुरीं रम्यामादेशं मखसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: ādideśa pratīhārān yajñasambhārasiddhaye / gatvā 'yodhyāṃ purīṃ ramyāmādeśaṃ makhasambhavam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: प्राणिसमुदाय आपमें उसी प्रकार गुँथा हुआ है, जैसे डोरेमें मनके पिरोये होते हैं। आपके लिये धर्म और अधर्म नहीं है, आपका गर्भवास और जन्म भी नहीं होता। मैं जरा-जन्म और मृत्युके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञोपस्करमादाय सर्वैर् आगम्य ताम् इति । राज्ञीनां च कुमाराणां सहस्रं साष्टकं तथा
verses.transliteration: yajñopaskaramādāya sarvair āgamya tām iti / rājñīnāṃ ca kumārāṇāṃ sahasraṃ sāṣṭakaṃ tathā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: संकटोंसे मुक्ति पानेके लिये आप श्रीहरिकी शरणमें
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वांश् चैव महीपालान् नानादेशसमुद्भवान् । सप्तरात्राभ्यन्तरतो यथा यज्ञः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: sarvāṃś caiva mahīpālān nānādeśasamudbhavān / saptarātrābhyantarato yathā yajñaḥ pravartate
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: तथा श्वास-प्रश्वास आदि चेष्टाएँ सभी योनियोंमें सुलभ हैं। यह शरीर काष्ठकी भाँति एक दिन नष्ट हो जानेवाला है। आत्माके लिये तो यह बड़ी भारी विपत्तिरूप है। अपने-आपका अकेला
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कृत्य गतौ तौ तु प्रतीहारौ पुरं प्रति । कथयामासतुस्तत्र यथोद्दिष्टं नृपेण तु
verses.transliteration: namaskṛtya gatau tau tu pratīhārau puraṃ prati / kathayāmāsatustatra yathoddiṣṭaṃ nṛpeṇa tu
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: होना तो स्वयंसिद्ध है। केवल शरीरके जन्मसे ही इसमें पुनर्जन्मकी प्रतीति होती है। भगवन्! मैं अपने मन, बुद्धि और प्राणोंको आपमें ही लगाकर, आपके भजनमें तत्पर और आपकी ही शरण
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टोत्तरसहस्रं तु राज्ञीनां दिव्यवाससाम् । कुमारा ये च राजानो ये चान्ये गृहकर्मिणः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu rājñīnāṃ divyavāsasām / kumārā ye ca rājāno ye cānye gṛhakarmiṇaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त होकर मृत्युकालमें भी आपका ही स्मरण करूँगा। प्रभो! मेरे द्वारा पूर्वजन्ममें जो अशुभ कर्म किये गये हों वे वातादिजनित रोगोंके रूपमें मेरे शरीरमें प्रवेश करें, जिससे उन सबका ऋण
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: असूताक्षतयोनीनां लक्षम् एकं तु योषिताम् । रम्भोर्वशीसमानानां रूपेणाप्रतिमत्विषाम्
verses.transliteration: asūtākṣatayonīnāṃ lakṣam ekaṃ tu yoṣitām / rambhorvaśīsamānānāṃ rūpeṇāpratimatviṣām
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: अन्यान्य यशस्वी पुरुषोंके लिये भी कल्याणका सबसे श्रेष्ठ उपाय यही है कि वे इस स्तोत्रका पाठ करें। यह सब पापोंकी शुद्धि करनेवाला, पुण्यस्वरूप तथा परमपदरूप है । सदा प्रातःकाल,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: महोरस्कन्धगात्राणां वाहानामयुतानि षट् । सुवर्णारत्नपूर्णानां मुद्राणामयुतं तथा
verses.transliteration: mahoraskandhagātrāṇāṃ vāhānāmayutāni ṣaṭ / suvarṇāratnapūrṇānāṃ mudrāṇāmayutaṃ tathā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: मध्याह्नकाल और सायंकालमें उठकर सब पापोंकी शान्ति करनेवाले इस जपनीय स्तोत्रका निरन्तर जप करना चाहिए-'मैं हरि, कृष्ण, हृषीकेश, वासुदेव, जनार्दन तथा जगन्नाथको प्रणाम करता
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: सवसानां च धेनूनां त्रिंशल् लक्षाणि यन्त्रितः । पाण्डुराणां हयानां तु अयुतानि दशैव तु
verses.transliteration: savasānāṃ ca dhenūnāṃ triṃśal lakṣāṇi yantritaḥ / pāṇḍurāṇāṃ hayānāṃ tu ayutāni daśaiva tu
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: हूँ। वे मेरे पापोंका निवारण करें। शंख, चक्र तथा शार्ङ्गधनुष धारण करनेवाले, मधुसूदन, लक्ष्मीपति श्रीविष्णुको प्रणाम करता हूँ। वे मेरे पापोंका नाश करें। जो जगतका पालन करनेके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: घण्टाभरणशोभानां दन्तिनामयुतं तथा । यज्ञोपस्करमादाय सर्वसम्भारसम्भृतम्
verses.transliteration: ghaṇṭābharaṇaśobhānāṃ dantināmayutaṃ tathā / yajñopaskaramādāya sarvasambhārasambhṛtam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: उद्यत रहनेवाले हैं, यशोदा माताके द्वारा कटिमें रस्सीसे बँधनेके कारण जो दामोदर नाम धारण करते हैं, सदा प्रसन्न रहते हैं तथा कमलके समान जिनके नेत्र हैं, उन अविनाशी विष्णुको
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रस्थितौ नर्मदां राज्ञे सन्निवेशयतां पुरः । प्रणम्य चाब्रवीद् राजा सप्तकल्पान्तवासिनम्
verses.transliteration: prasthitau narmadāṃ rājñe sanniveśayatāṃ puraḥ / praṇamya cābravīd rājā saptakalpāntavāsinam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: मैं प्रणाम करता इँ वे मेरे पापोंका नाश करें। जो सब भूतोंके ईश्वर, अक्षर और अनिर्देश्य
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: आदेशो दीयतां मह्यं मखं यत्र प्रवर्तते । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: वैदूर्यस्य च वारुण्यां यज्ञयूपांश् च मण्डपान्
verses.transliteration: ādeśo dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ makhaṃ yatra pravartate / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: vaidūryasya ca vāruṇyāṃ yajñayūpāṃś ca maṇḍapān
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: हैं और इसी रूपमें महात्मा पुरुष जिनका सहैव ध्यान करते हैं, उन भगवान् वासुदेवकी मैं शरणमें आया El सब प्रकारके बन्धनोंसे मुक्त हुआ पुरुष जिनमें प्रवेश करके पुनर्जन्मको नहीं प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यांश् च यज्ञसम्भारान् सर्वांस् तत्रैव कारय । वशिष्ठं वामदेवं च भृगुमङ्गिरसं तथा
verses.transliteration: anyāṃś ca yajñasambhārān sarvāṃs tatraiva kāraya / vaśiṣṭhaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca bhṛgumaṅgirasaṃ tathā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: होता, उन श्रीहरिकी मैं शरणमें आया हूँ। जो ब्रह्माजीका शरीर धारण करके देवता, असुर और मनुष्यसहित सम्पूर्ण जगत्की बार-बार सृष्टि करते हैं, उन भगवान् श्रीहरिकी मैं शरणमें आया हूँ।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्यं पुलहं चैव भारद्वाजं च कश्यपम् । याज्ञवल्क्यं मुनिं चैव मुनिं दुर्वाससं तथा
verses.transliteration: pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ caiva bhāradvājaṃ ca kaśyapam / yājñavalkyaṃ muniṃ caiva muniṃ durvāsasaṃ tathā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण जगतूकी योनिरूप जो भगवान् जनार्दन ब्रह्माजीका शरीर धारण करके सदा सृष्टिकर्ममें संलग्न रहते हैं, उनको मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ। जिनसे परे दूसरी कोई वस्तु नहीं है, जिनमें
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: विभाण्डकं पर्वतं च विश्वामित्रं च नारदम् । शौनकं चैव गर्गं च संवर्तं च पराशरम्
verses.transliteration: vibhāṇḍakaṃ parvataṃ ca viśvāmitraṃ ca nāradam / śaunakaṃ caiva gargaṃ ca saṃvartaṃ ca parāśaram
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् स्थित है, जो सबके भीतर अन्तर्यामीरूपसे विराजमान एवं अनन्त हैं, उन सर्वव्यापी श्रीहरिको मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ। जो सम्पूर्ण चराचर भूतोंमें व्याप्त हैं, वे श्रीविष्णु
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: आपस्तम्बोशनो व्यासान् सकात्यायनगौतमम् । हारीतं शङ्खलिखितौ ऋष्यशृङ्गं च सोमपम्
verses.transliteration: āpastambośano vyāsān sakātyāyanagautamam / hārītaṃ śaṅkhalikhitau ṛṣyaśṛṅgaṃ ca somapam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: ही मेरे समस्त पापोंका नाश at मेरे द्वारा जो निवृत्तिप्रधान कर्म अथवा भगवान् विष्णुकी प्रसन्नताके लिये कर्म किया गया है, उससे मेरै अनेक जन्मोंके कर्मोद्वार संचित पाप अभी नष्ट
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि वालखिल्यान् मुनींस् तथा । सर्वदेवनमस्कार्यो यज्ञपर्वतसंज्ञितः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi vālakhilyān munīṃs tathā / sarvadevanamaskāryo yajñaparvatasaṃjñitaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: हो जायँँ। रात्रि, प्रातःकाल, मध्याह्न तथा अपराहृकालमें अज्ञानवश मन, वाणी और क्रियाद्वार जो कोई अशुभ कर्म किया गया हो, वह अभी क्षणभरमें नष्ट हो जाय। जैसे पानीमें नमक घुल-
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्मया महास्तम्भा यादृशैर् उपशोभिताः । बहुधा यत्र शोभन्ते तथोक्ते यज्ञमण्डपे
verses.transliteration: hiraṇmayā mahāstambhā yādṛśair upaśobhitāḥ / bahudhā yatra śobhante tathokte yajñamaṇḍape
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: मिल जाता है, उसी प्रकार वह पापराशि भी विलीन हो जाय। दूसरोंको पीड़ा देना और परायौं निन्दा करना आदि दोष जो मैंने जन्मभर कियै हैं, उनसे तथा दूसरोंके धन, खेत आदिके प्रति
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: कुण्डस्थलीः स्रुवास् सर्वाः कृत्वा हेममया नृपः । नानाविधैर् भक्ष्यभोज्यै रसैश् च विविधैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: kuṇḍasthalīḥ sruvās sarvāḥ kṛtvā hemamayā nṛpaḥ / nānāvidhair bhakṣyabhojyai rasaiś ca vividhais tathā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: लोभ होनेके कारण क्रोध होनेसे जो मेरे द्वार पापराशिका संग्रह किया गया है, वह wit पिघलनेवाले नमककी भाँति विलीन हो जाय विष्णु, वासुदेव, हरि, केशव, जनार्दन तथा श्रीकृष्णको
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: सरितः सागरां शैलांस् तीर्थराजं च सर्वशः । लोकपालान् महाबाहुरसुरान् दैत्यदानवान्
verses.transliteration: saritaḥ sāgarāṃ śailāṃs tīrtharājaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ / lokapālān mahābāhurasurān daityadānavān
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: नमस्कार है, बार-बार नमस्कार है! .
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रादित्यौ ग्रहैः सार्धं नक्षत्रध्रुवमण्डलम् । ब्रह्माद्यांश् च सुरांस् तत्र मरुतो देवतास् तथा
verses.transliteration: candrādityau grahaiḥ sārdhaṃ nakṣatradhruvamaṇḍalam / brahmādyāṃś ca surāṃs tatra maruto devatās tathā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: युधिष्ठिर! इस स्तोत्रको ब्रह्माजीसे अंगिराने और अंगिरासे इन्द्रने प्राप्त किया। इधर, वसिष्ठजीने इस स्तोत्रको राजाओंमें श्रेष्ठ नाभागको सुनाया
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुं चैव सुरेशानं यज्ञे तत्पुरुषं स्वयम् । आवाहयन् महादेवं गणकोटिसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuṃ caiva sureśānaṃ yajñe tatpuruṣaṃ svayam / āvāhayan mahādevaṃ gaṇakoṭisamanvitam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: इस विष्णुस्तोत्रका सहैव पाठ किया । तत्पश्चात्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: आवाहितस् ततश् चाग्निर् ब्राह्मणैर् वेदपारगैः । निर्धूमः प्रज्वलंश् चैव सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभः
verses.transliteration: āvāhitas tataś cāgnir brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ / nirdhūmaḥ prajvalaṃś caiva sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: जो इस स्तोत्रद्वारा भगवान् जनार्दनकी स्तुति
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: वेदध्वनितनिर्घोषैर् दिवं भूमिं च नादयन् । कणधूमकृताहारांश् चाण्डालान् सप्तवानय
verses.transliteration: vedadhvanitanirghoṣair divaṃ bhūmiṃ ca nādayan / kaṇadhūmakṛtāhārāṃś cāṇḍālān saptavānaya
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: नर्मदाके जलमें स्नान और अनेक प्रकारके दान  करता है, उसका इस घोर संसार-सागरमें पुनरागमन
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तान् आनय तथा शूद्रान् नैमिषारण्यवासिनः । वशिष्ठ उवाच: अनुग्रहम् इमं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: tān ānaya tathā śūdrān naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ / vaśiṣṭha uvāca: anugraham imaṃ manye yanmāṃ vadasi pārthiva
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: करके राजा नाभाग अपनी पुरीको गये
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: कुशाग्रेण ततो राजा तेषां मूर्ध्नो न्यपातयत् । तं दृष्ट्वा मानुषं होमं सामिषं प्रेतरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: kuśāgreṇa tato rājā teṣāṃ mūrdhno nyapātayat / taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānuṣaṃ homaṃ sāmiṣaṃ pretarūpiṇam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: मेघनादतीर्थका प्राकट्य और उसकी महिमा
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणष्टतोया रेवा तु विहाय त्रिदिवं गता । होमावसाने सम्प्राप्ते स्नानार्थं नर्मदां ययुः
verses.transliteration: praṇaṣṭatoyā revā tu vihāya tridivaṃ gatā / homāvasāne samprāpte snānārthaṃ narmadāṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं-युधिष्ठिर! प्राचीन त्रेतायुगकी बात है। पुलस्त्यपौत्र त्रिलोकविजयी रावण
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: शुष्कतोयां ततो ऽपश्यन् नर्मदां शंसितव्रताः । विस्मयं परमं प्राप्तः प्राह दुर्वाससं नृपः
verses.transliteration: śuṣkatoyāṃ tato 'paśyan narmadāṃ śaṃsitavratāḥ / vismayaṃ paramaṃ prāptaḥ prāha durvāsasaṃ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: पाकर देवता, दानव, यक्ष, गन्धर्व, नाग तथा राक्षस सबके लिये अवध्य हो गया था और पृथ्वीपर सब ओर इच्छानुसार विचरण करता था। उन दिनों परम सुन्दर देवगिरिपर मय नामसे विख्यात एक
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: चुकोप राजा विप्रेषु पापकर्मा दुरासदः । पर्जन्यार्थं वृष्टिकामैः कृतो यज्ञो निरर्थकः
verses.transliteration: cukopa rājā vipreṣu pāpakarmā durāsadaḥ / parjanyārthaṃ vṛṣṭikāmaiḥ kṛto yajño nirarthakaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: बलोन्मत्त दानव रहता था। रावण वहाँ मयको उपस्थित जान उसके समीप जाकर विनीतभावसे खड़ा हो गया। मयने दान और सम्मानपूर्वक रावणका स्वागत-सत्कार किया। तब रावणने मयसे पूछा--
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: पयः पुरातनं नष्टं न जातं वर्षणं क्वचित् । राज्ञस् तु वचनं श्रुत्वा दुर्वासाश्चा ऽब्रवीत् नृपम्
verses.transliteration: payaḥ purātanaṃ naṣṭaṃ na jātaṃ varṣaṇaṃ kvacit / rājñas tu vacanaṃ śrutvā durvāsāścā 'bravīt nṛpam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: “प्रभो! यह किसकी कन्या है, इसका नाम क्या है और यह किसलिये उग्र तपस्या कर रही है ?' मय बोला--राक्षसराज! मैं दानवोंका राजा मय हूँ, मेरी पत्नीका नाम तेजवती है। यह
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: मुनींश् च सर्वांस् तत्रस्थान् धर्मतत्त्वविशारदान् । उदकं सर्वलोकानाम् ईप्सितं च न संशयः
verses.transliteration: munīṃś ca sarvāṃs tatrasthān dharmatattvaviśāradān / udakaṃ sarvalokānām īpsitaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: सुन्दरी कन्या भी मेरी ही है। इसका नाम मन्दोदरी
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणानां तपो होमो वेदमन्त्रा वशे स्थिताः । दक्षिणा यज्ञरक्षा च यजमानवशे नृप
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇānāṃ tapo homo vedamantrā vaśe sthitāḥ / dakṣiṇā yajñarakṣā ca yajamānavaśe nṛpa
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: है। यह पतिके लिये तपस्या कर रही है। मयका यह वचन सुनकर मदोन्मत्त रावण मयसे विनीत होकर बोला-महाभाग ! मैं देवताओं और दानवोंका दर्प दलन करनेवाला पुलस्त्यपौत्र
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञोपस्करणं किंचिद् यच्चान्यद् वेदसम्मितम् । तत्सर्वं यजमानेन वेदमूलं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: yajñopaskaraṇaṃ kiṃcid yaccānyad vedasammitam / tatsarvaṃ yajamānena vedamūlaṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: राजा रावण हूँ और आपसे प्रार्थना करता हूँ कि आप अपनी कन्या मुझे दे दें। उसे पितामह ब्रह्माजीके कुलमें उत्पन्न जान महात्मा मयने भी विधि-विधानसे उसके साथ अपनी पुत्रीका ब्याह
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: वितोया नर्मदा जाता पर्जन्यो नैव वर्षति । तत्सर्वं कृतम् एवं तु श्रुतिर् एषा सनातनी
verses.transliteration: vitoyā narmadā jātā parjanyo naiva varṣati / tatsarvaṃ kṛtam evaṃ tu śrutir eṣā sanātanī
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: कर दिया। मन्दोदरीको लेकर दुरात्माद्वारा पूजित राक्षस दिव्य विमानोंपर बैठकर उसके साथ क्रीड़ा करने लगा। कुछ कालमें पुत्रवानोंमें श्रेष्ठ रावणने एक पुत्रको जन्म दिया। उस पुत्रने जन्म
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: या ययौ तां प्रतीक्षस्व नर्मदामापगोत्तमाम् । तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा क्षमस्वेत्य् अब्रवीत् नृपः
verses.transliteration: yā yayau tāṃ pratīkṣasva narmadāmāpagottamām / tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kṣamasvety abravīt nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: लेते ही संवर्तक मेघके समान बड़ी भारी गर्जना कौ, इसलिये ब्रह्माजीने उसका नाम मेघनाद रख दिया। मेघनादने बड़े होनेपर उत्तम व्रतका आश्रय लिया और उमासहित देवेश्वर भगवान् शंकरकी
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: वशिष्ठो वामदेवश्च वदत्येवं युधिष्ठिर । काशीपुर्यां प्रयागे वा गङ्गायमुनसङ्गमे
verses.transliteration: vaśiṣṭho vāmadevaśca vadatyevaṃ yudhiṣṭhira / kāśīpuryāṃ prayāge vā gaṅgāyamunasaṅgame
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: आराधना प्रारम्भ की। वह विधिपूर्वक व्रत,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव वर्तते यज्ञः सत्यमेव तपोधनाः । केचिद् आहुः कुरुक्षेत्रं स्थाने यत्र सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: tatraiva vartate yajñaḥ satyameva tapodhanāḥ / kecid āhuḥ kurukṣetraṃ sthāne yatra sarasvatī
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: चान्द्रायण आदि व्रतोंद्वारा अपने शरीरको कष्ट
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्दिष्टानि तीर्थानि मुनिभिस् तु पृथक्पृथक् । अब्रवीत् सहसा राजन् दुर्वासा रौद्रतापसः
verses.transliteration: samuddiṣṭāni tīrthāni munibhis tu pṛthakpṛthak / abravīt sahasā rājan durvāsā raudratāpasaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: गया और वहाँसे एक शिवलिंग लेकर दक्षिण दिशाकी ओर लौट पडा । नर्मदाके किनारे पहुँचनेपर उसने उस लिंगको एक स्थानपर रख दिया और स्नान करके महादेवजीका पूजन
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: नारदो ऽपि मुनिश्रेष्ठः तापसो गतकिल्बिषः । सरस्वत्यां महाराज तत्र तोयं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: nārado 'pi muniśreṣṭhaḥ tāpaso gatakilbiṣaḥ / sarasvatyāṃ mahārāja tatra toyaṃ na vidyate
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: किया। फिर अपना जप पूरा करके जब वह लंकामें जानेको उद्यत हुआ तब उसने वहाँ पड़े हुए एक अन्य शिवलिंगको बायें हाथसे उठाया। इस प्रकार जब वह पहलेवाले और दूसरे
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सालङ्कायनभूपतिः । अब्रवीच् च ततो वाक्यं सर्वान् ऋषिगणान् प्रति
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sālaṅkāyanabhūpatiḥ / abravīc ca tato vākyaṃ sarvān ṛṣigaṇān prati
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: शिवलिंगको भी भक्तिपूर्वक ले जाने लगा, तब महादेवजीका वह महालिंग नर्मदाके जलमें गिर पड़ा और दूसरा भी नर्मदाके उत्तर तटपर गिर गया। जो नर्मदाके उत्तर तटपर गिरा, वह
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: क्षणमेकं प्रतीक्षध्वं यावद् वहति कल्पगा । इत्युक्त्वा स नृपश्रेष्ठः ततस्तुष्टाव कल्पगाम्
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇamekaṃ pratīkṣadhvaṃ yāvad vahati kalpagā / ityuktvā sa nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ tatastuṣṭāva kalpagām
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: शोभायमान लिंग वहाँ मेघनादेश्वरके नामसे विख्यात हुआ और जो जलके भीतर गिर पड़ा, उसका नाम मध्यमेश्वर हुआ। मेघनाद उस लिंगको उठाना चाहता था, पर सफल न हुआ।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते ऽस्तु सुरेशानि नमस्ते शङ्करात्मजे । इडा च पिङ्गला चैव उमा गङ्गा सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: namaste 'stu sureśāni namaste śaṅkarātmaje / iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva umā gaṅgā sarasvatī
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: उन दोनों विग्रहोंका अभिप्राय जानकर वह राक्षस आकाशमार्गसे लौट गया। तभीसे वह तीर्थ मेघनाद तथा मेघारव नामसे विख्यात हुआ। उत्तर तटपर खेटक नामक उत्तम तीर्थ हुआ। उसके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्री वेदमाता च सावित्री च सरस्वती । ब्राह्मी च वैष्णवी गौरी लोकमाता यशस्विनी
verses.transliteration: gāyatrī vedamātā ca sāvitrī ca sarasvatī / brāhmī ca vaiṣṇavī gaurī lokamātā yaśasvinī
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: पूर्वभागमें सब पापोंका नाश करनेवाला गर्जन नामक तीर्थ है। राजेन्द्र! जो उस तीर्थमें स्नान और एक दिन-रातका उपवास करता है, वह सनातन कल्याणका भागी होता है। जो उस
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्दिष्टानि तीर्थानि पृथिव्यां यानि कानि च । त्वया ऽवृतानि सर्वाणि जगच् च सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: samuddiṣṭāni tīrthāni pṛthivyāṃ yāni kāni ca / tvayā 'vṛtāni sarvāṇi jagac ca sacarācaram
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: तीर्थमें पिण्डदान करता है, उससे देवलोकमें पितृगण बारह वर्षोंतक तृप्त रहते हैं। जो वहाँ ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराता है, वह योगीजनोंको मिलनेवाले उत्तम फलको पाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: न तत् पश्यामि त्वद्वारा ऽवृतं यन्न प्रदृश्यते । त्वत्तोयस्नानमात्रेण तृप्ता यान्ति परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: na tat paśyāmi tvadvārā 'vṛtaṃ yanna pradṛśyate / tvattoyasnānamātreṇa tṛptā yānti parāṃ gatim
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: करंजेशवर तथा कुण्डलेशवरतीर्थका प्रादुर्भाव और माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा स्तोत्रम् इदं देवी राज्ञश् चामिततेजसः । मकरासनमारूढा प्रत्यक्षा सप्तकल्पगा
verses.transliteration: śrutvā stotram idaṃ devī rājñaś cāmitatejasaḥ / makarāsanamārūḍhā pratyakṣā saptakalpagā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं-राजन्! पहले सत्ययुगमें ब्रह्माजीके मानसपुत्र मरीचि हुए, जो ae चेदांगोंके तत्त्वज्ञ थे। मरीचिसे दीर्घकालके बाद महर्षि कश्यपका जन्म हुआ, जो द्वितीय ब्रह्माके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: प्राह ब्रूहि वरं राजन् यत् ते मनसि वर्तते । राजोवाच: पूर्वान् सप्त परान् सप्त प्रवाहान् अक्षयान् कुरु
verses.transliteration: prāha brūhi varaṃ rājan yat te manasi vartate / rājovāca: pūrvān sapta parān sapta pravāhān akṣayān kuru
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: समान थे। उनमें अपने पिताके क्षमा, दम, दया,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: वरम् एतम् अहं मन्ये सप्तकल्पान्तवासिनि । नर्मदोवाच: दत्तो वरो मया ह्येष सत्यं तव नराधिप
verses.transliteration: varam etam ahaṃ manye saptakalpāntavāsini / narmadovāca: datto varo mayā hyeṣa satyaṃ tava narādhipa
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: सद्गुण शोभा पाते थे। महर्षि कश्यपके इन गुणोंको जानकर प्रजापति दक्षने अपनी तेरह कन्याओंका विवाह उनके साथ कर दिया। उनके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा सरिच् छ्रेष्ठा जलौघेन परिप्लुता । प्रवाहैर् विस्तृतैस् तत्र वहन्ती सा व्यवस्थिता
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā saric chreṣṭhā jalaughena pariplutā / pravāhair vistṛtais tatra vahantī sā vyavasthitā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: इन दक्ष-कन्याओंके पुत्रों और पौत्रोंकी संख्या बहुत अधिक है। अदितिने इन्द्र आदि पुत्रोंको जन्म दिया। इसी प्रकार अन्य कन्याओंने नाग,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा तादृशं कर्म सालङ्कायनभूपतेः । तुष्टुवुर् मुनयः सर्वे सत्यधर्मपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ karma sālaṅkāyanabhūpateḥ / tuṣṭuvur munayaḥ sarve satyadharmaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: वराह आदिको उत्पन्न किया। महाबाहो ! प्रजापति कश्यपके पुत्रोंसे चराचर प्राणियोंसहित समस्त त्रिलोकी व्याप्त हो गयी।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानावगाहनं पानं चक्रुस् ते पितृतर्पणम् । ततो निर्वतितो यज्ञो विप्रैः सर्वस्वदक्षिणैः
verses.transliteration: snānāvagāhanaṃ pānaṃ cakrus te pitṛtarpaṇam / tato nirvatito yajño vipraiḥ sarvasvadakṣiṇaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: युधिष्ठिर! दक्षकन्या दनुके गर्भसे एक पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: यो यत्कामयते कामं तत्तस्मै प्रतिपादितम् । वस्त्रालङ्कारदानैश् च दिव्ययानैः सुशोभनैः
verses.transliteration: yo yatkāmayate kāmaṃ tattasmai pratipāditam / vastrālaṅkāradānaiś ca divyayānaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न हुआ, जिसका नाम करंज था। दानव करंजमें राजा बलिकी भाँति सभी प्रकारके उत्तम गुण विद्यमान थे। उसने बड़ी भारी तपस्या की, तब महादेवजीने उसे दर्शन देकर कहा--' करंज!
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: ऋत्विजः पूजिताः सर्वे सालङ्कायनभूभृता । युगपत् पूजिताः सर्वे ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: ṛtvijaḥ pūjitāḥ sarve sālaṅkāyanabhūbhṛtā / yugapat pūjitāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: तुम्हारे मनमें जो इच्छा हो, उसके अनुसार वर
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शिवालयं गत्वा लिङ्गं त्रिदशपूजितम् । नाम्ना माहेश्वराख्यातं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śivālayaṃ gatvā liṅgaṃ tridaśapūjitam / nāmnā māheśvarākhyātaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: करंज बोला--प्रभो! मुझे पुत्र और पौत्रोंके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: उमया सहितं शम्भुं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम् । ॐ महेश्वराय देवाय शम्भवाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: umayā sahitaṃ śambhuṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam / oṃ maheśvarāya devāya śambhavāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: “तथास्तु''कहकर पार्वतीसहित शिव वृषभपर आरूढ़ हो वहाँसे अन्तर्धान हो गये। तब वह हैत्य भी प्रसन्नतापूर्वक अपने नामसे महादेवजीकी स्थापना करके घरको लौट गया। तभीसे उस
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्यादिना तु मन्त्रेण समभ्यर्च्य विधानतः । कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा स्थितस् तत्रैव पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: ityādinā tu mantreṇa samabhyarcya vidhānataḥ / kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā sthitas tatraiva pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: स्थानकी करंजेश्वर तीर्थके नामसे प्रसिद्धि हुई। राजन्! वहाँ स्नानमात्र करनेवाला मनुष्य ब्रह्महत्या- भी मुक्त हो जाता है। जो उस और पितरोंका तर्पण करता है,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विनिर्गता देवी पदमूलेन शूलिनः । प्रवाहो नर्मदा भेदे नार्मदः सुरपूजितः
verses.transliteration: tato vinirgatā devī padamūlena śūlinaḥ / pravāho narmadā bhede nārmadaḥ surapūjitaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: -यज्ञका पुण्यफल प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वराद्यास् तथा देवाः सर्वे तुष्टास् तु भारत । वरं याचस्व भूपाल यथेष्टं मनसेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: īśvarādyās tathā devāḥ sarve tuṣṭās tu bhārata / varaṃ yācasva bhūpāla yatheṣṭaṃ manasepsitam
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: करता है। जो वहाँ प्राणत्याग करता है, वह बीस हजार वर्षोतक स्वर्गलोकमें निवास करता है और अन्तमें उत्तम कुलमें जन्म लेकर धनवान्, वेद-वेदांगोंका तत्त्वज्ञ, सर्वशास्त्रविशारद, राजा
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच वचनं देवान् राजा परमधार्मिकः । यदि मे वरदा यूयं कामदाश् च प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: uvāca vacanaṃ devān rājā paramadhārmikaḥ / yadi me varadā yūyaṃ kāmadāś ca prasādataḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: अथवा राजाके तुल्य होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: इदं स्थानं तु न त्याज्यम् ईश्वराद् यैः सुरैर् अपि । यान्तु राष्ट्रे प्रजावृद्धिम् अनावृष्ट्या प्रपीडिताः
verses.transliteration: idaṃ sthānaṃ tu na tyājyam īśvarād yaiḥ surair api / yāntu rāṣṭre prajāvṛddhim anāvṛṣṭyā prapīḍitāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--युधिष्ठिर! प्राचीन त्रेतायुगमें पुलस्त्यपुत्र विश्रवाने भरद्वाज मुनिकी पुत्रीसे विवाह किया। उससे धनंजय नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ, जो पुत्रोचित गुणोंसे सम्पन्न था।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: इदं वरम् अहं मन्ये पापा यान्तु त्रिविष्टपम् । अग्निश् चाहवनीयो ऽत्र स्वयं तिष्ठति सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: idaṃ varam ahaṃ manye pāpā yāntu triviṣṭapam / agniś cāhavanīyo 'tra svayaṃ tiṣṭhati sarvadā
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: उसके जन्मका समाचार सुनकर लोकपितामह ब्रह्माजीने ऋषियों और देवताओंके साथ बड़ी प्रसन्नतापूर्वक उस बालकका नामकरण-संस्कार किया और इस प्रकार कहा-'हे अनघ! यह
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः: यत् त्वया भाषितं राजंस् तत् सर्वं तु भवेद् इति । एवम् उक्त्वा ययुः सर्वे ह्य् अन्तर्धानं च खेचराः
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ: yat tvayā bhāṣitaṃ rājaṃs tat sarvaṃ tu bhaved iti / evam uktvā yayuḥ sarve hy antardhānaṃ ca khecarāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: बालक तुझ विश्रवासे प्रकट होकर मेरा पौत्र हुआ है। इसलिये मैंने तुम्हारे इस पुत्रको वैश्रवण नाम दिया है। यह सब देवताओंके धनका रक्षक होगा। लोकपालोंमें यह चौथा होगा। अविनाशी
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः प्रवर्धितं राष्ट्रं कामवर्षी च वासवः । यज्ञं निवर्तयित्वा तु दिव्यामात्यैः समावृतः
verses.transliteration: punaḥ pravardhitaṃ rāṣṭraṃ kāmavarṣī ca vāsavaḥ / yajñaṃ nivartayitvā tu divyāmātyaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: और यक्षोंका स्वामी होगा।'
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: महीपालसहस्रैस् तु सान्तःपुरपरिच्छदः । विवेश नगरीं रम्याम् अयोध्यां देवनिर्मिताम्
verses.transliteration: mahīpālasahasrais tu sāntaḥpuraparicchadaḥ / viveśa nagarīṃ ramyām ayodhyāṃ devanirmitām
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: आगे वही यक्षश्रेष्ठ कुण्डधार हुआ। उसने उत्तम स्वरूप और अवस्था पाकर माता-पिताकी आज्ञासे नर्मदाके तटपर बैठकर बड़ी भारी तपस्या की। तब दीर्घकालके पश्चात् महादेवजी उसपर
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् ते कथितं राजन्न् उमामाहेश्वरं प्रति । तिर्यग् योनिगताः पापा मृगपक्षिसरीसृपाः
verses.transliteration: etat te kathitaṃ rājann umāmāheśvaraṃ prati / tiryag yonigatāḥ pāpā mṛgapakṣisarīsṛpāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्न हुए और इस प्रकार बोले-"वत्स! तुम अपनी इच्छाके अनुसार वर माँगो।'
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: अवशः स्ववशो वा ऽपि शिवलोकमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: avaśaḥ svavaśo vā 'pi śivalokamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.hindi: कुण्डधार बोला--देव! यह तीर्थ और लिंग मेरे नामसे प्रसिद्ध हो।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, to the eastern side of Orhkara is the confluence, well-known all over the world, where Nilaganga meets Reva.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे पञ्चविंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय २६ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अथान्यत् कथयिष्यामि मण्डपेश्वरम् उत्तमम् । स्नातमात्रो नरस् तत्र न विशेद् योनिसङ्कटम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 26 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: athānyat kathayiṣyāmi maṇḍapeśvaram uttamam / snātamātro naras tatra na viśed yonisaṅkaṭam
verses.translation: Be victorious, O immeasurable Lotus-born One. Be victorious, O cause of creation. O most excellent one among Suras, we have sought refuge in you.
verses.hindi: तब “एवमस्तु' कहकर पार्वतीसहित भगवान् शिव अन्तर्धान हो आकाशमार्गसे कैलास पर्वतको
verses.wordMeaning: Be victorious, O immeasurable Lotus-born One. Be victorious, O cause of creation. O most excellent one among Suras, we have sought refuge in you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, O immeasurable Lotus-born One. Be victorious, O cause of creation. O most excellent one among Suras, we have sought refuge in you.

verses.sanskrit: दशलक्षाणि तीर्थानि तस्मिंस् तिष्ठन्ति भारत । मण्डपेश्वरतीर्थस्य कूर्मवृद्धिवदर्चनम्
verses.transliteration: daśalakṣāṇi tīrthāni tasmiṃs tiṣṭhanti bhārata / maṇḍapeśvaratīrthasya kūrmavṛddhivadarcanam
verses.translation: He eulogized Paramesvara through richly-worded prayers.
verses.hindi: हो वहाँ कुण्डलेशवर महादेवको स्थापित किया। विविध उपचारोंके साथ शिवलिंगका पूजन और अन्न-पानादि तथा वस्त्राभूषणादिके द्वारा ब्राह्मणोंको तृप्त करके महादेबजीको सन्तुष्ट करनेके अनन्तर
verses.wordMeaning: He eulogized Paramesvara through richly-worded prayers.
verses.commentary: Sense: He eulogized Paramesvara through richly-worded prayers.

verses.sanskrit: सुरासुरगणैर् इष्टं तस्मिंस् तीर्थे नराधिप । अनेकभाविकं पापं तत्क्षणाद् एव नश्यति
verses.transliteration: surāsuragaṇair iṣṭaṃ tasmiṃs tīrthe narādhipa / anekabhāvikaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati
verses.translation: Welcome unto the Devas and Vipras (Brahmanas). The night has dawned well today. What shall we do? Tell me quickly. Who else is to be resorted to by Suras and Asuras?
verses.hindi: वह अपने घरको लौट गया। तबसे वह तीर्थ तीनों लोकोंमें कुण्डलेशवरके नामसे विख्यात
verses.wordMeaning: Welcome unto the Devas and Vipras (Brahmanas). The night has dawned well today. What shall we do? Tell me quickly. Who else is to be resorted to by Suras and Asuras?
verses.commentary: Sense: Welcome unto the Devas and Vipras (Brahmanas). The night has dawned well today. What shall we do? Tell me quickly. Who else is to be resorted to by Suras and Asuras?

verses.sanskrit: तिलोदकप्रदानेन पिण्डपातेन भारत । तृप्यन्ति पितरः सर्वे यावत् तिष्ठति कल्पगा
verses.transliteration: tilodakapradānena piṇḍapātena bhārata / tṛpyanti pitaraḥ sarve yāvat tiṣṭhati kalpagā
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: हुआ। युधिष्ठिर! जो कोई भी उस तीर्थमें वेदोके पाठका फल प्राप्त होता है। जो मनुष्य उपवासपूर्वक ईशान देवका पूजन करता है, वह । वहाँ ब्राह्मणोंक लिये गोदान अथवा अन्नदान सब पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है। उस तीर्थमें स्नान  करता है, उस गौ तथा उसकी सन्तानोंके शरीरमें करके जो ब्राह्मण ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद और सामवेदकी जितने रोएँ होते हैं, उतने हजार वर्षोतक वह
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र यस् त्यजति प्राणान् अवशस्ववशो ऽपि वा । दशवर्षसहस्राणि राजा वैद्याधरे पुरे
verses.transliteration: tatra yas tyajati prāṇān avaśasvavaśo 'pi vā / daśavarṣasahasrāṇi rājā vaidyādhare pure
verses.translation: Be victorious, O $ambhu, O Virupaksa (odd-eyed that is three-eyed one). Be victorious, O three-eyed Lord; be victorious, O Sankara, O Isana, O Rudra, O Isvara. Obeisance to you.
verses.hindi: एक-एक ऋचाका भी पाठ करता है, उसे चारों  दाता स्वर्गलोकमें प्रतिष्ठित होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Be victorious, O $ambhu, O Virupaksa (odd-eyed that is three-eyed one). Be victorious, O three-eyed Lord; be victorious, O Sankara, O Isana, O Rudra, O Isvara. Obeisance to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, O $ambhu, O Virupaksa (odd-eyed that is three-eyed one). Be victorious, O three-eyed Lord; be victorious, O Sankara, O Isana, O Rudra, O Isvara. Obeisance to you.

verses.sanskrit: मानसौ ब्रह्मणः पुत्रौ बादरायण शाकटौ । अगस्त्यस्याश्रमं पुण्यं महर्षिगणसेवितम्
verses.transliteration: mānasau brahmaṇaḥ putrau bādarāyaṇa śākaṭau / agastyasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam
verses.translation: At your behest, O Lord of Devas, I shall get the excellent city broken up (by dissension) though it is impen- etrable by diverse means on the part of the Devas including Vasava (Indra).
verses.hindi: पिप्पलेश्वर, विमलेश्वर, विश्वरूपा-नर्मदासंगम तथा एक दिनमें मेघनादेश्वर आदि पाँच लिंगोंकी यात्राका माहात्म्य, राजा धर्मसेनकी कथा
verses.wordMeaning: At your behest, O Lord of Devas, I shall get the excellent city broken up (by dissension) though it is impen- etrable by diverse means on the part of the Devas including Vasava (Indra).
verses.commentary: Sense: At your behest, O Lord of Devas, I shall get the excellent city broken up (by dissension) though it is impen- etrable by diverse means on the part of the Devas including Vasava (Indra).

verses.sanskrit: कन्दमूलफलैः शाकैः शिवभक्तिपरायणैः । एकदा ऽवसरे प्राप्ते अजापालो नृपात्मजः
verses.transliteration: kandamūlaphalaiḥ śākaiḥ śivabhaktiparāyaṇaiḥ / ekadā 'vasare prāpte ajāpālo nṛpātmajaḥ
verses.translation: He bowed down to the feet of Narada quickly. Then he began to submit to Bana who was in the centre of the Royal Court. All his limbs began to tremble. He covered his face with the hand. Even as all the soldiers were listening he spoke these words: "There stands at the threshold, Narada who is honoured and adored by Devas, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Kinnaras and Danavas. He is fond of (instigating) quart els and is very difficult to pacify."
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं--नर्मदाके तटपर पिप्पलाद नामक एक मुनि थे। वे माता-पितासे
verses.wordMeaning: He bowed down to the feet of Narada quickly. Then he began to submit to Bana who was in the centre of the Royal Court. All his limbs began to tremble. He covered his face with the hand.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He bowed down to the feet of Narada quickly. Then he began to submit to Bana who was in the centre of the Royal Court. All his limbs began to tremble. He covered his face with the hand.…

verses.sanskrit: अयोध्याधिपतिः श्रीमान् चक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः । अष्टोत्तरं शतं व्याघ्रानजाः कृत्वा ररक्ष च
verses.transliteration: ayodhyādhipatiḥ śrīmān cakratulyaparākramaḥ / aṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ vyāghrānajāḥ kṛtvā rarakṣa ca
verses.translation: Excellent! Excellent! O mighty-armed one causing Danu's race to flourish! Who else excepting you is praise-worthy in the whole range of the three worlds? O leading scion of the family of Danu, O most excellent one among the descendants of Danu! I have been honoured with wealth and jewels of very excellent qualities; also by the offer of your kingdom as well as your own self. Who else will adore (me)?
verses.hindi: रहकर एकचित्त हो पार्वतीसहित भगवान् शंकरको
verses.wordMeaning: Excellent! Excellent! O mighty-armed one causing Danu's race to flourish! Who else excepting you is praise-worthy in the whole range of the three worlds? O leading scion of the family of Danu,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Excellent! Excellent! O mighty-armed one causing Danu's race to flourish! Who else excepting you is praise-worthy in the whole range of the three worlds? O leading scion of the family of Danu,…

verses.sanskrit: सपादलक्षं जीवन्ति प्रजास्तस्मिन् महीपतौ । धनाढ्या धनदस्येव प्रशशास पुरीं तथा
verses.transliteration: sapādalakṣaṃ jīvanti prajāstasmin mahīpatau / dhanāḍhyā dhanadasyeva praśaśāsa purīṃ tathā
verses.translation: O holy Sir, what are those Vratas in the world whereby Devas become pleased? What are the Danas (religious gifts) offered which yield great benefits? What are those holy obser- vances of fasts included by learned ones among the holy rites meant for women, by the performance whereof virtuous ladies go to heaven? O highly esteemed one, mention all these things truthfully. I wish to know everything. Do speak unhesitatingly.
verses.hindi: तब महादेवजी बोले-ब्रह्मन्! मैं तुम्हारी इस तपस्यासे सन्तुष्ट हूँ। तुम मनोवांछित वर माँगो।
verses.wordMeaning: O holy Sir, what are those Vratas in the world whereby Devas become pleased? What are the Danas (religious gifts) offered which yield great benefits? What are those holy obser- vances of fasts included by learned ones among the holy rites meant for women,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy Sir, what are those Vratas in the world whereby Devas become pleased? What are the Danas (religious gifts) offered which yield great benefits? What are those holy obser- vances of fasts included by learned ones among the holy rites meant for women,…

verses.sanskrit: स कदाचित् महाभागः ससैन्यो मृगयां गतः । महीपालसहस्रेण मुदा परमया युतः
verses.transliteration: sa kadācit mahābhāgaḥ sasainyo mṛgayāṃ gataḥ / mahīpālasahasreṇa mudā paramayā yutaḥ
verses.translation: Excellent! Excellent! O highly blessed lady, you have put such a question as will enable all ladies to get their piety increased by paying heed to it.
verses.hindi: पिप्पलाद बोले--देव! आप इस तीर्थमें सदा मेरे नामसे प्रसिद्ध होकर निवास करें।
verses.wordMeaning: Excellent! Excellent! O highly blessed lady, you have put such a question as will enable all ladies to get their piety increased by paying heed to it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excellent! Excellent! O highly blessed lady, you have put such a question as will enable all ladies to get their piety increased by paying heed to it.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपश्यत् पर्वतस्याग्रे मेरुतुल्ये महीपतिः । पुष्पारामसहस्राणि हर्म्याणि विविधानि च
verses.transliteration: so 'paśyat parvatasyāgre merutulye mahīpatiḥ / puṣpārāmasahasrāṇi harmyāṇi vividhāni ca
verses.translation: By fasts and Danas husband and sons come under control. I shall tell you those rites which when performed always bring about honour from kinsmen.
verses.hindi: पिप्पलादके ऐसा कहनेपर “तथास्तु' कहकर महादेवजी वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये। उनके चले जानेपर पिप्पलादने नर्मदाकी महाजलराशिमें स्नान किया और भगवान् शिवकी स्थापना करके वे
verses.wordMeaning: By fasts and Danas husband and sons come under control. I shall tell you those rites which when performed always bring about honour from kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: By fasts and Danas husband and sons come under control. I shall tell you those rites which when performed always bring about honour from kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव शतसाहस्रं यतीनाम् ऊर्ध्वरेतसाम् । भक्त्या ऽभ्यर्च्य विधानेन देवेशं च मुनींस् तथा
verses.transliteration: tatraiva śatasāhasraṃ yatīnām ūrdhvaretasām / bhaktyā 'bhyarcya vidhānena deveśaṃ ca munīṃs tathā
verses.translation: O beautiful lady, I shall mention those rites which bring good results if performed and bad results if not per- formed. If they are performed a Durbhagd (unfortunate woman)
verses.hindi: उत्तर पर्वतपर चले गये। जो मनुष्य उस तीर्थमें भक्तिपूर्वक स्नान करके देवताओं और पितरोंका तर्पण एवं महेश्वरका पूजन करता है, वह अश्वमेध यज्ञका उत्तम फल पाता है । पिप्पलेशवरके समीप
verses.wordMeaning: O beautiful lady, I shall mention those rites which bring good results if performed and bad results if not per- formed. If they are performed a Durbhagd (unfortunate woman)
verses.commentary: Sense: O beautiful lady, I shall mention those rites which bring good results if performed and bad results if not per- formed. If they are performed a Durbhagd (unfortunate woman)

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्योवाच मधुरं बादरायणशाकटौ । पितॄणां तारणार्थाय श्राद्धकालत्वसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: praṇamyovāca madhuraṃ bādarāyaṇaśākaṭau / pitṝṇāṃ tāraṇārthāya śrāddhakālatvasiddhaye
verses.translation: Also, listen to the propitiation of Vanaspatis (plants and herbs). One will attain heaven by approaching (devoutly) the following trees: Jambu, Nimba, Tinduka, Madhuka, Amra, Amalaka, Salmall, Vata, Pippala, Sami, Bilva, Amalivrksa, Kadali, Patali and other, meritorious trees.
verses.hindi: जिसकी मृत्यु होती है, वह भगवान् शिवके धाममें जाता है। पिप्पलेश्वर तीर्थमें भक्तिपूर्वक पितरोंकी तृप्तिके उद्देश्यसे जो ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराता है, उसके पितर बारह हजार वर्षोंतक तृप्त रहकर
verses.wordMeaning: Also, listen to the propitiation of Vanaspatis (plants and herbs). One will attain heaven by approaching (devoutly) the following trees: Jambu, Nimba, Tinduka, Madhuka, Amra, Amalaka, Salmall, Vata, Pippala, Sami, Bilva, Amalivrksa, Kadali, Patali and other, meritorious trees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Also, listen to the propitiation of Vanaspatis (plants and herbs). One will attain heaven by approaching (devoutly) the following trees: Jambu, Nimba, Tinduka, Madhuka, Amra, Amalaka, Salmall, Vata, Pippala, Sami, Bilva, Amalivrksa, Kadali, Patali and other, meritorious trees.

verses.sanskrit: महानयं भवद्भिश् च प्रसाद क्रियतां मयि । अभ्यर्च्य तान् मुनीन् सर्वान् प्रणिपत्य स्थितस् ततः
verses.transliteration: mahānayaṃ bhavadbhiś ca prasāda kriyatāṃ mayi / abhyarcya tān munīn sarvān praṇipatya sthitas tataḥ
verses.translation: "Obeisance to you, O Lord of the chiefs of Devas, O consort of Uma, O Lord of the cosmos. O Lord, accept this Arghya and destroy all my misfortunes."
verses.hindi: उत्तम गतिको प्राप्त होते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance to you, O Lord of the chiefs of Devas, O consort of Uma, O Lord of the cosmos. O Lord, accept this Arghya and destroy all my misfortunes."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance to you, O Lord of the chiefs of Devas, O consort of Uma, O Lord of the cosmos. O Lord, accept this Arghya and destroy all my misfortunes."

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा अजापालस्य भूभृतः । ऋषीणां तापसौ वृद्धौ बादरायणशाकटौ
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ajāpālasya bhūbhṛtaḥ / ṛṣīṇāṃ tāpasau vṛddhau bādarāyaṇaśākaṭau
verses.translation: After the offering of Arghya, the Karaka (waterpot) is offered. It is filled with water and it is covered with a leaf of Madhuka and is offered along with a gold piece in accor- dance with the capacity of the devotee.
verses.hindi: राजेनद्र! तदनन्तर उत्तम विमलेश्वरतीर्थको जाय। जहाँ एक मनोहर देवशिला है, जहाँ गर्जन और
verses.wordMeaning: After the offering of Arghya, the Karaka (waterpot) is offered. It is filled with water and it is covered with a leaf of Madhuka and is offered along with a gold piece in accor- dance with the capacity of the devotee.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the offering of Arghya, the Karaka (waterpot) is offered. It is filled with water and it is covered with a leaf of Madhuka and is offered along with a gold piece in accor- dance with the capacity of the devotee.

verses.sanskrit: ऊचतुस्तौ तु वचनम् अजापालं नराधिपम् । न राजग्राहकाः सर्वे मुनयः शंसितव्रताः
verses.transliteration: ūcatustau tu vacanam ajāpālaṃ narādhipam / na rājagrāhakāḥ sarve munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ
verses.translation: "O Lalita, the Karaka filled with water and endowed
verses.hindi: आनन्द भोगते हैं । जो देवशिलातीर्थमें भक्तिभावसे थोड़े-से दानके द्वारा भी ब्राह्मणोंका सत्कार करता है, उसके पुण्यफलका अन्त नहीं है। युधिष्ठिर! तदनन्तर नर्मदाके उत्तर तटकी यात्रा
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lalita, the Karaka filled with water and endowed
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lalita, the Karaka filled with water and endowed

verses.sanskrit: राजप्रतिग्रहो घोरो रौद्रः पापो भयावहः । नरके यातनां घोरां कः सोढुं शक्तिमान् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: rājapratigraho ghoro raudraḥ pāpo bhayāvahaḥ / narake yātanāṃ ghorāṃ kaḥ soḍhuṃ śaktimān bhavet
