verses.translation: Uttering this Mantra, the excellent Karaka is offered to a Brahmana. Till the next third lunar day of the bright half of the month the devotee should avoid salt. After praying for the forgiveness of the Goddess and the Lord of Devas the devotee should eat only the Havis at night. This procedure should be adopted every month. The Vrata is con- cluded on the third day of the bright half of Phalguna.
verses.hindi: करे। मेघनादतीर्थके समीप सरिताओंमें श्रेष्ठ विश्वरूपा नदी बहती है। एक समय नर्मदाके तटपर विराजमान होकर भगवान् शंकर तपस्या करते-करते विश्वरूप हो गये। तब उन्हींके शरीरसे सरिताओंमें श्रेष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: Uttering this Mantra, the excellent Karaka is offered to a Brahmana. Till the next third lunar day of the bright half of the month the devotee should avoid salt.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Uttering this Mantra, the excellent Karaka is offered to a Brahmana. Till the next third lunar day of the bright half of the month the devotee should avoid salt.…

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्ति ते ऽस्तु नृपश्रेष्ठ पन्थानः सन्तु ते शिवाः । एवम् उक्त्वा तु चक्रुस् ते मुनयो वाक्यसंयमम्
verses.transliteration: svasti te 'stu nṛpaśreṣṭha panthānaḥ santu te śivāḥ / evam uktvā tu cakrus te munayo vākyasaṃyamam
verses.translation: Sarva is to be worshipped with profuse offer- ings of the adoration and repeatedly with Kumkuma, and garlands of very tender flowers as well as Kusumbha flowers and Kesara. Twelve couples should be offered pairs of Kausumbha (red in hue) cloths, resembling the flowers of AtasI for wearing. Each of these pairs should be given pairs of sandals, umbrellas, necklaces,
verses.hindi: विश्वरूपा प्रकट हुई और नर्मदाके जलमें जाकर मिल गयी। दोनोंका संगम बड़ा ही गुणवान् है। जो मनुष्य उस तीर्थमें जाकर स्नान करता है, वह फिर इस संसारमें जन्म नहीं लेता। वहाँ जो कर्म
verses.wordMeaning: Sarva is to be worshipped with profuse offer- ings of the adoration and repeatedly with Kumkuma, and garlands of very tender flowers as well as Kusumbha flowers and Kesara. Twelve couples should be offered pairs of Kausumbha (red in hue) cloths,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarva is to be worshipped with profuse offer- ings of the adoration and repeatedly with Kumkuma, and garlands of very tender flowers as well as Kusumbha flowers and Kesara. Twelve couples should be offered pairs of Kausumbha (red in hue) cloths,…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मशापभयाद्भीतो नृपस्तूष्णीं बभूव ह । गजानां दशसाहस्रं घण्टाभरणभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: brahmaśāpabhayādbhīto nṛpastūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha / gajānāṃ daśasāhasraṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitam
verses.translation: The Udyapana (concluding procedure of the Vrata) is described in w 150 - 169.
verses.hindi: किया जाता है वह सब अक्षय होता है। उस तीर्थमें किया हुआ श्राद्ध, यज्ञ और शिवपूजन कोरिगुना फल देनेवाला होता है। वहाँ पाँच शिवलिंग प्रसिद्ध हैं-मेघनादेश्वर, गोष्ठेश्वर, वागीश्वर,
verses.wordMeaning: The Udyapana (concluding procedure of the Vrata) is described in w 150 - 169.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Udyapana (concluding procedure of the Vrata) is described in w 150 - 169.

O dear excellent Brahmana, I don't have any other deity excepting Bana. On the strength of this truth, may my husband live for a hundred years. I to my husband, O Brahmana Sage, go now. May blessing be granted (to me).

verses.commentary: Sense: Dana has been made as instructed by you. It is done with my husband in view. O excellent Brahmana, in every birth of mine may Bana alone be my husband. O dear excellent Brahmana, I don't have any other deity excepting Bana. On the strength of this truth,…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे करमर्देश्वरीकीर्तनं नाम सप्तविंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय २८ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: मान्धाता राजशार्दूलस् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः । एतद् इच्छाम्य् अहं श्रोतुं चरितं तस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe karamardeśvarīkīrtanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 28 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: māndhātā rājaśārdūlas triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ / etad icchāmy ahaṃ śrotuṃ caritaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime Rudra occupied the banks of Narmada. While he was sporting in the company of Uma, Narada arrived there.
verses.hindi: नर्मदाके उत्तर तटपर गौतमेश्वर नामक उत्तम तीर्थ है। महर्षि गौतमने सब लोगोंके हितकी इच्छासे स्वर्गकी सीढीके रूपमें उस तीर्थकी स्थापना की है। युधिष्ठिर! वहाँ सब पातकोंका
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime Rudra occupied the banks of Narmada. While he was sporting in the company of Uma, Narada arrived there.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime Rudra occupied the banks of Narmada. While he was sporting in the company of Uma, Narada arrived there.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: शृणु राजन् महाभाग यन् मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि । इक्ष्वाकुवंशसम्भूतो युवनाश्वो महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu rājan mahābhāga yan māṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi / ikṣvākuvaṃśasambhūto yuvanāśvo mahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: After bowing down to the Lord of the chiefs of Devas, Sankara along with Uma, he submitted to the Lord the details of what happened then at Tripura:
verses.hindi: नाश करने और स्वर्गलोककी प्राप्ति करानेके लिये जगद्गुरु महादेवजी निवास करते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to the Lord of the chiefs of Devas, Sankara along with Uma, he submitted to the Lord the details of what happened then at Tripura:
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to the Lord of the chiefs of Devas, Sankara along with Uma, he submitted to the Lord the details of what happened then at Tripura:

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽयजत् पृथिवीपालः क्रतुभिर् भूरिदक्षिणैः । अनपत्यस् तु राजर्षिः स महात्मा दृढव्रतः
verses.transliteration: so 'yajat pṛthivīpālaḥ kratubhir bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ / anapatyas tu rājarṣiḥ sa mahātmā dṛḍhavrataḥ
verses.translation: "At the behest of my Lord (you), I went to the place where Bana's palace was situated. After meeting Bana as per formalities, I went to the great Antahpura. There I saw thou- sands of the queens of Bana, the intelligent one. Then I stirred up that city in a befitting manner and in the way it had been desired and have now returned."
verses.hindi: नर्मदाके दक्षिण तटपर शंखचूडेशवर नामसे
verses.wordMeaning: "At the behest of my Lord (you), I went to the place where Bana's palace was situated. After meeting Bana as per formalities, I went to the great Antahpura. There I saw thou- sands of the queens of Bana, the intelligent one.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "At the behest of my Lord (you), I went to the place where Bana's palace was situated. After meeting Bana as per formalities, I went to the great Antahpura. There I saw thou- sands of the queens of Bana, the intelligent one.…

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रिष्वाधाय तद्राज्यं वननिष्ठो महीपतिः । शास्त्रदृष्टेन विधिना संयम्यात्मानम् आत्मना
verses.transliteration: mantriṣvādhāya tadrājyaṃ vananiṣṭho mahīpatiḥ / śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā saṃyamyātmānam ātmanā
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Narada, the Lord gave his approval saying, "Well done! Well done!" Then the Lord of Devas pondered over the whirling of Tripura.
verses.hindi: प्रसिद्ध तीर्थ है। उस तीर्थमें स्नान करके पवित्र और एकाग्रचित्त हो भक्तिपूर्वक मधु, दही और घीसे भगवान् शंखचूडको स्नान करावे। रातमें उनके आगे जागरण करे और उत्तम व्रतका पालन
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Narada, the Lord gave his approval saying, "Well done! Well done!" Then the Lord of Devas pondered over the whirling of Tripura.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Narada, the Lord gave his approval saying, "Well done! Well done!" Then the Lord of Devas pondered over the whirling of Tripura.

verses.sanskrit: फलमूलानुभक्षश् च स चचार महत्तपः । शुष्ककण्ठः पिपासार्तः पानीयार्थे भृशः नृपः
verses.transliteration: phalamūlānubhakṣaś ca sa cacāra mahattapaḥ / śuṣkakaṇṭhaḥ pipāsārtaḥ pānīyārthe bhṛśaḥ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: He thought: 'Tripura moves like the discus whirled from his hand by Visnu, the powerful one. It has great velocity and it is extensive. It has been preserved by my splendour. Bana is reputed all over the world as one devoted to me. Word has been already given by me particularly to the Brahmanas.'
verses.hindi: करनेवाले ब्राह्मणोंका दही-भातसे सत्कार करे। जो उस तीर्थमें साँपके डसनेसे भी मृत्युको प्राप्त होता है वह भी भगवान् शंखचूडकी आज्ञासे उत्तम लोकमें जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: He thought: 'Tripura moves like the discus whirled from his hand by Visnu, the powerful one. It has great velocity and it is extensive. It has been preserved by my splendour. Bana is reputed all over the world as one devoted to me.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He thought: 'Tripura moves like the discus whirled from his hand by Visnu, the powerful one. It has great velocity and it is extensive. It has been preserved by my splendour. Bana is reputed all over the world as one devoted to me.…

verses.sanskrit: सम्प्रविश्याश्रमस्यान्तः पानीयं सो ऽभ्ययाचत । तस्य शुष्केण कण्ठेन क्रोशतस् तु तदा भृशम्
verses.transliteration: sampraviśyāśramasyāntaḥ pānīyaṃ so 'bhyayācata / tasya śuṣkeṇa kaṇṭhena krośatas tu tadā bhṛśam
verses.translation: Thus Mahesvara, the Lord of Devas, the Lprd of the people, thought for a long time regarding the successful completion
verses.hindi: 'पराशराश्रमकी महिमा, पराशर मुनिकी तपस्या, वरदान-प्राप्ति, भीमेश्वरमें गायत्री-जपका महत्त्व और नारदेश्वरतीर्थका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: Thus Mahesvara, the Lord of Devas, the Lprd of the people, thought for a long time regarding the successful completion
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus Mahesvara, the Lord of Devas, the Lprd of the people, thought for a long time regarding the successful completion

verses.sanskrit: ना ऽश्रौषीद् वचनं तत्र चातकस्यैव वासवः । भगवांस् तु तदा कश्चिद् ऋषिस् तस्य महीपतेः
verses.transliteration: nā 'śrauṣīd vacanaṃ tatra cātakasyaiva vāsavaḥ / bhagavāṃs tu tadā kaścid ṛṣis tasya mahīpateḥ
verses.translation: Surajye$tha (Brahma) was made the charioteer; the Vedas were made the excellent horses. The Vedangas were turned into the iron bits in the mouth and the Chandas-s (Metres) were made the reins. The orally uttered Omkara was made the whip by Mahesvara. Dhata was placed at the head and Vidhata behind. The Marutas (Winds) gathered from all the quarters were placed in the Urdhva Yantra (the overhead mechanical device). All the following ones were fixed to all the joints: great Serpents, Pisacas, Siddhas, Vidyadharas, Ganas and groups of Bhutas. Meru was stationed in the centre of the pole; the great mountain (Mahagiri) was beneath the pole. The terrible serpents were stationed in the mechanical device; Varuna and Nairrta in the Samya (part of the chariot). Gayatri and Savitri were stationed at the place where the rein was fastened. All round in the flagstaff of the chariot were placed Satya (truth), Sauca (cleanliness), Dama (control of the senses) and Raksa (protection). After making the chariot (embellished with) all the Devas, Mahesvara, the Lord of Devas, stood ready (for battle) wearing the coat of mail and holding the sword with the fingers having protectors made of leather of Godha (mountain lizard). After adjusting his garments and binding the matted tresses of hair, he got his divine bow ready and fitted his excellent chariot. Stationed in the centre of the chariot, O Yudhi?jhira, the Lord shone brilliantly.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजी कहते हैं-राजन्! नर्मदाके उत्तर तटपर महर्षि पराशरने पुत्रके लिये बड़ी भारी तपस्या की। उन्होंने हिमाचलकन्या गौरी तथा नारायणसहित लक्ष्मीको अपनी पराभक्तिसे सन्तुष्ट
verses.wordMeaning: Surajye$tha (Brahma) was made the charioteer; the Vedas were made the excellent horses. The Vedangas were turned into the iron bits in the mouth and the Chandas-s (Metres) were made the reins. The orally uttered Omkara was made the whip by Mahesvara.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Surajye$tha (Brahma) was made the charioteer; the Vedas were made the excellent horses. The Vedangas were turned into the iron bits in the mouth and the Chandas-s (Metres) were made the reins. The orally uttered Omkara was made the whip by Mahesvara.…

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रीयमग्रतः कृत्वा मन्त्रैश्चाप्य् अभिमन्त्रितम् । रात्रौ च कलशं तत्र जलपूर्णं पिपासितः
verses.transliteration: putrīyamagrataḥ kṛtvā mantraiścāpy abhimantritam / rātrau ca kalaśaṃ tatra jalapūrṇaṃ pipāsitaḥ
verses.translation: With the twang of the bow, he made the three worlds quake. After making the Vaisakha-Sthana (? special warrior posture), Hara remained steady there. After surveying for a
verses.hindi: किया। तब देवी पार्वतीने प्रत्यक्ष दर्शन देकर कहा--' मुनिश्रेष्ठ! मैं तुम्हारी भक्तिसे प्रसन्न हूँ। विप्रवर! तुम कोई वर माँगो।' पराशरजी बोले--देवि! मुझे सब शास्त्रोंके
verses.wordMeaning: With the twang of the bow, he made the three worlds quake. After making the Vaisakha-Sthana (? special warrior posture), Hara remained steady there. After surveying for a
verses.commentary: Sense: With the twang of the bow, he made the three worlds quake. After making the Vaisakha-Sthana (? special warrior posture), Hara remained steady there. After surveying for a

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यद्रवत् स वेगेन पीत्वापस् तत्र चास्वपत् । स पीत्वा शीतलं तोयं पिपासार्तो महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: abhyadravat sa vegena pītvāpas tatra cāsvapat / sa pītvā śītalaṃ toyaṃ pipāsārto mahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: The description of the Chariot and other preparations against Tripura are reminiscent of similar preparations given in Mbh, Kama, Chs. 55-34. Here the enemy is Baga, a devotee of $iva.
verses.hindi: ama निपुण एक पुत्र शीघ्र दीजिये और यह स्थान तीर्थ हो जाय तथा आप भी लोकोपकारके लिये सदा यहाँ निवास करें। देवीने कहा--“ एवमस्तु'--ऐसा ही होगा।
verses.wordMeaning: The description of the Chariot and other preparations against Tripura are reminiscent of similar preparations given in Mbh, Kama, Chs. 55-34. Here the enemy is Baga, a devotee of $iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The description of the Chariot and other preparations against Tripura are reminiscent of similar preparations given in Mbh, Kama, Chs. 55-34. Here the enemy is Baga, a devotee of $iva.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर् निवर्तितस् तस्य सुखी चैवा ऽभवत् तदा । ततस् ते ऽचाप्यबुध्यन्त मुनयः शंसितव्रताः
verses.transliteration: agnir nivartitas tasya sukhī caivā 'bhavat tadā / tatas te 'cāpyabudhyanta munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ
verses.translation: The violent gust of wind demolished the gardens of various kinds. Induced by it, all the flames and sparks blazed. The trees, hedges, creepers and houses all round were envel- oped by the fire that blazed in all the directions. Everything that burned was seen blazing with the lustre of a Kimsuka leaf. On account of the smoke, it was impossible to go from house to house. All the people in Tripura began to wail and lament on being completely burned by the fire of the anger of Hara. The whole city*bf Tripura enkindled in all the quarters, began
verses.hindi: इतना कहकर पार्वतीदेवी अन्तर्धान हो गयीं। तब महात्मा पराशरजीने पार्वतीदेवी तथा भगवान् शंकरको वहाँ स्थापित किया जो देव-दानववन्दित तथा सब देवताओंद्वारा पूजित हैं। यह सब करके
verses.wordMeaning: The violent gust of wind demolished the gardens of various kinds. Induced by it, all the flames and sparks blazed. The trees, hedges, creepers and houses all round were envel- oped by the fire that blazed in all the directions.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The violent gust of wind demolished the gardens of various kinds. Induced by it, all the flames and sparks blazed. The trees, hedges, creepers and houses all round were envel- oped by the fire that blazed in all the directions.…

verses.sanskrit: कस्येदं कर्म कुपिताः पप्रच्छुस् तं नृपं तदा । युवनाश्वो ममेत्येवं सत्यं समभिपद्यते
verses.transliteration: kasyedaṃ karma kupitāḥ papracchus taṃ nṛpaṃ tadā / yuvanāśvo mametyevaṃ satyaṃ samabhipadyate
verses.translation: After saying thus the highly esteemed Bana, the most excellent one among devout persons, propitiated the Lord of the chiefs of Devas by means of a hymn as follows:
verses.hindi: पराशर मुनि कृतकृत्य हो निश्चिन्त हो गये। राजन्! उस तीर्थमें भक्तिपूर्वक स्नान करके शुद्धचित्त हो चैत्र, श्रावण और मार्गशीर्ष मासके शुक्ल पक्षमें अष्टमी, चतुर्दशी एवं सूर्यग्रहणके पर्वमें
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus the highly esteemed Bana, the most excellent one among devout persons, propitiated the Lord of the chiefs of Devas by means of a hymn as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus the highly esteemed Bana, the most excellent one among devout persons, propitiated the Lord of the chiefs of Devas by means of a hymn as follows:

verses.sanskrit: युवनाश्वम् इदं प्राह भगवान् भार्गवस् तदा । सुतार्थं स्थापितं ह्य् एतत् तपसा चैव सम्भृतम्
verses.transliteration: yuvanāśvam idaṃ prāha bhagavān bhārgavas tadā / sutārthaṃ sthāpitaṃ hy etat tapasā caiva sambhṛtam
verses.translation: O Siva, O Sankara, obeisance to the annihilator of everything. Obeisance to the one that dispels the distress of those who are afraid of the worldly existence. Obeisance, O Lord, O destroyer of the body of the Flower-weaponed One
verses.hindi: सदा भगवान् शंकर और पार्वतीदेवीका पूजन करे। स्त्रियाँ हों या पुरुष-सभी काम-क्रोधसे रहित हो उपवास करके भक्ति-भावसे व्रतका पालन करें। फिर हाथभरके कुश और उत्तम
verses.wordMeaning: O Siva, O Sankara, obeisance to the annihilator of everything. Obeisance to the one that dispels the distress of those who are afraid of the worldly existence. Obeisance, O Lord, O destroyer of the body of the Flower-weaponed One
verses.commentary: Sense: O Siva, O Sankara, obeisance to the annihilator of everything. Obeisance to the one that dispels the distress of those who are afraid of the worldly existence. Obeisance, O Lord, O destroyer of the body of the Flower-weaponed One

verses.sanskrit: मया कर्म कृतं चैतत् तप आस्थाय दारुणम् । पुत्रार्थं तव राजेन्द्र येन ते बलवान् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: mayā karma kṛtaṃ caitat tapa āsthāya dāruṇam / putrārthaṃ tava rājendra yena te balavān bhavet
verses.translation: From now onwards, O Danava, you need not be afraid. Stay in your golden abode or by my side along with your sons, grandsons, kinsmen and wife. From now onwards, O dear one, you are one who cannot be killed by any enemy.
verses.hindi: तिल लेकर ब्राह्मणको उत्तराभिमुख बिठावे और स्वयं दक्षिण दिशाकी ओर मुँह करके बैठे। फिर FUN कच्चा अन्न रखकर ब्राह्मणके आगे इस प्रकार कहे--'इस उत्तम तीर्थके प्रभावसे अमुक
verses.wordMeaning: From now onwards, O Danava, you need not be afraid. Stay in your golden abode or by my side along with your sons, grandsons, kinsmen and wife. From now onwards, O dear one, you are one who cannot be killed by any enemy.
verses.commentary: Sense: From now onwards, O Danava, you need not be afraid. Stay in your golden abode or by my side along with your sons, grandsons, kinsmen and wife. From now onwards, O dear one, you are one who cannot be killed by any enemy.

verses.sanskrit: महाबलो महावीर्यस् तपोबलसमन्वितः । सुतः शक्रसमो ऽत्यर्थं सर्वधर्मपरायणः
verses.transliteration: mahābalo mahāvīryas tapobalasamanvitaḥ / sutaḥ śakrasamo 'tyarthaṃ sarvadharmaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Since, O most excellent one among the de- scendants of Bharata, the excellent mountain is highly meri- torious, it shall always be destructive of all sins. It is overgrown with various kinds of trees and creepers. It is rendered splen- did by different kinds of flowers. Various kinds of hedges and creepers abound therein. It is overspread by various creepers. It is infested by lions and tigers. It is adorned by herds of deer. It is always joyously filled with the roaring sound of the beasts of prey. There on that mountain Sankara, the Lord of the chiefs of Devas, is served by thousands of gods, the chiefs of whom are Brahma. Indra and Visnu. He who falls off the precipices of this mountain Amarakantaka, sports about successively in all the fourteen worlds, O king, i.e. the worlds 2 of Indra, Vahni, Kubera, Vayu, Yama, Nirrti, Varuna, Soma, Surya, Brahma (whose region is devoid of pain), Vi$nu, Umarudra and thereafter that of Isvara. The greatest world is that of Sadasiva. It is quiescent, subtle,' the luminosity that is beyond all sense-organs. An in- telligent devotee gets merged into it undoubtedly in accor- dance with this procedure.
verses.hindi: प्रेतको श्रेष्ठ लोककी प्राप्ति हो। मेरा पाप नष्ट 'हो जाय, शुभ कर्मकी सदा वृद्धि हो, मेरे कुल और कुटुम्बक्का भी सर्वदा अभ्युदय हो।' ऐसा 'कहकर पराशर-आश्रममें ब्राह्मणको दान दे। जो
verses.wordMeaning: Since, O most excellent one among the de- scendants of Bharata, the excellent mountain is highly meri- torious, it shall always be destructive of all sins. It is overgrown with various kinds of trees and creepers. It is rendered splen- did by different kinds of flowers.…

verses.sanskrit: जलं त्वया महाराज तेन त्वं वीर्यवान् असि । अन्वहं कर्म कृत्वा ऽपि महान्तं सुखमाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: jalaṃ tvayā mahārāja tena tvaṃ vīryavān asi / anvahaṃ karma kṛtvā 'pi mahāntaṃ sukhamāpsyasi
verses.translation: Listen, O son of Pandu, I shall tell you that procedure. After performing a rite at the outset, a devotee shall fall down the precipice. He shall at first perform three Krcchra rites after performing the Japa a million times. He should take in only vegetables (greens) and barley' water. He should take ablutions three times (a day) and remain clean. He should worship Isa, the three-eyed Lord of Devas, three times. O great king, the number of Homas shall be one-tenth thereof(?) He should perform the Japa of the Lord a hundred thousand times and worship with scents and garlands. At night he shall in dream see himself seated in an aerial chariot. Thereafter he should hurl himself. One who hurls himself in accordance with this procedure shall attain the heavenly world and sport about along with Devas. After enjoying soul-stirring pleasures for thirty crore thirty thousand years, he shall return to the earth and enjoy the whole earth under his single umbrella. He will be adored by the people. Freed from ailments and grief he will live for a hundred years. That Tirtha is well-known in all the three worlds asjvalesvara. O son of KuntI, the river Jvala created by Siva flows there. After extinguishing the fire in the city of Bana, it joins Reva, O great king. The devotee should take his holy bath there in accordance with the injunctions. Duly uttering the Mantras he shall propitiate the Pitrs and deities with water mixed with gingelly seeds and offerings of balls of rice. He shall attain the benefit of Paundarlka sacri- fice. O king, he who performs Anasaka ('no destruction', 'not taking food') in that Tirtha is rid of all sins. He goes to Rudraloka.
verses.hindi: वशमें रखते हुए सूर्यकी ओर दोनों हाथ उठाकर एकाक्षर मन्त्र प्रणवका जप करता है उसका जन्मभरका पाप उसी क्षण नष्ट हो जाता है और गायत्री-मन्त्रका जप करनेसे सात जन्मोंका संचित

verses.transliteration: yatkiṃcid vai varaṃ proktaṃ tad dāsyāmi na saṃśayaḥ / bāṇāsuro vadaty evaṃ yadi tuṣṭo 'si me prabho
verses.translation: At the end of a hundred years, Mahesvara, the Lord of Devas, became pleased with his great devotion and spoke to him smilingly: "O Yaksa of great strength and excellent holy rites, choose a boon. I have become pleased with your devo- tion. I shall grant you what you wish."

verses.transliteration: puraṃ bhavatu me divyamajeyaṃ sarvadaivataiḥ / tvām eva varjayitvā tu duṣprāpyaṃ sarvadaivataiḥ
verses.translation: Hence, a man must make every effort to have his holy ablution there. He should worship Lord Isvara if he seeks the eternal state (i.e. Moksa). O king, Sndna, Dana and Arcana (adoration) performed devoutly by men (there) have more benefit than a horse-sacrifice, O excellent one among men. Everlasting heavenly pleasure is obtained through Homa; the life-span gets increased due to Japa; one attains the eternal region characterised by Sivakala(P) through meditation.
verses.hindi: प्रातःकाल क्रोधको जीतनेवाले, निन्दासे दूर रहनेवाले, सर्वांगसुन्दर, शान्त, अपनी पत्नीका पालन करनेवाले, गायत्रीजपपरायण तथा कुकर्म- रहित ब्राह्मणका पूजन करे। ऐसा करनेसे वह

verses.sanskrit: मयि तिष्ठति यत् तिष्ठेत् मयि गच्छति गच्छतु । कामिकं भवनं देव पुर भवतु मे तदा
verses.transliteration: mayi tiṣṭhati yat tiṣṭhet mayi gacchati gacchatu / kāmikaṃ bhavanaṃ deva pura bhavatu me tadā
verses.translation: For another fifteen births there will not be any break in the line of their succession. Their sin gets dissolved like snow at the time of sunrise. A man who takes his holy ablution in Kaveri obtains the benefit usually attained at the confluence of Ganga and Yamuna. It is remembered as eight times more beneficial when Tuesday coincides with the four- teenth lunar day, during Vyatlpata, during the transit of the Sun and when Rahu and the Moon come in conjunction (lu- nar eclipse).

A sin committed in this Tlrtha becomes fixed forever.

The mountain is guarded by a hundred thousand Oiiikaras, the persons engaged 'by Isa and equipped with sixty bows. A sin committed in other places perishes in this holy spot. A sin committed in this Tlrtha becomes fixed forever.

A sin committed in this Tlrtha becomes fixed forever.

verses.transliteration: sevyate tena kāryeṇa narmadā saptakalpagā / śravaṇāt kīrtanāt tasya rudrasyānucaro bhavet
verses.translation: So also to the south of Amaresvara, two Lingas guard the Tlrtha, one being Linga Capalesvara and the second Cancjiahasta. They were formerly installed by Siva as the guard- ians of Kaveri etc. The divine Narmada existing over many Kalpas, is guarded by a hundred thousand (Ksetrapalas). The mountain is guarded by a hundred thousand Oiiikaras, the persons engaged 'by Isa and equipped with sixty bows. A sin committed in other places perishes in this holy spot. A sin committed in this Tlrtha becomes fixed forever.

verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe 'mareśvaramāhātye ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 30 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ṛṣīṇāmayutaṃ rājan naimiṣāraṇyavāsinām / gargaś ca śaunako dakṣaḥ sarveṣāṃ dharmataḥ pitā
verses.translation: On the northern bank of Narmada, there is the ex- cellent Darutirtha where an excellent Brahmana performed penance, O highly esteemed one, and became a Siddha.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां निवसतां तत्र आश्चर्यम् अभवत् नृप । हिरण्या नाम नगरी दृष्टा वा यदि वा श्रुता

Sankara said that if a person abandons his life in that Tirtha in accordance with the injunctions, he will attain the ultimate state from which there is no return.

verses.translation: That Tirtha became well-known in all the three worlds after his name. One should take the holy bath there, in accor- dance with the injunctions and adore the Pitrs and deities. He should be truthful in speech and subdue anger. He should be engaged in what is beneficial to all living beings. O king, here itself he will obtain all desires in every respect. Sankara said that if a person abandons his life in that Tirtha in accordance with the injunctions, he will attain the ultimate state from which there is no return.

verses.translation: Be victorious, O immeasurable Lotus-born One. Be victorious, O cause of creation. O most excellent one among Suras, we have sought refuge in you.

verses.sanskrit: बभ्रमुः सर्वतीर्थानि आसमुद्रान्त गोचरे । तेषां ब्रह्मादयः शापं न निवर्तयितुं क्षमाः
verses.transliteration: babhramuḥ sarvatīrthāni āsamudrānta gocare / teṣāṃ brahmādayaḥ śāpaṃ na nivartayituṃ kṣamāḥ
verses.translation: Welcome unto the Devas and Vipras (Brahmanas). The night has dawned well today. What shall we do? Tell me quickly. Who else is to be resorted to by Suras and Asuras?
verses.hindi: उसी समय प्रभु सत्यनारायणने साधुको मिथ्यावादी जानकर उसे शाप देते हुए कहा--' आजसे कुछ ही दिनोंमें यहीं तुम दुःखको प्राप्त होओगे।' इधर उसी दिन एक चोरने राजमहलमें धन
verses.wordMeaning: Welcome unto the Devas and Vipras (Brahmanas). The night has dawned well today. What shall we do? Tell me quickly. Who else is to be resorted to by Suras and Asuras?
verses.commentary: Sense: Welcome unto the Devas and Vipras (Brahmanas). The night has dawned well today. What shall we do? Tell me quickly. Who else is to be resorted to by Suras and Asuras?

verses.sanskrit: वाराणसीं महापुण्यां गङ्गासागरसङ्गमम् । हिमवन्तं च केदारमौर्वतीर्थं च भारत
verses.transliteration: vārāṇasīṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgamam / himavantaṃ ca kedāramaurvatīrthaṃ ca bhārata
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: Wa चोर धनको लेकर साधुके मकानके बगलके रास्तेसे जा रहा था। उसने घूमकर पीछेकी ओर देखा, राजाके दूत उसके पीछे- पीछे दौड़े आ रहे थे। वह डर गया और
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गा च नैमिषारण्यं भैरवं पुष्करं तथा । मायापुरीं तथा रम्याम् उग्रं कनखलं तथा
verses.transliteration: gaṅgā ca naimiṣāraṇyaṃ bhairavaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā / māyāpurīṃ tathā ramyām ugraṃ kanakhalaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: चुराये हुए धनको वहीं छोड़कर जल्दीसे भाग निकला। दूतोंने आकर देखा, साधु वणिक्के घरके पास राजाका धन पड़ा है। तब उन्होंने जामाताके साथ साधुको पकड़ लिया और उन्हें
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: रौद्रं चैव तथेशानं सुरासुरनमस्कृतम् । गङ्गाद्वारं हिमस्थानं प्रभासं शशिभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: raudraṃ caiva tatheśānaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam / gaṅgādvāraṃ himasthānaṃ prabhāsaṃ śaśibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: बाँधकर प्रसन्न मनसे तुरंत राजाके समीप ले वरके लिये प्रार्थना की और क
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रकोटिसमायोगं गङ्गाभेदं सरस्वतीम् । स्थानेश्वरं तथा पुण्यं कुरुक्षेत्रं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: rudrakoṭisamāyogaṃ gaṅgābhedaṃ sarasvatīm / sthāneśvaraṃ tathā puṇyaṃ kurukṣetraṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: जाकर कहा--'प्रभो! दोनों चोर पकड़कर आ गये हैं। इनको देखिये और आज्ञा दीजिये कि क्या किया जाय?' तत्पश्चात् राजाकी आज्ञासे दूतोंने दोनों वणिकोंको अच्छी तरह बाँधकर
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुक्षेत्रं गमिष्यामि कुरुक्षेत्रे वसाम्यहम् । कुरुक्षेत्रस्य नाम्नापि नरः पापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: kurukṣetraṃ gamiṣyāmi kurukṣetre vasāmyaham / kurukṣetrasya nāmnāpi naraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: बड़े कठिन कारागारमें डाल दिया।
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रमेणैवं विषण्णास्ते शापस्यान्त न लेभिरे । निन्दितानि च तीर्थानि पापकर्मरतैस् ततः
verses.transliteration: bhrameṇaivaṃ viṣaṇṇāste śāpasyānta na lebhire / ninditāni ca tīrthāni pāpakarmaratais tataḥ
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: उस समय उनके सम्बन्धमें कोई भी विचार नहीं किया गया। उन दोनोंने बहुत कुछ कहा; परंतु सत्यनारायणदेवकी मायासे किसीने उनकी एक भी नहीं सुनी। इसके बाद राजा चन्द्रकेतुने
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशवचनं श्रुत्वा महातीर्थानि निन्दत । हरं हरिं च यो द्वेष्टि नाभिनन्दति यः सुरान्
verses.transliteration: ākāśavacanaṃ śrutvā mahātīrthāni nindata / haraṃ hariṃ ca yo dveṣṭi nābhinandati yaḥ surān
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: उनकी सारी धन-सम्पत्ति छीन ली। इधर सत्यदेवके शापसे घरमें लीलावती और कलावतीपर भी दुःख आ पड़ा। घरमें जो कुछ भी धन-सम्पत्ति थी, SRA सारी अपहरण कर ली। लीलावती
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: स याति यत्र यत्रैव दुःखं प्राप्नोत्य् असंशयः । एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे प्राप्तो नारदो देवपूजितः
verses.transliteration: sa yāti yatra yatraiva duḥkhaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayaḥ / etasminn antare prāpto nārado devapūjitaḥ
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: मानसिक और शारीरिक व्याधिसे तथा भूख- प्याससे पीडित हो दाने-दानेकी चिन्तामें नगरमें - घर-घर भटकने लगी। इस प्रकार कलावती भी प्रतिदिन अन्नके लिये भटकने लगी। एक दिन
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षशौनकगर्गादीन् सर्वांस्तान् मुनिसत्तमान् । ब्रह्मरक्षस्तनून् दृष्ट्वा नारदो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: dakṣaśaunakagargādīn sarvāṃstān munisattamān / brahmarakṣastanūn dṛṣṭvā nārado vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: भूखसे व्याकुल कलावती घरसे निकलकर किसी ब्राह्मणके घर पहुँची। उसने देखा, वहाँ सत्यनारायणका ब्रत हो रहा है। वह वहाँ बैठ गयी और कथा सुनकर उसने भगवानूसे मनोरथपूर्तिके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तः कर्मणा केन सञ्जाता ब्रह्मराक्षसाः । तस्याथ वचनं श्रुत्वा नारदस्य महामुनेः
verses.transliteration: bhavantaḥ karmaṇā kena sañjātā brahmarākṣasāḥ / tasyātha vacanaṃ śrutvā nāradasya mahāmuneḥ
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: प्रार्थना की। इसके बाद प्रसाद लेकर उसी रातको वह अपने घर लौट आयी।
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽभिवाद्य नमस्कृत्य दक्षो वचनम् अब्रवीत् । यथोत्सवं कृतं कर्म ब्रह्मलोकहिताय यत्
verses.transliteration: so 'bhivādya namaskṛtya dakṣo vacanam abravīt / yathotsavaṃ kṛtaṃ karma brahmalokahitāya yat
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: लीलावतीने कन्याको बहुत डाँटकर कहा-- बेटी! तू इतनी राततक कहाँ थी? तेरे मनमें
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: तद्विपर्यासमापन्नं गहना कर्मणो गतिः । कर्मोपदिश मे किंचिद् येन मुञ्चापि दुष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tadviparyāsamāpannaṃ gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ / karmopadiśa me kiṃcid yena muñcāpi duṣkṛtam
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: 'कलावतीने उत्तर दिया-माता! ब्राह्मणके घर सत्यनारायण भगवानका व्रत था। मैं उसीको देख रही थी। सत्यनारायणका व्रत मनोरथ पूर्ण करनेवाला है। )
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र यत्र च गच्छामो जलमन्नं न विद्यते । अनावृष्टिरभूद् घोरा तत्र तत्रैव नारद
verses.transliteration: yatra yatra ca gacchāmo jalamannaṃ na vidyate / anāvṛṣṭirabhūd ghorā tatra tatraiva nārada
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: कन्याकी यह बात सुनकर लीलावती व्रत करनेको तैयार हुई और उस साध्वी साधुपलीने  अपने सुहृद्-बन्धुओके साथ सत्यनारायण. व्रत
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच: प्रसाद्यतां मुनिश्रेष्ठाः शापस्यान्तं करिष्यति । हिरण्यबाहुर् धर्मात्मा हिरण्यपुरमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca: prasādyatāṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ śāpasyāntaṃ kariṣyati / hiraṇyabāhur dharmātmā hiraṇyapuramāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: आवें-सत्यनारायणदेवसे उसने
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञं कर्तुं समायातो रेवाचरुकसङ्गमे । पञ्चलिङ्गानि चाभ्यर्च्य शापान्तं च करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: yajñaṃ kartuṃ samāyāto revācarukasaṅgame / pañcaliṅgāni cābhyarcya śāpāntaṃ ca kariṣyati
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: 'पति और दामादका अपराध क्षमा कीजिये।' वणिकूपत्नीके व्रतसे प्रभु सत्यनारायण प्रसन्न हो गये और उन्होंने श्रेष्ठ राजा चन्द्रकेतुको स्वप्नमें दर्शन देकर कहा, “राजन्! सबेरा होते ही दोनों
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा स देवर्षिर् ब्राह्मणैः शापकर्षितैः । आजगाम ततो दिव्यां हिरण्यनगरीं शुभाम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā sa devarṣir brāhmaṇaiḥ śāpakarṣitaiḥ / ājagāma tato divyāṃ hiraṇyanagarīṃ śubhām
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: वणिकोंको छोड़ देना और उनका जो धन छीना है, उससे दुगुना उन्हें दे देना। नहीं तो मैं राज्य, धन और पुत्रके साथ तुम्हारा विनाश कर दूँगा ।' राजाको इतना कहकर प्रभु अन्तर्धान हो गये।
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यबाहुर् नृपतिर् वशिष्ठश् च महामुनिः । विलोक्य तान् मुनीन् सर्वान् स देवर्षिपुरोगमान्
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyabāhur nṛpatir vaśiṣṭhaś ca mahāmuniḥ / vilokya tān munīn sarvān sa devarṣipurogamān
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: प्रातःकाल होते ही राजा सभामें गये और स्वजनोंके साथ वहाँ बैठकर उन्होंने दूतोंको आज्ञा दी कि “अभी जाकर दोनों बन्दी महाजनोंको तुरंत कैदसे छोड़ दो।'
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: अभिवाद्य यथा न्यायम् अर्घपाद्यैर् अपूजयत् । नारदस् तु ततो वाक्यं राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: abhivādya yathā nyāyam arghapādyair apūjayat / nāradas tu tato vākyaṃ rājānam idam abravīt
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: राजाकी आज्ञा पाकर दूतोंने दोनों महाजनोंको मुक्त कर दिया और उन्हें साथ लेकर विनयपूर्वक राजासे कहा, 'दोनों वणिकोंकी हथकड़ी-बेड़ी खोलकर हम उन्हें यहाँ ले आये हैं।' इसी समय
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: कुशलं ते नृपश्रेष्ठ सुखं तिष्ठसि सुव्रत । नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वधर्मपरायणः
verses.transliteration: kuśalaṃ te nṛpaśreṣṭha sukhaṃ tiṣṭhasi suvrata / nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā sarvadharmaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: उन दोनोंके मनमें पुरानी बातका स्मरण हुआ और भगवान् सत्यनारायणकी महिमाको याद करके वे विस्मय और waa frac हो गये। उन्होंने राजा चन्द्रकेतुको प्रणाम किया। राजाने
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच वचनं राजा नारदं श्लक्ष्णया गिरा । अद्य मे कुशलं ब्रह्मंस्तवपादाब्जदर्शनात्

verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: किं कर्तव्यं मया ते ऽद्य ब्रह्मन् मे ऽनुग्रहं कुरु । नारद उवाच: कुरु ब्रह्ममुनीनां त्वं शापान्तं राजदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā te 'dya brahman me 'nugrahaṃ kuru / nārada uvāca: kuru brahmamunīnāṃ tvaṃ śāpāntaṃ rājadarśanāt

verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच: वेदं पठन्ति ये ऽज्ञानाद् वदन्त्यर्थं न तस्य च । प्रमाणं भूतलोकस्य तद्वत् कर्म च कुर्वतः
verses.transliteration: rājovāca: vedaṃ paṭhanti ye 'jñānād vadantyarthaṃ na tasya ca / pramāṇaṃ bhūtalokasya tadvat karma ca kurvataḥ

verses.hindi: नगरकी ओर दोनों चले।

verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मन् वेदेन विधिवत् ते तु स्वर्गं प्रयान्ति वै । अहंकरविमूढाश् च मिथ्यदानेन याजकाः

verses.hindi: 2 आकर उनसे पूछा--बताओ तो
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: पतन्ति नरके विष्णुशङ्करद्वेषणे रताः । अगस्त्यं च वशिष्ठं च कृत्वा तौ याजकौ मुने
verses.transliteration: patanti narake viṣṇuśaṅkaradveṣaṇe ratāḥ / agastyaṃ ca vaśiṣṭhaṃ ca kṛtvā tau yājakau mune

verses.hindi: क्या है? तब महाजनने प्रमत्त-

verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: क्रतुमिष्ट्वा विधानेन रेवाचरुकसङ्गमे । मोचयिष्याम्यहं शापात् पञ्चलिङ्गार्चनाद् द्विज
verses.transliteration: kratumiṣṭvā vidhānena revācarukasaṅgame / mocayiṣyāmyahaṃ śāpāt pañcaliṅgārcanād dvija

verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: वेदमन्त्रहुतं तत्र स्वयं विष्णुर् ग्रहीष्यति । रुद्रः कालाग्निरूपेण ग्राहकश् च भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: vedamantrahutaṃ tatra svayaṃ viṣṇur grahīṣyati / rudraḥ kālāgnirūpeṇa grāhakaś ca bhaviṣyati

verses.hindi: दण्डीके वेशमें आये हुए सत्यनारायण भगवानूने साधुके निष्ठुर वचन सुनकर कहा, ' तुम्हारे वचन सत्य हों।' और यह कहकर वे तुरंत वहाँसे चल दिये। दण्डीके कुछ दूर चले जानेपर साधु
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: एवं यज्ञे तु सम्पूर्णे तुष्टे नारायणे शिवे । द्विजानां मोक्षणं तत्र भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yajñe tu sampūrṇe tuṣṭe nārāyaṇe śive / dvijānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tatra bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.hindi: भी समुद्रके किनारे पहुँचा और नित्य-क्रियादि करके नावपर गया तो देखा, नावमें लता-पत्र भरे पड़े हैं। यह देखकर उसे बड़ा विस्मय हुआ और वह मूर्च्छित होकर पृथ्वीपर गिर
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: न मुने देवता यत्र शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः । इहलोके परे चैव गतिस् तस्य न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: na mune devatā yatra śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ / ihaloke pare caiva gatis tasya na vidyate

verses.hindi: पड़ा। थोड़ी देरके बाद चेत होनेपर वह बड़ी चिन्तामें डूब गया। श्वशुरकी यह दशा देखकर जामाताने उनसे कहा, “आप किसलिये शोक कर रहे हैं? यह सब दण्डीके शापका फल
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा ययौ राजा सर्वसंभारसंभृतः । यज्ञोपस्करम् आदाय ब्राह्मणैर् वेदपारगैः
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā yayau rājā sarvasaṃbhārasaṃbhṛtaḥ / yajñopaskaram ādāya brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ

verses.hindi: है। वे सब कुछ करनेमें समर्थ हैं। वे ही हर्ता- कर्ता हैं, इसमें कोई सन्देह नहीं। हमलोग उन्हींकी
verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: रेवाचरुकसंभेदे यज्ञमिष्ट्वा विधानतः । विहाय पापं शप्तांस् तान् मोचयामास स द्विजान्

verses.hindi: करनेमें ही लगे रहते हैं। यों कहकर शोकः विकल वणिक् बार-बार प्रणाम करने लगा और

verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् ते कथितं राजन् पुराणाख्यानम् उत्तमम् । श्रुत्वाख्यानाम् इदं पुण्यं पञ्चलिङ्गसमागमम्
verses.transliteration: etat te kathitaṃ rājan purāṇākhyānam uttamam / śrutvākhyānām idaṃ puṇyaṃ pañcaliṅgasamāgamam

verses.wordMeaning: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: यमलोकं न पश्येद् वै पापयोनिं न गच्छति । हयमेधफलं प्राप्य शिवलोके महीयते

verses.hindi: भगवानके इस प्रकारके वचनोंको सुनकर 'साधुने भगवानकी स्तुति की। साधु बोला

verses.sanskrit: पापग्रस्तो विमूढात्मा विष्णुमायाविमोहितः । कथं प्रयाति तत् तीर्थं कालग्रहवशीकृतः

verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: श्रवणात् कीर्तनाद् अस्य मुच्यते भवबन्धनात्

verses.commentary: Sense: Gold, silver, jewels, pearls, the beautiful jewel-like women — all these he seizes forcibly.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे पञ्चलिङ्गमाहात्म्ये एकत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ३२ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: गुह्यातिगुह्यरूपाणि पवित्राणि युधिष्ठिर । श्राद्धकार्यस्य सिद्धानि तीर्थानीह निबोध मे

verses.sanskrit: अतिगुह्यस्य पुण्यस्य सर्वतो ऽमरकण्टके । तम् आरभ्य गिरिश्रेष्ठं सर्वं पुण्यतरं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: atiguhyasya puṇyasya sarvato 'marakaṇṭake / tam ārabhya giriśreṣṭhaṃ sarvaṃ puṇyataraṃ smṛtam

verses.sanskrit: दक्षस्य दुहिता चासीत् कुमुदा नाम विश्रुता । सोमाय दत्त्वा तां दक्षो मुदा परमया युतः
verses.transliteration: dakṣasya duhitā cāsīt kumudā nāma viśrutā / somāya dattvā tāṃ dakṣo mudā paramayā yutaḥ
verses.translation: "O excellent Brahmanas, what is this mysterious incident? Consider this from the standpoint of the scriptures and do tell me the reason hereof. What is the reason for the disappearance of fire? Is it any of my sins or yours, whereby the Fire-god has vanished from the hall of sacred fire. Was there any loophole in the course of the recitation of the Man- tras? Was any rite performed without the requisite Daksina? Was thfere any omission of the due rites? Why is Vahni not to be seen? There is no enemy like Yajna. If there is any fault in the cooked food served, it will burn the nation. If it is without the utterance of the requisite Mantras it will burn the Rtviks. If it is deficient in Daksinas it will destroy the Datr (donor)."

verses.translation: Having been named thus he took up a great Vrata and propitiated Sankara, the Lord of Devas, along with Uma. He made his body lean through Vrata, Niyama, Dana, obser- vances, Homa,Japa in accordance with the injunctions and by performing Krcchra and Candrayana. On a certain day he went to Mountain Kailasa, took up two Lingas and proceeded to- wards the South. After coming to the banks of Narmada, the mighty Dafriava became desirous of taking a holy bath. He placed the Lihgas down and performed Japa and adored the Lord, O king. The night-stalker became contented by the stay in the shrine, holy ablution and Homa in the fire. When he wished to go back to Lanka, O excellent king, he took up one of the Lingas with his left hancl and the other one with the other hand with due devotion. verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे वैदूर्यपर्वतवर्णनं नाम पञ्चत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ३६ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: वसुदानस् तु राजर्षिश् चक्रवर्ती पुरा ऽभवत् । अयोध्याधिपतिः श्रीमान् छक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe vaidūryaparvatavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 36 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: vasudānas tu rājarṣiś cakravartī purā 'bhavat / ayodhyādhipatiḥ śrīmān chakratulyaparākramaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the excel- lent Daru Tlrtha 1 where Indra's friend Daruka became a Siddha formerly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: bubhuje pṛthivī sarvāṃ grāmam ekam ivātha saḥ / īje yāgasahasreṇa hayamedhakṛtena ca
verses.translation: As noted in Chapter 231 infra. Daruka Tirtha is repeated four times (catvaro daruksivardh) in this text.

verses.sanskrit: सपादलक्षमधिकं सर्वा जीवन्ति च प्रजाः । न तत्र दीनो दुःखी वा दरिद्रो वा ऽपि कश्चन
verses.transliteration: sapādalakṣamadhikaṃ sarvā jīvanti ca prajāḥ / na tatra dīno duḥkhī vā daridro vā 'pi kaścana
verses.translation: "Go to the banks of Narmada and stay there till the end of the Yuga propitiating Mahesvara. Then you will have a rebirth. In this birth you will be well known by the name Daruka 1 in the form of a human being. After serving the great Lord holding the conch, discus and club you will attain Siddhi."

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं कामदुघा धेनुः पृथिवी सस्यशालिनी । एव पालयतस् तस्य पृथिवीं पृथिवीपते
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ kāmadughā dhenuḥ pṛthivī sasyaśālinī / eva pālayatas tasya pṛthivīṃ pṛthivīpate
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले दैत्यास् त्रिदशकण्टकाः । केतुमाली सुकेतुश् च सुमुखो दुन्दुभिस् तथा

verses.transliteration: vasudāno 'bravīd vākyaṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ brahmavittamam / kasmiṃs tīrthe hi nirvighno hayamedho vidhīyate

verses.sanskrit: वशिष्ठश् चाब्रवीद् वाक्यं राजानं प्रति भारत । न शक्यते मुखः कर्तुं हयमेधो विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: vaśiṣṭhaś cābravīd vākyaṃ rājānaṃ prati bhārata / na śakyate mukhaḥ kartuṃ hayamedho viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: अमरेश्वरस्य मूर्तिर् वै दक्षिणाशामुखे स्थिता । दानवैर् निर्जितास् तत्र सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः
verses.transliteration: amareśvarasya mūrtir vai dakṣiṇāśāmukhe sthitā / dānavair nirjitās tatra sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञभागं ग्रहीतुं न शक्नुवन्ति कदाचन । एतस्मात् कारणाद् राजन् सत्यम् एतत् तवोदितम्
verses.transliteration: yajñabhāgaṃ grahītuṃ na śaknuvanti kadācana / etasmāt kāraṇād rājan satyam etat tavoditam
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वशिष्ठस्य महात्मनः । चुकोप वसुदानश् च प्रत्याह च पुरोधसम्
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vaśiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ / cukopa vasudānaś ca pratyāha ca purodhasam
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: हत्वैतान् राक्षसान् पापानद्य वै देवकण्टकान् । देवानां च प्रसादेन करिष्ये यागम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: hatvaitān rākṣasān pāpānadya vai devakaṇṭakān / devānāṃ ca prasādena kariṣye yāgam uttamam
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ययौ राजा सर्वसम्भारसंवृतः । ब्राह्मणैः सहितो विद्वान् ऋत्विग्भिर् वेदपारगैः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā yayau rājā sarvasambhārasaṃvṛtaḥ / brāhmaṇaiḥ sahito vidvān ṛtvigbhir vedapāragaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: गवां च पञ्चलक्षाणि सवत्सानां पयोमुचाम् । सपादलक्षमश्वानां दन्तिनाम् अयुतं तथा
verses.transliteration: gavāṃ ca pañcalakṣāṇi savatsānāṃ payomucām / sapādalakṣamaśvānāṃ dantinām ayutaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: मणिमाणिक्यरत्नानि हेमरूप्यवसूनि च । विविधं भक्ष्यभोज्यं च आज्यं व्रीहितिलांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: maṇimāṇikyaratnāni hemarūpyavasūni ca / vividhaṃ bhakṣyabhojyaṃ ca ājyaṃ vrīhitilāṃs tathā
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: मण्डपान् यज्ञयूपांश् च समादाय नृपोत्तमः । एवं प्रवर्तिते यज्ञे निर्विघ्नेन तु भारत
verses.transliteration: maṇḍapān yajñayūpāṃś ca samādāya nṛpottamaḥ / evaṃ pravartite yajñe nirvighnena tu bhārata
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: आवभृत्योदकैः क्लिन्ना वसुधा हेमनिर्मिता । बभूवुर् लुलिता ये तु कर्दमे मृगपक्षिणः
verses.transliteration: āvabhṛtyodakaiḥ klinnā vasudhā hemanirmitā / babhūvur lulitā ye tu kardame mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: ते हेमवर्णकाः सर्वे बभूवुस् तत्र भारत । युगपत् पूजिता यत्र ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: te hemavarṇakāḥ sarve babhūvus tatra bhārata / yugapat pūjitā yatra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: होमाच् च पृथक् क्षीराज्यप्रवाहास् तत्र निर्गताः । गवां मूत्रप्रवाहश् च तत्राभूत् नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: homāc ca pṛthak kṣīrājyapravāhās tatra nirgatāḥ / gavāṃ mūtrapravāhaś ca tatrābhūt nṛpasattama
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानोदकं च देवानाम् ऋषिभिर् वेदपारगैः । यत् कृतं तत् प्रवाहश् च तत्रासीत् नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: snānodakaṃ ca devānām ṛṣibhir vedapāragaiḥ / yat kṛtaṃ tat pravāhaś ca tatrāsīt nṛpasattama
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवाहेषु च सर्वेषु मिलितेषु तदा नृप । आपगा कपिला नाम दृष्टा ब्रह्मर्षिदैवतैः
verses.transliteration: pravāheṣu ca sarveṣu militeṣu tadā nṛpa / āpagā kapilā nāma dṛṣṭā brahmarṣidaivataiḥ
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदासङ्गमस् तत्र रुद्रावर्तः प्रकीर्तितः । ततस् तु ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे दक्षिणाभिः प्रपूजिताः
verses.transliteration: narmadāsaṅgamas tatra rudrāvartaḥ prakīrtitaḥ / tatas tu brāhmaṇāḥ sarve dakṣiṇābhiḥ prapūjitāḥ
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: गजाश्वरथमारूढा नानाभरणभूषिताः । तुष्टा देवगणाः सर्वे ऊचुस् तं पार्थिवं तदा
verses.transliteration: gajāśvarathamārūḍhā nānābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ / tuṣṭā devagaṇāḥ sarve ūcus taṃ pārthivaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: वरं वृणु महाभाग यज्ञेनानेन सुव्रत । वसुदान उवाच: रेवाकपिलसम्भेदे स्नात्वा ऽभ्यर्च्य महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: varaṃ vṛṇu mahābhāga yajñenānena suvrata / vasudāna uvāca: revākapilasambhede snātvā 'bhyarcya maheśvaram
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: विमानैस् त्रिदिवं यान्तु ये मृता न पुनर्भवाः । इमं वरम् अहं मन्ये दीयतां मदनुग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: vimānais tridivaṃ yāntu ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ / imaṃ varam ahaṃ manye dīyatāṃ madanugrahāt
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः: कामं कामं फलिष्यन्ति चिन्तितास् ते मनोरथाः । वरं दत्त्वा च भो राजन् प्रीता वै देवतास् ततः
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ: kāmaṃ kāmaṃ phaliṣyanti cintitās te manorathāḥ / varaṃ dattvā ca bho rājan prītā vai devatās tataḥ
verses.translation: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O dear one of good holy Vratas, the origin of Darutlrtha has been recounted in the manner it was nar- rated to me by Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: स्वं स्वं विमानम् आरुह्य मुदितास् त्रिदिवं ययुः । वसुदानो ऽपि राजर्षिर् ब्राह्मणैर् वेदपारगैः
verses.transliteration: svaṃ svaṃ vimānam āruhya muditās tridivaṃ yayuḥ / vasudāno 'pi rājarṣir brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ

verses.transliteration: bhogāṃś ca puṣkalān bhuktvā gato māheśvaraṃ puram / etat te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ revākapilasaṅgamam

verses.transliteration: śravaṇāt kīrtanād asya mucyate bhavabandhanāt

verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe kapilāvatāro nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 37 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: svāyambhuve 'ntare prāpte ādikalpe kṛte yuge / arundhatīprasūtāyā dākṣāyaṇyās suto 'bhavat
verses.translation: For the sake of the destruction of the Danavas, station yourselves on the banks of Narmada and perform pen- ance in the place with composure. Penance is the greatest strength.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: विश्रवां नाम राजा ऽभूच् छक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः । मथुराधिपतिः श्रीमांश् चक्रवर्ती महाबलः
verses.transliteration: viśravāṃ nāma rājā 'bhūc chakratulyaparākramaḥ / mathurādhipatiḥ śrīmāṃś cakravartī mahābalaḥ

verses.transliteration: nirjitā 'maradaityāś ca sa rājā maghavā tviva / sarvakāmasamṛddhāś ca brāhmaṇāś cetare janāḥ

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे कल्पान्तदर्शनं नाम सप्तत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ३८ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: ईदृशं यस्य माहात्म्यं तीर्थस्य च परंतप । तृप्तिं नैवाधिगच्छामि शृण्वन् वेदविदां वर
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe kalpāntadarśanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 38 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: īdṛśaṃ yasya māhātmyaṃ tīrthasya ca paraṃtapa / tṛptiṃ naivādhigacchāmi śṛṇvan vedavidāṃ vara
verses.translation: Therefrom, O great king, one should go to the excel- lent Tirtha named Guhavasi where Mahadeva spent millions of years as a Siddha staying in a cave.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: समर्थैः सर्वकार्येषु ब्राह्मणैर् वेदपारगैः । भूयस् तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं निवेदय महामते
verses.transliteration: samarthaiḥ sarvakāryeṣu brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ / bhūyas tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ nivedaya mahāmate
verses.translation: O Lord, whose is this hermitage echoing with the sounds of the Vedic texts? On seeing this one becomes rid of all tiresome feelings of hunger, thirst etc.

verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: asti tīrthaṃ mahārāja liṅgam anyaṃ yameśvaram / darśanāt pūjanād asya yamalokaṃ na paśyati
verses.translation: O Lord, the honour of those ladies is highly es-

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदादक्षिणे तीरे कपिलायाश् च पश्चिमे । विष्णोस् तत्र पुरी रम्या शक्रस्येवामरावती
verses.transliteration: narmadādakṣiṇe tīre kapilāyāś ca paścime / viṣṇos tatra purī ramyā śakrasyevāmarāvatī
verses.translation: By that time, all those Brahmanas after wandering all over the great forest came back to their abodes and saw their wives weak and for splendour. Those ladies who had great devotion towards their husbands formerly had now slipped down from chastity. On coming to know of this, those excel- lent Brahmanas came out. They consulted one another and understood that Lord Mahesvara had vanished after upsetting the minds of their ladies. One infuriated Brahmana lifted a stick and ran. Another raised up a Kalmasayasti (spotted stick?) and still others a handful of Darbha grass. They ran about here and there in the forest, O king; the noble-souled ones gath- ered together and said in anger:
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: By that time, all those Brahmanas after wandering all over the great forest came back to their abodes and saw their wives weak and for splendour. verses.sanskrit: कल्पकोटियुगं चापि तस्यां तिष्ठति माधवः । पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे दानवैर् देवकण्टकैः
verses.transliteration: kalpakoṭiyugaṃ cāpi tasyāṃ tiṣṭhati mādhavaḥ / purā devāsure yuddhe dānavair devakaṇṭakaiḥ
verses.translation: In Lokaloka there was a great lamentation, O descendant of Bharata, when the Lihga of the Lord fell down and the great destruction of the whole universe became immi- nent.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: निर्जिता देवताः सर्वास् तदासीच् च धरार्दिता । ब्रह्माद्या देवताः सर्वा क्षीरोदर्णवशायिनम्
verses.transliteration: nirjitā devatāḥ sarvās tadāsīc ca dharārditā / brahmādyā devatāḥ sarvā kṣīrodarṇavaśāyinam
verses.translation: "O Lord of Suras, the spiritual splendour of the twice-born is extremely powerful. Endowed with forbearance and performing the penance, you shall become devoid of fatigue. Since it was due to the resentment of the sages that the ex- cellent Linga of yours, O Mahadeva, fell down, it will not become worthy of being worshipped. The merit that men attain by worshipping the Linga cannot be obtained either by perform- ing Agnihotra or Agnistoma. By the words of Devas, Danavas, Yaks as, Gandharvas, Uragas, Raksasas and the Brahmanas it will be worthy of being worshipped. It will be worthy of being worshipped by Brahma, Visnu, Indra and Candra. It is the benefit of your Linga in this world as well as in the other."
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lord of Suras, the spiritual splendour of the twice-born is extremely powerful. Endowed with forbearance and performing the penance, you shall become devoid of fatigue. Since it was due to the resentment of the sages that the ex- cellent Linga of yours, O Mahadeva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord of Suras, the spiritual splendour of the twice-born is extremely powerful. Endowed with forbearance and performing the penance, you shall become devoid of fatigue. Since it was due to the resentment of the sages that the ex- cellent Linga of yours, O Mahadeva,…

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टुवुः प्रणिपत्यैनं स्तुत्यं चान्तःस्थम् अव्ययम् । जय देव जगन्नाथ दैत्यान्तक जनार्दन
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭuvuḥ praṇipatyainaṃ stutyaṃ cāntaḥstham avyayam / jaya deva jagannātha daityāntaka janārdana
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord of the cosmos bowed down to the excellent Brahmanas. Endowed with great delight he joined his palms in reverence and spoke: "Brahmanas are mobile Tirthas bereft of water. They can be desired by all. Dirty (sinful) people become purified by the water of the words of these Brahmanas. There is no holy spot, no Tlrtha where after causing the anger of a Brahmana one can go and get purified. Even Puskaras (holy places) are Usaras (arid lands). That which is not composed by Brahmanas is no Sastra; that which is not offered to a Brahmana is no Dana; that which is no outcome of the favour of a Brahmanads no happiness; and that which is not caused by the anger of a Brahmana is no misery. All the Tirthas throughout the earth and also Gariga

verses.translation: From there, one should go to the excellent Tirtha called Kapila Tirtha. By the holy ablution alone with devotion (in it), a man is liberated from all sins.

verses.translation: "O meritorious Kapila, obeisance to you. O auspi- cious one bowed down to by all the worlds, O divine one, you are conducive to all auspiciousness, inimitable and incompa- rable in all the three worlds. You are Lsfksmi; you are Smrti; you are intellect; you are fortitude. O lady of excellent coun- tenance, you are well-known as Goddess Uma. You are Sati.

verses.sanskrit: बभ्रुर् नाम पुरा चासीद्राजा परमधार्मिकः । पुण्ड्रवर्द्धनवासी च सत्यधर्मपरायणः

verses.translation: When, O dear one, at the instance of Brahma, the splendid one came here, how were the Devas and the worlds stationed In her limbs? O excellent Brahmana, how did Kapila settle herself in the Usara (arid) Ksetra? Tell me this.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे विमलेश्वरवर्णनो नामैकोनचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ४० युधिष्ठिर उवाच: मनसा चिन्तितं यच्च तद् एव समुपस्थितम् । लक्षणं सूत्रयागस्य पर्वतस्य तु वेष्टनम्

verses.translation: Therefrom a person should go to the excellent Tlrtha Karahjesvara, O great king, where a Daitya became a Siddha and well-known in all the worlds.

verses.transliteration: kasmin kāle prakartavyaṃ vidhānāṃ vidhipūrvakam / tvam eva vetsi sarvaṃ vai viditaṃ kuru sāmpratam
verses.translation: He was richly endowed with all good features. Even as a boy, he performed great penance after resorting to the banks of Narmada. His penance was excellent and very severe. It continued for a thousand divine years. It consisted of Krcchra, Can dray an a etc., O king.

verses.sanskrit: तानि साक्षात् कोटितीर्थे लीयन्ते परमे पदे । कपिला ऽमरयोर् मध्ये नर्मद्ॐकारमध्यतः

verses.sanskrit: वसन्ति वामभागे वै ते लोकं यान्ति वैष्णवम् । ये पूर्वपश्चिमे भागे वसन्त्य् अमरकण्टके

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राणि तथाशीतिर् मरणाद् गोगृहे तथा । अनशने ब्रह्मलोकः सार्द्धं लक्षमुदाहृतः

verses.sanskrit: चतुरङ्गुलमयं के ऽपि केचिद् अङ्गुलमानतः । अर्द्धाङ्गुलं यवमात्रं ब्रह्मसूत्रप्रमाणतः
verses.transliteration: caturaṅgulamayaṃ ke 'pi kecid aṅgulamānataḥ / arddhāṅgulaṃ yavamātraṃ brahmasūtrapramāṇataḥ
verses.translation: Anyone who is engaged in the observance of ritu- alistic fast at that Tlrtha and worships Isana, the Lord, be- comes rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: caturviṃśe dvādaśābde kurukṣetrāt sarasvatī / koṭitīrthe tathā snātuṃ rāhugraste divākare

verses.sanskrit: करिणीरूपमास्थाय आयात् स्वपुण्यकक्षयात् । स्नानं कृत्वा पुनर्याति कुरुक्षेत्रं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: kariṇīrūpamāsthāya āyāt svapuṇyakakṣayāt / snānaṃ kṛtvā punaryāti kurukṣetraṃ na saṃśayaḥ

verses.sanskrit: कावेरीसङ्गमं यावद् आरभ्यो दधिसङ्गमम् । अत्रान्तरे महाराज तीर्थकोट्यो दश स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: kāverīsaṅgamaṃ yāvad ārabhyo dadhisaṅgamam / atrāntare mahārāja tīrthakoṭyo daśa smṛtāḥ

verses.sanskrit: कोटितीर्थं समारभ्य नीलगङ्गावसानतः । अष्टलक्षाणि तीर्थानां ब्रह्मसूत्रप्रमाणतः

verses.sanskrit: कावेर्याः पूर्वभागे च यावत् पर्यङ्कपर्वतः । दश लक्षाणि तीर्थानां संख्या च कथिता तव
verses.transliteration: kāveryāḥ pūrvabhāge ca yāvat paryaṅkaparvataḥ / daśa lakṣāṇi tīrthānāṃ saṃkhyā ca kathitā tava

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदायां समासाद्य जमदग्नेर् महाश्रमम् । श्रीकण्ठं नीलकण्ठं च लिङ्गं पापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: narmadāyāṃ samāsādya jamadagner mahāśramam / śrīkaṇṭhaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ ca liṅgaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam

verses.sanskrit: कन्यातीर्थं महापुण्यं कपिलेश्वरम् उत्तमम् । कपिलावर्तसंज्ञं तु तीर्थं पापहरं परम्
verses.transliteration: kanyātīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ kapileśvaram uttamam / kapilāvartasaṃjñaṃ tu tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ param
verses.translation: Anyone who is engaged in the observance of ritu- alistic fast at that Tlrtha and worships Isana, the Lord, be- comes rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र पूषा च सूर्यस् तु शिवध्यानपरायणः । दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु तपस् तेपे सुदुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: tatra pūṣā ca sūryas tu śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ / divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tapas tepe suduṣkaram
verses.translation: Anyone who is engaged in the observance of ritu- alistic fast at that Tlrtha and worships Isana, the Lord, be- comes rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तुष्टः सुरेशानस् तम् उवाच तदा नृप । वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते यत् ते मनसि वर्तते
verses.transliteration: tatas tuṣṭaḥ sureśānas tam uvāca tadā nṛpa / varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yat te manasi vartate
verses.translation: Anyone who is engaged in the observance of ritu- alistic fast at that Tlrtha and worships Isana, the Lord, be- comes rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: पूषोवाच: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि देवेश वरं दातुं त्वम् इच्छसि । सूर्यपिङ्गलसंज्ञं तु लिङ्गं परमसिद्धिदम्
verses.transliteration: pūṣovāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa varaṃ dātuṃ tvam icchasi / sūryapiṅgalasaṃjñaṃ tu liṅgaṃ paramasiddhidam
verses.translation: Anyone who is engaged in the observance of ritu- alistic fast at that Tlrtha and worships Isana, the Lord, be- comes rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
