verses.sanskrit: आकाशे प्रतपद्रश्मिसहस्रांशु समप्रभम् । मासे मासे ऽन्यमित्रस् तु संक्रमश् चान्यराशिषु
verses.transliteration: ākāśe pratapadraśmisahasrāṃśu samaprabham / māse māse 'nyamitras tu saṃkramaś cānyarāśiṣu
verses.translation: Anyone who is engaged in the observance of ritu- alistic fast at that Tlrtha and worships Isana, the Lord, be- comes rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: इमं वरम् अहं मन्ये जगद् द्योतनकारकम् । ईश्वर उवाच: सर्वसम्पत्समृद्धिस् ते मत्प्रसादाद् भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: imaṃ varam ahaṃ manye jagad dyotanakārakam / īśvara uvāca: sarvasampatsamṛddhis te matprasādād bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Anyone who is engaged in the observance of ritu- alistic fast at that Tlrtha and worships Isana, the Lord, be- comes rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: कृते युगे महाराज मयैतद् दृष्टम् एव च । चतुर्दश्यां तथा ऽष्टम्यां पिङ्गलेश्वरपूजनात्
verses.transliteration: kṛte yuge mahārāja mayaitad dṛṣṭam eva ca / caturdaśyāṃ tathā 'ṣṭamyāṃ piṅgaleśvarapūjanāt
verses.translation: Anyone who is engaged in the observance of ritu- alistic fast at that Tlrtha and worships Isana, the Lord, be- comes rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: कोटियज्ञफलं प्राप्य शिवलोके महीयते । रेवातीरेषु ये देवाः क्रोशमात्रं स्वयंभुवः
verses.transliteration: koṭiyajñaphalaṃ prāpya śivaloke mahīyate / revātīreṣu ye devāḥ krośamātraṃ svayaṃbhuvaḥ
verses.translation: Anyone who is engaged in the observance of ritu- alistic fast at that Tlrtha and worships Isana, the Lord, be- comes rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे ते सिद्धिदा ज्ञेयाः कामभोगफलप्रदाः । केचित् कूष्माण्डमात्रा वै केचिद्वै पुष्पमात्रकाः
verses.transliteration: sarve te siddhidā jñeyāḥ kāmabhogaphalapradāḥ / kecit kūṣmāṇḍamātrā vai kecidvai puṣpamātrakāḥ
verses.translation: Anyone who is engaged in the observance of ritu- alistic fast at that Tlrtha and worships Isana, the Lord, be- comes rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: एरण्डफलमात्राश् च वज्रमौक्तिकमानतः । कृते मणिमयाः प्रोक्तास् त्रेतायां तु हिरण्मयाः
verses.transliteration: eraṇḍaphalamātrāś ca vajramauktikamānataḥ / kṛte maṇimayāḥ proktās tretāyāṃ tu hiraṇmayāḥ
verses.translation: Anyone who is engaged in the observance of ritu- alistic fast at that Tlrtha and worships Isana, the Lord, be- comes rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Anyone who is engaged in the observance of ritu- alistic fast at that Tlrtha and worships Isana, the Lord, be- comes rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरे रौप्यताम्राश् च कलौ चाश्ममयाः स्मृताः । ब्राह्मं कृतयुगं प्राहुस् त्रेतां वै क्षत्रियं तथा
verses.transliteration: dvāpare raupyatāmrāś ca kalau cāśmamayāḥ smṛtāḥ / brāhmaṃ kṛtayugaṃ prāhus tretāṃ vai kṣatriyaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Anyone who is engaged in the observance of ritu- alistic fast at that Tlrtha and worships Isana, the Lord, be- comes rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरं वैश्यम् इत्य् एवं कलिं शूद्रं तथैव च । नापुण्यालिङ्गमासाद्य म्रियते ऽमरकण्टके
verses.transliteration: dvāparaṃ vaiśyam ity evaṃ kaliṃ śūdraṃ tathaiva ca / nāpuṇyāliṅgamāsādya mriyate 'marakaṇṭake
verses.translation: Anyone who is engaged in the observance of ritu- alistic fast at that Tlrtha and worships Isana, the Lord, be- comes rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: को न मुच्येत कौन्तेय सप्तजन्मजकिल्बिषात् । यादृशो ऽयं गिरिः पुण्यः सर्वतो ऽमरकण्टकः
verses.transliteration: ko na mucyeta kaunteya saptajanmajakilbiṣāt / yādṛśo 'yaṃ giriḥ puṇyaḥ sarvato 'marakaṇṭakaḥ

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रगुणितं पुण्यं भवेत् तस्यास् तु सङ्गमे । शस्त्रेण निहता ये वै तिलमिश्राम्बुदानतः

verses.sanskrit: ते चैकोद्दिष्टश्राद्धेन स्वर्गलोकम् अवाप्नुयुः । चाण्डालाद् गुहकात् सर्पाद् विद्युतो ब्राह्मणाद् अपि

verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭribhyaś ca paśubhyaś ca maraṇaṃ pāpakarmiṇām / sarve te nṛpaśārdūla kāverīsaṅgame śubhe

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे कावेरीमाहात्म्यं नामैकचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ४२ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: रेवा भित्त्वा चण्डवेगा महाभागा विनिःसृता । तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe kāverīmāhātmyaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 42 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: revā bhittvā caṇḍavegā mahābhāgā viniḥsṛtā / tatra snātvā naravyāghra brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
verses.translation: Therefrom, one should go to the excellent Pippalesvara where Pippalada, a great Yogin of austere penance, became a Siddha.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Therefrom, one should go to the excellent Pippalesvara where Pippalada, a great Yogin of austere penance, became a Siddha.

verses.sanskrit: तिलोदकं तत्र तीर्थे हविषा पिण्डदानतः । पितॄन् समुद्धरेद् घोरात् नरकान् नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: tilodakaṃ tatra tīrthe haviṣā piṇḍadānataḥ / pitṝn samuddhared ghorāt narakān nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: She attended to his needs and stayed there perform- ing penance. On a certain occasion, she had her monthly course during the day when she took her bath. She saw a rag kept concealed and so wore it as her undergarment. In the mean- time, at night Yajnavalkya had an erotic dream in a place where there was none. As a result of the dream, there was an emis- sion of semen in his loin cloth. It resembled a drop of blood. Since he was refulgent with his austere penance, it had the lustre of fire. The poor Brahmana woke up and found the piece of cloth defiled. He thought it not worthy of being touched and so cast it off and washed himself clean in accordance with the injunctions in the Smrti texts. Bath at night has been prohibited. So the Brahmana went to sleep again. At midnight the woman took this cloth and covered her vaginal aperture. In the morning the sage searched for his loin cloth here and there. Thereupon the Brahmana woman said: "Dear Sir, what are you searching for? What do you want? Tell me the fact."
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: She attended to his needs and stayed there perform- ing penance. On a certain occasion, she had her monthly course during the day when she took her bath. She saw a rag kept concealed and so wore it as her undergarment. In the mean- time,…
verses.commentary: Sense: She attended to his needs and stayed there perform- ing penance. On a certain occasion, she had her monthly course during the day when she took her bath. She saw a rag kept concealed and so wore it as her undergarment. In the mean- time,…

verses.sanskrit: पापमृत्युमृता ये तु चण्डकर्मकृतो नराः । मुच्यन्ते तेन पापेन चण्डवेगासमागमे
verses.transliteration: pāpamṛtyumṛtā ye tu caṇḍakarmakṛto narāḥ / mucyante tena pāpena caṇḍavegāsamāgame
verses.translation: I had an unholy dream at night, O fair lady. My loin cloth became wet, which I kept aside. It is not to be seen now.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: चण्डेश्वरं तत्र लिङ्गं सर्वदेवमयं शुभम् । दर्शनात् पूजनाद् अस्य पुष्पगन्धादिदानतः
verses.transliteration: caṇḍeśvaraṃ tatra liṅgaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ śubham / darśanāt pūjanād asya puṣpagandhādidānataḥ
verses.translation: "May all those living beings in all the worlds, mobile and immobile, protect this child abandoned by me."
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: "May all those living beings in all the worlds, mobile and immobile, protect this child abandoned by me."
verses.commentary: Sense: "May all those living beings in all the worlds, mobile and immobile, protect this child abandoned by me."

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्या सहस्रैर् हि तत्क्षणाद् एव मुच्यते । चन्द्रसेनः पुरा चासीद् दुरात्मा पापकर्मकृत्
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyā sahasrair hi tatkṣaṇād eva mucyate / candrasenaḥ purā cāsīd durātmā pāpakarmakṛt
verses.translation: Ruthlessness is my innate nature. My viewing is also likewise. Leave me free. I shall undoubtedly do what you ask me to do.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Ruthlessness is my innate nature. My viewing is also likewise. Leave me free. I shall undoubtedly do what you ask me to do.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ruthlessness is my innate nature. My viewing is also likewise. Leave me free. I shall undoubtedly do what you ask me to do.

verses.sanskrit: परदाररतश्चौरो ब्रह्मघ्नो गुरुतल्पगः । रघुवंशी च पापात्मा ऋषिपत्नीं च ब्राह्मणीम्
verses.transliteration: paradārarataścauro brahmaghno gurutalpagaḥ / raghuvaṃśī ca pāpātmā ṛṣipatnīṃ ca brāhmaṇīm
verses.translation: O Lord of Devas, I have been thought of by Pippalada overwhelmed with anger. I shall destroy his body. O Lord, I have been invoked for doing this act of violence.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord of Devas, I have been thought of by Pippalada overwhelmed with anger. I shall destroy his body. O Lord, I have been invoked for doing this act of violence.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord of Devas, I have been thought of by Pippalada overwhelmed with anger. I shall destroy his body. O Lord, I have been invoked for doing this act of violence.

verses.sanskrit: अन्याश् च या वै सुभगाः पतिं हत्वा समाहरत् । नैमिषारण्यवासी च शाण्डिल्यो ब्रह्मवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: anyāś ca yā vai subhagāḥ patiṃ hatvā samāharat / naimiṣāraṇyavāsī ca śāṇḍilyo brahmavittamaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: सौदामिनी तस्य भार्या धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनी । रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना चन्द्रकान्तिसमप्रभा
verses.transliteration: saudāminī tasya bhāryā dharmapatnī yaśasvinī / rūpayauvanasampannā candrakāntisamaprabhā
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: कामिनी वल्कलधरा पीनोन्नतपयोधरा । आख्यानं कथयिष्यामि तस्यास् तस्य पुरातनम्
verses.transliteration: kāminī valkaladharā pīnonnatapayodharā / ākhyānaṃ kathayiṣyāmi tasyās tasya purātanam
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: हयारूढश् चन्द्रसेनो नैमिषारण्यवासिनः । शाण्डिल्यस्याश्रमं प्राप्तो वने स मृगयन् मृगान्
verses.transliteration: hayārūḍhaś candraseno naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ / śāṇḍilyasyāśramaṃ prāpto vane sa mṛgayan mṛgān
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: दष्टा सौदामिनी तेन शाण्डिल्यस्य प्रिया तदा । उवाच वचनं तां वै त्वं मे राज्ञी भवेद् इति
verses.transliteration: daṣṭā saudāminī tena śāṇḍilyasya priyā tadā / uvāca vacanaṃ tāṃ vai tvaṃ me rājñī bhaved iti
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: वल्कलाजिनधारी च कुशकाशपवित्रकः । कन्दमूलफलाशी च ब्राह्मणश् च पतिस् तव
verses.transliteration: valkalājinadhārī ca kuśakāśapavitrakaḥ / kandamūlaphalāśī ca brāhmaṇaś ca patis tava
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: किं करिष्यसि तत् तेन मम भोगांश् च पुष्कलान् । सर्वदा मत्प्रसादेन भुङ्क्ष्व त्वं वरवर्णिनि
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kariṣyasi tat tena mama bhogāṃś ca puṣkalān / sarvadā matprasādena bhuṅkṣva tvaṃ varavarṇini
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा नृपतेः पापकर्मणः । आह सौदामिनी वाक्यं चन्द्रसेनं नृपाधमम्
verses.transliteration: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā nṛpateḥ pāpakarmaṇaḥ / āha saudāminī vākyaṃ candrasenaṃ nṛpādhamam
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: याचस्व मे पतिं राजंस् तस्याहं वशवार्तिनी । शाण्डिल्यम् अब्रवीद् राजा ततो ऽमूं वरयामि ते
verses.transliteration: yācasva me patiṃ rājaṃs tasyāhaṃ vaśavārtinī / śāṇḍilyam abravīd rājā tato 'mūṃ varayāmi te
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: कन्याम् इमां च पत्नी ते चेद् अद्य त्वं ददस्व मे । मौल्ये ददामि ते द्रव्यमस्याः शतसहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: kanyām imāṃ ca patnī te ced adya tvaṃ dadasva me / maulye dadāmi te dravyamasyāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: शाण्डिल्य उवाच: सर्वाः स्त्रियः कैतवबद्धमूलास् तासां प्रियो नास्ति मनुष्यलोके । यथेष्टचेष्टो भव भूमिपाल किं मां द्विजं पृच्छसि दुर्बलं च
verses.transliteration: śāṇḍilya uvāca: sarvāḥ striyaḥ kaitavabaddhamūlās tāsāṃ priyo nāsti manuṣyaloke / yatheṣṭaceṣṭo bhava bhūmipāla kiṃ māṃ dvijaṃ pṛcchasi durbalaṃ ca
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: कामान्धस् तु ततो राजा करे जग्राह तां तदा । सा निरीक्ष्या हतं पापं ज्वलन्ती तीव्रकोपतः । रजस्वला ऽहं मां स्पृष्ट्वा चाण्डालस् त्वं भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: kāmāndhas tu tato rājā kare jagrāha tāṃ tadā / sā nirīkṣyā hataṃ pāpaṃ jvalantī tīvrakopataḥ / rajasvalā 'haṃ māṃ spṛṣṭvā cāṇḍālas tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा तादृशीं नग्नां भयार्तां प्राणवल्लभाम् । चाण्डालस् तत् क्षणाज् जातः सर्वभूतभयावहः
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśīṃ nagnāṃ bhayārtāṃ prāṇavallabhām / cāṇḍālas tat kṣaṇāj jātaḥ sarvabhūtabhayāvahaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: हाहाकारं ततश् चक्रुः सर्वे देवाः समानुषाः । अश्वम् आरुह्य राजा ऽसाव् अयोध्याम् आविशत् पुरीम्
verses.transliteration: hāhākāraṃ tataś cakruḥ sarve devāḥ samānuṣāḥ / aśvam āruhya rājā 'sāv ayodhyām āviśat purīm
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा चाण्डालरूपं तं ब्राह्मणाः पुरवासिनः । राजपुत्रा महीपालस्यान्तःपुरनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā cāṇḍālarūpaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇāḥ puravāsinaḥ / rājaputrā mahīpālasyāntaḥpuranivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: बभूवुर् भयभीताश् च गर्हयन्तो महीपतिम् । वशिष्ठं शरणं प्राप्तः शोचित्वा चात्मनस् तनुम्
verses.transliteration: babhūvur bhayabhītāś ca garhayanto mahīpatim / vaśiṣṭhaṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptaḥ śocitvā cātmanas tanum
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: राजा विषण्णवदन उवाच स्वपुरोहितम् । जगामाहं समुद्देशं नैमिषारण्यवासिनम्
verses.transliteration: rājā viṣaṇṇavadana uvāca svapurohitam / jagāmāhaṃ samuddeśaṃ naimiṣāraṇyavāsinam
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: शाण्डिल्यं च नमस्कृत्य साष्टाङ्गं प्रणिपत्य च । अब्रवं देहि भार्यां स्वां वित्तेन बहुलेन मे
verses.transliteration: śāṇḍilyaṃ ca namaskṛtya sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatya ca / abravaṃ dehi bhāryāṃ svāṃ vittena bahulena me
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: शाण्डिल्यस्य तु पत्न्या वै तया शप्तो ऽहम् अन्तिके । श्रुत्वा तस्य चरित्रं च पापस्य भो नराधिप
verses.transliteration: śāṇḍilyasya tu patnyā vai tayā śapto 'ham antike / śrutvā tasya caritraṃ ca pāpasya bho narādhipa
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: वशिष्ठो ऽप्य् अब्रवीद् वाक्यं चन्द्रसेनं नराधिपम् । शाण्डिल्यं गच्छ राजेन्द्र तापसं ऋतुगामिनम्
verses.transliteration: vaśiṣṭho 'py abravīd vākyaṃ candrasenaṃ narādhipam / śāṇḍilyaṃ gaccha rājendra tāpasaṃ ṛtugāminam
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: सौदामिनीम् ऋषेर् भार्यां ज्वलन्तीम् इव तेजसा । एवम् अस्त्व् इति चोक्त्वा तं नमस्कृत्य पुरोधसम्
verses.transliteration: saudāminīm ṛṣer bhāryāṃ jvalantīm iva tejasā / evam astv iti coktvā taṃ namaskṛtya purodhasam
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: स जगाम तम् उद्देशं नैमिषारण्यवासिनम् । शाण्डिल्यं तु नमस्कृत्य साष्टाङ्गं च पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: sa jagāma tam uddeśaṃ naimiṣāraṇyavāsinam / śāṇḍilyaṃ tu namaskṛtya sāṣṭāṅgaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: अब्रवीत् तं मुनिश्रेष्ठं भयत्रस्तो नराधिपः । क्षमस्व मे मुनिश्रेष्ठ त्वद्भार्यां प्रति कामिनः
verses.transliteration: abravīt taṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ bhayatrasto narādhipaḥ / kṣamasva me muniśreṣṭha tvadbhāryāṃ prati kāminaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं माता मे पिता चासि रघुवंशं समुद्धर । मया त्व् अपकृतं ते ऽद्य तस्य प्राप्तं फलं हि वै
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ mātā me pitā cāsi raghuvaṃśaṃ samuddhara / mayā tv apakṛtaṃ te 'dya tasya prāptaṃ phalaṃ hi vai
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच ब्राह्मणः प्रीतो भार्या चैव पतिव्रता । मार्कण्डेयः पिता राजन् छिष्यो ऽहं तस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: uvāca brāhmaṇaḥ prīto bhāryā caiva pativratā / mārkaṇḍeyaḥ pitā rājan chiṣyo 'haṃ tasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: भार्यार्थम् इह संप्राप्तो नैमिषारण्यवासिनः । त्वं तु गच्छ नृपश्रेष्ठ चण्डवेगासमागमम्
verses.transliteration: bhāryārtham iha saṃprāpto naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ / tvaṃ tu gaccha nṛpaśreṣṭha caṇḍavegāsamāgamam
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: चण्डेश्वरं तमभ्यर्च्य तत्र स्नात्वा नृपोत्तम । अवाप्स्यसि परं स्थानं मुक्तश् चास्माच् च किल्बिषात्
verses.transliteration: caṇḍeśvaraṃ tamabhyarcya tatra snātvā nṛpottama / avāpsyasi paraṃ sthānaṃ muktaś cāsmāc ca kilbiṣāt
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा शाण्डिल्यस्य महात्मनः । शाण्डिल्यं च नमस्कृत्य तथा सौदामिनीं नृपः
verses.transliteration: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā śāṇḍilyasya mahātmanaḥ / śāṇḍilyaṃ ca namaskṛtya tathā saudāminīṃ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्ति वो ऽस्तु गमिष्यामि चण्डवेगासमागमम् । एवमुक्त्वा गतस् तत्र समागत्य क्षमापतिः
verses.transliteration: svasti vo 'stu gamiṣyāmi caṇḍavegāsamāgamam / evamuktvā gatas tatra samāgatya kṣamāpatiḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: चण्डेश्वरं समभ्यर्च्य तत्र स्नात्वा विधानतः । दिव्ययानसमारूढः स्तूयमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: caṇḍeśvaraṃ samabhyarcya tatra snātvā vidhānataḥ / divyayānasamārūḍhaḥ stūyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तस् तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः । क्षणाच् छिवपुरं प्राप्तश् चन्द्रसेनो महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmuktas tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ / kṣaṇāc chivapuraṃ prāptaś candraseno mahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: स्वारोचिषे ऽन्तरे प्राप्ते आदिकल्पे कृते युगे । भूतानां च सहस्राणि संसिद्धिं तत्र चान्वयुः
verses.transliteration: svārociṣe 'ntare prāpte ādikalpe kṛte yuge / bhūtānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi saṃsiddhiṃ tatra cānvayuḥ
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् ते कथितं राजंश् चण्डवेगासमागमम् । श्रवणात् कीर्तनाद् वापि भ्रूणहत्या प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: etat te kathitaṃ rājaṃś caṇḍavegāsamāgamam / śravaṇāt kīrtanād vāpi bhrūṇahatyā praṇaśyati
verses.translation: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the Lord said to Pippalada, the great sage, "So be it" and vanished along with the groups of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे चण्डवेगामाहात्म्यवर्णनो नाम द्विचत्वारिंशो ऽध्याय र्क्स् अध्याय ४३ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: एरण्डीनर्मदायोगं ततो गच्छेद् युधिष्ठिर । तृतीया चण्डवेगा च स्वर्गसोपानपद्धतिः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe caṇḍavegāmāhātmyavarṇano nāma dvicatvāriṃśo 'dhyāya rks adhyāya 43 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: eraṇḍīnarmadāyogaṃ tato gacched yudhiṣṭhira / tṛtīyā caṇḍavegā ca svargasopānapaddhatiḥ
verses.translation: From there, O great king, a pilgrim should go to the excellent Vimalesvara, There the divine rock (Devasila, the divine slab) is beautiful, made by Devas themselves. The per- son should take his holy bath there with devotion and adore
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: From there, O great king, a pilgrim should go to the excellent Vimalesvara, There the divine rock (Devasila, the divine slab) is beautiful, made by Devas themselves. The per- son should take his holy bath there with devotion and adore
verses.commentary: Sense: From there, O great king, a pilgrim should go to the excellent Vimalesvara, There the divine rock (Devasila, the divine slab) is beautiful, made by Devas themselves. The per- son should take his holy bath there with devotion and adore

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति ये मृता न पुनर्भवाः । तिलोदकप्रदानेन पिण्डपातेन भारत
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ / tilodakapradānena piṇḍapātena bhārata
verses.translation: The devotee should take his holy bath in that Tirtha and duly adore Brahmanas. His merit becomes a crore times more. There is no doubt about it.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee should take his holy bath in that Tirtha and duly adore Brahmanas. His merit becomes a crore times more. There is no doubt about it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee should take his holy bath in that Tirtha and duly adore Brahmanas. His merit becomes a crore times more. There is no doubt about it.

verses.sanskrit: अनेककालिका तृप्तिः पितॄणाम् उपजायते । अमासोमसमायोगे राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे
verses.transliteration: anekakālikā tṛptiḥ pitṝṇām upajāyate / amāsomasamāyoge rāhugraste divākare
verses.translation: He should take leave of Brahmanas who are quies- cent, have self-control, have controlled anger and who have mastered scriptures and are very efficient. He should prepare Karisagni (fire of dry cowdung) with their advice (to burn himself).

verses.translation: As uttered by Rudra himself, Narmada is the most excellent of all rivers and has issued forth from Rudra's body. She shall redeem all living beings, mobile and immobile. This highly meritorious river has been made to come down for the benefit of all the worlds, by the noble-souled Is vara, the pre- siding deity of all the Devas.

verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tatparamaṃ liṅgaṃ yamalokaṃ na paśyati / etat tu kathitaṃ rājan mayā tvāṃ prati bhārata

verses.transliteration: śravaṇāt kīrtanād asya gacchet māheśvaraṃ puram

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे दुर्वासश्चरित्रे एरण्डीतीर्थवर्णनो नाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः र्क्स् अध्याय ४५ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत् महाभाग रेवाशल्याविशल्ययोः । तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं याति फलं यज्ञेश्वराज्ञया
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe durvāsaścaritre eraṇḍītīrthavarṇano nāma catuścatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ rks adhyāya 45 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet mahābhāga revāśalyāviśalyayoḥ / tatra snātvā divaṃ yāti phalaṃ yajñeśvarājñayā
verses.translation: This very question was put to Mahesvara formerly by King Uttanapada in the assembly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र यज्ञेश्वरां लिङ्गं धूपेश्वरमनुत्तमम् । सिद्धिदं मोक्षदं विद्धि न ते पश्यन्ति मानवाः
verses.transliteration: tatra yajñeśvarāṃ liṅgaṃ dhūpeśvaramanuttamam / siddhidaṃ mokṣadaṃ viddhi na te paśyanti mānavāḥ
verses.translation: He reached the bank of Reva. The Danava performed

verses.sanskrit: तिलोदकप्रदानेन चान्नदानेन भारत । पितरस्तृप्तिम् आयान्ति यावच् चन्द्रार्कतारकम्
verses.transliteration: tilodakapradānena cānnadānena bhārata / pitarastṛptim āyānti yāvac candrārkatārakam
verses.translation: Excellent! Excellent! O great goddess marked with all auspicious characteristics, I do not know that the great Danava is undergoing sufferings. O fair lady, he has estab- lished himself in the Yogic practice meditating on the greatest position (Brahman). Come with me to the place where he is performing his penance.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: पौर्णमास्यां तु सोमे वै व्यतीपाते च संक्रमे । दानं यत् क्रियते तत्र तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु
verses.transliteration: paurṇamāsyāṃ tu some vai vyatīpāte ca saṃkrame / dānaṃ yat kriyate tatra tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the Lord, Andhaka stood there disappointed and gloomy. He said: "My painful struggles and austerities have become futile. Nothing has been achieved by me." He took a deep sigh and fell on the ground like a tree the roots of which have been cut. He lay breathless.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे शल्याविशल्यामाहात्म्यानुवर्णनो नाम पञ्चचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ४६ भृगुं पतन्ति ये शूराः कां गतिं प्राप्नुवन्ति ते । श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं त्वे तत् कथयस्व महामुने
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe śalyāviśalyāmāhātmyānuvarṇano nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 46 bhṛguṃ patanti ye śūrāḥ kāṃ gatiṃ prāpnuvanti te / śrotumicchāmyahaṃ tve tat kathayasva mahāmune
verses.translation: After getting the boon, the Danava went to his city. It had quadrangles of diverse types. There were many gardens full of plantain groves, jackfruit trees, Bakulas, mangoes, Amratakas, Campakas, Asokas, coconut trees, pomegranates, citrons and various other kinds of Fine trees. There were many lakes beau- tifying the gardens. The temples of divine features were deco- rated with a series of banners and festoons. The whole place reverberated with the sounds of the chanting of the Vedas and other auspicious passages and musical notes.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अनाशकेन भो राजन् भृगुगोग्रहसङ्गरैः । प्राणांस् त्यजन्ति ये शूरा गतिं तेषां निबोध मे
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: anāśakena bho rājan bhṛgugograhasaṅgaraiḥ / prāṇāṃs tyajanti ye śūrā gatiṃ teṣāṃ nibodha me
verses.translation: He entered his divine abode made of gold and golden strings and saw his sons, wife, ministers, servants and slaves. Then he saw many persons shouting cries of victory and run- ning about here and there. With ensigns and banners raised up, they revealed the radiance of their hearts. Some of them tied festoons and raised arched doorways. Some of them scat- tered flowers. JOthers rushed towards Andhaka to greet him with citrons in their hands. Some people in the city were seen

verses.sanskrit: पृथक् पृथङ् निवासांश्च तेषां कर्म्माणि भारत । चतुर्विंशतिकोट्यस् तु सप्तविंशतिर् एव च

verses.translation: After coming to know that he had secured great boons the heaven-dwellers began to feel apprehensive. They collected together and sought refuge in Indra.

verses.sanskrit: उमया तु पुरा ज्ञप्ता मध्यमोत्तमकन्यकाः । अनेन विधिना ये तु प्राणांस् त्यक्ष्यन्ति मानवाः
verses.transliteration: umayā tu purā jñaptā madhyamottamakanyakāḥ / anena vidhinā ye tu prāṇāṃs tyakṣyanti mānavāḥ
verses.translation: How is it that all the heaven-dwellers have come here? Wherefrom has fear arisen in your case? Why have you come seeking refuge?

verses.sanskrit: तांश्च भुङ्ग्ध्वं मया दत्ता युष्माकं सुप्रसादतः । अमरेशे प्रमृताश्च भ्रंशितुं ये पतन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: tāṃśca bhuṅgdhvaṃ mayā dattā yuṣmākaṃ suprasādataḥ / amareśe pramṛtāśca bhraṃśituṃ ye patanti te
verses.translation: What is the purpose of your visit to this place? Do tell me. O Danava, whatever wealth we possess, I shall hand over to you.

verses.translation: All the Girvanas (Devas) sought refuge in Brahma. verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे ॐकारमहिमानुवर्णनो नाम सप्तचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ४८ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ब्रह्मणे कथितो मन्त्र ॐकारेण ततो ऽनघ । ब्रह्मापि तद्वचः श्रुत्वा स्तोत्रमेतद् उदाहरत्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe oṃkāramahimānuvarṇano nāma saptacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 48 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: brahmaṇe kathito mantra oṃkāreṇa tato 'nagha / brahmāpi tadvacaḥ śrutvā stotrametad udāharat
verses.translation: O Lord, in which place did that Andhaka, the great Daitya, stay? After conquering all the Devas which place did he resort to?
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ व्योमसंख्यायिते व्योमहराय सर्वव्यापिने । अनन्ताय अनाथाय अमृताय ध्रुवाय च
verses.transliteration: oṃ vyomasaṃkhyāyite vyomaharāya sarvavyāpine / anantāya anāthāya amṛtāya dhruvāya ca
verses.translation: Be victorious; obeisance to Kr$na, Hari, Visnu, the victorious. Be victorious, O Hrsikesa. Obeisance to the creator of the universe, to the noble-souled Acyuta. Obeisance to the lotus-navelled one. Obeisance to the Lord having lotus gar- lands, to Srisa (Lord of Sri), to Janardana, to the yellow-robed one. O Sripati, be victorious. Perpetual obeisance to Govinda. Obeisance to the Lord lying down in the ocean. Obeisance to the roaring Narasimha of a hideous face. Obeisance to Sarngin, of dark complexion, holding the conch, discus and club. Obeisance to you, the Lord in the form of Vamana, to the Lord in the form of Yajna. Obeisance to the Lord in the form of Varaha; to the Lord who measured the three worlds with (three) steps. Obeisance, obeisance to Kesava who has pervaded all the quarters. O Vasudeva, obeisance to you. Obeisance to the destroyer of Kaitabha. Obeisance to you, O most excellent one among Suras, O leader of Suras, O resort of Lak$mi. I bow unto all those who pay respects to Vi$nu, the Lord of Devas, to Prajipati, the

verses.sanskrit: शम्भवाय शाश्वताय योगपीठसंस्थिताय । नित्यं योगयोगिने व्योमहराय
verses.transliteration: śambhavāya śāśvatāya yogapīṭhasaṃsthitāya / nityaṃ yogayogine vyomaharāya
verses.translation: O great Danava, I am pleased with you. Choose any boon as desired. I shall grant you a boon even if it be some- thing rare in all the three worlds.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय सर्वप्रभवाय शिवाय ईशानाय
verses.transliteration: oṃ namaḥ śivāya sarvaprabhavāya śivāya īśānāya
verses.translation: There my objective is not achieved.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मूर्धाय तत्पुरुषाय वक्त्राय अघोराय हृदयाय वासुदेवाय गुह्याय सद्योजाताय मूर्तये ॐकाराय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: mūrdhāya tatpuruṣāya vaktrāya aghorāya hṛdayāya vāsudevāya guhyāya sadyojātāya mūrtaye oṃkārāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: Whose mind has become wicked? Who has put his hand into the mouth of the serpent? On whose forehead Varman 1 (coat of mail?) has been put? He will go to the abode of Yama. I have been asleep after resorting to Kailasa. Undoubtedly if anyone wakes me up and comes face to face with me I will kill him.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.translation: Probably 'Karman' as Va (*) and Ka (▼) are similar in Devanagari script. If emended thus it means 'On whose forehead is this act imprinted (i.e. to whom has this act been allotted by Destiny)?*

verses.sanskrit: अध्यक्षश् च विधुः शास्ता पिनाकी त्रिदशाधिपः । अग्नी रुद्रो हुताशश् च पिङ्गलः पावनो हर
verses.transliteration: adhyakṣaś ca vidhuḥ śāstā pinākī tridaśādhipaḥ / agnī rudro hutāśaś ca piṅgalaḥ pāvano hara
verses.translation: An echo of the chariot prepared for killing Tripur&sura. Here the names of gods so employed are not given.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलनो दहनो वस्तुर् भस्मान्तश् च क्षमान्तकः । अपमृत्युहरो धाता विधाता कर्तृसंज्ञकः
verses.transliteration: jvalano dahano vastur bhasmāntaś ca kṣamāntakaḥ / apamṛtyuharo dhātā vidhātā kartṛsaṃjñakaḥ
verses.translation: He said, "Stop! Stop! O evil-minded one, where do you go?" Taking up the bow in his hand, he discharged arrows at the Danava. When the Danava stood firm in the battle, the Lord cut off his arrows. Andhaka was then covered (with a volley of arrows). Neither the sun nor the sky, nor the moon were to be seen there. The Danava then discharged the Agneya (pertaining to the Fire-god) missile on Siva. All the Devas trembled with fear on being scorched by the smouldering charcoals dropping from the arrows. (They cried:) "O Mahadeva, save us, save us. We are being burnt by the Danava."
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: कालो धर्मपतिः शास्ता वियोक्ता नवमः प्रियः । निर्मित्तो वारुणो हन्ता क्रूरदृष्टिर् भयावहः
verses.transliteration: kālo dharmapatiḥ śāstā viyoktā navamaḥ priyaḥ / nirmitto vāruṇo hantā krūradṛṣṭir bhayāvahaḥ
verses.translation: The Lord of Devas began to think about the means of restraining Andhaka. "There is no doubt that I will kill the evil-minded one." O excellent king, when he was hurled by Siva the Danava fell on the ground face down and hands lifted up. Then the enemy of Devas became furious. The Lord of Devas was kept in the armpit, pressed and afflicted. Lord Mahesvara became motionless and he swooned. On seeing him senseless the Danava thought thus: 'Alas, an evil action has been per- petrated by me, a sinner. What shall I do? Where can I get rid of the Karma?'
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वदृष्टिर् विरूपाक्षो दंष्ट्रावान् धूम्रलोचनः । वालो ह्यतिबलश्चैव पाशहस्तो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvadṛṣṭir virūpākṣo daṃṣṭrāvān dhūmralocanaḥ / vālo hyatibalaścaiva pāśahasto mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: "How was this discomfiture brought down upon me by that evil-minded wretch?" Saying this he was overwhelmed with anger and he rushed against the Danava after seizing an iron bar weighing a thousand Bharas. On seeing the Danava, the Lord hurled it on to the head of the Danava.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतो विरूपो रुद्रश् च दीर्घबाहुर्जडान्तकः । शीघ्रो लघुर्वायुवेगो भीमश् च वडवामुखः
verses.transliteration: śveto virūpo rudraś ca dīrghabāhurjaḍāntakaḥ / śīghro laghurvāyuvego bhīmaś ca vaḍavāmukhaḥ
verses.translation: O fair lady, drink the blood of this Danava as much as you please. O Durga, lap up the blood that drops on to the ground. Do not delay. O fair lady, extend a helping hand so that I can kill the Danava.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चशीर्षा कपर्दी च सूक्ष्मस्तीक्ष्णः क्षपान्तकः । निधीशो रौद्रवान् धन्वी सौम्यदेहः प्रमर्दनः
verses.transliteration: pañcaśīrṣā kapardī ca sūkṣmastīkṣṇaḥ kṣapāntakaḥ / nidhīśo raudravān dhanvī saumyadehaḥ pramardanaḥ
verses.translation: Well! Well! O Danava of great intrinsic strength, request for a boon. I am the donor and you are the suppliant. I shall grant whatever is desired.

verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe pañcabrahmātmakastavo nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 49 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet mahābhāga revākapilasaṅgamam / tatra snātā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ
verses.translation: After subduing Andhaka, Mahesvara, the Lord of Devas, Rudra, went to Kailasa mountain along with Uma.

verses.translation: The Jalalihga is the highly meritorious Cakratirtha, O excellent king. The Lord of Devas himself duly performed the holy ablution at the spot Sulabheda. He considered him- self pure as if no sin had been committed. To the northern quarter thereof the Lord of Devas, the preceptor of the uni- verse, the trident-bearing Lord of the chiefs of Devas estab- lished himself.

verses.sanskrit: वर्धते कपिलाभेदस् तद्वद् एव विशाम्पते । रेवायाः कपिलायोगे वाराणस्याः समागमे
verses.transliteration: vardhate kapilābhedas tadvad eva viśāmpate / revāyāḥ kapilāyoge vārāṇasyāḥ samāgame
verses.translation: They went to the presence of the Lord and began to extol: "O Lord of Devas! This Tirtha is on a par with your Gayatirtha. Another Tirtha. the most secret of all secret Tirthas, like this was never there nor will there ever be." The Trident- bearing Lord was worshipped by Indra and others, the groups of Apsaras, Yaksas, Kinnaras, Gandharvas, the Guardians of the Quarters and of the worlds. Through dances and songs and prayers, he was worshipped by all the Suras and Asuras, by Ganas and by all the Siddhas, Nagas and others. Mahesvara was worshipped by them. O king, the spot was pierced by the Lord with the tip of his trident. Even today the eddy filled by the Suras is seen in three distinct ways. The group of three Kundas, O tiger among men, is great and is always full of confused noise. It is destructive of all sins. It dispels all miseries and it is excellent.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे वाराहस्वर्गारोहणं नामैकोनपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ५० मार्कण्डेय उवाच: स तस्मिन् नृपति श्रेष्ठस्तृषितः श्रान्तवाहनः । हयं मुमोच राजा वै सर्वोपस्करम् एव च
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe vārāhasvargārohaṇaṃ nāmaikonapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 50 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sa tasmin nṛpati śreṣṭhastṛṣitaḥ śrāntavāhanaḥ / hayaṃ mumoca rājā vai sarvopaskaram eva ca
verses.translation: O Lord, what type of Brahmanas are worthy of being adored? What type are proclaimed as not worthy of being adored, especially in connection with Sraddha rites, Dana rites and rites connected with marriage celebration? Kindly let me know whether the faith in regard to Sraddha and other rites arises by the intercession of divine beings or Destiny. O Lord, to whom is Dana not offered?
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord, what type of Brahmanas are worthy of being adored? What type are proclaimed as not worthy of being adored, especially in connection with Sraddha rites,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord, what type of Brahmanas are worthy of being adored? What type are proclaimed as not worthy of being adored, especially in connection with Sraddha rites,…

verses.sanskrit: स्मरन् ऊर्ध्वगतिं तावद् उपविष्टः शिलातले । रेणुध्वस्तस् ततो ऽश्वो वै प्रविष्टः सप्तकल्पगाम्
verses.transliteration: smaran ūrdhvagatiṃ tāvad upaviṣṭaḥ śilātale / reṇudhvastas tato 'śvo vai praviṣṭaḥ saptakalpagām
verses.translation: The following Brahmanas should always be avoided 1 after due consideration: a chronic patient; one deficient in organs or having extra limbs; one-eyed; a son (born) of a widow; one who violates the vow of continence; one with black teeth; a gluttonous one eating everything (pure, impure); a paramour of a Sudra woman; one who betrays friends; a slan- derer; one who sells Soma juice; one who censures others; one who abandons father, mother and the preceptor; one who always censures Brahmanas etc. O king, a Brahmana who eats the cooked food of a Sudra though consecrated with Mantras is a Karmacandala (Candala by acts as against one born as a
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: पानस्नानादिकं कृत्वा ह्यन्तरिक्षस्थितो हयः । ब्रह्मतेजः स्थितो भूत्वा ब्रह्मयानं समाश्रयत्
verses.transliteration: pānasnānādikaṃ kṛtvā hyantarikṣasthito hayaḥ / brahmatejaḥ sthito bhūtvā brahmayānaṃ samāśrayat
verses.translation: After a careful enquiry these Brahmanas should be abandoned: one with defective nails; one associating with a Sudra woman; a thief; a bastard; one who depends upon great gifts and one who indulges in self-destruction; one who teaches on wages; a eunuch; a ravisher of a virgin and an accursed one.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: अत्यद्भुतं तु तं दृष्ट्वा परं विस्मयम् आगत । उवाच वचनं राजा तुरङ्गं तं द्विजर्षभम्
verses.transliteration: atyadbhutaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ vismayam āgata / uvāca vacanaṃ rājā turaṅgaṃ taṃ dvijarṣabham
verses.translation: A person should control all his sense-organs with great purity and devoutly perform Sraddha at home. He should circumambulate the preceptor after feeding him and silently follow him till he reaches the boundary (of the village) (and bid farewell to him). Then he should go to Sulabheda and duly perform the holy ablution. If a devotee performs Sraddha with Havya, Kavya etc., in due order in five holy spots and then offers balls of rice along with milk pudding, honey and ghee, the Pitrs are propitiated for seventeen years.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: किम् एतत् कारणं ब्रह्मञ्च् छंस मे ऽद्ययथोचितम् । उवाच तद्वचः श्रुत्वा हयरूपो द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: kim etat kāraṇaṃ brahmañc chaṃsa me 'dyayathocitam / uvāca tadvacaḥ śrutvā hayarūpo dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord, how is the gift of a virgin to be made by righteous persons? How is a wife to be nourished (taken care of)? How is the marriage rite of a virgin to be performed? O Lord of Devas, I have one more thing to ask. To whom is a virgin not to be given? O Lord, where should she be offered? By giving to whom will it be of everlasting merit? What is the criterion for considering something as best, middling or base, O Lord? How can (a gift) be Rajasa or Tamasa or one having no better (i.e. Sattvika)?
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मर्षिर् गालवश् चाहं कुरुक्षेत्रे पुरा स्थितः । अश्वप्रतिग्रहाद् दग्धस् त्व् अश्वयोनिं समाश्रित
verses.transliteration: brahmarṣir gālavaś cāhaṃ kurukṣetre purā sthitaḥ / aśvapratigrahād dagdhas tv aśvayoniṃ samāśrita
verses.translation: Of all Danas, Kanyd Dana (gift of a virgin) is the best. A parent should give his daughter after approaching a boy of noble birth, handsome features, learning and discre- tion. The father should give his well-adorned daughter on an auspicious Lagna and Muhurta. If he offers horses, elephants and garments in accordance with his capacity, his stay shall be in the region where there is no ailment.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: दावाग्निना च यद् दग्धम् उदकात् तत्प्ररोहति । दुष्टप्रतिग्रहाद् दग्धो न प्ररोहेत् कदाचन
verses.transliteration: dāvāgninā ca yad dagdham udakāt tatprarohati / duṣṭapratigrahād dagdho na prarohet kadācana
verses.translation: O king, one should celebrate the marriage of a daughter, even if one has no wealth, merely by repeating the name of the virgin. It does not bring about any defect.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे कपिलामाहात्म्ये धुन्धुमारस्वर्गारोहणं नाम पञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ५१ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: द्वीपसंख्या भुवो मानं सागराणां च कीर्तनम् । पाताललोकसंख्यानं सर्वतो विदितं कुरु
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe kapilāmāhātmye dhundhumārasvargārohaṇaṃ nāma pañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 51 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: dvīpasaṃkhyā bhuvo mānaṃ sāgarāṇāṃ ca kīrtanam / pātālalokasaṃkhyānaṃ sarvato viditaṃ kuru
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.transliteration: narakaṃ svargamānaṃ ca yatkiṃcid anyadīdṛśam / uktānuktaṃ yatkiṃcit karmākarmaśubhāvaham
verses.translation: One should observe fast on the eleventh day in the bright half of the month of Madhu (Caitra). At night he should keep awake near the feet of Visiju. Those who perform the adoration of Visnu with incense, light, Naivedyas (food offer- ings), flower garlands, agallochum, sandal etc. and read the old legends (Puranas) and a Brahmana who repeats the Suktas from the Rk, Yajus or Sama Vedas shall be rid of all sins. He goes to the world of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् सर्वं समासेन स्कन्दपृष्टेन शम्भुना । कथितं तु पुराणं वै यथावृत्तं पुरातनम्
verses.transliteration: etat sarvaṃ samāsena skandapṛṣṭena śambhunā / kathitaṃ tu purāṇaṃ vai yathāvṛttaṃ purātanam
verses.translation: The eminent sage Markandeya is well-known in all the three worlds'. He performed severe austerities for a period of one thousand divine years. He entered the cave and prac- tised Yoga there. The Linga named Markandesvara was installed by him. A pilgrim should take his holy ablution there devoutly, observe fast and control the sense-organs. Keeping awake at night, he should assiduously offer lamps. The Lord should be bathed in Panc&mrta in accordance with one's capacity. After anointing the Lord therewith, he should duly perform the adoration. Brahmanas should perform Japa (chanting of Man- tras) of the Mantras current in their Sakhas (branch of their particular Veda). They should also recite Savitri Mantra one

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यभूततत्त्वज्ञस् त्रिकालज्ञस् त्रिवेदवित् । त्वम् एव वेत्सि सर्वं च प्रसादाद् वक्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyabhūtatattvajñas trikālajñas trivedavit / tvam eva vetsi sarvaṃ ca prasādād vaktum arhasi
verses.translation: He would redeem twenty generations of his family, ten before him and ten after him. Thereafter the person should remain pure and with a mind fully concentrated perform Nyasa on the southern idol as mentioned before and offer eight flowers. These are the eight mental flowers mentioned in the scriptures: Listen. They are: (1) Varija, (2) Saumya, (3) Agneya, (4) Vayavya, (5) Parthiva, (6) Vanaspatya, (7) Prajapatya, and (8) Sivapuspa. Now listen to the meaning of these: (1) Varija should be known as water; (2) Saumya means honey, ghee and milk; (3) Agneya means incense, light etc.; (4) Vayavya means sandalpaste etc.; (5) Parthiva means roots, bulbous roots etc.; (6) Vanaspatya means fruits; (7) Prajapatya means reading and recitation; and (8) Sivapuspa is vasana (imagination, knowl- edge through intuition etc.).
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.translation: A follower of Rgveda chants the Suktas agnimlle etc. A follower of Yajurveda should chant Rudra Sukta, Purusa Siikta, Slokadhyaya, Sukriya, the groups of Mantras beginning with isetvd, etc., Jyotir Br'ahmana, Gdyatrya, Madhu and Mandala Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: युगे युगे क्षत्रियाणां दानयज्ञक्रियाणि च । नान्यस् तु त्वादृशो राजा दृष्टस् तेषां तु मध्यतः
verses.transliteration: yuge yuge kṣatriyāṇāṃ dānayajñakriyāṇi ca / nānyas tu tvādṛśo rājā dṛṣṭas teṣāṃ tu madhyataḥ
verses.translation: When two legs and the face of the calf are seen at the vaginal outlet of a cow, she should be known as the very earth, so long as she does not release the calf from the womb. Somehow the devotee should offer her to a Brahmana. The merit thereof is as though the earth consisting of mountains, forests and great parks has been gifted. verses.translation: The Jalalihga is the highly meritorious Cakratirtha, O excellent king. The Lord of Devas himself duly performed the holy ablution at the spot Sulabheda. He considered him- self pure as if no sin had been committed. To the northern quarter thereof the Lord of Devas, the preceptor of the uni- verse, the trident-bearing Lord of the chiefs of Devas estab- lished himself.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Jalalihga is the highly meritorious Cakratirtha, O excellent king. The Lord of Devas himself duly performed the holy ablution at the spot Sulabheda. He considered him- self pure as if no sin had been committed. To the northern quarter thereof the Lord of Devas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Jalalihga is the highly meritorious Cakratirtha, O excellent king. The Lord of Devas himself duly performed the holy ablution at the spot Sulabheda. He considered him- self pure as if no sin had been committed. To the northern quarter thereof the Lord of Devas,…

verses.sanskrit: पूज्यमाना नरा यान्ति कामिकैश् च यथा सुखम् । द्योतयन्तो दिशः सर्वा यान्ति दीपप्रदानतः
verses.transliteration: pūjyamānā narā yānti kāmikaiś ca yathā sukham / dyotayanto diśaḥ sarvā yānti dīpapradānataḥ
verses.translation: They went to the presence of the Lord and began to extol: "O Lord of Devas! This Tirtha is on a par with your Gayatirtha. Another Tirtha. the most secret of all secret Tirthas, like this was never there nor will there ever be." The Trident- bearing Lord was worshipped by Indra and others, the groups of Apsaras, Yaksas, Kinnaras, Gandharvas, the Guardians of the Quarters and of the worlds. Through dances and songs and prayers, he was worshipped by all the Suras and Asuras, by Ganas and by all the Siddhas, Nagas and others. Mahesvara was worshipped by them. O king, the spot was pierced by the Lord with the tip of his trident. Even today the eddy filled by the Suras is seen in three distinct ways. The group of three Kundas, O tiger among men, is great and is always full of confused noise. It is destructive of all sins. It dispels all miseries and it is excellent.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: They went to the presence of the Lord and began to extol: "O Lord of Devas! This Tirtha is on a par with your Gayatirtha. Another Tirtha. the most secret of all secret Tirthas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They went to the presence of the Lord and began to extol: "O Lord of Devas! This Tirtha is on a par with your Gayatirtha. Another Tirtha. the most secret of all secret Tirthas,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिश्रयप्रदानेन सुखं यान्ति यमालयम् । सर्वकामसमृद्धेन तथा गच्छति तोयदः
verses.transliteration: pratiśrayapradānena sukhaṃ yānti yamālayam / sarvakāmasamṛddhena tathā gacchati toyadaḥ
verses.translation: The syllable Ksa used in conjunction with five Rephas (letter Ra) is honoured by Suras (" Raksa, Raksa" repeated five times) used along with Omkara (ten-syllabled Mantra) should be known as praiseworthy.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The syllable Ksa used in conjunction with five Rephas (letter Ra) is honoured by Suras (" Raksa, Raksa" repeated five times) used along with Omkara (ten-syllabled Mantra) should be known as praiseworthy.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नं पानं प्रयच्छन्ति सुखं यान्ति निराकुलाः । दीपमालां हि यच्छन्ति गुरुशुश्रूषणे रताः
verses.transliteration: annaṃ pānaṃ prayacchanti sukhaṃ yānti nirākulāḥ / dīpamālāṃ hi yacchanti guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ
verses.translation: O Lord, what type of Brahmanas are worthy of being adored? What type are proclaimed as not worthy of being adored, especially in connection with Sraddha rites, Dana rites and rites connected with marriage celebration? Kindly let me know whether the faith in regard to Sraddha and other rites arises by the intercession of divine beings or Destiny. O Lord, to whom is Dana not offered?
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord, what type of Brahmanas are worthy of being adored? What type are proclaimed as not worthy of being adored, especially in connection with Sraddha rites,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord, what type of Brahmanas are worthy of being adored? What type are proclaimed as not worthy of being adored, especially in connection with Sraddha rites,…

verses.sanskrit: पादाभ्यङ्गं च यः कुर्यात् सो ऽश्वपृष्ठेन गच्छति । हेमरत्नप्रदानेन यान्ति रत्नविभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: pādābhyaṅgaṃ ca yaḥ kuryāt so 'śvapṛṣṭhena gacchati / hemaratnapradānena yānti ratnavibhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: The following Brahmanas should always be avoided 1 after due consideration: a chronic patient; one deficient in organs or having extra limbs; one-eyed; a son (born) of a widow; one who violates the vow of continence; one with black teeth; a gluttonous one eating everything (pure, impure); a paramour of a Sudra woman; one who betrays friends; a slan- derer; one who sells Soma juice; one who censures others; one who abandons father, mother and the preceptor; one who always censures Brahmanas etc. O king, a Brahmana who eats the cooked food of a Sudra though consecrated with Mantras is a Karmacandala (Candala by acts as against one born as a
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The following Brahmanas should always be avoided 1 after due consideration: a chronic patient; one deficient in organs or having extra limbs; one-eyed; a son (born) of a widow; one who violates the vow of continence; one with black teeth;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following Brahmanas should always be avoided 1 after due consideration: a chronic patient; one deficient in organs or having extra limbs; one-eyed; a son (born) of a widow; one who violates the vow of continence; one with black teeth;…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा भूमिदानेन गच्छति । अन्नपानप्रदानेन पिबन् खादंश् च गच्छति
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā bhūmidānena gacchati / annapānapradānena piban khādaṃś ca gacchati
verses.translation: After a careful enquiry these Brahmanas should be abandoned: one with defective nails; one associating with a Sudra woman; a thief; a bastard; one who depends upon great gifts and one who indulges in self-destruction; one who teaches on wages; a eunuch; a ravisher of a virgin and an accursed one.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: After a careful enquiry these Brahmanas should be abandoned: one with defective nails; one associating with a Sudra woman; a thief; a bastard; one who depends upon great gifts and one who indulges in self-destruction; one who teaches on wages; a eunuch;…
verses.commentary: Sense: After a careful enquiry these Brahmanas should be abandoned: one with defective nails; one associating with a Sudra woman; a thief; a bastard; one who depends upon great gifts and one who indulges in self-destruction; one who teaches on wages; a eunuch;…

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवम् आदिभिर् दानैः सुखं यान्ति शिवालयम् । स्वर्गे च विपुलान् भोगान् प्राप्नोत्य् अन्नप्रदानतः
verses.transliteration: ity evam ādibhir dānaiḥ sukhaṃ yānti śivālayam / svarge ca vipulān bhogān prāpnoty annapradānataḥ
verses.translation: A person should control all his sense-organs with great purity and devoutly perform Sraddha at home. He should circumambulate the preceptor after feeding him and silently follow him till he reaches the boundary (of the village) (and bid farewell to him). Then he should go to Sulabheda and duly perform the holy ablution. If a devotee performs Sraddha with Havya, Kavya etc., in due order in five holy spots and then offers balls of rice along with milk pudding, honey and ghee, the Pitrs are propitiated for seventeen years.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: A person should control all his sense-organs with great purity and devoutly perform Sraddha at home. He should circumambulate the preceptor after feeding him and silently follow him till he reaches the boundary (of the village) (and bid farewell to him).…
verses.commentary: Sense: A person should control all his sense-organs with great purity and devoutly perform Sraddha at home. He should circumambulate the preceptor after feeding him and silently follow him till he reaches the boundary (of the village) (and bid farewell to him).…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषाम् एव दानानामन्नदानपरं विदुः । सर्वप्रीतिकरं पुण्यं बलपुष्टिविवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣām eva dānānāmannadānaparaṃ viduḥ / sarvaprītikaraṃ puṇyaṃ balapuṣṭivivarddhanam
verses.translation: O Lord, how is the gift of a virgin to be made by righteous persons? How is a wife to be nourished (taken care of)? How is the marriage rite of a virgin to be performed? O Lord of Devas, I have one more thing to ask. To whom is a virgin not to be given? O Lord, where should she be offered? By giving to whom will it be of everlasting merit? What is the criterion for considering something as best, middling or base, O Lord? How can (a gift) be Rajasa or Tamasa or one having no better (i.e. Sattvika)?
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord, how is the gift of a virgin to be made by righteous persons? How is a wife to be nourished (taken care of)? How is the marriage rite of a virgin to be performed? O Lord of Devas, I have one more thing to ask. To whom is a virgin not to be given? O Lord,…

verses.sanskrit: नान्नदानसमं दानं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् । अन्नादानसमं दानं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् । अन्नाद् भवन्ति भूतानि म्रियन्ते तद् अभावतः
verses.transliteration: nānnadānasamaṃ dānaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam / annādānasamaṃ dānaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam / annād bhavanti bhūtāni mriyante tad abhāvataḥ
verses.translation: Of all Danas, Kanyd Dana (gift of a virgin) is the best. A parent should give his daughter after approaching a boy of noble birth, handsome features, learning and discre- tion. The father should give his well-adorned daughter on an auspicious Lagna and Muhurta. If he offers horses, elephants and garments in accordance with his capacity, his stay shall be in the region where there is no ailment.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Of all Danas, Kanyd Dana (gift of a virgin) is the best. A parent should give his daughter after approaching a boy of noble birth, handsome features, learning and discre- tion. The father should give his well-adorned daughter on an auspicious Lagna and Muhurta.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Of all Danas, Kanyd Dana (gift of a virgin) is the best. A parent should give his daughter after approaching a boy of noble birth, handsome features, learning and discre- tion. The father should give his well-adorned daughter on an auspicious Lagna and Muhurta.…

verses.sanskrit: रक्तं मांसं मज्जशुक्रे क्रमाद् अन्नात् प्रवर्तते । शुक्राद् भवन्ति भूतानि तस्माद् अन्नमयं जगत्
verses.transliteration: raktaṃ māṃsaṃ majjaśukre kramād annāt pravartate / śukrād bhavanti bhūtāni tasmād annamayaṃ jagat
verses.translation: O king, one should celebrate the marriage of a daughter, even if one has no wealth, merely by repeating the name of the virgin. It does not bring about any defect.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, one should celebrate the marriage of a daughter, even if one has no wealth, merely by repeating the name of the virgin. It does not bring about any defect.

verses.sanskrit: हेमरत्नाश्वनागेन्द्रनारीस्रक् चन्दनादिभिः । नास्त्य् आहारसमं सौख्यं नास्ति क्रोधसमो रिपुः
verses.transliteration: hemaratnāśvanāgendranārīsrak candanādibhiḥ / nāsty āhārasamaṃ saukhyaṃ nāsti krodhasamo ripuḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: अत एव महापुण्यम् अन्नदानं च भारत । अन्नदः प्राणदः प्रोक्तस् तस्माद् अन्नप्रदो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ata eva mahāpuṇyam annadānaṃ ca bhārata / annadaḥ prāṇadaḥ proktas tasmād annaprado bhavet
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.wordMeaning: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् अन्नप्रदानेन दत्तान्य् अन्यानि सर्वशः । त्रैलोक्ये यानि दानानि भोगस्त्रीवाहनानि च
verses.transliteration: tasmād annapradānena dattāny anyāni sarvaśaḥ / trailokye yāni dānāni bhogastrīvāhanāni ca

verses.sanskrit: अन्नपानादि यत्किंचिद् ऐश्वर्यं च युधिष्ठिर । अन्नदानस्य तत्सर्वम् इहामुत्र फलं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: annapānādi yatkiṃcid aiśvaryaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira / annadānasya tatsarvam ihāmutra phalaṃ smṛtam

verses.wordMeaning: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद् अन्नेन पुष्टाङ्गः कुरुते धर्मसंचयम् । पवित्रममृतं दिव्यं शुद्धं सत्त्वं रसायनम्
verses.transliteration: yasmād annena puṣṭāṅgaḥ kurute dharmasaṃcayam / pavitramamṛtaṃ divyaṃ śuddhaṃ sattvaṃ rasāyanam
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नपानाश्वगोवत्सशय्याछत्राण्य् उपानहौ । प्रेतलोकप्रशस्तानि दानान्यष्टौ युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: annapānāśvagovatsaśayyāchatrāṇy upānahau / pretalokapraśastāni dānānyaṣṭau yudhiṣṭhira
