verses.wordMeaning: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: एवं दानविशेषेण धर्मराजपुरे नराः । सुखेनैव तु गच्छन्ति तस्माद् धर्मं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dānaviśeṣeṇa dharmarājapure narāḥ / sukhenaiva tu gacchanti tasmād dharmaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नदानं महाराज जलं चैव तु पुष्कलम् । पितृभ्यः प्रयतो दद्यात् तीर्थे चैवामरेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: annadānaṃ mahārāja jalaṃ caiva tu puṣkalam / pitṛbhyaḥ prayato dadyāt tīrthe caivāmareśvare
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानि पुण्यक्षेत्राणि यानि वै कीर्तितानि च । काममोक्षप्रदानीह सर्वसिद्धिकराणि च
verses.transliteration: tīrthāni puṇyakṣetrāṇi yāni vai kīrtitāni ca / kāmamokṣapradānīha sarvasiddhikarāṇi ca

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.transliteration: sarveṣām eva teṣāṃ tu mātā vai parikīrtitā / narmadā saritā śreṣṭhā saptakalpavahā śubhā

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: तपसो यज्ञदानानां संख्या तीर्थेषु विद्यते । नर्मदायां न संख्यास्ति तेषाम् इत्य् आह शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: tapaso yajñadānānāṃ saṃkhyā tīrtheṣu vidyate / narmadāyāṃ na saṃkhyāsti teṣām ity āha śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: यथा शिवस् तथा रेवा पूजनीया प्रयत्नतः । एषु ये तु कुकर्माणः पापा दानविवार्जिताः
verses.transliteration: yathā śivas tathā revā pūjanīyā prayatnataḥ / eṣu ye tu kukarmāṇaḥ pāpā dānavivārjitāḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: पथा घोरेण ते यान्ति दक्षिणेन यमालयम् । षडशीतिसहस्राणि योजनानां समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: pathā ghoreṇa te yānti dakṣiṇena yamālayam / ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ samantataḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: पुरं ज्ञेयं महारौद्रं नानारूपैर् अधिष्ठितम् । समीपस्थम् इवाभाति नराणां क्रूरकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: puraṃ jñeyaṃ mahāraudraṃ nānārūpair adhiṣṭhitam / samīpastham ivābhāti narāṇāṃ krūrakarmaṇām
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: पापिनाम् अपि दूरस्थं पथा रौद्रेण यान्ति ते । तीव्रकण्टकयुक्तेन शर्कराभूषितेन च
verses.transliteration: pāpinām api dūrasthaṃ pathā raudreṇa yānti te / tīvrakaṇṭakayuktena śarkarābhūṣitena ca
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: क्षुरधारावृतैस् तीक्ष्णैः पाषाणैर् निर्मितेन च । केचित् त्व् अनेन महता दारुदारैश् च घातकैः
verses.transliteration: kṣuradhārāvṛtais tīkṣṇaiḥ pāṣāṇair nirmitena ca / kecit tv anena mahatā dārudāraiś ca ghātakaiḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: लोहसूचीभिर् उग्राभिर् ग्रस्तेन च क्वचित् क्वचित् । लताप्रतानविषमैः पर्वतैर् वृक्षसंकुलैः
verses.transliteration: lohasūcībhir ugrābhir grastena ca kvacit kvacit / latāpratānaviṣamaiḥ parvatair vṛkṣasaṃkulaiḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: सुतप्ताङ्गारयुक्तेन यान्ति मार्गेण दुःखिताः । क्वचिद् विषम् अगर्ताभिस् तप्तलोष्टेष्टकैर् अपि
verses.transliteration: sutaptāṅgārayuktena yānti mārgeṇa duḥkhitāḥ / kvacid viṣam agartābhis taptaloṣṭeṣṭakair api
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: सुतप्तबालुकाभिश् च तथा तीक्ष्णैश् च शङ्कुभिः । अनेकभग्नशाखाभिर् आवृतेन क्वचित् क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: sutaptabālukābhiś ca tathā tīkṣṇaiś ca śaṅkubhiḥ / anekabhagnaśākhābhir āvṛtena kvacit kvacit
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: कष्टेन तमसा केचिद् गच्छन्ति हि यमालयम् । मार्गस्थाङ्गारकैस् तप्तैर् ग्रस्ता दावाग्निभिस् तथा
verses.transliteration: kaṣṭena tamasā kecid gacchanti hi yamālayam / mārgasthāṅgārakais taptair grastā dāvāgnibhis tathā
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित् तप्तशिलाभिश् च पङ्केन कटिमानतः । क्वचिद् दुष्टाम्बुना व्याप्तं दुष्करीषाग्निना क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: kvacit taptaśilābhiś ca paṅkena kaṭimānataḥ / kvacid duṣṭāmbunā vyāptaṃ duṣkarīṣāgninā kvacit
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिद् गृध्रैर् बकैर् व्याघ्रैर् दुष्टैः कीटैः सुदारुणैः । क्वचिन् महाकुलीराद्यैः क्वचित् त्वजगरैः पुनः
verses.transliteration: kvacid gṛdhrair bakair vyāghrair duṣṭaiḥ kīṭaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ / kvacin mahākulīrādyaiḥ kvacit tvajagaraiḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: मक्षिकाभिश् च रौद्राभिः क्वचित् सर्पैर् विषोल्वणैः । मत्तमातङ्गयूथैश् च समन्ताच् च प्रमाथिभिः
verses.transliteration: makṣikābhiś ca raudrābhiḥ kvacit sarpair viṣolvaṇaiḥ / mattamātaṅgayūthaiś ca samantāc ca pramāthibhiḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: पन्थानमुल्लिखद्भिश् च तीक्ष्णशृङ्गैर् महाबलैः । सिंहैर् विषाणमहिषैर् रौद्रैर् मत्तैश् च श्वापदैः
verses.transliteration: panthānamullikhadbhiś ca tīkṣṇaśṛṅgair mahābalaiḥ / siṃhair viṣāṇamahiṣair raudrair mattaiś ca śvāpadaiḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: डाकिनीभिश् च रौद्राभिर् विकरालैश् च राक्षसैः । व्याधिभिश् च महाघोरैः पावकैश् च दुरासदैः
verses.transliteration: ḍākinībhiś ca raudrābhir vikarālaiś ca rākṣasaiḥ / vyādhibhiś ca mahāghoraiḥ pāvakaiś ca durāsadaiḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: महानलविमिश्रेण महाचण्डेन वायुना । महापाषाणवर्षेण भिद्यमाना निराश्रयाः
verses.transliteration: mahānalavimiśreṇa mahācaṇḍena vāyunā / mahāpāṣāṇavarṣeṇa bhidyamānā nirāśrayāḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित् क्वचित् प्रतप्तेन दीप्यमाना व्रजन्ति हि । महता व बाणवर्षेण भिद्यमानाः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: kvacit kvacit prataptena dīpyamānā vrajanti hi / mahatā va bāṇavarṣeṇa bhidyamānāḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: पतद्भिर्वज्रसङ्घातैर् उल्कापातैश् च दारुणैः । प्रदीप्ताङ्गारवर्षेण हन्यमाना व्रजन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: patadbhirvajrasaṅghātair ulkāpātaiś ca dāruṇaiḥ / pradīptāṅgāravarṣeṇa hanyamānā vrajanti hi
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: nīyante dehinaḥ sarve mūḍhāḥ pāpaparāyaṇāḥ / yamadūtair mahāghorair yamājñākāribhir balāt

verses.transliteration: ekākinaḥ parādhīnā mitrabandhuvivarjitāḥ / śocantaḥ svāni karmāṇi dahyante ca muhurmuhuḥ

verses.transliteration: pretabhūtavimiśrāś ca śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukāḥ / kṛśāṅgā bhītabhītāś ca dahyamānā hutāgninā
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.transliteration: baddhāḥ śṛṅkhalayā kecit majjantaḥ pāpino bhṛśam / kṛṣyante dahyamānās tu yamadūtair balotkaṭaiḥ

verses.transliteration: urasyadhomukhasthāne tathaiva khalu duḥkhitāḥ / keśapāśe vibaddhāś ca kṛṣyante pāpinas tathā

verses.transliteration: lalāṭe cāśugair biddhvā kṛṣyante dehinaḥ kvacit / uttānā duṣṭapanthānaṃ nīyante pāpakarmaṇā

verses.transliteration: pārśvabāhuvibaddhāś ca jaṭhare paripīḍitāḥ / grīvāpāśavikṛṣyāś ca ke 'pi yānti suduḥkhitāḥ

verses.transliteration: jihvāśaṅkupradānena samānīyakṛkāṭikāḥ / arddhacandreṇa gṛhyante kṣipyamāṇā itas tataḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: विच्छिन्नशिश्नवृषणाश् छिन्नशीर्षाङ्गसंचयाः । अङ्कुशैर् भिद्यमानास् तु खाद्यमानाः सरीसृपैः

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.transliteration: itaś cetaś ca dhāvanti krandamānā nirāśrayāḥ / mudgārair lohadaṇḍaiś ca hanyamānā muhur muhuḥ

verses.transliteration: kaśābhir vividhābhiś ca ghorābhiś ca samantataḥ / bhindipālaiś ca tudyante vamantaḥ śoṇitaṃ muhuḥ

verses.sanskrit: पात्यमानाश् च सलिले छायां वै प्रार्थयन्ति च । दानहीनाः प्रयान्त्य् एवं प्रायश्चित्तकृतो नराः
verses.transliteration: pātyamānāś ca salile chāyāṃ vai prārthayanti ca / dānahīnāḥ prayānty evaṃ prāyaścittakṛto narāḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: gṛhītvā caiva pātheyaṃ sukhaṃ yāti yamālayam / evaṃ pathā nikṛṣṭena prāptā yamapuraṃ narāḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: प्राज्ञापितैस् तथा दूतैः प्रवेश्यन्ते यमाग्रतः । तत्र ये शुभकर्माणस् तान् वै संस्मारयेद् यमः
verses.transliteration: prājñāpitais tathā dūtaiḥ praveśyante yamāgrataḥ / tatra ye śubhakarmāṇas tān vai saṃsmārayed yamaḥ
verses.translation: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: svakīyaiḥ karmabhir ghorair duṣprajñābalagarvitāḥ / bho bho nṛpā durācārāḥ prajāvidhvaṃsakāriṇaḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.transliteration: svalpakālasya rājyasya kiṃ vai tad duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam / bhavadbhī rājyalobhena mohenānyāyavṛttibhiḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: यद्गृहीतं फलं तस्य यूयं भुङ्ग्ध्वं यथातथम् । कुत्र राज्यं कलत्रं वा यदर्थम् अशुभं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: yadgṛhītaṃ phalaṃ tasya yūyaṃ bhuṅgdhvaṃ yathātatham / kutra rājyaṃ kalatraṃ vā yadartham aśubhaṃ kṛtam

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सर्वस्वं परित्यज्य यूयम् एकाकिनस् तथा । त्वद् बान्धवा न पश्यन्ति येन विध्वंसिताः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: tatsarvasvaṃ parityajya yūyam ekākinas tathā / tvad bāndhavā na paśyanti yena vidhvaṃsitāḥ prajāḥ

verses.sanskrit: यमदूतैः पात्यमाना अधुना कीदृशं भवेत् । एवं बहुविधैर् वाक्यैर् उपलब्धा यमेन ते
verses.transliteration: yamadūtaiḥ pātyamānā adhunā kīdṛśaṃ bhavet / evaṃ bahuvidhair vākyair upalabdhā yamena te

verses.sanskrit: शोचन्ति स्वानि कर्माणि तूष्णीं भूताश् च पार्थिव । इति वाक्यैः समादिश्य नृपांस् तान् धर्मराट् ततः
verses.transliteration: śocanti svāni karmāṇi tūṣṇīṃ bhūtāś ca pārthiva / iti vākyaiḥ samādiśya nṛpāṃs tān dharmarāṭ tataḥ

verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ pāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ yamo dūtān athābravīt / bho bhoś caṇḍa mahācaṇḍa gṛhītvā nṛpatīnimān

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: विशोधयध्वं पापेभ्यः क्रमेण नरकाग्निना । ततः शीघ्रं समास्थाय नृपान् संगृह्य पादयोः
verses.transliteration: viśodhayadhvaṃ pāpebhyaḥ krameṇa narakāgninā / tataḥ śīghraṃ samāsthāya nṛpān saṃgṛhya pādayoḥ

verses.transliteration: āsphālayanti mahati cāśmasāramaye drume / tatas te sarva evāśu prahārair jarjarīkṛtāḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: O Is vara, at what time is Sraddha and Dana to be performed and on what lunar day should pilgrimage be done? Tell me quickly.

verses.sanskrit: विसंज्ञाश् च तदा सन्ति निश्चेष्टाश् च युधिष्ठिर । ततस् ते वायुना स्पृष्टाः शनैस् तु जीविताः पुनः
verses.transliteration: visaṃjñāś ca tadā santi niśceṣṭāś ca yudhiṣṭhira / tatas te vāyunā spṛṣṭāḥ śanais tu jīvitāḥ punaḥ

verses.sanskrit: तानानीय विशुद्ध्यर्थं क्षिपन्ति नरकार्णवे । अष्टाविंशतिर् एवाद्यास् तीव्रानरककोटयः
verses.transliteration: tānānīya viśuddhyarthaṃ kṣipanti narakārṇave / aṣṭāviṃśatir evādyās tīvrānarakakoṭayaḥ

verses.transliteration: saptamasya talasyānte ghore tamasi saṃsthitāḥ / atighorā ca raudrā ca tathā ghoratamā sthitā

verses.transliteration: atyantaduḥkhajananī ghorarūpā ca pañcamī / ṣaṣṭhī taraṇatārākhyā saptamī ca bhayānakā

verses.sanskrit: अष्टमी कालरात्रिश् च नवमी च घटोत्कटा । दशमी चैव चण्डा च महाचण्डा ततो ऽप्यधः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭamī kālarātriś ca navamī ca ghaṭotkaṭā / daśamī caiva caṇḍā ca mahācaṇḍā tato 'pyadhaḥ

verses.sanskrit: चण्डकोलाहला चैव प्रचण्डा च पराग्निका । जघन्या ह्यवरा लोमा भीषणी चैव नायिका
verses.transliteration: caṇḍakolāhalā caiva pracaṇḍā ca parāgnikā / jaghanyā hyavarā lomā bhīṣaṇī caiva nāyikā

verses.transliteration: mahārauravapīḍābhir mahānto 'pi rudanti hi / tamaḥ śītaṃ tathā coṣṇaṃ pañcaite nāyakāḥ smṛtāḥ

verses.transliteration: aghoraḥ prathamas tīkṣṇaḥ padmaḥ saṃjīvanaḥ śaṭhaḥ / mahāmāyo vilomaś ca kaṇṭakaḥ kaṭakaḥ smṛtaḥ

verses.transliteration: tīvro vāmaḥ karālaś ca kiṅkarālaḥ prakampanaḥ / mahācakraḥ supadmaś ca kālasūtraḥ pragarjanaḥ

verses.transliteration: sūcīmukhaḥ sunemiś ca khādakaḥ suprapīḍitaḥ / kumbhīpākaḥ supākaś ca krakacaś ca sudāruṇaḥ

verses.transliteration: aṅgārarātriḥ pacanaḥ asṛkpūyabhavas tathā / sutīkṣṇāḥ śaṇḍaśakunī mahāsaṃvartakaḥ kratuḥ

verses.transliteration: uṣṭritastu mahānādaḥ pravāhaḥ supravāhanaḥ / vṛṣāśrayo vṛṣāśvaś ca siṃhavyāghragajānanāḥ

verses.transliteration: parvataḥ kṣuradhārākhyo mayo yamalaparvataḥ / sūcīviṣṭhāndhakūpāś ca patanaḥ pātanas tathā

verses.sanskrit: मुशली वृषली चैवाशिवा सङ्कटला तथा । तालपत्रासिगहनं महामोहक एव च

verses.sanskrit: कामनाभिर् विरूपाभिर् अकर्मप्रचयाद् द्रुतम् । सुगूढया ततो ध्वान्ते तप्तशृङ्खलया नराः
verses.transliteration: kāmanābhir virūpābhir akarmapracayād drutam / sugūḍhayā tato dhvānte taptaśṛṅkhalayā narāḥ
verses.translation: Distressed with hunger and thirst, he wandered all round in the forest and caves of the mountains. Then he saw a divine lake adorned with clusters of lotuses. It was full of swans and Karandava variety of cranes. The Cakravaka birds rendered it splendid. On seeing it, the great king felt his hairs standing on ends. He gathered the lotuses and took his bath. After offering libations to the Pitrs, Devas and human beings duly, he covered Sankara with the lotuses and adored him. He drank the pure water adequately with mental concentration and purity. He came out of the water and saw a tree nearby. He spread his upper cloth on the ground and sat down. Then, as he sat there he began to think, 'What shall I do now?' Even as he was sitting there, he saw many deer in the forest region. verses.sanskrit: महावृक्षस्य शाखायां लम्ब्यन्ते यमकिङ्करैः । ततस् तान् सर्वतश् चैव दोलयन्ति हि किङ्कराः
verses.transliteration: mahāvṛkṣasya śākhāyāṃ lambyante yamakiṅkaraiḥ / tatas tān sarvataś caiva dolayanti hi kiṅkarāḥ
verses.translation: All those forest-dwellers (deer) became frightened and went from there crying. The sage who fell down cried "Krsna! Krsna!" and continued: "Alas! something horrible has been committed by him who has killed me now. Who is that evil-minded wretch, in whom this sinful thought has occurred? 1 was stationed amidst the deer. I do not harass or obstruct anyone." On hearing that human voice, the king was struck with dismay. Hurrying there he saw the Brahmana shining with Brahmanical splendour.

verses.translation: When he became unable to carry he began to take rest frequently. Presently he saw that the Brahmana had lost consciousness and that all his sense-organs had become im- paired. Citrasena kept him in the shade of a banyan tree. He folded his cloth four times and began to fan him therewith frequently. Even as he watched, O great king, Rk?asrhga of great austerities quickly passed away by means of Dhyanayoga (meditation) because he was fully conversant with Yoga. He cremated the Brahmana according to the rites that have been enjoined. After taking his bath, he lamented with great sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे नरकायातनानुवर्णनो नाम त्रिपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ५४ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: तीर्यते केन धर्मेण संसाराब्धिः सुदुस्तरः । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: तेन निर्भर्त्सितैः पापैः कथ्यमानां कथां शृणु
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe narakāyātanānuvarṇano nāma tripañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 54 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: tīryate kena dharmeṇa saṃsārābdhiḥ sudustaraḥ / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tena nirbhartsitaiḥ pāpaiḥ kathyamānāṃ kathāṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Thereupon the king became greatly anguished. (He thought:) 4 How can I go back to my abode in Varanasi? Af- flicted by the sin of Brahmana-slaughter, I shall consign my body to fire. Or at the instance (of the son of the sage) 1 shall go to the hermitage and recount to the great sage everything in the way it had happened.'
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: रक्तो मूढश् च लोको ऽयम् अकार्ये संप्रवर्तते । न चात्मानं विजानाति न परं न च दैवतम्
verses.transliteration: rakto mūḍhaś ca loko 'yam akārye saṃpravartate / na cātmānaṃ vijānāti na paraṃ na ca daivatam
verses.translation: O great sage, I am not worthy of being received with the offerings of Argha (materials of worship) or even being spoken to. Your son, the Brahmana stationed in the middle of the deer, was killed by me. Rksasrnga, a Brahmana of great austerities, was killed as a result of the wrong impression that he was a deer. Know that I am the slayer of your son. Punish me with the severest form of punishment. Having consider- ation for my delusion and confusion, O excellent sage, do what is befitting in this regard.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: न शृणोति परं श्रेयः सति चक्षुषि नेक्षते । समे पथि शनैर् गच्छन् प्लवते स्म पदे पदे
verses.transliteration: na śṛṇoti paraṃ śreyaḥ sati cakṣuṣi nekṣate / same pathi śanair gacchan plavate sma pade pade
verses.translation: Go away, get away, O great sinner. Do not show me your face. Why was my son, a Brahmana, killed without any purpose? O king, many sins of many Brahmana-slaughters will befall you. You alone are the cause of the death of me along with the entire family.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तो धर्मराजः संक्षेपात् पापदेहिनाम् । विस्तरेण यदा चख्यौ तेषां तच् छृणु साम्प्रतम्
verses.transliteration: evam ukto dharmarājaḥ saṃkṣepāt pāpadehinām / vistareṇa yadā cakhyau teṣāṃ tac chṛṇu sāmpratam
verses.translation: O Lord, even a single sin of Brahmana-slaughter cannot be redeemed. How can eleven such sins be redeemed? Listen, O king. On account (of the death) of Rksasrriga, my four sons, their wives, the mother and I — all these will die. O dear one, I shall tell you a splendid way-out. Listen to it. See whether you can carry out that easy task, O king. Cremate the entire family including me in funeral pyre; O king, cast off the bones at Sulabheda in the waters of Narmada. On the south- ern bank of Narmada is the well-known Tirtha named Sulabheda. It is an excellent Tirtha that destroys all sins and all miseries. Be clean (physically and mentally) and cast off our bones into the Tirtha. You will be rid of all sins undoubtedly. That is my word.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: यम उवाच: मया मुक्तो न जानाति बोध्यमानो बुधैर् अपि । संसारे क्लिश्यते नाना रागलोभवशात् नरः
verses.transliteration: yama uvāca: mayā mukto na jānāti bodhyamāno budhair api / saṃsāre kliśyate nānā rāgalobhavaśāt naraḥ
verses.translation: O dear one, let the command be given. I shall undoubtedly carry it out. Whatever I have, the entire kingdom, the treasury, the friends and sons, O great Brahmana, all of them are yours, at your disposal. I shall give them to you. Be pleased (to accept it).
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: गर्भपातेन भावेन शास्त्रम् उक्तं न बुध्यते । नरैर् न श्रूयते कर्म स्वर्गमोक्षप्रसाधकम्
verses.transliteration: garbhapātena bhāvena śāstram uktaṃ na budhyate / narair na śrūyate karma svargamokṣaprasādhakam
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, O highly blessed ones, may the path leading to Sulabheda be shown to me, so that I can go there for the fulfilment of my task.

verses.sanskrit: सन्तप्यति शिवध्याने सर्वकामार्थसाधने । नरकाद् आत्मनः श्रेयो यदत्र महदद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: santapyati śivadhyāne sarvakāmārthasādhane / narakād ātmanaḥ śreyo yadatra mahadadbhutam
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, in which part of the land is that Tirtha? Tell me the truth so that the thing desired may be made possible.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेतभूता नराः सर्वे यमलोकं समागताः । आख्यानं कथयिष्यामि यथोद्दिष्टं पुरातनम्
verses.transliteration: pretabhūtā narāḥ sarve yamalokaṃ samāgatāḥ / ākhyānaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yathoddiṣṭaṃ purātanam
verses.translation: He thought. This is my blessed day since I have come here/ He then placed the bones down and took his holy bath in accordance with the injunctions. With water mixed with gingelly seeds he propitiated the Pitrs and deities. Then the king took the bones and cast them into the water. For a moment, the king stood looking up with the face lifted up. He saw all of them (members of the family of Dlrghatapas) in divine forms and splendid features. They had divine garments and were adorned with divine ornaments. They were seated in various kinds of aerial chariots attended upon by celestial damsels. On seeing them separately seated in the aerial chariots, the king was de- lighted.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे कर्मगतियमवाक्यं नाम चतुष्पञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ५५ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: धेनुः कतिविधा प्रोक्ता कस्मिन् काले च दीयते । सर्वोपस्करसंयुक्ता त्वत्त इच्छामि वेदितुम्

verses.sanskrit: चक्रवर्ती शशाङ्को ऽभूत् सर्वधर्मभृतां वरः । न च वर्णयितुं शक्यः सत्यधर्मव्रते स्थितः
verses.transliteration: cakravartī śaśāṅko 'bhūt sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / na ca varṇayituṃ śakyaḥ satyadharmavrate sthitaḥ
verses.translation: O king, we the three Devas, shall stay in Sulabheda from today onwards in all the three divisions of time by means of a fraction. You shall certainly be the Lord of the Ganas. By the name 'Nandin' staying near me you shall be worshipped before I am. After your casting off the hones, as Dirghatapas went to heaven seated in an aerial chariot along with the members of his family, so you too shall do.

verses.sanskrit: बुभुजे स महीमेतामेकच्छत्रां समाहितः । नवखण्डां सप्तद्वीपा यथा शक्रो ऽमरावतीम्
verses.transliteration: bubhuje sa mahīmetāmekacchatrāṃ samāhitaḥ / navakhaṇḍāṃ saptadvīpā yathā śakro 'marāvatīm
verses.translation: Visnu stationed himself in the form of Pitr (i.e. father), Brahma in the form of Pitamaha (grandfather) and Rudra as Prapitamaha (great-grandfather). Thus the three deities got themselves stationed, O king. The Pitrs are always waiting like this: "When will my son visit the Tirtha? When will he redeem us?" If a devotee takes the holy bath in Sulabheda and visits but once Suladhara (Trident-bearing Lord Siva) he shall not be without sons or wealth for seven births. He will never become sick. He shall redeem twenty-one generations of his father's family, twenty-one generations of the mother's family and ten generations of his wife's family. O king, if a single Brahmana is fed in the Sulabheda Vana with even greens, roots and fruits, it amounts to the feeding of ten million persons elsewhere. A devout man who performs Sraddha at the five spots shall redeem all the members of the family, who have become Pretas (ghosts), with the favour of Brahmanas and deities as well as of the Pitrs. A person who offers Sraddha should stay there where Lord Mahesvara is present. If a devotee performs Sraddha with devotion in that Tirtha, the following persons shall attain liberation undoubtedly for a Yuga: They are: those who commit suicide, those who have killed cows and Brahmanas, those who have been killed by animals with curved fangs, or drowned in water, or struck down by lightning, those who were not cremated or on whose death Asauca 1 was not observed or libation not offered. O king, merely by taking bath all the sins committed through ignorance or childish nature will be dis- pelled.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे गोदानमहिमानुवर्णनो नाम पञ्चपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ५६ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: माहिष्मत्याः पश्चिमे वै तीर्थं पापहरं परम् । अशोकवनिका नाम सर्वशोकविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe godānamahimānuvarṇano nāma pañcapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 56 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: māhiṣmatyāḥ paścime vai tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ param / aśokavanikā nāma sarvaśokavināśanam
verses.translation: I wish to know some more. By whom was Ganga brought down? How did the holy River which was stationed on the head of Rudra, happen to come here? What is the efficacy of the holy Devasila? O Sankara, if you are pleased, describe these things to me.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा तत्रार्चयेद् गौरीं यथा विभवविस्तरैः । मातङ्गस्याश्रम तद्वत् सिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितम्

verses.translation: Praci Sarasvatl is to the west of the celestial river, O king, in the Kunda of Sulabheda where she had fallen.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लकृष्णातृतीयायां गन्धधूपविलेपनैः । उपहारैर् अनेकैश् च दीपमालाप्रबोधनैः
verses.transliteration: śuklakṛṣṇātṛtīyāyāṃ gandhadhūpavilepanaiḥ / upahārair anekaiś ca dīpamālāprabodhanaiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter the king of Cedi began a Yajria (a sac- rifice) lasting for twelve years. In the meantime the husband of his daughter met with his death.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र या पूजयेन् नारी गौरीं भक्तिसमन्विता । रूपसौभाग्यसम्पन्नं लभते सत्पतिं तु सा
verses.transliteration: tatra yā pūjayen nārī gaurīṃ bhaktisamanvitā / rūpasaubhāgyasampannaṃ labhate satpatiṃ tu sā
verses.translation: In view of her intended pilgrimage, the king placed a vast amount of wealth at her disposal. To guard her he engaged many old men to accompany her. He sent Brahmanas and priests, slaves and servants as well as foot-soldiers capable of protecting her.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: In view of her intended pilgrimage, the king placed a vast amount of wealth at her disposal. To guard her he engaged many old men to accompany her. He sent Brahmanas and priests, slaves and servants as well as foot-soldiers capable of protecting her.
verses.commentary: Sense: In view of her intended pilgrimage, the king placed a vast amount of wealth at her disposal. To guard her he engaged many old men to accompany her. He sent Brahmanas and priests, slaves and servants as well as foot-soldiers capable of protecting her.

verses.sanskrit: कार्त्तिक्यां तु गतप्राणा मोदमाना तु संयता । अस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यात् प्राप्ता माहेश्वरं पुरम्
verses.transliteration: kārttikyāṃ tu gataprāṇā modamānā tu saṃyatā / asya tīrthasya māhātmyāt prāptā māheśvaraṃ puram
verses.translation: This is well-known as Cakra TIrtha. It was here that the discus was granted to Hari by the Trident-bearing Lord of Devas, the delighted Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मातङ्गो नाम देवर्षिः पुराकल्पे युधिष्ठिर । नर्मदातीरमाश्रित्य तपस् तेपे सुदुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: mātaṅgo nāma devarṣiḥ purākalpe yudhiṣṭhira / narmadātīramāśritya tapas tepe suduṣkaram
verses.translation: This spot consists of all Devas and all Tlrthas. The place is full of crores of deities and is the most excellent of all excellent Tlrthas with ten million Lingas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: पुरा जन्मनिषादः स जातिं स्मरति पूर्विकाम् । अघमर्षणदेशस्थः सर्वधर्म बुबोध च
verses.transliteration: purā janmaniṣādaḥ sa jātiṃ smarati pūrvikām / aghamarṣaṇadeśasthaḥ sarvadharma bubodha ca
verses.translation: Now, O king, listen to another story showing the greatness of Devasila. I shall narrate, O mighty-armed one, an old legend along with the historical background.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Now, O king, listen to another story showing the greatness of Devasila. I shall narrate, O mighty-armed one, an old legend along with the historical background.

verses.sanskrit: महर्षीणां प्रसङ्गेन नर्मदादर्शनेन च । पापबुद्धिं परित्यज्य धर्मबुद्धिं चकार सः
verses.transliteration: maharṣīṇāṃ prasaṅgena narmadādarśanena ca / pāpabuddhiṃ parityajya dharmabuddhiṃ cakāra saḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the entire country present there, the Sahara said to his wife: tf Go and ask someone as to why they

verses.sanskrit: निर्विण्णो ऽहं च भिक्षुश् चाधुना श्वपचयोनिषु । एवम् उक्त्वा ततो राजन्न् अशोकवनिकां गतः
verses.transliteration: nirviṇṇo 'haṃ ca bhikṣuś cādhunā śvapacayoniṣu / evam uktvā tato rājann aśokavanikāṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Upto verse 57 the story of Bh&numat! is narrated. The remaining part of her story will be told later. In the meanwhile the story of £abari, which is a part of BhSnumatTs, is told by Isvara. The story is told to emphasize the MihStmya of Devafitt and is not a break in BhSnumati's story.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Upto verse 57 the story of Bh&numat! is narrated. The remaining part of her story will be told later. In the meanwhile the story of £abari, which is a part of BhSnumatTs, is told by Isvara.…

verses.sanskrit: जटावल्कलधारी च कन्दमूलफलाशनः । दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु शिवाराधनतत्परः
verses.transliteration: jaṭāvalkaladhārī ca kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ / divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu śivārādhanatatparaḥ
verses.translation: As far as I remember, L did not eat before you (have eaten). Whatever was left after your meal only that was eaten by me.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: शिवध्यानपरः सो ऽभूद् उग्रे तपसि संस्थितः । दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं हि तथा तस्य तपस्यतः
verses.transliteration: śivadhyānaparaḥ so 'bhūd ugre tapasi saṃsthitaḥ / divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ hi tathā tasya tapasyataḥ
verses.translation: O queen, I do not desire to get (any) price of the flowers and the fruits. Sriphalas and flowers may be taken from me as you please. Do perform duly the adoration of Vasudeva, the Lord of the universe.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: एकाशीतिसहस्राणि जटाग्रेभ्यो विनिःस्मृताः । स्वयं पतन्ति विविधा नर्मदातोयम् अध्यतः
verses.transliteration: ekāśītisahasrāṇi jaṭāgrebhyo viniḥsmṛtāḥ / svayaṃ patanti vividhā narmadātoyam adhyataḥ
verses.translation: It has been rejected earlier. Everything is estab- lished in Satya (Truth). It is due to Satya that the sun blazes. It is because of Satya that the fire burns. Through Satya the ocean stands (firm). The wind blows through Satya. Through Satya crops ripen and cows yield milk. The entire universe consisting of mobile and immobile beings has Satya for its support. Hence by all means, one should protect Satya through abiding by Satya. Excepting the task pertaining to the Lord, my mind is not inclined in regard to anything. Take the flow- ers, O queen, and perform the adoration of the mace-bearing Lord Visnu.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तत्क्षणाद् यक्षिणीरूपा अनन्ताश् चाप्रमाणिकाः । श्यामवर्णाः सुतेजः काः सर्वाभरणभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: tatkṣaṇād yakṣiṇīrūpā anantāś cāpramāṇikāḥ / śyāmavarṇāḥ sutejaḥ kāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: Some went to Cakratirtha and took the holy bath in accordance with the injunctions. All those pure persons performed Sraddha assiduously and faithfully on the Devasila rock after their holy bath. Their mind remained pure.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: यक्षलोकं व्रजन्त्य् आशु तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः । मन्त्रयन्त्रविहीनो ऽपि शिवभक्तिपरायणः
verses.transliteration: yakṣalokaṃ vrajanty āśu tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ / mantrayantravihīno 'pi śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: A person who gives foodgrain attains permanent happiness; one who gives Vedic text attains the eternal Brah- man. Of all Danas, viz. water, food, earth, clothes, gingelly seeds, gold and ghee, Brahmadana (gift of learning) is the best.

verses.transliteration: mātaṅga uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa varaṃ dātum ihecchasi / mātaṅganāmnā vikhyātiṃ tīrtham etat prayātu vai

verses.transliteration: cāṇḍālāḥ śvapacāś caiva pāpayonigatā 'pi / japādi rahitāś cāpi mucyante 'trāpi kilbiṣāt

verses.transliteration: idaṃ varam ahaṃ manye tvatprasādāt maheśvara / tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā praty uvāca śivāpatiḥ

verses.sanskrit: जगामाशु चिरं भोक्तुं भोगान् स्नानप्रभावतः । या चैत्रमासे ऽमावास्या कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशी

verses.sanskrit: सक्त्वाढ्यगुडपिण्डेन पितॄन् मोदयते तु यः । पितरस्तस्य तृप्यन्ति यावदिन्द्राश् चतुर्दश

verses.sanskrit: तिलतण्डुलमिश्रं यः कुर्याल् लिङ्गस्य पूजनम् । सो ऽपि वर्षसहस्राणि शिवलोके महीयते

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा ऽर्चयेद् विष्णुं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् । एकादश्यां महाराज निराहारो निशां नयेत्

verses.sanskrit: हरिं मृगवने तत्र गन्धपुष्पैश् च पूजयेत् । एकस्मिन् भोजिते विप्रे लक्षं भवतु भोजितम्

verses.sanskrit: तिलोदकप्रदानेन पितॄणां वैष्णवं पदम् । तत्रैव सन्निविष्टं तु वाराहं तीर्थमुत्तमम्

verses.sanskrit: यत्र वाराहरूपेण धरा चैव समुद्धृता । विश्वरूपं तथा चान्यद्धरिणामिततेजसा

verses.sanskrit: पतिव्रता च नारी वै तथा मासोपवासिनी । तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन लोकं प्राप्नोति वैष्णवम्

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे मातङ्गाश्रमवर्णनो नाम षट्पञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ५७ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: आख्यानं कथयिष्यामि ख्यातं मृगवनं यथा । व्याध कश्चिद् दुराचारः सर्वभूतेषु निर्दयः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe mātaṅgāśramavarṇano nāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 57 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ākhyānaṃ kathayiṣyāmi khyātaṃ mṛgavanaṃ yathā / vyādha kaścid durācāraḥ sarvabhūteṣu nirdayaḥ
verses.translation: After feeding Brahmanas, Bhanumati ate what was left after feeding them. After eating she took rest with plea- sure, while the food got digested. On the Madanakhya Trayodasi day (thirteenth of the bright half named Madana), she took bath in the Hrada (whirlpool) of Markanda and adored Lord Guhasaya (Siva) (stationed in a cave as abode). She observed fast as enjoined. She bathed Mahesvara with Pancamrta and sweet scents. Incense, lamps, Naivedyasv/ere offered. She adored (the Lord) with different kinds of flowers and excellent Naivedyas. She kept awake in the night hearing Puranic stories and wit- nessing dances and hearing songs and prayers. She meditated upon Lord Mahesvara. The entire quantity of cooked food was duly spread in front of the Lord. All the people belonging to all the four castes were fed along with their attendants.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: After feeding Brahmanas, Bhanumati ate what was left after feeding them. After eating she took rest with plea- sure, while the food got digested. On the Madanakhya Trayodasi day (thirteenth of the bright half named Madana),…
verses.commentary: Sense: After feeding Brahmanas, Bhanumati ate what was left after feeding them. After eating she took rest with plea- sure, while the food got digested. On the Madanakhya Trayodasi day (thirteenth of the bright half named Madana),…

verses.sanskrit: पाशहस्तो धनुष्पाणिर् विचरन् गिरिकन्दरे । आजघान मृगान् सर्वान् कुटुम्बार्थे नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: pāśahasto dhanuṣpāṇir vicaran girikandare / ājaghāna mṛgān sarvān kuṭumbārthe nṛpottama
verses.translation: Gifts were made to Brahmanas in accordance with own capacity as well as the qualifications of the ones. The Lord was adored with sweet-smelling flowers such as Madana and the like, and clothed all round with delicate clothes of various colours. Many garlands were kept hanging down and many lamps were kept blazing. There were various kinds of sweet cooked foods such as Modakas etc., round in shape.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Gifts were made to Brahmanas in accordance with own capacity as well as the qualifications of the ones. The Lord was adored with sweet-smelling flowers such as Madana and the like, and clothed all round with delicate clothes of various colours.…

verses.transliteration: kāṣṭhamṛnmayagehaṃ ca yo dvijāya prayacchati / evaṃ vidhān gṛhān ramyān sarvato 'marakaṇṭake
verses.translation: I desire no money, no food-grains, no garments. If anyone accepts food from another, he accepts his sins as well.

verses.sanskrit: कारयेद् यः पुमान् दिव्यांस् तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु । किं तस्य बहुभिर् दत्तैर् दानैर् भवति भारत
verses.transliteration: kārayed yaḥ pumān divyāṃs tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / kiṃ tasya bahubhir dattair dānair bhavati bhārata
verses.translation: I desire no money, no food-grains, no garments. If anyone accepts food from another, he accepts his sins as well.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् एव परं दानं सर्वकामार्थसाधकम् । यः शृणोति नरो भक्त्या सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: etad eva paraṃ dānaṃ sarvakāmārthasādhakam / yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: I desire no money, no food-grains, no garments. If anyone accepts food from another, he accepts his sins as well.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये सप्तपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ५८ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: श्रुत्वैतत् परमं गुह्यं गवां देवसम् उद्भवम् । ब्रह्मकूर्चस्य माहात्म्यं श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye saptapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 58 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: śrutvaitat paramaṃ guhyaṃ gavāṃ devasam udbhavam / brahmakūrcasya māhātmyaṃ śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O Lord of the chiefs of Devas, what did Bhanumati do? This is my doubt. O Lord, do me the favour of mentioning this.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O Lord of the chiefs of Devas, what did Bhanumati do? This is my doubt. O Lord, do me the favour of mentioning this.

verses.sanskrit: आख्याहि भगवन् सर्वं गोलोकः कीदृशः स्मृतः । प्राप्यते कर्मणा केन के तस्मिन्न् अनिशं स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: ākhyāhi bhagavan sarvaṃ golokaḥ kīdṛśaḥ smṛtaḥ / prāpyate karmaṇā kena ke tasminn aniśaṃ sthitāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śrūyatām abhidhāsyāmi namaskṛtya maheśvaram / gomātṛlokaṃ paramaṃ sarvakām asamanvitam

verses.sanskrit: नागराजः सदैवास्ते तस्मिन् कृतनिकेतनः । अनन्तो ऽनन्तधामा च मुकुन्दो नृपशैवलः
verses.transliteration: nāgarājaḥ sadaivāste tasmin kṛtaniketanaḥ / ananto 'nantadhāmā ca mukundo nṛpaśaivalaḥ

verses.sanskrit: ततो रसातलं नाम शिवसन्तोषभूमिकम् । वासुकेर् नागराजस्य तत्र चारु महापुरम्

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुतलनामास्ति शर्कराञ्चितभूमिकम् । नागादीनां स्वस्तिकानां तत्रैव वसतिः सदा

verses.sanskrit: दानवाधिपतीनां च तत्रैव निलयः परः । वैरोचनहिरण्याख्यप्रभृतीनां महात्मनाम्

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चातलम् इत्युक्तं पातालानां तस्य तु वै । तेषाम् ऊर्ध्ववस्तुसर्वेषां मृन्मयं च तलं क्षितेः
verses.transliteration: tataścātalam ityuktaṃ pātālānāṃ tasya tu vai / teṣām ūrdhvavastusarveṣāṃ mṛnmayaṃ ca talaṃ kṣiteḥ

verses.sanskrit: असुराधिपतेस् तावत् कालनेमेर्महापुरम् । चारुचामीकराभासं वैनतेयस्य चापरम्

verses.sanskrit: ततश् च वितलं नाम पातालं रक्तभूतलम् । तस्मिन् महान्तको नाम दानवेन्द्रकृतालयः
verses.transliteration: tataś ca vitalaṃ nāma pātālaṃ raktabhūtalam / tasmin mahāntako nāma dānavendrakṛtālayaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: तालको ऽग्निमुखस् तस्मिन् नलह्रादश् च दानवाः । निवसन्ति कृतागारास् तथा प्रह्लादवर्चसः
verses.transliteration: tālako 'gnimukhas tasmin nalahrādaś ca dānavāḥ / nivasanti kṛtāgārās tathā prahlādavarcasaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: पातालं वितलं नाम शुक्लं क्षितितलं ततः । कम्बलाश्वतरौ नागौ सहितौ तत्र तिष्ठतः
verses.transliteration: pātālaṃ vitalaṃ nāma śuklaṃ kṣititalaṃ tataḥ / kambalāśvatarau nāgau sahitau tatra tiṣṭhataḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: महाजम्भहयग्रीवप्रभृतीनां महात्मनाम् । वाराणस्यसुरेन्द्राणां निवासस् तत्रकल्पितः
verses.transliteration: mahājambhahayagrīvaprabhṛtīnāṃ mahātmanām / vārāṇasyasurendrāṇāṃ nivāsas tatrakalpitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णं क्षितितलं तस्मात् पातालतलसंज्ञकम् । शङ्कुकर्णमहानादनमुचीनां निकेतनम्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇaṃ kṣititalaṃ tasmāt pātālatalasaṃjñakam / śaṅkukarṇamahānādanamucīnāṃ niketanam
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: पातालात् सप्तमाद् ऊर्ध्वं सप्तद्वीपा मही स्थिता । समुद्रैः सप्तभिर् युक्ता पर्वतैः समलंकृता
verses.transliteration: pātālāt saptamād ūrdhvaṃ saptadvīpā mahī sthitā / samudraiḥ saptabhir yuktā parvataiḥ samalaṃkṛtā
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: जम्बूद्वीपश् च तन् मध्ये प्लक्षद्वीपस् ततः परः
verses.transliteration: jambūdvīpaś ca tan madhye plakṣadvīpas tataḥ paraḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: क्रौञ्चद्वीपश् च परतः शाकद्वीपश् च तद्बहिः । परतः पुष्करद्वीपः सप्तमः परिकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: krauñcadvīpaś ca parataḥ śākadvīpaś ca tadbahiḥ / parataḥ puṣkaradvīpaḥ saptamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: क्षारोदकश् चेक्षुरसः सुरोदश् च घृतोदधिः । दधितोयः क्षीरपूर्णः स्वादूदः सप्तमः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: kṣārodakaś cekṣurasaḥ surodaś ca ghṛtodadhiḥ / dadhitoyaḥ kṣīrapūrṇaḥ svādūdaḥ saptamaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तद्वीपसमुद्राणां द्विगुणद्विगुणान्तरः । प्रमाणविस्तरो ज्ञेयो नियुतः प्रथमः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: saptadvīpasamudrāṇāṃ dviguṇadviguṇāntaraḥ / pramāṇavistaro jñeyo niyutaḥ prathamaḥ smṛtaḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: हिमवान् हेमकूटश् च निषधश् चेति दक्षिणे । नीलश् च श्वेतः शृङ्गश् च मेरोरुत्तरतः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: himavān hemakūṭaś ca niṣadhaś ceti dakṣiṇe / nīlaś ca śvetaḥ śṛṅgaś ca meroruttarataḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: मेरुर् अस्ति स्थितो मध्ये जम्बूद्वीपस्य भारत । माल्यवान् पूर्वतो ज्ञेयः पश्चिमे गन्धमादनः
verses.transliteration: merur asti sthito madhye jambūdvīpasya bhārata / mālyavān pūrvato jñeyaḥ paścime gandhamādanaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: एते पर्वतराजानो जम्बूद्वीपे नव स्मृताः । प्लक्षद्वीपादिषु ज्ञेयाः सप्तसप्तैव पर्वताः
verses.transliteration: ete parvatarājāno jambūdvīpe nava smṛtāḥ / plakṣadvīpādiṣu jñeyāḥ saptasaptaiva parvatāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्करद्वीपमध्ये तु पर्वतो वलयाकृतिः । एकः स्मृतः समन्ताच् च नामतो मानसः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: puṣkaradvīpamadhye tu parvato valayākṛtiḥ / ekaḥ smṛtaḥ samantāc ca nāmato mānasaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: विन्ध्यो नाम महाभागो जम्बूद्वीपे व्यवस्थितः । यत्रैषा नर्मदादेवी प्लवन्ती लोकतारिणी
verses.transliteration: vindhyo nāma mahābhāgo jambūdvīpe vyavasthitaḥ / yatraiṣā narmadādevī plavantī lokatāriṇī
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: विन्ध्यस्य चानुजो भ्राता सह्यो दक्षिणतः स्मृतः । उर्वी कूर्मतलाकारा काञ्चनी परिमण्डला
verses.transliteration: vindhyasya cānujo bhrātā sahyo dakṣiṇataḥ smṛtaḥ / urvī kūrmatalākārā kāñcanī parimaṇḍalā
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: अणुरेव तथा सा तु निर्दिष्टातिविदः क्षितिः । तस्याः प्रमाणं निर्दिष्टं दशयोजनकोटयः
verses.transliteration: aṇureva tathā sā tu nirdiṣṭātividaḥ kṣitiḥ / tasyāḥ pramāṇaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ daśayojanakoṭayaḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: लोकालोक इति ख्यातस् तस्याः प्रान्ते समन्ततः । स्फीतो हेममयः श्रीमान् सरलः परिमण्डलः
verses.transliteration: lokāloka iti khyātas tasyāḥ prānte samantataḥ / sphīto hemamayaḥ śrīmān saralaḥ parimaṇḍalaḥ

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां सहस्राणि चार्धमस्य व्यवस्थितम् । तावदेव च विस्तीर्णं तदर्धे भानुराहितः

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशयति स ज्योतिः परभागे निहन्यते । लोकालोक इति प्रोक्तस् ततो ऽसावचलो महान्
verses.transliteration: prakāśayati sa jyotiḥ parabhāge nihanyate / lokāloka iti proktas tato 'sāvacalo mahān
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: लोकालोकावसानो ऽयं भूर्लोकः परिकीर्तितः । गन्धर्वयक्षरक्षोभिः पिशाचैश् च निषेवितः
verses.transliteration: lokālokāvasāno 'yaṃ bhūrlokaḥ parikīrtitaḥ / gandharvayakṣarakṣobhiḥ piśācaiś ca niṣevitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: मानुषैः पशुभिश् चैव मृगपक्षिसरीसृपैः । स्थावरैर्विविधाकारैर् भूतैर् एतैश् च षड्विधैः
verses.transliteration: mānuṣaiḥ paśubhiś caiva mṛgapakṣisarīsṛpaiḥ / sthāvarairvividhākārair bhūtair etaiś ca ṣaḍvidhaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: भूर्लोकश् च भुवर्लोको यावद् आदित्यमण्डलम् । वसन्ति सततं रुद्रास् सततं वक्त्रभास्कराः
verses.transliteration: bhūrlokaś ca bhuvarloko yāvad ādityamaṇḍalam / vasanti satataṃ rudrās satataṃ vaktrabhāskarāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यमण्डलादूर्ध्वं स्मृता स्वर्लोकसंस्थितिः । विमानकोटयस् तस्मिन्न् अष्टाविंशतिराशयः
verses.transliteration: ādityamaṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ smṛtā svarlokasaṃsthitiḥ / vimānakoṭayas tasminn aṣṭāviṃśatirāśayaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: मेढीभूतो विमानानां सर्वेषाम् उपरि ध्रुवः । नियुता अनिलस्कन्धाः सप्तास्मिन्न् अन्तरे स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: meḍhībhūto vimānānāṃ sarveṣām upari dhruvaḥ / niyutā anilaskandhāḥ saptāsminn antare sthitāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्याः प्रथमः स्कन्धः स्थितश् चामेघमण्डलम् । आहवो नाम वै वातो व्यूहानां व्यूहकृत् तथा
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāḥ prathamaḥ skandhaḥ sthitaś cāmeghamaṇḍalam / āhavo nāma vai vāto vyūhānāṃ vyūhakṛt tathā
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयः प्रवहो नाम निबद्धः सूर्यमण्डले । तृतीयः संवहो माम सुस्कन्धो ऽसौ प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: dvitīyaḥ pravaho nāma nibaddhaḥ sūryamaṇḍale / tṛtīyaḥ saṃvaho māma suskandho 'sau pratiṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थः सोद्वहः स्कन्धः स्थितो नक्षत्रमण्डले । ततो द्वयोर् विनिर्दिष्टा विमानोद्वहनक्रिया
verses.transliteration: caturthaḥ sodvahaḥ skandhaḥ sthito nakṣatramaṇḍale / tato dvayor vinirdiṣṭā vimānodvahanakriyā
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां ध्रुवः कोटिर् महर्लोकः समुच्छ्रितः । स्कन्धः परिवहो नाम निबद्धः सप्तमो ध्रुवे
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ dhruvaḥ koṭir maharlokaḥ samucchritaḥ / skandhaḥ parivaho nāma nibaddhaḥ saptamo dhruve
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नादीनि करोत्य् एष पर्वणाम् उपरि स्थितः । विनिर्वृत्तं विकाराणाम् अधिवासो महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: annādīni karoty eṣa parvaṇām upari sthitaḥ / vinirvṛttaṃ vikārāṇām adhivāso mahātmanām
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राधिकारिदेवानाम् अष्टाविंशति कोटयः । जनात् स्वर्लोकम् आगत्य नियोगात् पद्मजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: tatrādhikāridevānām aṣṭāviṃśati koṭayaḥ / janāt svarlokam āgatya niyogāt padmajanmanaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: स्थिता मन्वन्तरं तत्र स्वव्यापारावसायिनः । आरुह्य च महर्लोकम् आगच्छन्ति ततः पुनः
verses.transliteration: sthitā manvantaraṃ tatra svavyāpārāvasāyinaḥ / āruhya ca maharlokam āgacchanti tataḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो दिवसैकेन देवाः स्वर्गे चतुर्दश । क्रमेण कृत्वा कर्माणि महर्लोके वसन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo divasaikena devāḥ svarge caturdaśa / krameṇa kṛtvā karmāṇi maharloke vasanti te
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: कोटिद्वयं महर्लोकाज् जनलोकः समुच्छ्रितः । साध्यानाम् असुरास् तत्र वसन्ति सुखिनः सदा
verses.transliteration: koṭidvayaṃ maharlokāj janalokaḥ samucchritaḥ / sādhyānām asurās tatra vasanti sukhinaḥ sadā
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां चतुःकोट्यः जनाद् अप्य् उच्छ्रितं तपः । प्रजानां पतयस् तत्र स्थितास् तु ब्रह्मणः सुताः
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ catuḥkoṭyaḥ janād apy ucchritaṃ tapaḥ / prajānāṃ patayas tatra sthitās tu brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यलोकस् तपोलोकात् कोटिषट्कं समुच्छ्रितम् । आस्ते परिवृतस् तत्र देवासुरगणैर् विराट्
verses.transliteration: satyalokas tapolokāt koṭiṣaṭkaṃ samucchritam / āste parivṛtas tatra devāsuragaṇair virāṭ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.transliteration: vimānaiḥ sarvato vyāptaṃ candrair ivanabhastalam / apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ sarvavidyādharānvitam

verses.transliteration: nṛtyagītaravopetair aprameyaguṇānvitaiḥ / manojavair asaṃkhyātaiḥ parivārasamanvitaiḥ

verses.transliteration: kvacid dolāgṛhair ramyaiḥ kiṅkiṇīr avakānvitaiḥ / udgatair ardhacandraiś ca ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ

verses.transliteration: maṇimuktāvitānaiś ca maṇiratnacayaiḥ śubhaiḥ / sarvaratnārcitair dravyair muktādāmasuśobhanaiḥ

verses.transliteration: mahāsiṃhāsanair divyaiḥ sarvaratnavibhūṣitaiḥ / kvacit puṇyagṛhair vyāptam asaṃkhyaguṇānvitaiḥ

verses.transliteration: ekavaktrair mahāvaktrair bahuvaktrair avaktrakaiḥ / ekapādais tripādaiś ca bahupādair apādakaiḥ

verses.sanskrit: नानारूपाकृतिधरैर् नानाभरणभूषितैः । नानावेषधरैर् दिव्यैः कामरूपैर् महाबलैः
verses.transliteration: nānārūpākṛtidharair nānābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ / nānāveṣadharair divyaiḥ kāmarūpair mahābalaiḥ

verses.sanskrit: नानाप्रभावसंयुक्तैर् नानाशास्त्रविशारदैः । असंख्या जातयश् चान्या निवसन्ति तथा विधाः
verses.transliteration: nānāprabhāvasaṃyuktair nānāśāstraviśāradaiḥ / asaṃkhyā jātayaś cānyā nivasanti tathā vidhāḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: कुब्जावामनकादीर्घा वरदेहा वराननाः । मुण्डाश् च विकटा नीचा ह्रस्वदीर्घश् च तादृशाः
verses.transliteration: kubjāvāmanakādīrghā varadehā varānanāḥ / muṇḍāś ca vikaṭā nīcā hrasvadīrghaś ca tādṛśāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: लम्बोदरा ह्रस्वभुजा विनता ह्रस्वजानुकाः । मृगेन्द्रवदनाश् चान्या गजवाजिमुखास् तथा
verses.transliteration: lambodarā hrasvabhujā vinatā hrasvajānukāḥ / mṛgendravadanāś cānyā gajavājimukhās tathā
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
