verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: ह्रस्वकुञ्चितकेशाश् च सुन्दरप्रियदर्शनाः । पञ्चाशत्कोटयस् तत्र शिवस्य परिचारिकाः
verses.transliteration: hrasvakuñcitakeśāś ca sundarapriyadarśanāḥ / pañcāśatkoṭayas tatra śivasya paricārikāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: मणिमाणिक्यगेहेषु रमन्ते ता बहिः क्वचित् । तत्र गेहेषु यद् द्वारिसहस्रशतभूमिषु
verses.transliteration: maṇimāṇikyageheṣu ramante tā bahiḥ kvacit / tatra geheṣu yad dvārisahasraśatabhūmiṣu
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रभूमयस् तत्र वज्रवैदूर्यभूषिताः । इति सर्वगुणोपेतैः स्त्रीसहस्रैर् वराननैः
verses.transliteration: vicitrabhūmayas tatra vajravaidūryabhūṣitāḥ / iti sarvaguṇopetaiḥ strīsahasrair varānanaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: असंख्यातैः पुरं व्याप्तम् ईश्वरस्य समन्ततः । तन् मध्ये सर्वतोभद्रं दिव्यमायतनं महत्
verses.transliteration: asaṃkhyātaiḥ puraṃ vyāptam īśvarasya samantataḥ / tan madhye sarvatobhadraṃ divyamāyatanaṃ mahat
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं स्थानम् आद्यम् उमापतेः । तत्रास्ते भगवान् सोमः पूज्यमानो गणेश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ sthānam ādyam umāpateḥ / tatrāste bhagavān somaḥ pūjyamāno gaṇeśvaraiḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धैः स्वस्थानसंप्राप्तैर् ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादिभिस् तथा । धर्मस् तत्र स्थितः श्रीमानीश्वरायतने ऽनघ
verses.transliteration: siddhaiḥ svasthānasaṃprāptair brahmaviṣṇvādibhis tathā / dharmas tatra sthitaḥ śrīmānīśvarāyatane 'nagha
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र वीरवृषः तत्र नित्यं गोमातरः स्थिताः । तत्र सा नर्मदादेवी पूज्यमाना सुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration: yatra vīravṛṣaḥ tatra nityaṃ gomātaraḥ sthitāḥ / tatra sā narmadādevī pūjyamānā surāsuraiḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: तेनोदकेन तृप्यन्ति गोवत्साः सर्वदेवताः । ब्रह्माविष्णुः सुरेशान उमया सहितो ऽनघ
verses.transliteration: tenodakena tṛpyanti govatsāḥ sarvadevatāḥ / brahmāviṣṇuḥ sureśāna umayā sahito 'nagha
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: सुराश् च ऋषयो भूताः पितरो मातरस् तथा । स लोकः शिवलोको ऽत्र नर्मदालोक एव च
verses.transliteration: surāś ca ṛṣayo bhūtāḥ pitaro mātaras tathā / sa lokaḥ śivaloko 'tra narmadāloka eva ca
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: ये गुणा रुद्रलोकस्य गोलोकस्य तथैव च । नन्दा भद्रा सुभद्रा च सुशीला सुरभिस् तथा
verses.transliteration: ye guṇā rudralokasya golokasya tathaiva ca / nandā bhadrā subhadrā ca suśīlā surabhis tathā
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: इति गोमातरः पञ्च शिवलोकविनिर्गताः । षष्ठी तु नर्मदादेवी लोकानुग्रहकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: iti gomātaraḥ pañca śivalokavinirgatāḥ / ṣaṣṭhī tu narmadādevī lokānugrahakāmyayā
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: एताः सर्वा जगत्सर्वं सर्वलोकस्य मातरः । तर्पयन्ति महाराज नित्यम् अत्रात्मिकैर् गुणैः
verses.transliteration: etāḥ sarvā jagatsarvaṃ sarvalokasya mātaraḥ / tarpayanti mahārāja nityam atrātmikair guṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: कारणाच् च शिवस्थानाद् ईश्वरेच्छावशा ऽनुगा । ॐकारात् सर्वलोकानाम् इमं लोकं समाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: kāraṇāc ca śivasthānād īśvarecchāvaśā 'nugā / oṃkārāt sarvalokānām imaṃ lokaṃ samāśritāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: तृणानि खादन्ति चरन्त्य् अरण्ये पिबन्ति तोयानि सुनिर्मलानि । दुग्धं प्रयच्छन्ति पुनन्ति देहं गावो यतो जीवति जीवलोकः
verses.transliteration: tṛṇāni khādanti caranty araṇye pibanti toyāni sunirmalāni / dugdhaṃ prayacchanti punanti dehaṃ gāvo yato jīvati jīvalokaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: कुतस् तेषां हि पापानि येषां गृहमलंकृतम् । सततं बालवत्साभिर् गोभिः स्त्रीभिरिव स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: kutas teṣāṃ hi pāpāni yeṣāṃ gṛhamalaṃkṛtam / satataṃ bālavatsābhir gobhiḥ strībhiriva svayam
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: ये स्मरन्ति सद्ॐकारं नर्मदां च शिवात्मना । न तेषां पुनरावृत्तिर्घोरे संसारसागरे
verses.transliteration: ye smaranti sadoṃkāraṃ narmadāṃ ca śivātmanā / na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttirghore saṃsārasāgare
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: ये कुर्वन्ति परां भक्तिं तृणतोयप्रदानतः । प्रसादात् तु गवां तासां शिवलोकं व्रजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: ye kurvanti parāṃ bhaktiṃ tṛṇatoyapradānataḥ / prasādāt tu gavāṃ tāsāṃ śivalokaṃ vrajanti te

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: एताः सदानुकूलेन मातरः सर्वकामदाः । ये रक्षन्ति शुभा गाश् च शिवलोकं व्रजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: etāḥ sadānukūlena mātaraḥ sarvakāmadāḥ / ye rakṣanti śubhā gāś ca śivalokaṃ vrajanti te

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽर्चयन्ति शिवं भक्त्या सद्विधानैः समाहिताः । ते विन्दन्ति महाभोगान् पुरं यान्ति शिवस्य वै
verses.transliteration: ye 'rcayanti śivaṃ bhaktyā sadvidhānaiḥ samāhitāḥ / te vindanti mahābhogān puraṃ yānti śivasya vai
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: ये शिवाश्रयतीर्थानि श्रद्धया यान्ति मानवाः । कल्पगां च विशेषेण शैलं चामरकण्टकम्
verses.transliteration: ye śivāśrayatīrthāni śraddhayā yānti mānavāḥ / kalpagāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa śailaṃ cāmarakaṇṭakam

verses.sanskrit: ते क्रीडन्ति महाभोगैर् ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवालये । पयो ऽमृतं घृतं क्षीरं मधुदध्यादिकं तु यत्
verses.transliteration: te krīḍanti mahābhogair brahmaviṣṇuśivālaye / payo 'mṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ madhudadhyādikaṃ tu yat

verses.sanskrit: न पश्यति महाभाग कल्पगायां विमोहितः । एतत्ते कथितं राजन् रेवावतरणं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: na paśyati mahābhāga kalpagāyāṃ vimohitaḥ / etatte kathitaṃ rājan revāvataraṇaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: अस्याख्यानेन भगवान् ।# प्रीयतां मे शिवः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: asyākhyānena bhagavān /# prīyatāṃ me śivaḥ svayam
verses.translation: Thus the full details regarding Sulabheda have been recounted to you as heard earlier from Sankara in the assem- bly of sages and Devas.

verses.sanskrit: # इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे शिवलोकवर्णनो नामाष्टपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ५९ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: दानधर्मविधानं च श्रोतुम् इच्छामि कल्पग । दरिद्रा भिक्षवो वापि कथं यान्ति शिवालयम्
verses.transliteration: # iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe śivalokavarṇano nāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 59 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: dānadharmavidhānaṃ ca śrotum icchāmi kalpaga / daridrā bhikṣavo vāpi kathaṃ yānti śivālayam
verses.translation: Thereafter, a person should go to PuskarinI that is destructive of all sins. When its power is listened to, one is rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, a person should go to PuskarinI that is destructive of all sins. When its power is listened to, one is rid of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, a person should go to PuskarinI that is destructive of all sins. When its power is listened to, one is rid of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: विधिना केन दानेन मुच्यते दुष्कृतं तथा । लोकानां च हितार्थाय कथयस्व महामुने
verses.transliteration: vidhinā kena dānena mucyate duṣkṛtaṃ tathā / lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya kathayasva mahāmune
verses.translation: If a person performs Sraddha there with milk-pud- ding, honey and ghee, the performer of Sraddha attains heaven. Everything given to the Pitrs shall be everlasting.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu rājan yathā nyāyaṃ kathayāmi tavānagha / puṣkaraṃ bilvapatraṃ ca kuśāstoyaṃ ca nārmadam

verses.transliteration: punaś ca kṣitimāsādya siṃhāsanapatir bhavet / tṛṇavalkalaparṇāni śayyā prāvaraṇādikam

verses.transliteration: apy ekadivasaṃ yāvac chivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ / śivadharmaparas tasya dharmasyānto na vidyate

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: If a person performs Sraddha there with milk-pud- ding, honey and ghee, the performer of Sraddha attains heaven. Everything given to the Pitrs shall be everlasting.

verses.sanskrit: योगधर्मसु सारत्वादभेद्यं पापमुद्गरैः । वज्रतण्डुलवज् ज्ञेयं तस्मात् तस्य फलं महत्
verses.transliteration: yogadharmasu sāratvādabhedyaṃ pāpamudgaraiḥ / vajrataṇḍulavaj jñeyaṃ tasmāt tasya phalaṃ mahat

verses.sanskrit: देहान्तेनैव धर्मेण स्थानमाद्यं शिवालयम् । यत्रास्ते विपुलैर् भोगैः क्रीडन् कल्पायुतं नरः
verses.transliteration: dehāntenaiva dharmeṇa sthānamādyaṃ śivālayam / yatrāste vipulair bhogaiḥ krīḍan kalpāyutaṃ naraḥ

verses.sanskrit: ततः कल्पायुतस्यान्ते स्थानं कौमारम् आप्नुयात् । तत्रार्धसम्मितं कालं स क्रीडन् ससुखं वसेत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kalpāyutasyānte sthānaṃ kaumāram āpnuyāt / tatrārdhasammitaṃ kālaṃ sa krīḍan sasukhaṃ vaset
verses.translation: If a person performs Sraddha there with milk-pud- ding, honey and ghee, the performer of Sraddha attains heaven. Everything given to the Pitrs shall be everlasting.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तदन्ते विष्णुलोकं च संप्राप्य वसते पुनः । ब्रह्मलोकं गतश् चान्ते तत्रापि वसते नरः
verses.transliteration: tadante viṣṇulokaṃ ca saṃprāpya vasate punaḥ / brahmalokaṃ gataś cānte tatrāpi vasate naraḥ
verses.translation: If a person performs Sraddha there with milk-pud- ding, honey and ghee, the performer of Sraddha attains heaven. Everything given to the Pitrs shall be everlasting.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मलोकपरिभ्रष्टो वसेच् छिवपुरे सुखम् । तत् तस्माद् ब्रह्मविष्ण्वाद्यांल् लोकान् प्राप्नोत्य् अनुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: brahmalokaparibhraṣṭo vasec chivapure sukham / tat tasmād brahmaviṣṇvādyāṃl lokān prāpnoty anukramāt
verses.translation: If a person performs Sraddha there with milk-pud- ding, honey and ghee, the performer of Sraddha attains heaven. Everything given to the Pitrs shall be everlasting.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: If a person performs Sraddha there with milk-pud- ding, honey and ghee, the performer of Sraddha attains heaven. Everything given to the Pitrs shall be everlasting.

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवं सर्वलोकेषु रमित्वा क्रमशस् ततः । मनुष्यलोकम् आसाद्य शिवं रेवां समाश्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: ity evaṃ sarvalokeṣu ramitvā kramaśas tataḥ / manuṣyalokam āsādya śivaṃ revāṃ samāśrayet
verses.translation: If a person performs Sraddha there with milk-pud- ding, honey and ghee, the performer of Sraddha attains heaven. Everything given to the Pitrs shall be everlasting.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मया ते कथिता ऽन्यत्र यानि दानानि भारत । तानि सर्वे प्रशंसन्ति पर्वते ऽमरकण्टके
verses.transliteration: mayā te kathitā 'nyatra yāni dānāni bhārata / tāni sarve praśaṃsanti parvate 'marakaṇṭake
verses.translation: If a person performs Sraddha there with milk-pud- ding, honey and ghee, the performer of Sraddha attains heaven. Everything given to the Pitrs shall be everlasting.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: If a person performs Sraddha there with milk-pud- ding, honey and ghee, the performer of Sraddha attains heaven. Everything given to the Pitrs shall be everlasting.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person performs Sraddha there with milk-pud- ding, honey and ghee, the performer of Sraddha attains heaven. Everything given to the Pitrs shall be everlasting.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये शिवमहिमानुवर्णनो नामैकोनषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ६० मार्कण्डेय उवाच: वैष्णवं दानधर्मं च कथ्यमानं निबोध मे । विष्णुयोगं समभ्यस्य सर्वक्लेशापनुत्तये
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye śivamahimānuvarṇano nāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 60 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: vaiṣṇavaṃ dānadharmaṃ ca kathyamānaṃ nibodha me / viṣṇuyogaṃ samabhyasya sarvakleśāpanuttaye
verses.translation: I shall further describe (the greatness of) the excel- lent Adityesvara which is destructive of all miseries and all obstacles, O son of Prtha. The Tirtha is always conducive to longevity, increase in glory and prosperity. It grants sons, welfare and heavenly pleasures.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: I shall further describe (the greatness of) the excel- lent Adityesvara which is destructive of all miseries and all obstacles, O son of Prtha. The Tirtha is always conducive to longevity, increase in glory and prosperity. It grants sons, welfare and heavenly pleasures.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall further describe (the greatness of) the excel- lent Adityesvara which is destructive of all miseries and all obstacles, O son of Prtha. The Tirtha is always conducive to longevity, increase in glory and prosperity. It grants sons, welfare and heavenly pleasures.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुं सम्पूज्य विधिना घृतस्नानादिभिः स्तवैः । द्वादश्यां विष्णुम् उद्दिश्य दद्याद् एकां पयस्विनीम्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuṃ sampūjya vidhinā ghṛtasnānādibhiḥ stavaiḥ / dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇum uddiśya dadyād ekāṃ payasvinīm
verses.translation: I shall recount it to you. Listen to it with caution. BrShmagas oppressed by famine resorted to Narmada. They were: Uddllaka, Vasiftha, Mandavya, Gautama, Yajftavalkya, Garga, &n<Jilya, Galava, Naciketa, Vibhanija, Valakhilyas and others, &itatapa, Sankha,Jaimini, Gobhila,Jaigi$avya, Satanika. All those came there.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount it to you. Listen to it with caution. BrShmagas oppressed by famine resorted to Narmada. They were: Uddllaka, Vasiftha, Mandavya, Gautama, Yajftavalkya, Garga, &n<Jilya, Galava, Naciketa, Vibhanija, Valakhilyas and others, &itatapa, Sankha,Jaimini,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount it to you. Listen to it with caution. BrShmagas oppressed by famine resorted to Narmada. They were: Uddllaka, Vasiftha, Mandavya, Gautama, Yajftavalkya, Garga, &n<Jilya, Galava, Naciketa, Vibhanija, Valakhilyas and others, &itatapa, Sankha,Jaimini,…

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातीरम् आसाद्य तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु । पूज्यते धर्मराजेन यथा विष्णुस् तथैव सः
verses.transliteration: narmadātīram āsādya tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / pūjyate dharmarājena yathā viṣṇus tathaiva saḥ
verses.translation: At the end of the forest, they saw women of red complexion wearing red garments. They had smeared them- selves with red sandalpaste and worn red-coloured ornaments. They were holding nooses in their hands and were terrifying (to look at). Near them were men resembling black clouds. Their faces (mouths) were large and they had huge bodies. They had nooses in their hands and they could be compared to Anavrsti (Drought). They had tawny-coloured eyes.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of the forest, they saw women of red complexion wearing red garments. They had smeared them- selves with red sandalpaste and worn red-coloured ornaments. They were holding nooses in their hands and were terrifying (to look at).…
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the forest, they saw women of red complexion wearing red garments. They had smeared them- selves with red sandalpaste and worn red-coloured ornaments. They were holding nooses in their hands and were terrifying (to look at).…

verses.sanskrit: शैवानां वैष्णवानां च सहस्रम् भोजयेत् तु यः । गर्भिणी धेनुसंमिश्रं वृषभैर् दशभिर्युतम्
verses.transliteration: śaivānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca sahasram bhojayet tu yaḥ / garbhiṇī dhenusaṃmiśraṃ vṛṣabhair daśabhiryutam
verses.translation: Then some of the others began to eulogize: "Be victorious, O divine one, (we make) obeisance to you. Obei- sance to you, O (river) resorted to by groups of Siddhas. Obeisance to you, the most auspicious and sacred one among all. Obei- sance to you, the most excellent one issuing forth from the person of Rudra.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Then some of the others began to eulogize: "Be victorious, O divine one, (we make) obeisance to you. Obei- sance to you, O (river) resorted to by groups of Siddhas. Obeisance to you, the most auspicious and sacred one among all. Obei- sance to you,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then some of the others began to eulogize: "Be victorious, O divine one, (we make) obeisance to you. Obei- sance to you, O (river) resorted to by groups of Siddhas. Obeisance to you, the most auspicious and sacred one among all. Obei- sance to you,…

verses.sanskrit: अर्चितं गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर् हेमवस्त्रैर् अलंकृतम् । प्रदक्षिणम् उपाक्रम्य मन्त्रराजं च भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: arcitaṃ gandhapuṣpādyair hemavastrair alaṃkṛtam / pradakṣiṇam upākramya mantrarājaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: O king, those who read and listen to this prayer with great devotion and mental calmness, attain Rudra by means of a vehicle yoked with a bull. Their limbs will be embellished with divine garments.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, those who read and listen to this prayer with great devotion and mental calmness, attain Rudra by means of a vehicle yoked with a bull. Their limbs will be embellished with divine garments.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, those who read and listen to this prayer with great devotion and mental calmness, attain Rudra by means of a vehicle yoked with a bull. Their limbs will be embellished with divine garments.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवयेति समुच्चरन् । वेदविद्भिः समाकीर्णं विष्णोर् आराधनैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevayeti samuccaran / vedavidbhiḥ samākīrṇaṃ viṣṇor ārādhanaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: At the end of the forest was a pair of women extremely
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of the forest was a pair of women extremely
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the forest was a pair of women extremely

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातोयम् आसाद्य दीपमालां प्रबोधयेत् । गावो ममाग्रतो नित्यं गावः पृष्ठत एव च
verses.transliteration: narmadātoyam āsādya dīpamālāṃ prabodhayet / gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāvaḥ pṛṣṭhata eva ca
verses.translation: Nowhere can sins gain access here. All those sin- ners thought after consulting one another. Citrabhanu (Sun) was remembered by them after thinking about Hari in the heart After taking the holy plunge in the auspicious waters of Reva, the Pitrs and deities were propitiated by them. After meditating on Lord Janardana in the heart and bowing to Lord Bhaskara (Sun-god) they circumambulated the blazing
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Nowhere can sins gain access here. All those sin- ners thought after consulting one another. Citrabhanu (Sun) was remembered by them after thinking about Hari in the heart After taking the holy plunge in the auspicious waters of Reva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Nowhere can sins gain access here. All those sin- ners thought after consulting one another. Citrabhanu (Sun) was remembered by them after thinking about Hari in the heart After taking the holy plunge in the auspicious waters of Reva,…

verses.sanskrit: गावो मे हृदये वापि गवां मध्ये वसाम्य् अहम् । इमं मन्त्रं समुत्थाय जपेद् आसां पुरो गवाम्
verses.transliteration: gāvo me hṛdaye vāpi gavāṃ madhye vasāmy aham / imaṃ mantraṃ samutthāya japed āsāṃ puro gavām
verses.translation: Whether it is a village or a forest, Narmada is aus- picious and meritorious everywhere. Especially at Ravi Tirtha Reva is the bestower of meritorious benefits.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Whether it is a village or a forest, Narmada is aus- picious and meritorious everywhere. Especially at Ravi Tirtha Reva is the bestower of meritorious benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whether it is a village or a forest, Narmada is aus- picious and meritorious everywhere. Especially at Ravi Tirtha Reva is the bestower of meritorious benefits.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धतो याक्षतैर् मिश्रैर् गृहीत्वा ताम्रभाजनम् । शृङ्गपुच्छ जलस्नातः शुक्लवस्त्रसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: gandhato yākṣatair miśrair gṛhītvā tāmrabhājanam / śṛṅgapuccha jalasnātaḥ śuklavastrasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: Enemy becomes friend; poison becomes Amrta. The Planets become highly pleased and the Sun becomes pleased.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Enemy becomes friend; poison becomes Amrta. The Planets become highly pleased and the Sun becomes pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: Enemy becomes friend; poison becomes Amrta. The Planets become highly pleased and the Sun becomes pleased.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदास्नानपानेन गवां पुच्छाम्भसा तथा । सर्वकल्मषनिर्मुक्तः सुसिद्धः सुचिरव्रतः

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये षष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ६१ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: श्रुत्वा नानाविधान् धर्मास्त्वत्प्रसादान् महामुने । नाहं तृप्तिं तु गच्छामि नर्मदाख्यानकीर्तनात्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye ṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 61 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: śrutvā nānāvidhān dharmāstvatprasādān mahāmune / nāhaṃ tṛptiṃ tu gacchāmi narmadākhyānakīrtanāt
verses.translation: Thereafter one should go to the well-known merito- rious Sakratirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरश्रेष्ठ श्राद्धं कार्यं विधानतः । स्वागतेन यमः प्रीतश् चासनेन शतक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: asmiṃstīrthe naraśreṣṭha śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ vidhānataḥ / svāgatena yamaḥ prītaś cāsanena śatakratuḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter one should go to the well-known merito- rious Sakratirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter one should go to the well-known merito- rious Sakratirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter one should go to the well-known merito- rious Sakratirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.transliteration: pitaraḥ pādaśaucena atrādyena prajāpatiḥ / viprapādodakaklinnā yāvat tiṣṭhati medinī

verses.transliteration: tathā paramahaṃsāya viṣṇuvratadharāya ca / sarvopaskaraṇaṃ dattvā śivaloke mahīyate

verses.sanskrit: अर्धार्धं सफलं तस्य यावज् जीवं न संशयः । विष्णुलोके ऽन्तकाले च भोगान् भुङ्क्ते च पुष्कलान्

verses.sanskrit: स्वद्रव्येण च यो यज्ञं करोति विधिवद् द्विजः । नर्मदातीरम् आसाद्य ब्रह्मलोके स मोदते
verses.transliteration: svadravyeṇa ca yo yajñaṃ karoti vidhivad dvijaḥ / narmadātīram āsādya brahmaloke sa modate
verses.translation: Thereafter one should go to the well-known merito- rious Sakratirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: धात्रीं हिरण्मयीं कृत्वा ब्राह्मणाय प्रकल्पयेत् । कल्पगा तीरम् आश्रित्य विष्णुलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: dhātrīṃ hiraṇmayīṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāya prakalpayet / kalpagā tīram āśritya viṣṇuloke mahīyate

verses.sanskrit: तिलतण्डुलकर्पूरसुसम्भोज्यविमिश्रितैः । कुङ्कुमैर् वस्त्रधान्यैश् च निर्मितं शिवसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: tilataṇḍulakarpūrasusambhojyavimiśritaiḥ / kuṅkumair vastradhānyaiś ca nirmitaṃ śivasannidhau

verses.sanskrit: पर्वकाले च यो दद्यात् पर्वते मेकलातटे । वसेत् विष्णुलोकेषु नरः स्वर्गे न संशयः
verses.transliteration: parvakāle ca yo dadyāt parvate mekalātaṭe / vaset viṣṇulokeṣu naraḥ svarge na saṃśayaḥ

verses.sanskrit: रेवाकपिलयोर् योगे दत्त्वैतान् नरसत्तमः । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो लोके क्रीडति वैष्णवे

verses.transliteration: yadi tatra mahārāja bhikṣānnaṃ ca niveditam / tasya saṃkhyā na vidyeta sa yāvat saṃgamo nṛpa

verses.transliteration: vanaṃ meghavanaṃ nāma yajñaparvatam āśritam / rantidevaḥ purā tatra cakravartī yudhiṣṭhira

verses.transliteration: gavi nītaṃ kulaṃ yena sa devāsuramānuṣam / pitaro mocitā yena gobhir vinihatāḥ purā
verses.translation: Thereafter one should go to the well-known merito- rious Sakratirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.transliteration: cāṇḍālaiś ca hatā ye ca prāpnuvanti parāṃ gatim / cāṇḍālād udakāt sarpād vidyuto brāhmaṇād api

verses.transliteration: astragrāmas tataḥ prāpto lokapālair yathā tathā / gonardaṃ nāma nagaraṃ tat tu lokeṣu viśrutam

verses.transliteration: govidyutpaśucāṇḍālasarpairvinihatā narāḥ / devalokaṃ na te yānti na teṣāmudakakriyā

verses.transliteration: śocayitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ sāntaḥpuraparigrahaḥ / prakṣālya narmadātoye tadasthīni vyasarjayat

verses.sanskrit: पप्रच्छ मुनिशार्दूलान् वशिष्ठप्रमुखान् द्विजान् । त्रिःप्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य यथा न्यायम् इदं वचः
verses.transliteration: papraccha muniśārdūlān vaśiṣṭhapramukhān dvijān / triḥpradakṣiṇam āvṛtya yathā nyāyam idaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter one should go to the well-known merito- rious Sakratirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: के देशाः पर्वताः पुण्या नद्यः काः कीर्तिताः शुभाः । नरकस्थान् पितॄन् यत्र तद्वदेयुः समुद्धरेत्
verses.transliteration: ke deśāḥ parvatāḥ puṇyā nadyaḥ kāḥ kīrtitāḥ śubhāḥ / narakasthān pitṝn yatra tadvadeyuḥ samuddharet
verses.translation: Thereafter one should go to the well-known merito- rious Sakratirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयं च पितृश्राद्धं पितॄणाम् अक्षया गतिः । ऋषय ऊचुः: मार्कण्डेयाश्रमं गच्छ अस्माभिः सह भूपते
verses.transliteration: akṣayaṃ ca pitṛśrāddhaṃ pitṝṇām akṣayā gatiḥ / ṛṣaya ūcuḥ: mārkaṇḍeyāśramaṃ gaccha asmābhiḥ saha bhūpate
verses.translation: Thereafter one should go to the well-known merito- rious Sakratirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि सर्वं विजानीयात् कल्पगा तीरमाश्रितः । तच् छ्रुत्वा रन्तिदेवो ऽपि मुनिभिः परिभाषितः
verses.transliteration: so 'pi sarvaṃ vijānīyāt kalpagā tīramāśritaḥ / tac chrutvā rantidevo 'pi munibhiḥ paribhāṣitaḥ

verses.transliteration: jagāma munibhiḥ sārddhaṃ kalpagātīravāsinam / sa rājā brāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ praṇipatya tathā 'rcayat

verses.transliteration: samutthāyābravīd vākyam upaviṣṭaḥ kuśāsane / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: kān na mocayate ghorān pitṝn saṃsārasāgarāt

verses.transliteration: śṛṇvantu mama vākyāni munayo viditātmanaḥ / sarvatīrthamayī revā sarvārthātmamayī śubhā

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter one should go to the well-known merito- rious Sakratirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.transliteration: tatra snātā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ / tatra śrāddhena yogena pitṝṇāṃ paramā gatiḥ

verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter one should go to the well-known merito- rious Sakratirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.transliteration: śaptāstenaiva doṣeṇa kuberapuravāsinaḥ / sarve te siddhim āpannāḥ kubjārevāsamāgame

verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe rantidevopākhyānaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 62 rantideva uvāca: yathā śaptās tu tāḥ kanyās tāsāṃ nāmāni kalpaga / śrotum icchāmi tattvena keṣu sthāneṣu pūjitā
verses.translation: Then, one should go to the excellent Tlrtha named Karodisvara, O great king. O dear one, it was there that Danavas along with their followers were killed by the delighted Devas led by Indra who always thought of victory. The Danavas were killed in battle by the infuriated groups of Devas. Remember- ing again and again the previous enmity, sons and grandsons (of Danavas) too were killed.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

He will re- member the TIrtha once again, O excellent king, will go to that TIrtha, worship Kanxjksvara and attain the greatest goal.

verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe viṣṇukīrtanaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 65 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadāyāmyabhāge tu tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / māṇḍavyasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ siddhagandharvasevitam
verses.translation: Fools have no happiness. Patients have no happi- ness. One who is not free has no happiness. Particularly a hen- pecked husband (dependent on another i.e. wife) has no happiness. O Visnu, urged by a woman a boon has been granted to the Danava by me: "If you place your hand on anyone's head he will be reduced to a heap of ashes." Told thus by me he has become invincible and immortal, O Kesava. The sinner wishes to kill me. Have you any means of remedy?
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: अशोकवनिकां राजन् छृणु साम्प्रतमुत्तमम् । तत्र सन्निहितो देव उमया सहितो हरः
verses.transliteration: aśokavanikāṃ rājan chṛṇu sāmpratamuttamam / tatra sannihito deva umayā sahito haraḥ
verses.translation: A cool breeze blew gently over the splendid forest. Sweet fragrance was wafted by wind and it tickled the sense of smell of the Danava.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: आविष्टश् चाश्रमे तत्र विशोको विमलः शिवः । विशोकया सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा नर्मदा यत्र सङ्गता
verses.transliteration: āviṣṭaś cāśrame tatra viśoko vimalaḥ śivaḥ / viśokayā saricchreṣṭhā narmadā yatra saṅgatā
verses.translation: O lady of splendid eyes, if you are not going to act independently, if you do not wish me (to be your husband), it will end in my death today. It is true.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नाता दिवं यान्ति ये मृता न पुनर्भवाः । अशोकेश्वरलिङ्गम् च प्रत्यक्षं सिद्धिशङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ / aśokeśvaraliṅgam ca pratyakṣaṃ siddhiśaṅkaram

verses.sanskrit: राहुसूर्यसमायोगे रविश्चन्द्रो नृपोत्तमः । सप्तकल्पवहा यत्र शैलश्चामरकण्टकः
verses.transliteration: rāhusūryasamāyoge raviścandro nṛpottamaḥ / saptakalpavahā yatra śailaścāmarakaṇṭakaḥ

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये पञ्चषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ६६ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: एवं श्रुतं पुरा राज्ञा रविश्चन्द्रेण धीमता । उवाच वचनं श्रीमानगस्त्यो मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye pañcaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 66 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: evaṃ śrutaṃ purā rājñā raviścandreṇa dhīmatā / uvāca vacanaṃ śrīmānagastyo munisattama
verses.translation: Then, O great king, a person should go to the excel- lent Matrtirtha. It is situated on the southern bank of Narmada very near the confluence.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: अशोकवनिकायां तु कीर्तितानि तवानघ । श्रवणात् कीर्तनात् तेषां गोसहस्रफलं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: aśokavanikāyāṃ tu kīrtitāni tavānagha / śravaṇāt kīrtanāt teṣāṃ gosahasraphalaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Then, O great king, a person should go to the excel- lent Matrtirtha. It is situated on the southern bank of Narmada very near the confluence.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे ऽशोकवनिकावर्णनो नाम षट्षष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ६७ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अथातः कथयिष्यामि तीर्थं पापप्रणाशनम् । रेवाया उत्तरे कूले पुरं वागीश्वराभिधम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe 'śokavanikāvarṇano nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 67 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: athātaḥ kathayiṣyāmi tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / revāyā uttare kūle puraṃ vāgīśvarābhidham
verses.translation: The Tirtha well-known as Luhkesvara is situated in the middle of water beyond (the previous Tirtha). It is bowed to by Suras and Asuras.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Tirtha well-known as Luhkesvara is situated in the middle of water beyond (the previous Tirtha). It is bowed to by Suras and Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tirtha well-known as Luhkesvara is situated in the middle of water beyond (the previous Tirtha). It is bowed to by Suras and Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: वागुर्नाम नदी तत्र रेवया सह संगता । तत्र स्नाता दिवं यान्ति ये मृता न पुनर्भवाः
verses.transliteration: vāgurnāma nadī tatra revayā saha saṃgatā / tatra snātā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ
verses.translation: It is stated in scriptures that when a husband requested (for something) by the wife speaks of various causes (pleads excuses) that woman becomes humiliated. "If you do not honour me (my request), I shall commit suicide."
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: It is stated in scriptures that when a husband requested (for something) by the wife speaks of various causes (pleads excuses) that woman becomes humiliated. "If you do not honour me (my request), I shall commit suicide."
verses.commentary: Sense: It is stated in scriptures that when a husband requested (for something) by the wife speaks of various causes (pleads excuses) that woman becomes humiliated. "If you do not honour me (my request), I shall commit suicide."

verses.sanskrit: वागीशा तत्र चामुण्डा दानवक्षयकारिणी । मणिभद्रो वीरभद्रस् तथा ऽन्ये शतशो नृपाः
verses.transliteration: vāgīśā tatra cāmuṇḍā dānavakṣayakāriṇī / maṇibhadro vīrabhadras tathā 'nye śataśo nṛpāḥ
verses.translation: Do request for whatever has been desired by you, O devotee of good Vratas. I am pleased with you.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Do request for whatever has been desired by you, O devotee of good Vratas. I am pleased with you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Do request for whatever has been desired by you, O devotee of good Vratas. I am pleased with you.

verses.sanskrit: बभूवुर् मुक्तशापास् ते तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः । तिलपिण्डप्रदानेन पितॄणां परमा गतिः
verses.transliteration: babhūvur muktaśāpās te tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ / tilapiṇḍapradānena pitṝṇāṃ paramā gatiḥ
verses.translation: This story seems to be a special contribution of Reva Khanda. As PE 127A f notes, it is not traced in any other Purina.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: This story seems to be a special contribution of Reva Khanda. As PE 127A f notes, it is not traced in any other Purina.
verses.commentary: Sense: This story seems to be a special contribution of Reva Khanda. As PE 127A f notes, it is not traced in any other Purina.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मदत्तश्चक्रवर्ती सूर्यवंशे महीपतिः । अयोध्याधिपतिः श्रीमान् चक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: brahmadattaścakravartī sūryavaṃśe mahīpatiḥ / ayodhyādhipatiḥ śrīmān cakratulyaparākramaḥ
verses.translation: Accompanied by Uma, the Lord went in the south- ern direction. Extremely frightened, he turned his neck fre- quently to look back (to see how far he followed). When the Lord vanished from the scene, the Daitya fought with the bull. Both of them were very powerful, the most excellent ones among the mighty. They fought each other for three Ghatikas, striking each other with thunderbolt-like hits and the Daitya could not get the chance to touch the head of the bull with the hands.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by Uma, the Lord went in the south- ern direction. Extremely frightened, he turned his neck fre- quently to look back (to see how far he followed). When the Lord vanished from the scene, the Daitya fought with the bull. Both of them were very powerful,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by Uma, the Lord went in the south- ern direction. Extremely frightened, he turned his neck fre- quently to look back (to see how far he followed). When the Lord vanished from the scene, the Daitya fought with the bull. Both of them were very powerful,…

verses.sanskrit: धनधान्यसमायुक्तो भयदारिद्र्यवर्जितः । प्रजास् तस्मिन् महीपाले सर्वा ऽपि मुदान्विताः
verses.transliteration: dhanadhānyasamāyukto bhayadāridryavarjitaḥ / prajās tasmin mahīpāle sarvā 'pi mudānvitāḥ
verses.translation: m O Narada, O most excellent one among sages, do you know where Kesava is? Go there and inform Kesava about this."
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: इष्टः क्रतुवरस्तेन नर्मदावागुसङ्गमे । ब्रह्माद्या देवताः सर्वाः शक्रविष्णुपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: iṣṭaḥ kratuvarastena narmadāvāgusaṅgame / brahmādyā devatāḥ sarvāḥ śakraviṣṇupurogamāḥ
verses.translation: Hurry up, Mahadeva; my good Lord, save yourself. No doubt, I shall go to the place where Lord Janardana is present.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hurry up, Mahadeva; my good Lord, save yourself. No doubt, I shall go to the place where Lord Janardana is present.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षश् च महेशानो गणेश्वरसमन्वितः । लोकपालाश् च मरुतश्चन्द्रादित्यौ ध्रुवस् तथा
verses.transliteration: pratyakṣaś ca maheśāno gaṇeśvarasamanvitaḥ / lokapālāś ca marutaścandrādityau dhruvas tathā
verses.translation: O Lord, this morning, is fruitful unto me, thanks to thy vision. The Devas have ceased to be in good condition and safe. Get up and proceed to them.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord, this morning, is fruitful unto me, thanks to thy vision. The Devas have ceased to be in good condition and safe. Get up and proceed to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord, this morning, is fruitful unto me, thanks to thy vision. The Devas have ceased to be in good condition and safe. Get up and proceed to them.

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षाणि योगसिद्धाश् च सोममुख्याश् च सर्वशः । वशिष्ठो मुनिभिः सार्द्धं विदेहाधिपतिस् तथा
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣāṇi yogasiddhāś ca somamukhyāś ca sarvaśaḥ / vaśiṣṭho munibhiḥ sārddhaṃ videhādhipatis tathā
verses.translation: Fools have no happiness. Patients have no happi- ness. One who is not free has no happiness. Particularly a hen- pecked husband (dependent on another i.e. wife) has no happiness. O Visnu, urged by a woman a boon has been granted to the Danava by me: "If you place your hand on anyone's head he will be reduced to a heap of ashes." Told thus by me he has become invincible and immortal, O Kesava. The sinner wishes to kill me. Have you any means of remedy?
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Fools have no happiness. Patients have no happi- ness. One who is not free has no happiness. Particularly a hen- pecked husband (dependent on another i.e. wife) has no happiness. O Visnu,…

verses.transliteration: evamādyāḥ samāhūtā mitrāvaruṇa eva ca / sarve hiraṇmayās tatra yajñayūpāś ca maṇḍapāḥ
verses.translation: He diverted himself very much along with the groups of Maruts. Thereafter Lord (Kr§na) employed his Maya in various ways. verses.sanskrit: दशयोजनपर्यन्तं यज्ञभूमिर् महीभृतः । स्वारोचिषे ऽन्तरे राजन्न् आदिकल्पे कृते युगे
verses.transliteration: daśayojanaparyantaṃ yajñabhūmir mahībhṛtaḥ / svārociṣe 'ntare rājann ādikalpe kṛte yuge
verses.translation: A cool breeze blew gently over the splendid forest. Sweet fragrance was wafted by wind and it tickled the sense of smell of the Danava.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: A cool breeze blew gently over the splendid forest. Sweet fragrance was wafted by wind and it tickled the sense of smell of the Danava.

verses.sanskrit: गवां शतसहस्राणि हेमभारान्वितानि च । हयानां श्यामकर्णानाम् अयुतं साग्रम् एव च
verses.transliteration: gavāṃ śatasahasrāṇi hemabhārānvitāni ca / hayānāṃ śyāmakarṇānām ayutaṃ sāgram eva ca
verses.translation: O lady of splendid eyes, if you are not going to act independently, if you do not wish me (to be your husband), it will end in my death today. It is true.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O lady of splendid eyes, if you are not going to act independently, if you do not wish me (to be your husband), it will end in my death today. It is true.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lady of splendid eyes, if you are not going to act independently, if you do not wish me (to be your husband), it will end in my death today. It is true.

verses.sanskrit: दन्तिनाम् अयुतं चैव घण्टाभरणभूषितम् । मणिमाणिक्यम् उक्ताश् च भक्ष्यभोज्यान्य् अनेकधा
verses.transliteration: dantinām ayutaṃ caiva ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitam / maṇimāṇikyam uktāś ca bhakṣyabhojyāny anekadhā
verses.translation: An auspicious shower of flowers was heaped upon Kesava by the Devas. Delighted and free from feverish mental anguish, all the Devas went to their respective abodes.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: An auspicious shower of flowers was heaped upon Kesava by the Devas. Delighted and free from feverish mental anguish, all the Devas went to their respective abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: An auspicious shower of flowers was heaped upon Kesava by the Devas. Delighted and free from feverish mental anguish, all the Devas went to their respective abodes.

verses.sanskrit: एवं राजा ब्रह्मदत्तः सर्वभूपालसत्तमः । यज्ञं प्रवर्तयामास सर्वसम्भारसंभृतः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ rājā brahmadattaḥ sarvabhūpālasattamaḥ / yajñaṃ pravartayāmāsa sarvasambhārasaṃbhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: An auspicious shower of flowers was heaped upon Kesava by the Devas. Delighted and free from feverish mental anguish, all the Devas went to their respective abodes.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: An auspicious shower of flowers was heaped upon Kesava by the Devas. Delighted and free from feverish mental anguish, all the Devas went to their respective abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: An auspicious shower of flowers was heaped upon Kesava by the Devas. Delighted and free from feverish mental anguish, all the Devas went to their respective abodes.

verses.sanskrit: वेदनिर्घोषशब्देन गीतवाद्यरवेण च । नानायानसमारूढैः स्तूयमानो मरुद्गणैः
verses.transliteration: vedanirghoṣaśabdena gītavādyaraveṇa ca / nānāyānasamārūḍhaiḥ stūyamāno marudgaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: An auspicious shower of flowers was heaped upon Kesava by the Devas. Delighted and free from feverish mental anguish, all the Devas went to their respective abodes.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: An auspicious shower of flowers was heaped upon Kesava by the Devas. Delighted and free from feverish mental anguish, all the Devas went to their respective abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: An auspicious shower of flowers was heaped upon Kesava by the Devas. Delighted and free from feverish mental anguish, all the Devas went to their respective abodes.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मदत्तस्य यज्ञेन वागीशस्य प्रसादतः । नर्मदायाः प्रसादेन प्रेतास् तृप्तिं परां गताः
verses.transliteration: brahmadattasya yajñena vāgīśasya prasādataḥ / narmadāyāḥ prasādena pretās tṛptiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: An auspicious shower of flowers was heaped upon Kesava by the Devas. Delighted and free from feverish mental anguish, all the Devas went to their respective abodes.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: An auspicious shower of flowers was heaped upon Kesava by the Devas. Delighted and free from feverish mental anguish, all the Devas went to their respective abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: An auspicious shower of flowers was heaped upon Kesava by the Devas. Delighted and free from feverish mental anguish, all the Devas went to their respective abodes.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कथं तु ब्रह्मदत्तस्य कल्पगातीरयाजनम् । कथं प्रेता विनिर्मुक्ताः प्रेतास् ते केन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ tu brahmadattasya kalpagātīrayājanam / kathaṃ pretā vinirmuktāḥ pretās te kena karmaṇā
verses.translation: An auspicious shower of flowers was heaped upon Kesava by the Devas. Delighted and free from feverish mental anguish, all the Devas went to their respective abodes.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe vāgīśvarākhyāna nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 68 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: pratigrahagrahagrastā lobhamohavimohitāḥ / majjanti narake ghore yatra gatvā na nirgatāḥ
verses.translation: Then one should go to the Tirtha of Dhanada, O Yudhisthira. It is on the southern bank of Narmada and it causes the destruction of all sins. There is no doubt about this that the benefit of all the Tlrthas is obtained there.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: āsaptamaṃ kulaṃ caiva punīte nā 'tra saṃśayaḥ / revāyā uttare kūle sahasrāyudhasaṃkhyayā

verses.transliteration: tataś cānte mahābhāga kārāyā vanam uttamam / agniṣṭomaphalaṃ yatra snātvā svargaṃ ca gacchati

verses.sanskrit: रेवाया उत्तरे भागे तीर्थ परमशोभनम् । सौगन्धिकं वनं नाम ब्रह्मचारिशुचिव्रताः
verses.transliteration: revāyā uttare bhāge tīrtha paramaśobhanam / saugandhikaṃ vanaṃ nāma brahmacāriśucivratāḥ

verses.sanskrit: सिषिचुः पितरस् तत् तु ब्रह्माद्याः सुतपोधनाः । सिद्धचारणगन्धर्वाः सकिन्नरमहोरगाः

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सप्तर्षयः प्राप्ताः स्नानार्थं भरतर्षभ । कपिञ्जलो मुनिश्रेष्ठो हव्यवाहश् च भारत
verses.transliteration: tatra saptarṣayaḥ prāptāḥ snānārthaṃ bharatarṣabha / kapiñjalo muniśreṣṭho havyavāhaś ca bhārata

verses.sanskrit: पितरः श्राद्धदानेन प्रयाता ब्रह्मणः पुरम् । उदुम्बरस्य कृत्वा तु विधिवद् दर्शनं ततः

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्याम् अभिगम्य वृषध्वजम् । लभते सर्वकामांश् च स्वर्गलोकं हि गच्छति

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदायाम्यभागे तु गोप्याद् गोप्यतर महत् । सिद्धलिङ्गं मणिमयं न तत्पश्यन्ति मानवाः

verses.sanskrit: नागेन्द्रसुरसिद्धैश् च नागकन्याभिर् अर्च्यते । सपादकोटिस्तीर्थानां शङ्करे कुरुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: nāgendrasurasiddhaiś ca nāgakanyābhir arcyate / sapādakoṭistīrthānāṃ śaṅkare kurunandana

verses.sanskrit: वसूनामाश्रमं पुण्यं मुनीनां ब्रह्मचारिणाम् । शिवभक्तिपराणांच कन्दमूलफलाशिनाम्

verses.transliteration: dhruvo dharaś ca somaś ca sāvitraś cānalo 'nilaḥ / pratyūṣaś ca prabhāsaś ca vasavo 'ṣṭau prakīrtitā

verses.sanskrit: कङ्कासुरनिहन्ता च मधुकैटभनाशनः । शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिर् वासुदेवो ऽस्तु मे गतिः

verses.sanskrit: हृषीकेशश् चेन्द्रपालोपेन्द्रो गरुडासनः । सहस्रनामा धर्मज्ञो वासुदेवो ऽस्तु मे गतिः

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खी च नन्दकी चक्री शार्ङ्गधन्वा गदाधरः । धीरो वपुष्मान् मेधावी वासुदेवो ऽस्तु मे गतिः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhī ca nandakī cakrī śārṅgadhanvā gadādharaḥ / dhīro vapuṣmān medhāvī vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ

verses.sanskrit: बृहत्संकर्षणः शम्भुः स्वयम्भूर् भूतभावनः । निपुणो लक्षणः शुद्धो वासुदेवो ऽस्तु मे गतिः

verses.sanskrit: त्रैकालिकस्त्रिकालज्ञस्त्रयी कर्ता त्रिलोचनः । त्रिसामा देवकीसूनुर् वासुदेवो ऽस्तु मे गतिः

verses.transliteration: viśvātmā viśvakartā ca viśvasya patirātmavān / dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ kartā ca vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ

verses.transliteration: sahasraśīrṣā bhagavān sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt / sahasrakoṭidhārī vā vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ

verses.transliteration: iti vāgīśvaro vāgmī pūjitaḥ parameśvaraḥ / bhaktasya bhagavān viṣṇuḥ prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ

verses.sanskrit: एष निष्कण्टकः पन्था यत्र सम्पूज्यते हरिः । कुपथं तं विजानीयाद् यत्र नाराध्यते हरिः
verses.transliteration: eṣa niṣkaṇṭakaḥ panthā yatra sampūjyate hariḥ / kupathaṃ taṃ vijānīyād yatra nārādhyate hariḥ

verses.sanskrit: वासुदेवपरा वेदा सुदेवपराक्रिया । वासुदेवात्मका विप्रा वासुदेवपराश्रयः
verses.transliteration: vāsudevaparā vedā sudevaparākriyā / vāsudevātmakā viprā vāsudevaparāśrayaḥ
verses.translation: Then one should go to the Tirtha of Dhanada, O Yudhisthira. It is on the southern bank of Narmada and it causes the destruction of all sins. There is no doubt about this that the benefit of all the Tlrthas is obtained there.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे देवा वासुदेवं यजन्ते सर्वे देवा वासुदेवात् प्रसूताः । सर्वेषां वा वासुदेवो ऽपि देवो नान्यत् किंचिद् अवासुदेवातिरिक्तम्
verses.transliteration: sarve devā vāsudevaṃ yajante sarve devā vāsudevāt prasūtāḥ / sarveṣāṃ vā vāsudevo 'pi devo nānyat kiṃcid avāsudevātiriktam

verses.sanskrit: नान्यः पुण्यतरो देवो नास्ति विष्णुपरं तपः । नास्ति विष्णुपरं ज्ञानं सर्वं विष्णुमयं जगत्
verses.transliteration: nānyaḥ puṇyataro devo nāsti viṣṇuparaṃ tapaḥ / nāsti viṣṇuparaṃ jñānaṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ jagat

verses.sanskrit: ये पठन्ति नरा भक्त्या विष्णुनामाङ्कितस्तवम् । ते यान्ति वैष्णवं लोकं परं ब्रह्म सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: ye paṭhanti narā bhaktyā viṣṇunāmāṅkitastavam / te yānti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam
verses.translation: Then one should go to the Tirtha of Dhanada, O Yudhisthira. It is on the southern bank of Narmada and it causes the destruction of all sins. There is no doubt about this that the benefit of all the Tlrthas is obtained there.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: श्रुत्वा स्तोत्रम् इदं देवो ब्रह्मणः समहात्मनः । श्रिया प्रबोधितः कृष्णः शयानो योगनिद्रया
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śrutvā stotram idaṃ devo brahmaṇaḥ samahātmanaḥ / śriyā prabodhitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śayāno yoganidrayā
verses.translation: Then one should go to the Tirtha of Dhanada, O Yudhisthira. It is on the southern bank of Narmada and it causes the destruction of all sins. There is no doubt about this that the benefit of all the Tlrthas is obtained there.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा ऽब्रवीत् सुरान् सर्वान् नानारूपान् भयानकान् । किमस्ति वः समुत्पन्नं मां दिदृक्षुर् इहागताः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā 'bravīt surān sarvān nānārūpān bhayānakān / kimasti vaḥ samutpannaṃ māṃ didṛkṣur ihāgatāḥ
verses.translation: Then one should go to the Tirtha of Dhanada, O Yudhisthira. It is on the southern bank of Narmada and it causes the destruction of all sins. There is no doubt about this that the benefit of all the Tlrthas is obtained there.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच वचनं ब्रह्मा केशवं प्रति भारत । त्वां विनात्र जगन्नाथ कस् त्राता देवकण्टकैः
verses.transliteration: uvāca vacanaṃ brahmā keśavaṃ prati bhārata / tvāṃ vinātra jagannātha kas trātā devakaṇṭakaiḥ
verses.translation: Then one should go to the Tirtha of Dhanada, O Yudhisthira. It is on the southern bank of Narmada and it causes the destruction of all sins. There is no doubt about this that the benefit of all the Tlrthas is obtained there.

verses.sanskrit: दानवैर् वेष्टिता धात्री स्वर्गश्चैव विनाशितः । धर्मकामादिका यज्ञा वेदा विप्लावितास् तथा
verses.transliteration: dānavair veṣṭitā dhātrī svargaścaiva vināśitaḥ / dharmakāmādikā yajñā vedā viplāvitās tathā

verses.sanskrit: दनुभारभराक्रान्ता रसातततलं गता । जटासुरश् च जाबालिर्दैत्यो मयसुतस् तथा
verses.transliteration: danubhārabharākrāntā rasātatatalaṃ gatā / jaṭāsuraś ca jābālirdaityo mayasutas tathā
verses.translation: Then one should go to the Tirtha of Dhanada, O Yudhisthira. It is on the southern bank of Narmada and it causes the destruction of all sins. There is no doubt about this that the benefit of all the Tlrthas is obtained there.

verses.sanskrit: दशकोट्यस् तु दैत्यानां समग्रबलशालिनाम् । शिवप्रसादयुक्तानां स्वर्गविप्लवकारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: daśakoṭyas tu daityānāṃ samagrabalaśālinām / śivaprasādayuktānāṃ svargaviplavakāriṇām

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् प्रवर्तितं चक्रमुद्धर स्ववसुन्धराम् । श्रुत्वा वाक्यम् इदं देवो भयार्तं प्राणपीडितम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt pravartitaṃ cakramuddhara svavasundharām / śrutvā vākyam idaṃ devo bhayārtaṃ prāṇapīḍitam

verses.sanskrit: उवाच वचनं देवो भयं त्यजत दैत्यजम् । अचिरेणैव कालेन हनिष्यामि महासुरान्
verses.transliteration: uvāca vacanaṃ devo bhayaṃ tyajata daityajam / acireṇaiva kālena haniṣyāmi mahāsurān
verses.translation: Then one should go to the Tirtha of Dhanada, O Yudhisthira. It is on the southern bank of Narmada and it causes the destruction of all sins. There is no doubt about this that the benefit of all the Tlrthas is obtained there.

verses.sanskrit: वाराहरूपमास्थाय प्रेषितं कल्पगाजले । दंष्ट्राग्रेण धृता धात्री दानवानां क्षयः कृतः
verses.transliteration: vārāharūpamāsthāya preṣitaṃ kalpagājale / daṃṣṭrāgreṇa dhṛtā dhātrī dānavānāṃ kṣayaḥ kṛtaḥ

verses.sanskrit: पुनः प्रवर्तिता सृष्टिर् यथापूर्वं तथैव च । ब्रह्माद्या मुदिता देवाः प्रतिजग्मुस् त्रिविष्टपम्
verses.transliteration: punaḥ pravartitā sṛṣṭir yathāpūrvaṃ tathaiva ca / brahmādyā muditā devāḥ pratijagmus triviṣṭapam
verses.translation: Then one should go to the Tirtha of Dhanada, O Yudhisthira. It is on the southern bank of Narmada and it causes the destruction of all sins. There is no doubt about this that the benefit of all the Tlrthas is obtained there.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् ते कथितं राजन् वाराहं कल्पगातटे । श्रवणात् कीर्तनाद् अस्य हयमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: etat te kathitaṃ rājan vārāhaṃ kalpagātaṭe / śravaṇāt kīrtanād asya hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे वाराहमहिमानुवर्णनो नामाष्टषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ६९ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो देवपथं तीर्थं सर्वदेवमयं शुभम् । तत्र स्नातश् च विधिवत् सर्वयज्ञफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe vārāhamahimānuvarṇano nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 69 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato devapathaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ śubham / tatra snātaś ca vidhivat sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Then one should go to the excellent Mahgalesvara installed by the Son of the Earth (i.e. Mars) with a desire for the welfare of all people.

verses.sanskrit: मासे मासे कुशाग्रेण सोमयागं करोति यः । स रेवाजलपूतस्य कलां नार्हति षोडशीम्

verses.translation: O excellent king, (he should observe) the Caturthi- angaraka-vrata, at the conclusion of which a cow along with bulls capable to carry the yoke is given to a Brahmana couple (man and wife). The Brahmana should be learned and a master of the Veda. The gift should be given with God Siva in view saying, "May Mahadeva, the bull-emblemed Lord, accompa- nied by his wife be pleased." O son of Pandu, gift of a pair of red clothes should be made. The bearers of yoke (bulls) may be red in colour, or white or black. An umbrella, auspicious bed, red garlands and unguents should be given with a pure heart, O excellent son of Pandu.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तानाम् अपि शक्ताय नमः शक्ततमाय च । शुद्धाय सर्वशुद्धाय सर्वशुद्ध्येकहेतवे

verses.translation: O excellent king, (he should observe) the Caturthi- angaraka-vrata, at the conclusion of which a cow along with bulls capable to carry the yoke is given to a Brahmana couple (man and wife). The Brahmana should be learned and a master of the Veda. The gift should be given with God Siva in view saying, "May Mahadeva, the bull-emblemed Lord, accompa- nied by his wife be pleased." O son of Pandu, gift of a pair of red clothes should be made. The bearers of yoke (bulls) may be red in colour, or white or black. An umbrella, auspicious bed, red garlands and unguents should be given with a pure heart, O excellent son of Pandu.

verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe śambhustutirnāmaikonasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 70 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kimarthaṃ saṃstuto devo brahmaṇā tena tatra vai / śuklatīrtham idaṃ kasmādāste yatra maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: There is a highly splendid Tirtha on the northern bank of Reva. It was inaugurated by Ravi. O son of KuntI, it causes the destruction of all sins.

verses.transliteration: ūcus te vacanaṃ devā rājānaṃ prati bhārata / tvayā samo 'tra rājarṣe na bhūto na bhaviṣyati

verses.transliteration: svaṃ svaṃ yānaṃ samārūḍhā yayur devās triviṣṭapam / mudā paramayā yuktaḥ stūyamāno nṛpottamaḥ

verses.sanskrit: र्क्स् अध्याय ७१ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: दीप्तकेश्वरदेवेशं सिद्धलिङ्गं प्रकीर्तितम् । नातः परतरं किंचित् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: rks adhyāya 71 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: dīptakeśvaradeveśaṃ siddhaliṅgaṃ prakīrtitam / nātaḥ parataraṃ kiṃcit triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: श्रीपतिः परमाद्यश् च द्वितीयश् च पितामहः । तृतीयो देवराजश् च चतुर्थः सूर्य एव च
verses.transliteration: śrīpatiḥ paramādyaś ca dvitīyaś ca pitāmahaḥ / tṛtīyo devarājaś ca caturthaḥ sūrya eva ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमः कथितः सोमः षष्ठो राहुः प्रकीर्तितः । सप्तमश् च शनिश् चैव त्वष्टमः केतुकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pañcamaḥ kathitaḥ somaḥ ṣaṣṭho rāhuḥ prakīrtitaḥ / saptamaś ca śaniś caiva tvaṣṭamaḥ ketukaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: वैश्वानरश् च नवमो दशमश् च दिगीश्वरः । एकादशो वैक्रमश् च द्वादशो वारुणस् तथा
verses.transliteration: vaiśvānaraś ca navamo daśamaś ca digīśvaraḥ / ekādaśo vaikramaś ca dvādaśo vāruṇas tathā

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोदशश् च वायुर् वै धनदश् च चतुर्दशः । नाना पदप्रकारेण स्तुतो देव उमापतिः
verses.transliteration: trayodaśaś ca vāyur vai dhanadaś ca caturdaśaḥ / nānā padaprakāreṇa stuto deva umāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुना देवनाथेन ब्रह्मणा च सुरासुरैः । स्थिरः स्थाणुः प्रभाभानुः प्रवरो वरदो वरः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇunā devanāthena brahmaṇā ca surāsuraiḥ / sthiraḥ sthāṇuḥ prabhābhānuḥ pravaro varado varaḥ

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्च हरिणाख्यश् च सर्वभूतहरः प्रभुः । प्रवृत्तिश् च निवृत्तिश् च नियमः शाश्वतो ध्रुवः
verses.transliteration: hariśca hariṇākhyaś ca sarvabhūtaharaḥ prabhuḥ / pravṛttiś ca nivṛttiś ca niyamaḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: श्मशानवासी भगवान् खेचरो गोचरस् तथा । अभिवन्द्यो महाकर्मा तपस्वी भूतभावनः
verses.transliteration: śmaśānavāsī bhagavān khecaro gocaras tathā / abhivandyo mahākarmā tapasvī bhūtabhāvanaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: उन्मत्तवेषप्रच्छन्नः सर्वलोकप्रजापतिः । महारूपो महाकायः सर्वलोकप्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: unmattaveṣapracchannaḥ sarvalokaprajāpatiḥ / mahārūpo mahākāyaḥ sarvalokaprajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: परात्मा सर्वभूतानां विरूपो वामनो मनुः । लोकपालो पिहितात्मा प्रसन्नो भवनाशनः
verses.transliteration: parātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ virūpo vāmano manuḥ / lokapālo pihitātmā prasanno bhavanāśanaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तश् च महाङ्गश् च निचयो नियताश्रयः । सर्वकामः स्वयम्भूश् च आदिनादिकरो निधिः
verses.transliteration: pravṛttaś ca mahāṅgaś ca nicayo niyatāśrayaḥ / sarvakāmaḥ svayambhūś ca ādinādikaro nidhiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राक्षो विरूपाक्षः सोमो नक्षत्रसाधकः । चन्द्रः सूर्यः शनिः केतुर्ग्रहो ग्रहपतिर्वरः
verses.transliteration: sahasrākṣo virūpākṣaḥ somo nakṣatrasādhakaḥ / candraḥ sūryaḥ śaniḥ keturgraho grahapatirvaraḥ

verses.sanskrit: तपोद्रष्टा बलः स्थातुर् मृगबाणार्पणो ऽनघः । महातपा दीर्घतपा आदिर्दीनानुकम्पनः
verses.transliteration: tapodraṣṭā balaḥ sthātur mṛgabāṇārpaṇo 'naghaḥ / mahātapā dīrghatapā ādirdīnānukampanaḥ

verses.sanskrit: सवत्सरकरो मन्त्रः प्रमाणं परमं तपः । योगी योगमहावीर्यो महारेता हरो हरः
verses.transliteration: savatsarakaro mantraḥ pramāṇaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ / yogī yogamahāvīryo mahāretā haro haraḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: महाचेताश् च सर्वज्ञः सबीजो ऽपहरो हरः । कमण्डलुधरो धन्वी प्राणहस्तः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: mahācetāś ca sarvajñaḥ sabījo 'paharo haraḥ / kamaṇḍaludharo dhanvī prāṇahastaḥ pratāpavān

verses.sanskrit: अंशो ऽनीशस् तथा शूली खट्वाङ्गी पट्टिशी तथा । शुचिश् च शुचिरूपश्च तेजस्तेजस्करो निधिः
verses.transliteration: aṃśo 'nīśas tathā śūlī khaṭvāṅgī paṭṭiśī tathā / śuciś ca śucirūpaśca tejastejaskaro nidhiḥ

verses.sanskrit: उष्णीषी च सुवक्त्राश्च उदक्यो वितनस् तथा । हरिश् च हरिनेत्रश् च सुतीर्थः कृष्ण एव च
verses.transliteration: uṣṇīṣī ca suvaktrāśca udakyo vitanas tathā / hariś ca harinetraś ca sutīrthaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca

verses.sanskrit: शृगालरूपी सर्वार्थः शुण्डीशुद्धः कमण्डलुः । अजश् च गन्धमाली च मृगरूपी कपालभृत्
verses.transliteration: śṛgālarūpī sarvārthaḥ śuṇḍīśuddhaḥ kamaṇḍaluḥ / ajaś ca gandhamālī ca mṛgarūpī kapālabhṛt

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वरेता ऊर्ध्वसाक्षी ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्नभः स्थलः । त्रिजटी च निवासश् च रुद्रः सेनापतिर्विभुः
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvaretā ūrdhvasākṣī ūrdhvabāhurnabhaḥ sthalaḥ / trijaṭī ca nivāsaś ca rudraḥ senāpatirvibhuḥ

verses.sanskrit: अहश् चरो रात्रिचरः सुवासश्च दिशाम्पतिः । राजहा दैत्यहा चैव धातारूपगुणात्मकः
verses.transliteration: ahaś caro rātricaraḥ suvāsaśca diśāmpatiḥ / rājahā daityahā caiva dhātārūpaguṇātmakaḥ

verses.sanskrit: सिंहशार्दूलरूपश् च आर्द्रचर्मधरो हरः । कालयोगी महानादः सर्ववासश्चतुष्पथः
verses.transliteration: siṃhaśārdūlarūpaś ca ārdracarmadharo haraḥ / kālayogī mahānādaḥ sarvavāsaścatuṣpathaḥ

verses.sanskrit: दुर्वारप्रेतचारी च भूतचारी महेश्वरः । बहुभूतो बहुधनः सर्वार्थो रुचिरा गतिः
verses.transliteration: durvārapretacārī ca bhūtacārī maheśvaraḥ / bahubhūto bahudhanaḥ sarvārtho rucirā gatiḥ

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यप्रियो नृत्यकर्ता नर्तकश् च बलाहकः । घोरो महातपा वासो नित्यो गिरिधरो नभः
verses.transliteration: nṛtyapriyo nṛtyakartā nartakaś ca balāhakaḥ / ghoro mahātapā vāso nityo giridharo nabhaḥ

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रभूतो विज्ञेयो व्यवसायश् च निश्चयः । अमर्षो मर्षणो दक्षो दक्षक्रतुविनाशनः
verses.transliteration: sahasrabhūto vijñeyo vyavasāyaś ca niścayaḥ / amarṣo marṣaṇo dakṣo dakṣakratuvināśanaḥ

verses.sanskrit: दक्षयज्ञापहारी च सुमहो मध्यमस् तथा । तेजो ऽपहारी बलिहा मुदितश् चार्चितो भवः
verses.transliteration: dakṣayajñāpahārī ca sumaho madhyamas tathā / tejo 'pahārī balihā muditaś cārcito bhavaḥ

verses.sanskrit: गम्भीरघोषो गम्भीरो गभीरो हव्यवाहनः । न्यग्रोधरूपो न्यग्रोधऋक्षवर्णः प्रभुर् विभुः
verses.transliteration: gambhīraghoṣo gambhīro gabhīro havyavāhanaḥ / nyagrodharūpo nyagrodhaṛkṣavarṇaḥ prabhur vibhuḥ

verses.sanskrit: तीक्ष्णबाणश् च हर्यक्षो महेशः कर्मकालवित् । दीक्षः प्रसादितो यज्ञः समुद्रो वडवानलः
verses.transliteration: tīkṣṇabāṇaś ca haryakṣo maheśaḥ karmakālavit / dīkṣaḥ prasādito yajñaḥ samudro vaḍavānalaḥ

verses.sanskrit: हुताशश् च हृताशास्यः प्रसन्नात्मा हृताशनः । महातेजाः सुतेजाश् च विजयो जय एव च

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिषामयनं सिद्धिः सन्धिर्विग्रह एव च । शिखी दण्डी जटी ज्वाली मूर्तोदो दुर्बलो बहिः
verses.transliteration: jyotiṣāmayanaṃ siddhiḥ sandhirvigraha eva ca / śikhī daṇḍī jaṭī jvālī mūrtodo durbalo bahiḥ

verses.sanskrit: वैणवी पापवेतालः कालाग्निः कालदण्डकः । नक्षत्रविग्रहो वृद्धिरजो गन्धवहो ऽग्रजः
verses.transliteration: vaiṇavī pāpavetālaḥ kālāgniḥ kāladaṇḍakaḥ / nakṣatravigraho vṛddhirajo gandhavaho 'grajaḥ

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिर् हरिर् बाहुर्विभागः सर्वतोमुखः । विमोचनः सुरगणो हिरण्यकवचो भवः
verses.transliteration: prajāpatir harir bāhurvibhāgaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ / vimocanaḥ suragaṇo hiraṇyakavaco bhavaḥ

verses.sanskrit: अरजो धूलिधारी च महाचारी श्रुतश्रवाः । अनादिः सर्वभूतादिः सर्वस्याद्यः पिता गुरुः
verses.transliteration: arajo dhūlidhārī ca mahācārī śrutaśravāḥ / anādiḥ sarvabhūtādiḥ sarvasyādyaḥ pitā guruḥ

verses.sanskrit: सर्ववासी सर्वचारी दुर्वासा भैरवो यमः । हिमो हिमकरो यज्ञः सर्वधाता बुधोत्तमः

verses.sanskrit: लोहिताक्षो महाक्षश् च विजयाख्यो विशारदः । संग्रहो विग्रहः कर्म सर्प राजविभूषणः

verses.sanskrit: मुख्यो विमुक्तदेहश् च देहचारी च कर्दमः । सर्वाचारः प्रसादश् च खेचरो बलरूपधृक्
verses.transliteration: mukhyo vimuktadehaś ca dehacārī ca kardamaḥ / sarvācāraḥ prasādaś ca khecaro balarūpadhṛk

verses.sanskrit: आकाशवृत्तिरूपश् च निपात उरगः खलः । रौद्ररूपः सुरादित्यो वसुरश्मिः सुवर्चसः

verses.sanskrit: वसुवेगो महावेगो मनोवेगो निशाचरः । सर्वावासः श्रियावास आपदीशकलो हरः
verses.transliteration: vasuvego mahāvego manovego niśācaraḥ / sarvāvāsaḥ śriyāvāsa āpadīśakalo haraḥ

verses.sanskrit: मुनिर् आत्मगतिर् लोकः सहस्रवदनो विभुः । यक्षी च यक्षराजश् च श्येनो दीप्तिर् विशाम्पतिः
verses.transliteration: munir ātmagatir lokaḥ sahasravadano vibhuḥ / yakṣī ca yakṣarājaś ca śyeno dīptir viśāmpatiḥ

verses.sanskrit: उन्मदो मदनाकारो ऽप्य् अर्थानर्थकरो महान् । सिद्धयोगो ऽपहारी च सिद्धः सर्वार्थसाधकः
verses.transliteration: unmado madanākāro 'py arthānarthakaro mahān / siddhayogo 'pahārī ca siddhaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुश् च भिक्षुरूपश् च विभुः षण्णां मृदुत्वचः । महासेनो विशाखश् च यष्टिभागो गवाम्पतिः
verses.transliteration: bhikṣuś ca bhikṣurūpaś ca vibhuḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ mṛdutvacaḥ / mahāseno viśākhaś ca yaṣṭibhāgo gavāmpatiḥ

verses.sanskrit: वज्रहस्तश् च विष्टम्भिर् विष्ठः स्तम्भन एव च । ऋक्षो रिपुकरः कालो मधुर्मधुकलोचनः
verses.transliteration: vajrahastaś ca viṣṭambhir viṣṭhaḥ stambhana eva ca / ṛkṣo ripukaraḥ kālo madhurmadhukalocanaḥ

verses.sanskrit: वाचस्पत्यो वाजसेनो नैष्ठश्चाश्रमसूचकः । ब्रह्मचारी लोकचारी सर्वचारी सुरत्नवित्

verses.sanskrit: ईशान ईश्वरः कालो निशाचारी त्वम् एकधृक् । अमितश्चाप्रमेयश् च नदीनदकरो ऽव्ययः
verses.transliteration: īśāna īśvaraḥ kālo niśācārī tvam ekadhṛk / amitaścāprameyaś ca nadīnadakaro 'vyayaḥ

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वरः सुनन्दी च नन्दनो नन्दवर्द्धनः । नागहारो विहारी च कालो ब्रह्मविदां वरः

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्मुखो महालिङ्गश्चतुर्लिङ्गस् तथैव च । लिङ्गाध्यक्षः सुरध्यक्षो कालाध्यक्षो युगावहः
verses.transliteration: caturmukho mahāliṅgaścaturliṅgas tathaiva ca / liṅgādhyakṣaḥ suradhyakṣo kālādhyakṣo yugāvahaḥ

verses.sanskrit: उमापतिरुमाकान्तो जाह्नवी धृतिमान् वरः । सर्वार्थः सर्वभूतार्थो नित्यः सर्वव्रतः शुचिः

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: श्रुत्वा स्तोत्रमिदं देवः श्रीमान् द्वीपेश्वरः शिवः । प्रसन्नब्रवीद् देवान् प्रार्थयध्वं वरं सुराः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śrutvā stotramidaṃ devaḥ śrīmān dvīpeśvaraḥ śivaḥ / prasannabravīd devān prārthayadhvaṃ varaṃ surāḥ

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः: यदि तुष्टो महेशानो देवानां वरदः प्रभुः । तद् विनाशाय दैत्यानां त्राता भव महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ: yadi tuṣṭo maheśāno devānāṃ varadaḥ prabhuḥ / tad vināśāya daityānāṃ trātā bhava maheśvara

verses.sanskrit: पापकर्माधमश् चैव पञ्चलिङ्गानि यो ऽर्चयेत् । सो ऽपि तां गतिम् आप्नोति दुर्लभा या महामखैः
verses.transliteration: pāpakarmādhamaś caiva pañcaliṅgāni yo 'rcayet / so 'pi tāṃ gatim āpnoti durlabhā yā mahāmakhaiḥ

verses.sanskrit: शक्रेणाभिवृतस् तत्र देवदेव उमापतिः । पुरा नाम्नां सहस्रेण सुरासुरनमस्कृतः
verses.transliteration: śakreṇābhivṛtas tatra devadeva umāpatiḥ / purā nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ

verses.sanskrit: शिवप्रसादसम्पन्नो देवराजस् ततो ऽभवत् । धनदेन स्तुतस् तत्र देवो लक्षेश्वरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: śivaprasādasampanno devarājas tato 'bhavat / dhanadena stutas tatra devo lakṣeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षदा नाम गौरीं च तां देवीं विद्धि भारत । मोक्षेश्वरं सिद्धलिङ्गं सुरासुरनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: mokṣadā nāma gaurīṃ ca tāṃ devīṃ viddhi bhārata / mokṣeśvaraṃ siddhaliṅgaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam
