verses.sanskrit: सिद्धैर् विद्याधरैर् यक्षैर् गन्धर्वैः किन्नरैर् नरैः । देवत्वं समनुप्राप्तं पञ्चलिङ्गसमर्चनात्
verses.transliteration: siddhair vidyādharair yakṣair gandharvaiḥ kinnarair naraiḥ / devatvaṃ samanuprāptaṃ pañcaliṅgasamarcanāt
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: कुबेरो मारुतश् चैव वरुणो निरृतिस् तथा । वैवस्वतो यमश् चैव ततश् च नरकेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kubero mārutaś caiva varuṇo nirṛtis tathā / vaivasvato yamaś caiva tataś ca narakeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: तस्य लिङ्गस्य माहात्म्यात् सूर्यपुत्रो महायशाः । अन्यैर् अभिष्टुतस् तत्र पूर्वं द्वीपेश्वरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tasya liṅgasya māhātmyāt sūryaputro mahāyaśāḥ / anyair abhiṣṭutas tatra pūrvaṃ dvīpeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या नामसहस्रेण स्तुतः पूज्यतमः शिवः । सोमेनातो ऽभवत् तत्र शम्भोः शिरसि भूषणम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā nāmasahasreṇa stutaḥ pūjyatamaḥ śivaḥ / somenāto 'bhavat tatra śambhoḥ śirasi bhūṣaṇam

verses.sanskrit: रोहिण्या ऽभ्यर्चिता गौरी सुभगा तेन साभवत् । ऋक्षैर् योगतरैस् तद्वत् स्तुतो देवः पिनाकधृक्
verses.transliteration: rohiṇyā 'bhyarcitā gaurī subhagā tena sābhavat / ṛkṣair yogatarais tadvat stuto devaḥ pinākadhṛk

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तैर् भास्करेणैव तभः स्थलमलं कृतम् । व्याधयः कालमृत्युश् च चित्रगुप्तश् च लेखकः
verses.transliteration: tatas tair bhāskareṇaiva tabhaḥ sthalamalaṃ kṛtam / vyādhayaḥ kālamṛtyuś ca citraguptaś ca lekhakaḥ

verses.sanskrit: तथा शक्रः सुरगणैर् एतैः परिवृतः प्रभुः । पापिष्ठानां महारौद्रो धर्मिष्ठानां प्रसादवान्
verses.transliteration: tathā śakraḥ suragaṇair etaiḥ parivṛtaḥ prabhuḥ / pāpiṣṭhānāṃ mahāraudro dharmiṣṭhānāṃ prasādavān

verses.sanskrit: कोट्यो ऽष्टौ चोर्ध्वकेशा रौद्राश् च विकृताननाः । पतिव्रतासहस्रैश् च तथा मासोपवासिभिः
verses.transliteration: koṭyo 'ṣṭau cordhvakeśā raudrāś ca vikṛtānanāḥ / pativratāsahasraiś ca tathā māsopavāsibhiḥ

verses.sanskrit: किल्किलारवशब्दैश् च धर्मराजपुरोत्तमम् । व्याप्तं तु परितः श्रीमदसंख्यातैर् मनोरमैः
verses.transliteration: kilkilāravaśabdaiś ca dharmarājapurottamam / vyāptaṃ tu paritaḥ śrīmadasaṃkhyātair manoramaiḥ

verses.transliteration: śrutvā teṣāṃ ravaṃ sārddhaṃ dharmarājaḥ sabhāsadaiḥ / śvetavastraparīdhānaḥ śvetamālyānulepanaḥ

verses.sanskrit: पादचारी गतः क्षिप्रं यत्र ते यानसंस्थिताः । कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा पप्रच्छ शुभकर्मणः
verses.transliteration: pādacārī gataḥ kṣipraṃ yatra te yānasaṃsthitāḥ / kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā papraccha śubhakarmaṇaḥ

verses.sanskrit: यथा शक्तेन योगेन धर्मं धर्मोत्तरं महत् । कस्माद् देशात् समायाताः कथं पुण्यमुपार्जितम्
verses.transliteration: yathā śaktena yogena dharmaṃ dharmottaraṃ mahat / kasmād deśāt samāyātāḥ kathaṃ puṇyamupārjitam

verses.sanskrit: विमानारूढा ऊचुः: कुरुक्षेत्रे तपस् तप्तं गङ्गायां च विशेषतः । सर्वेषाम् एव लोकानां द्वारं तद्धि प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: vimānārūḍhā ūcuḥ: kurukṣetre tapas taptaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ / sarveṣām eva lokānāṃ dvāraṃ taddhi pratiṣṭhitam

verses.sanskrit: धर्माधर्मं तव बलं कारणं चेति तत्त्वतः । वाराणसी प्रयागश् च गङ्गासागरसङ्गमः
verses.transliteration: dharmādharmaṃ tava balaṃ kāraṇaṃ ceti tattvataḥ / vārāṇasī prayāgaś ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgamaḥ

verses.sanskrit: पितृतीर्थं महापुण्यं पुष्करं नैमिषं तथा । केदारं भैरवं चैव तथा रुद्रमहालयम्
verses.transliteration: pitṛtīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ puṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ tathā / kedāraṃ bhairavaṃ caiva tathā rudramahālayam

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वतीरुद्रकोटिः प्रभासं शशिभूषणम् । नानातीर्थसहस्रेषु दानयज्ञतपः कृतम्
verses.transliteration: sarasvatīrudrakoṭiḥ prabhāsaṃ śaśibhūṣaṇam / nānātīrthasahasreṣu dānayajñatapaḥ kṛtam

verses.sanskrit: एतत् ते कथितं सर्वं सूर्यपुत्रमहायशः । अन्ये दृष्ट्वा यथा न्यायं धर्मराजं ततस् तथा
verses.transliteration: etat te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sūryaputramahāyaśaḥ / anye dṛṣṭvā yathā nyāyaṃ dharmarājaṃ tatas tathā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: ऊचुः सर्वे वचः श्लक्ष्णं धर्मराजं यथोदितम् । न त्वं प्रभुः सुकृतिनां ब्रह्मा विष्णुः शिवः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: ūcuḥ sarve vacaḥ ślakṣṇaṃ dharmarājaṃ yathoditam / na tvaṃ prabhuḥ sukṛtināṃ brahmā viṣṇuḥ śivaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: पापकर्मरता ये तु तेषां शास्ता यमः स्वयम् । यम उवाच: गत्वा कैलासमायामि यावत् तावत् प्रतीक्षताम्
verses.transliteration: pāpakarmaratā ye tu teṣāṃ śāstā yamaḥ svayam / yama uvāca: gatvā kailāsamāyāmi yāvat tāvat pratīkṣatām
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा ययौ राजन् कैलासं स नगोत्तमम् । यस्मिन् शिवाद्यास् ते सर्वे पार्वती षण्मुखस् तथा
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā yayau rājan kailāsaṃ sa nagottamam / yasmin śivādyās te sarve pārvatī ṣaṇmukhas tathā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: स्तुवन्ति देवताः सर्वादेवदेवम् उमापतिम् । नृत्यन्ति चाग्रतः केचिद् उत्पत्य निपतन्ति च
verses.transliteration: stuvanti devatāḥ sarvādevadevam umāpatim / nṛtyanti cāgrataḥ kecid utpatya nipatanti ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा तादृशं शम्भुं स्तुवन्तं दीप्ततेजसम् । स्तुवन्नामसहस्रेण देवदेवं पिनाकिनम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ śambhuṃ stuvantaṃ dīptatejasam / stuvannāmasahasreṇa devadevaṃ pinākinam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: साष्टाङ्गं च नमस्कृत्य धर्मराजो ऽब्रवीद् इदम् । ये ऽस्मत्पुरीं समायातास् तेषां का गतिर् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: sāṣṭāṅgaṃ ca namaskṛtya dharmarājo 'bravīd idam / ye 'smatpurīṃ samāyātās teṣāṃ kā gatir ucyate

verses.sanskrit: प्रहसन्न् अब्रवीद् देवो धर्मराजं युधिष्ठिर । अत्र प्रयान्तु ते सर्वे ये रेवातीरवासिनः
verses.transliteration: prahasann abravīd devo dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhira / atra prayāntu te sarve ye revātīravāsinaḥ

verses.sanskrit: अन्यतीर्थनिवासा ये भोगान् भुञ्जन्तु ते दिवि । शिववाक्यं ततः श्रुत्वा ब्रह्माविष्णुर् यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: anyatīrthanivāsā ye bhogān bhuñjantu te divi / śivavākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā brahmāviṣṇur yathātatham

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टा देवस्य वाक्येन सर्वदेवगणेश्वरुः । आगतः क्षणमात्रेण धर्मराजः पुरोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭā devasya vākyena sarvadevagaṇeśvaruḥ / āgataḥ kṣaṇamātreṇa dharmarājaḥ purottamam

verses.sanskrit: शिवोक्ताः प्रेषिताः सर्वे शिवलोकं युधिष्ठिर । यथा यथा समादिष्टास् ततो ऽन्ये ऽपि शूभान्विताः
verses.transliteration: śivoktāḥ preṣitāḥ sarve śivalokaṃ yudhiṣṭhira / yathā yathā samādiṣṭās tato 'nye 'pi śūbhānvitāḥ

verses.sanskrit: पुराकल्पे मया दृष्टं कार्त्तिक्यां देवतागमे । ततो गच्छेन् महाराज वैष्णवं तीर्थमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: purākalpe mayā dṛṣṭaṃ kārttikyāṃ devatāgame / tato gacchen mahārāja vaiṣṇavaṃ tīrthamuttamam

verses.sanskrit: कोकिला नाम विख्यातं सर्वपापविमोक्षणम् । वैष्णवं क्षेत्रमित्य् आह देवदेवो जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: kokilā nāma vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpavimokṣaṇam / vaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetramity āha devadevo janārdanaḥ

verses.sanskrit: सपादकोटिस्तीर्थानां तत्रास्ते चैव भारत । उपोष्यैकादशीं पुण्यां दीपमालां प्रबोधयेत्
verses.transliteration: sapādakoṭistīrthānāṃ tatrāste caiva bhārata / upoṣyaikādaśīṃ puṇyāṃ dīpamālāṃ prabodhayet

verses.sanskrit: न तस्य पुनरावृत्तिर् मर्त्यलोके दुरासदे । सर्वकामसमृद्धेन विमानाग्रेण भारत
verses.transliteration: na tasya punarāvṛttir martyaloke durāsade / sarvakāmasamṛddhena vimānāgreṇa bhārata

verses.sanskrit: असंख्यकालिका तृप्तिः पितॄणां नात्र संशयः । विप्रे च तोषिते तत्र दानसङ्ख्या न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: asaṃkhyakālikā tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ / vipre ca toṣite tatra dānasaṅkhyā na vidyate

verses.sanskrit: अत्रान्तरे त्यजेत् प्राणानवशः स्ववशो ऽपि वा । दशवर्षसहस्राणि राजा वैद्याधरे पुरे
verses.transliteration: atrāntare tyajet prāṇānavaśaḥ svavaśo 'pi vā / daśavarṣasahasrāṇi rājā vaidyādhare pure

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवो ध्रुवत्वं स्वर्गे तु तारातेजः समुज्ज्वलन् । मर्त्ययोनिषु सम्भूता भूतग्रामा तथापरे
verses.transliteration: dhruvo dhruvatvaṃ svarge tu tārātejaḥ samujjvalan / martyayoniṣu sambhūtā bhūtagrāmā tathāpare

verses.sanskrit: अर्चन्राड् देवदेवस्य दिवि देवत्वम् आप्नुवन् । देवपुण्यक्षये मर्त्या भक्त्या पुण्यैश् च देवताः
verses.transliteration: arcanrāḍ devadevasya divi devatvam āpnuvan / devapuṇyakṣaye martyā bhaktyā puṇyaiś ca devatāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गमर्त्यप्रभेदो ऽयं धर्माधर्मप्रभेदतः । केनापि तत्प्रकारेण पूजनीयो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: svargamartyaprabhedo 'yaṃ dharmādharmaprabhedataḥ / kenāpi tatprakāreṇa pūjanīyo maheśvaraḥ

verses.sanskrit: यद् वा तद् वा शिवे देयं भक्तियुक्तेन चेतसा । अरुन्धत्या सा भरण्या सावित्र्या च तथा तथा
verses.transliteration: yad vā tad vā śive deyaṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasā / arundhatyā sā bharaṇyā sāvitryā ca tathā tathā

verses.sanskrit: अहल्यया मेनकया मरुत्वत्या च रम्भया । अप्सरोगणसङ्घैश् च सुरसिद्धगणैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: ahalyayā menakayā marutvatyā ca rambhayā / apsarogaṇasaṅghaiś ca surasiddhagaṇais tathā

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातटम् आश्रित्य पूजितो येन शङ्करः । तेन वै विपुला भोगाः प्राप्ता मोक्षश् च भारत
verses.transliteration: narmadātaṭam āśritya pūjito yena śaṅkaraḥ / tena vai vipulā bhogāḥ prāptā mokṣaś ca bhārata

verses.sanskrit: न पूजयेद् धरं यस् तु शिवमायाविमोहितः । न तस्य स्वर्गमोक्षौ च कैलासं प्रति का कथा
verses.transliteration: na pūjayed dharaṃ yas tu śivamāyāvimohitaḥ / na tasya svargamokṣau ca kailāsaṃ prati kā kathā

verses.sanskrit: क्षमा सत्यं जपो ऽधीतं तपः संयमलक्षणम् । एतत् ते कथितं राजं शिवेन कथितं पुरा
verses.transliteration: kṣamā satyaṃ japo 'dhītaṃ tapaḥ saṃyamalakṣaṇam / etat te kathitaṃ rājaṃ śivena kathitaṃ purā

verses.sanskrit: मया च तव राजेन्द्र भ्रातॄणां च विशेषतः । न सामान्यतरा देवी कथिता या मया तव
verses.transliteration: mayā ca tava rājendra bhrātṝṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ / na sāmānyatarā devī kathitā yā mayā tava

verses.sanskrit: द्वीपेश्वरः कपिलेश्वरस् तथा वै नरकेश्वरः । एतान् देवान् समुत्थाय यथावत् परिकीर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: dvīpeśvaraḥ kapileśvaras tathā vai narakeśvaraḥ / etān devān samutthāya yathāvat parikīrtayet

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतीर्थफलं प्राप्य शिवलोके महीयते । अघौघे च परिक्षीणे प्राप्यते सप्तकल्पगा
verses.transliteration: sarvatīrthaphalaṃ prāpya śivaloke mahīyate / aghaughe ca parikṣīṇe prāpyate saptakalpagā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).

verses.sanskrit: शिवः संनिहितो यस्यां शिवक्षेत्रं ततः परम् । श्रवणात् कीर्तनाद् अस्य शिवलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ saṃnihito yasyāṃ śivakṣetraṃ tataḥ param / śravaṇāt kīrtanād asya śivaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent one among the sons of Pandu, listen to another Tirtha named Kamesvara. It was here that Ganadhyaksa (Ganesa), the highly powerful son of Gaurl, became a Siddha (i.e. one who had achieved spiritual perfection).
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे द्वीपेश्वरवर्णनो नामैकसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ७२ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: नर्मदासङ्गमं पुण्यं सुरसिद्धनिषेवितम् । तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe dvīpeśvaravarṇano nāmaikasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 72 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadāsaṅgamaṃ puṇyaṃ surasiddhaniṣevitam / tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti pūjayitvā maheśvaram
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the aus- picious Maninagesvara on the northern bank of Narmada. It causes the destruction of all sins. It has been installed by Maninaga with a desire for the welfare of all the worlds.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the aus- picious Maninagesvara on the northern bank of Narmada. It causes the destruction of all sins. It has been installed by Maninaga with a desire for the welfare of all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the aus- picious Maninagesvara on the northern bank of Narmada. It causes the destruction of all sins. It has been installed by Maninaga with a desire for the welfare of all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: आगच्छन्ती पुरा लोके नर्मदा भरतर्षभ । स्तुता पूर्वं नमस्कृत्य देवैर् ब्रह्मर्षिभिस् तथा
verses.transliteration: āgacchantī purā loke narmadā bharatarṣabha / stutā pūrvaṃ namaskṛtya devair brahmarṣibhis tathā
verses.translation: Or, O dear one, the benefit (fruit) that is derived from Vidyadana (imparting learning) is obtained by always listening to the stories or episodes concerning Hari.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Or, O dear one, the benefit (fruit) that is derived from Vidyadana (imparting learning) is obtained by always listening to the stories or episodes concerning Hari.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, O dear one, the benefit (fruit) that is derived from Vidyadana (imparting learning) is obtained by always listening to the stories or episodes concerning Hari.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया पवित्रितं पुण्यं मर्त्यलोकं चराचरम् । अपां रूपगता रेवा हरस्य परमा कला
verses.transliteration: tvayā pavitritaṃ puṇyaṃ martyalokaṃ carācaram / apāṃ rūpagatā revā harasya paramā kalā
verses.translation: As and when you go on speaking (by way of request), O king, fluency of speech comes to me naturally. Neither the laxity of limbs due to my old age nor your friendship becomes diminished, O dear one. Hence in the company of your kins- men listen to this praiseworthy story that destroys sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: As and when you go on speaking (by way of request), O king, fluency of speech comes to me naturally. Neither the laxity of limbs due to my old age nor your friendship becomes diminished, O dear one.…
verses.commentary: Sense: As and when you go on speaking (by way of request), O king, fluency of speech comes to me naturally. Neither the laxity of limbs due to my old age nor your friendship becomes diminished, O dear one.…

verses.sanskrit: उमा कात्यायनी गङ्गा यमुना च सरस्वती । चामुण्डा चर्चिका देवी रेवा त्वं सप्तकल्पगा
verses.transliteration: umā kātyāyanī gaṅgā yamunā ca sarasvatī / cāmuṇḍā carcikā devī revā tvaṃ saptakalpagā
verses.translation: Is it not that you see pnly black (things) with your etsiand not white ones? O fair lady, by speaking the untruth
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Is it not that you see pnly black (things) with your etsiand not white ones? O fair lady, by speaking the untruth

verses.sanskrit: शिवजा प्रवहा पुण्या मेकलाद्रिसुता स्तुता । यज्ञयूपा च मूर्धा च स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदा तथा
verses.transliteration: śivajā pravahā puṇyā mekalādrisutā stutā / yajñayūpā ca mūrdhā ca svargamokṣapradā tathā
verses.translation: O mother, you are our mother and hence worthy of being worshipped by us. In the same manner she is worthy of being worshipped (by her sons). Hence one should be particular in not deceiving mothers. Verbally, mentally and physically one should do whatever is conducive to the benefit of the mother, father's wife (step-mother), maternal and paternal grand- mothers.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O mother, you are our mother and hence worthy of being worshipped by us. In the same manner she is worthy of being worshipped (by her sons). Hence one should be particular in not deceiving mothers. Verbally,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O mother, you are our mother and hence worthy of being worshipped by us. In the same manner she is worthy of being worshipped (by her sons). Hence one should be particular in not deceiving mothers. Verbally,…

verses.sanskrit: तारिणी सर्वभूतानां पापघ्नी च तरङ्गिणी । लक्ष्मीः स्वाहा स्वधा चैव पुरुहूता यशस्विनी
verses.transliteration: tāriṇī sarvabhūtānāṃ pāpaghnī ca taraṅgiṇī / lakṣmīḥ svāhā svadhā caiva puruhūtā yaśasvinī
verses.translation: "Excellent! Excellent! O highly esteemed one. O serpent, you have intrinsic strength. I have been resorted to by you with devotion. I am pleased with you, O Lord of serpents. Request for any boon from me whatever may be in your mind."
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: त्वया व्याप्तं जगत्कृत्स्नम् अपां रूपेण सुव्रते । सङ्गमं सिद्धलिङ्गं च सुरासुरनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tvayā vyāptaṃ jagatkṛtsnam apāṃ rūpeṇa suvrate / saṅgamaṃ siddhaliṅgaṃ ca surāsuranamaskṛtam
verses.translation: Sraddha for the departed should be performed, O son of Kunti, on the fifth and eighth lunar days through well- qualified Brahmanas — those who study and ponder over Vedic passages, who are devoted to their own wives with scrupulous avoidance of other men's wives, who are gentle and polished, who invariably perform the six enjoined rites and who avoid sending Sudras on errands (of spiritual nature).
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: atra dattaṃ hutaṃ sarvam etad bhavati cākṣayam / atyadbhutaṃ mahārāja narmadāsnānam arcanam
verses.translation: Sraddha for the departed should be performed, O son of Kunti, on the fifth and eighth lunar days through well- qualified Brahmanas — those who study and ponder over Vedic passages, who are devoted to their own wives with scrupulous avoidance of other men's wives, who are gentle and polished, who invariably perform the six enjoined rites and who avoid sending Sudras on errands (of spiritual nature).

verses.transliteration: anekāni sahasrāṇi vimānāni yudhiṣṭhira / nānāratnaprabhājālaiḥ sūryakoṭisamāni ca
verses.translation: Sraddha for the departed should be performed, O son of Kunti, on the fifth and eighth lunar days through well- qualified Brahmanas — those who study and ponder over Vedic passages, who are devoted to their own wives with scrupulous avoidance of other men's wives, who are gentle and polished, who invariably perform the six enjoined rites and who avoid sending Sudras on errands (of spiritual nature).

verses.transliteration: gatāni dharmarājasya purīṃ vīṇādiniḥ svanaiḥ / nādayanti divaṃ bhūmiṃ vedanirghoṣaṇādibhiḥ

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन् समये दृष्ट्वाश्चर्यं वैवस्वतो नृपः । अत्रिश् चैव वशिष्ठश् च पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः
verses.transliteration: ekasmin samaye dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ vaivasvato nṛpaḥ / atriś caiva vaśiṣṭhaś ca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तादण्डम् उत्पन्नम् अव्यक्ताद् अपरः प्रभुः । यस्मात् परतरं नास्ति तम् अस्मि शरणं गतः

verses.translation: Sraddha for the departed should be performed, O son of Kunti, on the fifth and eighth lunar days through well- qualified Brahmanas — those who study and ponder over Vedic passages, who are devoted to their own wives with scrupulous avoidance of other men's wives, who are gentle and polished, who invariably perform the six enjoined rites and who avoid sending Sudras on errands (of spiritual nature).

verses.sanskrit: ये च त्वाम् अभिजानन्ति संसारे न वसन्ति ते । रागद्वेषविनिर्मुक्ता लोभमोहविवार्जिताः

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे विष्णुस्तुतिर्नाम द्विसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ७३ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेच् च राजेन्द्र मेघनादम् इति स्मृतम् । जलमध्ये महादेवो यत्र तिष्ठत्य् अदर्शितः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe viṣṇustutirnāma dvisaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 73 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchec ca rājendra meghanādam iti smṛtam / jalamadhye mahādevo yatra tiṣṭhaty adarśitaḥ
verses.translation: O son of Kunti, there is an extremely splendid Tirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. The excellent Goparesvara is destructive of all sins. A meritorious Liriga issued Jorth from the body of a cow on the surface of the earth there, O king.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: जलमध्ये महादेवस् तिष्ठते केन हेतुना । उत्तरं दक्षिणं कूलं वर्जयित्वा द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: jalamadhye mahādevas tiṣṭhate kena hetunā / uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kūlaṃ varjayitvā dvijottama
verses.translation: I have been created by Paramesthin for the sake of helping the worlds. It is with my favour that all the affairs of the world come to fulfilment. O Sankara, if people will pro- ceed towards heaven, it is due to my favour. O Sambhu, do stay in my Tirtha with a desire for the welfare of the wprlds.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: एतद् आख्यानम् अतुलं पुण्यं श्रुतिसुखावहम् । पुराणे यच्छ्रुतं तात तत् ते वक्ष्याम्य् अशेषतः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: etad ākhyānam atulaṃ puṇyaṃ śrutisukhāvaham / purāṇe yacchrutaṃ tāta tat te vakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डदानं तु यः कुर्यात् तस्मिंस् तीर्थे नराधिप । तेन द्वादश वर्षाणि पितरस् तर्पिता दिवि

verses.translation: O excellent Brahmana, quickly explain assiduously the benefit that accrues to men when Vrsotsarga (ceremonial and ritualistic releasing of a bull) is done.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.translation: There is an excellent Tirtha on the northern bank of Reva. It is destructive of all sins in the mortal world. It is (known) by the name Gautamesvara. Go there with great devotion to the place where the Lord, the preceptor of the universe, is present for the sake of the destruction of sins. He is also the bestower of a residence in Svarga.

verses.translation: There is a great and beautiful Tirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It is well-known in the terrestrial sphere by the name of Sankhacuda, O son of Pandu. Sankhacuda is himself present there on the pleasant bank of Narmada, due to the fear of Vainateya (Garuda).

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे देवतीर्थमहिमानुवर्णनो नाम पञ्चसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ७६ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततोगच्छेच् च राजेन्द्र गुहावासीति चोत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धो महादेवो गुहावासीति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe devatīrthamahimānuvarṇano nāma pañcasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 76 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tatogacchec ca rājendra guhāvāsīti cottamam / yatra siddho mahādevo guhāvāsīti śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Paresvaia (Tirtha), O great king. The noble-souled Parasara performed on the splendid banks of Narmada a severe penance for the sake of a son, O son of Pandu.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Paresvaia (Tirtha), O great king. The noble-souled Parasara performed on the splendid banks of Narmada a severe penance for the sake of a son, O son of Pandu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Paresvaia (Tirtha), O great king. The noble-souled Parasara performed on the splendid banks of Narmada a severe penance for the sake of a son, O son of Pandu.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: केन कार्येण विप्रेन्द्र गुहावासीति शङ्करः । एतद् विस्तरतः सर्व कथयस्व ममानघ
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kena kāryeṇa viprendra guhāvāsīti śaṅkaraḥ / etad vistarataḥ sarva kathayasva mamānagha
verses.translation: So be it, O Brahmana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: So be it, O Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: So be it, O Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: श्रोतुम् इच्छाम्य् अहं देव सर्वं कौतूहलं हि मे । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: महाप्रश्नः कृतो मां यो महाप्राज्ञ नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ deva sarvaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: mahāpraśnaḥ kṛto māṃ yo mahāprājña nareśvara
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: पुराणे विस्तरो ऽप्य् अस्य न शक्यो हि मयाधुना । वृद्धभावात् कथयितुम् अहं च बहुकालिकः
verses.transliteration: purāṇe vistaro 'py asya na śakyo hi mayādhunā / vṛddhabhāvāt kathayitum ahaṃ ca bahukālikaḥ
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्व दारुवने विप्रा वसन्ति स्म सुरैः समाः । ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थश् च वानप्रस्थो यतिस् तथा
verses.transliteration: pūrva dāruvane viprā vasanti sma suraiḥ samāḥ / brahmacārī gṛhasthaś ca vānaprastho yatis tathā
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: स्वधर्मनिरतानां च कथितं परमं पदम् । तावद्वसन्तसमये कस्मिंश्चित् कारणान्तरे
verses.transliteration: svadharmaniratānāṃ ca kathitaṃ paramaṃ padam / tāvadvasantasamaye kasmiṃścit kāraṇāntare
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: विमानस्थो महादेवो गम्यमानोमया सह । ददर्श च जनावासं वेदध्वनिनिनादितम्
verses.transliteration: vimānastho mahādevo gamyamānomayā saha / dadarśa ca janāvāsaṃ vedadhvaninināditam
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: अगतागतसंवासं सर्वपापक्षयं करम् । तद्दृष्ट्वा मुदितां देवीं हर्षगद्गदया गिरा
verses.transliteration: agatāgatasaṃvāsaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃ karam / taddṛṣṭvā muditāṃ devīṃ harṣagadgadayā girā
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच वचनं देवो दृष्ट्वा तापसयोषितः । नान्यं देवं न वै धर्मं ध्यायन्ति हिमनन्दिनि
verses.transliteration: uvāca vacanaṃ devo dṛṣṭvā tāpasayoṣitaḥ / nānyaṃ devaṃ na vai dharmaṃ dhyāyanti himanandini
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा परं वाक्यं देवदेवेन भाषितम् । कौतूहलसमाविष्टा शङ्करं पुनर् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā paraṃ vākyaṃ devadevena bhāṣitam / kautūhalasamāviṣṭā śaṅkaraṃ punar abravīt
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: यत् त्वयोक्तं महादेव पतिधर्मपरास्त्रियः । तासाम् अनङ्गो भूत्वा त्वं चरित्रं क्षोभय प्रभो
verses.transliteration: yat tvayoktaṃ mahādeva patidharmaparāstriyaḥ / tāsām anaṅgo bhūtvā tvaṃ caritraṃ kṣobhaya prabho
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: महादेव उवाच: त्वयोक्तं वचनं देवि न चैतद् रोचते प्रिये । ब्राह्मणा हि महाभागा न तेषां विप्रियं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: mahādeva uvāca: tvayoktaṃ vacanaṃ devi na caitad rocate priye / brāhmaṇā hi mahābhāgā na teṣāṃ vipriyaṃ caret
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: मन्युप्रहरणा विप्राश् चक्रप्रहरणो हरिः । चक्रात् तीक्ष्णतरो मन्युस् तस्माद् विप्रं न कोपयेत्
verses.transliteration: manyupraharaṇā viprāś cakrapraharaṇo hariḥ / cakrāt tīkṣṇataro manyus tasmād vipraṃ na kopayet

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: न ते देवा न ते लोकास् ते नागा नासुरास् तथा । दृश्यन्ते च त्रिभिर् लोकैर् एतैर् उष्टैर् न वञ्चिताः
verses.transliteration: na te devā na te lokās te nāgā nāsurās tathā / dṛśyante ca tribhir lokair etair uṣṭair na vañcitāḥ
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां क्षोभकरः प्रायः स्वर्गभोगफलच्युतः । येषां तुष्टा महाभागा ब्राह्मणाः क्षितिदेवताः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ kṣobhakaraḥ prāyaḥ svargabhogaphalacyutaḥ / yeṣāṃ tuṣṭā mahābhāgā brāhmaṇāḥ kṣitidevatāḥ

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां धर्मस् तथार्थश् च कामो मोक्षो न संशयः । एवं ज्ञात्वा महाभागे आग्रहस्त्यज्यताम् अयम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ dharmas tathārthaś ca kāmo mokṣo na saṃśayaḥ / evaṃ jñātvā mahābhāge āgrahastyajyatām ayam
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: एतल् लोकविरुद्धं हि यदीच्छसि वशे सुखम् । देव्य् उवाच: नाहं ते दयिता देव नाहं ते वशवर्तिनी
verses.transliteration: etal lokaviruddhaṃ hi yadīcchasi vaśe sukham / devy uvāca: nāhaṃ te dayitā deva nāhaṃ te vaśavartinī
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यायधर्षणां चात्र सर्वासां कुरु सुव्रत । लोकालोके महादेव अशक्यं नास्ति ते विभो
verses.transliteration: anyāyadharṣaṇāṃ cātra sarvāsāṃ kuru suvrata / lokāloke mahādeva aśakyaṃ nāsti te vibho

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.transliteration: kriyatāṃ mama devaitatparaṃ kautūhalaṃ prabho / evam ukto mahādevo devyāḥ priyahite rataḥ

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा कापालिकं रूपं ययौ दारुवनं प्रति । महाहिनां जटाजूटं नियम्य शशिभूषणः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā kāpālikaṃ rūpaṃ yayau dāruvanaṃ prati / mahāhināṃ jaṭājūṭaṃ niyamya śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: अनिवर्तिका गतिस् तस्य यथा मे शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत् । एतत् कीर्तयते यस् तु नर्मदेश्वरम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: anivartikā gatis tasya yathā me śaṅkaro 'bravīt / etat kīrtayate yas tu narmadeśvaram uttamam
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या शृणोति यो राजन्न् अश्वमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā śṛṇoti yo rājann aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: In the case of women and Sudras, Ama-sraddha (Sraddha with uncooked food) is recommended.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे दारुवनप्रसङ्गे नर्मदेश्वरकीर्तनं नाम षट्सप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ७७ ततो गच्छेच् च राजेन्द्र कपिलातीर्थम् उत्तमम् । स्नानमात्रः प्रसङ्गेन नर्मदेश्वरकीर्तनम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe dāruvanaprasaṅge narmadeśvarakīrtanaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 77 tato gacchec ca rājendra kapilātīrtham uttamam / snānamātraḥ prasaṅgena narmadeśvarakīrtanam
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस् तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र कपिलां यः प्रयच्छति । यावन्ति रोमकूपानि तत्प्रसूतिकुलेषु च
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃs tīrthe tu rājendra kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati / yāvanti romakūpāni tatprasūtikuleṣu ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.sanskrit: तावन्त्य् अब्दसहस्राणि विष्णुलोके महीयते । जले वाग्निप्रवेशे वा अथवानशके नरः
verses.transliteration: tāvanty abdasahasrāṇi viṣṇuloke mahīyate / jale vāgnipraveśe vā athavānaśake naraḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे मृतो यस् तु न गर्भे जायते क्वचित् । एव हि विधिर् उद्दिष्टः सकलो नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe mṛto yas tu na garbhe jāyate kvacit / eva hi vidhir uddiṣṭaḥ sakalo nṛpasattama
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थस्य च फलं पुण्यं किम् अन्यत् परिपृच्छसि । धन्यं यशस्यम् आयुष्यं सर्वदुःखघ्नम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tīrthasya ca phalaṃ puṇyaṃ kim anyat paripṛcchasi / dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnam uttamam
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा नरो राजन् सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते । ततो गच्छेत् तु राजेन्द्र करञ्जेश्वरम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā naro rājan sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate / tato gacchet tu rājendra karañjeśvaram uttamam
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सिद्धो महाभाग दैत्यो वै लोकविश्रुतः । युधिष्ठिर उवाच: को ऽसौ सिद्धो महाभाग तत्र तीर्थे महातपाः
verses.transliteration: tatra siddho mahābhāga daityo vai lokaviśrutaḥ / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: ko 'sau siddho mahābhāga tatra tīrthe mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: कस्य पुत्रो ऽथ किंकार्यं कालः कः कथय द्विज । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: पुरा चादियुगे राजन् मानसो ब्रह्मणः सुतः
verses.transliteration: kasya putro 'tha kiṃkāryaṃ kālaḥ kaḥ kathaya dvija / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā cādiyuge rājan mānaso brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञो मरीचिर् नाम नामतः । तस्या ऽपि कश्यपो राजन् कालेन महतानघ
verses.transliteration: vedavedāṅgatattvajño marīcir nāma nāmataḥ / tasyā 'pi kaśyapo rājan kālena mahatānagha
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: putro 'tha mānaso jātaḥ sākṣād brahmeva cāparaḥ / kṣamā damā dayā dānaṃ satyaṃ śaucam athārjavam
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.sanskrit: मरीचेस् तु गुणास् त्व् एते सन्ति भान्ति च भारत । एवं गुणगणाः कीर्तिः कश्यपे द्विजसत्तमे
verses.transliteration: marīces tu guṇās tv ete santi bhānti ca bhārata / evaṃ guṇagaṇāḥ kīrtiḥ kaśyape dvijasattame
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.transliteration: jñātvā prajāpatir dakṣo bhāryārthe svasutāṃ dadau / aditir vai danuś caiva tathā hyekādaśā parāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.sanskrit: यासां पुत्राश् च पौत्राश् च जाता भ्रातरसंख्यकाः । अदितिर् जनयामास पुत्रानिन्द्रपुरोगमान्
verses.transliteration: yāsāṃ putrāś ca pautrāś ca jātā bhrātarasaṃkhyakāḥ / aditir janayāmāsa putrānindrapurogamān
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.sanskrit: नागान् प्रेतपिशाचांश् च पतत्रीन् यक्षराक्षसान् । सिंहव्याघ्रवराहांश् च अन्या इत्य् एवम् आदयः
verses.transliteration: nāgān pretapiśācāṃś ca patatrīn yakṣarākṣasān / siṃhavyāghravarāhāṃś ca anyā ity evam ādayaḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.sanskrit: जातास् तस्य महाबाहो कश्यपस्य प्रजापतेः । यैस् तु लोकत्रयं व्याप्तं स्थावरं जङ्गमं महत्
verses.transliteration: jātās tasya mahābāho kaśyapasya prajāpateḥ / yais tu lokatrayaṃ vyāptaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ mahat

verses.sanskrit: तथान्यश् च महाभागो दनोः पुत्रो व्यजायत । सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नः करञ्जो नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration: tathānyaś ca mahābhāgo danoḥ putro vyajāyata / sarvalakṣaṇasampannaḥ karañjo nāma nāmataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.sanskrit: बलेर् इव महाभाग चचार सुमहत् तपः । वरेण छन्दयामास त्रिपुरान्तकरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: baler iva mahābhāga cacāra sumahat tapaḥ / vareṇa chandayāmāsa tripurāntakaraḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.sanskrit: भोः करञ्ज महासत्त्व परितुष्टो ऽस्मि ते ऽनघ । वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते यत् ते मनसि वर्तते
verses.transliteration: bhoḥ karañja mahāsattva parituṣṭo 'smi te 'nagha / varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yat te manasi vartate

verses.sanskrit: करञ्ज उवाच: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि मे देव त्रिपुरान्तकर प्रभो । ततः पुत्रैश् च पौत्रैश् च सहितं मे धनं कुरु
verses.transliteration: karañja uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva tripurāntakara prabho / tataḥ putraiś ca pautraiś ca sahitaṃ me dhanaṃ kuru

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा महादेव उमया सहितस् तदा । वृषारूढो गणैः सार्धं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā mahādeva umayā sahitas tadā / vṛṣārūḍho gaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata

verses.sanskrit: गते चादर्शनं देवे सो ऽपि दैत्यो मुदान्वितः । स्वनाम्ना च महादेवं स्थापयित्वा गृहं ययौ
verses.transliteration: gate cādarśanaṃ deve so 'pi daityo mudānvitaḥ / svanāmnā ca mahādevaṃ sthāpayitvā gṛhaṃ yayau

verses.sanskrit: तदा प्रभृति तत्तीर्थं करञ्जेश्वरम् उत्तमम् । स्नानमात्रो नरो राजन् मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया
verses.transliteration: tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ karañjeśvaram uttamam / snānamātro naro rājan mucyate brahmahatyayā

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस् तीर्थे महाराज तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः । सो ऽग्निष्टोमस्य यत्पुण्यं फलं प्राप्नोत्य् असंशयम्
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃs tīrthe mahārāja tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / so 'gniṣṭomasya yatpuṇyaṃ phalaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.sanskrit: अनाशकं तु यः कुर्यात् तस्मिंस् तीर्थे नरोत्तम
verses.transliteration: anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃs tīrthe narottama

verses.sanskrit: अथाग्नौ च जले प्राणान् भूतले वापि यस् त्यजेत् । स्वर्गे स तु वसेन् नूनं वर्षाणाम् अयुतद्वयम्
verses.transliteration: athāgnau ca jale prāṇān bhūtale vāpi yas tyajet / svarge sa tu vasen nūnaṃ varṣāṇām ayutadvayam

verses.transliteration: dhanavān sukule cānte jāyate vipule kule / vedavedāṅgatattvajñaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.sanskrit: राजा वा राजतुल्यो वा जायते नात्र संशयः । पुत्रपौत्रसमायुक्तः सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: rājā vā rājatulyo vā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / putrapautrasamāyuktaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Bhimesvara Tlrtha, which destroys all sins. It is resorted to by the groups of sages who are splendid and regular performers of severe Vratas.

verses.transliteration: etat te sarvamākhyātaṃ yat tvaṃ māṃ paripṛcchasi / tīrthasya tu phalaṃ yuktyā sarvadāneṣu bhārata

verses.transliteration: etat puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥkhapraṇāśanam / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva tīrthamāhātmyam uttamam

verses.sanskrit: यस् तु श्रावयते श्राद्धे स तत्पितृपरायणः । अक्षयं तस्य सर्वं स्याच् छङ्करस् त्व् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: yas tu śrāvayate śrāddhe sa tatpitṛparāyaṇaḥ / akṣayaṃ tasya sarvaṃ syāc chaṅkaras tv idam abravīt

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे करञ्जेश्वरमहिमानुवर्णनो नाम सप्तसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ७८ अथ अष्टसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेच् च राजेन्द्र कुण्डलेश्वरम् उत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धिं गतो देवः कुण्डधारो नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe karañjeśvaramahimānuvarṇano nāma saptasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 78 atha aṣṭasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchec ca rājendra kuṇḍaleśvaram uttamam / yatra siddhiṃ gato devaḥ kuṇḍadhāro nṛpottama
verses.translation: Thereafter, a person should go to the excellent Naradesvara Tirtha, O great king. It is the greatest of all Tirthas, established by Narada.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, a person should go to the excellent Naradesvara Tirtha, O great king. It is the greatest of all Tirthas, established by Narada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, a person should go to the excellent Naradesvara Tirtha, O great king. It is the greatest of all Tirthas, established by Narada.

verses.sanskrit: तपः कृत्वा तु विपुलं सुरासुरभयं करम् । कुण्डधारो मन्दरस्थः क्रीडते स नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: tapaḥ kṛtvā tu vipulaṃ surāsurabhayaṃ karam / kuṇḍadhāro mandarasthaḥ krīḍate sa nṛpottama
verses.translation: In human bodies, there are ten Nadis. Out of them Id&, Pirigala and Suumpa are the main ones. Susumna is the most important as it leads to God-reatization. There is no appropriate equivalent term in English as some of the Nadis carry life breath and not blood.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कस्यान्वये समुत्पन्नः कस्य पुत्रो महामतिः । तपस् तप्त्वा सुविपुलं तोषितो येन शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kasyānvaye samutpannaḥ kasya putro mahāmatiḥ / tapas taptvā suvipulaṃ toṣito yena śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: O Narada, undoubtedly everything shall occur thus. What has been thought of by you will be achieved. There is no doubt about it.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: etad vistaratas tāta kathayasva mamānagha / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā tretāyuge rājan paulastyo nāma viśravāḥ

verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe pañcaliṅgamahimānuvarṇano nāmaikāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 82 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: athānyat kathayiṣyāmi tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / mayūrakukkuṭaṃ nāma brahmahatyā vyapohanam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the excellent Vahni TIrtha where the highly refulgent Hutasana performed penance and became a Siddha. Formerly he had been made one that eats everything by a (certain) sage in Dandaka. But Hutasana resorted to the banks of Narmada and became pu- rified.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मृकण्डस्याश्रमं पुण्यं नर्मदादक्षिणे तटे । मृकण्डो नाम भूपाल ऋषिः परमधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: mṛkaṇḍasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe / mṛkaṇḍo nāma bhūpāla ṛṣiḥ paramadhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: The benefit that is obtained in Dadhiskanda, Madhu- skanda, Nandisa, Varunalaya and Agneya is obtained merely by taking holy bath in that Tirtha. Those by whom the five exces- sively meritorious Narmada Tirthas have been visited, are worthy of being saluted. They are blessed in the world of human beings and their wishes have been fulfilled.

verses.transliteration: maṇḍūkāḥ pāpavṛkṣāś ca mṛtā yānti śivaṃ padam

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे मृकण्डाश्रमकीर्तनो नाम द्व्यशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ८३ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो ऽन्यत् परमं तीर्थं चन्द्रमत्यास् तु सङ्गमे । चन्द्रेश्वरं सिद्धलिङ्गं तथा सिद्धेश्वरं पुनः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe mṛkaṇḍāśramakīrtano nāma dvyaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 83 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato 'nyat paramaṃ tīrthaṃ candramatyās tu saṅgame / candreśvaraṃ siddhaliṅgaṃ tathā siddheśvaraṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: Then, O great king, one should go the extremely splendid Tirtha reputed as destructive of the sin of Brahmana- slaughter. It is installed on the banks of Reva. Here is an excellent Linga named Hanumanta 1.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: घण्टेश्वरं महिषेशम् अश्वतीर्थम् अतः परम् । वृषसेनं हयग्रीवं शुकतीर्थम् अतः परम्
verses.transliteration: ghaṇṭeśvaraṃ mahiṣeśam aśvatīrtham ataḥ param / vṛṣasenaṃ hayagrīvaṃ śukatīrtham ataḥ param
verses.translation: I can never be conquered by monkeys, men, bears, boars etc. devoid of arms, nor by groups of Devas and Asuras.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: रमेश्वरं ततो गच्छेत् तीर्थं पापप्रणाशनम् । मेकलायास् तटे राजन् महापातकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: rameśvaraṃ tato gacchet tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / mekalāyās taṭe rājan mahāpātakanāśanam
verses.translation: Was not (the river) born of Rudra's body and sta- tioned in the earth heard of by you? By listening to her name, the sin incurred in the course of a birth perishes. By glorifying her twice the sin is destroyed. By taking bath in Reva, the sin acquired in the course of thirty births becomes annihilated. Hence go to the banks of Narmada and perform a severe penance.

verses.transliteration: yadā dāruvane pūrvaṃ mahādevena mohitāḥ / brāhmaṇānāṃ striyas tatra ramamāṇāḥ samāgatāḥ

verses.transliteration: strīṇāṃ uvāca deveśaḥ śāpamokṣo bhavatv iti / gacchantu sarvāḥ svagṛhaṃ sāmprataṃ gatakalmaṣāḥ

verses.transliteration: ityuktvā devadeveśas tatraivāntaradhīyata / tasmiṃs tīrthe naraḥ snātvā sa bhave na punarbhavet
verses.translation: In the dark half of Asvina on the lunar day pertain- ing to Tripurari (i.e. 14th day) bathe the Trident-bearing Lord devoutly and keep awake at night. verses.sanskrit: अनाशकेन चाग्नौ हि ये मृता न पुनर्भवाः । तिलोदकं पितॄणां तु पिण्डदानं यथाविधि

verses.sanskrit: गते तस्मिन् देवलोके धनुर्बाणौ जले स्थितौ । चत्वार्य् एतानि लिङ्गानि ख्यातानि भुवनत्रये
verses.transliteration: gate tasmin devaloke dhanurbāṇau jale sthitau / catvāry etāni liṅgāni khyātāni bhuvanatraye

verses.transliteration: hariṇeśvaraṃ ca bāṇeśaṃ lubdheśaṃ dhanurīśvaram / rameśvaraṃ pañcamaṃ tu pañcaliṅgāni kīrtayet

verses.transliteration: na tasya punarāvṛttir ghore saṃsārasāgare / tasmiṃs tīrthe naro rājan snātvā śivapuraṃ vrajet

verses.transliteration: brahmahatyādi pāpāni vilayaṃ yānti pārthiva / anāśake cārdhajale mṛtaḥ śivamavāpnuyāt

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे रमेश्वरहरिणेश्वरलुब्धकेश्वरधनुरीश्वरबाणेश्वरकथनो नाम त्र्यशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ८४ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: तत्र स्नात्वा तु भक्त्या य उपवासपरायणः । क्षपाजागरणं कुर्याद् दद्याद् दानं च यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe rameśvarahariṇeśvaralubdhakeśvaradhanurīśvarabāṇeśvarakathano nāma tryaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 84 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tatra snātvā tu bhaktyā ya upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / kṣapājāgaraṇaṃ kuryād dadyād dānaṃ ca yatnataḥ
verses.translation: In this context they cite an ancient legend. On the Kailasa Mountain this was recounted by Siva to Sanmukha who had devoutly asked him.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: In this context they cite an ancient legend. On the Kailasa Mountain this was recounted by Siva to Sanmukha who had devoutly asked him.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this context they cite an ancient legend. On the Kailasa Mountain this was recounted by Siva to Sanmukha who had devoutly asked him.

verses.sanskrit: देवस्य स्नपनं कुर्याद् अमृतैः पञ्चभिस् तथा । समालभेद् यथाशक्त्या पूजां कृत्वा विधानतः
verses.transliteration: devasya snapanaṃ kuryād amṛtaiḥ pañcabhis tathā / samālabhed yathāśaktyā pūjāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: O Nandin, was it any sin that I committed, when I was carrying out the task of Devas? Of course the wicked Raksasas who desecrated the Yajnas of the Brahmanas were killed.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: पात्रं परीक्ष्य दातव्यम् आत्मनः श्रेय इच्छता । पितरस् तस्य तृप्यन्ति द्वादशाब्दं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: pātraṃ parīkṣya dātavyam ātmanaḥ śreya icchatā / pitaras tasya tṛpyanti dvādaśābdaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: All the sins of that person who takes his holy bath there devoutly and worships the Liriga, perish as averred by Hara himself.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: All the sins of that person who takes his holy bath there devoutly and worships the Liriga, perish as averred by Hara himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the sins of that person who takes his holy bath there devoutly and worships the Liriga, perish as averred by Hara himself.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छति तत्र दाता च यत्र देवो निरञ्जनः । गृहमध्ये प्रविष्टस् तु स्मरन् नामास्य शक्तितः
verses.transliteration: gacchati tatra dātā ca yatra devo nirañjanaḥ / gṛhamadhye praviṣṭas tu smaran nāmāsya śaktitaḥ
verses.translation: In order to enhance the glory of Rama, the Lord granted another boon. On the twenty-fourth year of his pen- ance, Rama attained relief from sins, when Saturn was in Kanya (Virgo) Zodiac along with Jupiter (Guru). Hence the Devas proclaimed gladly that the Devayatra (divine procession) shall be conducted at that time.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: नीलाद्रौ तु च यत्पुण्यं तत् समस्तं लभेत सः । शूलभेदे च यः कुर्याच् छ्राद्धं पर्वणि पर्वणि
verses.transliteration: nīlādrau tu ca yatpuṇyaṃ tat samastaṃ labheta saḥ / śūlabhede ca yaḥ kuryāc chrāddhaṃ parvaṇi parvaṇi
verses.translation: This is spoken by the Lord, that the Devayatra should be conducted in the twenty-fourth year as in the case of Godavari Yatra as per bidding of the sages.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: विशेषाच् चैव मासान्ते तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु । केदारे चैव यत्पुण्यं कुब्जायां च तथा नृप
verses.transliteration: viśeṣāc caiva māsānte tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / kedāre caiva yatpuṇyaṃ kubjāyāṃ ca tathā nṛpa
verses.translation: Accompanied by sages, people, deities and the members of his family, and after making a gold idol of Sita, he performed a sacrifice there at that Tirtha. That Tlrtha was created formerly in Tretayuga, and named after Skanda. Hence the Linga should be regularly visited by people.

verses.transliteration: asmiṃs tīrthe tathā puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ / vidhimantrasamāyuktaṃ tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ

verses.transliteration: vārijaṃ saumyam āgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ pārthivaṃ punaḥ / vānaspatyaṃ bhavet puṣpaṃ prājāpatyaṃ tu saptamam

verses.sanskrit: अष्टमं शिवपुष्पं च शृण्व् एतेषां विनिर्णयम् । वारिजं सलिलं ज्ञेयं सौम्यं मधुयुतं पयः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭamaṃ śivapuṣpaṃ ca śṛṇv eteṣāṃ vinirṇayam / vārijaṃ salilaṃ jñeyaṃ saumyaṃ madhuyutaṃ payaḥ
verses.translation: Accompanied by sages, people, deities and the members of his family, and after making a gold idol of Sita, he performed a sacrifice there at that Tirtha. That Tlrtha was created formerly in Tretayuga, and named after Skanda. Hence the Linga should be regularly visited by people.

verses.transliteration: evamuktās surās sarve kathayanti sma tattvataḥ / pradarśayanti cāṅgāni vepamānās tv adhomukhāḥ

verses.sanskrit: पितेव पुत्रान् परिरक्ष देव जहीह शत्रुं सह पुत्रगोत्रैः । तथेति चोक्त्वा कमलासनं प्रभुः सुरासुरैर् वन्दितपादपीठः
verses.transliteration: piteva putrān parirakṣa deva jahīha śatruṃ saha putragotraiḥ / tatheti coktvā kamalāsanaṃ prabhuḥ surāsurair vanditapādapīṭhaḥ

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे ऽन्धकोपाख्याने चतुरशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ८५ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: शङ्खं चक्रं गदां पाशं संगृह्य परमेश्वरः । उत्थितः शयनात् तूर्णं देवानां च जयप्रदः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe 'ndhakopākhyāne caturaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 85 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ pāśaṃ saṃgṛhya parameśvaraḥ / utthitaḥ śayanāt tūrṇaṃ devānāṃ ca jayapradaḥ
verses.translation: Then, O great king, one should go to the age-old TTrtha of Narmada that destroys even the sin of Brahmana- slaughter. It is on a par with Varanasi.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Then, O great king, one should go to the age-old TTrtha of Narmada that destroys even the sin of Brahmana- slaughter. It is on a par with Varanasi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, O great king, one should go to the age-old TTrtha of Narmada that destroys even the sin of Brahmana- slaughter. It is on a par with Varanasi.

verses.sanskrit: केशव उवाच: पाताले यदि वा स्वर्गे मर्त्ये वा यदि वा सुराः । अन्धकं तं वधिष्यामि येन सन्तापितास् सुराः
verses.transliteration: keśava uvāca: pātāle yadi vā svarge martye vā yadi vā surāḥ / andhakaṃ taṃ vadhiṣyāmi yena santāpitās surāḥ
verses.translation: O venerable Lord, tell me succinctly the power of Somanatha. You have come to us, O excellent Brihmana, as the saviour of those who are submerged in the ocean of misery.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O venerable Lord, tell me succinctly the power of Somanatha. You have come to us, O excellent Brihmana, as the saviour of those who are submerged in the ocean of misery.
verses.commentary: Sense: O venerable Lord, tell me succinctly the power of Somanatha. You have come to us, O excellent Brihmana, as the saviour of those who are submerged in the ocean of misery.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन्तु स्वगृहं देवास् सन्तोषे भावितात्मनः । विष्णोस् तु वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्माद्यास् तु सवासवाः
verses.transliteration: gacchantu svagṛhaṃ devās santoṣe bhāvitātmanaḥ / viṣṇos tu vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmādyās tu savāsavāḥ
verses.translation: With great devotion, Soman£tha was adored by him, O Yudhi$thira. He drank the excessively pure waters that destroy all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: With great devotion, Soman£tha was adored by him, O Yudhi$thira. He drank the excessively pure waters that destroy all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great devotion, Soman£tha was adored by him, O Yudhi$thira. He drank the excessively pure waters that destroy all sins.

verses.sanskrit: स्वं स्वं यानं समारुह्य हृदि तुष्टा दिवं ययुः । ततो देवो माधवस् तु यत्र तिष्ठति चान्धकः
verses.transliteration: svaṃ svaṃ yānaṃ samāruhya hṛdi tuṣṭā divaṃ yayuḥ / tato devo mādhavas tu yatra tiṣṭhati cāndhakaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmana, may this message be heard. If you are going towards the confluence, my husband is staying there. Send him to me quickly saying, "Your wife is waiting alone in the middle of the forest."
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा हृषीकेश आग्नेयास्त्रं मुमोच ह । दृष्ट्वा ज्वलन्तं चाग्नेयं केशवेन विसर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvā hṛṣīkeśa āgneyāstraṃ mumoca ha / dṛṣṭvā jvalantaṃ cāgneyaṃ keśavena visarjitam
verses.translation: She is in the park itself half a Krosa away from the confluence.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: She is in the park itself half a Krosa away from the confluence.
verses.commentary: Sense: She is in the park itself half a Krosa away from the confluence.

verses.sanskrit: विसर्जयामास तदा वारुणं चास्त्रम् उत्तमम् । वारुणास्त्रेण बाणेन आग्नेय शोषितं तदा
verses.transliteration: visarjayāmāsa tadā vāruṇaṃ cāstram uttamam / vāruṇāstreṇa bāṇena āgneya śoṣitaṃ tadā
verses.translation: O Lord, why do you grieve? Whether it is auspi- cious or inauspicious, it has already been acquired.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: अन्धकश् चिन्तयामास केन बाणो विसर्जितः । कस्येयं पौरुषी शक्तिः को यास्यति यमालयम्
verses.transliteration: andhakaś cintayāmāsa kena bāṇo visarjitaḥ / kasyeyaṃ pauruṣī śaktiḥ ko yāsyati yamālayam
verses.translation: If a person with his sense-organs under control goes to Somatlrtha on a day of eclipse, he shall become a righteous king even after falling down from Satyaloka. His residence shall always be there. It never perishes. His son becomes long- lived. His wife is always favourably disposed towards Kim. He shall be free from all miseries and shall live more than a hundred years.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽन्धकः कोपयुक्तो बाणमार्गस्य संचरन् । दृष्ट्वा युद्धपथे प्राप्तं देवं तं चान्धको ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tato 'ndhakaḥ kopayukto bāṇamārgasya saṃcaran / dṛṣṭvā yuddhapathe prāptaṃ devaṃ taṃ cāndhako 'bravīt
verses.translation: There is no doubt that a slayer of a Brahmana, an imbiber of liquor, one who resorts to the wife of the preceptor, a killer of foetus, one who steals gold — all these are rid of their sins. A person with the sense-organs subdued, who listens to this narrative of the Tirtha, becomes rid of the ailment if he is sick and if he is not sick attains happiness.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: hṛṣīkeśāya keśāya jagaddhātre 'cyutāya ca / namaḥ paṅkajanābhāya namaḥ paṅkajamāline

verses.transliteration: etadicchāmy ahaṃ sarvaṃ yadi dāsyasi śaṅkara / śūlāgrastho vadad yāvat tāvat tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे ऽन्धकवरप्रदानो नाम पञ्चाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ८६ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अन्धकस्य वरं दत्त्वा तेनैव सह शङ्करः । उमया सहितश्चापि कैलासं पर्वतं गतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe 'ndhakavarapradāno nāma pañcāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 86 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: andhakasya varaṃ dattvā tenaiva saha śaṅkaraḥ / umayā sahitaścāpi kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the excel- lent Pingalavarta. It is on the northern bank in the vicinity of the confluence. O leading king, Pingalesvara was installed by Havyavahana (Fire-god).
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: ततस् समागता देवा ब्रह्माद्यास् सह वासवाः । हृष्टपुष्टाश् च ते सर्वे महेश तं प्रणेमिरे
verses.transliteration: tatas samāgatā devā brahmādyās saha vāsavāḥ / hṛṣṭapuṣṭāś ca te sarve maheśa taṃ praṇemire

verses.transliteration: raktena tasya me śūlaṃ nirmalaṃ ca na dṛśyate / kartavyaṃ kiṃ mayā cādya kathyatāṃ hi pitāmaha

verses.transliteration: sutas tu bhavato brahman yaścā 'sau nihato mayā / kartumicchāmyahaṃ samyak tīrthayātrāṃ na saṃśayaḥ

verses.transliteration: giriṃ bibheda śūlena tena bhinnaṃ rasātalam / nirmalaṃ cābhavac chūlaṃ na lepo dṛśyate kvacit

verses.transliteration: kecit kuṭumbacintāṃ tu kecic cintāṃ kṛṣīṣu ca / sevāṃ ca kurvate kecid dravyārjanaparāyaṇāḥ

verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedotpattirnāma ṣaḍaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 87 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: uttānapādo rājendra pṛcchati sma maheśvaram / siddhāś ca kīdṛśā deva apūjyāś caiva kīdṛśāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
