verses.transliteration: uttānapāda uvāca: vidhiś ca kīdṛśī deva kathaṃ śrāddhasya ca kriyā / dānaṃ ca dīyate yena tan mamākhyātum arhasi
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: देव उवाच: श्राद्धं कृत्वा गृहे भक्त्या सुस्नातो विजितेन्द्रियः । वाग्यतस् तर्पयेत् तावद् यावत् संख्यामलङ्घयन्
verses.transliteration: deva uvāca: śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā gṛhe bhaktyā susnāto vijitendriyaḥ / vāgyatas tarpayet tāvad yāvat saṃkhyāmalaṅghayan
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: शूलभेदं ततो गत्वा स्नानं कृत्वा यथाविधि । पञ्चस्थानेषु यः श्राद्धं हव्यकव्यादिभिश् चरेत्
verses.transliteration: śūlabhedaṃ tato gatvā snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi / pañcasthāneṣu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ havyakavyādibhiś caret
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डदानं च य कुर्यात् पायसैर् मधुसर्पिषा । तस्य तत्फलम् आप्नोति तस्मिंस् तीर्थे न संशयः
verses.transliteration: piṇḍadānaṃ ca ya kuryāt pāyasair madhusarpiṣā / tasya tatphalam āpnoti tasmiṃs tīrthe na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: उपानहौ च यो दद्याद् ब्राह्मणेभ्यो विशेषतः । गच्छेद् विमानमारूढस् त्व् अमरैः परिवारितः
verses.transliteration: upānahau ca yo dadyād brāhmaṇebhyo viśeṣataḥ / gacched vimānamārūḍhas tv amaraiḥ parivāritaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमं च गृहं दद्यात् सप्तधान्यैश् च पूरितम् । स स्वर्गलोके वसति काञ्चने भवनोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: uttamaṃ ca gṛhaṃ dadyāt saptadhānyaiś ca pūritam / sa svargaloke vasati kāñcane bhavanottame
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: तिलधेनुं च यो दद्यात् सवत्सां विधिपूर्वकम् । नाकपृष्ठे वसेत् तावद् यावद् आहूतसंप्लवम्
verses.transliteration: tiladhenuṃ ca yo dadyāt savatsāṃ vidhipūrvakam / nākapṛṣṭhe vaset tāvad yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: गृहे वा यदि वारण्ये तीर्थे वा कुपथेषु च । तोयम् अन्नं च यो दद्याद् यमलोकं न पश्यति
verses.transliteration: gṛhe vā yadi vāraṇye tīrthe vā kupatheṣu ca / toyam annaṃ ca yo dadyād yamalokaṃ na paśyati
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयं चान्नदानं च तोयभूमिस् तथैव च । अन्नदानात् परं दानं न भूतो न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: akṣayaṃ cānnadānaṃ ca toyabhūmis tathaiva ca / annadānāt paraṃ dānaṃ na bhūto na bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तानपाद उवाच: कन्यादानं कथं देव कर्तव्यं कथयस्व तत् । प्रतिग्रहं तथा तोष्यं कन्योद्वाहम् उपस्करम्
verses.transliteration: uttānapāda uvāca: kanyādānaṃ kathaṃ deva kartavyaṃ kathayasva tat / pratigrahaṃ tathā toṣyaṃ kanyodvāham upaskaram
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: दातव्यं कस्य वै दानं दत्तं भवति चाक्षयम् । उत्तमं मध्यमं वापि कनीयांसं कथंचन
verses.transliteration: dātavyaṃ kasya vai dānaṃ dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam / uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ vāpi kanīyāṃsaṃ kathaṃcana
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: राजसं तामसं वापि निःश्रेयसम् अथापि वा । ईश्वर उवाच: सर्वेषाम् एव दानानां कन्यादानं विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ vāpi niḥśreyasam athāpi vā / īśvara uvāca: sarveṣām eva dānānāṃ kanyādānaṃ viśiṣyate
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: यो दद्यात् परया भक्त्या अभिगम्य च यत्नतः । कुलीनस्य स्वरूपस्य गुणज्ञस्य विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: yo dadyāt parayā bhaktyā abhigamya ca yatnataḥ / kulīnasya svarūpasya guṇajñasya viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: सुलग्ने च मुहूर्ते च दद्यात् कन्याम् अलंकृताम् । अश्वान् नागांश् च वासांसि यो दद्याच् चैव भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: sulagne ca muhūrte ca dadyāt kanyām alaṃkṛtām / aśvān nāgāṃś ca vāsāṃsi yo dadyāc caiva bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वासो भवेत् तत्र पदं यत्र निरामयम् । येन सा दुहिता दत्ता प्राणेभ्यो ऽपि गरीयसी
verses.transliteration: tasya vāso bhavet tatra padaṃ yatra nirāmayam / yena sā duhitā dattā prāṇebhyo 'pi garīyasī
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: तेन सर्वम् इदं दत्तं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । धनं कन्यार्थतः कल्प्यो न रोचयति दुर्मतिः
verses.transliteration: tena sarvam idaṃ dattaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / dhanaṃ kanyārthataḥ kalpyo na rocayati durmatiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: स भवेत् कर्मचाण्डालः कोशकारो भवेन् मृतः । कन्यार्थं याचते यस् तु स धनी निर्धनो ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: sa bhavet karmacāṇḍālaḥ kośakāro bhaven mṛtaḥ / kanyārthaṃ yācate yas tu sa dhanī nirdhano 'pi vā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: अभोज्यो भवते मर्त्यः सर्ववस्तुषु वर्जितः । गृहे तस्य च यो ऽश्नीयाज् जिह्वालम्पटको नृप
verses.transliteration: abhojyo bhavate martyaḥ sarvavastuṣu varjitaḥ / gṛhe tasya ca yo 'śnīyāj jihvālampaṭako nṛpa
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: चान्द्रायणेन शुद्धः स्यात् तप्तकृच्छ्रम् अथापि वा । राजोवाच: वित्तं न विद्यते यस्य कन्योद्वाहे ऽवतिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: cāndrāyaṇena śuddhaḥ syāt taptakṛcchram athāpi vā / rājovāca: vittaṃ na vidyate yasya kanyodvāhe 'vatiṣṭhati
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: कथं चोद्वाहनं कुर्याद् एतद् आचक्ष्व मे प्रभो । देव उवाच: स्ववित्तेनानुकर्तव्यं कन्योद्वाहनम् एव च
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ codvāhanaṃ kuryād etad ācakṣva me prabho / deva uvāca: svavittenānukartavyaṃ kanyodvāhanam eva ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: कन्या नाम समुच्चार्य न दोषो याचकस्य च । अभिगम्योत्तमं दानम् आहूतं चैव मध्यमम्
verses.transliteration: kanyā nāma samuccārya na doṣo yācakasya ca / abhigamyottamaṃ dānam āhūtaṃ caiva madhyamam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: अधमं प्रोच्यमानं तु सेवादानं च निष्फलम् । असमर्थे न दातव्यं कन्यादानं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: adhamaṃ procyamānaṃ tu sevādānaṃ ca niṣphalam / asamarthe na dātavyaṃ kanyādānaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: समर्थस् तारयेद् विद्वान् काष्ठं क्षिप्तं यथा जले । यथा नौका तथा विद्वांस् तारयेत् परमं तटम्
verses.transliteration: samarthas tārayed vidvān kāṣṭhaṃ kṣiptaṃ yathā jale / yathā naukā tathā vidvāṃs tārayet paramaṃ taṭam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: आहिताग्निस् तु यो भूत्वा गृह्नञ् शूद्रप्रतिग्रहम् । इह जन्मनि शूद्रत्वं मृतः श्वा चोपजायते
verses.transliteration: āhitāgnis tu yo bhūtvā gṛhnañ śūdrapratigraham / iha janmani śūdratvaṃ mṛtaḥ śvā copajāyate
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: वृथा क्लेशाश् च जायन्ते ब्राह्मणस्याग्निहोत्रिणः । असत् प्रतिग्रहं गृह्णन् नापदं च विना द्विजः
verses.transliteration: vṛthā kleśāś ca jāyante brāhmaṇasyāgnihotriṇaḥ / asat pratigrahaṃ gṛhṇan nāpadaṃ ca vinā dvijaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सर्वं नाशयेत् तस्य भिन्ना नौका यथाम्भसि । अतिक्लेशवशार्जितं विनाशयति तत्क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: tatsarvaṃ nāśayet tasya bhinnā naukā yathāmbhasi / atikleśavaśārjitaṃ vināśayati tatkṣaṇāt
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: एवं दुःखार्जितं पुण्यं शूद्रे गच्छति नान्यथा । लक्षदाक्षिण्यलाभाय प्रदानं चापराधकम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ duḥkhārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ śūdre gacchati nānyathā / lakṣadākṣiṇyalābhāya pradānaṃ cāparādhakam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: कीर्तिपात्रेषु यद् दत्तं वृथा भवति पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: kīrtipātreṣu yad dattaṃ vṛthā bhavati pārthiva
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly excellent Tirtha which was established by the groups of sages born of the family of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे दानमहिमानुवर्णनं नाम सप्ताशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ८८ उत्तानपाद उवाच: कस्मिन् काले च क्रियते श्राद्धं दानं च शङ्कर । तीर्थयात्रा कथं कार्या आतिथ्यं कथयस्व नः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe dānamahimānuvarṇanaṃ nāma saptāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 88 uttānapāda uvāca: kasmin kāle ca kriyate śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ ca śaṅkara / tīrthayātrā kathaṃ kāryā ātithyaṃ kathayasva naḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कर उवाच: पितुरर्थं यथा पुण्यं सार्वकालिकम् उत्तमम् । इदं तीर्थं तथा पुण्यं स्नानदानादितर्पणैः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkara uvāca: piturarthaṃ yathā puṇyaṃ sārvakālikam uttamam / idaṃ tīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ snānadānāditarpaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषेण च कुर्वन्ति श्राद्धं चतुर्युगादिषु । मन्वन्तरादयो वत्स श्रूयतां च चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: viśeṣeṇa ca kurvanti śrāddhaṃ caturyugādiṣu / manvantarādayo vatsa śrūyatāṃ ca caturdaśa
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: आश्विने नवमी शुक्ला द्वादशी कार्तिकस्य च । तृतीया चैत्रमासे तु तथा भाद्रपदस्य च
verses.transliteration: āśvine navamī śuklā dvādaśī kārtikasya ca / tṛtīyā caitramāse tu tathā bhādrapadasya ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: आषाढदशमी तथा माघस्यैव चसप्तमी । श्रावणस्याष्टमी कृष्णा तथाषाढी तु पूर्णिमा
verses.transliteration: āṣāḍhadaśamī tathā māghasyaiva casaptamī / śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhī tu pūrṇimā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: फाल्गुनस्य अमावास्या पौषस्यैकादशी शुभा । कार्त्तिकी फाल्गुनी चैत्री ज्यैष्ठी पञ्चदशी सिता
verses.transliteration: phālgunasya amāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī śubhā / kārttikī phālgunī caitrī jyaiṣṭhī pañcadaśī sitā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरादयश् चैव ह्यनन्तफलदाः स्मृताः । अयने तूत्तरे चैव दक्षिणे च तथैव हि
verses.transliteration: manvantarādayaś caiva hyanantaphaladāḥ smṛtāḥ / ayane tūttare caiva dakṣiṇe ca tathaiva hi
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: कार्त्तिक्यां च तथा माध्यां वैशाख्यां च तृतीयया । चैत्र्यां चैव तथा षष्ठ्यां प्रौष्ठपद्यां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: kārttikyāṃ ca tathā mādhyāṃ vaiśākhyāṃ ca tṛtīyayā / caitryāṃ caiva tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prauṣṭhapadyāṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धकालाश् च ते सर्वे दत्तं भवति चाक्षयम् । मधुमासे सिते पक्ष एकादश्याम् उपोषितः
verses.transliteration: śrāddhakālāś ca te sarve dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam / madhumāse site pakṣa ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: क्षपाजागरणं कुर्याद् विष्णोः पदसमीपतः । दद्याद् दानं तथा शक्त्या हिरण्यं गो ऽम्बराणि च
verses.transliteration: kṣapājāgaraṇaṃ kuryād viṣṇoḥ padasamīpataḥ / dadyād dānaṃ tathā śaktyā hiraṇyaṃ go 'mbarāṇi ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: धूपं दीपं च नैवेद्यं स्रक्पुष्पचन्दनानि च । अर्चां करोति यो विष्णोः कथां पौराणकीर्तनम्
verses.transliteration: dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ srakpuṣpacandanāni ca / arcāṃ karoti yo viṣṇoḥ kathāṃ paurāṇakīrtanam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्यजुःसामाथर्वाणां सूक्तं तज् जपति द्विजः । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvāṇāṃ sūktaṃ taj japati dvijaḥ / sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.transliteration: prabhāte kurute śrāddhaṃ dvijān bhojya prayatnataḥ / daded dānaṃ yathā śaktyā hiraṇyaṃ go 'mbarāṇi ca

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोदश्यां ततो गच्छेद् गुहावासीति तिष्ठति । दृष्ट्वा मार्कण्डमीशानं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: trayodaśyāṃ tato gacched guhāvāsīti tiṣṭhati / dṛṣṭvā mārkaṇḍamīśānaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

verses.sanskrit: उत्तानपाद उवाच: गुहामध्ये यथा देव लिङ्गं परमशोभनम् । प्रतिष्ठा येन देवस्य तन् ममाख्यातुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: uttānapāda uvāca: guhāmadhye yathā deva liṅgaṃ paramaśobhanam / pratiṣṭhā yena devasya tan mamākhyātum arhasi

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्यातं मार्कण्डेश्वरसंज्ञिकम् । बृहद्रथान्तरं यच् च सामवेदं द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ mārkaṇḍeśvarasaṃjñikam / bṛhadrathāntaraṃ yac ca sāmavedaṃ dvijottamaḥ

verses.sanskrit: अथर्वाथर्वशीर्षाणि तथा हृच्च वृषाकपिम् । शिवसंकल्पितं जप्त्वा मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: atharvātharvaśīrṣāṇi tathā hṛcca vṛṣākapim / śivasaṃkalpitaṃ japtvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ

verses.sanskrit: स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो महेश्वरः । पादशौचं तथा तस्य कुर्वते ये च भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ / pādaśaucaṃ tathā tasya kurvate ye ca bhaktitaḥ

verses.sanskrit: गोदानेनैव यत्पुण्यं लभन्ते ना ऽत्र संशयः । ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेत् तत्र पायसैर् मधुसर्पिषा
verses.transliteration: godānenaiva yatpuṇyaṃ labhante nā 'tra saṃśayaḥ / brāhmaṇān bhojayet tatra pāyasair madhusarpiṣā

verses.sanskrit: एकेन भोजितेनापि सहस्रं तेन भोजितम् । सुवर्णं रजतं वस्त्रं दद्याद् भक्त्या द्विजातिषु
verses.transliteration: ekena bhojitenāpi sahasraṃ tena bhojitam / suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ dadyād bhaktyā dvijātiṣu

verses.sanskrit: तेन तृप्यन्ति ते देवा मनुष्याः पितरस् तथा । चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहे भक्त्या स्नानं कुर्वन्ति ये नराः
verses.transliteration: tena tṛpyanti te devā manuṣyāḥ pitaras tathā / candrasūryagrahe bhaktyā snānaṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ

verses.sanskrit: देवार्चनं च यः कुर्याज् जपं होमं विशेषतः । दह्याद् दानं यथाशक्त्या ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे
verses.transliteration: devārcanaṃ ca yaḥ kuryāj japaṃ homaṃ viśeṣataḥ / dahyād dānaṃ yathāśaktyā brāhmaṇe vedapārage

verses.sanskrit: अश्वरत्नं गजरत्नं तूलापुरुषम् एव च । यो दद्याच् छकटं तत्र सप्तधान्यप्रपूरितम्
verses.transliteration: aśvaratnaṃ gajaratnaṃ tūlāpuruṣam eva ca / yo dadyāc chakaṭaṃ tatra saptadhānyaprapūritam

verses.transliteration: yuktaṃ ca lāṅgalaṃ dadyād yuvānau tu dhurandharau / gobhūtilahiraṇyaṃ ca pātre dātavyam īpsitam

verses.sanskrit: अपात्रे विदुषा किंचित् न देयं श्रेय इच्छता । सर्वभूतानि चात्मैव यतो धारयते मही
verses.transliteration: apātre viduṣā kiṃcit na deyaṃ śreya icchatā / sarvabhūtāni cātmaiva yato dhārayate mahī

verses.sanskrit: ततो विप्राय सा देया सर्वसस्यानुशालिनी । अन्यच् च शृणु राजेन्द्र गोदानस्य च यत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: tato viprāya sā deyā sarvasasyānuśālinī / anyac ca śṛṇu rājendra godānasya ca yatphalam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: यावद् वत्सस्य पादौ द्वौ मुखं योन्यां च दृश्यते । तावद् गौः पृथिवी ज्ञेया यावद् गर्भं न मुञ्चति
verses.transliteration: yāvad vatsasya pādau dvau mukhaṃ yonyāṃ ca dṛśyate / tāvad gauḥ pṛthivī jñeyā yāvad garbhaṃ na muñcati
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: येन केनाप्य् उपायेन ब्राह्मणाय समर्पयेत् । पृथ्वी दत्ता भवेत् तेन सशैलवनकानना
verses.transliteration: yena kenāpy upāyena brāhmaṇāya samarpayet / pṛthvī dattā bhavet tena saśailavanakānanā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: तारयन्ती च सा दत्ता कुलानाम् एकविंशतिम् । रौप्यखुरीं कांस्यदोहां सवत्सां च पयस्विनीम्
verses.transliteration: tārayantī ca sā dattā kulānām ekaviṃśatim / raupyakhurīṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ savatsāṃ ca payasvinīm
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.transliteration: prayacchanti janāḥ puṇyā rāhugraste niśākare / sarvasyaiva tu dānasya saṃkhyā cāsti narādhipa
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रसूर्योपरागे च दानसंख्या न विद्यते । यत्र गावः प्रदृश्यन्ते सर्वतीर्थानि तत्र वै
verses.transliteration: candrasūryoparāge ca dānasaṃkhyā na vidyate / yatra gāvaḥ pradṛśyante sarvatīrthāni tatra vai
verses.translation: Thereafter, O son of Kuntl, a person should resort to the Kapila Tirtha installed by Kapila. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the excellent Putikesvara which is destructive of all sins. It is situ- ated on the southern bank of Narmada. It was installed by Jambavanta who sought the welfare of all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: सा पुरी जनसम्पूर्णा नानारत्नोपशोभिता । वाराणासीति विख्याता गङ्गातीरे समाश्रिता
verses.transliteration: sā purī janasampūrṇā nānāratnopaśobhitā / vārāṇāsīti vikhyātā gaṅgātīre samāśritā
verses.translation: There appears some confusion of the author. According to BhP X.56.13- 14 a lion killed Prasenajit and took away the dazzling Syamantaka gem from him; Jambavan killed the lion and took away the gem. Here Jambavan is said to have taken the gem from the chest of Prasenajit; so it was Prasenajit who was wounded and the wound was healed at this Tirtha. So here ferns' stands for Prasenajit and not Jambavan unless we imagine that seeing the healing effect of the water of the Tirtha in the case of Prasenajit, Jambavan installed the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे दीर्घतपाख्यानो नामैकोननवतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ९० उत्तानपाद उवाच: दृष्ट्वा तत्तीर्थमाहात्म्यं चित्रसेनो नरेश्वरः । विपुलं तीक्ष्णधारं च कण्ठे चासि नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe dīrghatapākhyāno nāmaikonanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 90 uttānapāda uvāca: dṛṣṭvā tattīrthamāhātmyaṃ citraseno nareśvaraḥ / vipulaṃ tīkṣṇadhāraṃ ca kaṇṭhe cāsi nṛpottama
verses.translation: On the northern bank of Reva, there is an excellent Tirtha dedicated to Vi?nu. It's name Jalasdyi is well-known all over the earth.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: devān sarvān hṛdi dhyāyan brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān / vinikṣipannathātmānau pratyakṣau viṣṇuśaṅkarau
verses.translation: No such demon is known to Mbh, VR, and PE. This appears to be a new

verses.sanskrit: करे धृत्वा तु राजानं रुद्रो वचनम् अब्रवीत् । हर उवाच: प्राणत्यागं महाराज अकाले मा कुरुष्व ह
verses.transliteration: kare dhṛtvā tu rājānaṃ rudro vacanam abravīt / hara uvāca: prāṇatyāgaṃ mahārāja akāle mā kuruṣva ha
verses.translation: Welcome unto the group of Suras. Why? Your earlier brilliance has vanished? Your faces resemble the luminaries under the painful influence of overhanging mist and fog? The weapons of the Suras remain unmanifesl due to the disappear- ance of their lustre. The Kulisa (thunderbolt) of the Slayer of Vrtra appears as though its glory has been checked and mit- igated. Further, the noose in the hand of Pracetas (Varuna) which used to be impossible to ward off to the enemies has reduced to the helplessness of a serpent whose vigour and vitality has been checked by a Mantra (magic spell).
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: अद्यापि तु युवासि त्वं न युक्तं मरणं तव । स्वस्थानं गच्छ वै शीघ्रं भोगान् भुङ्क्ष्व यथेप्सितान्
verses.transliteration: adyāpi tu yuvāsi tvaṃ na yuktaṃ maraṇaṃ tava / svasthānaṃ gaccha vai śīghraṃ bhogān bhuṅkṣva yathepsitān
verses.translation: O Suras, except Lord MSdhava, there is no one among you who is on a par with that Talamegha. That Danava cannot be controlled by me too.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: भुङ्क्ष्व निष्कण्टकं राज्यं नाकं शक्र इवापरः । चित्रसेन उवाच: न राज्यं कामये देव न पुत्रान् न च बान्धवान्
verses.transliteration: bhuṅkṣva niṣkaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ nākaṃ śakra ivāparaḥ / citrasena uvāca: na rājyaṃ kāmaye deva na putrān na ca bāndhavān
verses.translation: That Lord of Danavas dwells in the caves of Himalaya surrounded by twenty-four thousand maidens and by innumer- able horses and chariots, O Krsna.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: न भार्यां न च कोशं च न गाश्च न तुरङ्गमान् । मुञ्चस्व मां महादेव अविघ्नं क्रियतां मम

verses.transliteration: svargaprāptir mamādyaiva tvatprasādān maheśvara / deva uvāca: yasyāgrato bhaved viṣṇurbrahmā rudras tathaiva ca
verses.translation: A pestle and % plough as weapons of war are associated with Balar&ma, Kona's elder lSrOther. They are shown to be Vi*Qu's weapons here!

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गेण तस्य किं कार्यं गतो ऽसौ किं करिष्यति । तुष्टाव त्वां त्रयो देवा वृणीष्व वरम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: svargeṇa tasya kiṃ kāryaṃ gato 'sau kiṃ kariṣyati / tuṣṭāva tvāṃ trayo devā vṛṇīṣva varam uttamam
verses.translation: O Dhundhumara, who is it that has unwittingly fallen into the clutches of Death without being aware of my power? O Dhundhumara, at my behest, go quickly, surrounded by your own army; bind that professedly mighty one and bring him to me forcibly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: यथेप्सितं महाराज सत्यम् एतन्न संशयः । चित्रसेन उवाच: यदि तुष्टास् त्रयो देवा ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: yathepsitaṃ mahārāja satyam etanna saṃśayaḥ / citrasena uvāca: yadi tuṣṭās trayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
verses.translation: The Danava discharged twice the number further

verses.sanskrit: अद्य प्रभृति युष्माभिः स्थातव्यम् इह सर्वदा । गयाशिरं यथा पुण्यं कृतं युष्माभिर् एव च
verses.transliteration: adya prabhṛti yuṣmābhiḥ sthātavyam iha sarvadā / gayāśiraṃ yathā puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ yuṣmābhir eva ca
verses.translation: Then the Devas let down a shower of flowers on Kesava (saying): "O Kesava, one who could not be killed by the groups of Suras, has been killed by you!" Then the Devas became normal and happy when Talamegha was felled down. O son of KuntI, Janardana resorted to the banks of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: तथैवेदं तु कर्तव्यं शूलभेदं च पावनम् । यत्र यत्र स्थिता यूयं तत्र तत्र वसाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: tathaivedaṃ tu kartavyaṃ śūlabhedaṃ ca pāvanam / yatra yatra sthitā yūyaṃ tatra tatra vasāmy aham
verses.translation: With great devotion, one should bathe the Lord with honey, milk, ghee or with water mixed with sugar candy. Those people bereft of jealousy who visit Janardana, the source of origin of the universe, the deity as being bathed, go to the greatest world bowed to by Suras and Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: गणानाम् इह सर्वेषाम् अवध्यो ऽहं सुरेश्वर । ईश्वर उवाच: अद्य प्रभृति तिष्ठाम शूलभेदे नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: gaṇānām iha sarveṣām avadhyo 'haṃ sureśvara / īśvara uvāca: adya prabhṛti tiṣṭhāma śūlabhede nareśvara

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यत्य् अग्रपूजा ते मत्समीपे सदा नृप । प्रक्षिप्य च निजास्थीनि यथा दीर्घतपा ययौ
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyaty agrapūjā te matsamīpe sadā nṛpa / prakṣipya ca nijāsthīni yathā dīrghatapā yayau
verses.translation: Tiladhenu purifies from all the following sins: those committed in the childhood; those unwittingly committed; ver- bal ones; physical ones; mental ones; the sins of spitting into water, crossing over a threshing rod, carnally approaching a Vrsall, the wife of the preceptor, a virgin etc.; stealing gold; and imbibing liquor. Other sins too are quelled.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: sakuṭumbo vimānasthaḥ svarge tiṣṭhati tatkuru / evaṃ devā varaṃ dattvā citrasenāya pārthiva
verses.translation: It should be given to one who has mastered the Vedanta, to a Srotriya having a large family. It should be given to a son of a master of Vedanta, to a householder, to a Brahmana of handsome features in all limbs, one of good conduct and pleasing words.

verses.transliteration: ātmano ghātakā ye ca goghnāḥ straiṇahatāś ca ye / daṃṣṭribhir jalapātena vidyutpātena ye hatāḥ

verses.transliteration: mokṣaprāptir bhavet teṣāṃ tristhāneṣu na saṃśayaḥ / tṛptis tu jāyate teṣāṃ varṣam ekaṃ na saṃśayaḥ

verses.transliteration: rajakena yathā dhautavastraṃ nirmalatāṃ vrajet / pāpopaliptas tīrthe 'smin snāto nirmalatāṃ vrajet

verses.transliteration: likhitvā tīrthamāhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadāti yaḥ / jātismaraṃ sa labhate prāpnoty abhimataṃ phalam

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे चित्रसेनकथावर्णनो नाम नवतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ९१ राजोवाच: अन्यच् च श्रोतुम् इच्छामि केन गङ्गावतारिता । रुद्रशीर्षस्थिता पुण्या देवी कथम् इहागता
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe citrasenakathāvarṇano nāma navatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 91 rājovāca: anyac ca śrotum icchāmi kena gaṅgāvatāritā / rudraśīrṣasthitā puṇyā devī katham ihāgatā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: पिबन्ति च जलं नित्यं न ते यान्ति यमालयम् । यत्र सा पतिता कुण्डे शूलभेदे नराधिप
verses.transliteration: pibanti ca jalaṃ nityaṃ na te yānti yamālayam / yatra sā patitā kuṇḍe śūlabhede narādhipa

verses.sanskrit: देवनद्याः प्रतीच्यां च यत्र प्राची सरस्वती । याम्यां च शूलभेदाख्यम् अस्ति तीर्थम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: devanadyāḥ pratīcyāṃ ca yatra prācī sarasvatī / yāmyāṃ ca śūlabhedākhyam asti tīrtham anuttamam

verses.sanskrit: तत्रदेवशिला रम्या स्वयं देवेन निर्मिता । तत्र स्नात्वा तु यो भक्त्या ब्राह्मणं भोजयेन् नृप
verses.transliteration: tatradevaśilā ramyā svayaṃ devena nirmitā / tatra snātvā tu yo bhaktyā brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayen nṛpa

verses.sanskrit: अल्पस्यैव तु दानस्य तस्य चान्तो न विद्यते । उत्तानपाद उवाच: कानि दानानि शस्तानि देवेश धरणीतले
verses.transliteration: alpasyaiva tu dānasya tasya cānto na vidyate / uttānapāda uvāca: kāni dānāni śastāni deveśa dharaṇītale

verses.sanskrit: यानि दत्त्वा नरो भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः । देवशिलाया माहात्म्यं स्नानदानाद्धि यत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: yāni dattvā naro bhaktyā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ / devaśilāyā māhātmyaṃ snānadānāddhi yatphalam

verses.sanskrit: व्रतोपवासनि यमैर् यत् प्राप्यं तद् वदस्व मे । श्रीभगवान् उवाच: आसीत् पुरा महावीर्यश्चेदिनाथो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: vratopavāsani yamair yat prāpyaṃ tad vadasva me / śrībhagavān uvāca: āsīt purā mahāvīryaścedinātho mahābalaḥ

verses.sanskrit: वीरसेन इति ख्यातो मण्डलाधिपतीश्वरः । तस्य राज्ये रिपुर्नास्ति न व्याधिर्न च तस्करः
verses.transliteration: vīrasena iti khyāto maṇḍalādhipatīśvaraḥ / tasya rājye ripurnāsti na vyādhirna ca taskaraḥ

verses.sanskrit: न चाधर्मो ऽभवत् तत्र धर्म एव हि सर्वदा । सदा मुदान्वितो राजा सभार्यो बहुपुत्रकः
verses.transliteration: na cādharmo 'bhavat tatra dharma eva hi sarvadā / sadā mudānvito rājā sabhāryo bahuputrakaḥ

verses.sanskrit: एका च दुहिता तस्य सुरूपा गिरिजा इव । दृष्टा सा पितृमातृभ्यां बन्धुवर्गजनैः सह
verses.transliteration: ekā ca duhitā tasya surūpā girijā iva / dṛṣṭā sā pitṛmātṛbhyāṃ bandhuvargajanaiḥ saha

verses.transliteration: kṛtvā vaivāhikaṃ kāryaṃ kāle prāpte yathā vidhi / anantaraṃ cedipatir dvādaśābde maheśvaraḥ

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तस्यास्तु यो भर्ता स मृत्युवशम् आगतः । विधवां तां सुतां दृष्ट्वा राजा शोकसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: tatas tasyāstu yo bhartā sa mṛtyuvaśam āgataḥ / vidhavāṃ tāṃ sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā śokasamanvitaḥ

verses.sanskrit: उवाच वचनं राजा स्वभार्यां दुःखपीडितः । भद्रे दुःखम् इदं जातं यावज् जीवं सुदुःसहम्
verses.transliteration: uvāca vacanaṃ rājā svabhāryāṃ duḥkhapīḍitaḥ / bhadre duḥkham idaṃ jātaṃ yāvaj jīvaṃ suduḥsaham

verses.sanskrit: नैषा रक्षयितुं शक्या रूपयौवनदर्पिता । नोपायो विद्यते भार्य्ये भानुमत्याश् च रक्षणे
verses.transliteration: naiṣā rakṣayituṃ śakyā rūpayauvanadarpitā / nopāyo vidyate bhāryye bhānumatyāś ca rakṣaṇe

verses.sanskrit: परस्परं विवदतोस् तच्छ्रुत्वा कन्यका ऽब्रवीत् । भानुमत्य् उवाच: न व्रीडामि तवाग्रे ऽहं ज्वलन्ती दाहकेनच
verses.transliteration: parasparaṃ vivadatos tacchrutvā kanyakā 'bravīt / bhānumaty uvāca: na vrīḍāmi tavāgre 'haṃ jvalantī dāhakenaca

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं नोत्पद्यते दोषो मदर्थे च नराधिप । अद्य प्रभृत्य् अहं तात न वेषं धारये क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: satyaṃ notpadyate doṣo madarthe ca narādhipa / adya prabhṛty ahaṃ tāta na veṣaṃ dhāraye kvacit

verses.sanskrit: स्थूलवस्त्रैर् निजाङ्गानि परिधास्यामि संयता । चरिष्यामि व्रतान् सर्वान् पुराणविहितान् अपि
verses.transliteration: sthūlavastrair nijāṅgāni paridhāsyāmi saṃyatā / cariṣyāmi vratān sarvān purāṇavihitān api

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं शोषयिष्यामि तोषयन्ती जनार्दनम् । ममैषा वर्तते बुद्धिर् यदि त्वं तात मन्यसे
verses.transliteration: ātmānaṃ śoṣayiṣyāmi toṣayantī janārdanam / mamaiṣā vartate buddhir yadi tvaṃ tāta manyase

verses.transliteration: prāptā sā sacivaiḥ sārddhaṃ yatra revā mahānadī / ṣaṇmāsaṃ ca sthitā tatra oṃkāre 'marakaṇṭake

verses.sanskrit: नानाविधेषु तीर्थेषु तीर्थात् तीर्थं जगाम ह । स्नात्वा स्नात्वा द्विजान् पूज्यभक्तियुक्ता ह्य् अधिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration: nānāvidheṣu tīrtheṣu tīrthāt tīrthaṃ jagāma ha / snātvā snātvā dvijān pūjyabhaktiyuktā hy adhiṣṭhitā

verses.sanskrit: वारुणीं च दिशं गत्वा देवनद्याश् च सङ्गमे । ददर्श चाश्रमं पुण्यम् ऋषिसङ्घैर् निषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: vāruṇīṃ ca diśaṃ gatvā devanadyāś ca saṅgame / dadarśa cāśramaṃ puṇyam ṛṣisaṅghair niṣevitam

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा ऋषिसमूहं सा प्रणिपत्येदम् अब्रवीत् । माहात्म्यं चास्य तीर्थस्य नाम चैवास्य कीर्तय
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā ṛṣisamūhaṃ sā praṇipatyedam abravīt / māhātmyaṃ cāsya tīrthasya nāma caivāsya kīrtaya

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिर् उवाच: चक्रतीर्थं तु विख्यातं चक्रं दत्तं पुरा हरेः । महेश्वरेण तुष्टेन देवदेवेन शूलिना
verses.transliteration: ṛṣir uvāca: cakratīrthaṃ tu vikhyātaṃ cakraṃ dattaṃ purā hareḥ / maheśvareṇa tuṣṭena devadevena śūlinā

verses.transliteration: dvitīye 'hni tato gacchec chūlabhedaṃ tapasvini / rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā paṭhet paurāṇikīṃ kathām

verses.transliteration: śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathā nyāyam anindyān pūjayed dvijān / pitarastasya tṛpyanti dvādaśābdaṃ na saṃśayaḥ

verses.transliteration: sarvadevamayaṃ sthānaṃ sarvatīrthamanuttamam / koṭitīrthasamaṃ sthānaṃ koṭiliṅgottamottamam

verses.transliteration: trirātraṃ kurute yas tu śuciḥ snānaṃ jitendriyaḥ / pakṣaṃ māsaṃ ca ṣaṇmāsam abdam ekaṃ kadācana

verses.transliteration: vinā pumāṃsaṃ yā nārī dvādaśābda tu suvratā / tiṣṭhate sākṣayaṃ kālaṃ rudraloke mahīyate

verses.sanskrit: मुनेश् च वचनं श्रुत्वा मुदां परमिकां ययौ । ततो ऽवगाहते तीर्थमहर्निशमतन्द्रितम्
verses.transliteration: muneś ca vacanaṃ śrutvā mudāṃ paramikāṃ yayau / tato 'vagāhate tīrthamaharniśamatandritam

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तीर्थप्रभावं तु राज्ञी वचनम् अब्रवीत् । श्रूयतां वचनं मे ऽद्य ब्राह्मणाः सपुरोहिताः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tīrthaprabhāvaṃ tu rājñī vacanam abravīt / śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ me 'dya brāhmaṇāḥ sapurohitāḥ

verses.sanskrit: न त्यजाम् ईदृशं स्थानं यावज् जीवाम्य् अहर्निशम् । मात्रे पित्रे तथा भ्रात्रे सद्भिर् वाच्यम् इदं वचः
verses.transliteration: na tyajām īdṛśaṃ sthānaṃ yāvaj jīvāmy aharniśam / mātre pitre tathā bhrātre sadbhir vācyam idaṃ vacaḥ

verses.sanskrit: वर्तते शूलभेदे सा नियता व्रतचारिणी । एकान्तरोपवासेन शनैर् मासमुपोषिता
verses.transliteration: vartate śūlabhede sā niyatā vratacāriṇī / ekāntaropavāsena śanair māsamupoṣitā

verses.sanskrit: देवशिलास्थिता नित्यं ध्यायमाना तु केशवम् । अहर्निशं स्थिता भूमौ दृष्टा राज्ञी शुभानना
verses.transliteration: devaśilāsthitā nityaṃ dhyāyamānā tu keśavam / aharniśaṃ sthitā bhūmau dṛṣṭā rājñī śubhānanā

verses.sanskrit: व्रतस्था नियताहारा नाम्ना भानुमती शुभा । गतेषु द्विजमुख्येष्व् आययौ शबरयुग्मकम्
verses.transliteration: vratasthā niyatāhārā nāmnā bhānumatī śubhā / gateṣu dvijamukhyeṣv āyayau śabarayugmakam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच वचनं तत्र तां दृष्ट्वा शबराङ्गना । नैवा ऽस्याः सदृशी काचित् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता
verses.transliteration: uvāca vacanaṃ tatra tāṃ dṛṣṭvā śabarāṅganā / naivā 'syāḥ sadṛśī kācit triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: साक्षाद् असौ देवकन्या ह्यवतीर्णा महीतले । भार्याया वचनं श्रुत्वा शबरस् ताम् उवाच ह
verses.transliteration: sākṣād asau devakanyā hyavatīrṇā mahītale / bhāryāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā śabaras tām uvāca ha
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: कमलानि यथा लाभं दत्त्वा त्वं भुङ्क्ष्व सत्वरम् । मम चैवार्चने बुद्धिर् न भोक्तव्यं मया ऽद्य वै
verses.transliteration: kamalāni yathā lābhaṃ dattvā tvaṃ bhuṅkṣva satvaram / mama caivārcane buddhir na bhoktavyaṃ mayā 'dya vai
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: न मया वर्जितं भद्रे पापवृद्ध्या ऽशुभं कृतम् । शबर्य् उवाच: न पूर्वं तु मया स्वामिन् भुक्तं तस्मिंस् तु वासरे
verses.transliteration: na mayā varjitaṃ bhadre pāpavṛddhyā 'śubhaṃ kṛtam / śabary uvāca: na pūrvaṃ tu mayā svāmin bhuktaṃ tasmiṃs tu vāsare
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: भुक्तशेषं मया भुक्तं यावत् कालं स्मराम्य् अहम् । भार्याया निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा स्नानं कर्तुं जगाम ह
verses.transliteration: bhuktaśeṣaṃ mayā bhuktaṃ yāvat kālaṃ smarāmy aham / bhāryāyā niścayaṃ jñātvā snānaṃ kartuṃ jagāma ha

verses.sanskrit: अर्धोत्तरीयवस्त्रेण स्नानं कृत्वा तु भक्तितः । सर्वदेवं नमस्कृत्य गतो देवशिलां प्रति
verses.transliteration: ardhottarīyavastreṇa snānaṃ kṛtvā tu bhaktitaḥ / sarvadevaṃ namaskṛtya gato devaśilāṃ prati

verses.sanskrit: तस्थौ स शङ्कमानो ऽपि ध्यायमानो जनार्दनम् । कुमुदद्वयं शबर्या तु दासीहस्ते निवेदितम्
verses.transliteration: tasthau sa śaṅkamāno 'pi dhyāyamāno janārdanam / kumudadvayaṃ śabaryā tu dāsīhaste niveditam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा राज्ञी तथा पुष्पे दासीं चैव तदाब्रवीत् । त्वेदं पुष्पद्वयं लब्धं कथ्यतां तच् च साम्प्रतम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā rājñī tathā puṣpe dāsīṃ caiva tadābravīt / tvedaṃ puṣpadvayaṃ labdhaṃ kathyatāṃ tac ca sāmpratam

verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: शीघ्रं गच्छावगच्छ त्वं पुष्पं चैवानयापरम् । अनेन वसुना चैव कमलानि समानय
verses.transliteration: śīghraṃ gacchāvagaccha tvaṃ puṣpaṃ caivānayāparam / anena vasunā caiva kamalāni samānaya
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: भानुमत्या वचः श्रुत्वा गता सा शबरीं प्रति । श्रीफलानि च पुष्पाणि बहून्य् अन्यानि देहि मे
verses.transliteration: bhānumatyā vacaḥ śrutvā gatā sā śabarīṃ prati / śrīphalāni ca puṣpāṇi bahūny anyāni dehi me
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: शबर्य् उवाच: श्रीफलानि च दास्यामि पुष्पाणि च विशेषतः । मूल्येन मे स्पृहा नास्ति गत्वा राज्ञीं निवेदय
verses.transliteration: śabary uvāca: śrīphalāni ca dāsyāmi puṣpāṇi ca viśeṣataḥ / mūlyena me spṛhā nāsti gatvā rājñīṃ nivedaya

verses.sanskrit: गता दासी निवेद्याथ राज्ञी च स्वयम् आगता । उवाच शबरं राज्ञी पुष्पं मूल्येन देहि मे
verses.transliteration: gatā dāsī nivedyātha rājñī ca svayam āgatā / uvāca śabaraṃ rājñī puṣpaṃ mūlyena dehi me

verses.sanskrit: शबर उवाच: न मूल्यं कामये देवि फलपुष्पसमुद्भवम् । श्रीफलानि च पुष्पाणि यथेष्टं मम गृह्यताम्
verses.transliteration: śabara uvāca: na mūlyaṃ kāmaye devi phalapuṣpasamudbhavam / śrīphalāni ca puṣpāṇi yatheṣṭaṃ mama gṛhyatām
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चां कुरु यथान्यायं वासुदेवं जगत्पतिम् । राज्ञी उवाच: विना मूल्यं न गृह्णामि कमलानि तवाधुना
verses.transliteration: arcāṃ kuru yathānyāyaṃ vāsudevaṃ jagatpatim / rājñī uvāca: vinā mūlyaṃ na gṛhṇāmi kamalāni tavādhunā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: धान्यस्य खण्डिकाम् एकाम् एतां प्रति निगृह्यताम्
verses.transliteration: dhānyasya khaṇḍikām ekām etāṃ prati nigṛhyatām

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: शबर उवाच: नाहारं चिन्तयाम्यद्य मुक्त्वा देवं वरानने
verses.transliteration: śabara uvāca: nāhāraṃ cintayāmyadya muktvā devaṃ varānane
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: देवकार्यं विना भद्रे नान्याबुद्धिः प्रवर्तते । राज्ञी उवाच: न त्वयान्नं परित्याज्यं सर्वमन्ने प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: devakāryaṃ vinā bhadre nānyābuddhiḥ pravartate / rājñī uvāca: na tvayānnaṃ parityājyaṃ sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन ममान्नं प्रतिगृह्यताम् । तपस्विनो महाभागा ये चारण्यनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena mamānnaṃ pratigṛhyatām / tapasvino mahābhāgā ye cāraṇyanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: ते मद्द्वारे स्थिताः सर्वे याचन्ते ते ऽन्नकाङ्क्षिणः । शबर उवाच: निषेधो ऽधिकृतः पूर्वं मया सत्यं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: te maddvāre sthitāḥ sarve yācante te 'nnakāṅkṣiṇaḥ / śabara uvāca: niṣedho 'dhikṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ mayā satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमूलं जगत् सर्वं सत्ये चैव प्रतिष्ठितम् । सत्येन तपते सूर्यः सत्येन द्योतते शशी
verses.transliteration: satyamūlaṃ jagat sarvaṃ satye caiva pratiṣṭhitam / satyena tapate sūryaḥ satyena dyotate śaśī
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: सत्येन वायवोवान्ति धरा सत्ये प्रतिष्ठिता । तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन सत्यं सत्यं न लोपयेत्
verses.transliteration: satyena vāyavovānti dharā satye pratiṣṭhitā / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena satyaṃ satyaṃ na lopayet
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञी उवाच: आरामोपहृतं पुष्पम् आरण्यं पुष्पम् एव च । क्रीतं प्रहिग्रहाल् लब्धं पुष्पम् एवं चतुर्विधम्
verses.transliteration: rājñī uvāca: ārāmopahṛtaṃ puṣpam āraṇyaṃ puṣpam eva ca / krītaṃ prahigrahāl labdhaṃ puṣpam evaṃ caturvidham
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमं फलमारण्यं गृहीत्वा स्वयम् एव हि । मध्यमं फलमाराम्यमधमं क्रीतम् एव च
verses.transliteration: uttamaṃ phalamāraṇyaṃ gṛhītvā svayam eva hi / madhyamaṃ phalamārāmyamadhamaṃ krītam eva ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिग्रहेण यल् लब्धं निष्फलं तद् विदुर्बुधाः । पुरोहित उवाच: गृहाण राज्ञि पुष्पाणि पूजां कुरु जनार्दने
verses.transliteration: pratigraheṇa yal labdhaṃ niṣphalaṃ tad vidurbudhāḥ / purohita uvāca: gṛhāṇa rājñi puṣpāṇi pūjāṃ kuru janārdane
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: उपकारं प्रकुर्वन्ती पूजां चक्रे यथाविधि । रात्रौ जागरणं कृत्वा कथा पौराणिकी श्रुता
verses.transliteration: upakāraṃ prakurvantī pūjāṃ cakre yathāvidhi / rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā kathā paurāṇikī śrutā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: शबरस् तु ततो भार्याम् इदं वचनम् अब्रवीत् । दीपार्थं गृह्यतां स्नेहो यथालाभेन सुन्दरि
verses.transliteration: śabaras tu tato bhāryām idaṃ vacanam abravīt / dīpārthaṃ gṛhyatāṃ sneho yathālābhena sundari

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा दीपं ततः कृत्वा धूपं पूजां जनार्दने । कृत्वा जागरणं रात्रौ ध्यायमानस् तु केशवम्
verses.transliteration: dattvā dīpaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhūpaṃ pūjāṃ janārdane / kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau dhyāyamānas tu keśavam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभातसमये दृष्ट्वा स्नानोत्सुकंजनम् । केचिच् च शूलभेदे तु देवनद्यां तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhātasamaye dṛṣṭvā snānotsukaṃjanam / kecic ca śūlabhede tu devanadyāṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वत्यां तथा केचिन्मार्कण्डेये तथा ह्रदे । चक्रतीर्थे तथा केचित् स्नानं कुर्वन्ति भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: sarasvatyāṃ tathā kecinmārkaṇḍeye tathā hrade / cakratīrthe tathā kecit snānaṃ kurvanti bhaktitaḥ

verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: शुचिभूतास् तु ते सर्वे जना देवशिलोपरि । श्राद्धं कुर्वन्ति वै तत्र प्रयत्नेन द्विजर्षभाः
verses.transliteration: śucibhūtās tu te sarve janā devaśilopari / śrāddhaṃ kurvanti vai tatra prayatnena dvijarṣabhāḥ

verses.sanskrit: तान् दृष्ट्वा शबरो बिल्वैः पिण्डं निर्वर्तयेत् ततः । भानुमत्या तथा सक्तुपिण्डनिर्वपणं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā śabaro bilvaiḥ piṇḍaṃ nirvartayet tataḥ / bhānumatyā tathā saktupiṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kṛtam

verses.transliteration: anindya bhojayed vipraṃ dambhadoṣavivarjitam / haviṣyeṇa tathā dadhnā śarkarāmadhusarpiṣā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.transliteration: uttānapāda uvāca: tilapradaḥ prajā iṣṭā dīpadaścakṣuruttamam / bhūmidaḥ svargam āpnoti dīrghāyuś ca hiraṇyadaḥ

verses.sanskrit: गृहदो रोगरहितो रौप्यदो रूपमुत्तमम् । वासोदश् चन्द्रलोकं तु अश्वदः सूर्यलोकभाक्

verses.sanskrit: वृषदस् तु श्रियं पुण्यां गोदानात् तु त्रिविष्टपम् । शय्यादानं च यो दद्यात् स स्वर्गमभयप्रदः
verses.transliteration: vṛṣadas tu śriyaṃ puṇyāṃ godānāt tu triviṣṭapam / śayyādānaṃ ca yo dadyāt sa svargamabhayapradaḥ

verses.sanskrit: धान्यदः शाश्वतं सौख्यं ब्रह्मदो ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् । सर्वेषाम् एव दानानां ब्रह्मदानं विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: dhānyadaḥ śāśvataṃ saukhyaṃ brahmado brahma śāśvatam / sarveṣām eva dānānāṃ brahmadānaṃ viśiṣyate

verses.sanskrit: भार्याम् अश्वं महीं वासस् तिलकां च न सर्पिषम् । ये नयेन हि भावेन दानं विप्राय यच्छति
verses.transliteration: bhāryām aśvaṃ mahīṃ vāsas tilakāṃ ca na sarpiṣam / ye nayena hi bhāvena dānaṃ viprāya yacchati

verses.sanskrit: तेन तेन हि भावेन प्राप्नोति पदपूजितम् । दृष्ट्वा दानानि सर्वाणि राज्ञ्या दत्तानि यानि च
verses.transliteration: tena tena hi bhāvena prāpnoti padapūjitam / dṛṣṭvā dānāni sarvāṇi rājñyā dattāni yāni ca

verses.transliteration: uvāca śabaro bhāryāṃ yac chṛṇuṣva narādhipa / śabara uvāca: purāṇaṃ paṭhitaṃ bhadre brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतं च तन् मया सर्वं दानधर्मपरं शुभम् । पूर्वजन्मार्जितं पापं स्नानदानव्रतेन च
verses.transliteration: śrutaṃ ca tan mayā sarvaṃ dānadharmaparaṃ śubham / pūrvajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ snānadānavratena ca

verses.transliteration: tatsarvaṃ ca kṣayaṃ jātaṃ madīyena priye śṛṇu / atra dattaṃ hutaṃ taptaṃ sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam

verses.sanskrit: ते द्विजा भानुमत्या च शूलभेदं गतास् ततः । ददृशुः शबरं कुण्डे शबर्या सह संस्थितम्

verses.sanskrit: ईशान्यां च ततो गत्वा भृगुपर्वतमूर्धनि । मर्तुकामस् तथारूढो भार्यया सह पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: īśānyāṃ ca tato gatvā bhṛguparvatamūrdhani / martukāmas tathārūḍho bhāryayā saha pārthiva

verses.sanskrit: राजपुत्र्य् उवाच: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ महासत्त्व शृणुष्व वचनं मम । किमर्थं त्यजसि प्राणानद्यापि च युवा भवान्

verses.sanskrit: किं सन्तापः समुद्वेगः किं दुःखं व्याधिर् एव च । शिशुश् च दृश्यते ऽद्यापि कारणं कथयस्व मे
verses.transliteration: kiṃ santāpaḥ samudvegaḥ kiṃ duḥkhaṃ vyādhir eva ca / śiśuś ca dṛśyate 'dyāpi kāraṇaṃ kathayasva me

verses.transliteration: śabara uvāca: kāraṇaṃ nāsti me kiṃcin na duḥkhaṃ kiṃcid eva hi / saṃsārasārabhūtatve nānyā buddhiḥ pravartate

verses.transliteration: duḥkhena labhate yasmān manuṣyatvaṃ varānane / mānuṣyaṃ janma cāsādya yo na dharmaṃ samācaret

verses.sanskrit: स गच्छेन् नरकं घोरम् अल्पदोषेण सुन्दरि । तस्मात् पतितुम् इच्छामि अस्मिंस् तीर्थे तपस्विनि
verses.transliteration: sa gacchen narakaṃ ghoram alpadoṣeṇa sundari / tasmāt patitum icchāmi asmiṃs tīrthe tapasvini
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.transliteration: rājaputry uvāca: adyāpi vartate kālaḥ svadharmā vividhāḥ kriyāḥ / kṛtvā prakṛtadharmāṇi tatra dānena śuddhyati
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: अहं दास्यामि ते धान्यं वासांसि द्रविणानि च । नित्यं त्वमाचरेर्धर्मं ध्यायमानो जनार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ dāsyāmi te dhānyaṃ vāsāṃsi draviṇāni ca / nityaṃ tvamācarerdharmaṃ dhyāyamāno janārdanam

verses.sanskrit: शबर उवाच: न चाहं कामये देवि धान्यं वस्त्राणि चैव हि । यः परस्यान्नम् अश्नाति स नरो ऽश्नाति किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: śabara uvāca: na cāhaṃ kāmaye devi dhānyaṃ vastrāṇi caiva hi / yaḥ parasyānnam aśnāti sa naro 'śnāti kilbiṣam

verses.sanskrit: राजपुत्र्य् उवाच: कन्दमूलफलाहारो भुक्त्वा वै भक्ष्यमुत्तमम् । अवगाह्य च तीर्थानि सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यसे
verses.transliteration: rājaputry uvāca: kandamūlaphalāhāro bhuktvā vai bhakṣyamuttamam / avagāhya ca tīrthāni sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyase
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विमुक्तपापस् तु यः कश्चित् पुरुषः शुचिः । कर्मणा तेन चैव त्वं गतिं सम्प्राप्स्यसे शुभाम्
verses.transliteration: tato vimuktapāpas tu yaḥ kaścit puruṣaḥ śuciḥ / karmaṇā tena caiva tvaṃ gatiṃ samprāpsyase śubhām

verses.sanskrit: शबर उवाच: अत्र मध्ये मया त्यक्ताः प्राणा दृष्ट्वा हितं च यत् । सत्यन्न लोपये देवि इति मे निश्चिता मतिः
verses.transliteration: śabara uvāca: atra madhye mayā tyaktāḥ prāṇā dṛṣṭvā hitaṃ ca yat / satyanna lopaye devi iti me niścitā matiḥ

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादः क्रियतां देवि क्षमस्व त्वं जनैः सह । बद्धोत्तरीयवस्त्रेण आत्मानं च प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ devi kṣamasva tvaṃ janaiḥ saha / baddhottarīyavastreṇa ātmānaṃ ca prayatnataḥ

verses.sanskrit: भार्यया सहितस् तत्र हरिं ध्यात्वा पपात ह । नगार्धं पतितो यावद् गतजीवो नराधिप
verses.transliteration: bhāryayā sahitas tatra hariṃ dhyātvā papāta ha / nagārdhaṃ patito yāvad gatajīvo narādhipa
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तूष्णीं भूतं तु तं दृष्ट्वा कुण्डस्योपरि भूमिप । त्रिमूर्तिगर्ते तत्काले शबरो भार्यया सह
verses.transliteration: tūṣṇīṃ bhūtaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā kuṇḍasyopari bhūmipa / trimūrtigarte tatkāle śabaro bhāryayā saha
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यं विमानम् आरूढो गतश् च गतिमुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: divyaṃ vimānam ārūḍho gataś ca gatimuttamām
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the highly splendid Tirtha called Candaditya. O excellent king, it was established by Canda and Munda.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे शबरस्वर्गारोहणं नामैकनवतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ९२ राजोवाच: ततस् तयापि देवेश भानुमत्या हि किंकृतम् । एतन् मे संशयं देव कथयस्व प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe śabarasvargārohaṇaṃ nāmaikanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 92 rājovāca: tatas tayāpi deveśa bhānumatyā hi kiṃkṛtam / etan me saṃśayaṃ deva kathayasva prasādataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Yamahasya Tirtha which dispels all sins. It is situated on the banks of Narmada.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Yamahasya Tirtha which dispels all sins. It is situated on the banks of Narmada.
