verses.sanskrit: हर उवाच: चिन्तयित्वा तु सा राज्ञी गता कुण्डस्य सन्निधौ । दृष्ट्वा तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं राज्ञी हर्षेण पूरिता
verses.transliteration: hara uvāca: cintayitvā tu sā rājñī gatā kuṇḍasya sannidhau / dṛṣṭvā tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ rājñī harṣeṇa pūritā
verses.translation: How do men loaded with sins come to my city? Merely through a single holy bath in Reva, the position in the world of Vi$nu is obtained.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: विप्रान् बहून् समाहूय पूजयामास तत्क्षणात् । ददौ च विविधं दानं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नराधिप
verses.transliteration: viprān bahūn samāhūya pūjayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt / dadau ca vividhaṃ dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo narādhipa
verses.translation: Yama becomes delighted at every birth, O \Udhirthira. Buffalo is the vehicle of Yama and buffaloes are the mothers of his vehicle, buffalo. Certainly Yama becomes pleased as a result of their gift.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा च दक्षिणाम् एवं मधुमासे च भूमिप । अमायां च ततो राज्ञी गता पर्वतमूर्धनि
verses.transliteration: dattvā ca dakṣiṇām evaṃ madhumāse ca bhūmipa / amāyāṃ ca tato rājñī gatā parvatamūrdhani
verses.translation: Before the Brahmana, one shall utter these words: "Yama's world is highly frightening. Asipatravana is terrible. YamacullI is extremely terrifying. Vaitaranl is horrible. Kumbhlpaka causes terror. Kalasutra is extremely terrifying. So also the Yamala mountains, Krakaca (scissors), Tailayantra (oil-extract- ing machine), the hounds, the vultures are hideous. Nirucchvasa is highly noisy, Raurava is excessively terrible. O excellent Brahmana, we hear that all these are present in the world of Yama. With your favour and by the power of this Tirtha, let them be gentle. By the power of this Dana and with the favour of Yamaraja, may I not go to Naraka in any birth whatsoever."

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः: सन्देशं कथयिष्यामस् त्वयोक्तं शोभनव्रते । मातापित्रोश् च सुश्रोणि मा ते ऽभूद् अत्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ: sandeśaṃ kathayiṣyāmas tvayoktaṃ śobhanavrate / mātāpitroś ca suśroṇi mā te 'bhūd atra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Before the Brahmana, one shall utter these words: "Yama's world is highly frightening. Asipatravana is terrible. YamacullI is extremely terrifying. Vaitaranl is horrible. Kumbhlpaka causes terror. Kalasutra is extremely terrifying. So also the Yamala mountains, Krakaca (scissors), Tailayantra (oil-extract- ing machine), the hounds, the vultures are hideous. Nirucchvasa is highly noisy, Raurava is excessively terrible. O excellent Brahmana, we hear that all these are present in the world of Yama. verses.transliteration: dīrghajihvaḥ karālāsyas tīkṣṇādaṃṣṭro durāsadaḥ / vṛddhāṃ striyaṃ kuruśreṣṭha te paśyan viprapuṃgavāḥ

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: ततः समीपगा वृद्धा स च वृद्धश् च भारत । स्वाध्यायनिरतैर् विप्रैस् तौ पृष्टौ पापकर्मिणौ
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samīpagā vṛddhā sa ca vṛddhaś ca bhārata / svādhyāyaniratair viprais tau pṛṣṭau pāpakarmiṇau
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धावूचतुः: युष्माकं यमिनः सर्वे तिष्ठध्वं तीर्थमध्यतः । शीघ्रं प्रविश्यतां सर्वे नर्मदा चैव सेव्यताम्
verses.transliteration: vṛddhāvūcatuḥ: yuṣmākaṃ yaminaḥ sarve tiṣṭhadhvaṃ tīrthamadhyataḥ / śīghraṃ praviśyatāṃ sarve narmadā caiva sevyatām
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: तयोः श्रुत्वा तु वचनं ब्राह्मणाः शंसितव्रताः । जग्मुस् ते नर्मदाकच्छं दृष्ट्वा रेवां द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ śrutvā tu vacanaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ / jagmus te narmadākacchaṃ dṛṣṭvā revāṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: नताः केचित् स्तुवन्त्य् अन्ये जयदेवि नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: natāḥ kecit stuvanty anye jayadevi namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः: नमो ऽस्तु ते सिद्धगणैर् निषेविते नमो ऽस्तु ते सर्वपवित्रमङ्गले । नमो ऽस्तु ते विप्रसहस्रपूजिते । नमो ऽस्तु ते रुद्रसमुद्भवे परे
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ: namo 'stu te siddhagaṇair niṣevite namo 'stu te sarvapavitramaṅgale / namo 'stu te viprasahasrapūjite / namo 'stu te rudrasamudbhave pare
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वपवित्रपावने नमो ऽस्तु ते देवि वरे प्रसीद नः । नमो ऽस्तु ते शीतजले सुखप्रदे सरिद्वरे पापहरे दयान्विते
verses.transliteration: namo'stu te sarvapavitrapāvane namo 'stu te devi vare prasīda naḥ / namo 'stu te śītajale sukhaprade saridvare pāpahare dayānvite
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: अनेकभूताङ्गसुशोभिताङ्गे गन्धर्वयक्षोरगपाविताङ्गे । महागजौघा महिषा वराहाः क्रीडन्ति तोये सुमहोर्मिमालैः
verses.transliteration: anekabhūtāṅgasuśobhitāṅge gandharvayakṣoragapāvitāṅge / mahāgajaughā mahiṣā varāhāḥ krīḍanti toye sumahormimālaiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: नमामः सर्वे वरदे सुखप्रदे ऽस्मान् पशुपाशबद्धान् । पापैरनेकैः पशुपाशबद्धा भ्रमन्ति तावन्नरकेषु नित्यम्
verses.transliteration: namāmaḥ sarve varade sukhaprade 'smān paśupāśabaddhān / pāpairanekaiḥ paśupāśabaddhā bhramanti tāvannarakeṣu nityam
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: यावत् तवाम्भो नहि संस्पृशन्ति स्पृष्टं करैश्चन्द्रमसो रवेश् च । अनेकसंसारभयार्दितानां पापैर् अनेकैः परिवेष्टितानाम्
verses.transliteration: yāvat tavāmbho nahi saṃspṛśanti spṛṣṭaṃ karaiścandramaso raveś ca / anekasaṃsārabhayārditānāṃ pāpair anekaiḥ pariveṣṭitānām
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: गतिस् त्वम् अम्भोजसमानवक्त्रे द्वन्द्वैर् अनेकैर् अभिसंवृतानाम् । नद्यस् तु पूज्या विमला भवन्ति । त्वां देवि चासाद्य न संशयो ऽत्र
verses.transliteration: gatis tvam ambhojasamānavaktre dvandvair anekair abhisaṃvṛtānām / nadyas tu pūjyā vimalā bhavanti / tvāṃ devi cāsādya na saṃśayo 'tra
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: दुखातुराणाम् अभयं ददासि देवैर् अनेकैर् अभिपूजितासि । विण्मूत्रदेहार्णवमग्नदेहा भवन्ति तावन् नरकेषु मर्त्याः
verses.transliteration: dukhāturāṇām abhayaṃ dadāsi devair anekair abhipūjitāsi / viṇmūtradehārṇavamagnadehā bhavanti tāvan narakeṣu martyāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: महानिलोद्धूततरङ्गभङ्गं जलं न यावत् तव संस्पृशन्ति । म्लेच्छाः पुलिन्दास् त्वथ यातुधानाः पिबन्ति चाम्भस्तव देवि पुण्यम्
verses.transliteration: mahāniloddhūtataraṅgabhaṅgaṃ jalaṃ na yāvat tava saṃspṛśanti / mlecchāḥ pulindās tvatha yātudhānāḥ pibanti cāmbhastava devi puṇyam
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: ते ऽपि प्रमुञ्चन्ति भयात् तु घोरात् किम् अत्र विप्रा भयपापभीताः । घोरे युगे ऽस्मिन् कलिनाम्न्यपुण्ये त्वं भ्राजसे कालजलौघपूर्णे
verses.transliteration: te 'pi pramuñcanti bhayāt tu ghorāt kim atra viprā bhayapāpabhītāḥ / ghore yuge 'smin kalināmnyapuṇye tvaṃ bhrājase kālajalaughapūrṇe
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: देव्यत्र नक्षत्रपथे ऽपि गङ्गा तव प्रसादाद् दिवि देव्यतिष्ठत् । काले यथेष्टं परिपालय त्वं यास्याम लोकं तव सुप्रसादात्
verses.transliteration: devyatra nakṣatrapathe 'pi gaṅgā tava prasādād divi devyatiṣṭhat / kāle yatheṣṭaṃ paripālaya tvaṃ yāsyāma lokaṃ tava suprasādāt
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: वयं तथा त्वं कुरु नः प्रसादं त्वाम् आश्रितास् त्वां शरणं गता वै । गतिस् त्वम् एवात्र पितेव पुत्रं त्वम् आदिदेव प्रभवे विचित्रे
verses.transliteration: vayaṃ tathā tvaṃ kuru naḥ prasādaṃ tvām āśritās tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā vai / gatis tvam evātra piteva putraṃ tvam ādideva prabhave vicitre
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: काले ऽप्य् अनावृष्टिभवं क्षयं च रक्षस्व (?) । सर्वं जगतः स्वरूपम् ॥॥ ॥॥
verses.transliteration: kāle 'py anāvṛṣṭibhavaṃ kṣayaṃ ca rakṣasva (?) / sarvaṃ jagataḥ svarūpam .... ....
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुता महादेवी नर्मदा सरितां वरा । प्रत्यक्षा सा पराभूता ब्राह्मणानां युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: evaṃ stutā mahādevī narmadā saritāṃ varā / pratyakṣā sā parābhūtā brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदोवाच: तुष्टाहं वरदा विप्रा दास्ये वो वाञ्छितं फलम् । ततो ऽवर्षन् महामेघा धान्यं च प्रचुरं तथा
verses.transliteration: narmadovāca: tuṣṭāhaṃ varadā viprā dāsye vo vāñchitaṃ phalam / tato 'varṣan mahāmeghā dhānyaṃ ca pracuraṃ tathā

verses.sanskrit: कन्दमूलफलं शाकं सुखं सर्वसंश्रितम् । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: पठन्ति ये स्तोत्रम् इदं नरेन्द्र शृण्वन्ति भक्त्या परयआ प्रपन्नाः
verses.transliteration: kandamūlaphalaṃ śākaṃ sukhaṃ sarvasaṃśritam / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: paṭhanti ye stotram idaṃ narendra śṛṇvanti bhaktyā parayaā prapannāḥ

verses.transliteration: pāpāni sarvāṇi layaṃ grayānti samāśrayante ca mahānubhāvāḥ / pāpais tu muktā divi modayante śambhorgirā caiva tu nānyathā ca

verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: dṛṣṭās te puruṣā nānyā narmadātaṭam āśritāḥ / snānadevārccanairyuktāḥ pañcaiva tu mahābalāḥ

verses.transliteration: te dṛṣṭā brāhmaṇaiḥ sarvair vedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ / viprā ūcuḥ: dinānte ca striyor yugmaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ raudraṃ bhayāvaham

verses.sanskrit: त्रयो वृद्धाश् च पुरुषाः पाशहस्ता भयावहाः । दुर्द्धरा दुर्निसंकाशा इतश्चेतश् च चञ्चलाः
verses.transliteration: trayo vṛddhāś ca puruṣāḥ pāśahastā bhayāvahāḥ / durddharā durnisaṃkāśā itaścetaś ca cañcalāḥ

verses.sanskrit: व्याहरन्ति भिया वाचा आकाङ्क्षा दर्शनस्य च । अपरस्परिणस् सर्वे निरीक्षन्ते परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: vyāharanti bhiyā vācā ākāṅkṣā darśanasya ca / aparaspariṇas sarve nirīkṣante parasparam
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the excellent Kalhodi Tirtha which is well-known all over Bharata as destroyer of the sins of (even) Gahga.

verses.sanskrit: तेषु सङ्घेषु यत्प्रोक्तं तत्सर्वं कथयामि ते । पुरुषा ऊचुः: तीर्थावगाहनं सर्वैः पूर्वपश्चिमदक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: teṣu saṅgheṣu yatproktaṃ tatsarvaṃ kathayāmi te / puruṣā ūcuḥ: tīrthāvagāhanaṃ sarvaiḥ pūrvapaścimadakṣiṇe

verses.transliteration: uttare ca kṛtaṃ bhaktyā na pāpaṃ tad vyapohitam / niṣpāpāś cātra sañjātās tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ

verses.transliteration: śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve agnijvālopamā dvijāḥ / pātakāni ca ghorāṇi yāny acintyāni dehinām

verses.transliteration: pāpiṣṭhena tu cānena garordārā vidūṣitāḥ / hṛtaṃ cānyena mitrasya suvarṇaṃ ca tathā ca vai

verses.transliteration: brahmahatyā kṛtā raudrā kṛtaṃ cānyena pātakam / surāpānaṃ tu cāpy asya saṃjātaṃ cānyakāmataḥ

verses.sanskrit: गोवधं पापम् एतेन कृतम् एकेन पापिना । अकामतो ऽपि सर्वेषां पातकानि नराधिप
verses.transliteration: govadhaṃ pāpam etena kṛtam ekena pāpinā / akāmato 'pi sarveṣāṃ pātakāni narādhipa

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणास् तांस् तु ते दृष्ट्वा पापिष्ठा गतकल्मषाः । तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावेण नर्मदायाः प्रभावतः

verses.sanskrit: न क्वाचित् पातकानां तु प्रवेशश् चात्र जायते । एवं संचिन्त्य ते सर्वे पापिष्ठाश् च परस्परम्

verses.transliteration: kṣipram eva samuddhṛtya vicintya hṛdaye harim / snātvā revājale puṇye tārpitvā pitṛdevatāḥ

verses.transliteration: natvā tu bhāskaraṃ devaṃ hṛdi dhyātvā janārdanam / kṛtvā pradakṣiṇāṃ bhaktyā jvalite jātavedasi

verses.sanskrit: पतिताः पाण्डवश्रेष्ठ पापोद्विग्नाश् च पापिनः । सात्त्विकीं कामनां कृत्वा त्यक्त्वा प्राणान् दिवङ्गताः
verses.transliteration: patitāḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha pāpodvignāś ca pāpinaḥ / sāttvikīṃ kāmanāṃ kṛtvā tyaktvā prāṇān divaṅgatāḥ

verses.transliteration: uddeśaṃ kathayiṣyāmi dṛṣṭvā vāntaram eva ca / kurukṣetraṃ yathāpūtaṃ ravitīrthaṃ śrutaṃ tathā

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहाः सर्वे ऽभवन् प्रीताः प्रीतस् तस्य दिवाकरः । तीर्थस्यास्य पयः पीत्वा यत् पुण्यं जायते नृणाम्

verses.sanskrit: पापाः सर्वे विलीयन्ते भिन्नपात्रे जलं यथा । तीर्थस्याभिमुखं वृत्तं गच्छतां नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: pāpāḥ sarve vilīyante bhinnapātre jalaṃ yathā / tīrthasyābhimukhaṃ vṛttaṃ gacchatāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ

verses.sanskrit: इह बाह्यान्तरं तीर्थं कथितं तव पार्थिव । पापिष्ठानां कृतघ्नानां स्वामिमित्रविरोधिनाम्
verses.transliteration: iha bāhyāntaraṃ tīrthaṃ kathitaṃ tava pārthiva / pāpiṣṭhānāṃ kṛtaghnānāṃ svāmimitravirodhinām

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थाख्यानं शुभं तेषां गोपितव्यं सदा बुधैः
verses.transliteration: tīrthākhyānaṃ śubhaṃ teṣāṃ gopitavyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ
verses.translation: Beyond that itself, O king, one should go to the aus- picious Nanditirtha that is destructive of all sins of men. It was formerly created by Nandin.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे आदित्येश्वरतीर्थकीर्तनो नाम चतुर्नवतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ९५ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत् तु राजेन्द्र करञ्जेश्वरम् उत्तमम् । यत्र ते निहतास् तात दानवास् तत्पदानुगैः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe ādityeśvaratīrthakīrtano nāma caturnavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 95 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra karañjeśvaram uttamam / yatra te nihatās tāta dānavās tatpadānugaiḥ
verses.translation: If a devotee perceives Siva being bathed duly, and he has devotion and absence of envy, his residence is near Siva in the world of Sakra. There is no doubt at all.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: If a devotee perceives Siva being bathed duly, and he has devotion and absence of envy, his residence is near Siva in the world of Sakra. There is no doubt at all.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a devotee perceives Siva being bathed duly, and he has devotion and absence of envy, his residence is near Siva in the world of Sakra. There is no doubt at all.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राद्यैश् चैव संहृष्टैः स्तुतो यज्ञः सुबुद्धिभिः । तेषां ये पुत्रपौत्राश् च पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन्
verses.transliteration: indrādyaiś caiva saṃhṛṣṭaiḥ stuto yajñaḥ subuddhibhiḥ / teṣāṃ ye putrapautrāś ca pūrvavairamanusmaran
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्थास् तु सुराः सर्वे स्थापयित्वा ह्य् उमापतिम् । इन्द्रचन्द्रयमाः सूर्यः स्थापयित्वेष्टसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: tatra sthās tu surāḥ sarve sthāpayitvā hy umāpatim / indracandrayamāḥ sūryaḥ sthāpayitveṣṭasiddhaye
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.transliteration: hṛṣṭapuṣṭāḥ surāḥ sarve jagmur ākāśasasthitāḥ / dānavānāṃ mahābhāga karoṭyaḥ patitā yataḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: tadā prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ karoṭīti mahīpate / vikhyātaṃ bhārate loke bhūpṛṣṭhe pāṇḍunandana

verses.transliteration: aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ śubhe pakṣe tu bhaktitaḥ / upoṣya śūlinaś cāgre rātrau kurvīta jāgaram

verses.transliteration: tatkathālāpasaṃyuktaṃ vedodgītaṃ tathaiva ca / prabhāte vimale prāpte sthāṇuṃ sampūjya yatnataḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.transliteration: pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya śrīkhaṇḍenaiva cārcayet / śatapallavapuṣpaiś ca pūjayec ca prayatnataḥ

verses.sanskrit: बहुरूपं जपेन्मन्त्रं दक्षिणां तु प्रदाय च । तत्फलं समवाप्नोति आदित्येश्वर नार्मदे
verses.transliteration: bahurūpaṃ japenmantraṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tu pradāya ca / tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ādityeśvara nārmade

verses.transliteration: śrutatīrthaprabhāvaṃ vai yaḥ paṭhec ca narādhipa / tatsarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi bhaktyā tava mahīpate

verses.transliteration: yathoktena vidhānena nābhimātre jale sthitaḥ / śrāddhaṃ tatraiva pretāya kārayeta jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.transliteration: vividhairagrapāṭhaiś ca vedādhyayanatatparaiḥ / gohiraṇyena sampūjya vastratāmbūlabhojanaiḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: भूषणैः पट्टदानैश् च ब्राह्मणं पाण्डुनन्दन । तस्मिंस् तीर्थे तु सम्पूज्य कामिकं भोजनं ददेत्
verses.transliteration: bhūṣaṇaiḥ paṭṭadānaiś ca brāhmaṇaṃ pāṇḍunandana / tasmiṃs tīrthe tu sampūjya kāmikaṃ bhojanaṃ dadet
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: भवेत् कोटिगणं तस्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा । तत्र तीर्थे यथा भक्त्या त्यजेद् देहं च मानद
verses.transliteration: bhavet koṭigaṇaṃ tasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā / tatra tīrthe yathā bhaktyā tyajed dehaṃ ca mānada
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तीर्थे भवेत् पुण्यं तच् छृणुष्व नराधिप । यावद् अस्थिमनुष्यस्य तिष्ठते नर्मदाम्भसि
verses.transliteration: tasya tīrthe bhavet puṇyaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva narādhipa / yāvad asthimanuṣyasya tiṣṭhate narmadāmbhasi
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: तावद् वसति धर्मात्मा शिवलोके सुदुर्लभे । ततः कालात् प्रच्युतश् च देवो मानुष्यतां गतः
verses.transliteration: tāvad vasati dharmātmā śivaloke sudurlabhe / tataḥ kālāt pracyutaś ca devo mānuṣyatāṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: कोटिध्वजपतिः श्रीमान् जायते नात्र संशयः । सर्वधर्मसमायुक्तो मेधावी जीवपुत्रकः
verses.transliteration: koṭidhvajapatiḥ śrīmān jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / sarvadharmasamāyukto medhāvī jīvaputrakaḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: विख्यातश् च धरापृष्ठे दीर्घायुर् मानवो भवेत् । इन्द्रचन्द्रयमैः रुद्रैर् आदित्यैर् वसुभिस् तथा
verses.transliteration: vikhyātaś ca dharāpṛṣṭhe dīrghāyur mānavo bhavet / indracandrayamaiḥ rudrair ādityair vasubhis tathā
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेदेवैस् तथा सर्वैः स्थापितास् त्रिदशेश्वरः । नर्मदोत्तरकूले तु लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: viśvedevais tathā sarvaiḥ sthāpitās tridaśeśvaraḥ / narmadottarakūle tu lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: मानवः प्रेतम् उद्दिश्य प्रासादं कारयेत् तु यः । तस्मिन् नरवरश्रेष्ठः स सद्गतिम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: mānavaḥ pretam uddiśya prāsādaṃ kārayet tu yaḥ / tasmin naravaraśreṣṭhaḥ sa sadgatim avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: न्यायोपार्जितद्रव्येण यः श्राद्धं कुरुते ऽत्र वै । ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः स्त्रियः शूद्राश् च सत्कृताः
verses.transliteration: nyāyopārjitadravyeṇa yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute 'tra vai / brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ striyaḥ śūdrāś ca satkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: ते ऽपि यान्ति परे लोके शाङ्करे सुरपूजिते । यः शृणोति नरो भक्त्या माहात्म्यं तीर्थजं नृप
verses.transliteration: te 'pi yānti pare loke śāṅkare surapūjite / yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā māhātmyaṃ tīrthajaṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पापं प्रणश्येत षण्मासेन तु यत्कृतम् । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत् तु राजेन्द्र कुमारेश्वरम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasya pāpaṃ praṇaśyeta ṣaṇmāsena tu yatkṛtam / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra kumāreśvaram uttamam
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसिद्धं सर्वतीर्थानाम् अगस्त्येश्वरम् उत्तमम् । षण्मुखेन तपस्तप्तं सर्वपातकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: prasiddhaṃ sarvatīrthānām agastyeśvaram uttamam / ṣaṇmukhena tapastaptaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं च परया भुक्त्या सिद्धिः प्राप्ता नराधिप । देवसैन्याधिपो राजन् सर्वशत्रुविमर्दनः
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ ca parayā bhuktyā siddhiḥ prāptā narādhipa / devasainyādhipo rājan sarvaśatruvimardanaḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: उग्रतेजा महात्मा च संजातस् तीर्थसेवनात् । तदा प्रभृति तत्तीर्थं विख्यातं नर्मदातटे
verses.transliteration: ugratejā mahātmā ca saṃjātas tīrthasevanāt / tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ vikhyātaṃ narmadātaṭe
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस् तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या एकचित्तो जितेन्द्रियः । अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां कार्त्तिकस्य विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃs tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā ekacitto jitendriyaḥ / aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ kārttikasya viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयेद् गिरिजानाथं दधिदुग्धेन सर्पिषा । गीतं तत्र प्रकर्तव्यं पिण्डदानं यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: snāpayed girijānāthaṃ dadhidugdhena sarpiṣā / gītaṃ tatra prakartavyaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणैः श्रोत्रियैः पार्थ षट्कर्मनिरतैः सदा । यत्किंचिद् दीयते तत्र अक्षयं पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaiḥ śrotriyaiḥ pārtha ṣaṭkarmanirataiḥ sadā / yatkiṃcid dīyate tatra akṣayaṃ pāṇḍunandana
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतीर्थात् परं तीर्थं निर्मितं शशिना नृप । एतत् ते सर्वम् आख्यातं कुमारेश्वरजं फलम्
verses.transliteration: sarvatīrthāt paraṃ tīrthaṃ nirmitaṃ śaśinā nṛpa / etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ kumāreśvarajaṃ phalam
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: कुमारदर्शनात् पुण्यं प्राप्यते पाण्डुनन्दन । मृतः स्वर्गम् अवाप्नोति सत्यम् ईश्वरभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: kumāradarśanāt puṇyaṃ prāpyate pāṇḍunandana / mṛtaḥ svargam avāpnoti satyam īśvarabhāṣitam

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत् तु राजेन्द्र अगस्त्येश्वरम् उत्तमम् । तत्र सिद्धो महाभाग अगस्त्यो मुनिपुङ्गवः
verses.transliteration: tato gacchet tu rājendra agastyeśvaram uttamam / tatra siddho mahābhāga agastyo munipuṅgavaḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कथं सिद्धो महाभाग अगस्त्यो मुनिपुङ्गवः । कुम्भोद्भवो महाभाग मित्रावरुणसम्भवः
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ siddho mahābhāga agastyo munipuṅgavaḥ / kumbhodbhavo mahābhāga mitrāvaruṇasambhavaḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातटम् आश्रित्य तत्सर्वं कथयस्व मे । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: महाप्रश्नो महाराज परिपृष्टश् च यस् त्वया
verses.transliteration: narmadātaṭam āśritya tatsarvaṃ kathayasva me / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: mahāpraśno mahārāja paripṛṣṭaś ca yas tvayā
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तत् ते ऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमनाः सदा । पुराकृतयुगे तात भारार्ता जगती स्थिता
verses.transliteration: tat te 'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ sadā / purākṛtayuge tāta bhārārtā jagatī sthitā
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञप्तुकामा देवेशं नाकपृष्ठं गता नृप । इन्द्राय कथयामास दैत्यभारार्दितं जगत्
verses.transliteration: vijñaptukāmā deveśaṃ nākapṛṣṭhaṃ gatā nṛpa / indrāya kathayāmāsa daityabhārārditaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र उवाच: ब्रह्मा च जगतः कर्ता तवैव मम सुन्दरि । ब्रह्मलोकं गमिष्यामि मन्त्रिभिर्दैवतैः सह
verses.transliteration: indra uvāca: brahmā ca jagataḥ kartā tavaiva mama sundari / brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyāmi mantribhirdaivataiḥ saha
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सर्वे गतास् तत्र यत्रासौ कमलासनः । बृहस्पतिर् उवाच: ब्रह्मन् निर्लम्बना जाता दैत्यभाराद् वसुन्धरा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sarve gatās tatra yatrāsau kamalāsanaḥ / bṛhaspatir uvāca: brahman nirlambanā jātā daityabhārād vasundharā
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: असहन्ती तु तं भारं याति देवी रसातलम् । प्रतीकारं पृथिव्याश् च कुरुष्व जगतीपते
verses.transliteration: asahantī tu taṃ bhāraṃ yāti devī rasātalam / pratīkāraṃ pṛthivyāś ca kuruṣva jagatīpate
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसत्त्वोपकाराय सृष्टिस् त्वयि जगत्पते । पितामह उवाच: कर्ता ऽस्मि सर्वजगताम् अयोनिकलशोद्भवः
verses.transliteration: sarvasattvopakārāya sṛṣṭis tvayi jagatpate / pitāmaha uvāca: kartā 'smi sarvajagatām ayonikalaśodbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यस् तपसां राशिः शक्तो दैत्यनिवारणे । एकतः सर्वदेवानां बलं तेजश् च जायते
verses.transliteration: agastyas tapasāṃ rāśiḥ śakto daityanivāraṇe / ekataḥ sarvadevānāṃ balaṃ tejaś ca jāyate
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: एकतो ऋषिमुख्यस्य जायते नात्र संशयः । ब्रह्मणो वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः
verses.transliteration: ekato ṛṣimukhyasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव कारणं चान्यत् कथयन्ति स्म भारत । विज्ञातं देवदेवेश विश्वामित्रचिकीर्षितम्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva kāraṇaṃ cānyat kathayanti sma bhārata / vijñātaṃ devadeveśa viśvāmitracikīrṣitam
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशङ्क्वर्थे च यज्ञो ऽयं विश्वामित्रेण साधितः । स्पर्धया च वशिष्ठस्य यज्ञाङ्गानि समासृजत्
verses.transliteration: triśaṅkvarthe ca yajño 'yaṃ viśvāmitreṇa sādhitaḥ / spardhayā ca vaśiṣṭhasya yajñāṅgāni samāsṛjat
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: स्पर्धया सृजताकाशं भूमिं चान्यां समासृजत् । यथा तु हिमवच् छैलः पूर्वापरमहोदधिम्
verses.transliteration: spardhayā sṛjatākāśaṃ bhūmiṃ cānyāṃ samāsṛjat / yathā tu himavac chailaḥ pūrvāparamahodadhim
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: व्याप्यैव संस्थितो भूम्यां देवकार्यार्थसाधकः । तथासौ स्पर्धते विन्ध्यः स्पर्धया कौशिकस्य च
verses.transliteration: vyāpyaiva saṃsthito bhūmyāṃ devakāryārthasādhakaḥ / tathāsau spardhate vindhyaḥ spardhayā kauśikasya ca
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठन्ति देवकार्याणि कौशिकेन सुरेश्वर । कार्यद्वयप्रतीकारं चिन्तय स्वजगद्गुरो
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭhanti devakāryāṇi kauśikena sureśvara / kāryadvayapratīkāraṃ cintaya svajagadguro
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच: एकस् त्व् अस्य गुरुर् विप्रो ह्य् अगस्त्यो मुनिपुङ्गवः । उत्पथे वर्तमानस्य कौशिकस्य दुरासदः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca: ekas tv asya gurur vipro hy agastyo munipuṅgavaḥ / utpathe vartamānasya kauśikasya durāsadaḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यो मार्गभेत्ता वै भविष्यति न संशयः । गुरुर् आत्मवतां शास्ता सर्वेषां वै न संशयः

verses.transliteration: kṣamaḥ samastakāryāṇāṃ mitrāvaruṇanandanaḥ / evaṃ tu niścayaṃ kṛtvā devāḥ sendrapitāmahāḥ

verses.sanskrit: ययुर्वसुन्धरासार्धं हिमवन्तं नगेश्वरम् । ददृशुस् ते स्थितं विप्रं ध्यायमानं च योगिनम्
verses.transliteration: yayurvasundharāsārdhaṃ himavantaṃ nageśvaram / dadṛśus te sthitaṃ vipraṃ dhyāyamānaṃ ca yoginam

verses.sanskrit: सुदृढं निश्चलध्यानं मोक्षमार्गनियामकम् । तंदृष्ट्वा स्तोतुम् आरब्धाः सेन्द्रचन्द्राः सवारुणाः
verses.transliteration: sudṛḍhaṃ niścaladhyānaṃ mokṣamārganiyāmakam / taṃdṛṣṭvā stotum ārabdhāḥ sendracandrāḥ savāruṇāḥ

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः: जयम् इच्छस्व देवानां भगवन् कलशोद्भव । प्रसादसुमुखो भूत्वा देवानां भयमागतम्
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ: jayam icchasva devānāṃ bhagavan kalaśodbhava / prasādasumukho bhūtvā devānāṃ bhayamāgatam

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्य उवाच: किं कार्यं तु समुत्पन्नं येन दूरं समागताः । एकान्तवासिनं नित्यं तं मां यूयं सुराश् च भोः
verses.transliteration: agastya uvāca: kiṃ kāryaṃ tu samutpannaṃ yena dūraṃ samāgatāḥ / ekāntavāsinaṃ nityaṃ taṃ māṃ yūyaṃ surāś ca bhoḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: उच्यतां यन् मया कार्यं तत्सर्वं करवाण्य् अहम् । ततो मन्दानिलोद्धूतकमलाकरशोभिना
verses.transliteration: ucyatāṃ yan mayā kāryaṃ tatsarvaṃ karavāṇy aham / tato mandāniloddhūtakamalākaraśobhinā
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: गुरुं नेत्रसहस्रेण प्रेरयामास वृत्रहा । वाक्पतिर् उवाच: त्वया पूर्वं महाभाग देवकार्यार्थसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: guruṃ netrasahasreṇa prerayāmāsa vṛtrahā / vākpatir uvāca: tvayā pūrvaṃ mahābhāga devakāryārthasiddhaye
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: समुद्राः कर्षिताः सर्वे ईश्वरेण यथा जगत् । विध्वस्तास्त्रिदशाः सर्वे दानवैर् बलदर्पितैः
verses.transliteration: samudrāḥ karṣitāḥ sarve īśvareṇa yathā jagat / vidhvastāstridaśāḥ sarve dānavair baladarpitaiḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: जिता देवास् तु ते सर्वे दानवेभ्यः पराङ्मुखाः । तेषां वरापहाराय समुद्राः शोषिताः पुरा
verses.transliteration: jitā devās tu te sarve dānavebhyaḥ parāṅmukhāḥ / teṣāṃ varāpahārāya samudrāḥ śoṣitāḥ purā
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: साम्प्रतं दुःखिता धात्री पश्येमां भूतधारिणीम् । दैत्यभारेण दुःखार्ता भूमिर्जाता रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: sāmprataṃ duḥkhitā dhātrī paśyemāṃ bhūtadhāriṇīm / daityabhāreṇa duḥkhārtā bhūmirjātā rasātalam
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: गन्तव्यं दक्षिणामाशां तपोराशे द्विजोत्तम । नर्मदोदधिमर्यादां कुरु पुण्यां महाद्विज
verses.transliteration: gantavyaṃ dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ taporāśe dvijottama / narmadodadhimaryādāṃ kuru puṇyāṃ mahādvija
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धिं विन्ध्यनगस्यापि देवकार्यं समुद्धर । कौशिको ऽथ कनीयांस् ते य उन्मार्गप्रवर्तकः
verses.transliteration: vṛddhiṃ vindhyanagasyāpi devakāryaṃ samuddhara / kauśiko 'tha kanīyāṃs te ya unmārgapravartakaḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्य उवाच: देवकार्यं करिष्यामि सुखं तिष्ठ वसुन्धरे । गच्छामि दक्षिणाम् आशां शक्तः शिष्यस्य वारणे
verses.transliteration: agastya uvāca: devakāryaṃ kariṣyāmi sukhaṃ tiṣṭha vasundhare / gacchāmi dakṣiṇām āśāṃ śaktaḥ śiṣyasya vāraṇe
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: वर्धनं पर्वतस्यास्य वारयामि न संशयः । देवा ऊचुः: याम्यां गत्वा सुरैः सार्धं द्रष्टव्यो यं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: vardhanaṃ parvatasyāsya vārayāmi na saṃśayaḥ / devā ūcuḥ: yāmyāṃ gatvā suraiḥ sārdhaṃ draṣṭavyo yaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: सिंहस्थे भास्करे विप्र येन यास्यन्ति भक्तितः । नश्यते च धनं धान्यं तेषां सौख्यं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: siṃhasthe bhāskare vipra yena yāsyanti bhaktitaḥ / naśyate ca dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ teṣāṃ saukhyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: अधिकाराय देवानां स च दृष्टो भविष्यति । तत्प्रतिज्ञाय गीर्वाणाः समं वसुधया गताः
verses.transliteration: adhikārāya devānāṃ sa ca dṛṣṭo bhaviṣyati / tatpratijñāya gīrvāṇāḥ samaṃ vasudhayā gatāḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यं तपसां राशिं निर्गच्छन्तः समन्ततः । अगस्त्यपदविक्षेपाच् चलिता च वसुन्धरा
verses.transliteration: agastyaṃ tapasāṃ rāśiṃ nirgacchantaḥ samantataḥ / agastyapadavikṣepāc calitā ca vasundharā
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: मनोवेगेन सम्प्राप्तः कौशिको यत्र तापसः । कौशिको ऽपि गुरुं दृष्ट्वा साष्टाङ्गं प्रणिपत्य च
verses.transliteration: manovegena samprāptaḥ kauśiko yatra tāpasaḥ / kauśiko 'pi guruṃ dṛṣṭvā sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatya ca

verses.sanskrit: धन्ये ऽहं मुनिशार्दूलप्रीतो ऽहं तव दर्शनात् । अर्घपात्रं समादाय दध्यक्षतसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: dhanye 'haṃ muniśārdūlaprīto 'haṃ tava darśanāt / arghapātraṃ samādāya dadhyakṣatasamanvitam
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: दूर्वा च चन्दनं पूज्यभक्त्या पात्रे समाहितम् । गुरुपादपरिक्षिप्त उवाच मधुरं तदा
verses.transliteration: dūrvā ca candanaṃ pūjyabhaktyā pātre samāhitam / gurupādaparikṣipta uvāca madhuraṃ tadā
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
