verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: आदेशो दीयतां तात तव प्रेष्यो द्विजोत्तम । अगस्त्य उवाच: देवकार्यविघातं च कौशिक त्वं विसर्जय
verses.transliteration: ādeśo dīyatāṃ tāta tava preṣyo dvijottama / agastya uvāca: devakāryavighātaṃ ca kauśika tvaṃ visarjaya
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: देवकार्यविसृष्टेन कर्मणा न प्रवर्तसे । यदि ते निश्चला भक्तिर् विश्वामित्र ममोपरि
verses.transliteration: devakāryavisṛṣṭena karmaṇā na pravartase / yadi te niścalā bhaktir viśvāmitra mamopari
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: तदा त्वं वर्जयेः सर्वम् उन्मार्गस्य प्रवर्तनम् । विश्वामित्र उवाच: गुरुर् आत्मवतां शास्ता राजा शास्ता दुरात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: tadā tvaṃ varjayeḥ sarvam unmārgasya pravartanam / viśvāmitra uvāca: gurur ātmavatāṃ śāstā rājā śāstā durātmanām
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: इह प्रच्छन्नपापानां शास्ता वैवस्वतो यमः । स्पर्धया च वशिष्ठस्य त्रिशङ्कुर्मे सुयाचितः
verses.transliteration: iha pracchannapāpānāṃ śāstā vaivasvato yamaḥ / spardhayā ca vaśiṣṭhasya triśaṅkurme suyācitaḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य प्रभृति तत् सर्वं त्यक्तम् एव द्विजोत्तम । इत्युक्तः प्रययौ शीघ्रं रेवातीरं सुदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: adya prabhṛti tat sarvaṃ tyaktam eva dvijottama / ityuktaḥ prayayau śīghraṃ revātīraṃ sudurlabham
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरं तटम् आसाद्य तपस् तत्र समारभत् । नर्मदा त्रिषु लोकेषु पवित्रा पापनाशिनी
verses.transliteration: uttaraṃ taṭam āsādya tapas tatra samārabhat / narmadā triṣu lokeṣu pavitrā pāpanāśinī
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: निश्चयं परमं कृत्वा मित्रावरुणनन्दनः । शिलातले निविष्टस् तु चचार विपुलं तपः
verses.transliteration: niścayaṃ paramaṃ kṛtvā mitrāvaruṇanandanaḥ / śilātale niviṣṭas tu cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: वायुभक्षः सदा कालं कुम्भयोनिर् महातपाः । ज्ञातो भक्तियुतः श्रेष्ठ ईश्वरेण युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: vāyubhakṣaḥ sadā kālaṃ kumbhayonir mahātapāḥ / jñāto bhaktiyutaḥ śreṣṭha īśvareṇa yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षो द्वादशे वर्षे सङ्गतः पार्वतीपतिः । ईश्वर उवाच: साधु साधु मुनिश्रेष्ठ तपसा द्योतितं नभः
verses.transliteration: pratyakṣo dvādaśe varṣe saṅgataḥ pārvatīpatiḥ / īśvara uvāca: sādhu sādhu muniśreṣṭha tapasā dyotitaṃ nabhaḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: निश्चयं तव तुष्टो ऽस्मि मित्रावरुणनन्दन । वर्षायुतसहस्रेण नान्येषां वरदो ह्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: niścayaṃ tava tuṣṭo 'smi mitrāvaruṇanandana / varṣāyutasahasreṇa nānyeṣāṃ varado hy aham
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्य उवाच: संसारपल्वलातीतसृष्टिजन्मविवर्जित । दुर्लक्ष्यासुरसङ्घानां प्रमथेश नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: agastya uvāca: saṃsārapalvalātītasṛṣṭijanmavivarjita / durlakṣyāsurasaṅghānāṃ pramatheśa namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दिस्कन्दगणा देवा वृथा क्लिश्यन्ति मोहिताः । सनत्कुमारमुख्याश् च ऋषयः शंसितव्रताः
verses.transliteration: nandiskandagaṇā devā vṛthā kliśyanti mohitāḥ / sanatkumāramukhyāś ca ṛṣayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: त्वद् रूपं ते न जानन्ति शम्भो नाथ नमो ऽस्तु ते । ब्रह्माद्या देवताः सर्वे ध्यायन्ति त्वाम् अहर्निशम्
verses.transliteration: tvad rūpaṃ te na jānanti śambho nātha namo 'stu te / brahmādyā devatāḥ sarve dhyāyanti tvām aharniśam
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: नैते पश्यन्ति त्वद् रूपं धातर्देव नमो ऽस्तु ते । ईश्वर उवाच: प्रसन्नस् तव विप्रेन्द्र ऊर्ध्वरेतस् त्व् अयोनिज
verses.transliteration: naite paśyanti tvad rūpaṃ dhātardeva namo 'stu te / īśvara uvāca: prasannas tava viprendra ūrdhvaretas tv ayonija
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: तव भक्तिगृहीतो ऽहं प्रसन्न उमया सह । अगस्त्य उवाच: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि देवेश यदि देयो वरो मम
verses.transliteration: tava bhaktigṛhīto 'haṃ prasanna umayā saha / agastya uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: pratyakṣo bhava tīrthe 'smin yadi satyaṃ varapradaḥ / antarjale sadākālaṃ dharmādhyakṣo maheśvara

verses.transliteration: śilāyāṃ bhava nityaṃ ca narmadāyottare taṭe / devakāryasya kartāhaṃ tvatprasādāj jagatpate

verses.transliteration: tatheti coktvā vṛṣavāhano 'pi jagāma kailāsanagaṃ nageśaḥ / ayonijo yogabalena yuktaḥ pravidyayā liṅgabalāc chivasya

verses.sanskrit: जगाम दक्षिणाम् आशां सुरसङ्घैर् अभिष्टुतः । तपोवनं यथापुण्यं देवदानवसेवितम्
verses.transliteration: jagāma dakṣiṇām āśāṃ surasaṅghair abhiṣṭutaḥ / tapovanaṃ yathāpuṇyaṃ devadānavasevitam

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टो मुनिशार्दूलः पवित्रं देवकम्बलम् । निश्चला सुषमादेवी संस्थिता धरणी तथा
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭo muniśārdūlaḥ pavitraṃ devakambalam / niścalā suṣamādevī saṃsthitā dharaṇī tathā
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पाणि ववृषुर्देवा जयशब्दं पुनः पुनः । युधिष्ठिर उवाच: तस्य तीर्थस्य यत्पुण्यं कथ्यतां मुनिसुव्रत
verses.transliteration: puṣpāṇi vavṛṣurdevā jayaśabdaṃ punaḥ punaḥ / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: tasya tīrthasya yatpuṇyaṃ kathyatāṃ munisuvrata

verses.sanskrit: आदिमध्यावसाने च ब्राह्मणैः सह बान्धवैः । पितॄणां सर्वतीर्थानां सर्वसत्त्वोपकारकम्
verses.transliteration: ādimadhyāvasāne ca brāhmaṇaiḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ / pitṝṇāṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ sarvasattvopakārakam
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: पितॄन् मोक्षदं प्रोक्तं सर्वकाले जनाधिप । शिवाख्यां कार्त्तिके मासि कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशीम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: pitṝn mokṣadaṃ proktaṃ sarvakāle janādhipa / śivākhyāṃ kārttike māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: उपोष्य यो नरो भक्त्या कामक्रोधविवर्जितः । शमीतरुं समास्थाय रात्रौ कुर्वीत जागरम्
verses.transliteration: upoṣya yo naro bhaktyā kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ / śamītaruṃ samāsthāya rātrau kurvīta jāgaram
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: तत्कथालापसंयुक्तो धर्माख्यानैर् द्विजैः सह । गवां घृतेन देवेशं रात्रौ च स्नापयेत् पुनः
verses.transliteration: tatkathālāpasaṃyukto dharmākhyānair dvijaiḥ saha / gavāṃ ghṛtena deveśaṃ rātrau ca snāpayet punaḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.transliteration: ghaṭenaiva ghaṭārdhena tadardhena svaśaktitaḥ / ghṛtena bodhayed dīpaṃ ghṛtaṃ viprāya dāpayet
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.transliteration: pañcāmṛtena gavyena snāpayet parameśvaram / prabhāte pūjayed viprān svadāraniratān sadā
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.transliteration: vedābhyasanaśīlāṃś ca paradāravivarjitān / śūdrasevāratā nityaṃ dhūrtakarmaratā janāḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.transliteration: patitāḥ kūṭasākṣyeṇa pratigraharatāḥ sadā / vedadveṣaṇaśīlāś ca kubjāś ca vikalāḥ sadā
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.transliteration: hīnātiriktagātrā ye dvijāḥ śrāddhe vivarjitāḥ / vedoktena viśuddhāṅgāḥ pūjyā nityaṃ yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: भूमिदानेन वस्त्रेण कन्यादानैर् विशेषतः । श्राद्धकालेषु योगेषु भर्तव्या भक्तितत्परैः
verses.transliteration: bhūmidānena vastreṇa kanyādānair viśeṣataḥ / śrāddhakāleṣu yogeṣu bhartavyā bhaktitatparaiḥ
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.transliteration: godānaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ śreyo 'rtham ātmanas tathā / savatsāṃ kṣīriṇīṃ śubhrāṃ puṣṭāṃ vai śīlasaṃyutām

verses.sanskrit: कम्बलं परया भक्त्या पादुकोपानहौ तथा । हिरण्यरुक्मिणीं कन्थां ताम्बूलं भोजनं तथा
verses.transliteration: kambalaṃ parayā bhaktyā pādukopānahau tathā / hiraṇyarukmiṇīṃ kanthāṃ tāmbūlaṃ bhojanaṃ tathā

verses.sanskrit: घण्टाभरणशोभाढ्यां वस्त्रयुग्मावगुण्ठिताम् । स्वर्णशृङ्गीं रौप्यखुरीं कांस्यदोहेन संयुताम्
verses.transliteration: ghaṇṭābharaṇaśobhāḍhyāṃ vastrayugmāvaguṇṭhitām / svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurīṃ kāṃsyadohena saṃyutām
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: उच्चार्य परया भक्त्या यावद् आहूतसंप्लवम् । सर्व कोटिगुणं पार्थ शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम्
verses.transliteration: uccārya parayā bhaktyā yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam / sarva koṭiguṇaṃ pārtha śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थाख्यानं च यो भक्त्या पठते शृणुते ऽथवा । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः शिवलोके वसत्य् अपि
verses.transliteration: tīrthākhyānaṃ ca yo bhaktyā paṭhate śṛṇute 'thavā / mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ śivaloke vasaty api
verses.translation: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence with all efforts one should resort to a de- serving, well-qualified Brahmana. He shall then redeem the departed ones from hells, the chief whereof is Kumbhlpaka.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे ऽगस्त्यतीर्थवर्णनो नाम पञ्चनवतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ९६ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अथानन्देश्वरं गच्छेत् सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् । रुद्रस्य परमानन्दो यत्र जातो युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe 'gastyatīrthavarṇano nāma pañcanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 96 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: athānandeśvaraṃ gacchet sarvadevanamaskṛtam / rudrasya paramānando yatra jāto yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तीर्थं कथयिष्यामि सूर्यपापक्षयं करम् । युधिष्ठिर उवाच: आनन्दश् चैव संजातो रुद्रस्य द्विजसत्तम
verses.transliteration: tattīrthaṃ kathayiṣyāmi sūryapāpakṣayaṃ karam / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: ānandaś caiva saṃjāto rudrasya dvijasattama
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: कथयस्व महाभाग संक्षेपान् मुनिसत्तम । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: कथयामि नृपश्रेष्ठ आनन्देश्वरम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kathayasva mahābhāga saṃkṣepān munisattama / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: kathayāmi nṛpaśreṣṭha ānandeśvaram uttamam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: दानवानां वधं कृत्वा देवदेवश् च शङ्करः । पूजितो दैवतैः सर्वैः किन्नरैर् यक्षपन्नगैः
verses.transliteration: dānavānāṃ vadhaṃ kṛtvā devadevaś ca śaṅkaraḥ / pūjito daivataiḥ sarvaiḥ kinnarair yakṣapannagaiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दं परमं प्राप्य ननर्त वृषवाहनः । भैरवं रूपम् आसाद्य गौरी चार्द्धाङ्गधारिता
verses.transliteration: ānandaṃ paramaṃ prāpya nanarta vṛṣavāhanaḥ / bhairavaṃ rūpam āsādya gaurī cārddhāṅgadhāritā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: भूतवेतालकङ्कालैर् भैरवैर् भैरवो वृतः । नर्मदायोत्तरे तीरे दक्षिणे पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: bhūtavetālakaṅkālair bhairavair bhairavo vṛtaḥ / narmadāyottare tīre dakṣiṇe pāṇḍunandana
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टैर् मरुद्गणैस् तत्र स्थापितः कमलासनः । तदा प्रभृति वै देव आनन्देश्वर उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭair marudgaṇais tatra sthāpitaḥ kamalāsanaḥ / tadā prabhṛti vai deva ānandeśvara ucyate
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां पौर्णमास्यां नराधिप । विधिं स्नात्वार्चयेद् देवां सुगन्धेन विलेपयेत्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ narādhipa / vidhiṃ snātvārcayed devāṃ sugandhena vilepayet
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणान् पूजयेत् तत्र यथाशक्त्या युधिष्ठिर । गोदानं तत्र कर्तव्यं वस्त्रदानं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇān pūjayet tatra yathāśaktyā yudhiṣṭhira / godānaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ vastradānaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: वसन्तस्य त्रयोदश्यां श्राद्धं तत्रैव कारयेत् । इङ्गुदैर् बदरैर् बिल्वैर् अक्षतेन जलेन वा
verses.transliteration: vasantasya trayodaśyāṃ śrāddhaṃ tatraiva kārayet / iṅgudair badarair bilvair akṣatena jalena vā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेतानां कारयेच् छ्राद्धम् आनन्देश्वरतीर्थके । प्रेता आनन्दिताः स्युस् ते यावद् आहूत सम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: pretānāṃ kārayec chrāddham ānandeśvaratīrthake / pretā ānanditāḥ syus te yāvad āhūta samplavam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: सन्ततिर्धनसौख्यं च सप्तजन्मनि जायते । आनन्दश् च भवेत् तेषां जन्म जन्म युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: santatirdhanasaukhyaṃ ca saptajanmani jāyate / ānandaś ca bhavet teṣāṃ janma janma yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत् तु राजेन्द्र मातृतीर्थम् अनुत्तमम् । सङ्गमस्य समीपस्थं नर्मदादक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra mātṛtīrtham anuttamam / saṅgamasya samīpasthaṃ narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: मातरस् तत्र राजेन्द्र संजाता नर्मदातटे । उमया याचितस् तत्र व्यालयज्ञोपवीतकः
verses.transliteration: mātaras tatra rājendra saṃjātā narmadātaṭe / umayā yācitas tatra vyālayajñopavītakaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच योगिनीवृन्दं कष्टं कष्टं न शोभनम् । उवाच वरदश् चास्मि योगिवृन्दवरप्रदः
verses.transliteration: uvāca yoginīvṛndaṃ kaṣṭaṃ kaṣṭaṃ na śobhanam / uvāca varadaś cāsmi yogivṛndavarapradaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: योगिन्य ऊचुः: अजेयाः सर्वदेवानां त्वत् प्रसादान् महेश्वर । तीर्थानामभिसंख्याने प्रख्याता वसुधातले
verses.transliteration: yoginya ūcuḥ: ajeyāḥ sarvadevānāṃ tvat prasādān maheśvara / tīrthānāmabhisaṃkhyāne prakhyātā vasudhātale
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: एवं भवतु योगिन्यस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bhavatu yoginyas tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: तस्मिंस् तीर्थे तु यो मर्त्यो नवम्यां विजितेन्द्रियः । उपोष्य परया भक्त्या पूजयेन् मातृमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasmiṃs tīrthe tu yo martyo navamyāṃ vijitendriyaḥ / upoṣya parayā bhaktyā pūjayen mātṛmaṇḍalam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य ता मातरः प्रीताः प्रीतो ऽयं वृषवाहनः । बन्ध्याया मृतवत्साया अपुत्राया युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: tasya tā mātaraḥ prītāḥ prīto 'yaṃ vṛṣavāhanaḥ / bandhyāyā mṛtavatsāyā aputrāyā yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: स्नपनं चारभेत् तत्र मन्त्रज्ञैर् ब्राह्मणोत्तमैः । सहिरण्येन कुम्भेन पञ्चरत्नफलान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: snapanaṃ cārabhet tatra mantrajñair brāhmaṇottamaiḥ / sahiraṇyena kumbhena pañcaratnaphalānvitam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयेत् पुत्रकामा च कांस्यपात्रेण मन्त्रतः । पुत्रान् सा लभते नारी वीर्ययुक्तान् गुणान्वितान्
verses.transliteration: snāpayet putrakāmā ca kāṃsyapātreṇa mantrataḥ / putrān sā labhate nārī vīryayuktān guṇānvitān
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: यं यं कामम् अभिध्यायेत् तं तं सा लभते नृप । मातृतीर्थात् परं तीर्थं नास्त्य् अन्यत् पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: yaṃ yaṃ kāmam abhidhyāyet taṃ taṃ sā labhate nṛpa / mātṛtīrthāt paraṃ tīrthaṃ nāsty anyat pāṇḍunandana
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैवानन्तरं तात जलमध्येश्वरं परम् । लिङ्गेश्वरमिति ख्यातं सुरासुरनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tasyaivānantaraṃ tāta jalamadhyeśvaraṃ param / liṅgeśvaramiti khyātaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: अत्यक्ता सा तु रेवा या कथं त्यक्ता च शम्भुना । जलमध्ये हि तिष्ठेत शूलपाणिः पिनाकधृक्
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: atyaktā sā tu revā yā kathaṃ tyaktā ca śambhunā / jalamadhye hi tiṣṭheta śūlapāṇiḥ pinākadhṛk
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: तदहं श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तव वाक्याद् द्विजोत्तम । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: आश्चर्यभूता लोके ऽस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठा पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: tadahaṃ śrotum icchāmi tava vākyād dvijottama / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: āścaryabhūtā loke 'smin pratiṣṭhā pāṇḍunandana
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: पण्डितो वृद्धभावेन कथयामि नृपोत्तम । आदौ कृतयुगे तात दानवो बलदर्पितः
verses.transliteration: paṇḍito vṛddhabhāvena kathayāmi nṛpottama / ādau kṛtayuge tāta dānavo baladarpitaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: कालबाष्प इति प्रोक्तो दुर्जयो देवदानवैः । तपश् चचार विपुलं नर्मदाया जले शुभे
verses.transliteration: kālabāṣpa iti prokto durjayo devadānavaiḥ / tapaś cacāra vipulaṃ narmadāyā jale śubhe
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: आराधयन् महादेवम् उग्रेण तपसा भृशम् । ततस् तुतोष भगवान् सपत्नीको महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: ārādhayan mahādevam ugreṇa tapasā bhṛśam / tatas tutoṣa bhagavān sapatnīko maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: भो भो वत्स वरं ब्रूहि तुष्टो ऽहं तव भक्तितः । देवस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा कालबाष्पो ऽब्रवीद् वचः
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: bho bho vatsa varaṃ brūhi tuṣṭo 'haṃ tava bhaktitaḥ / devasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kālabāṣpo 'bravīd vacaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: देवाश् चैव मया भग्नाः प्रसादात् तव शूलिनः । संग्रामे च विषण्णो ऽहं तस्माद् आराधनं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: devāś caiva mayā bhagnāḥ prasādāt tava śūlinaḥ / saṃgrāme ca viṣaṇṇo 'haṃ tasmād ārādhanaṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: हस्तं शिरसि यस्यैव दास्यामि च महेश्वर । न स जीवेत् पुमांल् लोके वरम् एतं ददस्व मे
verses.transliteration: hastaṃ śirasi yasyaiva dāsyāmi ca maheśvara / na sa jīvet pumāṃl loke varam etaṃ dadasva me
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: यत् ते ऽभिलषितं दैत्य तत् तथैव भविष्यति । इति श्रुत्वा वचो दैत्यः शम्भुम् एवाभिदुद्रुवे
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: yat te 'bhilaṣitaṃ daitya tat tathaiva bhaviṣyati / iti śrutvā vaco daityaḥ śambhum evābhidudruve

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: हस्तं ते मूर्ध्नि दास्यामि न तत्सत्यं वचस् तव । रुद्रः पलायितस् तेन केशवं शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: hastaṃ te mūrdhni dāsyāmi na tatsatyaṃ vacas tava / rudraḥ palāyitas tena keśavaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: निवेद्य केशवं सर्वं तस्मिन्न् एव न्यलीयत । केशव उवाच: हन्म्य् अहं तं महादेव दुष्टं दैत्यजनेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nivedya keśavaṃ sarvaṃ tasminn eva nyalīyata / keśava uvāca: hanmy ahaṃ taṃ mahādeva duṣṭaṃ daityajaneśvaram
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: हस्तं शिरसि तस्यैव दापयामि महेश्वर । ततस् त्वरितमापन्नः प्रविष्टो नमदातटे
verses.transliteration: hastaṃ śirasi tasyaiva dāpayāmi maheśvara / tatas tvaritamāpannaḥ praviṣṭo namadātaṭe

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णः स्त्रीवेषधारी च दैत्यसंमुखम् आगतः । द्वात्रिंशल्लक्षणोपेता नियुक्ता कामसायकैः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇaḥ strīveṣadhārī ca daityasaṃmukham āgataḥ / dvātriṃśallakṣaṇopetā niyuktā kāmasāyakaiḥ

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मधुमाथवके शम्भुं ध्यात्वा सर्वत्र कैशवी । वनं बभ्राम सर्वत्र सुशीला वटपादपम्
verses.transliteration: madhumāthavake śambhuṃ dhyātvā sarvatra kaiśavī / vanaṃ babhrāma sarvatra suśīlā vaṭapādapam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: क्षोभयन्तीव चित्तानि सा रेमे धर्मनन्दन । रिङ्गमाणश् च दैत्यो ऽसौ कालबाष्पः सुदुर्जनः
verses.transliteration: kṣobhayantīva cittāni sā reme dharmanandana / riṅgamāṇaś ca daityo 'sau kālabāṣpaḥ sudurjanaḥ

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टः स वने रम्ये यत्र सा शुभलोचना । अहं भवामि ते भर्ता दुर्जयो देवदानवैः
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭaḥ sa vane ramye yatra sā śubhalocanā / ahaṃ bhavāmi te bhartā durjayo devadānavaiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यस्वामिनी त्वं च प्रसीद मम सुन्दरि । श्रीकृष्ण उवाच: यदि मां मन्यसे भार्यां प्रत्ययश् च भवेन् मम
verses.transliteration: trailokyasvāminī tvaṃ ca prasīda mama sundari / śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca: yadi māṃ manyase bhāryāṃ pratyayaś ca bhaven mama
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: दानव उवाच: स्वयं भवामि तन्वङ्गि शपथं मम साधनम् । तद् अहं च करिष्यामि इति मे सत्यभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: dānava uvāca: svayaṃ bhavāmi tanvaṅgi śapathaṃ mama sādhanam / tad ahaṃ ca kariṣyāmi iti me satyabhāṣitam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्र्युवाच: कुरुष्व त्वं महाभाग शिरो हस्ते प्रदीयताम् । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: कामान्धेनैव राजेन्द्र निक्षिप्तो मस्तके करः
verses.transliteration: stryuvāca: kuruṣva tvaṃ mahābhāga śiro haste pradīyatām / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: kāmāndhenaiva rājendra nikṣipto mastake karaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तत्क्षणाद् अभवद् भस्म दग्धस् तृणचयो यथा । केशवस्योपरि तदा पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात ह
verses.transliteration: tatkṣaṇād abhavad bhasma dagdhas tṛṇacayo yathā / keśavasyopari tadā puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ha
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: गताः सर्वे दिवं देवाः स्वस्थानं विगतज्वराः । क्षौराब्धिम् अगमद् विष्णुः कालबाष्पे निपातिते
verses.transliteration: gatāḥ sarve divaṃ devāḥ svasthānaṃ vigatajvarāḥ / kṣaurābdhim agamad viṣṇuḥ kālabāṣpe nipātite

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयाद् भक्त्या चरितं दानवस्य च । श्राद्धं तत्रैव यः कुर्यात् कामक्रोधविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā caritaṃ dānavasya ca / śrāddhaṃ tatraiva yaḥ kuryāt kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृतास् तेन सर्वे वै नरकाच् च पितामहाः । क्षेत्रे तस्मिंस् तु यो दद्याद् ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे
verses.transliteration: uddhṛtās tena sarve vai narakāc ca pitāmahāḥ / kṣetre tasmiṃs tu yo dadyād brāhmaṇe vedapārage
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य दानफलं सर्वं कुरुक्षेत्राद् विशिष्यते । स्पर्शते य इदं लिङ्गं शङ्करेण च निर्मितम्
verses.transliteration: tasya dānaphalaṃ sarvaṃ kurukṣetrād viśiṣyate / sparśate ya idaṃ liṅgaṃ śaṅkareṇa ca nirmitam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: स्पर्शमात्रो मनुष्यस् तु रुद्रवासो ऽभिजायते । एतस्मात् कारणाद् राजंल् लोकपालाश्च देवताः
verses.transliteration: sparśamātro manuṣyas tu rudravāso 'bhijāyate / etasmāt kāraṇād rājaṃl lokapālāśca devatāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गादेवी तथा चैव मधुहन्ता चतुर्भुजः । दानवाद्याश् च सर्वे ऽपि रक्षणे चेश्वरस्य च
verses.transliteration: durgādevī tathā caiva madhuhantā caturbhujaḥ / dānavādyāś ca sarve 'pi rakṣaṇe ceśvarasya ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: रक्षन्ते च सदाकालं गृहव्यापाररूपतः । पुत्रभ्रातृसमा भूत्वा स्वामिसम्बन्धरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: rakṣante ca sadākālaṃ gṛhavyāpārarūpataḥ / putrabhrātṛsamā bhūtvā svāmisambandharūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the great Kotisvara Tirtha where, O descendant of Kuru, a crore of sages came there for the sake of the welfare of Kr$nadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: liṅgeśvaraṃ tu rājendra devairadyā 'pi rakṣyate

verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe bhasmāsuravadho nāma ṣaṇṇavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 97 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchec ca rājendra dhanadaṃ tīrtham uttamam / narmadādakṣiṇe kūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
verses.translation: Thereafter, a person should go to the excellent Vyasatirtha, O king. It is rarely accessible to men. It is meri- torious and is stationed in the air-space between heaven and earth.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, a person should go to the excellent Vyasatirtha, O king. It is rarely accessible to men. It is meri- torious and is stationed in the air-space between heaven and earth.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतीर्थफलं तत्र प्राप्यते नात्र संशयः । चैत्रमासे त्रयोदश्यां शुक्लपक्षे जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: sarvatīrthaphalaṃ tatra prāpyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / caitramāse trayodaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: No bird crosses beyond the terrible trident. O prince, I shall succinctly mention its region.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: No bird crosses beyond the terrible trident. O prince, I shall succinctly mention its region.
verses.commentary: Sense: No bird crosses beyond the terrible trident. O prince, I shall succinctly mention its region.

verses.sanskrit: उपोष्य परया भक्त्या रात्रौ कुर्वीत जागरम् । पञ्चामृतेन राजेन्द्र स्नापयेद् वरदं विभुम्
verses.transliteration: upoṣya parayā bhaktyā rātrau kurvīta jāgaram / pañcāmṛtena rājendra snāpayed varadaṃ vibhum
verses.translation: O fair lady, by my knowledge (insight) I know your nativity. You are not the daughter of a fisherman. O beautiful woman, you are the daughter of a king. 8
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिग्रहाविमुक्ताश् च विद्यासिद्धान्तवादिनः । भर्तव्या हि प्रियैर् भक्त्या परिवादविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: pratigrahāvimuktāś ca vidyāsiddhāntavādinaḥ / bhartavyā hi priyair bhaktyā parivādavivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: King Vasu, the chastiser of enemies, has gone to the other shore. O splendid lady, without boats it is impossible to go there. All the boats are taken to the other shore.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: King Vasu, the chastiser of enemies, has gone to the other shore. O splendid lady, without boats it is impossible to go there. All the boats are taken to the other shore.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयेद् गोहिरण्येन वस्त्रालंकरणेन च । हस्त्यश्वरथदानेन सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: pūjayed gohiraṇyena vastrālaṃkaraṇena ca / hastyaśvarathadānena sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet
verses.translation: Take this letter and go quickly to the presence of King Vasu.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Take this letter and go quickly to the presence of King Vasu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Take this letter and go quickly to the presence of King Vasu.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिजन्मजनितं पापं धनदस्य प्रभावतः । स्वर्गदं दुर्विनीतानां विनीतानां च मुक्तिदम्
verses.transliteration: trijanmajanitaṃ pāpaṃ dhanadasya prabhāvataḥ / svargadaṃ durvinītānāṃ vinītānāṃ ca muktidam
verses.translation: Then she (the girl with the boat) reflected upon the words, of Parasara and said: "Well, O dear Brahniana, there is the odour of fish emanating from me." After saying this, O king, she was willing to surrender herself.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: धनवान् स नरव्याघ्र भवेज् जन्मनि जन्मनि । कुलीनत्वं स्वरूपत्वं दुःखं नास्ति निरन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: dhanavān sa naravyāghra bhavej janmani janmani / kulīnatvaṃ svarūpatvaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti nirantaram
verses.translation: On seeing that boy of her own family, O son of Kunti, the maiden became suspicious and nervous. Tremblingly she sought refuge in the sage saying: "O excellent sage, save, save my son, the wonderful son with a loin cloth and excellent girdle, holding a staff, having matted hairs and embellished with an upper cloth."
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: व्याधेस् तु न भयं तेषां नन्देद् धनदसेवनात् । धनस्य च यस् तीर्थे विद्यां वै प्रददाति हि
verses.transliteration: vyādhes tu na bhayaṃ teṣāṃ nanded dhanadasevanāt / dhanasya ca yas tīrthe vidyāṃ vai pradadāti hi
verses.translation: O dear son, do not go away now abandoning me, your sinless mother. Due to separation from you, there is no doubt, 1 will die soon.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: O dear son, do not go away now abandoning me, your sinless mother. Due to separation from you, there is no doubt, 1 will die soon.

verses.sanskrit: स याति भास्करं लोकं सर्वदुःखविवर्जितः । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अहं ते कथयिष्यामि चेतिहासं पुरातनम्
verses.transliteration: sa yāti bhāskaraṃ lokaṃ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ahaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi cetihāsaṃ purātanam

verses.sanskrit: द्वे भार्य्ये कश्यपस्यास्तां सर्वलोकेष्व् अनुत्तमे । गरुत्मान् विनतापुत्रः कद्रूपुत्रोरगाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: dve bhāryye kaśyapasyāstāṃ sarvalokeṣv anuttame / garutmān vinatāputraḥ kadrūputroragāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: He took bath in Ganga. Kedara and Pu$kara were visited by him. So also Gaya, Naimiga, Kuruksetra and Sarasvati. He visited Mahakala at Ujjayini and Somanatha at Prabhasaka. The great sage took his holy ablution everywhere on the earth girt by the ocean.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: सन्तोषेण द्वयं तात तिष्ठतः काश्यपे गृहे । कद्र्वास् तु भगिनी तत्र इष्टा च विनता तथा
verses.transliteration: santoṣeṇa dvayaṃ tāta tiṣṭhataḥ kāśyape gṛhe / kadrvās tu bhaginī tatra iṣṭā ca vinatā tathā
verses.translation: Let it be so in your case, dear son, undoubtedly with my favour. I have been captivated by your devotion. I shall be visible on the banks of Narmada by a half of one-thou- sandth part in your hermitage.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: krīḍed vinatayā sārdhaṃ kaśyapo 'pi prajāpatiḥ / tatas tv ekadine pārtha āśramasthā suśobhanā
verses.translation: But Mbfe does not mention VySsa's marriage. It was at the sight of the celestial lady GhrtScI that Vyiys had emission of semen and £uka was bom. (MM& ton* 324. 4-10)

verses.sanskrit: उच्चैःश्रवोहयं दृष्ट्वा अतिवेगं नभःस्थितम् । पश्य पश्य च तन्वङ्गि अश्वं सर्वत्र पाण्डुरम्
verses.transliteration: uccaiḥśravohayaṃ dṛṣṭvā ativegaṃ nabhaḥsthitam / paśya paśya ca tanvaṅgi aśvaṃ sarvatra pāṇḍuram
verses.translation: He bowed to them severally and invited all of them. On seeing the sage Kr$nadvaipayana humbly bowing down, they blessed him with benedictions for success and looked at one another. All of them then looked at Parasara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: धावमानम् अविश्रान्तं जवेन मानसोपमम् । कद्रूर् उवाच: कथम् एतत् तु तन्वङ्गि कृष्णं जल्पसि पाण्डुरम्
verses.transliteration: dhāvamānam aviśrāntaṃ javena mānasopamam / kadrūr uvāca: katham etat tu tanvaṅgi kṛṣṇaṃ jalpasi pāṇḍuram
verses.translation: "Be victorious, O venerable goddess. Obeisance to you, O bestower of boons. Be victorious, O destroyer of sins

verses.transliteration: asatyaṃ bhāṣitaṃ bhadre yamalokaṃ gamiṣyasi / vinatovāca: satyānṛte tu vacane paṇo 'yaṃ me 'stu te 'dhunā

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रं चैव वर्षाणाम् अज्ञात्वा दास्यतां व्रजेत् । असत्या यदि मे वाणी कृष्ण उच्चैःश्रवाहयः
verses.transliteration: sahasraṃ caiva varṣāṇām ajñātvā dāsyatāṃ vrajet / asatyā yadi me vāṇī kṛṣṇa uccaiḥśravāhayaḥ
verses.translation: "O Vyasa, O great sage, 1 am delighted with your truthful utterance. If at all you desire to be granted any boon, I shall fully grant it to you. M
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
