verses.commentary: Sense: "O Vyasa, O great sage, 1 am delighted with your truthful utterance. If at all you desire to be granted any boon, I shall fully grant it to you. M

verses.sanskrit: तदाहं त्वद् गृहे दासी सर्वदैव भवामि हि । यदि तूच्चैःश्रवाः श्वेतो दासी त्वं मद्गृहे पुनः
verses.transliteration: tadāhaṃ tvad gṛhe dāsī sarvadaiva bhavāmi hi / yadi tūccaiḥśravāḥ śveto dāsī tvaṃ madgṛhe punaḥ
verses.translation: Benefit has been indicated by all the Tirthas for resorting to them; yet due to my deficiency of fortune, O divine river, my meritorious hope has become futile like forest-flowers in the case of people.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Benefit has been indicated by all the Tirthas for resorting to them; yet due to my deficiency of fortune, O divine river, my meritorious hope has become futile like forest-flowers in the case of people.
verses.commentary: Sense: Benefit has been indicated by all the Tirthas for resorting to them; yet due to my deficiency of fortune, O divine river, my meritorious hope has become futile like forest-flowers in the case of people.

verses.sanskrit: एवं परस्परं द्वाभ्यां दासीयम् अब्रवीद् इति । स्वाश्रमं हि गता कद्रू रात्रौ चिन्तातुरा स्थिता
verses.transliteration: evaṃ parasparaṃ dvābhyāṃ dāsīyam abravīd iti / svāśramaṃ hi gatā kadrū rātrau cintāturā sthitā
verses.translation: Holy ablution, libations and the Nitya rites (de- scribed as daily rites) were performed by the excellent Brahmanas. Thereafter they went to Vyasakun<Ja and performed Homa by means of Sriphalas and Bilva leaves in the holy fire.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Holy ablution, libations and the Nitya rites (de- scribed as daily rites) were performed by the excellent Brahmanas. Thereafter they went to Vyasakun<Ja and performed Homa by means of Sriphalas and Bilva leaves in the holy fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Holy ablution, libations and the Nitya rites (de- scribed as daily rites) were performed by the excellent Brahmanas. Thereafter they went to Vyasakun<Ja and performed Homa by means of Sriphalas and Bilva leaves in the holy fire.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतवर्णं तु कथितं श्यामं तमश्वकं तदा । पुत्राणां कथितं पार्थ पणश्चैव कृतो मया
verses.transliteration: śvetavarṇaṃ tu kathitaṃ śyāmaṃ tamaśvakaṃ tadā / putrāṇāṃ kathitaṃ pārtha paṇaścaiva kṛto mayā
verses.translation: Do tell me in its entirety, whatever is merito- rious as associated with Vyasatirtha. At what time do Snana, Dana and the other rites yield great benefit?
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Do tell me in its entirety, whatever is merito- rious as associated with Vyasatirtha. At what time do Snana, Dana and the other rites yield great benefit?
verses.commentary: Sense: Do tell me in its entirety, whatever is merito- rious as associated with Vyasatirtha. At what time do Snana, Dana and the other rites yield great benefit?

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतं सर्वैस् तथा वाक्यं सर्पैर् मातृपणस् तदा । जाता दासी न सन्देहः श्वेतो भास्करवाहनः
verses.transliteration: śrutaṃ sarvais tathā vākyaṃ sarpair mātṛpaṇas tadā / jātā dāsī na sandehaḥ śveto bhāskaravāhanaḥ
verses.translation: O great king, one should devoutly take the holy ablution on a full-moon day in accordance with the injunctions while uttering the prescribed Mantras. It destroys all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O great king, one should devoutly take the holy ablution on a full-moon day in accordance with the injunctions while uttering the prescribed Mantras. It destroys all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great king, one should devoutly take the holy ablution on a full-moon day in accordance with the injunctions while uttering the prescribed Mantras. It destroys all sins.

verses.sanskrit: कद्रूर् उवाच: यथाहं न भवे दासी तत्कार्यं च विचिन्त्यताम् । उच्चैःश्रवो रोमकूपे विशध्वं यूयमेव च
verses.transliteration: kadrūr uvāca: yathāhaṃ na bhave dāsī tatkāryaṃ ca vicintyatām / uccaiḥśravo romakūpe viśadhvaṃ yūyameva ca
verses.translation: I have made a true statement that he who desires heavenly pleasures should make the gift of bullocks with well- adorned hoofs (with silver plate) along with food-grains and sundry articles of daily use.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: I have made a true statement that he who desires heavenly pleasures should make the gift of bullocks with well- adorned hoofs (with silver plate) along with food-grains and sundry articles of daily use.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have made a true statement that he who desires heavenly pleasures should make the gift of bullocks with well- adorned hoofs (with silver plate) along with food-grains and sundry articles of daily use.

verses.sanskrit: एकं मुहूर्तं तिष्ठध्वं यावत् कृष्णः प्रदृश्यते । क्षणेनैकेन भवतां दासी सा भवते मम
verses.transliteration: ekaṃ muhūrtaṃ tiṣṭhadhvaṃ yāvat kṛṣṇaḥ pradṛśyate / kṣaṇenaikena bhavatāṃ dāsī sā bhavate mama
verses.translation: By the power of Vyasatirtha he successively goes to the worlds of Sun-god, Sankara, Virinci and Vi?nu and enjoys the pleasures there as he pleases.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: By the power of Vyasatirtha he successively goes to the worlds of Sun-god, Sankara, Virinci and Vi?nu and enjoys the pleasures there as he pleases.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the power of Vyasatirtha he successively goes to the worlds of Sun-god, Sankara, Virinci and Vi?nu and enjoys the pleasures there as he pleases.

verses.sanskrit: दासीत्वे या तु तन्वङ्गी विनता सत्यगार्विता । ततः स्वस्थानगाः सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः सदा
verses.transliteration: dāsītve yā tu tanvaṅgī vinatā satyagārvitā / tataḥ svasthānagāḥ sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ sadā
verses.translation: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.

verses.sanskrit: सर्पा ऊचुः: यथा त्वं जननी चैव सर्वेषां भुवि पन्नगी । तथा सापि विशेषण वञ्चितव्या न मातृवत्
verses.transliteration: sarpā ūcuḥ: yathā tvaṃ jananī caiva sarveṣāṃ bhuvi pannagī / tathā sāpi viśeṣaṇa vañcitavyā na mātṛvat
verses.translation: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा तेन वाक्येन क्रुद्धा कालानलोपमा । मम वाक्यम् अकुर्वाणा ये केचिद् भुवि पन्नगाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā tena vākyena kruddhā kālānalopamā / mama vākyam akurvāṇā ye kecid bhuvi pannagāḥ
verses.translation: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.

verses.sanskrit: हव्यवाहमुखं सर्वे यास्यन्तीत्य् अविचारिणः । तेन वाक्येन भीतास्ते हयरोमसुवेष्टिताः
verses.transliteration: havyavāhamukhaṃ sarve yāsyantīty avicāriṇaḥ / tena vākyena bhītāste hayaromasuveṣṭitāḥ
verses.translation: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.

verses.sanskrit: नष्टाः केचिद् दिशो दिव्याः कद्रूशापभयान्विताः । केचिद् गङ्गाजले नष्टाः केचिन् नष्टाः सरस्वतीम्
verses.transliteration: naṣṭāḥ kecid diśo divyāḥ kadrūśāpabhayānvitāḥ / kecid gaṅgājale naṣṭāḥ kecin naṣṭāḥ sarasvatīm
verses.translation: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.

verses.sanskrit: केचिन् महोदधिं नीताः प्रविष्टा विन्ध्यकन्दरे । आश्रित्य नर्मदातोयं मणिनागोत्तमो नृप
verses.transliteration: kecin mahodadhiṃ nītāḥ praviṣṭā vindhyakandare / āśritya narmadātoyaṃ maṇināgottamo nṛpa
verses.translation: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.

verses.sanskrit: चचार विपुलं भक्त्या उत्तरे नर्मदातटे । मातृशापधरो नागः प्रविष्टो नर्मदाजले
verses.transliteration: cacāra vipulaṃ bhaktyā uttare narmadātaṭe / mātṛśāpadharo nāgaḥ praviṣṭo narmadājale
verses.translation: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्प्रसादेन भो नाथ मातृशापं तराम्य् अहम् । हव्यवाहमुखं यस्मात् प्रयामि न जगत्पते
verses.transliteration: tvatprasādena bho nātha mātṛśāpaṃ tarāmy aham / havyavāhamukhaṃ yasmāt prayāmi na jagatpate
verses.translation: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: हव्यवाहमुखं वत्स न यास्यसि ममाज्ञया । मम लोकनिवासो ऽपि तव पुत्र भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: havyavāhamukhaṃ vatsa na yāsyasi mamājñayā / mama lokanivāso 'pi tava putra bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.

verses.sanskrit: मणिनाग उवाच: अस्मिन् स्थाने महादेव स्थीयताम् अंशभागतः । सहस्रांशेन भागेन स्थीयतां नर्मदाजले
verses.transliteration: maṇināga uvāca: asmin sthāne mahādeva sthīyatām aṃśabhāgataḥ / sahasrāṃśena bhāgena sthīyatāṃ narmadājale
verses.translation: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.

verses.sanskrit: उपकाराय लोकानां मम नाम्ना च शङ्कर । ईश्वर उवाच: स्थापय स्वपरं लिङ्गमाज्ञया मम पन्नग
verses.transliteration: upakārāya lokānāṃ mama nāmnā ca śaṅkara / īśvara uvāca: sthāpaya svaparaṃ liṅgamājñayā mama pannaga
verses.translation: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे देवस्तदैव शिवया सह । तत्र तीर्थे तु ये भक्त्या शुचयो यतमानसाः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvāntardadhe devastadaiva śivayā saha / tatra tīrthe tu ye bhaktyā śucayo yatamānasāḥ
verses.translation: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चम्यां च चतुर्दश्याम् अष्टम्यां शुक्लपक्षके । अर्चयन्ति सदा पार्थ नोपसर्पन्ति ते यमम्
verses.transliteration: pañcamyāṃ ca caturdaśyām aṣṭamyāṃ śuklapakṣake / arcayanti sadā pārtha nopasarpanti te yamam
verses.translation: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, one who casts his life in that Tlrtha goes to the presence of Siva after piercing the world of Sun.

verses.sanskrit: दध्ना च मधुना चैव घृतेन क्षीरतो जनाः । स्नापयन्ति विरूपाक्षम् उमादेहार्धधारिणम्
verses.transliteration: dadhnā ca madhunā caiva ghṛtena kṣīrato janāḥ / snāpayanti virūpākṣam umādehārdhadhāriṇam

verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to an extremely splendid Tirtha on the northern bank of Narmada in the centre of Yajnavata (sacrificial hall), well-known on the earth as Sahkarsana. It is destructive of sins. Formerly, O king, a penance was performed by Balabhadra there.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: tadeva balamāśritya kadācit pāpam ācaret / ajñānāt tasya tatkṣipraṃ na phalaṃ hi kadācana

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु गोदानं शक्तिमात्रेण दापयेत् । तद् अक्षयं फलं सर्वं जायते पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu godānaṃ śaktimātreṇa dāpayet / tad akṣayaṃ phalaṃ sarvaṃ jāyate pāṇḍunandana

verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: nāradena muniśreṣṭha kasya tīrthaṃ vinirmitam / etad ākhyāhi me sarva prasanno yadi sattama

verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: parameṣṭhisutaścāpi nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ / narmadāyotare kūle tapas tepe purākṛte

verses.sanskrit: नवनाडीनिरोधेन काष्ठावस्थां गतेन च । तोषितः श्रीमहादेवो नारदेन युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: navanāḍīnirodhena kāṣṭhāvasthāṃ gatena ca / toṣitaḥ śrīmahādevo nāradena yudhiṣṭhira

verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: tuṣṭo 'haṃ tava viprendra yogīśvara ayonija / varaṃ prārthaya he deva yat te manasi vartate

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच: त्वत्प्रसादेन भो देव योगश् चैव प्रसिध्यतु । ईश्वर उवाच: योगो भवतु भक्तिस् ते सर्वकालं ममैव तु
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca: tvatprasādena bho deva yogaś caiva prasidhyatu / īśvara uvāca: yogo bhavatu bhaktis te sarvakālaṃ mamaiva tu

verses.transliteration: saptasvarāstrayo grāmā mūrchanās tv ekaviṃśatiḥ / mama priyakaraṃ divyaṃ nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca yoginā

verses.transliteration: ityuktvāntardadhe devo nāradas tatra liṅginam / sthāpayāmāsa rājendra sarvasattvopakārakam

verses.transliteration: yānti te paramaṃ lokaṃ piṇḍadānaprabhāvataḥ / kapilā caiva dātavyā tatra deśe narādhipa

verses.sanskrit: अस्य श्राद्धप्रभावेण ब्राह्मणानां नराधिप । नर्मदातोयपानस्य न्यायार्जितधनस्य च
verses.transliteration: asya śrāddhaprabhāveṇa brāhmaṇānāṃ narādhipa / narmadātoyapānasya nyāyārjitadhanasya ca

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां च प्रभावेण प्रेता यान्तु परां गतिम् । इत्युच्चार्य द्विजे देया दक्षिणा च स्वशक्तितः

verses.sanskrit: हविष्यान्नं विशालाक्ष द्विजानां चैव दापयेत् । विद्यादानेन चैकेन अक्षया गतिराप्यते

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस् तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र यो दद्याद् अग्रजन्मने । कांचनं स तिलं चैव स गच्छेच् च त्रिविष्टपम्

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र तीर्थद्वयम् अनुत्तमम् । दधिछन्दं मधुछन्दं सर्वपापक्षयं करम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthadvayam anuttamam / dadhichandaṃ madhuchandaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃ karam

verses.sanskrit: दधिच्छन्दे नरः स्नात्वा यो दद्याच् च द्विजे दधि । उपतिष्ठति तस्यैतत् सप्तजन्मसु भारत
verses.transliteration: dadhicchande naraḥ snātvā yo dadyāc ca dvije dadhi / upatiṣṭhati tasyaitat saptajanmasu bhārata

verses.transliteration: na vyādhir na jarā tasya na śoko na ca matsaraḥ / daśacandraśataṃ yāvaj jāyate vipule kule

verses.sanskrit: मधुना सह मिश्रं च तिलं यस् तु प्रयच्छति । तस्य पुत्रस्य पौत्रस्य दारिद्र्यं नैव जायते

verses.sanskrit: मधुना सह संमिश्रं तिलं यस् तु प्रयच्छति । मधुना सह संमिश्रं यस् तु पिण्डं प्रदापयेत्

verses.sanskrit: तपस् तप्तं जपंश् चैव तीर्थात् तीर्थं जगाम ह । दधिच्छन्दं मधुच्छन्दं यावत् त्यक्त्वा च गच्छति
verses.transliteration: tapas taptaṃ japaṃś caiva tīrthāt tīrthaṃ jagāma ha / dadhicchandaṃ madhucchandaṃ yāvat tyaktvā ca gacchati
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to an extremely splendid Tirtha on the northern bank of Narmada in the centre of Yajnavata (sacrificial hall), well-known on the earth as Sahkarsana. It is destructive of sins. Formerly, O king, a penance was performed by Balabhadra there.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: tatas tuṣṭo mahādevo nandinaṃ tamuvāca ha / maheśvara uvāca: bho bhoḥ prasanno nandīśa varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to an extremely splendid Tirtha on the northern bank of Narmada in the centre of Yajnavata (sacrificial hall), well-known on the earth as Sahkarsana. It is destructive of sins. Formerly, O king, a penance was performed by Balabhadra there.

verses.transliteration: tapasā tena tuṣṭo 'haṃ tīrthayātrākṛtena ca / nandy uvāca: na cāhaṃ kāmaye vittaṃ na cāhaṃ kulasantatim

verses.transliteration: muktiṃ na kāmaye cānyad deveśa caraṇāmbujam / kṛmikīṭapataṅgeṣu tiryagyonigateṣu ca

verses.transliteration: gṛhītvā taṃ kare śīghraṃ jagāma nilayaṃ haraḥ / tasmiṃs tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā bhaktyā tryakṣaṃ prapūjayet

verses.sanskrit: अग्निष्टोमे च यत्पुण्यं फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः । तत्र तीर्थे महापुण्ये प्राणत्यागं करोति यः
verses.transliteration: agniṣṭome ca yatpuṇyaṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ / tatra tīrthe mahāpuṇye prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्यानुचरो भूत्वा मोदते कल्पमक्षयम् । ततः कालेन महता जायते विपुले कुले
verses.transliteration: śivasyānucaro bhūtvā modate kalpamakṣayam / tataḥ kālena mahatā jāyate vipule kule

verses.transliteration: durlabhaṃ satyasaṃjñasya sarvapāpakṣayaṃ karam

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे नन्दितीर्थवर्णनो नामैकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय १०२ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत् तु राजेन्द्र वरुणेश्वरम् उत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धः पुरा देवो वरुणो नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe nanditīrthavarṇano nāmaikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 102 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra varuṇeśvaram uttamam / yatra siddhaḥ purā devo varuṇo nṛpasattama
verses.translation: Thereafter, a person should go to Manmathesa Tirtha bowed down to by all the Devas. Merely by taking holy bath, O king, the man will not see the world of Yama.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, a person should go to Manmathesa Tirtha bowed down to by all the Devas. Merely by taking holy bath, O king, the man will not see the world of Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, a person should go to Manmathesa Tirtha bowed down to by all the Devas. Merely by taking holy bath, O king, the man will not see the world of Yama.

verses.sanskrit: पिण्याकशाकपर्णैश् च कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणादिभिः । आराध्य गिरिजानाथं ततः सिद्धिं गता जनाः
verses.transliteration: piṇyākaśākaparṇaiś ca kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ / ārādhya girijānāthaṃ tataḥ siddhiṃ gatā janāḥ
verses.translation: The speciality here, O son of Bharata, is in the perfor¬ mance of Sraddha at dusk. By the gift of cooked food, O great king, an excellent benefit has been proclaimed.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः । पूजयेच् छङ्करं भक्त्या स गच्छेत् परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ / pūjayec chaṅkaraṃ bhaktyā sa gacchet paramaṃ padam

verses.transliteration: kuṇḍikāṃ vardhanīṃ vāpi mahadvā jalabhājanam / annena sahitaṃ pārtha tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे मृतानां च नराणां भावितात्मनाम् । वारुणे च पुरे वासो यावद् आहूत सम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe mṛtānāṃ ca narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām / vāruṇe ca pure vāso yāvad āhūta samplavam
verses.translation: The speciality here, O son of Bharata, is in the perfor¬ mance of Sraddha at dusk. By the gift of cooked food, O great king, an excellent benefit has been proclaimed.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The speciality here, O son of Bharata, is in the perfor¬ mance of Sraddha at dusk. By the gift of cooked food, O great king, an excellent benefit has been proclaimed.

verses.sanskrit: भुक्त्वा तत्र बहुं कालं मर्त्यलोके ऽभिजायते । अन्नदानप्रदो नित्यं जीवेच् च शरदां शतम्
verses.transliteration: bhuktvā tatra bahuṃ kālaṃ martyaloke 'bhijāyate / annadānaprado nityaṃ jīvec ca śaradāṃ śatam

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेच् च राजेन्द्र अग्नितीर्थम् अनुत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धो महातेजास् तपः कृत्वा हुताशनः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchec ca rājendra agnitīrtham anuttamam / yatra siddho mahātejās tapaḥ kṛtvā hutāśanaḥ

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभक्षीकृतो यश् च दण्डके मुनिना पुरा । नर्मदातटम् आश्रित्य पूतो जातो हुताशनः
verses.transliteration: sarvabhakṣīkṛto yaś ca daṇḍake muninā purā / narmadātaṭam āśritya pūto jāto hutāśanaḥ
verses.translation: The speciality here, O son of Bharata, is in the perfor¬ mance of Sraddha at dusk. By the gift of cooked food, O great king, an excellent benefit has been proclaimed.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा समभ्यर्च्य जगद्गुरुम् । उमया सहित भक्त्या सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā samabhyarcya jagadgurum / umayā sahita bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: The speciality here, O son of Bharata, is in the perfor¬ mance of Sraddha at dusk. By the gift of cooked food, O great king, an excellent benefit has been proclaimed.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा दत्ते वै कांचनं नृप । ब्राह्मणेभ्यो जलं दत्त्वा लभते वार्बुदं फलम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā datte vai kāṃcanaṃ nṛpa / brāhmaṇebhyo jalaṃ dattvā labhate vārbudaṃ phalam
verses.translation: The speciality here, O son of Bharata, is in the perfor¬ mance of Sraddha at dusk. By the gift of cooked food, O great king, an excellent benefit has been proclaimed.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: दधिच्छन्दे मधुच्छन्दे नन्दीशे वारुणे तथा । आग्नेये तत्फलं तात स्नात्वा मुच्येत किल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: dadhicchande madhucchande nandīśe vāruṇe tathā / āgneye tatphalaṃ tāta snātvā mucyeta kilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: The speciality here, O son of Bharata, is in the perfor¬ mance of Sraddha at dusk. By the gift of cooked food, O great king, an excellent benefit has been proclaimed.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: ते वन्द्या मानुषे लोके धन्याश् चाप्तमनोरथाः । यैर् हि दृष्टं महापुण्यं नर्मदातीर्थपञ्चकम्
verses.transliteration: te vandyā mānuṣe loke dhanyāś cāptamanorathāḥ / yair hi dṛṣṭaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ narmadātīrthapañcakam

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गलोकम् अवापुस्ते यावद् इन्द्राश् चतुर्दश । ततः स्वर्गाच् च्युताश् चापि राजानः सन्ति धार्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: svargalokam avāpuste yāvad indrāś caturdaśa / tataḥ svargāc cyutāś cāpi rājānaḥ santi dhārmikāḥ
verses.translation: The speciality here, O son of Bharata, is in the perfor¬ mance of Sraddha at dusk. By the gift of cooked food, O great king, an excellent benefit has been proclaimed.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्ता भुञ्जते ते ऽचलां महीम् । आखण्डलप्रतापो ऽयं नर्मदातटसेवने
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmuktā bhuñjate te 'calāṃ mahīm / ākhaṇḍalapratāpo 'yaṃ narmadātaṭasevane
verses.translation: The speciality here, O son of Bharata, is in the perfor¬ mance of Sraddha at dusk. By the gift of cooked food, O great king, an excellent benefit has been proclaimed.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाकनखले पुण्या कुरुक्षेत्रे सरस्वती । ग्रामे वा यदि वारण्ये पुण्या सर्वत्र नर्मदा
verses.transliteration: gaṅgākanakhale puṇyā kurukṣetre sarasvatī / grāme vā yadi vāraṇye puṇyā sarvatra narmadā
verses.translation: The speciality here, O son of Bharata, is in the perfor¬ mance of Sraddha at dusk. By the gift of cooked food, O great king, an excellent benefit has been proclaimed.

verses.sanskrit: रेवातीरं वसेन् नित्यं तोयं यस् तु सदा पिबेत् । स्नातो ऽसौ सर्वतीर्थेषु सोमपानं दिने दिने
verses.transliteration: revātīraṃ vasen nityaṃ toyaṃ yas tu sadā pibet / snāto 'sau sarvatīrtheṣu somapānaṃ dine dine

verses.commentary: Sense: The speciality here, O son of Bharata, is in the perfor¬ mance of Sraddha at dusk. By the gift of cooked food, O great king, an excellent benefit has been proclaimed.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाद्याः सरितः सर्वाः समुद्राश् च सरांसि च । कल्पान्ते संक्षयं यान्ति न मृतैका च नर्मदा
verses.transliteration: gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāś ca sarāṃsi ca / kalpānte saṃkṣayaṃ yānti na mṛtaikā ca narmadā

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे तीर्थपञ्चकवर्णनो नाम द्व्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय १०३ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: हनूमदीश्वरन् नाम कथं जातं महामते । ब्रह्महत्याहरं तीर्थं रेवायादक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe tīrthapañcakavarṇano nāma dvyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 103 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: hanūmadīśvaran nāma kathaṃ jātaṃ mahāmate / brahmahatyāharaṃ tīrthaṃ revāyādakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, a person should go to the exalted confluence of Erandl. The account of this was heard formerly by me, O king, even as Siva was recounting it.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O king, a person should go to the exalted confluence of Erandl. The account of this was heard formerly by me, O king, even as Siva was recounting it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, a person should go to the exalted confluence of Erandl. The account of this was heard formerly by me, O king, even as Siva was recounting it.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: साधु पृष्टं महाबाहो सोमवंशविभूषण । गुह्याद् गुह्यतरं तीर्थं नाख्यातं कस्यचिन् मया
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahābāho somavaṃśavibhūṣaṇa / guhyād guhyataraṃ tīrthaṃ nākhyātaṃ kasyacin mayā
verses.translation: O my beloved, (you are) a splendid, gentle lady of great beauty in all the limbs, richly endowed with learning and humility, having the eyes resembling petals of a lotus, with a face resembling the full moon, walking slowly with the weight of the huge hips! There is no other woman like you in all the three worlds consisting of mobile and immobile creatures. It is cited by expounders of the Vedas that a woman is one
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O my beloved, (you are) a splendid, gentle lady of great beauty in all the limbs, richly endowed with learning and humility, having the eyes resembling petals of a lotus, with a face resembling the full moon,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O my beloved, (you are) a splendid, gentle lady of great beauty in all the limbs, richly endowed with learning and humility, having the eyes resembling petals of a lotus, with a face resembling the full moon,…

verses.sanskrit: तव स्नेहात् प्रवक्ष्यामि पीडितो वार्धकेन तु । जातं पूर्वं महायुद्धं रामरावणयोर् अपि
verses.transliteration: tava snehāt pravakṣyāmi pīḍito vārdhakena tu / jātaṃ pūrvaṃ mahāyuddhaṃ rāmarāvaṇayor api
verses.translation: O Brahmana, what you bewail I too grieve over; what gives you great anguish burns me. within my mind.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmana, what you bewail I too grieve over; what gives you great anguish burns me. within my mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmana, what you bewail I too grieve over; what gives you great anguish burns me. within my mind.

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्यो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रस् तस्य वै विश्रवाः सुतः । रावणस् तस्य संजातो दशग्रीवो ऽपि राक्षसः
verses.transliteration: pulastyo brahmaṇaḥ putras tasya vai viśravāḥ sutaḥ / rāvaṇas tasya saṃjāto daśagrīvo 'pi rākṣasaḥ
verses.translation: A chaste lady enhances the sexual pleasure of her husband and makes the family flourish. She is the means of realizing the threefold aim of human life. Hence she deserves the praise of learned persons.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: A chaste lady enhances the sexual pleasure of her husband and makes the family flourish. She is the means of realizing the threefold aim of human life. Hence she deserves the praise of learned persons.
verses.commentary: Sense: A chaste lady enhances the sexual pleasure of her husband and makes the family flourish. She is the means of realizing the threefold aim of human life. Hence she deserves the praise of learned persons.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यविजयी जातः प्रसादाच् छूलिनस् तथा । गीर्वाणा निर्जिताः सर्वे रामस्य गृहिणी हृता
verses.transliteration: trailokyavijayī jātaḥ prasādāc chūlinas tathā / gīrvāṇā nirjitāḥ sarve rāmasya gṛhiṇī hṛtā
verses.translation: O lady of excellent Vratas, we are satisfied with your wonderful penance and the truthfulness of the penance. Further, through seeing you all our desires are fulfilled.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O lady of excellent Vratas, we are satisfied with your wonderful penance and the truthfulness of the penance. Further, through seeing you all our desires are fulfilled.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lady of excellent Vratas, we are satisfied with your wonderful penance and the truthfulness of the penance. Further, through seeing you all our desires are fulfilled.

verses.sanskrit: यद् भ्राता कुम्भकर्णो वै सीता सा वनमाश्रिता । विभीषणेन पापो ऽयं मन्दस् त्यक्तो विचार्य च
verses.transliteration: yad bhrātā kumbhakarṇo vai sītā sā vanamāśritā / vibhīṣaṇena pāpo 'yaṃ mandas tyakto vicārya ca
verses.translation: O great goddess, there was Janardana having four arms holding conch, discus and club, clad in yellow robes and having the complexion of an AtasI flower. Hari who had the vehicle of Garuda was accompanied by Sri. The glorious Lord was standing in his own form with a beaming face.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: स जितः कार्तवीर्येण स जितो जामदग्निना । स हतो रामचन्द्रेण तस्य राज्यं हृतं तथा
verses.transliteration: sa jitaḥ kārtavīryeṇa sa jito jāmadagninā / sa hato rāmacandreṇa tasya rājyaṃ hṛtaṃ tathā
verses.translation: I have been declared the Summer season, the cause of the destruction of all living beings. O saintly lady, in the form of Rudra, I pull and drag the entire universe (within me).
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: I have been declared the Summer season, the cause of the destruction of all living beings. O saintly lady, in the form of Rudra, I pull and drag the entire universe (within me).

verses.sanskrit: ततो रामेण रक्षो ऽपि जितः संख्ये महाबलः । वनं भग्नं हतो रक्षो गत्वा वायुसुतेन वै
verses.transliteration: tato rāmeṇa rakṣo 'pi jitaḥ saṃkhye mahābalaḥ / vanaṃ bhagnaṃ hato rakṣo gatvā vāyusutena vai
verses.translation: The men who die at the splendid confluence of Erandl, O goddess, reside in the Rudraloka for a thousand Yugas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The men who die at the splendid confluence of Erandl, O goddess, reside in the Rudraloka for a thousand Yugas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The men who die at the splendid confluence of Erandl, O goddess, reside in the Rudraloka for a thousand Yugas.

verses.sanskrit: रावणस्य सुतः संख्ये हतश् चाक्षकुमारकः । एवं रामायणे जाते सीता मोक्षे कृते ततः
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇasya sutaḥ saṃkhye hataś cākṣakumārakaḥ / evaṃ rāmāyaṇe jāte sītā mokṣe kṛte tataḥ
verses.translation: Formerly in the course of a dialogue with Bhrgu (I incurred the curse of) staying in the womb (and taking birth as a mortal). O splendid lady, I do not see a means of redemp¬ tion from it. But remembering the earlier episode I think about it again and again.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: अयोध्यायां गते रामे हनूमाश् च महाबलः । कैलासं हि गतः पार्थ प्रणामार्थं महेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: ayodhyāyāṃ gate rāme hanūmāś ca mahābalaḥ / kailāsaṃ hi gataḥ pārtha praṇāmārthaṃ maheśvare
verses.translation: With your favour, O celestial sage, I have obtained a rare boon. Hence the Devas, Siddhas and pure sages praise (us).
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: With your favour, O celestial sage, I have obtained a rare boon. Hence the Devas, Siddhas and pure sages praise (us).
verses.commentary: Sense: With your favour, O celestial sage, I have obtained a rare boon. Hence the Devas, Siddhas and pure sages praise (us).

verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चोक्तो वै नन्दिना वानरोत्तमः । ब्रह्महत्यायुतस् त्वं हि राक्षसानां वधेन हि
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cokto vai nandinā vānarottamaḥ / brahmahatyāyutas tvaṃ hi rākṣasānāṃ vadhena hi

verses.sanskrit: भैरवस्यासनं पुण्यं न गन्ता ऽसि महाबल । हनुमान् उवाच: नन्दिंस् त्वं हि वरं यच्छ पातकस्योपशान्तये
verses.transliteration: bhairavasyāsanaṃ puṇyaṃ na gantā 'si mahābala / hanumān uvāca: nandiṃs tvaṃ hi varaṃ yaccha pātakasyopaśāntaye
verses.translation: O son of KuntI, a Tlrtha was created by Anasuya on the northern bank of Reva. It causes the acquisition (birth) of a son and destruction of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O son of KuntI, a Tlrtha was created by Anasuya on the northern bank of Reva. It causes the acquisition (birth) of a son and destruction of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: भूत्वा निष्पातको ऽहं वै प्रणमामि महेश्वरम् । नन्द्य् उवाच: रुद्रदेहोद्भवा पुण्या नर्मदा सरितां वरा
verses.transliteration: bhūtvā niṣpātako 'haṃ vai praṇamāmi maheśvaram / nandy uvāca: rudradehodbhavā puṇyā narmadā saritāṃ varā
verses.translation: On hearing the sound of lamentation, Govinda became frightened. He fell down on the ground crying "What is this?"
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the sound of lamentation, Govinda became frightened. He fell down on the ground crying "What is this?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the sound of lamentation, Govinda became frightened. He fell down on the ground crying "What is this?"

verses.sanskrit: श्रवणाज् जन्मचरितं कीर्तनाद् द्विगुणं व्रजेत् । सप्तजन्मार्जितं पापं नश्येद् रेवावगाहनात्
verses.transliteration: śravaṇāj janmacaritaṃ kīrtanād dviguṇaṃ vrajet / saptajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ naśyed revāvagāhanāt
verses.translation: Men without merit do not see a son resembling the Holder of Ganga (Siva) with the quarters for clothes (naked), bereft of shame, dusty and matted locks of hair (wafted about).
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Men without merit do not see a son resembling the Holder of Ganga (Siva) with the quarters for clothes (naked), bereft of shame, dusty and matted locks of hair (wafted about).

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् तीरे वस त्वं च रेवासङ्गमदक्षिणे । ध्यायमानो विरूपाक्षं त्रिशूलकरसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt tīre vasa tvaṃ ca revāsaṅgamadakṣiṇe / dhyāyamāno virūpākṣaṃ triśūlakarasaṃsthitam
verses.translation: Thus, without a son there is no happiness in the mortal world. He who indulges in sexual intercourse for perpetuating the line, who makes use of learning to attain Svarga, who prepares excellent sweet food for the sake of Brahmanas attains residence in heaven. There is no greater sin than Brahmahatya and no greater meritorious thing than a horse- sacrifice. There is no greater happiness than birth of a son and no greater calamity than danger to his life. Why should I speak in this vein more, O dear one? Without a son there is no happiness."
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, without a son there is no happiness in the mortal world. He who indulges in sexual intercourse for perpetuating the line, who makes use of learning to attain Svarga, who prepares excellent sweet food for the sake of Brahmanas attains residence in heaven.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, without a son there is no happiness in the mortal world. He who indulges in sexual intercourse for perpetuating the line, who makes use of learning to attain Svarga, who prepares excellent sweet food for the sake of Brahmanas attains residence in heaven.…

verses.sanskrit: जटामुकुटसंकाशं व्यालयज्ञोपवीतकम् । उमार्धाङ्गधरं देवं गोराजासनसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: jaṭāmukuṭasaṃkāśaṃ vyālayajñopavītakam / umārdhāṅgadharaṃ devaṃ gorājāsanasaṃsthitam
verses.translation: Then the Brahmana hastened towards the buffa¬ loes. He did not see the buffaloes there. Then he rushed towards the field. On his way he came to the confluence of Erandi and Reva and entered the waters.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: वत्सरान् सुबहून् यावद् ध्यायतस् तस्य तत्र वै । तत्र तुष्टो महादेव आगतः सह भार्यया
verses.transliteration: vatsarān subahūn yāvad dhyāyatas tasya tatra vai / tatra tuṣṭo mahādeva āgataḥ saha bhāryayā
verses.translation: Thinking about this like this I spent the night in great terror. What can I say and to whom about you infested with a crowd of worms? Again you were seen today infested with the worms of foeticide (infanticide). In some places they bite into the body and in some places they have disappeared altogether.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: उवाच मधुरां वाणीं मेघगम्भीरया गिरा । साधु वत्स त्वया चात्र कष्टं तपसि संस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ meghagambhīrayā girā / sādhu vatsa tvayā cātra kaṣṭaṃ tapasi saṃsthitam
verses.translation: After taking the holy bath in the charming water and bowing to Lord Bhaskara, he bathed Sankara, the Lord of Devas, along with Uma with Pancagavya1, ghee, milk, curds, honey, ghee (sic) and water. Then he worshipped the Lihga identical with the Vedas and the auspicious goddess KatyayanT with fragrant flower garlands, incense and splendid Naivedyas. After keeping awake in the whole of the night along with her husband, the chaste lady honoured the Brahmanas assiduously when the day dawned clearly. Govinda honoured the excellent Brahmanas in accordance with his capacity by means of the gifts of cows, gold, cloth and food, O descendant of Bharata. Accompanied by his wife, he came home rid of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: हनूमांश् च हरं दृष्ट्वा उमार्धाङ्गधरं स्थितम् । साष्टाङ्गं प्रणतो भूत्वा जयदेव नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: hanūmāṃś ca haraṃ dṛṣṭvā umārdhāṅgadharaṃ sthitam / sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇato bhūtvā jayadeva namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Five cow Products, viz. milk, curds, butter and liquid and solid excreta.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Five cow Products, viz. milk, curds, butter and liquid and solid excreta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Five cow Products, viz. milk, curds, butter and liquid and solid excreta.

verses.sanskrit: जय चान्धकघाताय बाणासुरविमर्दिने । जय भूतपनाथाय जय भैरवभूषण
verses.transliteration: jaya cāndhakaghātāya bāṇāsuravimardine / jaya bhūtapanāthāya jaya bhairavabhūṣaṇa
verses.translation: After the day has dawned clearly on the eighth day, O king, the devotee should honour Brahmanas devoid of all faults or disqualifications. They should have all the limbs and organs complete. They should be adepts in all scriptures. They should be regularly practising study of the Vedas and th«y should be devoted to their own wives. The Brahmanas should be deserving ones for Sraddha, Dana and Vrata, O son of
