verses.sanskrit: आदौ पितामहस् तात समस् तस्य जनस्य च । मनसा तस्य संजाता ऋषयो दश पुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: ādau pitāmahas tāta samas tasya janasya ca / manasā tasya saṃjātā ṛṣayo daśa puṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Koti Tirtha 580
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Koti Tirtha 580
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Koti Tirtha 580

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिरत्र्यङ्गिरसौ पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः । प्रचेताश् च वशिष्ठश् च भृगुर् नारद एव च
verses.transliteration: marīciratryaṅgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ / pracetāś ca vaśiṣṭhaś ca bhṛgur nārada eva ca
verses.translation: The Greatness of Paitamaha rirtha 580
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Paitamaha rirtha 580
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Paitamaha rirtha 580

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञे प्रचेतसो दक्षो महातेजाः प्रजापतिः । दक्षस्यापि सुता जाताः पञ्चाशत् कन्यकाः किल
verses.transliteration: jajñe pracetaso dakṣo mahātejāḥ prajāpatiḥ / dakṣasyāpi sutā jātāḥ pañcāśat kanyakāḥ kila
verses.translation: The Greatness of Kurkuri Tirtha 582
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Kurkuri Tirtha 582
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Kurkuri Tirtha 582

verses.sanskrit: ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश । तथैव च महाभाग सप्तविंशतिम् इन्दवे
verses.transliteration: dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa / tathaiva ca mahābhāga saptaviṃśatim indave
verses.translation: The Greatness of Dasakanya Tirtha 583
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Dasakanya Tirtha 583
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Dasakanya Tirtha 583

verses.sanskrit: तासां हि रोहिणी चन्द्रस्याभीष्टा साभवत् तदा । तस्याश् च कारणं कृत्वा शप्तो दक्षेण चन्द्रमाः
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ hi rohiṇī candrasyābhīṣṭā sābhavat tadā / tasyāś ca kāraṇaṃ kṛtvā śapto dakṣeṇa candramāḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Suvarnabindu Tirtha 584
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Suvarnabindu Tirtha 584
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Suvarnabindu Tirtha 584

verses.sanskrit: क्षयरोग्यभवच् चन्द्रो विवक्षायाः प्रजापतेः । दक्षशापप्रभावेण निस्तेजाः शर्वरीपतिः
verses.transliteration: kṣayarogyabhavac candro vivakṣāyāḥ prajāpateḥ / dakṣaśāpaprabhāveṇa nistejāḥ śarvarīpatiḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: गतः पितामहं सोमो वेपमानः प्रणम्य च । ब्रह्मयोने नमस् तुभ्यं वेदगर्भ नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: gataḥ pitāmahaṃ somo vepamānaḥ praṇamya ca / brahmayone namas tubhyaṃ vedagarbha namo 'stu te
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच: सर्वत्र दुर्लभा रेवा त्रिषु स्थानेषु भारत । ॐकारे च भृगुक्षेत्रे नर्मदा ह्य् उरगेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca: sarvatra durlabhā revā triṣu sthāneṣu bhārata / oṃkāre ca bhṛgukṣetre narmadā hy urageśvare
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: काष्ठवत् संस्थितः सोमो ध्यायते परमेश्वरम् । यावद् वर्षशतं पूर्णं तावत् तुष्टो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kāṣṭhavat saṃsthitaḥ somo dhyāyate parameśvaram / yāvad varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tāvat tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: प्रेत्यक्षः सोमनाथस्य वृषासन उमार्धगः । साष्टाङ्गं प्रणतो भूत्वा जय देव नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: pretyakṣaḥ somanāthasya vṛṣāsana umārdhagaḥ / sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇato bhūtvā jaya deva namo 'stu te
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: जय शङ्कर पापकृतान्त नमो जय ईश्वर नाथ नमो ऽस्तु नमः । जय वासुकिभूषण भूतपते जय शूलकपालधराय नमः
verses.transliteration: jaya śaṅkara pāpakṛtānta namo jaya īśvara nātha namo 'stu namaḥ / jaya vāsukibhūṣaṇa bhūtapate jaya śūlakapāladharāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: जय अन्धकदेहविनाश नमो जय दानवदेहवधाय नमः । जय निष्कलसकलकलाय नमो जय कालकलादमनाय नमः
verses.transliteration: jaya andhakadehavināśa namo jaya dānavadehavadhāya namaḥ / jaya niṣkalasakalakalāya namo jaya kālakalādamanāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: जय नीलकण्ठ उमापते जय सूक्ष्मनिरञ्जनशब्द नमः । जय आद्य अनाद्य अनन्त नमो जय पाणिपिनाकत्रिशूल नमः
verses.transliteration: jaya nīlakaṇṭha umāpate jaya sūkṣmanirañjanaśabda namaḥ / jaya ādya anādya ananta namo jaya pāṇipinākatriśūla namaḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुतो महादेवः सोमनाथेन पाण्डव । तुष्टस् तस्य नृपश्रेष्ठ उमया सह शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ stuto mahādevaḥ somanāthena pāṇḍava / tuṣṭas tasya nṛpaśreṣṭha umayā saha śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: वरं वरय भद्रं ते यत् ते मनसि वर्तते । सोम उवाच: दक्षशापेन दग्धो ऽहं क्षीणदेहो महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yat te manasi vartate / soma uvāca: dakṣaśāpena dagdho 'haṃ kṣīṇadeho maheśvara
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: पापप्रशमनं देव कुरु सर्वं ममैव तु । महेश्वर उवाच: भवद्भक्तिगृहीतो ऽहं तूष्टश् चैवोमया सह
verses.transliteration: pāpapraśamanaṃ deva kuru sarvaṃ mamaiva tu / maheśvara uvāca: bhavadbhaktigṛhīto 'haṃ tūṣṭaś caivomayā saha
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: निष्पापः सोमनाथस्य संजातस् तीर्थसेवनात् । इत्य् उक्त्वान्तर्दधे देवः सोमो ध्यात्वा क्षणं नृप
verses.transliteration: niṣpāpaḥ somanāthasya saṃjātas tīrthasevanāt / ity uktvāntardadhe devaḥ somo dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयामास लिङ्गं तु सिद्धिदं प्राणिनां भुवि । सर्वदुःखहरं देवं ब्रह्महत्याविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: sthāpayāmāsa liṅgaṃ tu siddhidaṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi / sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ devaṃ brahmahatyāvināśanam
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: सोमनाथप्रभावं च संक्षेपात् कथयामि ते । शम्बरो नाम राजाभूत् तस्य पुत्रस् त्रिलोचनः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: somanāthaprabhāvaṃ ca saṃkṣepāt kathayāmi te / śambaro nāma rājābhūt tasya putras trilocanaḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: त्रिलोचनसुतः कण्ठः पापनिष्ठो महाधमः । वने विभ्रमतस् तस्य मृगयूथं त्व् अदृश्यत
verses.transliteration: trilocanasutaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ pāpaniṣṭho mahādhamaḥ / vane vibhramatas tasya mṛgayūthaṃ tv adṛśyata
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: मृगयूथं हतं सर्वं त्रिलोचनसुतेन च । मृगरूपी द्विजो मध्ये विचरन् निर्जने वने
verses.transliteration: mṛgayūthaṃ hataṃ sarvaṃ trilocanasutena ca / mṛgarūpī dvijo madhye vicaran nirjane vane
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: तदा हतस् तु शस्त्रेण कण्ठेन ऋषिसत्तमः । ब्रह्महत्यायुतः कण्ठो निस्तेजा व्यचरन् महीम्
verses.transliteration: tadā hatas tu śastreṇa kaṇṭhena ṛṣisattamaḥ / brahmahatyāyutaḥ kaṇṭho nistejā vyacaran mahīm
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: विचरन्न् अपि संप्राप्तो नर्मदानागसंगमे । कदम्बपाटलाकीर्णे बिल्वनारङ्गशोभिते
verses.transliteration: vicarann api saṃprāpto narmadānāgasaṃgame / kadambapāṭalākīrṇe bilvanāraṅgaśobhite
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: चिञ्चिनी चम्पकोपेते अगस्तितरुशोभिते । उन्मत्तभृङ्गसंयुक्ते तथा सर्वत्र शोभिते
verses.transliteration: ciñcinī campakopete agastitaruśobhite / unmattabhṛṅgasaṃyukte tathā sarvatra śobhite
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: चित्रकैर् मृगमार्जारैः सिंहैः सर्वत्र शूकरैः । शशकैर् गवयैर् युक्ते शिखण्डिरवनादिते
verses.transliteration: citrakair mṛgamārjāraiḥ siṃhaiḥ sarvatra śūkaraiḥ / śaśakair gavayair yukte śikhaṇḍiravanādite
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टस् तद्वने कण्ठस् तृषार्तः श्रमकर्षितः । स्नातो रेवाजले पुण्ये सङ्गमे पापनाशने
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭas tadvane kaṇṭhas tṛṣārtaḥ śramakarṣitaḥ / snāto revājale puṇye saṅgame pāpanāśane
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: पत्राणि च विचित्राणि भक्षयन् सह किङ्करैः । सुप्तः पादपछायायां श्रान्तो मृगवधेन च
verses.transliteration: patrāṇi ca vicitrāṇi bhakṣayan saha kiṅkaraiḥ / suptaḥ pādapachāyāyāṃ śrānto mṛgavadhena ca
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: आनर्च परया भक्त्या सोमनाथं युधिष्ठिर । पीत्वा तोयं कण्ठमात्रं सर्वपापक्षयंकरम्
verses.transliteration: ānarca parayā bhaktyā somanāthaṃ yudhiṣṭhira / pītvā toyaṃ kaṇṭhamātraṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: तावत् तीर्थवरे विप्रः स्नानार्थं संगमं प्रति । मार्गगो ब्राह्मणो भूयस् ततस् तद् गतमानसः
verses.transliteration: tāvat tīrthavare vipraḥ snānārthaṃ saṃgamaṃ prati / mārgago brāhmaṇo bhūyas tatas tad gatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: मार्गे वृक्षे समारूढा स्त्री चैका च भयङ्करी । उवाच ब्राह्मणं सा हि तिष्ठ तिष्ठ द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: mārge vṛkṣe samārūḍhā strī caikā ca bhayaṅkarī / uvāca brāhmaṇaṃ sā hi tiṣṭha tiṣṭha dvijottama
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: त्रस्तो निरीक्षते यावद् दिशः सर्वा नरेश्वर । तावद् वृक्ष समारूढां स्त्रियं रक्ताम्बरावृताम्
verses.transliteration: trasto nirīkṣate yāvad diśaḥ sarvā nareśvara / tāvad vṛkṣa samārūḍhāṃ striyaṃ raktāmbarāvṛtām
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: रक्तपुष्पधरां वालां रक्तचन्दनचर्चिताम् । रक्ताभरणशोभाढ्यां पाशहस्तां ददर्श ह
verses.transliteration: raktapuṣpadharāṃ vālāṃ raktacandanacarcitām / raktābharaṇaśobhāḍhyāṃ pāśahastāṃ dadarśa ha
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: स्त्र्य् उवाच: सन्देशं शृणु मे विप्र यदि गच्छसि संगमम् । मद्भर्ता तिष्ठते तत्र शीघ्रम् एव विसर्जय
verses.transliteration: stry uvāca: sandeśaṃ śṛṇu me vipra yadi gacchasi saṃgamam / madbhartā tiṣṭhate tatra śīghram eva visarjaya
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: एकाकिनी च ते भार्या तिष्ठते वनमध्यगा । इत्याकर्ण्य गतो विप्रः सङ्गमं सुरदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: ekākinī ca te bhāryā tiṣṭhate vanamadhyagā / ityākarṇya gato vipraḥ saṅgamaṃ suradurlabham
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षछायास्थितं कण्ठं ब्राह्मणो हि ददर्श ह । ब्राह्मण उवाच: वनान्ते च मया दृष्टा बाला कमललोचना
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣachāyāsthitaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ brāhmaṇo hi dadarśa ha / brāhmaṇa uvāca: vanānte ca mayā dṛṣṭā bālā kamalalocanā
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: रक्ताम्बरधरा तन्वी रक्तचन्दनर्चर्चिता । रक्तमाल्या सुशोभाढ्या पाशहस्ता मृगेक्षणा
verses.transliteration: raktāmbaradharā tanvī raktacandanarcarcitā / raktamālyā suśobhāḍhyā pāśahastā mṛgekṣaṇā
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षारूढावदद् वाक्यं भर्तारं प्रेषयस्व माम् । कण्ठ उवाच: कस्मिन् स्थाने तु विप्रेन्द्र तिष्ठते मृगलोचना
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣārūḍhāvadad vākyaṃ bhartāraṃ preṣayasva mām / kaṇṭha uvāca: kasmin sthāne tu viprendra tiṣṭhate mṛgalocanā
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: कस्य सा केन कार्येण एतत् सर्वं वद हि मे । ब्राह्मण उवाच: संगमाद् अर्धक्रोशे च उद्यानान्ते प्रशोभिते
verses.transliteration: kasya sā kena kāryeṇa etat sarvaṃ vada hi me / brāhmaṇa uvāca: saṃgamād ardhakrośe ca udyānānte praśobhite
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तिष्ठति सा नारी सोत्कण्ठितमना विभो । ततो भृत्यम् उवाचेदं कण्ठो राजा युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: tatra tiṣṭhati sā nārī sotkaṇṭhitamanā vibho / tato bhṛtyam uvācedaṃ kaṇṭho rājā yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: पृच्छ त्वं गच्छ का चासि आगता क्व गमिष्यसि । ततः क्षिप्रं गतस् तत्र यत्र नारी स्थिताभवत्
verses.transliteration: pṛccha tvaṃ gaccha kā cāsi āgatā kva gamiṣyasi / tataḥ kṣipraṃ gatas tatra yatra nārī sthitābhavat
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षस्थां ददृशे बालाम् उवाच नृपसत्तम । त्वां राजा पृच्छते बाले कासि त्वं क्व गमिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣasthāṃ dadṛśe bālām uvāca nṛpasattama / tvāṃ rājā pṛcchate bāle kāsi tvaṃ kva gamiṣyasi
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: स्त्र्य् उवाच: गुरुर् आत्मवतां शास्ता राजा शास्ता दुरात्मनाम् । इह प्रच्छन्नपापानां शास्ता वैवस्वतो यमः
verses.transliteration: stry uvāca: gurur ātmavatāṃ śāstā rājā śāstā durātmanām / iha pracchannapāpānāṃ śāstā vaivasvato yamaḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्यास्य संजाता मृगरूपद्विजोद्वधात् । मया युक्तो ऽपि राजासौ मुक्तस् तीर्थप्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyāsya saṃjātā mṛgarūpadvijodvadhāt / mayā yukto 'pi rājāsau muktas tīrthaprabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: अत्रार्धक्रोशमात्रं वै ब्रह्महत्या न संविशेत् । सोमनाथप्रभावाच् च तीर्थं वाराणसीसमम्
verses.transliteration: atrārdhakrośamātraṃ vai brahmahatyā na saṃviśet / somanāthaprabhāvāc ca tīrthaṃ vārāṇasīsamam
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ त्वं प्रेषयेः कण्ठं शीघ्रम् एव न संशयः । समस्तं कथयामास तद् वृत्तान्तं नृपं प्रति
verses.transliteration: gaccha tvaṃ preṣayeḥ kaṇṭhaṃ śīghram eva na saṃśayaḥ / samastaṃ kathayāmāsa tad vṛttāntaṃ nṛpaṃ prati
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वाक्येन राजासौ पपात धरणीतले । भृत्य उवाच: कस्मात् त्वं शोचसे नाथ पूर्वजातं शूभाशुभम्
verses.transliteration: tasya vākyena rājāsau papāta dharaṇītale / bhṛtya uvāca: kasmāt tvaṃ śocase nātha pūrvajātaṃ śūbhāśubham
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: इत्याकर्ण्य वचस् तस्य स राजा त्विदम् अब्रवीत् । प्राणत्यागं करोम्य् अत्र सोमनाथ समीपतः
verses.transliteration: ityākarṇya vacas tasya sa rājā tvidam abravīt / prāṇatyāgaṃ karomy atra somanātha samīpataḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: शीघ्रम् आनीयतां वह्णिर् इन्धनानि बहून्य् अपि । आनीतं तत्क्षणात् सर्वं भृत्यैः स्वैर् वशवर्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: śīghram ānīyatāṃ vahṇir indhanāni bahūny api / ānītaṃ tatkṣaṇāt sarvaṃ bhṛtyaiḥ svair vaśavartibhiḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं कृत्वा शुभे तोये संगमे पापनाशने । अर्चित्वा परया भक्त्या सोमनाथं नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ kṛtvā śubhe toye saṃgame pāpanāśane / arcitvā parayā bhaktyā somanāthaṃ nareśvara
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: त्रिःप्रदक्षिणकं कृत्वा ज्वलिते जातवेदसि । प्रविष्टः कण्ठराजस् तु हृदि कृत्वा जनार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: triḥpradakṣiṇakaṃ kṛtvā jvalite jātavedasi / praviṣṭaḥ kaṇṭharājas tu hṛdi kṛtvā janārdanam
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: पीताम्बरधरं देवं महामुकुटधारिणम् । विष्णोर् ध्यानेन चात्रैव सुगतिर् मे भवत्व् इति
verses.transliteration: pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ mahāmukuṭadhāriṇam / viṣṇor dhyānena cātraiva sugatir me bhavatv iti
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: पपात पुष्पवृष्टिश् च साधु साधु नृपात्मज । आश्चर्यमतुलं दृष्ट्वा निरीक्ष च परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: papāta puṣpavṛṣṭiś ca sādhu sādhu nṛpātmaja / āścaryamatulaṃ dṛṣṭvā nirīkṣa ca parasparam
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: हुतं तैः पावके भृत्यैर् हृदि ध्यात्वा गदाधरम् । विमानस्था दिवं सर्वे सङ्गताः पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: hutaṃ taiḥ pāvake bhṛtyair hṛdi dhyātvā gadādharam / vimānasthā divaṃ sarve saṅgatāḥ pāṇḍunandana
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: सोमनाथप्रभावो ऽयं शृणुष्वैकमना नृप । अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां सर्वकाले शुभे दिने
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: somanāthaprabhāvo 'yaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa / aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ sarvakāle śubhe dine
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: विशेषाच् छुक्लपक्षे च सूर्यवारेण सप्तमी । उपोष्य यो नरो भक्त्या रात्रौ कुर्वीत जागरम्
verses.transliteration: viśeṣāc chuklapakṣe ca sūryavāreṇa saptamī / upoṣya yo naro bhaktyā rātrau kurvīta jāgaram
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चामृतेन गव्येन स्नापयेत् परमेश्वरम् । श्रीखण्डलेपनं कुर्यात् पुष्पधूपादिकं तथा
verses.transliteration: pañcāmṛtena gavyena snāpayet parameśvaram / śrīkhaṇḍalepanaṃ kuryāt puṣpadhūpādikaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: घृतेन बोधयेद् दीपं गीतं नृत्यं च कारयेत् । सोमवारेण चाष्टम्यां प्रभाते पूजयेद् द्विजम्
verses.transliteration: ghṛtena bodhayed dīpaṃ gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca kārayet / somavāreṇa cāṣṭamyāṃ prabhāte pūjayed dvijam
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: आत्मवन्तं जितक्रोधं द्विजनिन्दाविवर्जितम् । सर्वाङ्गरुचिरं शान्तं स्वदारपरिपालकम्
verses.transliteration: ātmavantaṃ jitakrodhaṃ dvijanindāvivarjitam / sarvāṅgaruciraṃ śāntaṃ svadāraparipālakam
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रीं पठमानं च विकर्मरहितं सदा । पुनर् भूर्वृषली शूद्री वर्तते यस्य मन्दिरे
verses.transliteration: gāyatrīṃ paṭhamānaṃ ca vikarmarahitaṃ sadā / punar bhūrvṛṣalī śūdrī vartate yasya mandire
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: हीनाङ्गास् त्व् अतिरिक्ताङ्गा येषां पूर्वापरे न हि । व्रते श्राद्धे तथा दाने द्विजा वर्ज्याः सदा बुधैः
verses.transliteration: hīnāṅgās tv atiriktāṅgā yeṣāṃ pūrvāpare na hi / vrate śrāddhe tathā dāne dvijā varjyāḥ sadā budhaiḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: पुंश्चली तरुणी भार्या द्विजः स्वाध्यायवर्जितः । आत्मना सह दातारमधो नयति पाण्डव
verses.transliteration: puṃścalī taruṇī bhāryā dvijaḥ svādhyāyavarjitaḥ / ātmanā saha dātāramadho nayati pāṇḍava
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: शाल्मली नौकया तुल्याः स्वधर्मनिरता द्विजाः । दातारं चैवम् आत्मानं तारयन्ति तरन्ति च
verses.transliteration: śālmalī naukayā tulyāḥ svadharmaniratā dvijāḥ / dātāraṃ caivam ātmānaṃ tārayanti taranti ca
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धं सोमेश्वरे पार्थ यः कुर्यादुत मानवः । पितरस् तस्य तृप्यन्ति यावद् आभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: śrāddhaṃ someśvare pārtha yaḥ kuryāduta mānavaḥ / pitaras tasya tṛpyanti yāvad ābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: अन्नं वस्त्रं हिरण्यं च यो दद्याद् अग्रजन्मने । स याति शाङ्करं लोकम् इति मे सत्यभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: annaṃ vastraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca yo dadyād agrajanmane / sa yāti śāṅkaraṃ lokam iti me satyabhāṣitam
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: हयं यो वै ददात् यत्र सम्पूर्णाभरणान्वितम् । रक्तं वा पीतवर्णं वा सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम्
verses.transliteration: hayaṃ yo vai dadāt yatra sampūrṇābharaṇānvitam / raktaṃ vā pītavarṇaṃ vā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: कुङ्कुमेन विलिप्ताङ्गम् अप्रजं च ददेद् इति । स्रग्दामभूषितं कण्ठे सितवस्त्रावगुण्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: kuṅkumena viliptāṅgam aprajaṃ ca daded iti / sragdāmabhūṣitaṃ kaṇṭhe sitavastrāvaguṇṭhitam
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: अङ्घ्रिराधीयतां स्कन्धे मदीयं हयम् आरुह । आरूढे ब्राह्मणे भूयो भास्करः प्रीयताम् इति
verses.transliteration: aṅghrirādhīyatāṃ skandhe madīyaṃ hayam āruha / ārūḍhe brāhmaṇe bhūyo bhāskaraḥ prīyatām iti
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: स याति शाङ्करं लोकं सर्वपापविवर्जितः । तस्माल् लोकाच् च्युतश् चापि राजा भवति धार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: sa yāti śāṅkaraṃ lokaṃ sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ / tasmāl lokāc cyutaś cāpi rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वंशे सदा राज्यं न नश्यति कदाचन । दीर्घायुर् जायते पुत्रो भार्या च वशवर्तिनी
verses.transliteration: tasya vaṃśe sadā rājyaṃ na naśyati kadācana / dīrghāyur jāyate putro bhāryā ca vaśavartinī
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: जीवेद् वर्षशतं साग्रं सर्वदुःखविवर्जितः । सोमस्य चोपरागे तु यो गच्छेद् विजितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: jīved varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ / somasya coparāge tu yo gacched vijitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: सोपवासो जितक्रोधो गां तु दद्याद् द्विजन्मने । सवत्सां क्षीरसंयुक्तां श्वेतवर्णां बलान्विताम्
verses.transliteration: sopavāso jitakrodho gāṃ tu dadyād dvijanmane / savatsāṃ kṣīrasaṃyuktāṃ śvetavarṇāṃ balānvitām
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585
verses.commentary: Sense: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: शबलीं पीतवर्णां वा धूम्रां वा नीलकन्धराम् । कपिलां वा सवस्त्रां वा घण्टाभरणभूषिताम्
verses.transliteration: śabalīṃ pītavarṇāṃ vā dhūmrāṃ vā nīlakandharām / kapilāṃ vā savastrāṃ vā ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitām
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.sanskrit: रौप्यखुरां कांस्यदोहां स्वर्णशृङ्गीं नरेश्वर । श्वेतया वर्धते वंशो रक्ता सौभाग्यवर्धिनी
verses.transliteration: raupyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ nareśvara / śvetayā vardhate vaṃśo raktā saubhāgyavardhinī
verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.translation: The Greatness of Rnamocana TIrtha 585

verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the excel¬ lent Bhandan Tirtha. It is the means of averting poverty for a period of nineteen Yugas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो मृतो याति पुरं रवेः । चन्द्रादित्यम् इति ख्यातं तत्र तीर्थं नरोत्तम

verses.transliteration: vijayante sadā kālaṃ candrādityaṃ vrajanti ye

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे चन्द्रादित्येश्वरमहिमानुवर्णनो नाम सप्ताधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय १०८ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत् तु राजेन्द्र यमहासमनुत्तमम् । सर्वपापहरं पार्थ रेवायास्तटम् आश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe candrādityeśvaramahimānuvarṇano nāma saptādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 108 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra yamahāsamanuttamam / sarvapāpaharaṃ pārtha revāyāstaṭam āśritam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the excellent Rohini Tirtha well-known in all the three worlds and extremely destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the excellent Rohini Tirtha well-known in all the three worlds and extremely destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: यमहासं कथं जातं पृथिव्यां मुनिपुङ्गव । एतत् सर्वं समाख्याहि मम कौतूहलं परम्
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: yamahāsaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ pṛthivyāṃ munipuṅgava / etat sarvaṃ samākhyāhi mama kautūhalaṃ param
verses.translation: These words of the Lotus-navelled One were listened to by Lord (Brahma), O descendant of Bharata. He remem¬ bered (seven sages and) mentally created the seven sages with a desire for the welfare (of the worlds). These wise ones were remembered in this order: Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Pracetas, Vasistha, Bhrgu and Narada.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: साधु साधु महाभाग पृष्टं ते धर्मनन्दन । स्नानार्थं नर्मदायां तु आगतस् ते पिता पुरा
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sādhu sādhu mahābhāga pṛṣṭaṃ te dharmanandana / snānārthaṃ narmadāyāṃ tu āgatas te pitā purā
verses.translation: She made her body emaciated through fasts for a single night, three nights together, six nights, twelve nights, a fortnight and even for months.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: She made her body emaciated through fasts for a single night, three nights together, six nights, twelve nights, a fortnight and even for months.
verses.commentary: Sense: She made her body emaciated through fasts for a single night, three nights together, six nights, twelve nights, a fortnight and even for months.

verses.sanskrit: रजकेन यथा धौतं निर्मलं वसनं भवेत् । तथैव पश्यता राजन् रेवाजलम् अनुत्तमम्

verses.sanskrit: हास्यं कृतं यमेनाथ उत्थितं लिङ्गम् उत्तमम् । ततस् तदा हि राजेन्द्र वागुवाचा ऽशरीरिणी
verses.transliteration: hāsyaṃ kṛtaṃ yamenātha utthitaṃ liṅgam uttamam / tatas tadā hi rājendra vāguvācā 'śarīriṇī

verses.sanskrit: यमहासम् इदं तीर्थं ख्यातिं यास्यति सर्वदा । स्नापयित्वा शिवं तत्र यमः स्वर्गं जगाम ह

verses.translation: She made her body emaciated through fasts for a single night, three nights together, six nights, twelve nights, a fortnight and even for months.

verses.sanskrit: यमस्य वाहनं स्त्रीं च महिषीं तत्र भारत । तस्य दानेन सततं यमः प्रीतो भवेन् नृप

verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the excellent Cakra TIrtha well-known as Senapura. It is conducive to the destruction of all sins.

verses.transliteration: tiṣṭhate caiva gotreṣu yo dadyāc ca tilodakam / kārtikyāṃ ca tathā māghyāṃ vaiśākhyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ

verses.transliteration: svargaṃ ca te prayāntyante svasvaputraprabhāvataḥ / etat te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dvīpeśvaraphalaṃ śubham

verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhet prātar utthāya yaḥ śṛṇoti naro nṛpa / so 'pi pāpair vinirmukto modate śivamandire

verses.transliteration: īśvaraṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ nirmitaṃ ṛṣipuṅgavaiḥ / kāmadaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ revāyāṃ ca nṛpottama

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे द्वीपेश्वरव्यासतीर्थवर्णनो नाम नवाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ११० मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत् तु राजेन्द्र प्रभासेश्वरम् उत्तमम् । विख्यातां त्रिषु लोकेषु स्वर्गसोपानम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe dvīpeśvaravyāsatīrthavarṇano nāma navādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 110 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra prabhāseśvaram uttamam / vikhyātāṃ triṣu lokeṣu svargasopānam uttamam
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to Dhautapapa Tirtha that destroys great sins. It was created by Visnu formerly and is very near to Cakra Tirtha.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: प्रभासं नाम तीर्थं तु यथाजातं महाफलम् । स्वर्गसोपानमार्गं च संक्षेपात् कथयस्व मे
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: prabhāsaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ tu yathājātaṃ mahāphalam / svargasopānamārgaṃ ca saṃkṣepāt kathayasva me
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to Dhautapapa Tirtha that destroys great sins. It was created by Visnu formerly and is very near to Cakra Tirtha.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: दुर्भगा रविपत्नी च प्रभा नामेति विश्रुता । तया चाराधितः शम्भुर् उग्रेण तपसा पुरा
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: durbhagā ravipatnī ca prabhā nāmeti viśrutā / tayā cārādhitaḥ śambhur ugreṇa tapasā purā
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to Dhautapapa Tirtha that destroys great sins. It was created by Visnu formerly and is very near to Cakra Tirtha.

verses.sanskrit: वायुभक्षा स्थिता वर्षं शिवध्यानपरायणा । ततस् तुष्टो महादेवः प्रभां तां पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: vāyubhakṣā sthitā varṣaṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇā / tatas tuṣṭo mahādevaḥ prabhāṃ tāṃ pāṇḍunandana

verses.transliteration: uvāca kliśyate kasmād bāle tvaṃ brūhi ceṣṭitam / ahaṃ ca bhāskaropetaś cāntaraṃ naiva vidyate

verses.transliteration: prabhovāca: nānyo devas tathā śambho bhartā puṣyati na kvacit / saguṇo vāpi cākhyāto nirguṇo dravyavarjitaḥ

verses.transliteration: priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyaḥ strīṇāṃ bhartā hi devatā / durbhagā tvena dagdhāhaṃ lokamadhye maheśvara

verses.transliteration: alabdhasaukhyā bhartuś ca tena kliśye maheśvara / deva uvāca: vallabhā bhāskarasya tvaṃ matprabhāvād bhaviṣyasi

verses.transliteration: pārvaty uvāca: vallabhā tava vākyena bhāskare na bhaviṣyati / vṛthā kleśo bhaved eva prabhāyās tatra kā kathā

verses.sanskrit: देवीवाक्येन रुद्रेण ध्यातस् तिमिरनाशनः । आगतो गगनाद् भानुर् नर्मदायोत्तरे तटे
verses.transliteration: devīvākyena rudreṇa dhyātas timiranāśanaḥ / āgato gaganād bhānur narmadāyottare taṭe

verses.sanskrit: भानुर् उवाच: कस्माद् आह्वानितो देव अन्धकासुरनाशन । देव उवाच: प्रभां पालय हे भानो सन्तोषेण परेण च
verses.transliteration: bhānur uvāca: kasmād āhvānito deva andhakāsuranāśana / deva uvāca: prabhāṃ pālaya he bhāno santoṣeṇa pareṇa ca

verses.transliteration: prabhāyā mandire nityaṃ sthīyatāṃ himanāśana / evaṃ labdhavarā devāt prabhā sthāpyāha śaṅkaram

verses.transliteration: svāṃśena sthīyatām atra tīrthamunmīlayānagha / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sarvadevam ayaṃ liṅgaṃ sthāpitaṃ pāṇḍunandana

verses.sanskrit: प्रभासेश्वरनामेदं सर्वलोके च दुर्लभम् । अन्यानि यानि तीर्थानि काले ते ऽपि फलन्ति वै

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे प्रभासतीर्थमहिमानुवर्णनो नाम दशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय १११ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत् तु राजेन्द्र नर्मदादक्षिणे तटे । स्थापितं वासुकेर् नाम्ना अशेषाघौघनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe prabhāsatīrthamahimānuvarṇano nāma daśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 111 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe / sthāpitaṃ vāsuker nāmnā aśeṣāghaughanāśanam
verses.translation: There is an extremely splendid Tirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It was formerly created by Skanda after performing a very severe penance.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: There is an extremely splendid Tirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It was formerly created by Skanda after performing a very severe penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is an extremely splendid Tirtha on the southern bank of Narmada. It was formerly created by Skanda after performing a very severe penance.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: आः कस्मात् कारणात् तात स्थापितं दक्षिणे तटे । तत्त्वं सर्वं ममाख्याहि त्व् अशेषं धर्मकारणम्
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: āḥ kasmāt kāraṇāt tāta sthāpitaṃ dakṣiṇe taṭe / tattvaṃ sarvaṃ mamākhyāhi tv aśeṣaṃ dharmakāraṇam
verses.translation: W 3-21 describe the story of the birth of Skanda. If differs from a similar siory in Mbh and other Puranas on the following points: i. Siva invites Smara (god of Love) to inspire him sexually.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: शृणु त्वं कुरुशार्दूल यः प्रश्नः क्रियते त्वया । भैरवं रूपमास्थाय नृत्यं शम्भुश् चकार ह
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu tvaṃ kuruśārdūla yaḥ praśnaḥ kriyate tvayā / bhairavaṃ rūpamāsthāya nṛtyaṃ śambhuś cakāra ha
verses.translation: On hearing these splendid words of the Devas, Paramesvara who was enamoured of Goddess Uma mentally recollected Smara (god of Love).
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रमाज् जायते स्वेदो गङ्गातोयविमिश्रितः । तत्रैव पन्नगः स्नातो हरतोयविमिश्रिते
verses.transliteration: tac chramāj jāyate svedo gaṅgātoyavimiśritaḥ / tatraiva pannagaḥ snāto haratoyavimiśrite
verses.translation: If there is any pain caused by our seed deposited in your belly, cast off that fiery refulgence in the waters of Ganga, O Hutasana (Fire).
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मन्दाकिनी ततः क्रुद्धा व्यालस्योपरि भारत । अजगरत्वमाप्नोषि उरगं चाब्रवीत् तदा
verses.transliteration: mandākinī tataḥ kruddhā vyālasyopari bhārata / ajagaratvamāpnoṣi uragaṃ cābravīt tadā
verses.translation: Day and night he muttered ritualistically passages from Rk, Yujus and Saman. He meditated upon Mahadeva with great purity. He became so emaciated that all his veins became visible.

verses.sanskrit: वासुकिर् उवाच: अनुग्राह्यो ऽस्म्य् अहं पापो भवत्या हरसम्भृते । त्रैलोक्यपावनी पुण्या सरित् त्वं शुभलक्षणे

verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: prasanno 'haṃ mahābāho revāṃ gaccha śubhāṃ tvaram / yāmye caiva taṭe puṇye snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ

verses.transliteration: yo japet salile bhaktyā ityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt / śrāddhaṃ tatraiva yo bhaktyā kurute nṛpanandana

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे मार्कण्डेश्वरमहिमानुवर्णनो नामैकादशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ११२ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत् तु राजेन्द्र तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले यज्ञवाटस्य मध्यतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeśvaramahimānuvarṇano nāmaikādaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 112 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / uttare narmadākūle yajñavāṭasya madhyataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the Tirtha of Ahgirasa. It is situated on the northern bank of Narmada and is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: संकर्षणं च विख्यातं पृथिव्यां पापनाशनम् । तपश्चीर्णं पुरा राजन् नर्मदायास् तटे शुभे

verses.transliteration: annadānena bho rājan kīrtitaṃ phalam uttamam / sopānaṃ svargamārgasya pṛthivyāṃ manmatheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the Tirtha of Ahgirasa. It is situated on the northern bank of Narmada and is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the Tirtha of Ahgirasa. It is situated on the northern bank of Narmada and is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the Tirtha of Ahgirasa. It is situated on the northern bank of Narmada and is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषात् तत्र संख्यातं श्राद्धदानेन भारत । अन्नदानेन भो राजन् कीर्तितं फलम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: viśeṣāt tatra saṃkhyātaṃ śrāddhadānena bhārata / annadānena bho rājan kīrtitaṃ phalam uttamam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the Tirtha of Ahgirasa. It is situated on the northern bank of Narmada and is destructive of all sins.

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the Tirtha of Ahgirasa. It is situated on the northern bank of Narmada and is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् ते सर्वम् आख्यातं तव भक्त्या तु भारत
verses.transliteration: etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ tava bhaktyā tu bhārata
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the Tirtha of Ahgirasa. It is situated on the northern bank of Narmada and is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the Tirtha of Ahgirasa. It is situated on the northern bank of Narmada and is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the Tirtha of Ahgirasa. It is situated on the northern bank of Narmada and is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे मन्मथेश्वरमहिमानुवर्णनोनाम द्वादशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ११३ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत् तु राजेन्द्र एरण्डीसङ्गमेश्वरम् । प्रख्यातं सर्वलोकेषु ब्रह्महत्याप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe manmatheśvaramahimānuvarṇanonāma dvādaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 113 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra eraṇḍīsaṅgameśvaram / prakhyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu brahmahatyāpraṇāśanam
verses.translation: Five cow Products, viz. milk, curds, butter and liquid and solid excreta.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Five cow Products, viz. milk, curds, butter and liquid and solid excreta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Five cow Products, viz. milk, curds, butter and liquid and solid excreta.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कारणं नैव जाने ऽहं तत्सर्वं कथयस्व मे । एवम् उक्तस् तु धर्मात्मा धर्मपुत्रेण धीमता
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kāraṇaṃ naiva jāne 'haṃ tatsarvaṃ kathayasva me / evam uktas tu dharmātmā dharmaputreṇa dhīmatā
verses.translation: After the day has dawned clearly on the eighth day, O king, the devotee should honour Brahmanas devoid of all faults or disqualifications. They should have all the limbs and organs complete. They should be adepts in all scriptures. They should be regularly practising study of the Vedas and th«y should be devoted to their own wives. The Brahmanas should be deserving ones for Sraddha, Dana and Vrata, O son of
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: After the day has dawned clearly on the eighth day, O king, the devotee should honour Brahmanas devoid of all faults or disqualifications. They should have all the limbs and organs complete. They should be adepts in all scriptures.…

verses.sanskrit: कथयामास तत्सर्वम् ऋषिसङ्घैः समावृतः । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: कथितं चोमया पूर्वं शम्भुना परमेष्ठिना
verses.transliteration: kathayāmāsa tatsarvam ṛṣisaṅghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: kathitaṃ comayā pūrvaṃ śambhunā parameṣṭhinā
verses.translation: Thereafter one goes to the Tirtha called Karania. There e takes the holy bath, O great king, and observes fast with

verses.sanskrit: तत् ते ऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि श्रूयतां भ्रातृभिः सह । महेश्वर उवाच: अत्रिर् नामाह्वयो देव मानसो ब्रह्मणः सुतः
verses.transliteration: tat te 'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ saha / maheśvara uvāca: atrir nāmāhvayo deva mānaso brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: O Yudhisthira, none of the following (evil things) shall occur to him in the course of seven births: misfortune, wretchedness, penury, grief-incurring bondage and infertility.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Yudhisthira, none of the following (evil things) shall occur to him in the course of seven births: misfortune, wretchedness, penury, grief-incurring bondage and infertility.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Yudhisthira, none of the following (evil things) shall occur to him in the course of seven births: misfortune, wretchedness, penury, grief-incurring bondage and infertility.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निहोत्ररतो नित्यं देवता ऽतिथिपूजकः । सोमः संस्थापितो ऽत्रैव कृतो विप्रेण पर्वते
verses.transliteration: agnihotrarato nityaṃ devatā 'tithipūjakaḥ / somaḥ saṃsthāpito 'traiva kṛto vipreṇa parvate
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the excel¬ lent Bhandan Tirtha. It is the means of averting poverty for a period of nineteen Yugas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the excel¬ lent Bhandan Tirtha. It is the means of averting poverty for a period of nineteen Yugas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, one should go to the excel¬ lent Bhandan Tirtha. It is the means of averting poverty for a period of nineteen Yugas.

verses.sanskrit: अनसूयेति नाम्ना वै तस्य भार्या गुणान्विता । पतिव्रता पतिप्राणा पत्युः कार्यहिते रता
verses.transliteration: anasūyeti nāmnā vai tasya bhāryā guṇānvitā / pativratā patiprāṇā patyuḥ kāryahite ratā
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the excellent Rohini Tirtha well-known in all the three worlds and extremely destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the excellent Rohini Tirtha well-known in all the three worlds and extremely destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: एवं जातः सदा कालो न पुत्रो न च पुत्रिका । अपराह्णे महाबाहो सुखासीनौ तु तौ क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ jātaḥ sadā kālo na putro na ca putrikā / aparāhṇe mahābāho sukhāsīnau tu tau kvacit
verses.translation: These words of the Lotus-navelled One were listened to by Lord (Brahma), O descendant of Bharata. He remem¬ bered (seven sages and) mentally created the seven sages with a desire for the welfare (of the worlds). These wise ones were remembered in this order: Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Pracetas, Vasistha, Bhrgu and Narada.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: These words of the Lotus-navelled One were listened to by Lord (Brahma), O descendant of Bharata. He remem¬ bered (seven sages and) mentally created the seven sages with a desire for the welfare (of the worlds). These wise ones were remembered in this order: Pulastya, Pulaha,…

verses.sanskrit: वदतः सुखदुःखानि दैवदत्तानि यानि च । अत्रिर् उवाच: सौम्ये शुभे प्रिये कान्ते सुरूपे प्रियभाषिणि
verses.transliteration: vadataḥ sukhaduḥkhāni daivadattāni yāni ca / atrir uvāca: saumye śubhe priye kānte surūpe priyabhāṣiṇi
verses.translation: She made her body emaciated through fasts for a single night, three nights together, six nights, twelve nights, a fortnight and even for months.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: She made her body emaciated through fasts for a single night, three nights together, six nights, twelve nights, a fortnight and even for months.
verses.commentary: Sense: She made her body emaciated through fasts for a single night, three nights together, six nights, twelve nights, a fortnight and even for months.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाकारे प्रियकामे निरालसे । न त्वया सदृशी लोके त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे
verses.transliteration: pūrṇacandranibhākāre priyakāme nirālase / na tvayā sadṛśī loke trailokye sacarācare
verses.translation: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the excellent Cakra TIrtha well-known as Senapura. It is conducive to the destruction of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O king, one should go to the excellent Cakra TIrtha well-known as Senapura. It is conducive to the destruction of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: पतिपुत्रप्रिया नारी सुहृज्जनहिते रता । पुत्रेण लोकाज् जयति पुत्रेण परमा गतिः
verses.transliteration: patiputrapriyā nārī suhṛjjanahite ratā / putreṇa lokāj jayati putreṇa paramā gatiḥ
verses.translation: The various weapons used by him were Sakti, Rsti, Pasa, Musala, Khadga (sword), Tomara (iron rod), Tahkana

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति पुत्रसमो बन्धुः पृथिव्यां चैव दृश्यते । असिपत्रवने घोरे पतन्तं यो ऽभिरक्षति

verses.translation: The various weapons used by him were Sakti, Rsti, Pasa, Musala, Khadga (sword), Tomara (iron rod), Tahkana

verses.transliteration: durbhikṣeṣv api dainyādau vṛddhakāle 'pi putrakaḥ / putraṃ vinā ca kiṃ bhadre jīvitaiḥ sadhanair api
verses.translation: The various weapons used by him were Sakti, Rsti, Pasa, Musala, Khadga (sword), Tomara (iron rod), Tahkana

verses.translation: The various weapons used by him were Sakti, Rsti, Pasa, Musala, Khadga (sword), Tomara (iron rod), Tahkana

verses.translation: The various weapons used by him were Sakti, Rsti, Pasa, Musala, Khadga (sword), Tomara (iron rod), Tahkana

verses.transliteration: ahaś ca madhyarātre ca cintyamānaś ca sarvadā / śuṣyanti mama gātrāṇi grīṣme kusarito yathā
verses.translation: The various weapons used by him were Sakti, Rsti, Pasa, Musala, Khadga (sword), Tomara (iron rod), Tahkana
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: The various weapons used by him were Sakti, Rsti, Pasa, Musala, Khadga (sword), Tomara (iron rod), Tahkana

verses.transliteration: anasūyovāca: yat tvayā sūcitaṃ vipra tatsarvaṃ śocayāmy aham / tavodvegakaraṃ kāryaṃ tan me dahati cetasi
verses.translation: The various weapons used by him were Sakti, Rsti, Pasa, Musala, Khadga (sword), Tomara (iron rod), Tahkana
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe eraṇḍītīrthamahimānuvarṇano nāma trayodaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 114 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: etasyānantaraṃ pārtha sauvarṇaṃ tīrtham uttamam / vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं तु देवो महादेव सपत्नीको वृषध्वज । यथा ते देव देवेश न वियोगः कदाचन
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ tu devo mahādeva sapatnīko vṛṣadhvaja / yathā te deva deveśa na viyogaḥ kadācana

verses.sanskrit: सोमनाथाख्यकार्पण्यात् तं ध्यायाम् ईह चिन्तयन् । ज्येष्ठे शुक्ले तृतीयायां सौभाग्ये नर्मदाजले
verses.transliteration: somanāthākhyakārpaṇyāt taṃ dhyāyām īha cintayan / jyeṣṭhe śukle tṛtīyāyāṃ saubhāgye narmadājale

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा दत्त्वा च सुभगा न प्रियेण वियुज्यते । युधिष्ठिर उवाच: न दौर्भाग्यं न दारिद्र्यं न शोको न च दुर्गतिः
verses.transliteration: snātvā dattvā ca subhagā na priyeṇa viyujyate / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: na daurbhāgyaṃ na dāridryaṃ na śoko na ca durgatiḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् सर्वं भवेद् येन तत्सर्वं कथयस्व मे । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: दौर्भाग्यं दुर्गतिं चैव दारिद्र्यं शोकवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: etat sarvaṃ bhaved yena tatsarvaṃ kathayasva me / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: daurbhāgyaṃ durgatiṃ caiva dāridryaṃ śokavardhanam

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: वैधव्यं सप्तजन्मनि जायते न युधिष्ठिर । कर्मणा येन पापानां क्षयस् तच् च वदामि ते
verses.transliteration: vaidhavyaṃ saptajanmani jāyate na yudhiṣṭhira / karmaṇā yena pāpānāṃ kṣayas tac ca vadāmi te
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठे मासे सिते पक्षे ततीयायां विशेषतः । तत्र स्नात्वा तु यो भक्त्या पञ्चाग्निं साधयेत् तपः
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhe māse site pakṣe tatīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ / tatra snātvā tu yo bhaktyā pañcāgniṃ sādhayet tapaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.

verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि पापैर् अशेषैस् तु मुच्यते नात्र संशयः । गुग्गुलुं दाहयेद् यस् तु गौरी शिवसमीपतः
verses.transliteration: so 'pi pāpair aśeṣais tu mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / gugguluṃ dāhayed yas tu gaurī śivasamīpataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् कर्मणि विप्रस्य उक्तानि भवते ततः । देहपाते कृते स्वर्गम् इत्य् एवं शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tasmin karmaṇi viprasya uktāni bhavate tataḥ / dehapāte kṛte svargam ity evaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतैरक्तैस् तथा पीतैर् वस्त्रैश् च विविधैः शुभैः । ब्राह्मणीर्ब्राह्मणांश् चैव पूजयित्वा यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: śvetairaktais tathā pītair vastraiś ca vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ / brāhmaṇīrbrāhmaṇāṃś caiva pūjayitvā yathāvidhi

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पैर् नानाविधैश् चैव गन्धधूपैः सुशोभनैः । कण्ठे सूत्रं समाधाय कुङ्कुमेन विलेपयेत्
verses.transliteration: puṣpair nānāvidhaiś caiva gandhadhūpaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ / kaṇṭhe sūtraṃ samādhāya kuṅkumena vilepayet

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पयित्वा स्त्रियं गौरीं ब्राह्मणं शिवरूपिणम् । ताभ्यां दद्यात् समादृत्य दानम् उत्सृज्य वारिणा
verses.transliteration: kalpayitvā striyaṃ gaurīṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śivarūpiṇam / tābhyāṃ dadyāt samādṛtya dānam utsṛjya vāriṇā

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णवेष्टं त्वङ्गदं च काञ्चनीं मुद्रिकां तथा । सप्तधान्यं तथा देयं भोजनं नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: karṇaveṣṭaṃ tvaṅgadaṃ ca kāñcanīṃ mudrikāṃ tathā / saptadhānyaṃ tathā deyaṃ bhojanaṃ nṛpasattama

verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यानि चैव दानानि तस्मिंस् तीर्थे नरोत्तम । सर्वदानैश् च यत्पुण्यं तत्पुण्यं त्रिगुणं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: anyāni caiva dānāni tasmiṃs tīrthe narottama / sarvadānaiś ca yatpuṇyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ triguṇaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.transliteration: tatra sāhasraguṇitaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā / śaṅkareṇa samaṃ tatra bhuṅkte bhogān anuttamān
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: सौभाग्यं तस्य विपुलं जायते नात्र संशयः । अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रं निर्धनो धनम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: saubhāgyaṃ tasya vipulaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / aputro labhate putraṃ nirdhano dhanam āpnuyāt
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: कामदं तीर्थराजं तु नर्मदायां व्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: kāmadaṃ tīrtharājaṃ tu narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the extremely splendid Ayonija Tirtha of great merit, that is de¬ structive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे सौभाग्यतीर्थमहिमानुवर्णनो नाम चतुर्दशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्स् अध्याय ११५ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत् तु राजेन्द्र भाण्डारं तीर्थम् उत्तमम् । दारिद्र्यभेदकरणं पुरुषांश् चैकविंशतिम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe saubhāgyatīrthamahimānuvarṇano nāma caturdaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 115 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra bhāṇḍāraṃ tīrtham uttamam / dāridryabhedakaraṇaṃ puruṣāṃś caikaviṃśatim
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the great Angaraka Tirtha that accords handsome features to all people. It is situated on the banks of Narmada and is well- known.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the great Angaraka Tirtha that accords handsome features to all people. It is situated on the banks of Narmada and is well- known.

verses.sanskrit: धनदेन तपस्तप्तं प्रसन्नः पद्मसम्भवः । तत्रैव स्वस्वदानेन प्राप्तं वित्तमनन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: dhanadena tapastaptaṃ prasannaḥ padmasambhavaḥ / tatraiva svasvadānena prāptaṃ vittamanantakam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the great Angaraka Tirtha that accords handsome features to all people. It is situated on the banks of Narmada and is well- known.

verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the great Angaraka Tirtha that accords handsome features to all people. It is situated on the banks of Narmada and is well- known.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा तु यो भक्त्या स्नात्वा वित्तं प्रयच्छति । तस्य वित्तपरिच्छेदो न भवेच् च कदाचन

verses.transliteration: iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe cakratīrthamahimānuvarṇano nāma pañcadaśādhika śatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 116 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: dhūmapātaṃ tato gacchen mahāpātakanāśanam / samīpe cakratīrthasyā viṣṇunā nirmitaṃ purā

verses.sanskrit: अर्घं दत्त्वा यथान्यायं पूजयित्वा ऋषीन् सदा । अश्वैर्गजैस् तथा रथैर् भ्रातृभिः सह धर्मराट्
verses.transliteration: arghaṃ dattvā yathānyāyaṃ pūjayitvā ṛṣīn sadā / aśvairgajais tathā rathair bhrātṛbhiḥ saha dharmarāṭ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the great Angaraka Tirtha that accords handsome features to all people. It is situated on the banks of Narmada and is well- known.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य नित्य इसका पठन या श्रवण करता है, सत्यदेवके प्रसादसे उसके ' सारे पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the great Angaraka Tirtha that accords handsome features to all people. It is situated on the banks of Narmada and is well- known.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the great Angaraka Tirtha that accords handsome features to all people. It is situated on the banks of Narmada and is well- known.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थयात्रां चकाराशु नर्मदायां युधिष्ठिर । उत्तरे दक्षिणे तीरे स्नानपानावगाहनम्
verses.transliteration: tīrthayātrāṃ cakārāśu narmadāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira / uttare dakṣiṇe tīre snānapānāvagāhanam
verses.translation: Thereafter, O great king, a person should go to the great Angaraka Tirtha that accords handsome features to all people. It is situated on the banks of Narmada and is well- known.
